original: I hate to even think that Leo is stealing from us, but he can't really seem to explain where the money is going. A cap or two is an honest mistake, but we're talking over a hundred per month here. I can't really accuse him of stealing, but something is going on. \n\nAnd the oddest thing... Doc Church seems to know something about Leo, but won't tell me.
translation: 我不愿意怀疑利奥是内贼，但他根本解释不清钱到哪儿去了。要是少了一两个瓶盖确实有情可原，但是我们每个月都不见一百多个。我现在不能肯定是他偷的，但这事绝对有问题。\n\n最奇怪的是……丘奇博士好像知道些有关利奥的事情，但他不跟我讲。

original: Mission Orders
translation: 任务指令

original:
Mission Directive: Establish and enforce Enclave presence among general populace, disposal of genetic non-compliance offenders.

I.	Establish constituency enforcement point at coordinates 39.138 x -77.070. Monitor civilian movement in area, and debrief superior regarding any events of notable significance or regularity.

II.	Distribute purified water rations to civilians willing to submit to genetic compliance screening. Participation in screening is compulsory for all civilians, and use of force is authorized in enforcement.

III.	Genetic non-compliance offenders should be detained at checkpoint. 

IV.	To conserve consumption of Enclave resources, detainees should be disposed of by flame only when withholding facility becomes overcrowded, or detainees become unmanageable, whichever comes first.
translation:
任务指示：在普通民众中树立并加强英克雷的存在，处置基因违规者。

I.	在坐标39.138 x -77.070处建立选区执行点。监视地区内公民的活动，向上级汇报任何有特殊价值和长期规律性事件。

II.	向愿意接受基因顺从性筛查的平民分发纯化水配给。所有平民都必须参加筛查，在执法时允许使用武力。

III.	基因违规者将在监测点拘留。

IV.	为了控制英克雷资源消耗，只有在扣留设施人满为患或被拘留者无法管理时（以先到者为准），才应使用火焰处置。

original: Field Report
translation: 战地报告

original: Field Report - Prepared by NCO J.Tuckman by audio dictation on behalf of PFC Matthew Scott. PFC Scott’s voice is the only source recorded in the following text.\n\n<<BEGIN FILE>> Sir, I encountered three Ferals on my patrol. This was somewhere around 0300 hours, I think, and it was dark, so they saw me first. I discharged my firearm four times, fatally striking two of the three. My weapon jammed before I could fire on the third target, and just then I realized it wasn’t engaging. I knew our orders were to report on anything unusual, and well -- I thought that was pretty strange. He actually followed me back here on his own. We put him in the trailer with the other and he's been quiet as you like. Strangest thing I’ve ever seen. << END FILE>>
translation: 战地报告 — 由军士长J.达克曼代表一等兵马修·斯科特通过口述录音编写。一等兵斯科特的声音是以下文本中记录的唯一来源。\n\n<<BEGIN FILE>> 长官，我在巡逻时遇到了三个狂尸鬼。我想那是在03:00左右，当时很黑，所以他们先看到了我。我开了四枪，打死了其中两个。我还没来得及向第三个目标开火，武器就卡住了，就在这时，我意识到它没有进攻。我知道我们的命令是报告任何异常情况，但我觉得这很奇怪。他其实是自己跟着我回来的。我们把他和其他东西关在拖车里，他一直很安静。这是我见过的最奇怪的事了。<< END FILE>>

original:
Welcome to the Nuka-Cola Packing Line Operator's Station! You are now instrumental in getting Nuka-Cola from our factory and to the public, so please read the simple instructions below. If you need assistance, please call x347 and ask for your Line Supervisor.

1. Access the Packing Terminal and choose desired inventory to load into Sorting Units.
2. Select "Activate Packing Line."
3. Monitor the Packing Line by listening for things such as mechanical screeching, explosions and/or human cries for help.
4. If there is an emergency, DO NOT PANIC! Simply call x347 and ask for your Line Supervisor. The Packing Line will automatically shut down in the event of an issue.

Remember, only you can prevent inventory loss by being attentive and vigilant!

欢迎来到核子可乐包装线操作员站！你现在是将核子可乐从工厂送达公众手中的关键一环，因此请阅读以下简要说明。如需帮助，请拨打x347并找你的生产线主管。

1、访问包装终端，选择想要的货物装入分捡装置。
2、选择“启动包装线”。
3、通过声音来监听包装线的运作，比如发动机尖啸声、爆炸或者其他人的呼救。
4、如遇到紧急情况，请勿慌张！只需拨打x347，联系你的生产线主管。包装线出现问题时会自动停止运行。

请记住，只有你的细心和警惕才能够预防货物的损失！

original: CapitalPostTerminalNote1a
translation: 首都邮报终端机记录1a

original:
By Dorothy Proud

Capital Post Staff Writer

In the late evening hours of January 10th, brave American Army forces launched an all-out offensive against the entrenched Chinese Communist invaders in the beleaguered seaport of Anchorage, Alaska, destroying all opposition and finally liberating the city after more than ten years of Chinese occupation. 

No red-blooded American can ever forget that terrible winter of 2066, when Chairman Cheng’s commie cutthroats mercilessly invaded the icy extension of the United States, in an unprecedented act of foreign aggression that sent shockwaves all the way back to our nation’s Capital.

But the nightmare is finally over, and America, always the home of the brave, is once again the land of the free.
translation:
作者 多萝茜·普劳德

《首都邮报》特约撰稿人

1月10号的深夜，英勇的美军战士们启动了针对围攻入侵阿拉斯加安克雷奇港口的中国入侵者的全面反击行动，消灭了所有的共匪并最终解放了这座被中共军事占领长达10年之久的城市。

没有一个热血的美国人能够忘记2066年那个恐怖的冬天，当中共党魁程主席无情地向美国铁血扩张时，这个史无前例的外来入侵给我们国家的首都带来了强大的冲击。

但是噩梦终究完结了，美利坚，这个永恒的英雄家园，再次恢复了自由之身。

original: CapitalPostTerminalNote2a
translation: 首都邮报终端机记录2a

original:
By Dorothy Proud

Capital Post Staff Writer

In a move that is being widely viewed as both necessary and overdue, the United States military today declared that they will begin the immediate annexation of the country of Canada.

The decision comes after a long and contentious relationship with the Canadian government that began shortly after the Chinese invasion of Anchorage, Alaska in the winter of 2066. The Canadian leadership at that time expressed its opposition to American troops passing through their country or traversing their airspace, but ultimately capitulated.

Tensions with our neighbor to the north have only escalated since then as the United States has found itself relying heavily on Canada’s natural resources - including wood cultivated from the country’s great Timberland forests - to maintain the war effort against China.

But it was a recent near-sabotage of the Alaskan pipeline that finally tipped the American military’s hand. 

"That was the last straw," said Buzz Babcock, commander of U.S. forces in Canada. "You know what’s been stopping the Reds from pouring into downtown Juneau? American soldiers, that’s what. And now we’ve got to worry about someone - Chinese, Alaskan, or otherwise - taking out the pipeline? I don’t think so. Effectively immediately, United States troops are beginning a complete takeover of all Canadian assets and resources. Little America is ours. But let’s face it - it always has been."
translation:
作者 多萝茜·普劳德

《首都邮报》特约撰稿人

一个迟来的必然的进步，合众国的军队今天宣布，他们将很快与加拿大合并。

在中国于2066年的冬天入侵位于阿拉斯加的安克雷奇后不久，经过与加拿大政府漫长而充满争议的双边洽谈，终于达成了这个决议。当时，加拿大的领导层表达了对于美国军队穿越他们的领土和领空的反对，但是他们最终屈服了。

当我们发现不得不严重地依赖于加拿大的自然资源——包括来自大森林的木材——以支撑这场同中国的战争之后，我们和北方邻居的紧张关系不断升级。

但是最近这条由美国军队控制的阿拉斯加输油管道一直受到蓄意破坏。

“这是他们的困兽之斗”在加拿大的合众国指挥官巴兹·巴布克如是说，“你知道是什么在阻止赤色涌入朱诺的商业区么？正是美国的战士。然后我们现在要让某些人——中国人，阿拉斯加人，或者其他人——来占领输油管道么？我不这样认为。事实上，美国军队很快就将要全部接收加拿大的财产和资源。“小美国”是我们的。请正视这一点——它一直如此。”

original: CapitalPostTerminalNote1b
translation: 首都邮报终端机记录1b

original:
By Walter “Street Beat” Munroe

Capital Post Staff Writer

It would appear that Washington’s tolerance for American social disorder has finally reached its breaking point. 

In a recent public statement, White House spokesman Warren Eccleston said:

"Okay, Americans are hungry. We get it. Well I’ve got news for you - things are tough all over, people. The President himself has been forced to substitute cube steak for his nightly prime rib, and the only wine available is a detestable Chateau Montrose 2043. But does he whine? Does he take to the streets like a rabid Red? So please, good people, please. Wait in line. Get your food. And then go home. We’re Americans! We do not solve our problems with violence."
translation:
作者 沃尔特·“街拍”·芒罗

《首都邮报》特约撰稿人

看起来，华盛顿对于美国社会无序状态的容忍能力终于到了极限。 

在一份最近的公众声明中，白宫发言人沃伦·英克雷斯顿说：

“好吧, 美国人民在挨饿。我们了解这一点。嗯，我有一些消息给你们——到处都很艰难，各位。总统已经被迫用方牛排来代替往日晚餐的上等牛肋条，仅有的一瓶酒也是2043的劣质“蒙特罗斯庄园”。但是他抱怨过吗？像那些疯狂的激进分子走上街头吗？所以，求求你们，伟大的人民，求求你们，排队，领取食物，然后回家。我们是美国人！我们从不用暴力解决我们的问题！”

original: CapitalPostTerminalNote2b
translation: 首都邮报终端机记录2b

original:
By Walter “Street Beat” Munroe

Capital Post Staff Writer

In a startling turnaround from their previous policy of complete covert development, the United States Army has confirmed that they are indeed working on a new super weapon, one designed specifically to crush the Red Chinese invasion force and liberate occupied Anchorage, Alaska once and for all.

Speaking at an Army press conference at the Pentagon, General Constantine Chase stated: "No more secrets. The time has come to lay all our cards on the table, so the Chinese can see with their own eyes that we’ve got the winning hand. The United States Army is proud to announce that for the first time in history, General Atomics International and RobCo have joined forces to create for this great country a super weapon that will leave every single yellow-bellied Red shaking in their Commie booties."

Unfortunately for our readers, that’s as specific as Chase is willing to get. While he and the Army are ready for China to know the U.S. is developing a new weapon, they’re not quite ready to divulge just what it is, or when it will be ready for deployment.

"All in due time, all in due time. Rest assured, when this weapon is complete, liberty will come to Anchorage… and Hell will follow."
translation:
作者 沃尔特·“街拍”·芒罗

《首都邮报》特约撰稿人

合众国陆军已经确认，他们正在研制一种新的超级武器，专门用来粉碎红色中国入侵部队，并彻底解放被占领的阿拉斯加安克雷奇

在五角大楼召开的军方新闻发布会上，康士坦丁·蔡斯将军谈到:“没有什么秘密了。是时候全部摊牌了。中国人可以用他们自己的眼睛看看，我们已经稳操胜券。合众国的军队将历史上第一次骄傲地宣称，通用原子国际和机器人集团加入到了军方为这个伟大国度研制超级武器的行列当中，这将会让每一个黄皮鸟在他们的战利品上发抖。”

很不幸我的读者们，那个方案还未具体实施。当军队让中国知道合众国正在研究新式武器的时候，他们并没有准备完全透露那到底是什么，或者什么时候可以展开部署。

“一切尽在掌握。一切尽在掌握。毫无疑问，当这武器完成的时候，自由将会降临安克雷奇（地狱也将随之而来）。”

original: CapitalPostTerminalNote3a
translation: 首都邮报终端机记录3a

original:
By Dorothy Proud

Capital Post Staff Writer

In a crushing blow to foreign relations and world peace, the United Nations yesterday was completely disbanded, leaving its member nations to fend for themselves in these trying times.

Many had considered the United Nations the best hope for brokering a ceasefire between the European Commonwealth and the nations of the Middle East, but such an intervention is now impossible. 

In a somber press conference at the United Nations building in New York City, United Nations president Sakugama Okiri had this to say: "It is a sad day for the United States. Sadder still for the world. An era of relative peace and prosperity has come to a tragic end. The Resources Wars are upon us, and in my humble opinion the United Nations is needed now more than ever. Sadly, the world disagrees."

Those nations that have not already moved out of the immense headquarters will have completely vacated the premises by the end of the week. Several organizations have already begun bidding on the prime real estate, but children’s toy retailer Bumbalo's seems determined to transform the building into their new East Coast superstore.
translation:
作者 多萝茜·普劳德

《首都邮报》特约撰稿人

对于国际关系和世界和平这是一个致命的打击，昨天联合国彻底解散了，只留下成员国自己去渡过这段艰苦的日子。

很多人本来认为联合国是欧盟和中东国家之间停火的斡旋人，但是这种介入已经不再有可能了。

在纽约市联合国大会召开的这次压抑的新闻发布会上，联合国主席萨古伽玛·欧凯瑞就此问题谈到:“这对于联合国来说是悲伤的一天。对世界而言更糟。一段相对和平和繁荣的时期终于走到了悲惨的尽头。资源战争关乎我们每一个人，而且就我个人意见，我认为联合国比以往任何时候更有存在的必要。很遗憾，世界不答应。”

还未从这所巨大的总部中搬出的组织将在本周末之前完全撤离。另一些组织已经准备要承包这栋大楼的所有权，但是儿童玩具零售商邦巴拉公司看起来已经下定了决心，要把这栋楼变成他们的新的东海岸商店。

original:
He threw me in here! I cant believe he did it but that boltbrain foreman psychopath locked me in a closet!

A goddamn 17 minute break!? That's why it threw me in here!?

…

Its been a day, and that stupid robot hasn't even checked on me! I cant wait until the next time he opens that door, I'm going to brain him with this auto-stapler and then escape. This story will be front page news so fast that he'll have been reassigned with toaster duty by the time he sees it!

…

Day 3 and I'm running out of what little edible supplies there are, they dragged another guy in here as well, says his name is Seth from R&D. Apparently its now against company policy to leave the toilet seat up in the unisex bathrooms.

他把我扔在这里！我不相信他会这么做，但那个脑袋被门夹过的疯子把我锁在了厕所里！

休息了他妈的17分钟！？那就是把我扔在这里的理由！？

已经一天了，那白痴机器人还没来找我！我等不下去了，除非他下次来开门时我用自动订书机敲他的头之后再离开。这件事情会上报纸的头版，而当他看见这个头条的时候也就是他被分配去和烤面包机一起工作的时候！

……

第三天了，我这里仅剩的一点补给快吃完了，他们又拖了另一个家伙来这里，他是研发部的塞思。显然他是因为违法公司政策，没有放下男女公用盥洗室的马桶坐板。

original:
From: Scribe Elizabeth Jameson
To: Elder Lyons

Elder,

I have read the recent reports on the number of Paladins and Knights that have not reported in when expected. I understand the chaotic nature of the situation in the field, but tradition demands that each Brother who falls in battle have their death recorded in the Scrolls. To not put forward our best effort to recover proof of who has fallen and who has lived is unthinkable.

I understand that every Brother is needed for the efforts here at the Citadel and in the city nearby. To that end, I intend to contract with outsiders in order to recover proof of which of our brethren have fallen to the enemy. I will ask that they recover dog tags from any fallen brother that the find. It is the least we can do without the resources for a full and honorable funeral for them.

You needn't worry about providing rewards for these contractors. I will pay them from my personal funds. It is well worth it to me to be able to both keep the tradition and not stress the resources for your mission.

Yours In Steel,

Scribe Elizabeth Jameson
Head Librarian
Order of the Quill
DC Bunker
translation:
发信人：伊丽莎白·詹姆森学士
收信人：里昂斯长老

长老，

我读过了最近的报告，许多骑士和圣骑士没有按预期的那样返回报道。我理解这片区域现在混乱的形势，但根据我们的传统，每一位在战斗中牺牲的兄弟，在名册里都有他们的死亡记录。不尽我们最大的努力去查明那些牺牲和幸存下来的人，这是不可接受的。

我知道目前大本营这里和附近城区的工作需要每一位兄弟的力量。为此，我打算找一些外人签订合约，让他们去查明那些牺牲在敌人手下的兄弟们。我让他们找到牺牲的兄弟之后，就把遗体上的狗牌带回来给我。这是在不消耗资源的情况下，为他们举行的完整而光荣的葬礼，我们能做的也只有这样了。

你不用担心该如何慰劳这些合约人。我会用自己的钱来支付他们。这么做对我来说也很有意义，既延续了我们的传统，同时在你任务所需资金的问题上也不会有压力。

你的兄弟，

伊丽莎白·詹姆森学士
图书管理员组长
羽之修会

original: Report from first survey party
translation: 第一调查团的报告

original:
As our tests suggested, the immediate vicinity of the vault is no longer dangerously irradiated, although the background radiation is still well above safe levels. Pockets of more intense radiation appear to still be common, and all surface water seems to be undrinkable. We will need to carry ample supplies of Rad-X with us on all future surveys. But hazard suits do not seem to be necessary for general exploration.

Our old maps are largely useless. The town of Springvale is an abandoned ruin, and all Pre-War roads have disappeared or are no longer passable.

We encountered a group of monstrous ants which appeared to confirm Mackay's theories of mutation due to extended exposure to radiation. We drove off the ants with gunfire and collected several specimens for study upon return to the vault (see Exhibit A).

The good news is that human civilization still survives, despite everything! We discovered a settlement known as "Megaton" (see Exhibit B), whose inhabitants, although somewhat wary at first, soon welcomed us into their town. 

We spent a good deal of time in Megaton, and learned a great deal about the "Capital Wasteland" (as the area around Washington D.C. is now called) from them. Megaton is a fortified outpost of "civilization" (of sorts), but it seems that Giant Ants are the least of the dangers of this new world. We agreed that it was prudent to return to the Vault immediately to revise our survey plans in light of what we have learned. Lewis and Agnes remained in Megaton to serve as "ambassadors" and continue to collect information until we return.

Anne Palmer, Survey Team Leader
February 10, 2241
translation:
根据我们的检测，避难所的周围已经没有危险的放射性照射了，然而周边的辐射程度依然在安全等级之上。一些强烈的辐射依然很常见，暴露在外的水源看起来都无法饮用。在日后的考察行动中，我们需要带上足够的抗辐宁用做补给。不过在一般的探险过程中也没有必要穿着防护服。

旧地图基本已经没用了。春谷镇已经成了一片废墟，所有战前的公路，有的已经消失了，有的无法通行。

我们遭遇了一群巨大而畸形的蚂蚁，那些蚂蚁看起来验证了麦凯的理论，长期暴露于辐射之下会导致变异。我们击退了那些蚂蚁，还收集了一些它们的标本（见附件A），日后回到避难所的时候可以用于研究。

好消息是，尽管经历了那么多的灾难，人类文明依然延续了下来！我们发现了一个名叫“兆吨镇”（见附件B）的定居点，那里的居民开始还有些警惕，但很快就接待我们进入了镇子。

我们在兆吨镇的那段时间很不错，并且从居民那里了解了很多关于“首都废土”（指的就是华盛顿特区以及它的周围。这是新的叫法）的事情。兆吨镇是一个“文明”(勉强的说法)的加强前哨站，但那些大蚂蚁看上去只是这个新世界里一种微不足道的威胁。我们一致认为现在明智的做法，就是立即返回避难所，按照我们之前所了解的信息，重新修改我们的考察计划。路易斯和艾格尼丝作为“使者”留在了兆吨镇，继续收集着信息直到我们回去

安妮·帕尔默，侦察小队队长
2241年，2月10日

translation: Rho营地的指南

original:
DEPARTMENT OF THE ARMY
RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT
FIELD OPERATIONS SECTOR, 693R

RRD-HG53-P R27-866-51

WELCOME: 

1. You have been chosen by our great President to participate in this Camp Rho experiment. We have strategically deployed you to test out our newest technology, the R76-H3-0 chip(herein referred to as the RHO Chip).

2. The RHO Chip sends out a short range signal that will allow you to freely wander this (and only this) camp under the protection of the provided armaments. It is suggested you do not remove this card for any reason as the defense systems will only recognize the person in possession of the RHO Chip.

3. Thank you for your participation, we will be retrieving you in approximately 1-9 months.
translation:
陆军部
研究和开发部
外勤业务部门，693R

RRD-HG53-P R27-866-51

欢迎；

1、你已经被我们伟大的总统选中参与这个Rho营地试验。出于战略性的目的，我们安排你试验我们最新的科技，R76-H3-0芯片（就是后文中的RHO芯片）。

2、RHO芯片向外发射出短距离的信号。这里已经装备好了我们提供的武器系统，在它的保护下，你可以惬意的在这个营地（仅限于这个营地）里散步。这里建议你无论如何不要搞丢了这张卡片，因为防御系统只认可拥有RHO芯片的人

3、感谢你的参与，我们大概会在1-9个月后回来找你。

original: Rivet City Council Minutes
translation: 铆钉城议会会议记录

original:
April 25, 2239
Inaugural Meeting of the Rivet City Council

In attendance:
Science Rep. - Dr. Horace Pinkerton
Civilian Rep. - Annette Holmes
Security Rep. - Brad Danvers

Summary:
As the Rivet Station Science Outpost has displayed significant stability in its location and reliable profitability for supply traders, a burgeoning civilian settlement has sprung up in the available space on our ship.

To better protect and organize this growing community, we declare a three man council will act as a governing body to represent the interests of the residents of the newly dubbed "Rivet City."
translation:
2239年4月25日
铆钉城议会成立会议

出席人员：
科技代表 — 荷瑞克·平克顿博士
平民代表 — 安妮特·福尔摩斯
安全代表 — 布拉德·丹佛斯

会议概要：
随着“铆钉站科学前哨”在地理位置上表现出显著的稳定性，并为物资贸易商带来了可靠的盈利，我们的船上可用空间内涌现出一个新兴平民聚居点。

为了更好地保护和组织这个日益壮大的社区，我们宣布成立一个三人议会，作为管理机构，代表新命名的“铆钉城”居民的利益。

original: Wasteland Survival Guide
translation: 废土生存指南

original:
Author: Moira Brown
Research Assistant: [%]

This confusing guidebook is filled with dangerously misinformed tips for survival in the wastes.

It is complete with misleading tips about wasteland dangers, rambling notes about mutated creatures, and laughably naive suggestions about rebuilding humanity.

Worst of all, it tries to sound highbrow while offering this poor information. Following its advice would be an invitation to a tragic end.
translation:
作者：莫伊拉·布朗
研究助理：[%]

这本莫名其妙的指南充斥着危险的对野外求生的误导信息。

它包括了许多对废土危险性的错误提示，对变种生物的记载零散不堪，并提出了重建人类的天真可笑的建议。

最糟糕的是，它试图通过提供这些烂信息来叫板文化知识高的人。按照它的建议做，其下场会很悲惨。

original: Schematics - Dart Gun
translation: 图纸 - 毒镖枪

original:
At a workbench, combine:
Paint gun
Radscorpion poison gland
Toy car
Surgical tubing

By adding Radscorpion poison to the darts that can be found in most ruined houses and stores, the Dart Gun makes for a stealthy and surprisingly lethal little toy.
translation:
在工作台，组合以下零件：
喷漆枪
辐射蝎毒腺
玩具车
输液管

随处可见的飞镖加上辐射蝎毒，毒镖枪就是一件精巧的致命玩具啦。

original: Schematics - Deathclaw Gauntlet
translation: 图纸 - 死亡爪拳套

original:
At a workbench, combine:
Wonderglue
Leather belt
Medical brace
Deathclaw hand

With this weapon, your "unarmed" attacks will have the ferocity and armor-shredding power of the Deathclaws. Assuming you can survive long enough to take one of their hands, of course.
translation:
在工作台，组合以下零件：
万能胶
皮带
医用支架
死亡爪的爪子

有了这把武器，你的“徒手”攻击就会像死亡爪一样凶猛，并具有撕碎装甲的威力。当然，前提是你能活到来取得它们的一只爪子。

original: Schematics - Nuka Grenade
translation: 图纸 - 核子手雷

original:
At a workbench, combine:
1 bottle Nuka-Cola Quantum
Tin Can
Turpentine
Abraxo cleaner

A potent cocktail of carbonation and detonation, the Nuka Grenade makes plasma look like a bubble bath.
translation:
在工作台，组合：
一瓶量子版核子可乐
锡罐
松节油
阿伯莱萨清洁剂

混合了碳酸化和爆炸力的强力鸡尾酒，等离子与核子手榴相比就是泡泡浴。

original: Schematics - Railway Rifle
translation: 图纸 - 射钉枪

original:
At a workbench, combine:
Crutch
Steam gauge assembly
Fission battery
Pressure cooker

Firing the railway spikes that can be found in industrial sites or train stations, the Railway Rifle can stop targets in their tracks and pin their limbs to the wall.
translation:
在工作台，组合以下零件：
拐杖
蒸汽压力计
裂变电池
高压锅

工业区或者火车站找到的铁道钉可以用来当子弹了，射钉枪拥有最好的制退效果，它可以把目标的五肢钉在墙上。

original: Schematics - Rock-It Launcher
translation: 图纸 - 捣蛋发射器

original:

Leaf blower
Firehose nozzle

The Rock-It Launcher isn't the most accurate big gun, but as long as you've got junk lying around, you've got ammo. Just load the hopper with garbage and turn that junk into a deadly weapon.
translation:
在工作台，组合以下零件：
吸尘器
吹落叶机
消防栓喷嘴
导体

捣蛋发射器不能算是件精确打击武器，但只要周围地上有垃圾，你就有子弹。装料斗里放点小零碎，这就是你的强大致死武器。

translation:
在工作台，组合以下零件：
摩托车油箱
点火器
割草机刀片
摩托车手刹

在被点燃以及合理使用使用情况下，火焰刀在混战中只起到两个重要作用：割碎和燃烧。

樱桃爆竹

original: Trapped
translation: 被困

original: Here I am, trapped in a room by myself typing on a terminal trying to keep myself busy. Hell trying to keep myself sane. I don't know what it is about this place, but I want to get out of here. Yeah, get out of here -- I can't even bring myself to open that damn door again. I hear those things wandering around outside, sniffing, screaming, doing whatever they do. When I first got here I thought the place was abandoned and went around looking for anything to scavenge. Five minutes later, I'm in this room scared half out of my mind. Things started chasing me, I fired a few shots, missed, and ran through the darkness. Ahh shit. Told ol' Billy to meet me here and bring some extra ammo and grenades. That was three days ago, poor guy probably didn't make it too far. Those things better have given him a quick death. Listen to me, babbling like a damn fool. Billy's all right. I'll just stick here until those things go away and meet up with him. Hah, what a story I have for him.
translation: 我在这儿，独自一人被困在这屋子里，在终端机上打字，试着让自己保持忙碌状态。困境试图让我自己保持清醒。我不知道这儿是什么地方，但是我想离开这里。对，离开这 — 我甚至没有自己再打开这该死的门。我听见那些东西在外面徘徊，嗅闻，尖叫，肆意妄为。当我第一次来到这儿的时候，我以为这个地方被遗弃了，还到处找东西清扫。5分钟后，我在这个房间里被吓的半疯癫。有东西开始追我，我开了几枪，但打偏了，子弹消失在黑暗中。真是操他妈的，告诉老比利到这来见我，多带些子弹和手榴弹。那是三天前，可怜的家伙很可能没坚持多久。那些东西最好让他死得快些。听我说，胡说就像该死的白痴。比利很好。那些东西消失或者和他见面前，我会坚持在这。哈，我为他的故事。

translation: 我的终端密码是“lotsacaps”。

original: Moriarty's Info on Dad
translation: 莫里亚蒂有关爸爸的消息

original: So, out of nowhere, James came back to Megaton. Since he stayed here before he asked me where the hell he could get a lay of the land and find out what's going on in the world. I told him about Galaxy News Radio in the ruins of D.C., and that guy Three Dog. Then like that, he was gone again.\n\nI remember the first time he showed up almost twenty years ago. I never expected someone to actually want to or be able to get INTO a vault, but he must have had his reasons. He had his kid with him, some baby that wouldn't shut the fuck up. Normally I would have kicked someone like that out of my place, but he had a way with words. Then, like that, he ducks into Vault 101 and he's gone for almost twenty years. Nice guy I guess, but never spends enough caps.
translation: 就这么突然，詹姆斯回到了兆吨镇。仗着他以前在这呆过，进门就问老子，哪儿能搞到最新的废土情报，弄清当前局势。我告诉他特区废墟里的银河新闻电台，还有那个叫“三狗”的家伙。结果丫听完，又特么闪人了。\n\n还记得差不多二十年前他头回冒头的情景。我从没想过居然有人想去避难所，还能往里钻，只能是他定有自己的理由。他带着他小孩，一个鬼哭狼嚎的小崽子。通常我会把这种人轰出去，可这家伙挺能说的。然后，他就这样溜进了101号避难所，一走就快20年。人倒是不赖，但花盖子抠搜搜的。

original: Love letter from Burke
translation: 伯克的情书

original:
Beloved,

I must beg your indulgence a little while longer. I am not yet able to send for you. Stay in Megaton. Once my business has concluded, I will send for you, and we will live happily as man and woman.

The memory of your beauty and sweet aroma lingers in my memory...

Have patience my love.

Soon. Soon we shall be together once again!

Your's very truly,

Burke
translation:
亲爱的，

我得恳请你再宽限一段时间。我现在还不能接你过来。呆在兆吨镇。等我的事情处理完后，我会去接你，然后我们将结为夫妻，幸福地生活在一起。

你的美貌与芬芳，始终萦绕在我心间……

请耐心等待，我的爱人。

很快。很快我们就能再次相聚！

你最真诚的，

伯克

original: Love letter from Burke #2
translation: 伯克的情书 #2

original:
Beloved,

The pain of your absence is at times crippling. But I must persevere. I must! It is very important work I am doing for mankind.

Oh, but I wish I could sweep it all away to be with you now!

Be patient love. I will send for you soon.

Your's very truly,

Burke
translation:
亲爱的，

你不在身边的痛苦，有时几乎将我击溃。但我必须坚持下去。必须如此！我所从事的事业，对全人类而言至关重要。

哦，我多么希望能抛开这一切，此刻就与你相聚！

请耐心等待，亲爱的。我很快就会接你过来。

你最真诚的，

伯克

original: Love letter from Burke
translation: 伯克的情书

original:
Beloved,

The pain of our separation is unbearable. I miss you terribly.

I cherish the memory of our brief time together.

Send me a letter, won't you? Send it to Tenpenny Tower. They'll be sure to get it to me.

Oh, be patient a little while longer, my little song bird. Soon we will be free of our cages, and our love will soar to the heavens above!

Your's very truly,

Burke
translation:
亲爱的，

分离的痛苦难以忍受。我非常想念你。

我怀念我们在一起的日子。

给我写信，好吗？发到特佩尼大厦。他们肯定会转到我手上。

哦，只要再忍耐一点点，我的小鸟。我们很快就可以离开牢笼自由了，我们的爱会飞至天堂!

你最忠诚的，

伯克

original: Love letter from Burke
translation: 伯克的情书

original:
I can not live like this. Wanting you. NEEDING you! But unable to have you.

I'm afraid I must insist we cease this charade.

I beg your forgiveness. I'm sorry to have made you wait in that hell-hole for so long. Waiting for the summons to my side that never came.

Fly free my little love bird. Fly up and out of that filth.

I wish that I could have you, and the thought of another man getting to have you, breaks my heart.

But I'd rather you were set free, than waiting eternally for me. I'm growing tired of this burden of mine. This toiling away for humanity, building a new world for mankind. I'm not even sure they will appreciate all the efforts I am making for them. But it is a burden I shall continue to carry, because someone must. And I am a man of responsibility,

Good luck my love-bird. Fly free and be happy!

Your's truly,

Burke
translation:
我不能像这样活着。我要你，需要你!但是无法拥有你。

恐怕我必须说我们要停止这场文字游戏了。

我请求你的原谅。非常抱歉让你在那该死的洞里等了那么久。等着我那永远来不了的召唤。

自由飞翔吧我的小爱鸟。远离一切污秽。

我多么希望我可以拥有你，但是让另一个男人拥有你的想法，令我心碎。

不过我宁可你自由自在，也不要你再徒劳的等我。我厌倦了我身上的这个包袱。为人类的前途指路，建造一个新世界什么的。我甚至不能肯定他们会为了我所做的贡献而感谢我。但是我还是必须背着这个包袱，因为必须有人这么做。而我是个负责的人。

祝你好运我的爱情鸟。自由快乐的高飞吧!

你忠诚的，

Burke

original: CGDadComputerFreddie
translation: CGDadComputerFreddie

original: Freddie’s VDS is getting worse. Most days, he can't even get out of bed. When he does manage to function, Freddie hides his insecurities and low self esteem behind a bully’s mask.\n\nVault-Tec medical protocols dictate the prescription of anti-anxiety medication when Vault Depressive Syndrome is involved, but do I really want to string the kid out on Chlorpromazine for the rest of his life?
translation: 弗雷迪的VDS症状越来越严重了。大多数时候他甚至不能起床。当他能控制自己的时候，弗雷迪隐藏起自己的不安，把自尊藏在那副严厉的面具下面。\n\n避难所科技公司医疗规程指示，当出现VDS（避难所抑郁症）时要配发抗焦虑药物，但是我真的想把孩子的余生都挂在镇定剂上面么？

original: CGDadComputerStanley
translation: CGDadComputerStanley

original: Stanley continues to suffer from severe and chronic head pain. I’ve been feeding him aspirin like it's candy, but I’m reticent to give him anything stronger. He blames the lighting in his quarters, and though eyestrain is certainly compounding the problem, the headaches are actually a symptom of overwork and lack of sleep. \n\nKnowing Stanley -- and the schedule the Overseer has him on -- the problem isn't likely to get better anytime soon. So it's aspirin, indefinitely.
translation: 斯坦利仍然在承受那剧烈且不断的头痛。我拿阿司匹林当糖块一样喂他吃，我没法给他更有效的药物了。他抱怨灯光照到他的位置，虽然眼疲劳确实与头痛有关，但是他的头痛事实上是因为过于疲劳和缺乏睡眠。\n\n按斯坦利的状况——还有监督者对他的“时间安排”——这个问题在短期内估计不可能好转。所以还是用阿司匹林，虽然不确定这有没有用。

original: CGDadComputerAmata
translation: CGDadComputerAmata

original: Once again, the Overseer has insisted on being in the room for Amata’s examination, throwing any inkling of doctor-patient confidentiality right out the window. I know he doesn’t trust me; he never has. But I honestly believe the reason he attends his daughter’s medical appointments is because he doesn’t trust her. That’s as ridiculous as it is sad. Amata’s a great girl, and the chance of her doing something stupid - pregnancy, syphilis, whatever - is so unlikely it’s not even worth mentioning.
translation: 监督者再一次坚持要留在阿玛塔的手术室里面，把医患之间的隐秘关系置于脑后。我知道他不相信我——从来没相信过。但是我坦白的说，他关注他女儿的手术是因为他不信任她。这听起来真是荒谬。阿玛塔是一个好女孩，她确实没有做过那些蠢事 — 怀孕，梅毒，或者其他什么 — 这值得好好赞扬。

original: CGDadComputerExperiment27CE
translation: CGDadComputerExperiment27CE

original: The cells are still replicating normally. No mutation. Thank God. If whatever’s out there could penetrate this Vault, I can’t even begin to imagine what the Overseer would do.
translation: 细胞还在正常复制。没有变异。感谢上帝。如果外界的什么东西渗入了这个避难所，我甚至不敢想象监督者会做什么。

original: CGDadComputerExperimentPP216
translation: CGDadComputerExperimentPP216

original: After "borrowing" a few more water chips and rerouting some of the power here in the clinic, I’ve finally been able to affect the latest sample. It’s not much, but considering what I have to work with it, a definite step in the right direction. \n\nBut this new experiment was also monumental for another reason: it’s the first time Jonas has assisted me. He’s suspected forever, I know, so I guess it was inevitable. And his help has been invaluable. I just hope he knows what he's gotten himself into.
translation: 在又“借”了一些净水芯片并改动了一下诊所的动力电线之后，我终于可以研究这最后的样品了。改善并不多，但是想想我得在什么情况下工作，就会知道这是一个很大的进步了。 \n\n这次试验依然意义重大，这是因为乔纳斯第一次帮助我了。他总是怀疑一切，这我知道，而且我猜这是合理的。他的帮助很有价值。我只希望他知道他在干什么。

original: CGOverseersTerminalAmata
translation: CGOverseersTerminalAmata

original: Every time I try to get Amata to open up, she just pushes me further and further away. Since she was a child, I’ve tried to instill in her those virtues that have made this Vault what it is today: loyalty, honesty, commitment, hard work. \n\nShe does try, and with a lot of guidance has grown into a fine young woman. That makes it all the sadder that she continues to alienate me. She looks at me and sees the Overseer, not the father that has cared for her alone -- alone! -- since she was an infant.
translation: 每次我尝试着要和阿玛塔好好谈谈时，她总是避而远之。当她还是个孩子的时候，我就试着灌输她这些美德：忠诚、诚实、守信，努力。正是这些要素，避难所才被建设成为今天的这样子。\n\n她尝试着，凭着各方指导，成长为一个年轻的好女孩。她一直试图疏远我，这让一切都变得更糟。她面对我的时候，只把我当作监督者，而非父亲。当她尚在襁褓中时，就是那么的孤独！

original: CGOverseersTerminalTunnelSnakes
translation: CGOverseersTerminalTunnelSnakes

original: If Butch and his leather-clad delinquents accost Amata one more time, they'll have more to deal with than their acerbic teacher. \n\nTheir “services” have come in handy upon occasion, I must admit, but they’re starting to become… unruly. If dogs become feral, they must be put down. I'll have to remind Butch of that upon our next meeting.
translation: 如果布奇和他那些皮衣小痞子再去找阿玛塔的麻烦，他们要对付的就不只是他们那尖酸刻薄的老师了。\n\n我必须承认，他们的“服务”偶尔会派上用场，但他们开始变得……难以驾驭了。狗要是咬人，就应该被干掉。下次会面时我得提醒布奇这一点。

original: CGOverseersTerminalBeatrice
translation: CGOverseersTerminalBeatrice

original: Just what Vault 101 needs -- an absent-minded, sexually repressed sycophant. Beatrice has served Vault 101 admirably for years, but her mind is growing feeble. I'll have to speak with our good doctor about some kind of long-term pharmaceutical solution. \n\nWe may at least be able to keep her comfortable -- and quiet -- until she passes on.
translation: 这恰好是101号避难所需要的——一个健忘的，性压抑的马屁精。比阿特丽斯已经为101号避难所很好的服务很多年了，但是她的记忆力在逐渐退化。我得同我们的优秀医生谈一谈关于长期用药的事。\n\n我们至少可以让她保持舒适和安静，直到她离开人世。

original: CGOverseersTerminalJonas
translation: CGOverseersTerminalJonas

original: I never should have assigned Jonas as James' assistant. He was always too idealistic for his own good. Now he spends every waking minute with the good doctor, who gleefully fills his ears with even more idealistic nonsense. \n\nI’ve considered re-assigning him, but the truth is Jonas is a fine medic in his own right, and hiding him down in maintenance would be a terrible waste of resources.
translation: 我真不该让乔纳斯做詹姆斯的助手。他总是太理想化了。现在他一有时间就和好医生在一起，而好医生则乐此不疲地向他灌输更多理想主义的废话。\n\n我考虑过重新指派他，但事实是乔纳斯本身就是一名优秀的医务人员，把他藏在维修部是对资源的严重浪费。

original: Re: Weapon Practice
translation: 回复：武器训练

original:
From: McAndrews, Jeanne 
To: McCoy, Derrick

Subject: Re: Weapon Practice Tonight?

Sure, I'll definitely be there. I wouldn't miss a chance to have my weapon accidentally discharge and hit that "grenade" in Sam's pocket.
translation:
自：麦克安德鲁，珍妮 
致：麦克科依，德瑞克

主题：回复：今晚武器训练？

当然，我一定会去的。我怎么可能放弃这么好的机会，我会用我的武器意外的击中山姆裤兜里的那颗“手榴弹”。

original: Reilly's Directions to Statesman Hotel
translation: 莱莉提供的到政要酒店的提示

original: Using the Metro tunnels, head north from here to Metro Central. Then look for the tunnels to the Dupont Circle Station. Exit from Dupont Circle Station into the Dry Sewers and follow to Our Lady of Hope Hospital.
translation: 走地铁隧道，从这里向北到达地铁中心。找到通向杜邦环岛站的隧道。从杜邦环岛站离开到达干燥的下水道，然后朝着玛利亚医院医院走。

original: Brick
translation: 布瑞克

original:
Name: Brick
Position: Heavy Weapons
Age: 24
Term of Contract: Ongoing
Merits/Demerits: 5/1
Pay: 50 caps/mission
Status: Active

Brick is an outstanding asset to the Rangers. I find her zeal for destruction to be an asset rather than a liability. She is reliable and calm under fire, although can be a bit impatient during mission planning phases or debriefings. She seems fiercely loyal to the Rangers, and would be a great go-to person in the event of a falling out in the ranks.
translation:
姓名：布瑞克
位置：重型武器
年龄：24岁
契约状态：签约中
优/缺点：5/1
薪资：50个瓶盖/每任务
状态：活动中

对于游骑兵来说，布瑞克是笔宝贵的财富，原因就在于她对破坏的狂热之心。虽然在任务计划和报告阶段她经常表现得不耐烦，但在交火中，她却能够保持平静的心态，这是非常值得信赖的。她对突击队忠心耿耿，如果队伍出现内讧，她也能做出出色的决断。

original: Butcher
translation: 布彻

original:
Name: Butcher
Position: Medic
Age: 31
Term of Contract: Ongoing
Merits/Demerits: 3/0
Pay: 70 caps/mission
Status: Active

Butcher is an important part of our team. He is prone to making rational and logical decisions even in the heat of battle which makes him ideal for a secondary command position. His medical skills are moderate at best with room for improvement, but he continues to scour every hospital and clinic we happen across to learn more about his trade. His loyalty to the Rangers is without question.
translation:
姓名：布彻
位置：医师
年龄：31岁
契约状态：签约中
优/缺点：3/0
薪资：70个瓶盖/每任务
状态：活动中

布彻在我们队伍中扮演着重要的角色。在战斗中他总能做出理性有逻辑的判断，这使得他可以成为一名理想的副官。他的医疗技能已经造诣颇高。但每次我们路过医院或诊所时，他都不会放过每一点机会来精进自己的专长。他对游骑兵的忠诚是毋庸置疑的。

Donovan came to us highly recommended by my contact in the Brotherhood of Steel. He is an absolute wizard in regards to the repair of our firearms and personal armor. I wish he had more knowledge of electrical systems, hydraulics, etc which would help us circumvent obstacles we frequently encounter in the ruins, but hopefully this will improve with time. His loyalty to the Rangers seems solid, but it may take more time to gauge.

original: Strayer's Note
translation: 流浪者的信笺

original: Dear Miranda,\n I don't know if you'll ever get this letter. That job I took isn't going well. One of the mercs on the team is crazy. He talks like he's some sort of president in exile. I don't trust him. One of the others is a drunken lecher. He's always trying to make moves on the woman on the team. He almost got us killed yesterday because he was staring at her rather than watching the road.\n If I don't make it back, take good care of Ted. Take him to Rivet City. The two of you will be safe there. I'll join you there if I survive.
translation: 亲爱的米兰达，\n我不知道你是否会收到这封信。工作进展并不顺利。我的队伍中有个佣兵是个疯子，他口口声声地说自己是个被放逐的总统一类的人物，我可不相信他的鬼话。另一个队友是个酒鬼，他一直在试图接近我们的女队员，昨天我们差点因为他送了命，原因就是他一直盯着那个女人看，而顾不上看前边的道路。\n如果我一去不返，请照顾好泰德。带他一起去铆钉城，你们两个在那里生活会很安全的。如果我活下来的话，我会去那里找你们。

original: Dukov's Note
translation: 杜科夫的日记

original: Tara's Note
translation: 塔拉的笔记

original: If anyone finds this note, stay the hell away from this place. If the Feral Ghouls don't get you, the robots will. There's radiation everywhere. I think they used to make nukes here, or maybe they just kept them, I don't know.\n\nTara
translation: 如果有人看到这份笔记，请离这个鬼地方远点。即使狂尸鬼没有杀死你，机器人也会置你于死地。到处都是辐射。我想他们曾经在这里制造过核武器，或者他们只是保存了核武器，我不清楚。\n\n塔拉

original: Dave's Note
translation: 戴夫的日记

original:
Tuesday, don't know the date: This will look good on my war record. When I get back to the republic, my candidacy will be unstoppable.

Thursday, still don't know the date: Strayer needs to die. He refuses to use my title. I keep telling him that the election is a mere formality. He should start using my future title now to get in my good graces.

Sunday, I think: The disarmament treaty failed. I've got the Republic's treasure. The other ambassador's have all fled. It's time I returned to my people. I'm leaving this note to be found by future scholars. They will marvel at my accomplishments.
translation:
日期不详，星期二：继续我的战地记录。等我回到共和国，我将在选举中所向披靡。

日期仍不详，星期三：我要干掉斯崔尔，原因是他不肯用我给他的头衔。我一遍一遍又一遍地跟他说选举只是一个形式，但他就是不接受我的好意，使用我给他的头衔。

星期日：我认为裁军是错误的，回到我的人民身边的时刻到了，我把这篇记录留在这里，以便未来的学者们发现并敬仰我的造诣。

original: Trapped, trapped, trapped
translation: 被困了，被困了，被困了

original: I'm trapped. Dukov betrayed me. I'm stuck down here with nothing but the Ghouls and the robots for company. The Ghouls ignore me because they think I'm one of them. The robots are easy to avoid.\n\nAll I've got is this stupid terminal to keep me company. Someday I'll get out of here. Then Tenpenny and the others will pay.
translation: 我被困住了。杜科夫背叛了我。我被骗到这里，身边有的只是尸鬼和机器人。尸鬼认为我是他们的一员，并没对我怎么样。机器人则可以轻松躲开。\n\n我在这个破终端上立下此誓，早晚有一天我会离开这里，叫特佩尼他们为此付出代价。

original: Seven years and counting
translation: 七年了，还在继续

original: I forgot about this terminal. I've been down here seven years now. A human would never have survived. Only a Ghoul can live in these conditions. Three years ago I stopped looking for a way out. There isn't one.
translation: 我遗忘了这台终端。现在我已经被困在这里七年了。人类不可能生存的这么久，只有尸鬼才能活下来。在三年前我停止了寻找出口，因为这里根本没有出口。

original: I'm leaving!
translation: 我走了！

original: A small tremor made a crack in the wall. I think I can get out. Nineteen years I've been down here. At least that's what the terminal says.\n\nI'm going to take the plasma grenade with me. Once I'm out, I'll use it to seal the crack. I don't want anyone getting in until I can come back with the keys. I've paid for what's here, in blood and years. It belongs to me and not anyone else!
translation: 一次轻微的地震把墙壁震出了裂缝。我想我可以出去了。在被困十九年 — 至少这台终端是这么说的。\n\n我要带上这枚等离子手榴，以便在我出去后用它重新把裂缝封起来。因为在我带回钥匙前，我不希望其他人闯入这里。我在这里付出了代价，鲜血和时间的代价，所以这里只应属于我一个人！

original: Mesmetron Manual - Summary Page
translation: 迷魂枪手册 - 简介

original:
First, let us congratulate you on choosing the Mesmetron as your preferred non-lethal subjugation device! Your field reports will assist us in our research, and help us continue to improve the Mesmetron's capabilities.

IMPORTANT! Please see your supervisor or commanding officer for details regarding the legal requirements and restrictions, before discharging the Mesmetron on civilians.

SUMMARY:

The Mesmetron is the undisputed leader in the field of non-lethal target elimination and retrieval. Simply point, shoot, and subdue!

HOW IT WORKS:

Simply stated, the Mesmetron sends out a series of waves that short circuit key areas of the target's brain. Much like a radio signal, only instead of a radio picking up pleasant music, the target's brain picks up a series of complex and confusing signals that overwhelm the synaptic pathways with erroneous data, turning off important high-level thought centers and voluntary motor control.

CLASS B "Experimentally Efficient" CLASSIFICATION:

Warning! The Mesmetron is still designated as a Class B "experimentally efficient" weapon.

This means, that from time to time, unexpected, and potentially embarrassing side effect may be experienced (see your supervisor or commanding officer before using on civilians).

Occasional anomalous effects that have been recorded by field tests against certain targets include:

1.) Increased aggression

2.) The extremely rare "resonant brain wave feedback loop" (which is usually accompanied by explosive cranial deformation)

Please report the appearance of any of these anomalies immediately, and provide a clear and accurate account of all the circumstances in your field notes. The data we collect from agents in the field, such as yourself, is invaluable for working out these anomalies and getting the Mesmetron reclassified for everyday use! 

Thank you for your service to our company, and to your country!

Implied Hypnotics, Inc.
translation:
首先，让我们祝贺你选择迷魂枪作为你的非致命性防暴设备！你的反馈报告将会有助于我们的研究，帮助我们继续完善迷魂枪的功能。

重要！在使用迷魂枪对付平民之前，相关法律法规请咨询你的上级或者指挥官。

简介:

毫无疑问，迷魂枪是非致命性目标消灭与捕捉领域的领头羊。只要简单的瞄准，射击，就行了！

工作原理:

简而言之，迷魂枪发射出一系列电波使目标大脑的关键部分短路。类似无线电信号，只不过不是无线电带来的悦耳音乐，而是一系列复杂难懂的信号充斥大脑皮层，关闭重要的思维中心和自主控制。

级别B“试验阶段”分级：

警告！迷魂枪仍然是等级B“试验阶段”武器。

也就是说，偶尔地，意外地，潜在地负面效果也许会出现（在对平民使用之前，相关法律法规请咨询你的上级或者指挥官）。

实地试验记录的对特定目标的偶然的负面效果包括:

1.) 增加侵略性

2.) 非常罕见的“共振脑波反馈回路”（经常伴随着头盖骨爆炸性变形）

一旦上述异常出现，请立即报告，附上清楚准确的环境条件报告。我们从代理人处（例如您）收集来的报告，对于解决这些异常状况以及改进催眠枪的品质是非常宝贵的! 

感谢您对本公司的贡献，以及对您国家的贡献!

暗示催眠公司

original: Slave Collar Insructions
translation: 奴隶项圈指南

original:
Here are some simple rules for you to follow.

* Don't tinker with the collar -- you'll probably blow yourself up, which would serve you right.

* The Mezzer rays trigger the collar's self-destruct mechanism, so once the collar's on, don't shoot the slave with the Mesmetron, unless you want to pay me for a new collar.

* If you lose a collar, or get it stolen from you, you'll end up wearing one. We won't tolerate any threat to our business.

If you have any questions, piss off. I don't have time for retards.

 - Grouse

这里有些简单的规则你要服从。

* 不要随便摆弄项圈 -- 你可能会把自己炸飞，那就算是活该。

* 麦兹尔射线触发项圈的自爆装置，所以一旦戴上项圈，就不要用迷魂枪射击奴隶，除非你准备赔我个新项圈。

* 如果你丢了个项圈，或者被偷了，那你就准备自己戴上个吧。我们不会容忍任何威胁的行为。

 如有任何问题，滚蛋。我没空。

original: Atom's Philosophy
translation: 原子哲学

original:
People often innocently ask me "Confessor, why do you worship a bomb?" Like curious children, they come to me with questions about the most visible and perhaps controversial aspect of our faith. The innocent among us hear my sermons before the great symbol, they see us bathe in the waters, and they wonder if it is danger we seek -- a suicide pact, perhaps. And while you may be tempted to answer their curiosity with anger, my gentle Children of Atom, you must never do so.

The core of Atom's philosophy teaches us peace. That we must educate the curious and work towards alleviating their ignorance, that we must teach them to accept the glory of the Division of the past and to seek the glory of the Division that is to come. 

Teach them, my Children, teach them how the miserable rotten meat of their bodies will give birth to countless lives at the time of Division. Teach them that they should not mourn the world that has passed, but praise and celebrate those that have already been Divided. Teach them the blessing, the glory, that the peace of our communion and the satisfaction that can be found in our blessed work.

Teach them, my Children. Teach them well, and in the teaching, find your peace and your place. This is the core of Atom's message to us. Spread. Grow. Communicate.

Go in peace, my precious Children. Walk in Atom's Glow.
translation:
一些无罪的人们经常天真地、像小孩子似地问我：“教主，你为什么要崇拜个炸弹呢？“这是一个显而易见却又引人深思的问题。那些无罪之人曾聆听过我在伟大的神物前的训诫，看到过我们在圣水之中的沐浴，他们可能会想知道我们这样做是否在玩火自焚。这种时候，你们可能会想要怒斥他们的好奇，我的友爱的子民们，你们万万不可这样。

原子哲学的核心部分教导我们要和谐处世。对于那些好奇的人，我们要用耐心的教导来消逐他们的无知，我们要教导他们去接受审判日曾经带给我们的荣耀，去寻找审判日未来将会带给我们的荣耀。

去教导他们，我的子民们，教导他们那些腐烂的躯壳是怎样在审判日来临之时升华为数不尽的鲜活生命的。教导他们不要为了曾经失落的世界哀伤，而要去歌颂与赞扬审判过后的透彻。教导他们去祝福，教导他们去荣耀，教导他们在我们教众的神圣引导之下过上舒适安逸的和谐生活。

去教导他们，我的子民们，努力教导他们。在教导中找到你自己的和谐生活与安身之所。这就是原子神学的核心：散播、成长、传播。

和谐地出发吧，我至亲的子民们，带着原子的光和热出发吧。

original: Oath
translation: 宣誓

original: The oath of service:
translation: 效忠宣誓：

Atom is light. Power.

Atom is hope.

original: Second Division?
translation: 二次裂变？

original: I often ask myself if the time is right for the second Division. Here, in Atom's blessed village, are we truly ready for his coming? Have I properly prepared my people for the moment in which his great altar cracks open and reveals to us his glory? I am but a man, who am I to bring these people to glory? Who am I to seek to cause the division?
translation: 我常常自问是否已到了二次裂变的时刻。在这个被原子之力庇佑的村子里，我们是否已经准备好迎接它的来临？我是否已经让人们做好了准备，在神圣裂变的那一刻载入荣誉的史册？但我只是个普通人，谁能将这些人带入荣誉的殿堂？谁又能来触发这伟大的裂变？

original: CGOverseersTerminalBraunLetter
translation: CGOverseersTerminalBraunLetter

original:
A Letter to the Overseer from Dr. Stanislaus Braun:

If you are reading this, emergency Vault internment procedures have been initiated and you and your control group have been sealed into your Vault. Congratulations! You are now a vital part of the most ambitious program ever undertaken by Vault-Tec.

If you have not yet read your sealed orders, do so now. They will outline the experimental protocols assigned to your control group. Please remember that deviation from these protocols in any way will jeopardize the success of the program, and may be considered grounds for termination by Vault-Tec Corporation (as outlined in your Employment Agreement).

Your Vault may or may not have been selected to receive a G.E.C.K. module. Please see Attachment A for details.

Doctor Stanislaus Braun
Director, Societal Preservation Program
Vault-Tec Corporation
translation:
斯坦尼斯劳斯·布劳恩博士致监督者的一封信：

当你读到这封信，意味者避难所的紧急关闭系统已经启动，你和你的对照组已经封闭在避难所里了。恭喜！你们现在是避难所科技公司有史以来最雄心勃勃的计划的重要组成部分。

如果你还未读到密函的指示，请现在阅读。这份指示将阐述你的对照组的研究计划纲要。请记住，任何背离指示的行为都有可能影响项目顺利进行，并有可能导致避难所科技集团中止此项目（你的雇佣协议里有所说明）。

你的避难所可能被选中接受G.E.C.K.模块，也可能没有。详情请参见附件A。

斯坦尼斯劳斯·布劳恩博士
社会保护计划主管
避难所科技公司

original: CGOverseersTerminalGECK
translation: CGOverseersTerminalGECK

original: The G.E.C.K. is, quite simply, the most advanced piece of technology ever developed by Vault-Tec -- a terraforming module capability of creating life from complete lifelessness. \n\nAfter riding out the storm of nuclear Armageddon in a Vault-Tec patented vault, residents can then activate the G.E.C.K., and create a new Earthen paradise -- craters and dust will give way to rolling grasslands and sparkling clear water. Of course, due to time and monetary constraints, not every vault will be equipped with a G.E.C.K. module.

original: Terminal Entry
translation: 终端机记录

original: Lab Report: Prototype ZRIN-363\n\nExperimental prototype makes extensive use of hardware common to liquid ammunition flame projection weapons. While initial test results were impressive, extreme weight of unit (118.3kg) and fume inhalation rendered most test subjects incapable of firing the unit or remaining conscious under typical field conditions.
translation: 实验室报告：原型机ZRIN-363\n\n实验原型广泛应用于装配液体弹药火焰喷射武器。最初的测试结果令人印象深刻，过沉的重量（118.3公斤）以及大量烟尘的吸入导致大部分测试科目失败于人员在典型的战场条件下无法正常开火或者无法保持清醒状态。

original: Terminal Entry
translation: 终端机记录

original: Lab Report: Prototype ZRIN-375\n\nPrototype introduces proprietary ammunition type. Conventional 10mm shells house a caplet containing amalgamating agents. When the caplet was broken in lab tests, localized fireburst and shrapnel projection met requirements for project. However, in field tests amalgam caplet ammunition proved too fragile, and several detonated from excessive vibration or walk speed.
translation: 实验室报告：原型机ZRIN-375\n\n原型采用了专有的弹药类型。常规的10毫米弹壳内被放入了一个含有汞齐化作用剂的囊片。实验中，囊片被破坏时会产生局部的焰爆，同时必将导致弹片纷飞的结果。不管怎样，实弹实验中汞合金囊片的弹药被证实非常的脆弱，有些甚至会在震动和急行军的过程中被引爆。

original: Terminal Entry
translation: 终端机记录

original: Lab Report: Prototype ZRIN-401\n\nPrototype attempts to refine results of acumist coating within weapon barrel. Initial tests showed promise. As predicted, delivery friction super-heats projectile as it is delivered from the weapon, and conventional 10mm ammunition can be used. However; during live-fire testing, subjects firing the weapon in rapid succession suffered severe burns to the fingers and palm.
translation: 实验室报告：原型机ZRIN-401\n\n我们试着通过将混合涂层涂在枪管的内壁来完善原型。最初的测试让人看到了希望。同预料的一样，发射的时候子弹会因为摩擦力而过热，而且能够使用常规的10毫米弹药。然而，实弹射击实验中发现，持续不断的开火会导致手指与手掌的严重烧伤。

original: Terminal Entry
translation: 终端机记录

original: Lab Report: Prototype ZRIN-418\n\nPrototype refines acumist barrel experiments by addition of retardant jacketing, as well as internal heat diffusers. Rate of fire diminished from un-modified version of weapon. Conventional 10mm ammunition does not fully liquefy until impact, giving the 418 exceptional accuracy compared to earlier prototypes. Live-fire tests report no major casualties. Recommend ZRIN-418 as production candidate.
translation: 实验室报告：原型机ZRIN-418\n\n通过加上缓冲层，原型的混合涂层枪管更加完善了，内部散热问题也得到了解决。改进后的原型射速略低于更改前的武器。但是除非强烈的撞击常规的10毫米弹药是不会解体的，而且这赋予了418比先前的原型更加优越的精准度。实弹射击实验中没有什么重大事故，推荐ZRIN-418作为生产用枪。

original: Analysis ->\nFurther research regarding Laser Weaponry has not revealed much we didn't already know. Small production run of prototype weapons developed by US Military, most of these weapons were recovered from military armories where the weapons were being tested by live-fire groups of active duty personnel.
translation: 分析 ->\n对激光武器的进一步研究并未揭示出太多我们尚未知晓的信息。美国军方已开发出小批量的原型武器，其中大多已从军械库中回收，当时这些武器正由现役人员组成的实弹小组进行测试。

original: Research Note - Laser Rifle
translation: 研究笔记 — 激光步枪

original:
Critical Components ->
Power drawn from Microfusion Cell is processed through a Wave/Particle Diverter (manuf:Gen Atomics Intnl). Diverters are protected by carbon-fiber housing, preventing frequent malfunction, but when a diverter fails the weapon becomes unusable, and this part is extremely difficult to replace or repair.

Precision-cut lenses focus optic energy. Lenses are prone to damage and can grossly affect precision of the firing weapon's firing mechanism. Lenses are easily replaced with any clear glass, but require a great deal of skill to fabricate.
translation:
关键部件 ->
由微型聚变电池提供的电力通过波/粒分流器（制造商：通用原子国际）进行处理。分流器由碳纤维外壳保护，可防止频繁故障，但分流器一旦失效，武器将无法使用，且此部件极难更换或维修。

精密切割的透镜用于聚焦光学能量。透镜容易受损，并会严重影响开火武器发射机构的精确度。透镜很容易用任何透明玻璃替换，但制造需要极高的技艺。

original: Research Note - Laser Rifle
translation: 研究笔记 — 激光步枪

original: Field Operation ->\nA fully charged cell will discharge 20 bolts from a pistol, and 12 shots from the rifle model. Recoil is negligible compared to ballistic weapons, so long range combat requires less marksmanship ability of the soldier.
translation: 实地操作 ->\n一块充满电的电池可为手枪提供20发能量束，为步枪型号提供12发。与弹道武器相比，其后坐力微乎其微，因此远距离作战对士兵的射击技能要求较低。

original: Research Note - Laser Rifle
translation: 研究笔记 — 激光步枪

original: Maintenance ->\nThe chassis are easily opened, allowing the weapon to be serviced in the field. Purified water and a clean cloth can be used to wash mirrored and glass components, slowing wear on the weapon. The weapon can also overheat after a period of intense use. This can be counteracted by submerging the barrel of the weapon in water, which helps cool heat sinks located beneath the chassis shell in that area.
translation: 维护 ->\n底座易于打开，便于在野外进行维修。可以使用纯净水和干净的布来清洗镜面和玻璃部件，以减缓武器的磨损。长时间高强度使用后，武器可能会过热。这可通过将武器枪管浸入水中来抵消，这样做有助于冷却位于该区域底座外壳下方的散热片。

original: Where Did I Go Wrong?
translation: 我到底哪里做错了？

original: Where Did I Go Wrong?\n==============\nBatch A27 is a complete failure. I must return to my original formulas and begin the process all over again. Perhaps the pressure of working in these conditions without proper laboratory equipment is to blame, perhaps I simply didn't splice the correct genetic instructions or perhaps I am fatigued. Whatever the case may be, A27 is proving to be a disaster. I must introduce a new formula soon or I may not be alive to see my hypothesis come to fruition.
translation: 我到底哪里做错了？\n==============\nA27批次彻底失败了。我必须回到原来的配方，重新开始。也许归咎于在这种没有适当实验设备的条件下工作压力太大，也许是我没有拼接正确的基因指令，或者是我太疲劳了。无论如何，A27都是一场灾难。我必须尽快推出新的配方，否则我可能无法活着看到我的假设实现。

original: Doctor Lesko's Notes
translation: 莱斯科博士的便条

original: Sample Location Discovered!\n=================\nI've found the perfect specimen for my experiments inside Marigold Station! I've set up shop underground for now while I prepare the experiment. All I need is a bit of last-minute programming on my robot and it will be ready to perform the delicate injections. Soon I will prove to everyone that my formula is a viable alternative to the destruction of these misunderstood beings.
translation: 发现样本位置！\n=================\n我在玛丽戈德站内找到了实验所需的完美样本！在准备实验的过程中，我暂时在地下设置了实验室。我只需要对我的机器人进行最后的编程，它就可以进行精细的注射了。很快我就能向所有人证明，我的配方是毁灭这些被不为人理解的的生物的可行选择。

original: Dangers

original: Dangers\n=====\nI realize the dangers involved in tampering with nature. I've heard the rhetoric and the hoopla about "playing God". However, I am determined to reduce these poor things back to their original state when they were harmless. Only through genetic recoding is this possible. All that is needed is a proper test subject. My search continues as I tweak the formula.
translation: 危险\n=====\n我很清楚逆自然规律而动的风险。我已经听够了“游戏上帝”那些华丽的辞藻和虚无的欢乐。我已经决定把这些可怜的生灵重新调整回原始的、无害的形态。只有借助于基因记录才有可能把他们还原回去。所需的只要合适的实验体，设计好实验方案后，我的研究会继续下去。

original: Ghoul Note
translation: 尸鬼笔记

original: Brothers and sisters! Roy Phillips and his righteous band of diplomats have been massacred by the smooth-skins at Tenpenny Tower. It is time we arise and show the world that Ghouls are people too, that we have the same rights as everyone else, and that we won't placate and bow down to their bullshit any longer! Bring lots of firepower and righteous hatred with you. We amass at Warrington Station. The revolution has begun!
translation: 弟兄姐妹们！罗伊·菲利普斯和他正直的伙伴们被特佩尼塔的光皮肤们残忍杀害了。现在是我们站起来向世界宣布尸鬼也是人的时候了，我们跟所有人一样有同样的权利，我们再也不会屈服了!带上强大的火力和复仇的正义。我们在沃灵顿站集合。革命开始了!

original: Ghoul Note
translation: 尸鬼笔记

original: Brothers and sisters! We have over-thrown the bigoted smooth-skins at Tenpenny Tower. Come live in luxury! Kill any smooth-skins who finds out we are in control of the tower. And bring lots of firepower and righteous hatred with you. We will certainly need to defend our new home.
translation: 弟兄姐妹们!我们已经在特佩尼塔推翻了那些顽固的光皮肤。来爽一爽吧!杀了所有发现我们的光皮肤。带上强大的火力和复仇的正义。我们一定会需要保卫我们的新家园。

original: Jericho Incident
translation: 耶利哥事件

original: Jericho's been a bad boy. I heard all about him and Jenny Stahl. Tried to slip her some of the old gun barrel while she's yelling no. He's lucky the "gun" didn't go off or that would have given the Stahl clan something to crap their pants about. He thinks he's king of the hill, walking around Megaton like he does all high and mighty. He tries to pull that shit with me and the Jenny Incident goes public.
translation: 耶利哥这孙子可真是作到头了。我听说了他和珍妮·斯塔尔的事。人家姑娘喊“不要”了，他还硬要拿他那根“枪管”往里捅。得亏他那把“枪”没走火，不然斯塔尔家怕是要气炸肺。这杂碎真当自己是山大王，整天在兆吨镇昂着脑袋装大爷。他敢对老子玩这套，老子立马把“珍妮门”曝光。

original: Junkie
translation: 瘾君子

original: Never trust a junkie. That's what I've learned trying to deal with this piece of work. He wanders in here higher than a bird in flight and tries to make it with Nova. She slapped him silly after he didn't wanna pay, the good girl. I almost kicked him out myself, but he staggered out of here. That guy may just be the straw I need to break Andy's back.
translation: 信谁也别信药渣子。跟这号烂货打交道算是让我长见识了。他嗑得比飞鸟还飘，晃到我这，想和诺瓦上床。在他想白嫖后，诺瓦一巴掌扇飞了他，这娘们下手倒狠。老子当时就想把他踹出酒馆，结果他自己就滚出去了。这孙子也许是我用来压折安迪脊梁骨的最后稻草。

original: Competition
translation: 竞争

original: This guy is a real piece of work. Opening a fucking bar in my town? What a jackass. I swear, he's up to something. I'm going to have to think of a way to reduce his business a little. For now at least I still got my secret weapon... Nova: best refreshment in town.
translation: 这厮绝对是个祸害。敢在老子的镇子开他娘的狗屁酒吧？纯属找抽。我敢发誓，这杂碎憋着坏水。得琢磨个法子给他生意降降温了… 好在老子还有秘密武器……诺瓦：镇上最好的消遣。

original: Proud Father
translation: 模范父亲

original: That Nuka-Cola swilling prick. Parading his little "daughter" Maggie around for all to see like a proud father... yeah right. Found her wandering the Wasteland my left ass cheek. I bet old Billy fed Maggie's parents that buckshot sandwich himself then added the little girl to his trophy collection in that shithole he calls a home. I better keep my eye on him.
translation: 那灌满核子可乐的屌人。整天显摆他那“乖女儿”玛姬，装什么慈父……呵呵。说在废土上捡的？鬼才信。要我说，准是老比利拿铅弹三明治喂饱了她亲爹娘，再把这小妞塞进他那称为“家”的狗窝当战利品。得盯紧这孙子了。

original: Doc Church Secret
translation: 丘奇医生 秘密

original: Church thinks he such a freakin' badass. Everybody runs to him if they get a damn wood splinter and he just laps up their caps like a drunk downing alcohol. If people only knew he used to be a medic for the slavers at Paradise Falls, they'd run his sorry ass right out of town. But I think I'll keep that little nugget tucked away for later use.
translation: 丘奇真把自己当救世主了。大伙连扎个木刺都往他那儿跑，丫敛财舔盖子比灌酒还起劲。要那群人知道他以前在天堂瀑给奴隶贩子当医师，早把他那怂货赶出镇子了。不过这小秘密我先留着，说不定哪天能派上用场。

original: Moriarty's Info on Dad
translation: 莫里亚蒂有关爸爸的消息

original: This guy is a class A weirdo. One day I'm wiping down the bar and the fucker comes from out of nowhere... I didn't even hear the door open. He tells me he's here to wait for some sort of an opportunist to come through. Whatever. As long as he pays for his drinks, he can stay here until that damn bomb explodes in the center of town for all I care.
translation: 这货是个A级怪人。那天我正擦吧台呢，这混蛋突然从地缝里冒出来……我连门响都没听见。丫跟我说在这儿等什么投机份子上门。爱咋咋地吧。只要他付自己酒钱，待到镇中该死的炸弹炸成蘑菇云，老子管他呢。

original: Littlehorn & Associates
translation: 小号角&搭档

original:
Dear sir and/or madam,

Do you find yourself with an absence of moral fortitude? Is the notion of having a moral quandary alien to you? In your opinion, is a conscience inconceivable? Then you are the sort of person we're looking for at Littlehorn & Associates! 

Stop by our offices in the eastern side of the large Scrapyard in the Wasteland for details.

Yours sincerely,

Daniel Littlehorn
translation:
尊敬的先生/女士：

您是否自认缺乏道德操守？道德困境对您而言是否如同异域概念？在您的认知里，良知根本不存在？那么，您正是利特霍恩联合公司正在寻觅的人才！

请亲临废土大型废车场东侧的办事处详询。

您诚挚的，

丹尼尔·利特霍恩

original: The Regulators
translation: 监管者

original: Attention Lawbringers of the Capitol Wasteland: The Regulators require your aid in bringing the scum and pestilence that inhabit our home to justice. Report to Sonora Cruz at the Regulator Headquarters for details.
translation: 首都废土的执法者们请注意：监管者需要你们的帮助，将居住在我们家园的人渣和瘟疫绳之以法。向监管者总部的索诺拉·克鲁兹报到以获取详情。

original: Contract for Extermination
translation: 灭绝合同

original: Find [%] and show how we treat people that fail to live up to Mr. Tenpenny's expectations. Do not fail me. You know what will happen if you arouse my displeasure.\n\n-B
translation: 给[%]一点颜色瞧瞧，他们辜负了特佩尼先生的期望。别让我失望。你是知道的，如果我不高兴了，后果很严重。\n\n-B

original: Contract Killing
translation: 刺杀合同

original: Contract: \n\nKill that Slaver! No one takes our friends and family without getting some Wasteland justice in return!
translation: 合约：\n\n干掉那些奴贩们！只要重建了废土的法律，就没人能抓走我们的朋友和家人了！

original: Note From Pronto
translation: 来自普郎托的短信

original: Okay, look. Here's how it is: I need some better stuff to trade or else I'm never going to get anything worthwhile in this place. Bring me some Chinese Assault Rifles. Say... about 20? I should be able to get some better stuff in to sell you after that.
translation: 好吧，看。事情是这样的：我需要搞一些更好的东西来做买卖，否则我这永远都是些破烂。给我弄些中式突击步枪。恩……差不多20支？到时候我就能换到一些更好的东西卖你了。

original:
Vault 76 Goal Summary
*************************

Vault 76 is one of our seventeen control Vaults. It will operate exactly according to the plan dictated in the marketing material produced by Vault-Tec and precisely to resident expectations. This vault will open automatically after a period of 20 years and the residents will be pushed back into the open world for study in comparison to the other experiments.
translation:
76避难所目标摘要
*************************

76避难所是我们控制的17个避难所之一。此避难所将按居民的期望和计划，使用避难所科技公司来生产商用材料并投放市场。该避难所将于20年后自动开启，居民届时将回归外界生活，并与外界住民比较，或者用以继续进行其他实验研究。

original: I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life, freely.

original: A Birthday Poem
translation: 一首生日诗

original:
Gray walls, impenetrable steel.
Suffocation! Condemnation!
Little hands groping in subterranean uncertainty.
Mommy? Daddy? Am I dead?
Nay! Nay! Reborn into purifying fluorescence!

A face emerges, strong and male.
Father to me? Father to all! 
Overseeing our lives, our eternities.
Harshness of discipline. Harshness of love.
Obedience my savior!

Larva to pupa, pupa to worker.
Buzz, buzz! One with the steel honeycomb.
10 lies within the 101, significant at last.
Till gray seeps from walls to hair, to soul.
Then, eternal slumber, the sweet sleep of incineration.
translation:
阴暗的围墙，不可逾越的铁壁。
令人窒息！罪孽的宣告！
小手在这未知的地下摸索。
母亲？父亲？我已经死了吗？
没有！还没有！去为净化这荧光而重生吧！

一张脸浮现了出来，坚毅而阳刚。
是我的父亲吗？不 他是万物之父！
他俯视着我们的今生与来世。
严厉的训诫，严厉的爱。
服从你！我们的造物主！

虫化蛹，蛹化蜂。
在这铁铸的蜂房间飞舞。
101号避难所的十大谎言，深意最终也会彰显。
直到这黑暗从墙缝中流出，透进发丝，渗进灵魂。
那时，甜美地睡在焚身的烈火中，永恒的长眠。

original: Vault-Tec Security Procedures
translation: 避难所科技公司安保程序

original:
Due to repeated attempts to obtain protected Vault-Tec information, the following security procedures have now been instituted:

1. Shutdown of the VTMB01 Masterbrain requires authorization from all three System Operator terminals.

2. All materials of a sensitive nature have been removed from external terminals and access to the Mainframe Room requires authorization from all three System Operator terminals.

3. All mechanized security is now being handled by the VTMB01 Masterbrain via security uplink. Please do not tamper with this unit without an authorized Service Technician present.
translation:
为使避难所科技公司信息可以得到多重保护，以下安全程序已经被建立：

1.关闭 VTMB01主机器脑需要全部三个系统操作终端的授权。

2.所有敏感性质的材料已经从外部终端移除，访问主机房需要全部三个系统操作终端的授权。

3.所有机械化安全措施交由VTMB01主机器脑通过安全上行链路进行管理，在没有通过认证的服务技术员在场的情况下请勿修改本单元。

original: Message 0099D Vending Machines
translation: 消息0099D 自动售货机

original: Once again someone has been tampering with the vending machines in the cafeteria. This practice violates section VT00987/A in Volume 17 of the Employee Handbook. If the machine malfunctions or does not dispense its contents properly, please refrain from kicking, shaking, punching, hitting with a fire extinguisher or filling the coin slot with fecal matter.
translation: 又有人在自助餐厅的自动售货机上搞破坏了。这种做法违反了《员工手册》第17卷第VT00987/A条规定。如果自动售货机发生故障或不能正常投币，请不要用脚踢、用手摇、用拳敲、用灭火器砸或往投币口里塞垃圾。

original: Message 0101C Bathroom Breaks
translation: 消息0101C 洗手间时间

original: It has recently come to our attention that employees are abusing the liberal breaks policy as outlined in section VT00733/D in Volume 18 of the Employee Handbook. As a result, Human Resources and Administration have come to an agreement on a reasonable time reduction. As of today, all bathroom breaks will be reduced from 2.37 minutes to 2.25 minutes.
translation: 我们最近注意到，员工正在滥用《员工手册》第 18 卷第 VT00733/D 条所规定的宽松休息时间政策。因此，人力资源部和行政部就合理缩短休息时间达成了协议。从今天起，所有上厕所的时间将从2.37分钟减少到2.25分钟。

original: Message 0102A Vault 112 Done!
translation: 消息0102A 112号避难所完工！

original: This is just a quick announcement to let you know that work on Vault 112 has been completed sporting the latest and greatest in "Vault-Technology"?. Way to go, Tec-ites!
translation: 这只是个快报。为了让您知道避难所科技公司最新最伟大的成果 — 112号避难所的工作已经完成了。\哎呀，路还长着呢，科技城！

original: Mainframe Access Password
translation: 主机登录密码

original: The mainframe access password is "ILoveVaults."
translation: 主机登录密码是“ILoveVaults”。

original: Vault-Tec Vault Information
translation: 避难所科技公司避难所信息

original: You've downloaded the locations and access codes to Vaults 87, 92, 101, 106 and 108.
translation: 你下载了避难所87号、92号、101号，106号和108号的位置信息和密码。

original: Message 0114D Vault 77 Changes
translation: 信息号 0114D 77号避难所的调整

original: The following item has been added to the Vault 92 Requisition Request: 14 WNB Type Noise Generators, 14 Broadcast Relays, 14 Monitoring Terminals. If these changes are in error, please contact the Supplies and Planning Department immediately.
translation: 在92号避难所的设备申领单增加以下内容：14套WNB噪音发射器，14组广播中继，14组监控终端。如果这些调整有误，请立即联系补给与计划部门。

original: Transportation Exhibits
translation: 交通运输展厅

original: The Museum of Technology is proud to present a journey through the history of ground transportation. Take a step back in time and see the original steam-powered car and the development of the internal combustion engine. Experience the rise of micro-sized nuclear power and walk through our 2-story mock fusion engine to see what happens first hand when you turn the key. Exhibit sponsored by the Chryslus Corporation.
translation: 科技博物馆为能呈现一段陆上交通的历史而感到荣幸。回到过去，并见证原始的蒸汽动力机车和内燃引擎的发展。经历微型核电的崛起和领略我们的二层式模拟融合引擎。第一时间观测当你转动开关时会发生什么。展会提供方是克莱斯勒公司。

original: Robotics Exhibits
translation: 机器人展览

original:
The Museum of Technology is proud to be the home of some of the original prototypes in the Mr. Handy, Mr. Gutsy and Protectron robotics lines. 

See the development of these metallic assistants and how they've made our lives easier. 

Play our Artificial Intelligence game where you will program a robot and watch it obey your commands in real time! After seeing what makes them tick, you'll never look at your robot the same way again. 

Exhibit sponsored by RobCo and General Atomics International.
translation:
科技博物馆为能成为“巧手”先生、“勇敢”先生的原型机和保护者机器人生产线之家而感到荣幸。

看到这些金属助手的发展，还有他们如何使我们的生活更简单。

玩我们的人工智能游戏，您将为一个机器人编程，并观看它实时服从您的命令！在了解了机器人的工作原理后，您将对您的机器人有新的看法。

本展览由RobCo和通用原子国际公司赞助。

original: Flight Exhibits
translation: 飞行器展厅

original: Take to the skies and soar above the clouds as you view our aircraft exhibits throughout the Museum of Technology. The original Wright Brothers Flyer, the vintage WWII P-51 Mustang and several other aircraft can be found hanging about the museum. Also, be sure and visit our Flight Experience Gallery where you can take a simulated airline flight on board a full-sized jetliner or step into the hair-raising, white-knuckle world of air traffic control in our Tower of Terror exhibit. Sponsored by Lockreed Industries.
translation: 当你在参观我们科技博物馆的飞行器展时，犹如驰骋在蓝天白云之中。怀特兄弟的原型机，老式的二战P51野马和一系列其他的飞行器都被悬挂起来供欣赏。并且，可以肯定的是参观我们的飞行展会，你可以模拟一次飞行，无论是全尺寸的喷气式飞机，还是在我们的恐怖展塔上进入毛骨悚然的空中之旅世界。提供方Lockreed工业。

original: Spaceflight Exhibits
translation: 航天展厅

original: Countdown to excitement as you take to the stars in our brand new Spaceflight Gallery. Marvel at man's ingenuity as you view an exact replica of the Virgo II Moon Lander that participated in the first manned moon landing. Dabble with forces beyond your comprehension in our working G-Force simulator ride or take to the stars in the Copernicus Planetarium. Exhibits sponsored by the United States Space Administration.
translation: 当你进入我们的宇宙飞行展，犹如倒计时一样的兴奋。当你观赏一个做工精细的人类首次登月的室女II登月舱的复制品时，你会惊讶到人类的创造力。在我们的重力模拟器下，感触那个能超越你理解的力量，或者在哥伦比亚天文望眼镜下观测星空。展会提供方是美国宇宙协会。

original: Vault-Tec's Vault Tour
translation: 避难所科技公司：避难所观光旅游

original: Thanks to a generous grant from the Vault-Tec corporation, the Vault Tour is open to the public. Walk through a section of actual Vault and observe all of the modern conveniences Vault-Tec has added to its now legendary nuclear fallout shelters. Interact with the exhibits within the Vault and see just how life within one of these subterranean marvels is as comfortable as living at home. Time tickets for the tour are now available at the Information Desk in the Main Atrium.
translation: 感谢避难所科技公司的大力支持，避难所观光旅游正式对外开放。游览真实的避难所的一部分，并参观避难所科技公司为这传奇般的核辐射掩体所增加的所有现代化设施。与避难所里的展品进行互动，并亲身体验在这些地下奇迹中有如家般舒适的生活。限时票在主展厅的服务台有售。

original: Planetarium Shows
translation: 天文馆展览

original:
Copernicus Planetarium
Schedule is subject to change without notice. Please inquire at the Information Desk for tickets and ticket prices.

"The Long Road to Mars" 1:00pm, 3:00pm, 5:00pm
Take a simulated flight through the stars from our Earth to the Red Planet.

"Journey Beyond the Universe" 1:30pm, 3:30pm
What lies beyond our universe? Take a theoretical journey farther than anyone's gone before.

"We're All Just Stardust" 12:30pm, 2:00pm, 4:00pm
This program asks the simple but thought-provoking question "Where did we come from?".

"Zany Planet Show" 11:30am, 12:00pm, 2:30pm, 4:30pm
Join Captain Space Galaxy as he travels the solar system and visits each of the worlds within it. Recommended for Kids 4 - 10 years old.
translation:
哥白尼天文馆
本时间表可能随时更改，不另行通知。请到服务台咨询详情和票价。

《去火星的漫漫长路》 下午1:00，下午3:00，下午5:00
从我们地球飞往那个红色星球的模拟航行。

《超越银河系的旅行》下午1:30，下午3:30
我们宇宙的另一边有什么？踏上前所未有的理论之旅吧。

《我们都只是星尘》 中午12:30，下午2:00，下午4:00
这个节目提出了一个简单却引人深思的问题：“我们来自哪里？”。

《滑稽的行星表演》 上午11:30，中午12:00，下午2:30，下午4:30
同“银河空间”船长一起在太阳系里旅行，并到各个星球上观光。推荐：四到十岁的小孩。

original: Lecture Tickets
translation: 演讲门票

original:
Oppenheimer's Folly?
A Lecture by Professor R.J. Gumbie

This lecture explores the very real possibility that nuclear war may not be as far off as we think and the effects it will have on the future of our planet. By illustrating past uses of smaller scale atomic weapons, Professor Gumbie will shock you, frighten you and make you wish you could just Duck and Cover to survive a real nuclear attack. Tickets are now available for this Lecture Series at the Information Desk in the Main Atrium.
translation:
奥本海默的愚蠢？
演讲者：R·J·冈比教授

此演讲探究了一种非常真实的可能性，那就是核战可能并不像我们想象的那么遥远，而且会对我们星球的未来产生巨大的影响。通过列举过去人类使用的小规模核子武器，冈比教授的演讲将会震惊你，并让你期望能仅靠“弯下腰躲起来”就在一场真实的核子攻击中幸存下来。该演讲专题的门票在主展厅的服务台有售。

original: West Tek Power Armor Demo
translation: 西部科技动力装甲演示

original: West Tek, the world's leading arms manufacturer, demonstrates the T-51b Power Armor Suit in our Darwin Theater. Get a first hand look at how the armor is designed to defeat any type of adversary with an actual live combat simulation using robotic targets. Time tickets are available at the Information Desk in the Main Atrium. Note that a liability wavier must be signed to attend this event.
translation: 西部科技，引领世界的武器制造商，将在我们的达尔文展厅展示整套T-51b型动力装甲。来抢先目睹这个装甲是如何在机器人实战模拟中击败任意类型对手的吧。限时票在主展厅服务台有售。注意，参与者必须签署责任声明书。

original: GigantoMax Theater
translation: GigantoMax影院

original:
GigantoMax Theater
Schedule is subject to change without notice. Please inquire at the Information Desk for tickets and ticket prices.

"Yikes!" 12:00pm, 3:00pm, 6:00pm
Cower in fear as all sorts of gigantic vehicles drive at the viewer and give you a bug's eye view of oncoming traffic.

"Rollercoaster" 1:00pm, 4:00pm
Strap yourself in for the ride of your life... all from the safety of our 300 Seat GigantoMax theater. Ride 10 of the world's most notorious rollercoasters from the front seat. Sickness bags not included.

"Colonoscopy" 2:00pm, 5:00pm, 7:00pm
Using our special GigantoMax technology, you'll marvel at the details on our 3-story screen as you take a real time voyage into a very familiar part of the human anatomy.
translation:
GigantoMax影院
本时间表可能随时更改，不另行通知。请到服务台咨询详情和票价。

《呀！》  中午12:00，下午3:00，晚上6:00
以一只虫子的视角来展示迎面而来的车流，从而带给观众各种巨大交通工具驶过时的恐惧感受。

《过山车》 下午1:00，下午4:00
为了您的生命安全，请系好安全带……当然，我们拥有三百个座位的GigantoMax影院是保证安全的，从前排享受全世界十大最刺激的过山车吧。呕吐袋请自备。

《结肠镜检查》 下午2:00，下午5:00，晚上7:00
采用我们特殊的GigantoMax科技，让你在我们耳熟能详的人体内部器官中旅游，我们三层银幕上的细节将会让你惊叹不已。

original: Beta Testing Notice
translation: 公测通知

original:
***Beta Testing Notice***

Ms. Granier -

Beginning Monday, members of the Grognak's Lil' Heathens Fan Club will begin visiting the offices to participate in beta-testing our Reign of Grelok software. Participants must fill out our participation agreement, and should be directed to the testing station fifteen minutes prior to their scheduled appointment time. Just follow the main hallway all the way to the end and go through the door on your right. From there, the Beta Testing Area is just down the smaller hallway to your right.

Rebecca, a personal note - some members of the Fan Club may be a little… exuberant. We realize that you are not a baby-sitter, and appreciate the extra trouble you'll be going to this week. This beta test is very important to getting our Hubris Software venture off to a good start, so please do your best to keep things under control out front. You will be compensated at time-and-a-half for the week as a token of our gratitude for your trouble.
translation:
***公测通知***

格兰尼尔女士 -

星期一开始，歌南的“李·哈森”爱好者俱乐部的会员将来到办事处参加我们软件《葛瑞拉卡王朝》的公测活动。参加者必须填写我们的活动协议，并且要按照指引提前十五分钟进入测试区域。顺着主走廊走到头，然后进入右边的门就可以了。在那里，公测区就在右边小一点的走廊下面。

瑞贝卡，一个正式的照会 - 一些俱乐部的会员可能会有一些过于兴奋。我们非常明白你并不是一个临时保姆，对于这一周将会给你带来的这些额外的麻烦，我们将非常感激。这次公测对于降低我们虎不理软件的风险是一个很好的开端，所以非常重要，请尽可能做到最好使事情保持在控制之下。这一周你会被奖励相当于你工资一倍半的加班费作为我们对你辛勤劳动的感激。

original: MQ02MaintTermNote01
translation: MQ02MaintTermNote01

original:
The Planetarium recording system has been malfunctioning lately, causing the normally automated program to stop and repeat itself. If you observe this happening, please contact myself or the chief of maintenance on duty immediately so the system can be restarted. We hope to have the issue resolved by the start of next year.

Derek Remmings
Maintenance Coordinator
translation:
天像仪系统最近有故障，有时会自动的重复。如果您发现了这个问题，请立即联系我或者当班的维修组领班来让系统重启。我们希望在明年伊始能彻底解决这个问题。

德里克·瑞梅斯
维修协调员

original: MQ02MaintTermNote02
translation: MQ02MaintTermNote02

original:
After numerous complaints, and a single pending lawsuit, the GigantoMax Theater's sound system has been lowered from 130 decibels to 120 decibels. Please note that all employees working in or near the theater should still wear proper ear protection to prevent any permanent damage.

Derek Remmings
Maintenance Coordinator
translation:
由于大量的投诉和官司，GigantoMAX影院已把音响从130分贝下调到120分贝。请通知所有在剧院内部及附近工作人员，仍然需要佩带耳部防护设备以防止永久性听力损伤。

德里克·瑞梅斯
维修协调员

original: MQ02MaintTermNote03
translation: MQ02MaintTermNote03

original:
This is a general announcement to any employees who use the men's lavatory facility in the maintenance area. I have logged too many complaints that people are not flushing the toilets after using them. People who use the facility to relieve themselves expect a clean and tidy environment. To prevent this from becoming a reoccurring issue, card swipe access will be required for each stall which will log your name, time in the stall, and contents of the bowl until such time that we deem it no longer necessary.

Derek Remmings
Maintenance Coordinator
translation:
通告所有使用维修区洗手间的员工：近期有多起投诉员工用过洗手间不冲洗。洗手间需要干净卫生的环境。为防止此类事件再次发生，厕位将采用实名刷卡制度，卡片记录内容包括姓名、使用厕位时间及储水箱水位。此项制度将持续至我们认为不再必要为止。

德里克·瑞梅斯
维修协调员

original: MQ02MaintTermNote04
translation: MQ02MaintTermNote04

original:
Due to the increased power consumption from the installation of the Vault-Tec Vault Tour, three new reactors have been installed in the sub-basement section. This should help prevent any further brown-outs or full black-outs in the visitor galleries that we've been experiencing. Thanks for your patience during this transition.

Derek Remmings
Maintenance Coordinator
translation:
由于避难所科技展览导致电力消耗增加，地下室里将安装三个新的反应器。此举将解决游客展馆里灯光变暗和断电问题。此过程中请您耐心等待，谢谢。

德里克·瑞梅斯
维修协调员

original: MQ02ResearchTermNote01
translation: MQ02ResearchTermNote01

original:
The virus that has been plaguing our Archetype Model FF06 Mainframe due to an unknown attack has finally been localized by our research team and identified. After a complete cleanup on the mainframe's core, I am happy to announce that the infection has been removed... the soul of this machine has improved.

B. Bell
Research Lead
translation:
在某次未知攻击中感染原型FF06主计算机的病毒已被我研究小组发现并确认。对主机核心进行清理之后，我很高兴地宣布病毒感染被清除了……这台机器又获得了新生。

B.比尔
研究员主管

original: MQ02ResearchTermNote02
translation: MQ02ResearchTermNote02

original:
Our new addition to the Spaceflight Gallery, the Virgo II Lunar Lander, is now open to the general public and ready for viewing. I want to extend a hardy thank you and job well done to the entire Research & Restoration Team for pulling that pile of junk out of mothballs and putting it in such fine shape. Many sleepless nights were spent on this project, and as a small token of our thanks, you will find a substantial bonus in your next paycheck. Give each other a pat on the back... you've earned it.

B. Bell
Research Lead
translation:
新近添置进宇宙飞船展馆室女II登月舱已对公众开放，可以参观了。我在此谨对负责此项工作的研究与修复小组致以衷心的感谢。你们做了一项伟大的工作，是你们把成堆的废料从垃圾堆里拖出来并组装成了如此惊人逼真的形象。在此工作中你们付出了无数个不眠之夜和辛勤汗水。作为我们的一点小小谢意，你们会收到一笔丰厚的奖金作为酬劳，以资鼓励团队中的每一个人……这是你们应得的。

B.贝尔
研究员主管

original: MQ02ResearchTermNote03
translation: MQ02ResearchTermNote03

original:
This is just a quick rundown of acquisitions we have been awarded for 2078. If any of these interest you, please stop by and see me so we can discuss it or submit a standard research request before the cutoff date. All submissions must be made by October 2nd, 2077, so now is the time to get them in.

*Supersonic Airliner
*ZAX Computer Prototype
*Original Model T-45d Power Armor Suit
*Laser Pistol Prototype

B. Bell
Research Lead
translation:
这仅是一个我们在2078年获得的资产的纲要。如果您对其中某项感兴趣，请于截止日期前联系我们，我们可以详细商谈或者委托一份标准化的研究协议。投稿截止日期为2077年10月2日。现在即可开始。

*超音速客机
*扎克斯电脑原型
*T-45d动力装甲原始模型
*激光手枪原型

B.贝尔
研究员主管

original: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact01
translation: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact01

original: The planet Jupiter is larger than 1,000 Earths!
translation: 木星比1000个地球还大！

original: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact02
translation: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact02

original: The outer layers of the sun have what's known as "differential rotation". The equator of the surface rotates once every 25.4 days; but near the poles it rotates once every 36 days!
translation: 太阳大气的外层有种被称为“较差自转”的现象。在赤道附近的\n日面自转一周要25.4天，但是在极地附近，日面自转\n一周却需要36天！

original: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact03
translation: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact03

original: A neutron star is completely dense and solid matter. In fact, it weighs a trillion times heavier than lead. That means a piece of a neutron star the size of a pinhead would weigh as much as a large building!
translation: 中子星是超大密度的实体，密度是铅的一百亿\n亿倍。这意味着一个针尖大小的中子星物质其重量超过\n一座楼房！

original: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact04
translation: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact04

original: The sun loses almost 4 million tons of mass every second by turning hydrogen gas into energy. That adds up to almost 345 billion tons per day!
translation: 太阳在把氢气转化成能量的过程中，每秒会损失400万吨\n的质量，每天可以损失几乎3450亿吨物质！

original: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact05
translation: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact05

original: If we were to send a message to someone on a planet belonging to our closest neighboring solar system, Alpha Centauri, which is almost 4.4 light-years away, we wouldn't receive a reply message for 8.8 years!
translation: 如果我们向离我们最近的相邻太阳系的行星 — 4.4光年\n距离的半人马座阿尔法星 — 的人们发送信息，在8.8\n年之内，我们都不会收到任何回复的信号！

original: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact06
translation: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact06

original: There are about one hundred and seventy five billion galaxies in the observable universe each with as few as ten million stars up to giants with one trillion stars, all orbiting a common center of mass!
translation: 在我们能观测到的宇宙空间里，有大概1750亿个星云，每\n个星云都包含数量从一千万到一百亿亿不等的星体。\n这些星体全部围绕一个相同质量中心进行旋转！

original: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact07
translation: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact07

original: If all of the particles that make up Saturn's rings were gathered together, they would form a sphere about 120 miles in diameter!
translation: 如果把土星光环的所有物质能够堆放在一起，可以组成一个\n直径120英里的球体！

original: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact08
translation: MQ02FarOutSpaceFact08

original: Olympus Mons, a volcano found on Mars, is the largest known volcano in the solar system. It is 370 miles (595 km) across and rises 15 miles (24 km). That's 3 times taller than Mount Everest!

original: MQ02RocketInfoNote
translation: MQ02RocketInfoNote

original: The Delta IX Rocket, commissioned by the USSA in 2020, was the last of the manned rockets that sent our brave American Astronauts to the moon. The Delta IX was in use for almost 15 years before being converted for military use and having the crew and instruments sections replaced with a nuclear warhead. The Delta IX recorded over 77 successful launches, making it one of the most successful rockets in U.S. History.\n\nThe rocket, developed entirely by USSA scientists, was a single-stage vehicle with an ejectable crew section or satellite storage bay. The propulsion system was a nuclear-electric derivative drive, using a massive electrical jolt to start the nuclear reaction on launch. The crew section was protected from the radioactive chambers by way of a massive titanium-vanadium disc. The spacecraft had the capability to sustain 2 astronauts for up to 24 days maximum. The longest recorded spaceflight in a Delta IX rocket was the 17-day Zeus 12 Mission to the moon.
translation: 由USSA于2020年委任的D9型火箭是把伟大勇敢的美利坚合众国宇航员送入太空的最后一艘载人火箭。D9型在使用15年后转为军用，其船员和设备舱被替换成了核弹头，使之成为美国历史上最为成功的火箭之一。\nD9型是一枚完全由USSA科学家研发的单级火箭，装载了可弹出式的宇航员舱和卫星存放舱，推进系统为核电装置，发射时籍由大量的电子震动来激发核反应。宇航员舱以大量钛钒合金防御宇宙辐射。这艘飞船最多能够维持2名宇航员24天的生活。D9型火箭的最长记录产生于月球任务17-day Zeus 12 Misson。
