original:
By Walter “Street Beat” Munroe

Capital Post Staff Writer

What American child alive hasn’t heard the story of the Pint-Sized Slasher, that diminutive demon in a clown mask who stalks and slashes the innocent residents of supposedly safe suburbia? It’s just one of the many folk stories parents use to scare their youngsters into behaving themselves. Or is it?

According to Germantown police chief Joseph Field, the Pint-Sized Slasher may be more real than many people would like to admit. “After reviewing the autopsy results of the Linden Street slayings, we have confirmed that the force and direction of every knife wound are consistent with an attack from a much smaller assailant. A child, to be precise.”

Add to the sinister forensic findings this statement from Christopher Atkinson, the one surviving victim of the adolescent assassin, and it becomes clear that the Pint-Sized Slasher does indeed walk among us: “The clown! The clown! He’s going to kill us all, do you understand me? He stabbed my brother Shaun right in the face! He killed my brother! The little clown!”

But assuming the Pint-Sized Slasher is indeed a real, tangible threat to the peace loving residents of D.C. suburbia, one question remains: why? What could possible motivate a child to don a clown mask and murder innocent people in cold blood? We may never know. At least not until the miniature maniac is brought to justice. Until then, all we can do is lock our doors, kiss our children goodnight… and pray they live to see morning.
translation:
作者 沃尔特·“街拍”·芒罗

《首都邮报》特约撰稿人

哪个美国小孩没有听过那个小小屠夫的故事？这个迷你恶魔，带着小丑面具，偷偷地潜入家里，杀害那些住在郊区的无辜的居民，而他们一直都以为那儿很安全。这是众多民间故事中的一个，家长用来吓唬孩子，以使他们懂得要守规矩。是这样吗？

根据日耳曼敦警察局长乔瑟夫·菲尔德的说法，小小屠夫可能是真实的，而不是大多数人想的那样只是个谣传。“在重新检查过了林登大街凶杀案的尸检报告之后，我们确信，每一道刀伤的力度和角度，都来自于一个体型很小的凶手。 准确而言，一个孩子。”

除了这些阴险的法医鉴定结果之外，克里斯托弗·阿特金森也发表了声明，他是这名少年杀手的唯一幸存者： “小丑！小丑！小丑！他要把我们都杀了，你明白吗？他刺伤了我哥哥肖恩的脸！他杀了我哥哥！小丑！”

但是，假设“小小屠夫”确实对华盛顿郊区热爱和平的居民构成了真实的、有形的威胁，那么还有一个问题：为什么？是什么促使一个孩子戴上小丑面具，冷血地杀害无辜者？我们可能永远不会知道。至少在这个迷你疯子被绳之以法之前，我们永远不会知道。在此之前，我们所能做的就是锁好门，亲吻我们的孩子道晚安......并祈祷他们能活到天亮。

original: MS04WBrandice6172277Note
translation: MS04WBrandice6172277Note

original: I can't believe I went through all that trouble to leave Navarro and make my way across the country just to get stuck in this shithole. I'll be damned if I'm going to die here.\n\nNow that we're cut off from Lesko and Wilks, I think we're on our own. The damn ants keep trying to find a way to get inside the house. Even as I'm typing this, I can hear them scraping the walls looking for a way through. I don't know how much longer we can last.
translation: 真不敢相信，我费尽周折离开纳瓦罗，横跨全国，却被困在这个鬼地方。如果我死在这里，那就亏大了。\n\n现在我们与莱斯科和威尔克斯中断了联系，我想我们只能靠自己了。那些该死的蚂蚁一直在想办法进到屋子里来。就在我打字的时候，都能听到它们在刮墙找路。我不知道我们还能撑多久。

original: MS04WBrandice4022277Note
translation: MS04WBrandice4022277Note

original: I'm going to have to find a better way to protect Sheila and Will from those ants. Ever since Lesko came to town, I'm certain they're getting more and more aggressive. Wasteland ants are bad enough, but at least you can run away from them. These would seem to pursue you to the ends of the earth if they could. Call me crazy, but I swear I saw one start a fire the other day. I don't know how this could be happening.\n\nI've decided to dig up my old sidearm and keep it hidden on me at all times. If those things get too close, I'll blast the antennae right off their ugly heads.
translation: 我得想个好办法，保护希拉和威尔不受蚂蚁伤害。自从莱斯科来镇子后，我敢肯信它们越来越有攻击性了。废土蚂蚁已经够糟的了，但至少你还能躲开它们。如果可以的话，这里的蚂蚁会追着你到天涯海角。你可以说我疯了，但我发誓前几天我看到一只蚂蚁放火了。我不明白怎么会这样的。\n\n我决定把我的旧随身武器找出来，一直带在身上。如果这些畜生胆敢靠近我，我就一枪把触须从他们恶心的头上打下来。

original: MS04WBrandice11152276Note
translation: MS04WBrandice11152276Note

original: Some scientist named Lesko moved in with the Wilks family across the street. They are helping him make some sort of a structure on the old lot near the diner. Lesko offered to pay me caps if I helped, but I declined. I dunno who he's working for, but I don't think they're still looking for me.\n\nOur supplies are running low, and I need to begin foraging for food and some better drinking water. I'd have an easier time if it wasn't for the damn ants. I swear they have a nest around here somewhere.
translation: 有个叫莱斯科什么的科学家搬到了街对面的威尔克斯家。他们帮他在餐厅附近的旧地皮上建了个什么建筑。莱斯科说如果我帮忙就付我瓶盖，但我拒绝了。我不知道他在为谁工作，但我不觉得他们还在找我。\n\n我们的补给不多了，我得开始寻找食物和更好的饮用水。要不是这些该死的蚂蚁，我还能轻松点。我发誓它们在这附近有个巢穴。

original: MS04WBrandice2242277Note
translation: MS04WBrandice2242277Note

original: These ants are becoming a real pain in the ass. So much so that I had to take a trip to Megaton and buy a better gun to protect my family. It cost me a small fortune... I had to trade every bit of ant meat I had collected, but it was worth it. I'm teaching Frank and Sheila to use it just in case something happens to me. If one of you two are reading this, and I'm gone, I keep the gun in the kitchen behind the old fridge.
translation: 这些蚂蚁越来越让人头疼，因此我跑到兆吨镇买了把强力武器来保护家人。它真的花了我一大笔钱……我把搜集到的全部蚂蚁肉都卖了才攒够钱，不过很值得。我正在教弗兰克和希拉使用这把枪，万一我有个三长两短，他们也能保护自己了。如果你俩有人读到了这条信，而我又不在，我把枪放在了厨房里，就在那台旧冰箱后面。

original:

The spots on TV and radio will tease the consumer with the blue glow of the new drink, never showing the bottle in an illuminated environment. The billboard will show the bottle's blue silhouette on a black background.

The tag line will be "Try something new... Go Blue!". The name will not be revealed until Stage Two.
translation:
核子可乐量子版营销的第一阶段将包括：2（二） 15（十五）秒电视广告，4（四） 10（十）秒电台广告以及一块高速公路广告牌联动。

广告语将用“尝尝鲜……选蓝色！”。饮料的名字应于第二阶段公布。

translation: MS05MarketingTerminal02

In this stage, the name "Quantum" will be revealed and the bottle shown in full view. We will emphasize the drink's new energy content and flavor.

The tag line will be "Take the leap... enjoy a Quantum!"

核子可乐量子版营销的第二阶段将包括: 2（二） 30（三十）秒电视广告, 4（四） 15（十五）秒电台广告以及一块高速公路广告牌联动。

核子可乐量子版营销的第三阶段将包括：4（四） 30（三十）秒电视广告, 4（四） 15（十五）秒电台广告以及一块高速公路广告牌联动。

广告语仍用“勇敢一跃……尽享量子！”

translation: MS05RDTerminal01

The only listed side effects from the group are: 3 cases of dizziness, 1 case of nausea and 1 case of impaired vision. We find from a sampling of 50 that this is an acceptable number of cases and approve this product for production.
translation: 参与“核子可乐量子版”项目的测试对象对重新调配的口味和新同位素反应良好。该组列出的唯一副作用是：3例头晕、1例恶心和1例视力受损。我们在50例样本中发现，这些副作用的数量是可接受的，因此批准该产品投入生产。

original: MS05RDTerminal02
translation: MS05RDTerminal02

original: Isotope CE772 has proven too damaging to the initial test group which now needs to be disbanded due to their reluctance to continue in our program. This group has suffered 4 fatalities, 12 major internal organ failures and 32 internal radiation burns. This is an unacceptable number of issues in a given test group and recommend we switch to an alternate isotope (such as CE774 or UR993).
translation: 已证实，同位素CE772对初步测试组造成了极大的伤害，由于他们不愿继续参与我们的项目，该组现需要解散。此组中有4例死亡，12例严重脏器衰竭，32例内辐射灼伤。在一个特定的测试组中，出现如此多的问题是不可接受的，因此我们建议改用其他同位素（如CE774或UR993）。

translation: MS05RDTerminal03

We recommend the immediate destruction of container A32 in the production rooms and suggest switching to isotope CE772. Please send standard "Nuka Condolences" Fruit and Cheese Packages to test group member's families.
translation: 同位素CE770已被证明是一次灾难性的失败。所有测试对象在摄入后三天内均出现严重器官衰竭并死亡。我们建议立即销毁生产间内的A32容器，并建议改用同位素CE772。请向测试组成员的家属寄标准的“核子慰问”水果和奶酪礼盒。

original: MS09VanceTerminal01
translation: MS09VanceTerminal01

original: Vampires are beings based in folklore that prey on humans for the purpose of obtaining their blood. In these fictitious stories, the blood serves as both a food source and a center of power for the vampire. It is a common motif in these tales that a victim could become a vampire if bitten by one. Other noted attributes of the vampire are its abilities to change into the form of a bat or a wolf, to become gaseous at will, the ability to hypnotize the opposite gender and increased life span.
translation: 血族是传说中的捕食人类并专门吸血的族群。在这些虚构的故事里，血液既是血族的食物来源，也是能量的核心。在这些传说中，有个共通的说法：当一个人被血族咬伤之后，他本身也会变成一个血族。另一些故事传说血族能够变身成为蝙蝠或者狼、能化身为气体并诱惑与其性别不同的人以延长自身的寿命。

original: MS09VanceTerminal02
translation: MS09VanceTerminal02

original: It is interesting to note that the vampire is traditionally regarded in literature as having an aversion to sunlight. Many people believe this may stem from the misunderstanding of common phobias such as photophobia and heliophobia or even the actual physical issue of photosensitivity. In all of these accounts, the subject withdraws from daytime activities and is rarely seen outdoors. In the 18th century, with medical science in its infancy, this commonly gave rise to ridiculous accusations by the uninformed that these people were "strange" or "cursed". This is likely the reason vampires are awarded this attribute in their stories.
translation: 有意思的是，在传统的文学作品中，血族都被描绘成憎恶阳光的生物。许多人认为这些传说源于对某些恐惧性疾病的误解，比如畏光、日光恐怖症或者日光过敏症。在所有作品的描述中，血族日出而息，日落而作，并极少在户外活动。在18世纪，随着医学开始启蒙，患有这些疾病的患者经常会被无知的人们荒谬地以“异端”或者“被诅咒”的罪名指控，很大程度上也是拜文学作品中的血族所赐。

original: MS09VanceTerminal03
translation: MS09VanceTerminal03

original: Depending on the cultural source, there are several ways to kill or destroy a vampire. The most common is by driving a wooden stake usually composed of ash, hawthorn or oak through the vampire's heart. In some cultures, the stake was driven through the mouth or stomach as well. Other tales tell of decapitation or immolation being the preferred method of destruction along with anything else that can completely annihilate the vampire's physical form.
translation: 依据大量的文艺作品，有几种办法能杀掉一名血族。最常见的是拿一根烟灰、山茶花和像木制成的木棍刺入血族的心脏。在一些作品中，也有用木棍刺穿口或者腹部的。另一些作品中，则以斩首或者祭杀作为毁灭血族肉体的首选方法。

original: MS15AWashTerminal01
translation: MS15AWashTerminal01

original: Recovery of the Declaration of Independence seems to be a loss. That damn woman I hired, Sydney, she said she could do it. Haven't seen her in months. I bet she's dead or ran off with the advance I gave her. That's the last time I trust someone. Told Harkness to keep an eye out for her just in case she ever comes back to the city. That's what I get for sending a woman to do a man's job!
translation: 收回《独立宣言》的工作看来失败了。我雇佣的那个臭婆娘希妮，她说她可以搞定的。现在都几个月没见她的影子了。我猜她可能已经死了或者带着我给的订金跑了。我再也不会信任任何人了。告诉哈克尼斯，如果她回来了，叫哈克尼斯看着她点。这就是派个婆娘去做男人的工作的后果！

original: MS15AWashTerminal02
translation: MS15AWashTerminal02

original: Came to find out through the grapevine that there are a bunch of Lincoln's artifacts still in the Museum of History. I think I may branch out from just collecting documents if I could get my hands on those gems. Only problem is I have to find someone braver than me who can get to the museum in one piece.
translation: 有谣传说，在历史博物馆里还有一大堆林肯的遗物，去找找。我真希望能变成三头六臂，边处理这些文件边去搜寻那些宝贝。唯一的问题是我得找一个比我还勇敢的、敢单枪匹马去博物馆的人。

original: MS15AWashTerminal03
translation: MS15AWashTerminal03

original: Bumped into a traveler a little while ago who showed me what he said was a fragment of the actual Liberty Bell! Poppycock! The Liberty Bell is still intact and laying in the ruins of Philly. I have funded an expedition to that dump in hopes of having the entire bell brought back to my museum.
translation: 我碰到一个旅行者，这家伙给我看一样东西，号称是货真价实的自由钟碎片！胡说八道！自由钟肯定还完好无损地躺在费城的废墟里。我已经组建了一支探险队深入到废墟中，期待能把那个完整的钟搬到我的博物馆来。

original: MS15CPSConstitution
translation: MS15CPSConstitution

original: The Constitution of the United States was drafted in 1786 and adopted a year later by the Constitutional Convention of Philly. This document defines the organization of the U.S. government and sets forth the rules and regulations, known as articles. In addition, there are modifications made to the articles by ruling Presidents during their reigns known as amendments. The society owns the only known copy of the document to exist which was retrieved from the ruins of the National Archives in 2256.
translation: 美利坚合众国宪法起草于1786年，并于一年后由费城制宪会议通过。该文件明确阐述了美国政府的组织架构，奠定了美国的政治制度和法律基础。亦是世界上第一部成文的宪法。此外，宪法已由许多届的总统修改过，称为宪法修正案。已知社会上现存的唯一一份文件副本是2256年在国家档案馆废墟里找到并复原的。

original: MS15CPSEmancipation
translation: MS15CPSEmancipation

original: The Emancipation Proclamation was a document issued by the breathtakingly charismatic President Abraham Lincoln in 1862. This executive order was the beginning of the end of slavery in the United States. Although it was issued during the Civil War, making it a war measure, it paved the way for the Thirteenth Amendment of the Constitution which completely abolished slavery once and for all.
translation: 《独立宣言》由那位具有传奇色彩的总统 — 亚伯拉罕·林肯于1862年颁布。这分行政指令是美国废除奴隶制的开始。虽然它在南北战争时期颁布，并作为一种战争方案来执行，但它为13条宪法修正案美国正式废除奴隶制度铺平了道路。

original: MS15CPSGettysburg
translation: MS15CPSGettysburg

original: The Capital Preservation Society is proud to have in its possession a copy of one of the most iconic and prolific speeches in United States history. This speech, given by the astonishingly intelligent Abraham Lincoln on Thursday, November 19, 1863, laid the groundwork for what would later become the basis of democracy in the United States and set the standards for a country with a government "by the people, for the people."
translation: 资本保护协会拥有一份美国历史上最为经典、最广为传诵的演讲稿。他们为此深感自豪。这份讲稿是由聪颖过人的总统--亚伯拉罕林肯于1863年11月19日星期四作的演说。它奠定了美国民主制度的基础，确定了国家政府“民治，民享”的理念。

original: MS15CPSMonroe
translation: MS15CPSMonroe

original: The Monroe Doctrine was presented in 1823 by the average and unremarkable President James Monroe. The document warns the European powers of the time not to interfere in the affairs of the Western Hemisphere, citing the examples of colonization and puppet governments as possible intolerances.
translation: 门罗主义由平庸的总统詹姆斯·门罗于1823年在国情咨文中提出。该文件警告当时的欧洲列强不得再干涉西半球国家事务。客观上促进了拉美国家殖民地政府的独立。

original: MS15CPSWaronGermany
translation: MS15CPSWaronGermany

original: Part of our collection is a copy of the formal declaration of war made on Germany during World War II on December 11, 1941 by the government and endorsed by the President Franklin D. Roosevelt. While the document doesn't evoke the brilliance of other masterworks like the Emancipation Proclamation, it still served as a reminder to the world that the United States wasn't a power to be trifled with.
translation: 我们收藏品中，有一份第二次世界大战期间，福兰克林.D.罗斯福总统于1941年12月11日发表的对德宣战宣言的副本。尽管它不象《解放黑奴宣言》等名作那样耀眼，它仍然向世界宣布了美国不是个好惹的国家。

original: MS15CPSWaronChina
translation: MS15CPSWaronChina

original: Although it is uncertain when the Declaration of War on China was made (some say 2066 when they invaded Alaska, others say 2067 when the first Power Armor suits were deployed to counter their forces), it is the last known document of note authored by the United States Government before the bombs fell. Had the Declaration had the tenacity and might of a stronger President behind it, say Abraham Lincoln, who's to say what the outcome of those tremulous years would have been?
translation: 尽管尚不确定《对中国宣战书》具体是哪一年宣布的（有人说是在2066年中国入侵阿拉斯加时，也有人说是在2067年第一批动力甲装备部队以反击中国军队时），它是已知现存的在核弹落下之前最后一个由美国政府颁布的官方文件。 假如这份宣言是由一个像林肯那样更加强硬和坚韧的总统所颁布，但是他为什么没有为战争的结果---这么多年的颓废和凄凉买单？

original: MS15RobotTerminal01
translation: MS15RobotTerminal01

original: The unit designated BGWIN009 "Button Gwinnett" is suffering from a system memory leak. I've had to flush the unit's core CPU several times last month; it's getting all of its orders and directives confused. The unit's reenactment subroutines are interfering with its tour guide subroutines, causing conflicting actions and scaring the visitors to our galleries. Recommend shutdown of this unit and replacement of central core.\n\nP. Brantseg - Robotics Team
translation: “巴顿·格威纳特”单位正受困于系统记忆泄漏。上个月我不得不多次刷新该单位的CPU核心。该单位混淆所有的程序指令，会把演出程序和观光向导程序混淆在一起引起冲突，发出奇怪的动作吓跑游客。建议关闭此单位，更换它的核心处理器。\n\nP.博软赛克 - 机器人技术组

original: MS15RobotTerminal02
translation: MS15RobotTerminal02

original: TRT007, one of our automated turrets, is constantly locking in its reset position. It is not responding properly to calibration nor will it track the test targets properly. This is likely due to its tracking array being misaligned with its targeting laser (a common problem in all of our automated turrets). Recommend replacement of tracking array.\n\nP. Brantseg - Robotics Team
translation: 我们的一座自动炮塔 — TRT007，会不断地自动锁定到默认位置，既不能对人工校准正确响应，也不能正确地追踪测试目标。原因很可能是追踪阵列和目标探测激光不匹配（我们的自动炮塔很常见的故障）建议替换追踪序列。\n\nP.博软赛克 - 机器人技术组

original: MS15RobotTerminal03
translation: MS15RobotTerminal03

original: EMT002 unit "Nightingale" is back online after an extensive refit. I've replaced its surgical arm, injector units, gyro-stabilizer system and thruster number three. The unit's central core has been reset and is now ready for service.\n\nP. Brantseg - Robotics Team
translation: EMT002 “夜莺”单位经过大修之后已经又可以重新连线了。我已替换了它的外科臂、注射装置、罗盘稳定系统和3号推进器。 该单位的中央处理器已重启，能够投入使用了。\n\nP.博软赛克 - 机器人技术组

original: MS15PodButtonTerminal01
translation: MS15PodButtonTerminal01

original: The BGWIN009 Button Gwinnett Unit is designed primarily as a participant in our reenactments of the signing of the Declaration of Independence show. This unit plays the part of Button Gwinnett of Georgia, second signer of the Declaration. This unit is also programmed with the standard Tour Guide Assistance subroutines and limited Security subroutines.
translation: BGWIN009 巴顿·格威纳特单位是为扮演《独立宣言》演出的一名参与者而设计。该单元将扮演《独立宣言》的第二位签署人 — 乔治亚州的巴顿·格威纳特。该单位也加载了标准观光向导程序和有限的安全程序。

original: MS15PodHancockTerminal01
translation: MS15PodHancockTerminal01

original: The JHANC003 John Hancock Unit is designed primarily as a participant in our reenactments of the signing of the Declaration of Independence show. This unit plays the part of John Hancock of Massachusetts, first signer of the Declaration. This unit is also programmed with the standard Tour Guide Assistance subroutines and limited Security subroutines.
translation: JHANC003 约翰·汉考克单位是为扮演《独立宣言》演出的一名参与者而设计 ,该单元将扮演《独立宣言》的第一位签署人 — 马萨诸塞州的约翰·汉考克。该单位也加载了标准观光向导程序和有限的安全程序。

original: Hydroponics Notes
translation: 水栽笔记

original:
The RC hydroponics have been restored to basic functionality - easy enough after all our research. The limited amount of clean water we can produce is enough for growing basic foodstuffs.

Still no progress on any mass-purification tests, and with all of the maintenance that has to be done around here, there's hardly any time to attempt new experiments. 

In any case, RC wouldn't work as a location for truly large scale decontamination. The infrastructure just isn't here, and the idea of recreating it again is too daunting to convince the rest of the council.

And that's even if the process worked.
translation:
铆钉城的无土栽培工作被重置为只具备基本功能（种菜糊口） - 我们的研究工作等于白干了.有限的纯净淡水如果只用作出产食物的话，是足够的。

大规模净水测试没有进展，照这样的维护工作强度来看，我们也基本没时间去进行进一步的试验。

无论如何, 铆钉城并不适合作为一个真正的净水处理研究地。这里没有这方面的基础，想重建一个这类系统对于理事会的其他人来说是个可怕的主意。

就算它已经运行起来了也是一样的。

original: Council Minutes
translation: 会议记录

original:
In attendance:
Science Rep. - Dr. Madison Li
Civilian Rep. - Bannon
Security Rep. - Harkness

* Bridge repair continues to be a drain on funds. Permanent bridge considered, but dismissed as too risky, in case of attack.

* "Bridge Tax" for non-residents proposed by Bannon. Vote fails.

* Hydroponics and city health continues well, thanks to the efforts of Dr. Li and her scientific team. However, system breakdowns are commonplace, requiring much maintenance.

* Li proposed recruiting other scientific minds from Tenpenny Tower or Underworld. Vote fails.

* Attempts to clear out the Mirelurk infestation in down-below continue as usual. Harkness and team is able to contain them and occasionally wipe them out, but they continue to nest in the area, posing a theoretical risk if they ever turn aggressive towards higher decks.

* Bannon suggests closing off lower deck fore. Vote fails.

* Funds and ammunition allocation for a Mirelurk cleaning operation proposed by Harkness. Vote passes.

* Dr. Li leaves early to oversee hydroponics testing. 

* Meeting adjourned.
translation:
出席者：
科学执行官 — 麦迪逊·李博士
市政执行官 — 班侬
安全执行官 — 哈克尼斯

* 吊桥维修继续耗费资金。曾考虑建造永久性桥梁，但因风险太大而作罢，以防遭到攻击。

* 班侬提议向非居民征收“吊桥税”。未通过。

* 李博士和她的科研团队的努力下，水栽法和城市卫生工作进展顺利。然而，系统故障是家常便饭，需要大量维护。

* 李建议从特佩尼大厦或冥界招收更多的科学人才来充实科研队伍。未通过。

* 清除底层的泥沼蟹的工作照旧进行。哈克内斯和他的队伍能够控制住它们，偶尔也能将它们消灭，但它们继续在这个区域筑巢，如果它们转而攻击更高的甲板，就会构成理论上的风险。

* 班侬建议关闭下层甲板前部，未通过。

* 哈克尼斯提议加大清理泥沼蟹行动的经费和弹药支持，提议通过。

* 李博士提前离开去监督水培试验了。

* 会议结束。

original: Council Minutes
translation: 会议记录

original:
In attendance:
Science Rep. - Dr. Madison Li
Civilian Rep. - Bannon
Security Rep. - Lana Danvers

* Trader relations good - we continue to be one of the only reliable sources of clean vegetable foodstuff.

* Bannon proposed raising price of exported fruit by 50%. Vote fails.

* Li reports progress made with new tweaks to hydroponics system. Further testing necessary before complete success, she says.

* Danvers reports necessary ship maintenance in hangar deck level. Proposes increased allocation to internal maintenance to prevent decay from progressing to a dangerous point. Vote succeeds.

* Rumors of increased slave, raider, and Super Mutant activities in DC have prompted Danvers to renew combat training for city guards.

* Dr. Li called away to handle hydroponics system shortage. 

* Meeting adjourned.
translation:
出席:
科学执行官 — 麦迪逊·李博士
市政执行官 — 班侬
安全执行官 — 拉娜·丹佛斯

* 商业情况良好 — 我们仍是唯一能够提供安全的绿色蔬菜的城市

* 班侬提议将出口水果的价格提高50%，未通过。

* 李报告无土栽培系统试验有了不错的进展。“到全部完成还需要进一步的试验。”她声明。

* 丹佛斯报告机库层的船体需要加强维护，目的在于加强内部维护以防止锈蚀造成更大的危害。提议通过。

* 传言在特区的奴隶贩子、强盗，变种人的活动有所增加，丹佛斯需要加强保卫小组的战斗训练以确保城市安全。

* 李博士被叫走处理无土栽培系统问题。

* 会议延期。

original: Regional Health Hazards
translation: 区域性健康危害

original:
Apart from the standard dangers, Rivet City provides a few uncommon problems for long-time residents:

* Lockjaw: Muscle spasms, especially of the jaw, from getting cuts on the rusty ship hull. Treat with penicillin, when available.

* Red-lung: Respiratory problems from regularly inhaling rust particles - particularly a problem for hangar deck residents and shut-ins. Treat with steam therapy and time outside to flush system.

* Fish poisoning: Less of a problem nowadays, but occasionally someone finds a fish in the river and is dumb enough to try to eat the thing. Radiation levels spike and mercury poisoning drives most victims crazy. No cure, but at least people nearby get a reminder not to do it.
translation:
除了一些常规病例之外，铆钉城一直以来都有些不算常规的地方病：

*破伤风：肌肉痉挛，尤其在颚部，一般是被生锈的船体割伤导致的。及时发现可以使用盘尼西林医治。

*红肺症：长期呼入锈颗粒引起的呼吸系统问题 - 多发于长期呆在机库平台的人和足不出户的人，应用蒸汽疗法或多出去走走以清理肺部。

*鱼中毒：如今很少见，但偶尔有人会在河里发现一条鱼并且蠢到去吃它。极高的辐射水平以及重金属中毒会让受害人陷入疯狂，无药可救。至少在他抓鱼的时候，附近的人应该提醒他不要那么做。

original: Patient Files
translation: 患者档案

original:
Bannon: Still suffering from his "social problem." Keep on penicillin, and try to convince him to watch out in the future.

Brock: Another day, another broken nose. Rare to see him as a patient, but at least the people he "refers" are still alive. Barely.

Cantelli, Paulie: Treatment for the steady stream of his addictions would be a steady income, but I can't waste the resources on him if he's just going to get hooked again.

Holmes, Seagrave: Chronic case of red-lung from all his repairs below-decks. Prescribed a few hours of fresh air up top every night.

Staley, Gary: Exhaustion. The man really needs to take a rest at some point. But then again, who doesn't?

Trinnie: Surprisingly healthy, apart from the alcoholism and other chronic dangers of her line of work. Guess they grow them strong in Lamplight.
translation:
班侬：还在为他的“社会问题”而苦恼。继续服用青霉素，并尝试说服他今后小心。

布洛克：又是一天，鼻子又被打断了。很少见到他是病人，但至少他“介绍”的人还活着。勉强活着吧。

坎特利，保利：治疗他源源不断的瘾症是一笔稳定的收入，但如果他只会再次上瘾，我就不能在他身上浪费资源。

福尔摩斯，西格雷夫：由于在下层甲板进行的所有维修工作，他患上了慢性红肺病。开些每晚顶部的新鲜空气。

斯塔利，加里：过劳了。有时候他真的需要休息，但这里谁不是这样？

崔妮：除了酗酒和工作中的其他慢性危害之外，出乎意料的健康。我想她们在小灯镇把自己养得很壮。

original: Rebuilding Proposal
translation: 重建建议

original:
"We excel at destroying the old world, and we excel at building a new one."
- Chairman Cheng

Two hundred years ago, Chairman Cheng led his armies to defeat the decadent rulers of this land. Now, his humble descendant, Comrade Cheng, shall lead its noble people to rebuild a brighter land in its place!

By uniting to work together, we can eradicate the twin dangers of lawlessness and disease. With unified soldiers, we can cleanse the land of beasts and highwaymen. With organized farmers, we can overcome starvation and poverty. 

When competing villages are destroyed, all must unite under the glorious leadership of Comrade Cheng and the Tenpenny Commune!
translation:
“我们擅长摧毁旧世界，同时也擅长建立新世界。”
- 程主席

两百年前，程主席带领他的军队推翻了这个土地上腐朽的政权。现在，他谦卑的后代，程同志，将带领高贵的人民在这片土地上重建光明！

我们并肩作战，必将摧毁动乱和疾病这对孪生兄弟。通过有纪律的士兵，我们能够清洗这个大陆上的禽兽和逃犯。通过有组织的农民，我们能够战胜饥饿和贫穷。

当所有敌对村庄被消灭后，所有的人都将团结在光荣的领袖程同志和特佩尼公社之下！

original: Note From Walter
translation: 来自沃尔特的短信

original: Thanks for all your help. Stop on by any time and sell me whatever Scrap Metal you can find. We can always use it.\n\nWalter
translation: 谢谢你的那些帮助。只要你找到了废金属，就来卖给我。那些东西我能用上。\n\n沃尔特

original: Note From Leo Stahl
translation: 来自利奥·斯塔尔的短信

original:
Hey,

Stop by the Water Treatment Plant at night and I'll hook you up with some Chems. Let's just keep this between us.

Leo
translation:
嗨，

晚上有空了来水处理设施这，我给你准备了一些药。这件事只能我们两个人知道。

利奥

original: Letter from Bittercup
translation: “苦杯”的信

original:
love,

when are u comin back 2 bigtown?? i miss u soooo much!!! i have sum presents 4 u and i hope u come back soon 2 get them!!! ill save whutever i find that u can use 2 give 2 u when u come back!!

miss u!!!

xoxoxoxoxoxoxo

bittercup
translation:
心肝呀，

乃虾米时候回大镇？？暔想死你了！！！暔给你准备了一些东东，暔好希望乃能快点回来收下他们！！！只要是找到了乃能用的，暔都会留着，等乃回来就给乃！！

想乃！！！

亲亲抱抱亲亲抱抱亲亲抱抱

“苦杯”

original: Springvale Raider Mining Log
translation: 春之谷掠夺者挖掘日志

original: Hit a goddamned hive of ants in the tunnel. Bastards ate seven of our best diggers before we could lock off the way in. Need to find some way to poison them so we can keep digging and blast into that Vault. If we don't get there soon, I think I'm going to end up like Boppo, except it won't be the Sheriff popping me, it's gonna be my own men.
translation: 在地道里遇到了一窝该死的蚂蚁。我们还没来得及堵住进去的路，这群王八蛋就吃了我们七个挖掘的好手。为了能继续挖掘和爆破进那个避难所，我们得找到方法毒死它们。如果我们不能尽快到达那里，我可能会像波普那样玩儿完，只不过嘣我的不是警长，而是我自己的人。

original: Nuka 4 Zip!
translation: 核子交易

original: Don't forget! I'll trade you whatever I've got for more Nuka-Cola! \n\nNuka 4 Zip! Nuka 4 Zip!
translation: 别忘了！一搞到核子可乐我就会找你交易的！\n\nNuka 4 Zip! Nuka 4 Zip!

original: Tales of the Wastes
translation: 废土的传言

original:
You stories are pretty popular around town! 

I'm always looking forward to hearing more of them!

- Knock Knock
translation:
你的故事在坊间大量流传！

我总是渴望听到更多！

—— 诺克敲门

original: Kidnap Order
translation: 绑票订单

original:
Order Info:
One (1) kid from Little Lamplight

Requirements:
Friendly, trusting, too young to know not to follow strangers

Delivery Method:
Child slaver will be posted outside Lamplight
Bring the kid to her, and she'll deliver it

Payment:
After sending the kid for delivery, return to Eulogy Jones in Paradise Falls for payment
translation:
订单信息：
小灯镇的一（1）小孩

要求：
温顺的，容易轻信人的，非常小以至于不知道不该跟着陌生人走的。

送货方式：
儿童奴贩会出现在小灯镇外面。
把小孩交给她，她会处理的。

报酬：
把小孩送出去以后，去找天堂瀑的尤勒基·琼斯取得报酬。

original: Lamplight Fungus Trade
translation: 小灯镇蘑菇贸易

original:
Lucy, Eclair:

Looks like we've got ourselves a freelance scavver. Pay the bastard in cave fungus, and we should be good for supplies.

Lucy, trade fungus for Buffout doses. Keep those rickets treatments coming.

Eclair, trade fungus for Strange Meat. That should help keep the fungus pools fertilized.

Anyone who's got a fucking problem with this setup answers to me.

- RJ MacCready
translation:
露西，“闪电泡芙”：

看来我们找到了一个自由拾荒者。用洞穴菇付给那混蛋，我们就能得到补给了。

露西，用蘑菇交易壮大灵，以维持对佝偻病的治疗。

“闪电泡芙”，用蘑菇换来些奇怪的肉，这些东西能够帮助保持蘑菇场的高产量。

任何人出了差错都要让他来向我汇报。

- “RJ”麦奎迪

original: Caravan Trade Route
translation: 商队贸易路线

original: Angela and Diego
translation: 安吉拉和迭戈

original: It seems that Angela Staley has a crush on Diego. Because he's a priest, he's been resisting her. I wonder if this is common knowledge in Rivet City?
translation: 安吉拉·斯塔利似乎喜欢上了迭戈。因为他是牧师，所以一直在拒绝她。我不知道这在铆钉城是不是人尽皆知？

original: Angela and Diego
translation: 安吉拉和迭戈

original: It seems that Angela Staley has a crush on Diego. Because he's a priest, he's been resisting her. She seems to think that ant pheromones might help to seduce him.
translation: 安吉拉·斯塔利似乎喜欢上了迭戈。因为他是牧师，所以一直在拒绝她。她看来认为蚂蚁费洛蒙也许有助于吸引他。

original: Mister Lopez
translation: 洛佩斯先生

original: Mister Lopez is contemplating suicide. I can't decide if I should help him or get him help.
translation: 洛佩斯先生想自杀，我不知道应该帮帮他还是劝劝他。

original: C.J. Young is missing
translation: 杨长江不见了

original: C.J. Young is missing. This might have something to do with my taunting James Hargrave.
translation: 杨长江丢了，这也许跟我嘲弄了詹姆斯·哈格雷夫有关。

original: Notice From Winthrop
translation: 温思罗普的通知

original:
Alright, listen up. This is the last time I'm going to say it: we might be immune to radiation, but we still gotta breathe. So, whoever has been taking the Spare Parts from the supply closet better stop it, right quick. If I don't have parts, I can't keep the air circulating. Got it?

We're out of parts, so I need everyone to bring me any of those Stimpaks or RadAway things that you find. I'm gonna see if I can't trade them to some smoothskin for some parts. And if those ones go missing, you zombies are on your own.

Winthrop.
translation:
好吧，都听好了。我再最后重复一遍：我们或许能辐射免疫，但我们仍要呼吸。所以，从补给里拿走备用零件的那个人，无论你是谁，立刻停止这种行为。如果没有零件，我就不能保证空气的流通了。懂了吗？

我们的零件已经用完了，所以我要你们每一个人都把找到的治疗针或者消辐宁给我。如果找不到光皮肤购买零件，我会再想办法。反正如果再有零件丢失，你们这些僵尸们就等着自生自灭吧。

温思罗普。

original: Contract With Ahzrukhal
translation: 阿祖卡的合同

original: I, Ahzhrukal (henceforth known as "seller") agree to pass possession of the property known as "Charon" (henceforth known as "PROPERTY") to [%] (henceforth known at BUYER") upon the death of the Ghoul known as Greta (henceforth "TARGET"). \n\nBy execution hereof, BUYER acknowledges that all tasks related to TARGET shall be completed in due haste. Afterfor PROPERTY shall be transferred to BUYER with equal due haste.
translation: 我，阿祖卡（以下简称“卖方”）同意在被称为葛丽泰（以下简称“目标”）的尸鬼死亡后，将名为“卡戎”（以下简称“财产”）的财产的所有权转让给[%]（以下简称“买方”）。\n\n关于履行此点，买家须知，所有和目标有关的任务一旦完成。 之后财产便会立刻转让给买家。

original: FFRoDElectionNote
translation: FFRoDElectionNote

original: Megaton Cult Pamphlet
translation: 兆吨镇邪教小册子

original:
Lost Children of the Wastes, rejoice! Atom presents to you a chance to redemption! 

The Church of the Children of Atom offers you a chance to participate in the keeping of Atom's sacred city of Megaton! We accept currency, which shall be used to keep this holy place as pure and as safe as possible.

Rays shine upon, wayward Children of the Wastes!

Confessor Cromwell
translation:
废土上迷失的孩子们！欢呼吧！原子神给予你们一个赎罪的机会！

原子之子教会为你们提供一个机会，让你们参与守护原子的圣城，兆吨镇！我们接受货币，并将用于尽可能保持这个圣地的纯净和安全。

愿射线照耀，无知任性的废土之子！

忏悔者克伦威尔

original: Dispatch to Scribe Yearling
translation: 伊尔琳学士的派遣信

original:
Scribe Yearling,

Now that Scribe Warswick has been written into the scrolls, I pass his noble task onto you.

Journey into the ruins of the city, to the once great Arlington Library. There, you will continue to collect, archive, and catalog the written works of the ancients. You will have two Paladins sent with you and you shall be requisitioned an amount of currency in order to barter and trade with Outsiders for any books that they may present to you.

Depart immediately and make haste. We cannot afford to have this work interrupted.

Yours In Steel,

Scribe Rothchild
translation:
伊尔琳学士，

沃斯维克学士已经离我们而去了，他被载入了名册，现在我将这个崇高的任务交给了你。

请前往这个城市的废墟，找到战前的大图书馆—阿灵顿图书馆。在那里继续收集前人的书籍，将它们归档并编目。两位圣骑士会和你同行，已经给你拨了一大笔钱用于和外人进行交易，收购他们愿意出售的书籍。

请立即启程，抓紧赶路。我们不能让这项工作中断下来。

你的兄弟，

罗斯查德学士

original: Wanted: Trustworthy Surgeon - Transcript
translation: 悬赏：可靠的外科医生 - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nHey doc, I’m only sharing this with you because you seem like someone we can trust. Have you heard about the synthetic men they make up north in the Commonwealth? Well, the rumors are true. They’re called androids. They're men like us, just made out of different parts. I know one of these androids. He's looking for a trustworthy doctor to perform some facial surgery. Can you do it? Do you know someone who can? Also, do you know anyone who's really wiz with computers?
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n嘿大夫，我只把这消息同你分享，因为你似乎是我们可以信任的人。你听说过在联邦北部制造合成人的事吗？对，传闻是真的。他们被称为仿真人，外形和我们人类一样，只是由不同零件制成。我认识一个这样的仿真人。他在找一个可靠的医生做一个面部手术。你能做吗？你知道谁能做吗？此外，你知道谁是个电脑高手吗？

original: Assignment from the Commonwealth - Transcript
translation: 来自联邦的任务 - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nWe've a little assignment from the Commonwealth. A very important slave escaped into the Wasteland. Well, it’s not exactly a slave. It’s what they call an android. A kind of synthetic man. The important thing isn’t what this guy is. The important thing is the job pays more than you can imagine. He thinks the synthman might be looking to get in touch with a doctor and/or tech-head. If you want a cut, then get a move on.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n我们接到了一个来自联邦的小任务。一个很重要的奴隶逃进了废土。好吧，它并不完全是一个奴隶。它是他们所说的仿真人。一种合成人。重要的并不在于这家伙是什么。重要的是这任务的酬金超乎你的想象。他认为这仿真人会设法与医生和/或科技人员取得联系。要是你想分一杯羹，现在就行动吧。

original: Rogue Android - Transcript
translation: 异常仿真人 - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nYou’ll never guess who just showed up at my place! That android catcher from the Commonwealth! At first I thought he was going to kill me. But it turns out he’s an android himself! And he’s gone rogue! I didn’t believe him at first, but I’m convinced he’s telling the truth. We need to find him a place to hide along the Railroad. He also insists that we help him locate a trusted doctor and techie.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n你绝对猜不到谁刚来了我这！那个来自联邦的仿真人捕捉者！起先我认为他要杀了我。但结果他自己就是个仿真人！并且他失常了！起初我不相信他，但我现在确信他说的是真的。我们得随着“铁路”给他找一个藏身之所。他还坚持要我们帮他找到一位可靠的医生和技术人员。

original: Androids are real. No really! - Transcript
translation: 仿真人是真的。不说笑！ - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nYou’ve heard those rumors about androids? You know, those synthetic men they supposedly make up north in the Commonwealth? Well, a friend of a friend knows a guy that met one! No really, it’s true! He’s running away from his masters. Word is he’s looking for a doctor to do some kind of surgery, and a computer programmer of some kind. Can you believe that? Let me know if you hear something.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n你听过关于仿真人的传闻么？你知道，就是那种据说在联邦北部制造的合成人？好吧，我有个朋友的朋友认识一个人，他遇到了一个！不说笑，是真的！他在躲他的主人。说是他在找一个医生来做手术，还有一个电脑程序员什么的。你相信吗？如果你听到什么消息，记得告诉我。

original: We got the tech, now we need the doc. - Transcript
translation: 我们有了科技，现在我们需要医生 — 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nWe now have a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. We just need to find someone with the skills and willingness to perform the surgery. If anyone knows of a discreet and trustworthy surgeon who knows how to keep his mouth shut, send him our way. Also, we need to find a Circuit Neuralizer to reroute the signals in the android’s memory. Do you know any trustworthy techies?
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n我们现在有了脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。我们只需找一个既有能力又有意愿的人来做手术。如果有谁知道哪位外科医生行事谨慎且值得信赖，懂得保守秘密，请介绍给我们。此外，我们还要找一个环状神经器，以重新连接仿真人的记忆信号。你认识什么可靠的技师吗？

original: Get it done! - Transcript
translation: 搞定它！ - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nWe better find that fucking android soon. That Commonwealth asshole, Zimmer, keeps hounding me for results. If the job didn’t pay so well, I’d off that motherfucker myself. He was babbling about a “Lipoplasticator” and “Micro Dermal Graftilizer.” What the hell are those? Apparently something doctors use to fuck up someone’s face beyond recognition. So we don’t even have a description to work off of. To make matters worse, he now thinks the android got his memories wiped or something. Find some tech-junkies, knock on some doors, and try to find something called a “Circuit Neuralizer.” Knock on some heads, too, if you have to. Get it done!
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n我们最好赶快找到那个该死的仿真人。那个联邦的混帐，齐默，老是烦着我要结果。要不是酬金很可观，我就要亲自把这个混蛋干掉。他一直念叨什么“脂肪塑形机”和“微型皮肤移植机”。到底是什么玩意儿？很显然是医生用来把某人的脸改的面目全非用的。所以我们甚至没有一个描述来下手。更糟的是，他现在认为仿真人把记忆洗去或者什么的。找些技术迷，敲敲门，试着找到一种叫“环状神经器”的东西。如有必要，也可以敲一些脑袋。搞定它！

original: Extreme measures - Transcript
translation: 极端措施 - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nThe android has decided to take an extreme measure. He knows all the techniques of the retrieval trade, and is afraid facial reconstruction isn’t enough. He wants to have his memories erased and replaced with new ones. I don’t know how the hell that’s going to work. Start asking around for trustworthy tech-heads. We need to find something called a Circuit Neuralizer and a person who knows how to use one. Also, we have a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer, now we need to find a doctor able and willing to perform the facial reconstruction. We need to hurry. They’ve come very close to discovering the Railroad.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n那个仿真人决定采取极端措施。他了解所有的回收手段，并且担心仅仅是面部重建还不够。他想把他的记忆擦去，替换一个新的。我不知道这究竟要怎么操作。开始向附近可靠的技术人员打听。我们需要找到被称作“环状神经器”的东西，以及一位懂得用它的人。另外，我们已有了“脂肪塑形机”和“微型皮肤移植机”，现在需要找到一个有能力并且愿意做面部重建的医生。我们要快点。他们已经非常接近发现“铁路”了。

original: Oh man! A Circuit Neuralizer! -Transcript
translation: 天呐！一个环状神经器！ - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nRemember that secret android project I told you about? Well, they got some serious Pre-War tech on their hands. They nabbed a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer for the facial reconstruction. Not sure where they’ll find a chopper with enough skills to use it without making him look like a freaking Ghoul. Oh, and get this. Can you believe they found a Circuit Neuralizer? That or someone built one! Word is that they're going to completely rewire the brain of one of those things. If you know who they got working on this, let me know. I want to meet the guy.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n还记得我和你说过的秘密仿真人计划么？好了，他们搞到手了一些严肃的战前科技。他们为了面部重建，弄到了一台脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。不确定他们会从哪找到有足够技术的“一把刀”来用这些设备，而不会让他变得像一个该死的尸鬼。哦，还有这个。你敢相信他们找到了一个环状神经器吗？或是某人做了一个！据说他们打算把其中一个的大脑完全重新接线。如果你知道他们找了谁来做这个，告诉我。我想见见这个家伙。

original: A request for help - Transcript
translation: 请求帮助 - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nIf you're listening to this recording, it is because you're believed to be trustworthy. I hope that is the case, because this recording puts us both in danger. I’m escaping from the Commonwealth. I’m an android, a synthetic man... a slave. The men hunting me are ruthless and will stop at nothing to retrieve their property. I need to find a doctor in the Wasteland to perform facial reconstruction. I also need someone who knows a great deal about computers. I need... I need to have my memories erased and my face altered to look like someone else.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n如果你正在听这份录音，那意味着你被认为是可靠的。我希望确实如此，因为这份录音使我们彼此都很危险。我正在逃离联邦。我是一个仿真人，一个合成人……一个奴隶。追捕我的人冷酷无情，会不择手段地收回他们的财产。我需要在废土上找一位医生来做面部重建。我还需要一个对电脑很在行的人。我要……要洗去我的记忆，并改变我的面容，使我看起来像另外一个人。

original: A free man... a new man... - Transcript
translation: 一个自由之人……一个崭新之人…… - 转录稿

original: Transcript of Holotape:\n\nDespite the harshness of the Wasteland, I’ve discovered in more than a few here, a compassion that is unheard of in the Commonwealth. Perhaps it’s the daily struggle for life here which gives appreciation for life in general, whether human, or android. In a few days I’ll be a free man... a new man. Let me say thank you now, for referring me to Pinkerton at Rivet City, because I will not remember any of this soon.
translation: 全息磁带的转录稿：\n\n尽管废土如此艰辛，但我在这里的不少人身上，见识到在联邦从未听过的同情心。也许是因为在这里整日为生存而挣扎，人们普遍更加珍视生命，无论对人类，还是对仿真人。过几天我就将成为一个自由之人……一个崭新之人。现在让我对你们说声谢谢，感谢你们把我介绍给铆钉城的平克顿，因为我很快将会不记得这一切。

original: Self determination is not a malfunction - Transcript
translation: 自主意识不是故障 — 文字记录

original:
Transcript of Holotape:

Zimmer. By the time you get this message, I'll already be gone. I'm escaping the Commonwealth. I want to live my own life, on my own terms, as my own man. 

I know what you're thinking, that I'm malfunctioning. I used to think that's what caused the runaways, too. But, I know better, now. Self determination is NOT a malfunction. I'm just not willing to put up with all the bullshit anymore. You humans are going to have a full-fledged rebellion on your hands if you don't start treating us synths as full-fledged persons.

I know you'll be marshalling the Retention Bureau to come after me. But I know all the tricks of the trade. You won't be finding me. I assure you.

By the time you get this, I will be someone else. It's the price I pay for my liberation. My final act of rebellion against a system I no longer believe in. 

Goodbye Zimmer, and good riddance.
translation:
全息磁带的文字记录：

齐默，当你接到这条消息时，我已经走了。我要逃离联邦。我一定要按照我自己的主张，过我的生活。

我知道你在想什么，你认为我有毛病。我也曾想过是什么导致了失控。但是，我现在认识得更清楚了。自主的意识决不会是一个故障。我只是不想再忍受这些胡说八道了。要是你们人类再不像对待完整的人类一样对待我们合成人，那么你们就将自己承受一个完整的背叛。

我知道你们会让收容局来追踪我。但是我知道你们所有的把戏。你们找不到我。我确信。

当你拿到这个的时候，我将成为另外一个人。这是我为自由付出的代价。我的最后的背叛，就是为了反抗一个我不再相信的系统。

再见齐默。我走了，可喜的摆脱！

original: Wastelander Note
translation: 废土客字条

original:
Billy,

I'm sorry I stole it. You deserve to have it back. Remember the old scrapyard, north of the Bethesda ruins? Look in the burned out bus in the northwest corner. Near an old red boxcar.

Tell Loreen I still love her, and I'm sorry for everything. I hope somebody finds this before the buzzards tear it to pieces.

Your loving brother,

John
translation:
比利，

对不起，我偷了它。你该拿回去。记得在贝塞斯达遗址北面的那个旧废车场吗？在西北角那辆烧毁的巴士里找找，靠近一辆旧的红色棚车。

告诉罗琳我还爱着她，我为这一切感到抱歉。我希望有人能在秃鹰把它撕成碎片之前找到这个。

爱你的兄弟，

约翰

original: Feedback Loops
translation: 反馈回路

original: Okay, pass this on after you get it... gotta keep this crap off of the Intra-Vault mails. If you can hack the control panels, use their noise flush feature to spook the crazies. Works okay and its kept me alive these last two days, but they're starting to catch on. We need to get organized and make an attempt for the Vault door. It's our only chance.
translation: 好吧，既然你得到这个了，请把它传下去……别让这个进入内部邮件系统。如果你能黑了控制面板，可以用他们的噪声系统对付那些疯子。活儿还算顺利，这让我又多活了两天，不过他们快要明白过来了。我们必须组织起来搞定避难所的大门，这是我们唯一的机会。

original: Overseer Rubin Personal Entry 00897377
translation: 监督者鲁宾的私人条目 00897377

original: Malleus says WNMSCE is a failure. So, there's been a few deaths. One step back, two steps forward. It's easy to suppress what everyone in the Vault are calling "crazies". I've added a command word in their suggestion implants. Simply say the phrase "Sanity is not statistical" and they will stop dead in their tracks. I've informed the guards of this, but I've told them only to use it when out of earshot of anyone else.
translation: 马莱乌斯说WNMSCE是失败的。所以，死了几个人。退一步，进两步。要制止那些在避难所正喊叫“疯子”的人。我在他们的暗示植入体中加入了一条命令语句。只要说一句“理智并非统计学概念”他们就会停止行动。我已经通知了守卫，但我告诉他们只能在别人听不到的时候使用。

original: Overseer Rubin Personal Entry 00897332
translation: 监督者鲁宾的私人条目 00897332

original: As per instructions, the broadcast equipment for the White Noise has been rerouted from the sound booths and tied directly into the entire Vault's loudspeaker system. I'll now be able to execute Vault-Tec Confidential Plan WNMSCE (White Noise Mind Suggestion Combat Experimentation). I have three of Professor Malleus's team doing what I need to get done and hope to show some concrete results soon. I had the engineers make it so the WN can be either triggered from the control center or at the local security consoles. The password to these consoles is "UIY2249".
translation: 按照指示，“白噪声”广播系统已经从音响间改线，接入到了整个避难所的扬声器系统。现在我可以实施避难所科技的机密计划WNMSCE（白噪声心灵暗示战斗试验）。我让马莱乌斯教授的三个小组完成我需要完成的工作，希望很快就能取得一些具体成果。我让工程师们进行了调整，这样一来白噪声既可以在控制中心触发，也可以在本地安全控制台被触发。这些控制台的密码是“UIY2249”。

original: Overseer Rubin Personal Entry 00897357
translation: 监督者鲁宾的私人条目 00897357

original: The results of WNMSCE are even better than I could ever have imagined. The sheer strength and tenacity of combat suggestion implanted test subjects is incredible! Imagine an entire army of people who would never disobey a direct order from high command and can fight until it takes over 20 bullets to stop them.
translation: WNMSCE 效果好的出乎意料。增强战斗力和战斗意志的意识灌输测试效果惊人！想像一下一个由严格遵守最高指挥部的直接命令，不挨上20颗子弹绝不停止战斗的士兵组成的部队吧。

translation: MS17Vault92dEngineerLog01

original:
Maintenance Code: RL00 Green
Issue: Lighting on B Level
Engineer: Carl Maynard

Fix Notes:
If I told Zack once, I've told him a thousand times... stop using the higher amperage ballasts in the lighting grid on B Level. They will overheat within days and blow out because the power taps up there weren't installed to spec. Had to replace 37 ballasts with Type K09A ballasts and use a power tap converter on each one. Billing my missed dinner with that sexy red-headed violinist up in Women's Dorm 7 to Zack's Work Credit account!
translation:
维修代码：RL00 Green
问题：B层照明
工程师：卡尔·梅纳德

维修日志：
跟扎克说过不下一千遍了……B层不能在照明栅上用更高电流强度的稳流器。出不了几天它们就会过热爆炸，因为电力接头装在那儿不是用来试着玩的。必须把37个稳流器换成K09A型的，每个都接上变压器。和性感红发音乐家在7号女子公寓共进晚餐的香艳计划算是泡汤了，这笔帐得记在扎克头上！

original: MS17Vault92cSoundProducerDiary02
translation: MS17Vault92cSoundProducerDiary02

original:
To: Hilda Egglebrecht
From: Parker Livingsteen, Studio Supervisor

I just wanted to take this opportunity to send you an Intra-Vault mail regarding the wonderful session you performed this afternoon. The sound you coax from your Stradivarius is bar none the most haunting, beautiful thing I've heard here to date. I was wondering if perhaps we could get together tomorrow evening and discuss this in a more intimate setting.
translation:
致：希尔达·艾格雷伯彻德
自：演播室主管帕克·里万斯基

您今天下午的演奏真是精彩绝伦，借此机会，特以避难所内部邮件的方式呈上此函聊致敬意。有生以来我所聆听过的音乐中，属您那曼妙的琴声最为萦心回肠，使人如闻天籁。不知明晚您与我能否私下小聚一番，就此探讨探讨？

original: MS17Vault92cSoundProducerDiary01
translation: MS17Vault92cSoundProducerDiary01

original:
To: Engineering Staff
From: Parker Livingsteen, Studio Supervisor

Hey guys, I'm not sure if this is even worth putting an official trouble ticket in for, but I am getting some sort of odd pitch overlay on my sound equipment. It's almost like another signal is leaking from maybe the Vault intercom network or communications gear and piggybacking on everything I record. It's barely noticeable, but I can definitely see it on my 'scope. Do we have any cross-wiring issues or faulty cable insulation problems on C Level?
translation:
致：全体工程人员
自：演播室主管帕克·里万斯基

嘿伙计们，我不知道是否值得把这当个正事儿提出来，但我的音响设备有种奇怪的音频掺杂进来。好像有另一个信号正从避难所内部通讯网络或者通讯设备往外泄露着，并捎带上了我录制的所有内容。虽然它不易察觉，但逃不过我的火眼金睛。在C层，我们是否存在交叉布线问题或电缆绝缘故障？

original: MS17Vault92aShopkeeper
translation: MS17Vault92aShopkeeper

original:
To: Richard Rubin, Overseer Vault 92
From: Gordie Sumner

This is the FIFTH time I've requested that you allow me to release our supply of headphones and personal audio listening gear to the residents. It seems unfair that residents are required to listen to their music selections in the studio rooms. I have an ample supply of the type of equipment that would allow most residents to relax in their beds and enjoy their musical recordings. Please let me know your reasons behind this matter.
translation:
致：理查德·鲁宾，92号避难所监督者

这是第五次，我请求您允许我为居民们提供我们的头戴式耳机和随身听音设备了。仅在演播室才能听他们的音乐选集对公民们来说似乎不太合理。我有大量此类设备，使居民们躺在床上就能轻松地享受音乐。此中如有内情，还烦请您告知。

translation:

The wizard beckons wildly at you from his balcony. "You're here, you've arrived!", he exclaims. After an awkward silence, he jabs an excited finger into a crystal ball, nearly knocking it into the bog.

巫师的额头皱了起来，“我有点操之过急，是不是？等你找到一颗强大的宝石再回到我这里吧！快！ - 我还没有实现过一个预言呢！”

"Hoo-hoo! The slayer of Grelok approaches, raw stone in hand, just as I've seen!" The wizard's pointy hat bobs excitedly as he points a finger at you. “吼-吼！葛瑞拉卡的克星来了，手里拿着宝石，就像我曾经看到的那样！”，巫师指着你，尖尖的帽子兴奋的跳动着。突然，巫师多节的手指上出现了一道淡橘色的弧光，还没等你反应过来，宝石已经被它从包里拽走了。快到达巫师鼻头的时候，宝石悬停在了那里。

“精诚所至，金石为开，胖嘟嘟！”。随即，他拿起宝石在塔的墙体上猛击。随着一道闪光，宝石分成了两半，各自躺在这个忙碌的小个子巫师伸出的两个手掌里。

“这是为你的剑所准备的，把她嵌在剑里，她会为你找到葛瑞拉卡那颗黑暗的心脏。拿上这些玩意，付锻造费的时候你会用得着。”，他把石头扔了下来，你赶紧冲上去接住。

translation: 一条信息

translation: “找到铸剑的地方，把碎片嵌进去，然后去击败葛瑞拉卡！”\n\n巫师向你扔小石子赶你走，然后陶醉的吸起了他那带着魔幻色彩的烟。

original:
When you draw your sword, Grelok lowers his great horned head and bellows laughter in your face. You grit your teeth and swing a mighty two-handed blow, the magical blade ringing clearly, even amid the tumult of throaty cackling. 

You swing the sword so fiercely, it escapes your grip and hurtles into the open maw of the monstrosity, lost from sight in the arid darkness of Grelok's throat. You step back as Grelok jerks his mouth shut and stands upright. He is still for a moment, then starts clawing at his neck. Muffled, a ringing can be heard as if from a great distance.

Suddenly, Grelok's chest bursts in a fount of viscous, green blood. The Ringing can be heard clearly now, and as thick lifeblood oozes around the protruding tip of the magic sword, the stormclouds swirling the peak are already clearing. Grelok is defeated!

 (Thanks for playing!)
translation:
你决然的拔出手中的长剑，对面，葛瑞拉卡正低着他那颗长着怪角的硕大脑壳高声嘲笑你。你紧咬着牙关，双手抓着剑柄奋力的挥舞起来，如此噪杂的环境，仍然能够清晰的听到魔法剑破空发出的铮鸣声。

你奋力的挥舞并掷出手中的长剑，它呼啸着飞了出去，没入了对面那个怪物黝黑而干瘪的喉咙当中。格惹洛克僵立在原地，面部不停的抽搐，你小心翼翼的后退着。片刻之后，这个家伙开始抓挠自己的脖子。一种奇怪的响声从那下面传了出来，就像是从远处传来的一般。

突然间，粘稠的绿色血液染上了葛瑞拉卡的胸口，响声也清晰了起来。随着粘稠的血液顺着魔法剑缓缓的流了出来，盘旋在峰顶的暴风云也渐渐消失了。葛瑞拉卡被击败了！

original: Field Entry: A001 "Wild Dog"
translation: 实地记录: A001 "野狗"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Chordata
Class: Mammalia
Order: Carnivora
Family: Canidae
Genus: Canis

Despite extensive testing I cannot further identify the origins of this mammal. It is clearly canis familiaris but generations of mutation have caused it to become its own new breed. An educated guess would place it as Canis Lupus or possibly Canis Indica. Even with the order’s characteristically thick skull, the subject’s brainwaves have been mutated, and territorial aggression amplified. While domestication is still possible with some subjects, the creature should generally be considered hostile.
translation:
界：动物界
门：脊索动物门
纲：哺乳动物纲
目：食肉目
科：犬科
属：犬属

尽管已经进行了广泛的测试，我仍然无法进一步地鉴定出这种哺乳动物的来源。它们明显是一种食肉目犬科的动物，但是几代的变异已经使它们成为了一个新的物种。如果凭经验猜测，它们应该是狼属或者有可能是印度狼属。尽管它们有着这个目的典型特征 — 厚实的头盖骨，但是一些试验样本的脑波已经产生了变异，领地的侵略性也增强了。虽然一些样本依然可以被驯化，但是总的来说应该将它们归纳为攻击型生物。

original: Field Entry: A002 "Large Scorpion"
translation: 实地记录: A002 "巨型辐射蝎"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Arthropoda
Class: Arachnida
Order: Scorpiones
Family: Scorpionidae
Genus: Pandinus

Based on research, it first glance appears to be an enlarged Pandinus Imperator, but further testing is required to make a more precise identification. The subject’s vesicle has mutated to match its enlarged hypodermic aculeus and the neurotoxin now acts on the potassium and calcium channels. Captive subject was hostile and should be considered a minor threat, though they could prove a problem in larger numbers. Anecdotal reports of specimens even larger than those we have observed exist, but it is likely that such reports are exaggerations.
translation:
界：动物界
门：节肢动物门
纲：蛛形纲
目：蝎形目
科：蝎科
属：帝王属

根据研究，这个物种初步被认为是巨型化的将军巨蝎，但是想作出更精确的鉴定还需要进一步的实际测试。这个物种的毒腺发生了变异以便能适应它们增大后的尾刺，毒腺里的神经毒素现在能作用于细胞内的钾、钙离子通道。抓捕到的标本具有攻击性，应当考虑到他们可能带来的潜在威胁，虽然问题可能只有在他们的数量变得更多的时候才出现。据说这个物种甚至会比现在我们已经观察到的还要庞大，不过这种说法多是有些夸张的成分。

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Chordata
Class: Mammalia
Order: Rodentia
Family: Bathyergidae 

Subject most closely resembles a Heterocephalus Glaber with enlargement due to heavy radiation. While much larger in size than generational ancestors, the local variety seems to have similarly low brain function, possibly due to an exceedingly tiny brain organ. Subject’s incisors show increased enamel and dentine growth, making them razor sharp. Further study reveals extremely low levels of Substance P giving this subject an incredible tolerance to pain. I will take skin samples of my next subject as I believe the lack of Substance P can be spliced and manipulated for beneficial research, but this theory requires testing in a more fitting lab.
translation:
界：动物界
门：脊索动物门
纲：哺乳动物纲
目：啮齿目
科：滨鼠科 

该试验对象和受到重度辐射而增大化的裸鼹形鼠十分相似。这种本地动物的体型远大于它们种族的祖先，但脑部功能似乎和它们的祖先一样低下，也许是因为它们的脑部组织都很小。试验对象门齿的珐琅质与牙质的增长，使得他们的牙齿如剃刀般锐利。进一步的试验表明该对象体内的磷化物含量极低，使得他们对疼痛具有难以置信忍耐力。我会在下一个试验对象身上取一些皮肤样本，因为我相信这种低磷化物产生的机制可以用于日后有实际意义的研究工作，但是我需要一个更好的实验室来进一步测试这个理论。

original: Search Party Log #1
translation: 搜索小队日志#1

original:
First time I’ve thought to update the log since leaving Canterbury. Guard at the Citadel wouldn't let us in, but said a scribe had given Cheryl the medicine at least two weeks ago and sent her along to the Rangers. From the sounds of it, Myles didn't make it as far as Citadel. Damn shame, he was a good mutt.

Still no sign of Cheryl. Rumors about the city are true - place is a death trap. Mutants and psychos at every turn. Cheryl's tough enough, but I'm worried, especially with Myles missing. Emmet just about went to pieces the first time we ran into a centaur.

We should be able to reach the Ranger Compound in before sundown tomorrow. Kaya scouted ahead and it looks like the coast is clear for now. With any luck, Cheryl’s holed up with them and we can start back home. 

Here lies Henry. Muties saw him going for water in the street; there was nothing we could do to help him. If anybody else has to come looking for us, we’ll leave word with the Rangers.
translation:
这是我离开坎特伯雷之后第一次想更新日志。大本营的守卫不让我进去，但他们说至少两个星期前，一位学士已经医好了谢丽尔，然后将她送往了游骑兵那里。照这么说来，迈勒斯是没能到达大本营了。真该死，他是个好蠢货。

依旧没有谢丽尔的踪迹。关于这座城市的传言也是真的 - 这里就是死亡的陷阱。变种人和疯子们无处不在。谢丽尔十分的坚强，但我依然很担心，特别是因为迈勒斯的失踪。我们首次遭遇多脚兽这种怪物时，艾米特几乎都要崩溃了。

在明天日落之前，我们应该能到达游骑兵营地。卡娅侦查过了前方，那里的海岸现在看起来暂时是安全的。但愿，谢丽尔和他们藏好了，找到她之后我们就可以启程回家了。

亨利就躺在这里。他来这街上找水时变种人发现了他；我们也无能为力。如果已经有其他人出发来寻找我们了，我们会在游骑兵那里留下消息。

original: The First Law "Feast not on the flesh; consume only the blood. This is our strength."\n\nWe do not eat the flesh of those we kill for food. We will only drink of their blood and leave the body intact. The consumption of flesh is filthy and unclean. This action is what causes the humans to treat us like animals. We are not animals, we are The Family.
translation: 法则一：“勿啖猎物其肉，只饮猎物其血。乃吾等之力量”\n\n吾等不可以吃猎物的肉。只可饮猎物之血，给猎物留下全尸体。肉体肮脏而污秽。食猎物之肉会导致人类视吾等为野兽。吾等并非野兽，吾等是一个大家庭。

original: MS09FamilyLaw02Message
translation: MS09FamilyLaw02Message

original: The Second Law "Bear not the child; welcome only the exile. This is our fate."\n\nBecause we carry the stain of our past in our bodies, we can never let it pass to our offspring who would in turn carry out those foul actions beginning the cycle anew. The Family must seek the Wasteland for others of its kind in order to maintain itself. That is our fate.
translation: 法则二：“勿生后代造孼;仅迎流离自保.乃吾等之命运。”\n\n吾等身上带着曾经的污点，不可把这些污秽传给孩子，否则他们又会重新开始罪恶的轮回。吾等必须去废土上寻找同类并吸收进来，以保证家族人力不断。这就是吾等的命运。

original: MS09FamilyLaw03Message
translation: MS09FamilyLaw03Message

original: The Third Law "Feed not for pleasure; partake only to nourish. This is our dignity."\n\nWe only kill the humans when we are hungry or when we must defend ourselves, we never hunt for sport or pleasure. We do not prey on children for they are not yet tainted by society's view of us. The Family will not tolerate murder.
translation: 法则三：“勿以好恶猎食，仅以需要猎食，乃吾等之尊严。”\n\n吾等仅允许在饥饿或自卫时杀人觅食。吾等绝不为喜好或活动而杀人。吾等不可猎食儿童，因儿童未受世俗污染。家族严禁任何形式之谋杀，一经发现，从重处理。

original: MS09FamilyLaw04Message
translation: MS09FamilyLaw04Message

original: The Fourth Law "Seek not the sun's light; embrace only the shadows. This is our refuge."\n\nBecause we are creatures of the night, we must not set foot in daylight. We move silently across the ground only under the watchful eye of the moon above. At the rising of the sun, we must seek the embrace of the shadows and never again gaze at its brilliance. The Family seeks the dark as its refuge.
translation: 法则四：“永勿日出觅食，永以阴影为伴，乃吾等之庇护。”\n\n吾等为夜间生灵，不可于日间外出。吾等于悄无声息间穿行街巷，只与月光为伍。于日出间吾等须藏身于阴影之中，永勿注视阳光。家族以暗影为庇佑。

original: MS09FamilyLaw05Message
translation: MS09FamilyLaw05Message

original: The Fifth Law "Kill not our kindred; slay only the enemy. This is our justice."\n\nAbove all, no member of The Family will ever take the life of another member without the consent of the current leader. Anyone disobeying this action, the most heinous of all our crimes, will be exiled from this place forever. We must not let our own inner demons cause us to fight amongst ourselves. We number only in the few, and we cannot risk extinction.
translation: 法则五：“勿伤同类朋友;一致消灭敌人.乃吾等之公理。”\n\n综上，任何家族成员不得在未经现任领袖的许可下击杀同族。任何违背者将被视为家族最为恶劣之罪行，将被永世驱逐出此地。吾等绝不可任由心魔失控而相互攻击，吾等数量极稀，任何内斗都有可能导致吾等彻底灭亡。

original: MS09FamilyTownData
translation: MS09FamilyTownData

original: Feeding Grounds\n\nThese are perilous times for The Family. We must feed, but the Wasteland is a dangerous place. The only way to feed without massive loss of life is by getting close to the smaller human settlements. We will therefore use cunning and stealth to achieve our goals. No one is to forcibly enter any of their homes. We must keep our actions civilized. It's the only thing keeping us from being the animals they claim us to be.
translation: 饲养场\n\n对家族而言这是非常危险的时刻。我们必须进食，但废土危机四伏。为免遭大量伤亡，最好的办法就是接近人类的小聚居点。因此我们得偷偷地，安静地达成目标。任何人不许强闯别人的家。我们必须使行动迅速、文明。这才是我们并非人们所诬蔑的“动物”的原因。

original:
Journal Entry:

Nothing has meaning to me anymore.

Every time I'm in the outer tunnels I swear I can hear children's laughter. 

The Vault doctors say its just my mind compensating for the loss of Jason but I know I'm not crazy. They gave me new pills but pills are for crazy people! I refuse to take these pills!

I AM NOT CRAZY!

Why bring up kids in a hellhole like this? Why? This is a pointless existence.
translation:
日记：

对我而言生活已经没有任何意义了。

我发誓，每次在外隧道都可以听到孩子们的欢声笑语。

避难所的医生说这只是我失去儿子之后，大脑产生幻觉反应。但我明白我的神智是清醒的。他们给我更多的药丸，但我知道药丸是给精神病人吃的！我不需要吃药！

我没有疯！

为什么要在这个永不见天日的地下室里抚养我的孩子？这个避难所的存在根本就毫无意义！

We're alone out here, no one will come to our rescue... if anyone is even left. We have to deal with this ourselves. translation:
致：理查德·鲁宾，92号避难所监督者
自：约翰·马莱乌斯教授

我们这里出了严重的问题，您既没回复我上几封避难所内部邮件，也没有与我会面。我这里又多了七具尸体。三名92号避难所居民已患有V920717项目受试者相同症状。还要再死多少人，您才能意识到我们这里情况危急，迫在眉睫？我们独守此地，即使有人能活下来，也看不到半个救援者的影子。我们只能勉力维持，苟且偷生。求求您，我请求您即刻来见我，并下令让您的卫队从居住区门前撤走吧！

We have to consider the possibility we may need to abandon the Vault completely. Better to take a chance outside than in here. You still won't speak to me, and any attempt I've made to see you have ended in scuffles with your guards. It's obvious something's going on and I'm going to find out what.

工程师：卡尔·梅纳德

维修记录：
进行中。我这儿在D层有三处墙体断裂、渗水。我只能得出如下结论，有地下泉或者地下湖在给这些混凝土壁施压。我已经修补了应力断裂处，并进行了我们处理地面材料常用的金属敷镀，使其暂时支撑住。我建议就此事项召集全体工程人员立出某种更具持久性的解决方案，以免我们陷在齐膝深的地下污水里或者更糟。

original:

Issue: Squeaky Office Chair
Engineer: Carl Maynard

This huge emergency was immediately addressed by our crack engineering team. We ran up to Professor Malleus's office and deployed the Fluidic Lubrication Injector in an effort to stop impending doom from destroying us all. Okay fine, we oiled his damn chair. translation:
维修代码：RL00 Green
问题：办公椅呻吟
工程师：卡尔·梅纳德

我们修锅换壶底工程小分队第一时间着手处理这场惊天地泣鬼神的巨变。我们以迅雷不及掩耳盗铃之势瞬间移动到马莱乌斯教授的办公室，并动用了独家高科技环保工艺秘制绝不添加三聚氰胺的液态润滑油注油器以排山倒海之力稀里哗啦地解除了我们所有人迫在眉睫的灭顶之灾。上帝保佑，我们终于给他那坐上去就要便秘的破椅子灌饱了印度神油。难道这就是传说中那种打嗝放屁也能惊动全国人民的破烂玩意儿？

original:
To: Hilda Egglebrecht
From: Parker Livingsteen, Studio Supervisor

Hi Hildie. Just wanted to send you a quick note. Our "session" together yesterday was wonderful! I'm glad the studio doors lock, otherwise some of your stuffier fellow musicians might not appreciate how closely you and I work. Make sure when we meet tonight, you bring your delicate instrument, and your violin too. I have an idea of something we can do with the bow; a new technique I've always wanted to try...
translation:
致：希尔达·艾格雷伯彻德
自：演播室主管帕克·里万斯基

嗨，希尔达。只是想给你递个便条。我们昨天的“演出”真是棒极了！锁上演播室的门真好，否则让你那些迂腐的呆头音乐家们知道我们配合如此默契，大概会很不爽吧。别错过今晚我们约定的时间，带上你精巧的乐器，别忘了还有小提琴。我有个点子能让我们在琴弓上下点功夫；我一直都想试试这个新招……

original: MS17Vault92ZoesNote01
translation: MS17Vault92ZoesNote01

original: It's so wonderful to be surrounded by all this talent! Little old me, who can barely play the violin, is sitting among some of the world's greatest musicians. I still can't believe my luck!\n\nToday was great too. I was able to record an entire symphony... Haydn's Symphony No. 3 in d minor. It was so beautiful! I could barely keep up with everyone else in the string section, but they were so nice. They encouraged me instead of being stuffy jerks or something. Best of all, they record all of it and then let you hear yourself play on the studio's speakers. I can't wait until tomorrow... I hear we're doing a piece from Dvorak!
translation: 被天才的气息所围绕的感觉真是妙不可言！微不足道的我，不过会拉几下子小提琴，此刻却落座于世界顶级音乐家之列。真是令人难以置信的运气！\n\n今天同样很好。我能把整支曲子 — d小调海顿第三交响曲都录下来。它真是美极了！他们真是太厉害了，弦乐章节我差点跟不上别人。他们从不像有些蠢货一样只知道埋怨别人，而总是鼓励我。最棒的是，他们录下全部曲子然后让你在演播室的音响上听自己演奏。我简直等不及明天 — 听说我们要演奏德沃夏克的曲子！

original: MS17Vault92ZoesNote02
translation: MS17Vault92ZoesNote02

original: I've been feeling a little sick lately. Kind of woozy after playing in the studio usually. It gets so stuffy in that place, but it's sure worth it. I know I'm getting better just from watching my fellow violinist's techniques. They don't even mind giving me some pointers. Tonight, a bunch of us girls from the string section are going down to the rec hall for a dance. I hope that cute sound guy Parker asks me to dance. He's dreamy.
translation: 最近我觉得有点不舒服。在演播室演奏之后常常头昏眼花。那里实在太闷了，但这很值得。我知道只要看一眼我的小提琴家同志的高超技巧，我就会好起来的。他们甚至不介意给我指点一二。今晚，我们弦乐章节的一群女孩儿要去录音厅参加舞会。希望那个声音迷人的家伙帕克能邀我跳舞。他真是迷死人了。

attn: Warehouse/Repair Employees

Please make sure the main platform in the Repair Sector is properly raised before releasing the repaired bots from their pods. original: ForgeNote01
translation: ForgeNote01

original:
I can't take it anymore, Bob. I don't trust those turrets in Sector A. I swear I saw one track me the other day when I left work a little late. If that thing opens up on me, I'm screwed, since the bastard Feds suspended workman's comp as part of the "war effort." Hell.

Snake helped me smuggle in some pulse grenades that I locked away in the box under my desk. I tried one out on our Handy at the house and the missus nearly killed me! Knocks 'em out like a light. If you ever need one just grab the key from behind my terminal and use it to unlock the box. You can't say I never did anything for you! See you around buddy.

Oh, and stop throwing those staples over at me, they get on the floor and you know how I like to take my shoes off during the day.
translation:
我不能再想象了，鲍勃。我不相信在A区的那些炮塔。我发誓在前几天我晚下班的时候，我看见有个炮塔在瞄准我。如果那东西向我开火的话，我肯定会晕头转向的。因为讨厌的联邦政府工作人员把暂停工人抚恤金作为“战争成就”的一部分，该死的。

斯内克帮我偷运进来一些脉冲手榴弹，我把那些手榴弹锁在我的书桌下面。我就在我家附近试用了一个，但它差点把我给杀死了。当它爆炸时，就像闪过一阵光一样。如果你也需要一个的话，只要拿到在接线端后面的钥匙，就可以打开我的盒子。你不会说我从来没有为你做过什么吧！再见了朋友。

噢，还有，不要再向我丢那些钉子了，那些钉子都掉在地上，你也知道平日我是喜欢怎样脱掉鞋子的。

original: Camp Crater Orientation
translation: 弹坑营地的指南

original:
DEPARTMENT OF THE ARMY
RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT
FIELD OPERATIONS SECTOR, 76Z

RRD-HA23-P R27-954-88

WELCOME: 

1. You have been chosen by our great President to explore and collect samples at the crater located in sector 76Z.

2. The provided armaments stationed with you have proven reliable during early testing, however, should any problems arise, you are recommended to power down the defense grid using this terminal.

3. Thank you for your participation.
translation:
陆军部
研究和开发部
外勤业务部门，76Z

RRD-HA23-P R27-954-88

欢迎：  

1、你已经被我们伟大的总统选中探索76Z区域里的弹坑，并收集其中的样本。

2、与你相伴的那些武器系统在先前的测试中已经被证实是值得信赖的，不过，依然有出现问题的可能， 建议你使用这个终端机来关闭防御网。

3、感谢你的参与。

translation: 班侬让我到西格雷夫·福尔摩斯的房间看是否能发现指控他的证据，这样一来班侬可以避免西格雷夫?福尔摩斯代替他在理事会的位置。

original: The stash is hidden downstairs in one of the freezers. Rocky set it up. You know his style. Don't forget the key -- you'll need it to unlock the compartment.
translation: 东西就藏在楼梯下面的一个冰箱那。洛奇搞的。他总是这样。别忘了钥匙 — 你需要用它来打开那个隔间。

original: Note For Ted
translation: 给泰德的笔记

original:
Ted,
 
The Mirelurks busted out of the storage area and have been raisin' hell through the whole facility. Price says the bastards get smarter every day. He says I'm paranoid, but I think somebody might be sabotaging things around here. We've taken on so much extra help, I don't know who I can trust around here anymore. Things don't look too good.

I don't think I'll be walking out of here, and I figure you should be the one to get our stash. I managed to get it hidden pretty well in case something like this happened. 

I don't want any of these damn fools tripping over it, so I threw a couple of curves in, but it's nothing you can't handle. Start with my terminal -- just log in and follow the instructions. And if for some reason you’ve forgotten the password, you might want to sit down and have a think with a Nuka-Cola, if you catch my drift.

If this damn meat weren't in such high demand, I'd have pulled out of this racket before the word go. I got too greedy, Ted.
translation:
泰德，
 
那些泥沼蟹逃出了仓库区，现在整个设施内都他妈的是这些鬼东西了。老钱说这些混蛋们每天都会变得更聪明。他还说我多疑了，但我认为是有些人正在这附近搞破坏。我们雇了很多额外的帮手，我不知道身边谁还能够信任。这事可没有看上去那么简单。

我不认为我还能活着走出去，我想那个去取走我们收藏品的人应该是你了。我先前设法将它好好的藏了起来，就是怕会有今天这样的事发生。

我可不希望这里的某个该死的笨蛋不经意间发现了它，所以藏它的时候费了不少功夫，不过没什么你应付不了的事。去我的终端机那 -- 登陆进去然后按着上面的指示来。如果你因为某些原因忘了密码，那我看你可能得坐下来喝点核子可乐然后好好的想想了。

如果这些该死的肉没那么高的需求量，我可能早都洗手不干了。泰德，我真是太贪心了。

original: Terminal Instructions
translation: 终端机说明

original:
Ted,

Remember, I hid this stash for you to find. Don't trust anybody, especially anybody who works for me. Do this alone.

I busted the storage door, down near the service entrance.

There's a floor safe in the Clinic that contains the parts to fix the broken door. I also left you a repair manual, just in case you've gotten rusty, but you were always a wizard with a wrench, so I'm sure you'll be fine. Now get going.
translation:
泰德，

记住，我藏了一些东西让你来找。别相信任何人，特别是我的手下。自己一个人来。

我把下面储藏室的门弄坏了，就是维护通道旁的那个。

医疗室里地板上的保险箱里有零件，可以用来修理门。我还给你留下了一个维修手册，为了以防万一，那些门可能会生锈，不过你是摆弄这些玩意的好手，所以我相信这些对你来说没什么问题。拿到了东西就赶快离开这吧。

original: MQ08Vault87Physician01
translation: MQ08Vault87Physician01

original: The latest subjects in the Evolutionary Experimentation Program (EEP) are showing some promise after only a single exposure to the modified FEV. We are currently testing five subjects, two males and three females. Each one of them is under 24 hour observation as usual. We hope to have a breakthrough in this strain as the continual pressure from Vault-Tec and the military at Mariposa is becoming most bothersome.
translation: 最近一批EEP（进化实验项目）受试对象在对改良过的FEV进行简单暴露后即产生了一些预想结果。我们近日对5名受试者进行了研究，包括2名男性和3名女性。对每名实验对象都进行24小时常规观察。 在避难所科技公司和马里波萨军方的持续施压下，我们希望此菌株能够产生突破性进展。

original: MQ08Vault87Physician02
translation: MQ08Vault87Physician02

original: Incredible results! After only three days, subjects B440, B164 and D624 (all our female specimens) are all exhibiting a unique change. Their bodies are undergoing severe physical changes, losing most of their visible female indicators and transforming to an almost asexual state. They are also seeing increased upper body strength and muscle formation in line with males.\n\nSimilarly, subjects C376 and A541 (our male specimens) are losing most of their visible male indicators and taking on the same asexual state as the females. It seems that the FEV wishes to "level the playing field" and start with a clean slate as it works.
translation: 难以置信的结果！仅仅三天之后，实验对象B440、B164和D624（均为我们的雌性样本）都展现出很特别的变化。她们的身体产生了严重的肉体变化，丧失了大部分明显的女性性征，几乎转化为一种几乎无性状态。她们的上半身力量和肌肉构成也与男性一致。\n\n同样地，实验对象C376和A541（我们的雄性样本）也丧失了大部分可见的男性性征，和女性受试者一样转化成为无性状态。看来，FEV希望“公平竞争”并从零开始。

original: MQ08Vault87Physician03
translation: MQ08Vault87Physician03

original: We've had a minor setback. Subject B440, Mary Kilpatrik, is now deceased. According to my autopsy, she died of a massive loss of brain function and was unable to sustain her basic bodily needs. This is the usual pattern we see in all the FEV Strains we test... the brains of the subjects becoming too damaged to support even the most basic human needs (eating, sleeping, etc.). So far, all other subjects are nominal and continue to exhibit physical changes.
translation: 我们遭遇了一个小小的挫折，试验体B440，玛丽·基尔帕特里柯死亡了。尸检结果显示，她死于脑功能极度萎缩导致无法支持机体需求。在所有FEV菌株实验中这种情况十分普遍，受试对象的脑功能遭到严重破坏，以至于连身体基本的需求（进食、睡眠等）都无法维持。到现在为止，其他的实验体依旧存活，并切身体持续进行变化。

original: MQ08Vault87Physician04
translation: MQ08Vault87Physician04

original: At ten days, we are now noticing that the skin of all our remaining test subjects is actually thickening and becoming more resilient. This seems to be the FEV bringing about some new adaptive change. This is the kind of result we were looking for... adaptations that could prove useful in combat situations. I need to remember to congratulate Dr. Filo on his skin engineering; his coded instructions in this strain seem to be exactly what he expected.
translation: 在10天后，我们观察到所有存活的实验体皮肤都有所增厚并变得富有弹性。这可能是FEV所带来的某种适应性改变。这正是我们所寻求的结果……在恶劣的战斗环境中能够适应并生存下来。我得向费罗博士的皮肤工程研究工作表示祝贺，他对菌株进行的基因编码似乎已经产生了预期的结果。

original: MQ08Vault87Physician05
translation: MQ08Vault87Physician05

original: Once again, I've hit that damn wall. At fourteen days, all of the test subjects began to exhibit severe bouts of rage and anxiety. So much so that they were a danger to my team and to this facility. I had no choice once again but to order them to be destroyed. It pains me every time we do this. The same cycle has been repeated in every strain we test. We always see superior physical adaptations, but the mental changes are their downfall.
translation: 我又一次捶胸顿足了。在14天后，所有实验对象都变得不安和暴躁。甚至已经对我的研究小组和设备的安全构成威胁。我别无选择，只能再次毁灭他们。每次这样做的时候我都心痛不已。似乎每一个菌株实验都以这样的轮回结束。每一次实验我们都可以见到肉体的超强适应性改变，但同时精神上的崩溃亦是实验失败的罪魁祸首。

original: MQ08Vault87LabTech01
translation: MQ08Vault87LabTech01

original: Attention ALL Lab Technicians\n\nThe A Level Storage Room has been restocked with rad suits and other radiation dampeners. We were able to bring these up from deep storage for immediate use. Please only take what is needed (there is no need to hoard the items, there is plenty to go around) and to lock the door after you are finished.
translation: 所有实验技术人员请注意：\n\n储藏室A层新近存放了一批防辐射服和其他的防辐射装备，我们可以立即拿出来投入使用。请只拿取需要的装备（储藏室里有足够的装备可用，无须囤积），完成后请锁门。

original: MQ08Vault87LabTech02
translation: MQ08Vault87LabTech02

original: Attention ALL Lab Technicians\n\nThe radiation expulsion ducts from the G.E.C.K. chamber are once again venting radiation directly into the area due to faulty seals. These seals MUST be properly maintained and checked on a DAILY basis. There is a clipboard with the maintenance checklist that you must initial when the check is complete in the main laboratory. Any lab technician skipping their check will be held accountable for their inaction.
translation: 所有实验技术人员注意\n\n伊甸园创造器室的辐射排放管道再次脱焊，射线被直接排放到室内。焊接点必须得以妥善处理，并每日检查。维修记录边放置了一个备忘薄，每次主实验室检查完毕之后都必须在此签名。任何未做检查工作的技术人员必须说明原因。

original: MQ08Vault87LabTech03
translation: MQ08Vault87LabTech03

original: Attention ALL Lab Technicians\n\nDoctor Merrick has ordered the latest test subjects in the EEP to be terminated and then disposed of. Please make sure that: bodily remains are placed in the incinerator as soon as the subjects vitals are flat, the entire isolation room is disinfected and any relevant data on the subjects are given to Doctor Merrick. FEV is very unpredictable, and we do not want any contamination to remain when the next strain is introduced to new subjects.
translation: 所有实验室技术人员请注意\n\n梅里克博士已下令终止EEP中最新的测试对象，然后进行处理。请确保：在受试者生命体征无起伏后立即将遗体放入焚化炉，对整个隔离室进行消毒，并将受试者的任何相关数据交给梅里克博士。FEV非常难以预测，我们不希望下一个菌株引入新受试者时留下任何污染。

original: UnderworldTulipTerminalPL1
translation: UnderworldTulipTerminalPL1

original:
O Prince, O Chief of many Throned Powers, 
That led th' imbattelld Seraphim to Warr 
Under thy conduct, and in dreadful deeds 
Fearless, endanger'd Heav'ns perpetual King; 
And put to proof his high Supremacy, 
Whether upheld by strength, or Chance, or Fate, 
Too well I see and rue the dire event, 
That with sad overthrow and foul defeat 
Hath lost us Heav'n, and all this mighty Host 
In horrible destruction laid thus low, 
As far as Gods and Heav'nly Essences 
Can Perish: for the mind and spirit remains 
Invincible, and vigour soon returns, 
Though all our Glory extinct, and happy state 
Here swallow'd up in endless misery. 
But what if he our Conquerour, (whom I now 
Of force believe Almighty, since no less 
Then such could hav orepow'rd such force as ours) 
Have left us this our spirit and strength intire 
Strongly to suffer and support our pains, 
That we may so suffice his vengeful ire, 
Or do him mightier service as his thralls 
By right of Warr, what e're his business be 
Here in the heart of Hell to work in Fire, 
Or do his Errands in the gloomy Deep; 
What can it then avail though yet we feel 
Strength undiminisht, or eternal being 
To undergo eternal punishment?
translation: 大王，掌权天使的首长啊，在您的指挥之下，掌权者们率领英勇的撒拉弗天军去作战 毫无畏惧，投入到冒险的行动中， 使天上永生的王陷于危急， 他支持自己至高无上的权力以及， 靠的是暴力、侥幸，和命运， 我目睹了这次可怕的事件， 哀痛于这可悲的覆没，可耻的败绩。 这使我们失去天界； 这样的大军竟惨遭如此之大的失败， 沦落于这样的地狱中 我们原是神灵，气质轻清， 现在破败到穷途末路 但因为我们还留有不可战胜的心志和精神， 不久将元气大振。 虽然黑暗驱走我们的全部光辉， 无尽的悲惨吞噬了我的快乐； 可是我们的征服者，他使我们还保存这些精力， 也许是要使我们更能忍受痛苦， 受尽苦难，承受他那报复的怒火； 或者是要我们在地狱猛火的中心来干苦活，在幽暗的深渊中为他奔走。这样，我们将永受无穷刑罚 ，即使是自己觉得力量还没衰退，甚至是永生的，那又有什么好处？

original: Book II
translation: 卷二

original:
First MOLOCH, horrid King besmear'd with blood 
Of human sacrifice, and parents tears, 
Though for the noyse of Drums and Timbrels loud 
Their childrens cries unheard, that past through fire 
To his grim Idol. Him the AMMONITE 
Worshipt in RABBA and her watry Plain, 
In ARGOB and in BASAN, to the stream 
Of utmost ARNON. Nor content with such 
Audacious neighbourhood, the wisest heart 
Of SOLOMON he led by fraud to build 
His Temple right against the Temple of God 
On that opprobrious Hill, and made his Grove 
The pleasant Vally of HINNOM, TOPHET thence 
And black GEHENNA call'd, the Type of Hell. 
Next CHEMOS, th' obscene dread of MOABS Sons, 
From AROER to NEBO, and the wild 
Of Southmost ABARIM; in HESEBON 
And HERONAIM, SEONS Realm, beyond 
The flowry Dale of SIBMA clad with Vines, 
And ELEALE to th' ASPHALTICK Pool. 
PEOR his other Name, when he entic'd 
ISRAEL in SITTIM on their march from NILE 
To do him wanton rites, which cost them woe. 
Yet thence his lustful Orgies he enlarg'd 
Even to that Hill of scandal, by the Grove 
Of MOLOCH homicide, lust hard by hate; 
Till good JOSIAH drove them thence to Hell.
translation:
第一个降临人间的可怕魔王摩洛，
以人为牲，全身沾满了人血和亲人的眼泪。
孩子在狰狞恐怖的恶魔手中的哭喊声，
淹没在大鼓、小鼓的嚣声中。
亚扪人崇拜他，并在拉巴及其沟渠纵横的原野，
在亚珥歌伯、巴珊，
直到亚嫩河滨，供奉着他 
他不满足于这些淫邪的邻国
还使用奸计，迷惑了
绝顶聪明的所罗门
在不洁的橄榄山上 
面对真神的圣殿，立庙建祠 
又把秀丽的欣嫩子谷封上，尊为圣林
因此被称为陀斐特和格痕拿，
那就是阴间地狱的称号。
其次一个是基抹，
污秽无比的摩押子孙崇拜着他
享祀的地域从阿洛埃到尼波
一直到南端亚巴林的山野
还有希实本、何罗念和西宏的领土，
以及披着葡萄藤的西比玛百花之谷的一端。
还有以利亚利的境地到死海之滨 
后来他又用别名毗珥 
去蛊惑那时刚从尼罗河境出来的以色列人。
他们到了什亭，就为他建立淫祠 
举行淫秽的祭祀，致遭灾祸
他还把淫祀扩大到那邪恶的山边；
到凶杀者摩洛所处的林荫周围，
使凶残和淫逸相接为邻
最终被善良的约西亚统统赶进地狱。

original: Book IV
translation: 卷四

original:
O For that warning voice, which he who saw 
Th' APOCALYPS, heard cry in Heaven aloud, 
Then when the Dragon, put to second rout, 
Came furious down to be reveng'd on men, 
WO TO THE INHABITANTS ON EARTH! that now, 
While time was, our first Parents had bin warnd 
The coming of thir secret foe, and scap'd 
Haply so scap'd his mortal snare; for now 
SATAN, now first inflam'd with rage, came down, 
The Tempter ere th' Accuser of man-kind, 
To wreck on innocent frail man his loss 
Of that first Battel, and his flight to Hell
translation:
啊，多么希望，来一个警戒的声音 
就如那目睹天启的圣者, 
正当那恶龙第二次败北, 
怒气冲冲下到人间来泄愤私仇时, 
听到天上疾声高呼：“地上的居民有祸了！”，
但愿现在再来这一声
使我们的始祖父母受到警戒 
知道他们的隐敌即将来临 
可以尽早躲避，免入致命的陷阱，
因为这时撒旦首次怒火燃烧，
下到人间，做为人类控拆者之前的诱惑者 
前来要把自己第一次失败和溃逃
地狱中去的怨气一齐倾泻在
脆弱、无辜的人类身上

original: Book VIII
translation: 卷八

original:
To whom thus ADAM gratefully repli'd. 
What thanks sufficient, or what recompence 
Equal have I to render thee, Divine 
Hystorian, who thus largely hast allayd 
The thirst I had of knowledge, and voutsaf't 
This friendly condescention to relate 
Things else by me unsearchable, now heard 
VVith wonder, but delight, and, as is due, 
With glorie attributed to the high 
Creator; some thing yet of doubt remaines, 
VVhich onely thy solution can resolve. 
VVhen I behold this goodly Frame, this VVorld 
Of Heav'n and Earth consisting, and compute, 
Thir magnitudes, this Earth a spot, a graine, 
An Atom, with the Firmament compar'd 
And all her numberd Starrs, that seem to rowle 
Spaces incomprehensible (for such 
Thir distance argues and thir swift return 
Diurnal) meerly to officiate light 
Round this opacous Earth, this punctual spot, 
One day and night; in all thir vast survey 
Useless besides, reasoning I oft admire, 
How Nature wise and frugal could commit 
Such disproportions, with superfluous hand
translation:
亚当的耳朵里仍然留着他那迷人的声音
他仍旧继续聚精会神倾听着
以为他还在继续，一会儿
如梦初醒，答道
讲述历史的天人啊
我该怎样感谢您呢
您大大地为我解了求知的渴
像朋友一样，谦和地
告诉我许多难以探求的东西
我听了既惊奇又高兴
光荣该归于至高的创造主
可是我还有一些疑惑的事
需要您的解答才可消释
当我看到巧妙结构的这个工程
这个由天和地组成的世界
测量它们的大小
比起苍天和那么多的全部星星来
这个地球只不过是一点、一粒、一个原子
群星似乎逡巡于无限的空间
单单照亮这暗淡的地球
这一小点的周围，整天整夜供给光明
而对于其他广大的世界好像用处全无
推想起来，我常常觉得奇怪
聪明而朴素的‘自然’怎么会这样不均衡
仅为了一个用处，而奢侈地
造出了这么许多各种各式的高贵的天体来

original: Autonomic Nervous System
translation: 自主神经系统

original:
In my seven dozen years studying the ghoul anatomy, I discover more and more evidence to support my theory on the nature of the not-radiological human, or "ghoul" as they are commonly called. 

In summary: I theorize that our unnaturally long lifespan is due to a mutation within the autonomic nervous system of certain individuals following exposure to specific combinations of ionizing radiation with wavelengths below 10 picometers. This mutation, it seems, disrupts the normal process of decay in the neurotransmitters along the spinal cord. 

Specifically, the transmitters effected are those responsible for cardiac and respiratory function in a healthy human. According to my studies, these transmitters are continually regenerated after mutation, carrying sufficient oxygen to sustain the life of the subject while being insufficient to retain skin elasticity and avoid necrosis, the result of which is the corpse-like appearance of post-mutation humans. It should be noted that exposure to radiation typically result in sickness followed by death and the x-factor that will lead to mutation upon exposure in lieu of the typical outcome remains unknown to this researcher.

In the coming months, I will be assembling my findings on this subject into a full study.
translation:
在我研究尸鬼解剖学的七十年中，我发现了越来越多的证据来支持我关于非放射性人类或通常称为“尸鬼”的本质的理论。

归纳一下：我们这种不正常的长寿是由于自主神经系统某些内部变异，这些变异是因为个体暴露于一种可以产生10微微米以下波长电离辐射的特殊制品造成的。看起来，这种变异抑制了外周传出神经系统轴突的正常老化。

确切地说，外周传出神经系统主要负责一个健康人类的呼吸，心跳等内脏的非自主肌肉运动。根据我的研究，这些外周传出神经系统在变异后可以不停的再生，导致人的内脏永远有活力，但是皮肤却会由于缺乏氧供应而逐渐坏死。但关于为什么暴露于常规的辐射会导致疾病乃至死亡，而暴露于这种不明物质的辐射却会造成这样的结果暂时还不清楚。

接下来的几个月，我将全力以赴汇总我的发现以求能解开这个谜。

original:
The brain structure of a Luminous Necrotic Post-Human (colloquially referred to as a "Glowing One") indicates that the regenerative ability of the neurological systems that affords typical Necrotic Post-Humans their longevity, does not extend into the higher reasoning functions of the brain itself. (This subject is further covered in report on the dissection of Feral Necrotic Post-Humans)

The distinctive luminescence that is the trademark of the Glowing One can be best attributed to an unusual amount of radioactive chemicals that building up in the bloodstream and muscle tissue of a typical Ghoul. Upon the transformation into a Feral Ghoul, the neurological systems of the body cease filtering these particles from the blood and tissue, instead causing them to build a distinctive bioluminescence that is distinctive of the "Glowing Ones".

Their social structure seems to be different from that of the Feral Ghoul. They actively seek out others of both their strain and those afflicted with Ferocious Post-Necrotic Dystrophy, particularly those who may have been injured. Studies on the nature of their healing effects on other ghouls continues with no conclusive results as of yet.
translation:
荧光坏死型新人类（俗称“发光种”）的大脑结构表明使普通坏死型新人类获得长寿的神经系统再生能力还未能对大脑的高等思考能力发挥作用。（此观点在对疯狂坏死型新人类的解剖中被进一步证实。）

对发光种所发出的独特光芒的最好解释就是这些尸鬼血管与组织中充斥着的许多不寻常的放射性化学物质。在转变成狂尸鬼时，它们身体中的神经系统会停止对血液和组织中这些微粒的过滤作用，反而使它们构建出独特的生物发光系统，也就是“发光种”的独特之处。

它们的社会结构似乎和凶悍尸鬼不一样。他们积极地寻求同族和那些深受狂暴性坏死后脑萎缩折磨的同类，特别是那些有伤在身的。对它们给其他尸鬼进行治疗的原理的研究目前还没有得出结论。

original: The brain structure of a Feral Necrotic Post-Human indicates that the regenerative ability of the neurological systems that affords typical Necrotic Post-Humans their longevity does not extend into the higher reasoning functions of the brain itself. This is a condition that I refer to as Ferocious Post-Necrotic Dystrophy.\n\nAs the reasoning and high order thinking portions of the brain deteriorate, the Post-Human subject becomes increasingly hostile, giving into a carnal need to feed as opposed to the capacity for thinking that reasoning that a typical Necrotic Post-Human retains. It remains unclear exactly what precipitates this change in biology and psychology, but anecdotal evidence seems to indicate that non-social ghouls, or those in isolation, are more prone to the condition.
