original:
Maintenance Code: RL04 Red
Issue: Reactor Spikes, Sectional Power Outages
Engineer: Daniel Koster

Fix Notes:
For the last five weeks, we've had periodic interruptions to the power grid. Entire sections will lose power for approximately 1-6 minutes, then return to normal. By installing monitoring meters, I traced the issue to sudden immense power spikes in the main reactor. My fear was the reactor was having a major malfunction, but turns out that it's due to a power draw that the experimental section is creating. Whatever they are using in there is WAY over the limit for acceptable power consumption. I've temporarily remedied the situation by having the backup reactor kick on when needed. I don't like to do this, but I have no choice until I figure out what they're up to.
translation:
维修代码：RL04 Red
问题：反应堆峰值，分段断电
工程师：丹尼尔·寇斯德

维修记录：
在过去5个星期里，电网经常性的中断。整个区域将停电大约1至6分钟，然后恢复正常。通过安装监控仪表，我发现问题出在主反应堆突然出现的巨大功率峰值上。我担心是反应堆出现了重大故障，但事实证明，这是因为实验区产生了电力消耗。不管实验区的人员在使用何备设备，解决的办法只有限制电力消耗。我通过让备用反应堆在需要时启动来暂时补救这种情况。我们其实很不情愿这样做，但在搞清他们做什么前也只能这么做了。

original: MQ08Vault87Engineering03
translation: MQ08Vault87Engineering03

original:
Maintenance Code: RL01 Yellow
Issue: G.E.C.K. Chamber Radiation Purging Offline
Engineer: Daniel Koster

Fix Notes:
Vault-Tec's crappy handiwork is at it again. I have spent the better part of a month patching and re-patching the radiation purge system that vents excess radiation from the G.E.C.K. chamber. I have no idea why this system keeps failing. I suspect the system is simply inadequate and can't handle the amount of radiation it's purging. Recommend installing a new purging system as soon as I can get one cobbled together from spare parts. Should have it ready in about a month.
translation:
维修代码：RL01 黄色
事件：伊甸园创造器室射线净化系统无连接
工程师：丹尼尔·寇斯德

维修记录：
避难所科技公司的粗糙做工再次暴露无疑。在一个月里我不断地修补修补再修补伊甸园创造器室的多余射线净化系统。我也不知道为什么这个系统崩溃得如此频繁。我怀疑这个系统根本不足以净化它所产生的射线。建议安装新的净化系统，以便我能尽快把备件组装好。这项工作预计耗时一个月。

original: MQ08Vault87Engineering04
translation: MQ08Vault87Engineering04

original:
Maintenance Code: RL00 Green
Issue: Tapioca Pudding Miscolor
Engineer: Daniel Koster

Fix Notes:
The mess hall food reconstitution system is outputting the Monday night dessert, tapioca pudding, in an odd bright orange color. This was a simple fix. The color matrix was simply misinterpreting instructions from the main brain and outputting incorrectly. I replaced the interface and the pudding now outputs in its proper hue. Wish all my fixes were this easy.
translation:
维修代码：RL00 Green
问题：木薯布丁颜色混乱
工程师：丹尼尔·寇斯德

维修记录：
餐厅的食品制作系统在星期一晚上出产了一批有着怪异橙色的木薯布丁。问题很简单，颜色母板对主机处理器产生误解，输出了错误的颜色，我把重新插拔了一下接口，产出的布丁颜色就恢复正常了。要是所有的故障维修都这么简单才好呢。

Maintenance Code: RL04 Red
Issue: NEED HELP
Engineer: Daniel Koster

Fix Notes:
This is the only place I could think of hiding this message. In the event that anyone reads this, please try and get word back to Vault-Tec HQ that something very wrong is going on in the Experimentation section... something they keep referring to as the EEP. My wife, Mercia was "diagnosed" by the Medical section as having some sort of disease they wouldn't identify. She's dead now, and those sons-of-bitches won't even tell me why. From talking to people, I've discovered that many are dead or missing. Checking this with the Medical Records section gets me nowhere. This is getting out of hand. It's time to deal with this my way. They took my wife from me, now I'll take their lives away if I don't get some answers. I've hidden some extra "help" in my safe. Accessing this message will unlock it. If I don't come back, grab that stuff and save yourself.
translation:
维修代码：RL04 红色

这里是我能想到的唯一能保存信息的地方。如果有人看家见了此条信息，请告知避难所科技公司总部，实验区出现了严重问题，恐怕和EEP有关。我的妻子迈瑞卡在医务区被“诊断”出患有某种未知的疾病。她现在死了，可是那帮婊子养的至今不肯告诉我妻子的死因。从人们的谈论中，我发现许多人离奇失踪或者死亡，而医疗记录里甚至毫无记录。事态已经超出想象了。我要用自己的方式去面对。他们夺去了我妻子的生命，如果再没有合适的答复，我也会取他们的性命。我把一些特殊的“工具”放在保险柜里。输入此条信息即会解锁保险柜.如果我再也没有回来，请你拿上这些东西，保护自己。

original: MQ08Vault87CKidsLaughter01
translation: MQ08Vault87CKidsLaughter01

original:
Journal Entry:

I don't know what to do. My Jason, my little boy... he's gone.

My wife won't talk anymore. She just sits in this godforsaken sub-level and stares out of the window at the rock wall as if looking across a sunlit meadow or a lazy summertime lake.

Jason was my life. He was my joy, my meaning. Now all this work seems pointless.

This was a mistake. Better we had all died together outside than inside this permanent tomb.

I'm scared.
translation:
日记：

我不知该怎么办。杰森，我的小儿子……他死了。

 妻子沉默不语。她整天坐在这个被上帝遗弃的地下室里，漠然地盯着石墙上的窗子，好象在望着阳光下的牧场，抑或是夏季庸懒的湖面。

杰森是我的全部的生命，我全部的快乐，我全部的意义，现在这一切都变得没有意义了。

 这真是个错误，最好我们能一起死在这个永无天日的活死人墓里。

我好害怕。

original: The G.E.C.K. is, quite simply, the most advanced piece of technology ever developed by Vault-Tec -- a terra-forming module capability of creating life from complete lifelessness. After riding out the storm of nuclear Armageddon in a Vault-Tec patented vault, residents can then activate the G.E.C.K., and create a new earthen paradise – craters and dust will give way to rolling grasslands and sparkling clear water. Of course, due to time and monetary constraints, not every vault will be equipped with a G.E.C.K. module.
translation: 伊甸园创造器是…简单讲，避难所科技公司开发出的最先进的技术成果 — 1个能够将完全无生命的物质创造成生命体的模块。在避难所科技公司制造的避难所里平安度过那段末日核战之后，居民们可以使用伊甸园创造器来创造一个新的乐土。? 满目疮痍、尘埃蔽日的大地将重新裹上翠绿的草海和碧波荡漾的湖面。当然，由于时间仓促和资金限制，不可能使每个避难所都配备伊甸园创造器模块。

original: CGOverseersTerminalBraunLetter
translation: CGOverseersTerminalBraunLetter

original:
A Letter to the Overseer from Dr. Stanislaus Braun:

If you are reading this, emergency Vault internment procedures have been initiated and you and your control group have been sealed into your Vault. Congratulations! You are now a vital part of the most ambitious program ever undertaken by Vault-Tec.

If you have not yet read your sealed orders, do so now. They will outline the experimental protocols assigned to your control group. Please remember that deviation from these protocols in any way will jeopardize the success of the program, and may be considered grounds for termination by Vault-Tec Corporation (as outlined in your Employment Agreement).

Your Vault may or may not have been selected to receive a G.E.C.K. module. Please see Attachment A for details.

Doctor Stanislaus Braun
Director, Societal Preservation Program
Vault-Tec Corporation
translation:
斯坦尼斯劳斯·布劳恩博士致监督者的一封信：

当你读到这封信，意味者避难所的紧急关闭系统已经启动，你和你的对照组已经封闭在避难所里了。恭喜！你们现在是避难所科技公司有史以来最雄心勃勃的计划的重要组成部分。

如果你还未读到密函的指示，请现在阅读。这份指示将阐述你的对照组的研究计划纲要。请记住，任何背离指示的行为都有可能影响项目顺利进行，并有可能导致避难所科技集团中止此项目（你的雇佣协议里有所说明）。

你的避难所可能被选中接受G.E.C.K.模块，也可能没有。详情请参见附件A。

斯坦尼斯劳斯·布劳恩博士
社会保护计划主管
避难所科技公司

original: MQ08Vault87OverseersTerminalBraunAttachmentA

original:
Congratulations!

Vault 87 has been chosen as one of the very few select Vaults to receive a genuine G.E.C.K. The device was delivered before final sealing of the Vault and installed into its secure pedestal by our special G.E.C.K. Scramble Team. I'd like to extend my best wishes to you and all of your population. Your survival will ensure the continuation of the human race, and to carry the Vault-Tec name into the future.

Doctor Stanislaus Braun
Director, Societal Preservation Program
Vault-Tec Corporation
translation:
恭喜各位！

87号避难所荣幸地被选为少数几个能获得伊甸园创造器的避难所之一。这个设备已在避难所最终关闭之前运抵，并由我们的伊甸园创造器装配小组安装完毕。我在此向大家表示诚挚的祝福。诸位都是历尽劫难的幸存者，你们将使人类继续繁衍生息，并将避难所科技公司带入未来。

斯坦尼斯劳斯·布劳恩博士
社会保护计划主管
避难所科技公司

original: Scouting Report
translation: 侦察报告

original: I'm quite sad to report that due to a direct hit from what I presume to be a nuclear weapon on the entry area of Vault 87, we will be unable to provide the Scouting Reports as outlined in Vault-Tec's Operations Manual. The main door to Vault 87 is damaged beyond repair and we are detecting extremely high levels of lethal radiation outside and in the entry tunnel.
translation: 我十分抱歉地报告，由于87号避难所的入口区域可能被核武器直接击中，现在已不能按避难所科技公司操作手册的指示递交侦察报告了。87号避难所正门严重损毁，已无法修复，同时我们检测到通往外界的隧道内外都布满了直接致命的极强辐射。

original: MQ08Vault87OverseersTerminalDossier01
translation: MQ08Vault87OverseersTerminalDossier01

original:
Dr. Wayne Merrick

I'm told that Dr. Merrick is one of the brightest minds in the field of accelerated evolution, and apparently Vault-Tec agrees, because they've set up this Vault around him to suit all of his needs in the event that the bombs fall. All of his data and his work have been transferred to this facility from many important sources such as Mariposa Base, West-Tek and Vault-Tec Labs.

I like Dr. Merrick. He's driven without being careless. He knows that in the event of a nuclear war, he may be the only person left in the world that can advance human genetics beyond where they are now. He's meticulous, detail-oriented, and reports everything to me on a regular basis.
translation:
韦恩·梅里克博士

我得知梅里克博士是加速进化领域里最为杰出的天才。很显然避难所科技公司十分赞同这一点，因为这座避难所正是在核弹攻击的那次事件中，避难所科技公司专门为满足他的各种需求而建造的。他的所有数据和工作已经通过各种重要的渠道（军事基地、西部科技以及避难所科技研究所）传输进了这座设备里。

我喜欢梅里克博士的作风，他总是精益求精。在那次核战事后，他可能是世界上唯一的能推动人类基因变革的人。他工作一丝不苟，注重细节，会把井井有条地把所有工作汇报给我。

original: MQ08Vault87OverseersTerminalDossier02
translation: MQ08Vault87OverseersTerminalDossier02

original: Daniel Koster\n\nAn excellent Maintenance Chief. Thorough, careful, and honest to a fault. In fact, that's becoming a problem. His security clearance isn't high enough yet to grant him access to all of the information regarding the FEV experiments performed by Dr. Merrick, but we may have to bring him into the fold soon. In the event we need major repairs on A Level, we'll definitely need his skills.
translation: 丹尼尔·寇斯德\n\n一个非常优秀的维修组长，能专注、敬业和热诚地对待问题。实际上有点小麻烦。他的安全等级还不足以允许他接触梅里克博士所做的关于FEV的实验信息，但我们得尽快让他进入研究区，我们需要他的技术来对A层进行专业的维修。

original:
Peter Stevens

This gentleman continues to impress me. He was just recently promoted to Technician Third Class by Chief Koster for his ingenuity and ability to think quickly in emergencies. Given these talents, I think he'd make an excellent candidate for Koster's eventual successor if the need should ever arise.

UPDATE: It seems Peter has suffered some sort of a nervous breakdown. He keeps claiming that his "son" is missing and his "wife" is in deep depression, although I show no records of him ever being married or having a child. I've recommended that he be taken to the Test Labs for observation and sedation if need be.
translation:
彼得·史蒂文斯

这位绅士崭露头角，令我印象深刻。他在紧急事态中展现出过人的冷静和能力而被科斯特主任授权晋升为三级技师。我想，如果要选拔一位科斯特的下任接班人的话，凭着这些优秀的天分，这个位子非他莫属。

更新：好象彼得一直受者某种精神疾病的困扰。他经常说他的“儿子”不见了，他的“妻子”严重抑郁了，但却没有任何记录表明他结过婚或者有过小孩。我建议将他送入检查室观察，必要时给以镇静措施。

original: Merc's Orders
translation: 佣兵的命令

original:
By now, your handler's given you the location of the job and your basic orders. Here are the details.

Traders have been making a killing with Mirelurk meat, and we've been losing business because of it. One of our people got involved with a caravan supplier, and we finally know where it's all been coming from.

The meat's mostly coming from one group holed up along the river smack in the middle of the ruins. There's a huge old facility under some war memorial where they've herded up a nest of Mirelurks and have been breeding and butchering them. They've been in business for months and are sure to be sitting on a pile of caps. Take what you can carry -- we just want them out of the meat market. The rest is up to you.

This isn't the biggest job, but pull it off clean and there's plenty more work for a man with your skills. Get back to your handler as soon as the job is done and we'll be in touch.
translation:
现在，你的负责人给你了任务地点和指示。以下是详细内容：

商人已经开始宰杀泥沼蟹并出售它们的肉，搞得我们的生意一落千丈。我们有个人和一个商队的供货商有点交情，最后我们总算查到那些肉的来路了。

这些肉大部分来自同一伙人，他们就藏在沿着河的那片废墟的正中央。在一个什么战争纪念馆的地下有一个巨大的设施，在那里他们有一个泥沼蟹的巢穴，饲养屠宰那些泥沼蟹。这生意他们已经进行了一个多月了，肯定挣了不少，估计都躺在瓶盖堆上了。你能拿什么就拿什么 -- 我只想让他们滚出肉类市场。其他事随你便。

这也不算啥很棘手的任务，不过处理的利索些，像你这么老练的人，还会有很多工作等着你干呢。任务完成后就立刻回到负责人那，到时我会和你联系。

original: LDJuryBossNote01a
translation: LDJuryBossNote01a

original:
Attempt #173
 -I've finally done it! Who would have thought that the simple combination of Mole Rat Meat and Wonder Glue would have been the answer? Curing the mixture together in a metal box produces a sort of jerky that is very pleasant to the palette, chewy with a nutty taste. The usual toughness and bitter flavor of molerat is completely undetectable.

Further, I find that the meat has restorative properties. A man who eats a meal of this concotion will find himself feeling positivley buoyant and anxious to move about.

I'll be able to charge even more for it than I was originally planning. The only thing left to do is set up shop in one of the towns on the surface. None too soon! These filthy raiders have been my bane, and after these long months, I'm as destitute as the worst of them.

Odd, that's the alarm.

original:
Attempt #87
 -The molerats are starting to get more aggressive. I think we will have to push back our checkpoints a bit to make up for it. I wonder if my experiments with isoprene have somehow triggered their sudden increase in aggression. I wouldn't be so worried about it if I had something to show for it. There's got to be some way to make this meat taste better.

Chucky won't shut up about the one he kept as a pet being eaten by the others. I think I'll shoot him, that sort of thing seems to impress these raider types.
translation:
尝试 #87
 -鼹鼠们开始变得更具攻击性。我想我们必须把检查点往后推一推，以弥补这一点。我在想，是不是我用异戊二烯做的实验在某种程度上引发了它们攻击性的突然增强。如果有证据的话，我就不会这么担心了。一定有办法让这肉更好吃的

恰吉或许会为他的宠物被当做食物而喋喋不休吧。我想我应该让他见识下我的实验成果，或许那样就能让那些恶棍们闭嘴。

original: Diary of Candace Keller
translation: 坎达斯·凯勒的日记

original:
Dad just won't listen to a word I say. 

He keeps leaving the bunker to salvage supplies from the rest of the base. In understand he's bored, cooped up in here, but so are the rest of us. 

And the bunker is secure! Every time he leaves, he exposes all of us to that damned radiation. 

After all the effort it took to get us all in here, dad's willing to throw it all away just because he's a bit angsty.

I really hate him sometimes.
translation:
爸爸就是不听我的话。

他总是离开地堡，去基地其他地方回收物资。我知道他闷在这里很无聊，但我们其他的人也一样啊。

而且地堡是安全的！他每次离开，都会让我们暴露在那该死的辐射中。

费了那么大劲才把我们都弄进来，就因为他有点烦躁，爸爸就想把这一切都毁了。

有时候我真的很恨他。

original: MS18ReillyPersonal01
translation: MS18ReillyPersonal01

original: Well, Brick and Donovan were at it again today. I swear, if I have to break up another fight between the two of them I'll go crazy. As long as they keep it off mission, I guess I shouldn't care so much. I just want this group to stick together.\n\nIt's been a month since we lost Dallas and Kira. They were assets to the Rangers and even though I've taken Theo on board to bolster our numbers, he's hardly a replacement. He's green, but maybe with enough Mutie blood splashing on his boots, he'll wise up real fast.
translation: 好嘛，布瑞克和多诺万今天又干上了。我发誓，如果再逼我给他俩当和事佬我会疯掉的。只要他俩不因此影响任务，我大概就不必多虑了，全组团结一致就行。\n\n达拉斯和吉良离开我们到现在已经一个月了。他们是队伍的中坚，即使我把西奥拉了进来以壮声势，他根本不是替代品。他太嫩，但也许在变种人的血溅到他的靴子上，他很快就会成长起来的。

original: MS18ReillyPersonal02
translation: MS18ReillyPersonal02

original: I've gotten the approval from "Mr. Smith" for the mapping project. It's going well so far... definitely easier than hunting down Muties. The caps have been good, so we'll stick with it unless something better pops up.\n\nWe had a little bit of a run-in with Talon Company today. Those pricks always have to start shit with us... and unfortunately for them, Brick was with us. Needless to say it wasn't long before I heard Eugene's familiar whine and she started dropping them like flies. We got out of there with no casualties, but I think for now we'll give the Capital building a wide berth.
translation: 我已从“史密斯先生”那里获得了绘图计划的批准。迄今为止进展顺利 — 当然比猎捕缪利轻松多了。效益不错，所以我们得坚持接着干除非有什么更有油水的差事可做。\n\n今天我们和鹰爪公司发生了一点儿小口角。那帮刺儿头总是想骑在我们头上拉屎 — 可惜布瑞克站在我们这边。不用说啦，没过多久尤金那熟悉的哀嗥就如滔滔江水一般灌进了我的耳朵。我们立马逃了出来，所幸尚无人员伤亡。但我想安全起见，我们还是和首府大楼保持距离的好。

original: MS18ReillyPersonal03
translation: MS18ReillyPersonal03

original: Butcher and I slept together tonight. He'd always been kind of flirty with me, but I took it as typical merc humor. Well, I was wrong. I hope this hasn't jeopardized our relationship on a professional level, but I really want it to continue. After all, it's been a while since I've been with anyone and it's nice to know someone out there cares.\n\nI think we're going to try and move on to the next sector of the downtown ruins this week. I want to finish Takoma Park first though. There's still a lot of nooks and crannies in that place. If it wasn't for the Talon Company and Super Mutant resistance in the area, we'd be done by now.
translation: 今晚我和布彻上床了。他以前总是跟我打情骂俏的，我还以为那不过是佣兵特有的幽默，看来我错了。希望这没有在某种程度上危及我们的关系，因为我还想跟他好下去，毕竟，我身边已经很久没有男人了，知道还有个人关心着自己心里才温暖。\n\n我想这周内我们就要试着转移到市区废墟的下一区域了，但我还是想先处理完塔科马公园，那里还有不少隐蔽的犄角旮旯。要不是那地方有鹰爪公司和超级变种人的抵抗，我们早搞定了。

original: MS18ReillyPersonal04
translation: MS18ReillyPersonal04

original: Well, Theo's been itching to go on a mapping trip, so I'm taking the entire group into Vernon Square. I usually like to leave someone back at the compound, but the sector is brimming with potential loot locations, so I need all the muscle I can get. Butcher is anxious to check out Our Lady of Hope Hospital and get supplies, while I want to set up a transmitter on the Statesman Hotel.\n\nI hear Brick and Donovan going at it again. I better get these guys on the road before another fist fight breaks out.
translation: 呵，西奥一直渴望着绘图之旅，所以我把整个小组都带到弗农广场来了。通常我都会在场地上留个人殿后，但这一区到处都是潜在的掠夺点，所以每支枪杆每个脑袋都得给我上。布彻急着去搜索希望圣母医院寻找补给，我想在政要酒店设一部发报机。\n\n听说布瑞克和多诺万又往那儿冲过去了。我最好赶在下一场战斗前在路上找到这些家伙。

original: Research Note - Laser Rifle
translation: 研究笔记 — 激光步枪

original:
Subject -> Laser Rifle/Pistol
Researcher -> J. T. Benning

Analysis ->
Further research regarding Laser Weaponry has not revealed much we didn't already know. Small production run of prototype weapons developed by US Military. 

Critical Components ->
Power drawn from Microfusion Cell is processed through a Wave/Particle Diverter (manuf:Gen Atomics Intnl). Diverters are protected by carbon-fiber housing, preventing frequent malfunction, but when a diverter fails the weapon becomes unusable, and this part is extremely difficult to replace or repair.

Precision-cut lenses focus optic energy. Lenses are prone to damage and can grossly affect precision of the firing weapon's firing mechanism. Lenses are easily replaced with any clear glass, but require a great deal of skill to fabricate.

Field Operation ->
A fully charged cell will discharge 20 bolts from a pistol, and 12 shots from the rifle model. Recoil is negligible compared to ballistic weapons, so long range combat requires less marksmanship ability of the soldier. 

Maintenance ->
The chassis are easily opened, allowing the weapon to be serviced in the field. Purified water and a clean cloth can be used to wash mirrored and glass components, slowing wear on the weapon. The weapon can also overheat after a period of intense use. This can be counteracted by submerging the barrel of the weapon in water, which helps cool heat sinks located beneath the chassis shell in that area.
translation:
主题 -> 激光步枪/手枪
研究员 -> J. T. 本宁

分析 ->
对激光武器的进一步研究并未揭示出太多我们尚未知晓的信息。美国军方已开发出小批量的原型武器。

关键部件 ->
由微型聚变电池提供的电力通过波/粒分流器（制造商：通用原子国际）进行处理。分流器由碳纤维外壳保护，可防止频繁故障，但分流器一旦失效，武器将无法使用，且此部件极难更换或维修。

精密切割的透镜用于聚焦光学能量。透镜容易受损，并会严重影响开火武器发射机构的精确度。透镜很容易用任何透明玻璃替换，但制造需要极高的技艺。

实地操作 ->
一块充满电的电池可为手枪提供20发能量束，为步枪型号提供12发。与弹道武器相比，其后坐力微乎其微，因此远距离作战对士兵的射击技能要求较低。

维护 ->
底座易于打开，便于在野外进行维修。可以使用纯净水和干净的布来清洗镜面和玻璃部件，以减缓武器的磨损。长时间高强度使用后，武器可能会过热。这可通过将武器枪管浸入水中来抵消，这样做有助于冷却位于该区域底座外壳下方的散热片。

original: Research Note - Plasma Rifle
translation: 研究笔记 - 等离子步枪

original:
=== Weapons Research ===

Subject -> Plasma Rifle

Researcher -> R. R. Rasting

Analysis -> The Plasma Rifle, like the Laser Rifle, uses a micro fusion cell as its power supply. It taps into the cell, essentially a small fusion reactor, to produce a toroid of plasma that is ejected down a superconductor barrel. A typical microfusion cell can supply the rifle with around eight shots. Further research needs to be done to determine exactly how the plasma retains its density while traveling through the air toward its target.
translation:
=== 武器研究 ===

主题 -> 等离子步枪

研究员 -> R.R. 瑞斯丁

分析 -> 等离子步枪与激光步枪类似，使用微型聚变电池作为其能源。它利用该电池（本质上是一个小型聚变反应堆）来产生一等离子体环，该等离子体被喷射通过一个超导枪管。一块标准的微型聚变电池可为步枪提供大约八次射击。需要进一步研究以确定等离子体在空气中向目标移动时如何保持其密度的确切机制。

original: Research Note - Minigun
translation: 研究笔记 — 转管机枪

original:
=== Weapons Research ===

Subject -> Minigun

Researcher -> H. P. Smith

Analysis -> Why am I researching such old technology? Practice, practice, practice, blah, blah, blah. Anyway, the Minigun uses a much smaller round than most of the rifles found throughout the Wastes. However, the rate of fire of the Minigun makes up for the small, 5mm round, sending a hail of bullets toward its target. Its sheer size, coupled with its trademark sound, is enough to send anyone in its path running for cover. It's a great weapon for suppressing fire, letting others flank the unsuspecting enemy. A typical cartridge holds around 100 rounds.
translation:
=== 武器研究 ===

课题 -> 转轮机枪

研究员 -> H.P. 史密斯

分析报告 -> 为什么我在研究一个如此古老的技术？实习，实践，练习，诸如此类的原因。不管怎样，转轮机枪的口径都比废土大部分的步枪要小。然而，通过向目标暴雨般的倾泻子弹，转轮机枪弥补了它只有5毫米口径的缺点。缩小的尺寸，标志性的轰鸣，任何人都可以用它为队友制造强有力的掩护。它是一种用来提供压制火力的大型枪械，它的扫射能够在侧翼给予没有防备的敌人以沉重的打击。一块标准的弹匣能够提供大约100发子弹。

original: Research Note - Pulse Grenade
translation: 研究笔记 - 脉冲手雷

original:
=== Weapons Research ===

Subject -> Pulse Grenade

Researcher -> L. J. Rogers

Analysis -> The Pulse Grenade is the most effective weapon against robotics. Upon detonation, an intense electromagnetic pulse is emitted, severely crippling any robotics within the explosion radius. They are extremely handy against the many robots and turrets found throughout the Capital Wasteland.
translation:
=== 武器研究 ===

主题 -> 脉冲手雷

研究员 -> L.J. 罗杰斯

分析 -> 脉冲手雷是对抗机器人最有效的武器。爆炸时，会释放出强烈的电磁脉冲，使爆炸范围内的所有机器人瘫痪。用来对付遍及首都废土的众多机器人和炮塔非常方便。

original: Research Note - Enclave Armor
translation: 研究笔记 - 英克雷装甲

original:
=== Armor Research ===

Subject -> Enclave Armor

Researcher ->T. T. Bowser

Analysis -> After several radiation experiments, I can safely conclude that the Enclave Armor is more radiation resistant than Power Armor, although not by much. Regardless, more research and tests are needed to determine exactly what makes it more resistant.
translation:
=== 护甲研究 ===

主题 -> 英克雷装甲

研究员 ->T.T. 鲍泽

分析 -> 通过数次辐射实验，我能肯定地说，英克雷装甲具有的防辐射性能优于动力装甲，尽管相差不大。不管怎样，要确定其具有更强抗辐射性能的原因，仍然需要更多的研究和测试。

original: Research Note - Missile Launcher
translation: 研究笔记 - 火箭弹发射器

original:
=== Weapons Research ===

Subject -> Missile Launcher

Researcher ->J. J. Browne

Analysis -> After several attempts to modify the Missile Launcher to increase its accuracy, I conclude that it cannot be done. In fact, this is third one I've "broken" in the past month. I will pass the task on to L. J. Rogers, who seems confident enough that it can be modified and that I merely overlooked obvious miscalculations. Technically, the Missile Launcher I've recently worked on is not broken. It just does not function properly. I have since locked it up in Weapons Storage.
translation:
=== 武器研究 ===

主题 -> 火箭弹发射器

研究员 ->J.J. 布朗

分析 -> 经过多次尝试修改火箭弹发射器以提高其精确度后，我得出的结论是，这无法实现。事实上，这是我过去一个月内“弄坏”的第三个了。我会把这份差事交给L.J. 罗杰斯，他似乎对此很有信心并认为我忽略了明显的计算错误。从技术上讲，我最近研究的那个火箭弹发射器并没有坏。它只是无法正常工作。因此，我已经将其锁在武器库中。

original: FortIndDataNote01
translation: FortIndDataNote01

original:
Field Report
Protector Casdin
0700 Surface Patrol (Fairfax)

We've secured the building and are currently implementing our orders for the occupation of Fairfax. 

Raider activity in town has increased dramatically ever since we've taken up positions in and around the fort. We've killed a lot of them and scared off plenty others, but they just keep coming back. While there seems to be no limit to people willing to reduce themselves to their way of life, we don't have the luxury of surplus personnel, so we must remain vigilant. 

That the raiders take such continued risks to invade our facility appears to confirm suspicions that we've had an intelligence leak, and they're after our technology. They've tried tenaciously to infiltrate the base, but so far haven't stood a chance. Our objective remains the same - protect the research personnel and keep this fort safe until more reinforcements arrive.
translation:
战地报告
保护者卡斯丁
0700 地表巡逻（费尔法克斯）

我们已经守住了大楼，目前正在执行占领费尔法克斯的命令。

自从我们在堡垒内外建立阵地后，城里的掠夺者活动急剧增加。我们杀了很多人，也吓跑了很多人，但他们还是不断地回来。虽然愿意牺牲自己来换取他们的生活方式的人似乎不计其数，但我们没有多余的人手，所以我们必须保持警惕。

掠夺者冒着如此大的风险不断入侵我们的设施，这似乎证实了我们的猜测：我们的情报泄露了，他们是冲着我们的技术来的。他们顽强地试图潜入基地，但到目前为止还没有机会。我们的目标依然不变--保护研究人员，确保堡垒安全，直到更多援军到来。

original: FortIndDataNote02
translation: FortIndDataNote02

original:
Field Report
Defender Rockfowl
0300 SpecOps Recon Patrol

Defender Morgan and I executed a reconnaissance mission last night to gauge Raider entrenchment in the structural underground of Fairfax. We located three entrances into underground utility tunnels. 

We are able to confirm that the enemy has occupied and fortified positions within the underground, though some appear undefended. We also identified a small weapons cache in the southeast section of the tunnels. While deploying explosives to demolish the cache we were discovered by a Raider patrol. In accordance to mission parameters, we did not engage the enemy, instead retreating to Fort. Raiders will be likely to set up defenses and attach more patrols to the area as a result.
translation:
战地报告
捍卫者罗克浮
0300特种侦查巡逻

我和摩根保护者昨晚执行了一次侦察任务，以评估费尔法克斯地下结构中的掠夺者防卫工事。我们发现了三个进入地下公用设施隧道的入口。

我们可以确认的是，敌人已经占领并加固了地下阵地，但有些阵地似乎没有设防。我们还在隧道东南部发现了一个小型武器隐藏处。在部署炸药拆除武器隐藏处时，我们被一支掠夺者巡逻队发现。根据任务目的，我们没有与敌人交战，而是撤退到了堡垒。掠夺者可能会因此在该地区设置防御工事并增加巡逻次数。

original: Letters to the Editor, Feb. 2077
translation: 给编者的信，2077年2月

original:
"Requiem for an Antagonist"

Grognak the Barbarian is an excellent comic for many reasons, but one of the most widely-respected ones is the depth of its villains. From the cold-blooded manipulations of the Man-Saurian to the love-hate romance with Femme-Ra, the stories of Grognak's enemies are every bit as fascinating as his own tales.

But, for my money, no tale is more tragic and more fascinating than that of the AntAgonizer. While never developed as fully as major villains like Skullpocalypse or Mastadonald, the portrait of the orphaned girl raised by ants and instilled with a bitter hatred of humanity has tremendous potential for reader connection and possible redemption.

However, in "Grognak and the Ants of Agony," Mr. Neptura threw away all of that potential by simply treating the AntAgonizer as a two-dimensional villain with a futile and pointless grudge against mankind. His writing replaced her subtle undertones of lost humanity and tragically lost innocence with the worst sort of mustache-twirling cliched dialogue. It was an offense to a deep and tragic character.

How a hack like that continues to find work in comics is beyond my comprehension. Hubris Comics should fire him and return the series to the capable hands of Mr. Moorellis. Until that time, I REFUSE to buy another comic from what USED to be my favorite publisher!

Obsessed in Oakmont
translation:
“一个痛苦蚁后的挽歌”

由于各种原因，《野蛮人歌南》是一本很优秀的漫画，而其中一个最受欢迎的因素是剧中反派人物的深度。从控制蜥蜴人的冷血操纵者到女妖的爱恨罗曼史，歌南的敌人的故事和他自己的故事一样那么有吸引力。

但是，在我看来，没有任何故事比痛苦蚁后的故事更悲惨，更引人入胜。虽然他并没有像头骨启示者或唐纳德大人这些反派主角一样有大量的戏份，但对孤女被蚂蚁抬走并被灌输了憎恨人类的思想这个情节的生动描写，为读者的代入感和可能发生的救赎埋下了精彩的伏笔。

然而在《歌南和痛苦的蚂蚁》中，内普特拉先生却让我大失所望，仅仅把痛苦蚁后当成是一个对人类充满毫无意义的怨念的双面坏人，他的作品中竟用“极度扭曲”这种最恶劣的陈词滥调来描写她丧失人性后，微妙的潜在感情和不幸失去清白的遭遇，这是对这个深度悲情角色的冒犯。

我无法理解这样一个作者如何继续在漫画界立足，虎不理漫画应当开除他，并把这一系列还给能胜任的莫里斯先生来完成。在此之前，我拒绝购买它出版的其他漫画，尽管它曾经是我最喜欢的出版商！

来自奥克芒的痴迷者

original: MaxsonDiary1
translation: 麦克森日记1

original:
I, Roger Maxson, Captain, serial number 072389 have started this log because it doesn't look good for any of us, and I'd like for people to know what really happened here.

All hell broke loose when we finally discovered what those scientist bastards were up to. The Colonel has locked himself in his office and seems to be having some sort of breakdown. 

The men are screaming for blood. They're looking to me for answers, and I'm not sure what to do. Someone has to do something, though, before this place sinks into an anarchistic bloodbath.
translation:
我，罗杰·麦克森上尉，编号072389，因战友们情况均不容乐观，特此开始记录，以便让后来者知道这里发生过的事情。

当我终于弄清了那些搞科学的混蛋干的事情后，恐怖的事情开始发生了。上校把他自己关在办公室里日渐衰弱。

战友们开始变得嗜血，他们求助于我，但我对此无能为力。如果没有人来做些什么，这里将会上演恐怖屠杀。

original: MaxsonDiary2
translation: 麦克森日记2

original: Every time we get a report from higher up things get worse here. The war is going in a very bad direction and this place is about to go into full mutiny, with all the chaos that entails. \n\nI stopped one of the men from executing a scientist today, and demanded that we interrogate them to find out what their orders were.
translation: 每一次上级给我们带来的都是坏消息。战局越来越坏，叛变将要发生，混乱接踵而至。\n\n我今天在一名士兵准备处决一个科学人员时阻止了他，我希望通过审讯这些科学人员来得知他们是受谁的指示。

original: MaxsonDiary3
translation: 麦克森日记3

original: I killed a man today. I was interrogating Chief Scientist Anderson and he was giving me the full details of their inhuman experiments. He said his orders came from the government, but I didn't buy it. He started screaming about how he was following orders, how he was a military man, and I just shot him. I tell myself it was to keep him from causing a full mutiny among the men, but I'm not so sure.
translation: 今天我处决了一个家伙。起因是我审讯了科学人员头领，他把这些非人道试验的内容向我全盘托出了—他说他们执行的是政府的命令，看我对此不买账，于是他开始扯自己多么忠于军队，多么服从命令，于是我一枪把他给毙了。我告诉我自己，这么做是为了防止兵变的发生，但实际上我并不能肯定自己的做法是否是正确的。

original: MaxsonDiary4
translation: 麦克森日记4

original: I tried again to speak to the colonel through the door, but he seems to have completely lost touch with reality. I broke down the door with several of the men just in time to watch him blow his head off. Right before he pulled the trigger he said he was sorry.
translation: 我尝试隔着门与上校交流，但听上去他已经丧失了理智。我和几个手下撞开了门，但看到的却是上校正用枪顶着自己的脑袋，他只说了一句很抱歉后，就扣响了扳机。

original: MaxsonDiary5
translation: 麦克森日记5

original: By killing the egghead, I seem to have confirmed my position as leader of the men. They follow me without question now. The interrogations invariably end up being executions.\n\nShellman held out the longest, but the end result was the same. Her arguments about her orders were a bit too specific to be completely made up. I'm getting a real bad feeling in my gut about how this is all going to end up. I don't even lie to myself anymore about my reasons for executing the scientists.
translation: 在处决了那个搞学问的之后，我在战友之间树立了威信，他们变得服从我的指令了。现在每次审讯结束后受审者都会被处决掉。\n\n因为萨尔曼的供词有些具体信息需要补足，所以她是活得最长的，但最终也难逃一死。关于处决，我已经变得连眼睛都不眨了。

original: MaxsonDiary6
translation: 麦克森日记6

original: I finally replied to the outside world over our radio. I don't know why they never sent anyone here to see what was happening when we stopped responding to their transmissions. \n\nIt doesn't make any sense. Well, they'll come now. I declared ourselves seceded from the union. They remember Jefferson Davis. What will history say about me?
translation: 我终于通过无线电和外界取得了联络，我不知道为什么在失去这么久的联系之后，军方一直没有派人来这里。\n\n真是荒唐！好吧，事已至此，我决定对外宣称我的部队正式独立。不知后世之人会怎么评价我？会不会和杰斐逊·戴维斯一样？

original: MaxsonDiary7
translation: 麦克森日记7

original: What the hell is going on? We declare ourselves to be in full desertion from the Army and no longer under the government's command and what happens? Nothing. Something bad is coming down.
translation: 活见鬼，我宣布了我们彻底背叛了军队，不再听从政府指挥，但是你猜发生了什么？屁事都没！看来外面大事不妙了。

original: MaxsonDiary8
translation: 麦克森日记8

original: I can't believe those bastards finally did it. Damn them all to hell. They finally let the A-Bombs fly. We were right in the middle of trying to pry the real story out of von Felden when we completely lost contact. \n\nI have a feeling the research center was hit hard. I don't know why, just call it a gut feeling. It seems inconceivable that we were not targeted. I'm sure China will make up for that oversight real soon. Luckily, we had moved our families from outside into the facility the day before yesterday. We do not yet know if the fallout has reached this area.
translation: 我不敢相信那些王八蛋真的这么做了，我操他们大爷的，他们居然真的发射了核弹！就在我正要把冯·非欧德外面发生的事情经过查个水落石出时，与外界的联络彻彻底底的中断了。\n\n我感觉研究中心遭到了严重破坏，不知道为什么我会这么想，可能是直觉使然吧。不可思议的是，我们这里居然没有遭到打击。不过那些中国佬应该用不了多久就会发现失查而攻击这里的。幸运的是，我们的家人在前天已经全部移居到这里了。目前尚不清楚辐射是否会蔓延到这里。

original: MaxsonDiary9
translation: 麦克森日记9

original: Sgt. Platner volunteered to go outside today to take specific readings on the atmosphere. It seems the radiation has not spread this far. Since he was wearing his Power Armor, there was no threat to him from radiation, but if he had been exposed he would have had to be exiled. We don't have adequate decontamination facilities here.
translation: 普拉特纳中士今天自愿到外面采集了大气数据，看上去空气中的放射物还没有消散。由于穿着动力装甲，放射物对他不能构成威胁，但是如果他裸露在外的话，应该早就没命了。我们这里没有净化空气的设备。

original: MaxsonDiary10
translation: 麦克森日记10

original: I convinced the men that we should bury the scientists. I don't know why... perhaps it was to ease my conscience. I finally started to believe their stories when the last one was dying.\n\nMy God, what have I become?
translation: 我说服大家去埋葬科学人员的尸体。我也不知道我为什么要这么做……可能是为了免受良心的谴责吧。在那些科学人员中的最后一人死掉时，我终于开始相信他们的故事了。\n\n神啊，我怎么会变成了这个样子？

original: MaxsonDiary11
translation: 麦克森日记11

original: We're leaving this godforsaken place today. I'm leading the exodus to the old government bunker at Lost Hills. I'm leaving this log behind to be buried when this place goes in the next exchange. \n\nWho knows, maybe someone will find it someday...
translation: 我们今天准备离开这个不毛之地了。我将会把幸存者们带往位于失落丘的政府掩体中。我会留下这份日志，到下次交换时埋了它。\n\n或许有朝一日会有人找到它，我就不得而知了……

original: MaxsonDossier1
translation: 麦克森档案1

original:
Born -- NA
Died -- 2135

Second in command of the security team stationed at the West Tek research facility; later relocated to the Mariposa Military Base.

Assumed command after nervous breakdown of security team leader Colonel Robert Spindel. Executed scientists after learning of their research into the Forced Evolutionary Virus, or FEV.

Deserted from military just before the war. Maxson ordered the families of all base personnel brought inside the facility, thereby sparing their lives.

Led survivors in their Exodus to the Lost Hills bunker. Maxson's wife was killed on the journey.

At Lost Hills, Roger Maxson formed the Brotherhood of Steel. As the organization's first High Elder, he formed the Orders of Paladins, Knights and Scribes.
translation:
出生日期 — 不详
死亡日期 — 2135

西部科技研究所防卫队副指挥，随后调到马里波萨军事基地。

在防卫队长官罗伯特·斯宾铎上校神经失常之后临时担任总指挥。在得知研究人员从事于强制进化病毒的研究工作后处决了他们。

麦克森战前背叛了军队，他命令基地所有工作人员的家属撤入研究所来保全生命。

随后他带领幸存者抵达失落丘掩体。在行进过程中，麦克森的妻子被杀害了。

在失落丘掩体，杰·麦克森正式成立了钢铁兄弟会。作为首位大长老，他为圣骑士、骑士和学士制定了行为法则。

original: MaxsonDossier2
translation: 麦克森档案2

original:
Born -- NA (teenager of unspecified age in 2077)
Died -- 2155

Took over command of the Brotherhood of Steel as High Elder in 2135, when his father, Roger Maxson, died of cancer.

In 2155, while hunting down a group of Raiders knows as the Vipers, Maxson (who was unhelmeted at the time) was grazed in the head by an arrow. A deadly Viper poison killed him within hours.
translation:
出生日期 — 不详（2077年年龄不详的青少年）
死亡日期 — 2155年

2135年，他的父亲罗杰·麦克森因癌症去世，他作为大长老接管了钢铁兄弟会的指挥权。

2155年，在追击一群被称为“毒蛇帮”掠夺者的时候，麦克森（那时没有戴头盔）被一支毒箭擦破了头，几个小时后，箭上携带的致命蛇毒杀死了他。

original: MaxsonDossier3
translation: 麦克森档案3

original:
Born -- 2097
Died -- NA

Son of Maxson II and grandson of Roger Maxson.

A gifted soldier, John Maxson was promoted to the rank of Paladin at age 38, in the year 2135. Soon after, he was promoted once more to Head Paladin.

In 2155, Maxson was promoted to the illustrious position of High Elder when his father Maxson II was killed in glorious battle with the Raiders known as Vipers.

Records indicate John Maxson had some dealings with a mysterious figure identified only as the "Vault Dweller" in the year 2162, at the age of 65.
translation:
出生日期 — 2097年
死亡日期 — 不详

麦克森二世的儿子，罗杰·麦克森的孙子。

他是一个天生的战士，在2135年，也就是他38岁的时候被晋升为圣骑士。不久之后，他再一次被晋升为圣骑士长。

2155年，当他的父亲麦克森二世在同被称为“毒蛇帮”掠夺者的圣战中战死后，麦克森被提升为更高的职位。

记录显示约翰·麦克森在2162年，也就是他65岁的时候与一个被称为“避难所居民”的神秘人物有过交易。

original: MaxsonStateNote
translation: 麦克森州笔记

original: The state of Maxson, in the New California Republic, was built in close proximity to the Lost Hills Bunker, and enjoyed the protection of the Brotherhood of Steel.\n\nNo additional information is available at this time.
translation: 位于新加利福尼亚共和国的麦克森州，距离失落丘掩体十分近，并享有钢铁兄弟会的保护。\n\n这个时候没有额外的信息可以获得。

original: CitPalandineNote
translation: CitPalandineNote

original:
Further investigations into the U.F.O. codenamed "Palandine" have confirmed our suspicions. 

On the evening of May 3, 2062, an alien craft of unknown make and origin did indeed breach the airspace just north of Hagerstown, Maryland and crashed into a heavily wooded, non-residential area.

Unfortunately, attempts to retrieve the craft proved unsuccessful. It simply could not be located, either due to some kind of advanced invisibility shielding, or because the occupants managed to make repairs and vacate the crash site before our arrival.

Despite our failure of recovery, the significance of this event cannot be denied. 

We are not alone.
translation:
对代号为“帕兰顿”的UFO进行的深入调查确定了我们的猜测。

2062年5月3日夜晚，一架制造方与来源不详的外星飞行器闯入了马里兰州黑格斯敦北部的领空，并在非居住区的一片浓密的森林里坠毁。

不幸的是，试图寻找飞行器的尝试失败了。仅仅是由于无法定位，或者是因为某种先进隐身防护层，或许是由于驾驶员成功地修好了飞行器并在我们到达前离开。

尽管我们的寻找失败了，很明显的是这个事件是不可以被忽视的。

我们并不孤单。

original: CitadelTerminal1
translation: CitadelTerminal1

original:
Weapons -- Plasma-based, capable of molecular destabilization
Armor -- Advanced Power Armor Mark II
Transportation -- Vertibirds

Tactical Assessment -- The Enclave forces that have occupied Project Purity are nearly identical to those encountered on the West Coast in the year 2241.

Threat Potential -- Severe
translation:
武器 — 基于等离子体，能够破坏分子稳定
装甲 — 先进动力装甲II型
运输工具 — 飞鸟

战术评估 — 占领净水工程的英克雷部队与2241年在西海岸遭遇到的那些几乎一样。

潜在威胁 — 严重

original: CitadelTerminal2
translation: CitadelTerminal2

original: It is the opinion of Sentinel Lyons that the recent Super Mutant attack on GNR was not indicative of a larger assault, as was originally thought. \n\nInstead, the forces that attacked the radio station were probably en route to the Mall, to reinforce their own kind in a prolonged battle against the mercenaries of Talon Company.
translation: 里昂斯铁卫认为目前进攻银新台地区的超级变种人，并没有像原来想象那样发动更大规模的袭击。\n\n而且进攻无线电站的敌军也许只是将广场当作主要目标，去支援他们对抗鹰爪公司雇佣兵的战斗。

original: CitadelTerminal3
translation: CitadelTerminal3

original:
Scribe Rothchild has completed a new full diagnostic of the robot. Here are those results:

Mobility -- 0%
Navigation Translation -- 0%
Internal Processors -- 87%
Weapons Systems -- 60%
Power Management -- 3%
Voice Module -- 100%

It is the assessment of Scribe Rothchild that once the Power Management issues are solved, Mobility and Navigation Translation will jump to at least 50% -- well within acceptable operating capacity.
translation:
学士罗斯查德已经完成了对机器人的最新全新检修。这里是数据：

机动性 — 0%
导航仪 — 0%
内部处理区 — 87%
武器系统 — 60%
能量控制 — 3%
声音组件 — 100%

学士罗斯查德的看法是一旦能量控制问题得到解决，机动性和导航仪就可以至少在可控的范围内增加到50%。

original: CitadelTerminal4
translation: CitadelTerminal4

original: It is come to our attention that several Scribes have slipped on hydraulic fluid near the eastern end of the robot lift. Until the offending pipes can be mended completely, please use caution in that area.
translation: 值得注意的是，已经有很多记录员在机器人升降机东边尽头的地区，由于液压油而摔倒。在这些该死的管子被完全修好前，请留意那个区域。

original: CitadelTerminal5
translation: CitadelTerminal5

original: Due to the increased Super Mutant activity in the vicinity of GNR, and the importance of that outpost, all Knights and Paladins can expect to be added to the patrol rotation in that area.\n\nSee your squad leaders for more information.
translation: 由于超级变种人在GNR附近活动越来越频繁，外围据点显得尤为重要。所有的骑士和游侠都将被派到那地区进行例行巡逻。\n\n从你的小队指挥官那儿获取更多的信息。

original: CitadelTerminal6
translation: CitadelTerminal6

original: By order of Elder Lyons, Squire Maxson is not to be given unsupervised access to the Bailey while live fire practice is in effect!
translation: 奉里昂斯长老之命，在实弹射击练习期间，麦克森扈从不得在无人看管的情况下进入堡场！

original: CitadelTerminal7
translation: CitadelTerminal7

original:
Due to the tragic death of Paladin Reddin, Lyons' Pride now has one opening, effective immediately.

If you can't shoot an Ugly from 150 yards blindfolded, don't waste my time.
 -- Sentinel Lyons
translation:
由于新兵瑞丁悲剧性的死亡，“里昂斯的骄傲”马上出现了一个实质上的缺口。

如果你不能蒙着眼睛射中一个150码外的敌人，就不要浪费我的时间。
 — 里昂斯铁卫

original: CitadelTerminal8
translation: CitadelTerminal8

original: Due to certain unexpected tactical developments, funeral services for Initiate Reddin have been cancelled.\n\nA memorial service will be scheduled some time in the future. Date TBD.
translation: 由于某些意料之外的战术发展，为新兵瑞丁举行的葬礼被取消了。\n\n将来会安排一场追悼会。日期待定。

original: CitadelTerminal9
translation: CitadelTerminal9

original: Recent experiments with Accelerated Vector Fusion (AVF) have not gone according to plan. All Scribes assigned to the Lab should check with Scribe Rothchild on a daily basis, and obtain any modified technical parameters as needed.
translation: 加速矢量核聚变最近的实验(AVF)没有按照计划进行，所有被派到实验室的记录员应该每天都与学士罗斯查德一起记录，以便获得任何需要的技术参数修改。

original: CitadelTerminalLyons1
translation: CitadelTerminalLyons1

original: Squire Maxson’s training is proceeding well, and the boy certainly has an aptitude for small arms. But I often worry about his emotional state. He is a child surrounded by killers, being groomed to become a killer himself. \n\nMaybe I’ve become too cynical, too soft in my old age, but I wish I could give the boy a more normal childhood. Ironic, considering his upbringing is so much like my own. Maybe that’s what scares me.
translation: 麦克森扈从的训练进度很好，这孩子在轻武器方面简直是个天才。但我经常担心他的情绪状况，他是在我的杀手们中生存的孩子，自己也在逐渐变成一个杀手。\n\n也许我在晚年变得太多疑、太脆弱了，但我希望给这孩子一个更正常的童年。讽刺的是，他的成长经历和我的太像了，也许就这样吓到了我。

original: CitadelTerminalLyons2
translation: CitadelTerminalLyons2

original: I mustn’t forget Sarah’s birthday this year. Perhaps I’ll send Cross to Rivet City to peruse the shops, and pick something up. Something pretty. Sarah may have forgotten she’s a woman, but I haven’t, and neither have the rest of the Brothers, judging by the looks they give her.
translation: 我一定不能忘了莎拉今年的生日。也许我会让克罗丝去铆钉城逛逛商店，买点东西。一些漂亮的东西。莎拉可能已经忘了自己是个女人，但我没有忘。从兄弟们看她的眼神来看，其他人也没忘。

original: CitadelTerminalSquire2
translation: CitadelTerminalSquire2

original: Yesterday, Sarah taught me how to kill a man by stabbing him in the kidneys. I think I’m in love.
translation: 昨天，莎拉教我如何捅人的腰子来杀人。我想我恋爱了。

original: CitadelTerminalSquire1
translation: CitadelTerminalSquire1

original: Stupid Scribe Rothchild and his stupid lab. All I wanted to do was talk to the robot and see if he’d be my friend. So what if he can’t walk.
translation: 愚蠢的学士罗斯查德和他那愚蠢的实验室。我想做的一切就是同机器人聊聊，来看看它能否成为我的朋友。所以假设分析它不能走路。

The explosives have been placed along Pennsylvania Ave as instructed. The electrical switch is located on the first level of the scaffolding on PA avenue. Merc. Thompson
Talon Company

佣兵汤普森
鹰爪公司

original: MaxsonDossier4
translation: 麦克森档案4

original:
Born -- 2267
Died -- 

Only son of Jonathan and Jessica (both deceased).

Last of the Maxson bloodline.

As an infant, sent to the Citadel to be fostered by Elder Owyn Lyons. The reason for this decision was two-fold:

1.) Recent internal conflict amongst the Western Brotherhood of Steel created an unsafe environment for the child. It was believed that the Citadel -- despite being located in hostile territory -- would increase his probability of survival.

2.) Elder Lyons, at that time, was in high favor with the Western Elders, and deemed a perfect candidate to provide care and training to the Squire. 

Recent events have led to a lack of communication with the Western Elders. As a result, Squire Maxson will remain at the Citadel indefinitely.
translation:
出生日期 -- 2267
死亡日期 -- 

乔纳森和杰西卡（二人均已过世）的独子。

麦克森家族最后的传人。

婴儿时期，被送到大本营由欧文·里昂斯长老抚养长大。做出这个决定的原因有两个：

1.)近段时间以来发生在西岸钢铁兄弟会的内部冲突，给孩子的成长环境带来了不安的因素。人们相信在大本营--尽管处在敌人的势力范围中--还是会大大增加他的生存几率的。

2.)里昂斯长老，在那个时候受到韦斯特长老的高度宠信，认为是照顾侍从并训练他的完美候选人。

最近的事情导致和韦斯特长老的联系变少。因此，麦克森扈从将长期呆在大本营。

original: DashwoodTerminalPeople1
translation: 达什伍德终端机人1

original:
Good Ole’ Craggy, King of Rockopolis. 

He offered Argyle and me shelter back in the summer of ’48. Unfortunately, there was a little incident with his daughter, and we were exiled. 

We sought shelter again a couple years later, but Craggy didn’t take too kindly to us luring the Slavers into his hidden underground city. 

That was the last time I ever saw Argyle -- right after he saved my hide for the hundredth time.
translation:
老伙计峭壁君，岩石城之王。

48年的夏天，他为阿盖尔和我提供了庇护。可惜的是，出了点和他女儿有关的插曲，我们就被流放了。

几年后，我们再次寻求庇护，然而峭壁君对我们把奴隶主引到他隐秘的地下城很不满。

那是我最后一次见到阿盖尔——就在他第一百次救我小命之后。

original: DashwoodTerminalPeople1
translation: 达什伍德终端机人2

original: Miss Penelope Chase -- Two-timing bitch. She got what she deserved.
translation: 佩内洛普·蔡斯小姐——水性杨花的贱人。她咎由自取。

original: DashwoodTerminalPeople1
translation: 达什伍德终端机人3

original:
My dearest Destiny. 

Harlot par excellence and the proprietor of the Blue Destiny Brothel. One of the loveliest women I’ve ever had the pleasure to pleasure.

Sadly, she died from cholera in the summer of '49 (an event that closed down the brothel forever).
translation:
我最亲爱的命运。

风月场的头牌，蓝命运妓院的主人。她是我有幸取悦过的最可爱的女人之一。

令人痛心的是，她在49年夏天死于霍乱（这场疫情导致妓院永久关闭）。

original: DashwoodTerminalPeople1
translation: 达什伍德终端机人1

original:
The best manservant a guy could ask for. 

Tough, loyal, and a hell of a good friend (even if he did smell like a bag of rotten meat, but what’s a Ghoul gonna do?). 

The last time I saw Argyle was in Rockopolis, decades ago. I know he's still out there... somewhere.
translation:
天底下最棒的男仆。

坚韧、忠诚，铁哥们中的铁哥们（虽然他闻起来像一袋腐肉，但尸鬼能有什么办法呢？）。

我最后一次见到阿盖尔是在几十年前的岩石城。我知道他还在某个地方……某个角落。

original: DashwoodTerminalPeople1
translation: 达什伍德终端机人5

original: Slaver leader and psychotic cannibal, circa 2250. See entry on Paradise Falls.
translation: 奴隶贩头目兼精神变态食人魔，活跃于约2250年。详见“天堂瀑”条目。

original: DashwoodTerminalPlaces
translation: 达什伍德终端机地点

original:
The most dangerous dump in the Capital Wasteland. 

The Slavers there would have bought and sold anything with a pulse. They still will, from what I hear. 

Back in my day, they were more disorganized, though. Their leader was a guy named Harmon Jurley, a psychotic son of a bitch who was rumored to eat the slaves he couldn’t sell.
translation:
首都废土最危险的垃圾场。

那帮奴隶贩子当年连喘气的活物都敢倒腾。听说他们现在还是这样。

不过在我那个时候，他们更像一盘散沙。当时的头目叫哈蒙·杰利，是个丧心病狂的杂种，传言他会吃掉卖不掉的奴隶。

original: DashwoodTerminalPlaces
translation: 达什伍德终端机地点

original:
An underground city. 

Not a bad a accomplishment, all things considered, but their leader, King Crag, became too isolationist for his own good.

Okay, so I accidentally led the Slavers there and those bastards cleaned the place out. It was an honest mistake.
translation:
一座地下城。

总体来说，还算不赖。但是他们的统治者，峭壁王，因过于孤立主义而反受其害。

好吧，我不小心把奴隶贩子带到了那里，这些混蛋居然把那里洗劫一空。但这真的是个无心之失。

original: DashwoodTerminalPlaces
translation: 达什伍德终端机地点

original: The best damn whorehouse in the Capital Wasteland. Strong booze and soft women. It shut down in the summer of ’49 when most of the ladies died from a cholera outbreak.
translation: 华盛顿废土最棒的妓院。满是玉酒美女.妓院在49年的夏天因为一场突发的霍乱导致大部分妓女丧命而关门大吉了。

original: DashwoodTerminalPlaces
translation: 达什伍德终端机地点

original:
A city of the dead. Or undead, as some would believe.

Underworld was, and is, a settlement of Ghouls, established in an old art exhibit in the Museum of American History.

Argyle and I used to go there quite a bit. I was even voted "Honorary Ghoul" back in '51. I really should go back and visit sometime.
translation:
一座亡者之城。抑或如某些人所坚信的——不死者之城。

冥界曾是、且至今仍是尸鬼的聚居地，建立于美利坚历史博物馆的旧艺术展厅内。

阿盖尔和我以前常去那儿。我甚至在51年当选过“荣誉尸鬼”。真该找时间回去看看。

original: DashwoodTerminalPlaces
translation: 达什伍德终端机地点

original:
A town built around an undetonated atomic bomb. My kind of place!

Megaton is pretty well fortified now, but back in my day it was even more ramshackle. Great place to grab a drink or a broad.

I hear Moriarty even has his own place now. Guess that shouldn't surprise me. That guy had been playing the angles since the day he ended up in this country, as a kid.
translation:
一个围绕着未引爆原子弹而建的小镇。很对我的胃口！

如今的兆吨镇防御森严，但在我那个年代，那儿就是摇摇欲坠的破烂堆。绝佳的喝烂酒、找乐子的去处。

我听说莫里亚蒂现在都有自己的地盘了。倒也不意外，毕竟这小子打小流落到这儿起，就精于钻营算计。

original: DashwoodTerminalPests
translation: 达什伍德终端机害虫

original: Goddamn walking crabs. \n\nTough to kill, but pretty delicious afterwards. The outer carapace is hell to penetrate, though. Good thing their face isn’t armored (and Argyle had such a good right jab).
translation: 天杀的陆行甲壳怪。\n\n难啃的硬茬子，但肉质倒是意外鲜美。就是那背甲硬得能弹开子弹。幸好面部没防护（而且阿盖尔的右勾拳相当了得）。

original: DashwoodTerminalPests
translation: 达什伍德终端机害虫

original:
Ghouls gone bad. Their brains had rotted through so much, they lost the ability to think straight.

Argyle and I fought these hapless zombie bastards more times than I can count. 

I think he actually liked killing them -- saw it as some sort of revenge against God for his own situation, or something.
translation:
彻底变质的尸鬼。他们的脑组织烂到连基本理智都维持不住。

我和阿盖尔跟这些不幸的丧尸混蛋交过的手不计其数。

我觉得他其实挺喜欢杀这些家伙的——大概是把这当作某种对上帝的报复，为了他自己的遭遇之类的。

original: DashwoodTerminalPests
translation: 达什伍德终端机害虫

original: I've been a lot of places in my day, and everywhere you'd find those damned Radscorpions.\n \nRumor was they'd descended from Emperor Scorpions, which you could find in pretty much any pet store in the country when bombs fell. I guess that explains their population.
translation: 我这辈子走过不少地方，到哪儿都能碰到那些天杀的辐射蝎。\n\n传闻说它们是帝王蝎后代。核弹砸下的那时候，这玩意儿可是全国宠物店都在卖。大概这就是它们泛滥成灾的原因吧。

original: DashwoodTerminalPests
translation: 达什伍德终端机害虫

original: Bears, or the Capital Wasteland's equivalent, anyway. \n\nYou're not going to find one of these babies balancing on a big rubber ball, though, I can tell you that much. They're are vicious as they come -- razor sharp claws, razor sharp teeth. Nasty, nasty temperament.
translation: 熊，或者首都废土的类似生物，随你怎么说。\n\n但别指望这些宝贝会踩着大皮球卖萌。它们的凶残突破天际——爪子赛刀片，獠牙如钢锯。脾气，更是坏到极点。

original: DashwoodTerminalPests
translation: 达什伍德终端机害虫

original:
I have to admit, I've always been fascinated by these things. 

Such an ingenious creation -- a robot powered by a brain, and a sexy dame's voice. Of course, I always had to wonder. Were they human brains? Were they actually the brains of sexy dames?? Or is it all monkey brains and recordings?

Anyway, I got hit by one of their mind blasts once. Hell of a headache for three days.
translation:
不得不承认，我向来痴迷于这些玩意。

如此天才的发明——用大脑驱动的机器人，还配着性感女郎的嗓音。当然，我总忍不住琢磨，那些是人脑吗？真装着性感女郎的脑子？？还是说全是猴脑加录音？

总之，我有次挨了它们的意念冲击波。头疼欲裂了整整三天。

original: LibertyPrimeTerminalNote2a
translation: LibertyPrimeTerminalNote2a

original:
Here are the results of the latest robot diagnostic:

Mobility -- 0%
Navigation Translation -- 0%
Internal Processors -- 46%
Weapons Systems -- 45%
Power Management -- 37%
Voice Module -- 100%

Scribe Rothchild is confident that by redistributing power from the Weapons and Mobility subsystems, we'll be able to bring Power Management up to at least 67% -- enough to successfully carry out a full activation sequence.
translation:
机器人诊断结果报告：

行动力--0%
导航系统--0%
内部处理器--46%
武器系统--45%
动力系统--37%
发声模块--100%

学士罗斯查德系统确认，如果重新分配武器和动力系统的能源，动力系统的状态将可以至少提升到67% -- 在此状态下将可以保证完全激活程序完成。

original: LibertyPrimeTerminalNote2b
translation: LibertyPrimeTerminalNote2b

original:
Scribe Rothchild has completed a new full diagnostic of the robot. Here are those results:

Mobility -- 0%
Navigation Translation -- 0%
Internal Processors -- 12%
Weapons Systems -- 13%
Power Management -- 1%
Voice Module -- 100%

It has been determined that the recent feedback spike, which resulted in overall system degradation, was in fact caused by the installation of the new power capacitor, as Scribe Rothchild suspected.

Until further notice, Scribes are ordered to cease any and all experiments that involve the re-routing of power from any of the robot's sub-systems.
translation:
学士罗斯查德系统对机器人重新检测完毕，结果如下：

M行动力 -- 0%
导航系统 -- 0%
内部处理器 -- 12%
武器系统 -- 13%
动力系统 -- 1%
发声模块 -- 100%

根据学士罗斯查德系统对反馈信息进行的判断，系统性能整体下降的原因是新的能源电容器的安装。

除非得到通知，否则学士罗斯查德系统将终止一切此机器人的子系统闭路充能工作。

original: LibertyPrimeTerminalNote3a
translation: LibertyPrimeTerminalNote3a

original:
Another day, another setback. 

We had tried, of course, re-routing power from Weapons to the robot's other sub-systems several times. Each attempt ended in failure, thanks to the robot's overly aggressive combat subroutines. It's almost as if there's some hidden pocket of AI that keeps pushing against us, refusing to let anyone drain power from the weapons systems.

I guess that shouldn't surprise me, considering why he was constructed in the first place.

That's why I began work on the Neural Dampener in the first place. I was convinced I could "trick" the robot into thinking I had actually re-distributed the power from some other sub-system. But the damned thing proved smarter than that. Certainly smarter than me. 

All I managed to do was fry some of his circuitry (again) and set us back another three months.
translation:
失败接二连三。

我们为把机器人的能量从武器系统上转移到别的子系统中，已经尝试了很多次，但这些尝试均以失败告终，这可能是因为由于机器人在设计时，AI内容中编译进了特殊的代码，阻止敌人从武器系统上抽取能量。

对此我早有预料，因为这个机器人就是为服务于战争而设计的。

我曾以为我可以“骗过”这台机器人，让它以为我在从别的系统中转移能量。但是这个倒霉玩意儿比我想象得要聪明很多，至少是要比我聪明很多。

我现在唯一能做的就是把它的线路焊回原样，从头来过。

original: LibertyPrimeTerminalNote3b
translation: LibertyPrimeTerminalNote3b

original:
I'm tired of trying to re-route power like some kind of snot-nosed Initiate.

I don't care what kind of drain it puts on the Scribes' ability to research and maintain the weapons and armor -- I'm proceeding with the AVF experiments.

If I can successfully create an Accelerated Vector Fusion module (similar to the technology I saw Doctor Li working with all those years ago), we'll have our first real chance of getting the robot fully operational. 

Maybe then the Western Elders will realize our worth.
translation:
我已经厌倦了像个流鼻涕新兵一样试图改线能量。

我不管它会对学士研究和维护武器/装甲的能力造成怎样的消耗——我正在进行AVF实验。

只要我成功制造出一个增速矢量聚变(AVF)装置（就像我前几年看到的李博士弄的那个东西），我们将有第一次真正的机会让机器人完全运行。

也许到那时西岸的长老将会对我们另眼相看。

original: LibertyPrimeTerminalNote3c
translation: LibertyPrimeTerminalNote3c

original:
Unfortunately, the Accelerated Vector Fusion (AVF) experiments haven't gone as planned. 

Bowditch suffered 2nd degree burns, and at one point we accidentally channeled so much power to the robot's head laser, it discharged and nearly killed Elder Lyons. 

He was not pleased.
translation:
不幸的是，加速矢量聚变装置（AVF）并未像我们预计的那样正常工作。

鲍蒂奇遭受了二级烧伤，有一次我们不小心给机器人的头部激光发射器充入了过多能量，导致的能量泄露差点让里昂斯长老因此丧命。

他对此十分不快。

original: LibertyPrimeTerminalNote1a
translation: LibertyPrimeTerminalNote1a

original:
General Chase,

I'm sorry, but you're being completely unrealistic. There is simply no way the robot will be combat ready in three months. 

The chassis is complete, all weapons systems are online, and the voice module has been programmed as requested. But power consumption is still our primary concern, and neither doctors Honeywell nor Park have yet found an acceptable solution.

We had hoped to sub-contract Vault-Tec, and utilize the talents of Doctor Braun. But apparently he's gone into seclusion, working on one of their own projects, and they couldn't reach him at this point if they wanted to. So that's out. 

I'll give it to you straight, General -- this is the biggest robot the world has ever seen, and we just haven't been able to find a power source small enough, and powerful enough, to get the damn thing running with all its systems online. 

In three months we might be able to guarantee the robot can walk into downtown Anchorage, but all of his weapons systems will be OFFLINE.

Maybe he can just step on the Red Chinese?

Doctor Stanley Bloomfeld
Project Lead
translation:
彻斯将军，

别介意，但你的想法完全不切实际。三个月时间根本不可能让机器人参战。

纵然底座完成了，武器系统已完善，同时声音模块也顺利通过了测试。但能量消耗仍是牵制全局的最大难关，目前为止，霍尼韦尔和帕克两位博士的方案都没能彻底解决这个问题。

我们正在和避难所科技交涉，希望借助布劳恩博士的智慧来改变现状。但事实是，他正参与着他们某个方案的开发而受到了信息封锁，他们的工作人员也没办法把我们的问题传达给他。所以那办法也行不通了。

恕我直言，将军阁下—这是世界上最巨型的机器人，而我们迄今都没能找到那种够小又够劲的动能来供给那个大家伙所有系统的运行所须。

三个月后我或许可以保证机器人能信步于安克雷奇市，不过是手无寸铁。

不知能否让他踩那些中国军队？

医生斯坦利·布鲁非欧
项目负责人

Project Goal: No less than the creation of the most powerful combat robot the battlefield has ever seen, with the express goal of liberating occupied Anchorage, Alaska from its Chinese aggressors.

General Constantine Chase

Thank you for your participation in the exciting Shocker Glove pilot program. You're receiving a prototype FSGv118-b model of the Shocker Glove. Please reference this prototype number in any future correspondence. We encourage you to make this prototype a part of your daily life, and look forward to your valuable feedback.

original: Rebel Dossier
translation: 反叛者档案

original: An alliance of rebels has formed in my Vault, dedicated to the wholly destructive goal of re-opening the Vault to the outside world. Amata and Edwin Brotch are the leaders of the band, with those ridiculous Tunnel Snakes making up its muscle, along with a handful of other youths and naive idealists.\n\nAttempts to isolate and demoralize the group are proceeding apace: Edwin Brotch has been jailed for his attempt to lead a direct attempt to open the Vault's door, and their members have holed up in the old clinic and schoolroom. Their dwindling food and proximity to the dangerous "Dr. Andy" are sure to drain the morale from their rebellion, until they give up and are welcomed back into our happy family again.
translation: 在我的避难所里一群反叛者联合起来了，他们狂热的目的就是想让避难所向外面的世界敞开大门。这群人的首领是阿玛塔和埃德温·布洛彻，主要成员就是那些可笑的所谓隧蛇帮以及一些年轻人和几个幼稚的理想主义者。\n\n孤立、打压他们的措施已经实行了：埃德温·布洛彻因为其直接领导了妄图打开避难所的大门的行动已经被关进了牢里，其他人也已经被控制在旧诊所和旧教室里。缺少食物和我们的“安迪医生”将会迅速瓦解他们的斗志，他们很快就会放弃这种反叛行为并且乐意回到我们大家庭中来的。

original: Amata Dossier
translation: 阿玛塔的档案

original:
It pains me dearly to know that Amata is behind the rebellious element in my Vault. If she weren't their leader, it would be a simple matter to break their spirits and bring them back in line with the Vault's time-proven isolation plan.

But with her as a central figure in their rebellion, I must refrain from the more persuasive tactics at security's disposal. I will not repeat the mistakes of that night again. The Vault cannot afford it, and I cannot bear to drive my daughter further away from me.

Despite everything, I take great pride in her natural talent for leadership. When she inevitably comes around, I feel she will make a worthy successor to the position of Overseer.
translation:
得知我避难所中这些反抗分子的首领竟然是阿玛塔，这让我很痛苦。如果不是她，我可以很容易的击碎这些家伙的意志，好让他们回到避难所的整体计划中来。

但有了阿玛塔作为这次反叛事件的中心人物，这让我无法采取那些我认为有效的方法来处理这事。我绝不能再犯上次那样的错误了，避难所将难以承受，我也绝对做不到让我的女儿像那样离我而去。

无论如何，我为她体现出来的领导天赋感到骄傲。当她走上台前的时候，我觉得她有资格成为一个继承监督者位子的人。

original: Contact Report: "Enclave"
translation: 接触报告：“英克雷”

original:
The Vault recently received unexpected radio contact over the governmental Vault-Tec frequency, from an organization calling itself "The Enclave."

Governmental codes are valid according to the Vault's ancient records, and The Enclave put forth an offer of amnesty and unity with the official remnants of the American government, in exchange for access to the Vault and its data stores. They claim that our Vault passwords no longer match their records, preventing them from extending their offer in person.

After brief negotiation, I have refused entrance to this "Enclave." I cannot trust my Vault and its inhabitants to an unknown factor, much less one that would so gallantly suggest abandoning our vault's great mission. 

All the more reason to prevent the rebels from opening the Vault to the likes of them.
translation:
最近，避难所地通过政府的避难所科技频率，意外收到了一个自称“英克雷”的组织的无线电联络。

根据避难所的古老记录，政府代码是有效的。英克雷提出了大赦和团结美国政府的官方残余，以换取避难所及其数据存储的使用权。他们声称，我们的避难所密码与他们的记录不符，因此他们无法当面提出。

经过简短的谈判，我拒绝进入这个“飞地”。我不能把我避难所和它的居民托付给一个未知因素，更不用说一个如此大胆地建议放弃我们避难所伟大使命的组织了。

那就更有理由阻止反叛者向他们这样的人开放避难所了。

original: Raid Plans
translation: 突袭计划

original:
CONFIDENTIAL! 
TOP-LEVEL SECURITY ONLY!

From: Chief Officer
Subject: Raid on Rebels

In light of increased agitation from the rebel elements, I have come to the conclusion that we can no longer afford to be merciful to this scum. While some may hold out hope for a peaceful resolution, it's only a matter of time before they decide to take the fight to us. Or, worse yet, our families.

I propose a midnight raid into their compound - live ammo, zero tolerance. Make an example of the first two who fight back, and the rest will fall in line. We may lose a kid or two, but we'll save the Vault as a whole, and that's what counts.

You are not to inform the Overseer and some of our softer security guards about this plan, as they will only object and ensure our defeat. Once the deal's done, they'll see it was worth the price.

This'll show those scum what happens when you step out of line in our Vault.
translation:
机密！
仅限高层安全人员！

发件人：首席官员
主题：突袭反叛者

鉴于反叛分子的嚣张气焰愈演愈烈，我得出结论，我们不能再对这些人渣心慈手软了。虽然有些人可能会对和平解决抱有希望，但他们决定向我们开战只是时间问题。或者，更糟，向我们的家人动手。

我提议午夜时分突袭他们的营地——实弹，零容忍。杀鸡儆猴，给最先还击的两个人点颜色瞧瞧，其他人就会乖乖听话。我们可能会损失一两个孩子，但我们能拯救整个避难所，这才是最重要的。

你们不得向监督者和某些心软的安保警卫透露此计划，他们只会反对并确保我们的失败。等事情都结束了，他们会发现这是值得的。

这会让那些人渣知道，在我们的避难所里越轨的下场。

original: I've finally found a quiet place for my family. We've been running from one settlement to the next, just trying to keep out of sight. Now that I'm on the other coast, I feel much safer.\n\nThe family across the way from us seems pretty decent. Their kid, Bryan, likes to play with my son, which is great. It's hard for Will to make friends because we haven't stayed in one place long enough. Maybe we can finally put down some roots here in Grayditch.
translation: 我终于为家人找到了一处宁静的处所。我们从一个定居点跑到另一个定居点，只是想避开别人的视线。现在我在另一侧海岸，我觉得安全多了。\n\n街对面那户人家看起来十分容易相处。他们家的孩子布赖恩喜欢和我儿子一起玩，真是太好了。由于长期频繁地搬家，想交个朋友真是很困难，也许这次我们真的可以在灰渠扎根安顿了。

original: MS04WBrandice10302276Note
translation: MS04WBrandice10302276Note

original: I was scavenging some of the nearby buildings for junk to sell and came across a working radio. No sooner did I turn it on than I heard the familiar patriotic anthems they used to play whenever Richardson would give a speech. But this was different. Who the hell is President Eden? When did that happen? Are they on this coast too? Most importantly, will they come looking for me?\n\nI hope this journey wasn't a huge mistake.
translation: 我当时在清理附近楼房的垃圾拿去卖，偶然间发现一个还能用的收音机。一打开我就听见那无时无刻不在播放的爱国圣歌，每次理查森要发表演说的时候都会播这些歌曲。不过这次有点不一样，谁是伊登总统啊？什么时候选的啊？他们也住在这个海岸吗？更重要的是，他们是不是在找我？\n\n我希望这次搬到这里不要铸成大错啊。

original: "Chinese Invasion" Program Documentation
translation: “中国入侵”程序文档

original:
Dr. Braun,

Here is the revised code for the military training program you've expressed interest in. I'm not sure exactly what you want with it, and I again stress that this program was never designed to be run with civilian equipment. 

Frankly, I don't expect any system you have access to can even run it. 

But if you can run this program with the failsafes off, as requested... your real-world test subjects WILL die if killed in the simulation.

It goes without saying that, officially, I denied your request.

General Constantine Chase 

-----

US MILITARY TRAINING PROGRAM 923-B: CHINESE INVASION

Purpose: Simulate a Communist Incursion on US Soil

DOCUMENTATION CULLED: NEW PROTOCOLS ENACTED

- DISABLE SAFETY PROTOCOLS 1-6
- OVERRIDE TARGET ACQUISITION

WARNING: TEST SUBJECTS WILL EXPERIENCE REAL-WORLD TERMINATION. PROCEED WITH EXTREME CAUTION!
translation:
布劳恩博士，

这是你感兴趣的军事训练程序的修订代码。我不太清楚你要拿它做什么，我再次强调，该程序从来就不是为了让民用设备运行而设计的。

坦白的说，我认为你有权使用的任何系统都无法运行它。

但要是你如请求的那般，在关闭故障保险的情况下运行此程序……你在现实世界的实验对象，如果在模拟中被杀死，就会死亡。

不用说，我正式拒绝了你的请求。

康斯坦丁·蔡斯将军 

-----

美国军事训练程序923-B：中国入侵

目的：模拟共产主义入侵合众国本土

文档整理：实施新协议

- 禁用安全协议1-6
- 超驰目标获取

警告：测试对象将面临现实世界的终结。请极其谨慎地操作！
