original: Search Party Log #2
translation: 搜索小队日志#2

original: Bad news. Rangers haven't seen Cheryl and got troubles of their own. Muties been snatching people left and right. Reilly’s men are going to keep an eye out round here. They suggested we head to the western ruins, across the river and search there, so I guess that’s what we’ll do. Damn it, sis, why didn't you just wait for us?
translation: 坏消息。游骑兵们还没见到谢丽尔，而且现在他们自己也有麻烦了。变种人在到处抓人。莱莉的手下也要监视着附近的情况。他们建议我们前往西部的废墟，过河之后搜索那里的区域，我看我们下一步也只能这样了。该死啊，小妹，为什么你就不等等我们呢？

original: Search Party Log #3
translation: 搜索小队日志#3

original:
Has to be a month gone since we was at Citadel. Tracking mutants in the city is no easy job. Helps to have mentats to keep everyone focused, but we still have to be careful. These green bastards seem like they're on the move. You never hear em talk about it, but they're looking for something. And people. Anyone they can get their hands on.

Tracking Muties through the city isn't the hard part. They're good with metal, always ripping up junkers and building crap out of the bits. Just follow their freak sculpture shows. Hard part is staying hidden. Emmet took a bad cut on the leg from one of the spikes., took two shirts to stop the bleeding. I hope these freaks can’t smell blood. We’re headed towards the Citadel, maybe they’ll help us patch him up.

Relief to be outside of the city for a day. We’ll use the bridge and cross over to check beyond the ruins on the west side. We can’t hold out down here much longer. I can’t just give up on Cheryl, but I might not end up having a choice. Emmet’s in bad shape. We'll wait to cross the bridge until tomorrow.
 
RIP, Emmet. Poor kid left Canterbury so fresh I didn’t want him along, but he really came into his own these past few weeks. He died in the night. No point bothering with those pricks at the Citadel now. We head into the city tomorrow.
translation:
我们离开大本营已经一个月了。在城市里跟着变种人可不是简单的事情。在曼塔特的作用下每个人还很清醒，但我们依然要小心。这些绿皮混蛋们一直在前进着。始终没听到过他们说话，但是他们在找一些东西。以及活人。任何他们能抓到的人。

跟着变种人穿过城市并不是最难的。他们很善于使用金属的东西，总喜欢撕扯开一些废品然后在周围盖起一些破玩意。跟着这些怪胎们的杰作走就行。最难的是保持隐蔽而不被发现，艾米特的大腿被钉子切开了一个大口子，用尽了两件衬衣的布料才止住了血。但愿那些怪胎们闻不到血腥味。我们正向着大本营前进着，或许他们能帮忙缝上艾米特的伤口。

在城市外面待一天是一种解脱。沿着桥过河之后我们会穿越西边的废墟。我们在这里坚持不了多久。我不能就这么放弃了谢丽尔，但是我真的没有其他办法了。艾米特的情况现在很糟。等到明天我们就过桥。
 
安息吧，艾米特。可怜的孩子还是这么的稚嫩，就已经离开了坎特伯雷，我本来不想让他跟着我们，但这几个星期来他真自己坚持了下来。晚上的时候他死了。现在再去找大本营的那帮混蛋们也没什么用了。明天我们就进入城市。

original: Search Party Log #4
translation: 搜索小队日志#4

original:
Found something. Muties have a bunch of folks trussed up in a park nearby. Going to hole up and see what happens. Too risky to check for Cheryl until we know more.

Kaya crept down and checked tonight. Cheryl's not there and most of the people are dead, or close to it. Still, going to keep an eye on them from here a little longer.

Bastards are cleverer than they look. They stake people up, attracts attention. Saw a couple mercs get snatched investigating. One didn't put up much fight, they took him alive. May be hope to find Cheryl yet.

Stakes aren't just to attract people. Big 'ol mother came by today, yanked a stiff from one of those spikes and gnawed every scrap of meat off the bones. Looks like they were waiting for the biggun to pack up. They're on the move. I’ve got a feeling they'll take these folks the same place they must have taken sis.

Close call today, damn fool brotherhood scout nearly exposed us. Muties got him. Poor kid never had a chance. Finally clear of the city. Kaya refused to go any further, left for Canterbury. The mutants are headed west, and I still aim to find where they’re taking these people. Going to be harder to stay concealed out there in the open, but at least I don't have to worry about ghouls crawling up my ass all night.
translation:
有发现。在附近一个公园里，变种人将一群人捆在了一起。躲藏起来，看看会发生什么。在我们了解更多情况之前，查看谢丽尔的情况太冒险了。

今晚，卡娅爬了过去打探了一下。谢丽尔不在那里，大部分人都死了，有的奄奄一息。我们又继续在这里对那些变种人监视了一段时间。

那群混蛋比他们看起来的要聪明。他们把人捆在木桩上，作为诱饵。两个雇佣兵打算上前查看一下，就被抓了起来。一个人没怎么反抗，那群混蛋们没杀他。看样子还有希望找到谢丽尔。

捆人的木桩不只是用来做诱饵的。今天来了个大家伙，从钉子上拔下了一具死尸，吃光了骨头上的每一块肉。看上去他们正等着老大来收拾行装。他们出发了。我有预感，他们带着这些人要去的地方，小妹也会被带到那里。

今天真是惊险万分，一个该死的兄弟会侦查兵差点暴露了我们。变种人抓住了他。那可怜的孩子很倒霉。终于整个城市都搜查遍了。卡娅拒绝再往前走了，她返回了坎特伯雷。变种人们正在西行，我的目标还是要找出他们想把那些人带到哪里。在野外想保持隐蔽更难，但至少整晚我都不用担心会有尸鬼爆掉我的后庭了。

original: Wasteland Merchant Note
translation: 废土商人的笔记

original:
Trading Caravan Log

By tomorrow I should reach the green mountain. The people there may be weirdos, but hey, they trade great stuff for the weapons and ammunition, so who am I to complain? 

Last time I was there, they told me that someone named the Great One wanted to speak to me, and that I should drink some of their homemade hooch and join them in some kind of ceremony. I'll probably take them up on it this time -- I haven't had a good drink in a while and I'm a day ahead of schedule.
translation:
商队贸易日记

明天，我应该就能抵达那座青山。那儿的人可能有些古怪，但嘿，他们会用很棒的东西来交易武器和弹药，我又有什么好抱怨的呢？

上次我去那儿的时候，他们跟我说有个叫“圣贤”的人想和我谈谈，还说我应该喝点他们自制的烈酒，然后和他们一起参加某种仪式。这次我很可能会答应他们——我已经有一阵子没痛痛快快喝上一场了，而且我的行程比计划提前了一天。

original: Checking Out
translation: 都结束了

original:
If you're reading this, I'm dead.

I was running low on water, so I figured I'd go out and get some instead of waiting for fate to deliver it to me. Hell, I can't remember the last time it rained.

Looks like my plan backfired. I got slashed in the arm by some goddamn psychopath, barely escaped a Super Mutant, and then got shot in the hip by a crazy old woman.

I haven't been able to feel my legs for a full day, so there's not much I can do but sit here and write.

Here's hoping you have better luck out here than me.
translation:
你读到了这个字条时说明我已经死了。

我的水快没有了，我看我应该去外面找些水了，而不是在这干等着有人能给我水来了。见鬼，我都不知道上次下雨是什么时候的事了。

我的计划失败了。我的胳膊被一些狗娘养的疯子们砍伤了，勉强的从一个超级变种人的手里逃了出来，又被一个疯癫的老娘们开枪射中了屁股。

一整天我的腿都失去了知觉，我只能坐着等死了。

祝你在外面的时候能比我幸运点。

original: Left Behind
translation: 被落下了

original:
The others left me! They fucking left me behind!

Okay, I can understand them getting angry because I wandered off. But I thought I saw someone trailing us, so I went to check it out.

Turns out I was wrong. But I was only gone for like ten minutes! They didn't have to leave me behind. I have no idea where they went, but I guess I'd better get off my ass and try to catch up.
translation:
其他的人丢下了我！他妈的他们就这样丢下了我！

好吧，我能理解他们生气是因为我迷了路。但我是看见了有人跟在了后面，所以我就去查看了一下。

后来没发现什么，可能是我看错了。可我就离开了几分钟而已！他们没必要丢下我啊！我也不知道他们去哪了，但眼下最好赶快抬起屁股动身，看看能不能追上他们。

original: Loving Life!
translation: 钟爱的生活！

original:
I'm so glad I did this. 

I've been telling Joshua for years that if you really want to live, you've got to get out there and LIVE! Wander, explore, interact with this crazy Capital Wasteland. 

I've met so many great people, done so many amazing things. I can't wait to get home and tell Joshua all about it. I may even combine my journals into a book!
translation:
我非常的高兴，因为我做到了。

我几年前就跟约书亚说过，如果你追求真正的生活，那你就要走出去，生存下去！漫步，探索，走进这个疯狂的首都废土。

我曾经见过很多伟大的人，也做过许许多多不可思议的事情。我已经等不及的要回家了，我要把这一切讲给约书亚听。我甚至还把我的日记整理成了一本书！

original: Almost Home...
translation: 快到家了……

original: It seems like I've been out here scavving forever. I'm ready to head home soon, though. I've got just enough to keep Paulina, Kress and me going for another week.
translation: 我好像一直在外面捡破烂。不过呢，我马上就要回家了。我拥有的，足够宝利娜、凯瑞斯还有我再坚持一个星期。

original: Fuck This
translation: 操！

original:
Fine. If the world doesn't care about me, I'm not going to care about the world.

I just took 23 hits of Psycho. Let the Wasteland gobble me up.

If you're reading this, feel free to take any of my shit that gets left behind.
translation:
很好。如果这个世界抛弃了我，那么我也要抛弃这个世界了。

我刚才打了23针疯狂药。让这废土吞噬我吧。

如果你读到了这个， 我留下来的那些破玩意随你挑，爱拿什么就拿什么。

original: Dearest Grace...
translation: 最亲爱的格雷丝……

original:
Hello, my sweet sister. 

I know it's been a long time since I've written, and for that I sincerely apologize. 

It's been three years since I left home to make my mark on the world. I've been places, Grace. I've seen things your eyes could scarcely imagine. 

But my odyssey is now complete. I'm ready to return home, and will begin the journey in just a few days. 

Here's hoping we can pick up right where we left off. You're the only person I have left in this world, Grace. I love you, and I want us to be a family again.
translation:
你好，我亲爱的妹妹。

我知道已经很久没给你写信了，为此我真诚的表示歉意。

为了出人头地，我离开了家，已经整整三年了。格雷丝，我去过很多地方。也见到过许多你从没见过的事情。

但我漫长而惊险的旅程结束了。已经做好了回家的准备，几天后就出发。

希望我们能重拾旧好。格雷丝，你是我这世上唯一的亲人。我爱你，我也希望我们能重新成为一家人。

original: Dead End
translation: 死胡同

original:
It's been a week, and I still haven't picked up Marko's trail.

Sitting here now, alone, I can be completely honest. With myself and anyone who might read this. I've never felt like such a failure in my life.

To let a man enter your home, and then watch helplessly as he murders your family in cold blood, is more than any person should have to bear. 

Now I can't even find the son-of-a-bitch to give him what he has coming. He kills my children in front of my eyes, and he gets to just walk away? No punishment, no justice? How is that fair?

I'd kill myself, but I'm sure I'd just screw that up too. I just wish I knew what to do. I just wish God, or someone, would give me some kind of sign.
translation:
已经一个星期了，我依然没有发现马可的踪迹。

此刻，我坐在这里，就我一个人，我可以做到绝对的坦诚。对给我自己和能读到这字条的人。我这一生中从没有感受过这样的失败。

让一个人进入了你的家，他冷血的杀害了你的家人，你却只能无能为力的看着。这远远超出了一般人的承受能力。

现在，我甚至都找不到这婊子养的，不能给他应得的惩罚。他就在我眼前杀死了我的孩子，然后就走掉了？没有惩罚吗？没有正义吗？这一切公平吗？

我曾经想过自杀，我只知道，这一切被我搞砸了。我只是希望自己知道该做什么。只希望神，或者其他人，能给我一些指引。

original: Vault 112 Resident Stress Level
translation: 112号避难所居民压力水平

original:
I've finally come to the realization that the Toucan Lagoon simulation has run its course.
 
I'm tired of the beating sun and ceaseless pounding of the lagoon's waves upon the shore. I no longer take pleasure in watching Simpson wither away from scurvy, or hearing Neusbaum's screams as he's devoured by the mako shark.

I am, quite simply, bored. It is time to reset the simulation once again. 

I haven't been skiing in ages.
translation:
我终于意识到，“巨嘴鸟潟湖”模拟已经走到了尽头。
 
我厌倦了炙人的太阳和潟湖浪无休止地拍击海岸。我不在乐于看着辛普森因坏血病而憔悴，或是听着纽斯保被灰鲭鲨吞噬时的尖叫。

简而言之，我厌倦了。是时候再次重置模拟了。

我好长时间没滑雪了。

original: Vault 112 Resident Stress Level
translation: 112号避难所居民压力水平

original:
Yesterday, Dithers slipped on the chalet's icy stairs, went airborne, and managed to impale herself on the the wrought-iron fence. It was spectacular! And completely and utterly random! 

Is there anything more sublime than that bold crimson on fresh-fallen snow?

It was almost enough to make me reconsider a change of scenery. But not quite. 23 years is a long enough vacation in the Swiss Alps. 

I long for something more... domestic.
translation:
昨天，迪瑟在小木屋结冰的楼梯上滑倒，飞了出去，成功地把自己扎在了锻铁围栏上。那场面真是惊心动魄！而且完全出乎意料！

还有什么比新落白雪上的那抹殷红更壮丽？

这几乎足以让我重新考虑换个场景了。但也不尽然。在瑞士阿尔卑斯山度假23年已经够长了。

我渴望更加……家常的感觉。

original: Vault 112 Resident Stress Level
translation: 112号避难所居民压力水平

original:
I have surprised myself. I find Tranquility Lane... comforting. Although distinctly American, it somehow reminds me of Kronach, the town of my childhood.

There’s a beautiful irony with this particular simulation as well. The residents here are naturally at home, naturally safe. When I toy with them, when their suburban illusion is suddenly broken, it’s that much more satisfying. 

I do believe we shall all remain here in Tranquility Lane for a very long time. A very long time, indeed.
translation:
我自己都感到惊讶。我发现宁静巷……令人欣慰。尽管是典型的美式，但不知怎地，它让我想起了克罗纳赫，我童年时代居住的小镇。

这特定的模拟也是一种美丽的讽刺。这里的居民自然而然地感到自在，自然而然地安全。当我玩弄他们时，当他们的郊区幻像突然被打破时，那种满足感更加强烈。

我相信我们都会在宁静巷待很长一段时间。的确，很长时间了。

original: Vault 112 Resident Stress Level
translation: 112号避难所居民压力水平

original:
There are days I consider finally "pulling the plug," as it were, and putting a permanent end to both this simulation, and my life. 

That is the reason I requested installation of General Chase's Chinese invasion program, after all. By disabling the safety protocols, I have ensured that each subject in Vault 112 will physically die if their in-simulation avatars are killed. 

Real-world death. End of simulation. The perfect Failsafe.

At least it would have been, if not for my own misjudgment. I knew, when the simulation first went online, that the secondary safeties – those established for all Vault-Tec and military personnel – would prevent my own real-world demise in the event of a Failsafe execution. In the end, I would kill the subjects, and save myself. 

I wouldn’t want it any other way. Or so I thought.

It’s true the Failsafe would scare the living hell out of every resident in Tranquility Lane, and lead to their brutal deaths. But then – what about me? 

I have no ability to disable my own safety from within the simulation. And any other avatars I could create would be driven by the simulation’s A.I. routines – not actual living, thinking, human subjects. 

Where’s the fun in tormenting a machine?

And so, the release of the real-world subjects is more than they deserve, more that I could bear. They'd be dead, and I'd be left here in Tranquility Lane, alone and tragically bored for all eternity.

I can think of nothing more unacceptable.
translation:
有好几天，我真想干脆“拔掉插头”，一了百了，既结束这场模拟，也终结我的生命。

毕竟，这就是我请求安装蔡斯将军的中国入侵程序的原因。通过禁用安全协议，我确保了112号避难所里的每个人，如果他们在模拟中的化身被杀，那么在现实中也会死亡。

现实世界的死亡，模拟终结，完美的故障保险。

如果不是因为我自己的误判，这本来会是这样的。模拟初上线时我就知道，那些为所有避难所科技和军事人员设立的二级安全机制，会在故障保险启动时阻止我自己在现实世界中死亡。最终，我会杀死那些受试者，而我自己则能幸免。

我不希望有其他任何结果。或者，我曾是这样想的。

确实，故障保险会让宁静巷里的每个居民都吓得魂飞魄散，并导致他们惨死。但是——那我呢？

在模拟中，我无法解除自己的安全机制。而我能创造出的任何其他化身，全由模拟的AI驱动——不是真正活着、有思想的人类受试者。

折磨一台机器有什么乐趣呢？

因此，让这些现实世界中的受试者解脱，超出了他们应得的，也是我无法承受的。他们会死去，而我则会永远留在宁静巷，孤独而悲惨地无聊至死。

我想没有比这更让人无法接受的了。

original: LDJuryBossNote01b
translation: LDJuryBossNote01b

original: Attempt #172\n - Quite close now. I'm fairly certain the key ingredient is some form of ThermoStarch. My next attempt will be using Wonder Glue, the adhesive component contains a great deal of the stuff. Luckily we have a small store of the stuff available here, and I'm offering a handful of caps to the raiders for every bottle they can bring me. Those greasy villains are handy when you've got the money.
translation: 尝试 #172\n    - 非常接近了。我几乎能确定关键成分是某种形式的热淀粉。我的下一次尝试将使用万能胶，其中的粘合剂成分含有大量这种物质。幸运的是，我们这里有一个小仓库，里面有这些东西，掠夺者每给我带一瓶，我就给他们一把瓶盖。只要你有钱，那些油腻腻的坏蛋就会派上用场。

original: LDJuryBossNote01c
translation: LDJuryBossNote01c

original: Attempt #171\n - I've noticed positive reactions with base dextrin substances. I'll continue testing different forms to see where it leads me. If there was ever a time for a breakthrough it would be right now. Masquerading as one of these foul murderers grows tiring, once the theatrics of it wear off. One thing is true, though - we can all be rich if the experiment succeeds. Molerat is one of the easiest meats to get hold of, yet the most disgusting. If I can turn it into a viable food source...
translation: 尝试 #171\n  - 我注意到基础糊精物质会产生积极的反应。我将继续测试不同的形式，看看它能给我带来什么。如果有一突破的时刻，那就是现在了。伪装成这些肮脏的杀人犯，一旦戏剧性消失，就会变得很累。但有一件事是真的，如果实验成功，我们都能发财。鼹鼠是最容易弄到的肉类之一，但也是最恶心的。如果我能把它变成可行的食物来源……

original: LDJuryBossNote01OlderB
translation: LDJuryBossNote01OlderB

original: Attempt #86\n -I introduced a small component of isoprene, didn't seem to make a difference in taste or composition. I'm not hopeful, but in the next round I'll increase the concentration, if only because the damn stuff is so plentiful.
translation: 尝试 #86\n - 我掺入了少量异戊二烯，但无论对口味还是口感似乎都没有改善。我虽没抱太大希望，但我会在下一次的试验中加大使用计量，仅仅是因为这该死的东西太丰富了。

original: Takoma Park Artillery Note
translation: 塔科马公园 炮兵队记录

original:
Artillery Order #447
Talon Company Support Team Bravo
Location: Takoma Park

Establish position near the parking lot west of the factory and monitor enemy movement. Three squads will be dispatched once you are in position. Their objective is re-take our old positions in Takoma Park. Your directive is to provide artillery support when they arrive. The coordinates have been encoded on the switch provided. Call in the strikes once alpha squad established a base of fire outside of the blast range.
translation:
炮兵队命令 #447
鹰爪公司 Bravo支援组
位置：塔科马公园

在工厂西面的停车场附近建立阵地，监视敌人动向。你们就位后，将派出三个小队。他们的目标是重新夺回我们在塔科马公园的旧阵地。你的任务是当他们到达的时候提供炮火支援，坐标已经在编码在提供的交换机上。alpha小队在轰炸范围外建立火力据点后，立即呼叫攻击。

original: Tech Museum Loot
translation: 科技博物馆战利品

original:
Hey there Jiggs,

I finally found a good place to ditch your share of the loot. It was hell getting here, but I made it. I left the usual breadcrumbs all over some of the info terminals in this place; their computer security was a joke. Complete the sequence and you're home free, but make any mistakes and the system will lock you out. We'll meet up in the usual spot later.

Good luck,
Prime
translation:
嗨，吉格斯，

我终于找了个好地方来存放你的战利品。找到这里如同进了地狱，但是我成功了。我也在此地放置了些有关的线索。他们的电脑安全系统真是好笑，完成所有程序你就可以畅通无阻。但如果犯下任何错误，系统会自动锁死。我们等会在老地方见。

祝你好运，
普莱姆（注：意为“质数”）

original: Earned Your Share
translation: 你所应得的

original:
Nice job, Jiggs!

I knew you'd remember the good old days! The loot is in the Security Office Safe in the upper part of the West Wing. Use the terminal up there to get in. Enjoy your share, pal... you earned it! Meet me in the old diner outside the Jury Street Metro Station. See you there.

Good luck,
Prime
translation:
干得好，吉格斯！

我知道你还记得过去的美好日子！战利品就在西翼上层的安全办公室保险柜里。使用终端来开启，享受你所应得的吧，伙计……你应得的。和我在陪审团大街地铁站那个老式餐厅见面，再见。

祝你好运，
普莱姆（注：意为“质数”）

original: Springvale Raider Mining Log
translation: 春之谷掠夺者挖掘日志

original: Some of the scabs got tired of digging the tunnel and started using mines to get into the caves. Not a half bad idea, the explosions damn near knocked the building apart. We got a new window or two on the side of the building. haha. I'm going to have some of the boys knock over a caravan for more explosives, but we'll have to use fewer in the blasts, or some assholes from Megaton will come looking.
translation: 一些家伙挖腻了地道，开始在洞穴里使用地雷。这主意还不赖，爆炸差点把这楼炸得四分五裂。现在我们在建筑侧面多了几扇窗户，哈哈。我打算让几个小子袭击商队以搞到更多炸药，但我们在爆破中得少用些量，否则兆吨镇的那帮屁眼儿们会找过来的。

original: Springvale Raider Mining Log
translation: 春之谷掠夺者挖掘日志

original: Boppo died like a bitch. He didn't have half a bad idea, setting up here. We had a good thing going, picking off caravans and traders on their way into Megaton. He was stupid to try and raid the town. Dumbass deserved the bullet Simms put in his head. \n\nAnyway, there's sweeter water to be had here. That damn Vault's what we should be trying to get into, not that rag-ass town. If we can get in there, ain't none of us going to want again for the rest of our lives.
translation: 波普死得像个婊子。他在这里驻扎的想法其实并不坏。我们本来干得好好的，在商队和商人前往兆吨镇的路上就把他们干掉。可他真蠢，居然发昏想掠夺镇子。白痴活该被西姆斯一枪爆头。\n\n无论如何，这地方还有甜头，我们应该试着进入那个该死的避难所，而不是那个狗屁的城镇。一旦我们能进到那里面，我们下半辈子就不用愁了。

original: MQ02SecurityBu01Note
translation: MQ02SecurityBu01Note

original:
Attention: All Museum Security Personnel

The International Ordnance Museum has graciously loaned us some of their prized antique weapons for the Firearms Exhibition being displayed in the Atrium. The exhibit will be in place from August 14, 2077 until December 31, 2077. Please adjust your rounds accordingly and have an extra security presence in this area at all times.

Donald Cohen
Lead Museum Curator
translation:
通知:致博物馆全体安保人员

国际军事博物馆近期租借给我们一批旧式武器，用以供前厅的轻兵器展览。展出日期将从2077年8月14日至2077年12月31日。请各单位相应调整巡逻路线和时间来加强展区的安全保卫力度。

博物馆馆长  唐纳德·科恩

original: Museum Gun Locker
translation: 博物馆枪支保管处

original:
Attention: All Museum Security Personnel

I'd like to request that all riot gear and security firearms be moved to the new gun locker in the planetarium research office. The cabinet should remain locked at all times. HUBRIS COMICS AND VAULT-TEC INCORPORATED UNVEIL "VAULT BOY MEETS HELL'S CHAIN GANG" LIMITED FIVE-PART MINISERIES

The five-part miniseries will feature an alternate future in which Chinese Communists have invaded America. Vault Boy and Hell's Chain Gang are the last, best hope for America to break free from the shackles of Communism in this cautionary tale of vigilance.

"It has always been Vault-Tec's mission to educate and protect our Countrymen from the Communist threat", commented Vault-Tec Public Relations Executive Joanne Strausser, "This exciting project is a perfect opportunity to thrill young Americans while sending home an important message for us all: Every good American must help shoulder the burden of freedom, and always be wary of the Communist Threat".

original: redRacerSurgeonsDiary01
translation: redRacerSurgeonsDiary01

original: Diary Entry 64D-A3: Mutant Chips\n\nI have had to alter the chips for the mutants to account for their greater size. Fortunately, they exhibit a higher intellect than the ghouls and can be controlled to an even greater extent. The enthralled mutants have mentioned legends of even larger mutants, almost twice as big as the ones I’ve captured. If only I could get my hands on one of those… the experiments… the fun.
translation: 日记条目64D-A3：变种人芯片\n\n我不得不修改变种人的芯片来适应他们更大的体型。幸运的是，与尸鬼相比，他们表现出更高的智力，并且可以在更大程度上进行控制。这些受控制的变种人曾提到过更大变种人的传说，据说其个头是我抓到的这些的两倍。要是我能抓到其中的一个……实验……有趣了。

original: redRacerSurgeonsDiary02
translation: redRacerSurgeonsDiary02

original: Diary Entry 2R-A0: The first ghoul chips\n\nSome of my earlier chip prototypes(C6-A and C6-L) have started to malfunction causing the chips to overheat and eventually detonate the implanted charge. In retaliation I have upgraded the P7 series and above to counter the malfunction. I have also altered the Y2 series in the mutants as a precaution. Ghouls are easily replaceable, mutants are not.
translation: 日记条目2R-A0：第一批尸鬼芯片\n\n我早期的一些芯片原型（C6-A和C6-L）开始出现故障，导致芯片过热，并最终引爆植入的炸药。作为反击，我升级了P7系列及更高版本以应对这种故障。同时，我也出于预防措施，修改了变种人体中的Y2系列。尸鬼很容易替换，变种人则不然。

original: redRacerSurgeonsDiary03
translation: redRacerSurgeonsDiary03

original: Diary Entry 07-C: Stefan\n\nMy masterpiece! Stefan is now under my control! The latest chip I installed in him seems to have taken and he is now mine. The effort to capture one of these glowing ghouls was immense but finally I can take solace in the fact that I have one under my control. His limited intellect means I will have to keep him downstairs with the rest of the ghouls but I pity any rabble that pokes their head in here now.
translation: 日记条目07-C：斯特凡\n\n我的杰作！斯特凡现在在我的掌控之下了！我给他安装的最新芯片看起来起作用了，现在他是我的了。虽然抓一个活生生的发光尸鬼所要花费的代价是巨大的，但毕竟我已经成功掌控了一个尸鬼，这给了我足够的安慰。可惜他有限的智商意味着我只能将把他扔到下面，和其他的尸鬼一块，现在我对外面那些对这地方探头探脑的乌合之众感到遗憾。

original: redRacerSurgeonsDiaryChips
translation: redRacerSurgeonsDiaryChips

original: Diary Entry L-2\n\nI have used materials from the small explosives cache I found to further safeguard myself from my experiments. I have wired the building to broadcast a signal from this terminal that in emergency will detonate all chips. I pray that day never comes.
translation: 日记条目 L-2\n\n我已经利用我从小型炸药库中找到的材料，来进一步保障自己免受实验的伤害。我已经在大楼里布了线，以便在紧急情况下通过该终端发出信号引爆所有芯片。我祈祷那一天永远不会到来。

original: Field Entry: "Bloatfly"
translation: 实地记录: "辐射蝇"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Arthropoda
Class: Insecta
Order: Diptera
Family: Tabanidae
Genus: Tabanus Linnaeus

Field observation suggests that the Bloatfly is a mutation of the Tabanus horse fly with provocative advances. These evolutionary forebears possessed neither the significant body mass, nor projectile sting of the Bloatfly. Dissection has revealed that this stinger is engorged with living pupae and neurotoxins. These projectiles are capable of incapacitating large prey on which the bloatfly and it's gestating young can freely feed. These neurotoxins are only nominally effective on humans, but can cause localized necrosis at the wound site. This observation is contrary to earlier assumptions that the Bloatfly was primarily a scavenger. The Bloatfly can be dispatched easily with light weapons, but nonetheless present a threat to field operatives, especially when encountered in numbers. They are hostile and can strike before the target is aware of its presence.
translation:
界：动物界
门：节肢动物门
纲：昆虫纲
目：双翅目
科：虻科
属：虻属 

实地观测表明辐射蝇是马虻蝇受激增生后的一个变种。这些动物进化上的祖先既没有巨大的体型，也没有抛射刺针的能力。解剖后可以发现，这种有刺动物体内充斥着大量的蛹和神经毒素。这些发射出的针刺可以使一些大型的猎物麻痹，进而辐射蝇就可以在猎物身上取食并繁育幼虫。这些神经毒素对人体的作用很有限，但是会在伤口处造成局部的坏疽。这次观测的结果，与早期设想的变异蝇主要靠食腐为生的结论相反。轻武器就可以很简单地处理掉这些辐射蝇，但对于野外人员说仍然是一种威胁，尤其遇到它们成群出现的时候。它们充满敌意，并且能够在目标察觉之前发起攻击。

original: Field Entry: "Great American Cockroach"
translation: 实地记录: "美利坚大蟑螂"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Arthropoda
Class: Insecta
Order: Blattodea
Family: Blattidae
Genus: Periplaneta

The insect colloquially known as the Radroach is one of the most ubiquitous denizens of the modern American landscape. I believe it to be of the species P. Americana, the American cockroach, albeit a genome strain affected by years of exposure to heavy radiation levels. While winged, they are incapable of flight. I theorize that this is due to the evolutionary failure of the wing appendages to grow in strength commensurate to the surge in body mass. Radroach wings still seem to serve some purpose, however, in inter-species communication. Dark, damp, irradiated habitats, such as the metro tunnels, provide an ideal environment for breeding. Caution should be taken while exploring such areas, but the threat to operatives is minimal, even in great numbers.
translation:
界：动物界
门：节肢动物门
纲：昆虫纲
目：蜚蠊目
科：蜚蠊科
属：大蠊属

这种被俗称为辐射蟑螂的昆虫是现代美洲大陆上最常见的居民。我确信它是美洲蜚蠊的一种，也就是美洲蟑螂，但它们长期暴露在重度辐射下，导致了基因突变。虽然它们有翅膀，但是飞不起来。我推测这应该是一种进化上的失败，翅膀没能跟得上他们身体重量的大幅增长。不过，它们的翅膀还是起到了一点作用，可用来与自己的同类交流。像地铁隧道这样阴暗、潮湿、充满辐射的地方为它们提供了理想的繁殖环境。在这类地区探索时需要十分的小心，不过即使它们成群出动，对野外人员来说也没什么威胁。

original: Field Entry: "Giant Ant"
translation: 实地记录: "巨蚁"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Arthropoda
Class: Insecta
Order: Hymenoptera
Family: Formicidae
Genus: Camponotus

I've determined with near certainty that the aboriginal Ants are of the genus Camponotus. My best guess would be that a majority of the ants encountered are black carpenter ants (Camponotus pennsylvanicus). However, given that this particular genus consists of over a thousand different species, classification has been difficult. Prior generations of the genus were only considered a nominal threat to humans, but their social and fiercely territorial nature, combined with the greatly increased mass of current varieties has made them extraordinarily dangerous. The antennae of the ant is the primary sense organ, and soldiers report disabling this to be a successful tactic, as it sends the ant into a frenzy whereupon it attacks anything nearby, human or ant.
translation:
界：动物界
门：节肢动物门
纲：昆虫纲
目：膜翅目
科：蚁科
属：弓背蚁属

我现在基本可以确定这种本地的蚂蚁是弓背蚁属的。据我估计，这些蚂蚁多数都是黑木工蚁（弓背蚁属田野种）。尽管如此，想要在这个属里的近千种生物中确定它们的身份，十分的困难。该生物属的早期种群对人类的威胁一度被认为是可以忽略的，但是它们的群体性与强烈的领地性再加上现在这个新种群的庞大规模使得它们极度危险。蚂蚁的触须是他们最主要的感知器官，在士兵的报告中提到过打断它们的触须是一种有效的战术，这样会使他们进入一种狂躁的状态，攻击身边的一切生物，不论人还是同类。

original: Field Entry: "Mirelurk"
translation: 实地记录: "泥沼蟹"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Arthropoda
Subphylum: Crustacea/Chelicerata???
Class: Merostomata / Malacostraca / ???
Order: ???
Family: ???
Genus: ???

After going to enormous lengths to procure DNA samples of hypothesized forebears, we cannot explain why ancestry evidence is present from two vastly different creatures; the Limulus polyphemus (horseshoe crab) and the Callinectes sapidus (blue crab). It's obvious that a mutation occurred, giving this creature bipedal movement and massive growth, but I cannot explain the presence of multiple subphylum markers in DNA/RNA. Given their mystifying origins, I have decided the species deserves its own classification, and have thus dubbed them "Scylla Serrata Horrendus." They can often be found in sewers and caves and should be considered hostile and very dangerous, as their chitnous shell provides excellent resistance to both firearms and hand-held weapons. They are disgusting creatures, and I cannot fathom their popularity as a food source among the citizens of the Wasteland.
translation:
界：动物界
门：节肢动物门
亚门：甲壳类/螯肢动物亚门？？？
纲：肢口纲/ 软甲亚纲 / ？？？
目：？？？
科：？？？
属：？？？

即便艰难的获取了这种动物假定祖先的DNA样本之后，我们仍然无法解释为什么他们祖先DNA的特征会出现在两种截然不懂的生物上。很明显变异使这种生物后具有了两足行走的能力，并且体型急剧的增加，但我无法解释为什么不同门的生物的DNA/RNA会同时出现在一种生物身上。鉴于它们谜一般的起源，我决定将它们列为一个新的物种，并且给它们起名为“恐怖锯齿青蟹”。它们在下水道与洞窟中很常见，极具攻击性而且十分的危险，因为它们天生的甲壳对于轻武器和手持武器有着极佳的防护力。它们是一种令人作呕的动物，令我不解的是对于废土居民来说，它们竟然能作为一种食物来源而大受欢迎。

original: Field Entry: "Two-Headed Brahmin"
translation: 实地记录: "双头牛"

original:
Kingdom: Animalia
Phylum: Chordata
Class: Mammalia
Order: Artiodactyla
Family: Bovidae
Genus: Bos

The Brahmin has been encountered both in domesticated and wild varieties. They are hardy animals, and their utility has made them valuable to humans, in turn allowing these animals to reproduce in quantities beyond what they would otherwise be likely to acheive. They are commonly employed as pack animals. In addition to having two heads, dissection has revealed that these creatures have eight stomachs, but otherwise do not differ significantly from their likely ancestors of the Bovidae Family. Typically docile in demeanor, these creatures are useful as both as beasts of burden and a food source for field operatives.
translation:
界：动物界
门：脊索动物门
纲：哺乳动物纲
目：偶蹄目
科：牛科
属：Bos

双头牛很常见，野生的驯养的都有。它们是一种能吃苦耐劳的动物，对人类也有重要的作用，也使得它们的繁殖数量超出了它们应有的数量。双头牛一般被当作驮畜来使用。他们长了两个头，在解剖中还发现它们有8个胃。别的方面与它们的牛科祖先没什么很大的差别。它们的个性温。对于野外人员来说，它们是最好的驮畜和食物来源。

original: LDIsabellaNote01
translation: LDIsabellaNote01

original:
Day 45: 

Jason found a terminal suitable to our needs in the nearby ruins. With some work, we may be able to move this workstation closer to where our research has been taking place. Must keep an eye out for a portable source of power. Must remember to translate my notes onto this thing when I have some time to do so.

While Jason was scavenging the ruins, I caught a glimpse of the group by the pool in the afternoon. Contrary to what most people think, they don't fear the daylight at all, but they do seem to prefer indoor habitats.
translation:
第45天：

杰森在附近的废墟里找到了一台电脑终端。或许我们能设法把它移动到我们的观测站附近。必须留意下附近是否有小型的发电装置。之后我会抽时间把我心得的都记录其中。

中午当杰森搜索废墟的时候，我瞥见了傍池而居的那个群体。与多数人的认知相反，他们毫不畏惧白天，但他们更喜欢在非露天的环境下生活。

original: LDIsabellaNote02
translation: LDIsabellaNote02

original: Day 51:\n\nI've conducted an informal experiment this week. I've filled some heavy basins with water, each with different levels of radiation. Consistent with my predictions, they seem to prefer water with high rad content. Thanks to these radiation suits, I was able to irradiate one of the basins with a typically lethal level of radiation, and to my amazement, this has worked better than any of our attempts at constructing a lure to attract them into our research area. This is very exciting!
translation: 第51天：\n\n本周我进行了一次尝试性的试验。我在几个池子里加入不同辐射等级的水。如我所预测的一样，他们更喜欢辐射高水池。依靠防辐射服的帮忙，我将其中一处池水的辐射等级提升到了可以致命的程度，而让我吃惊的是，这比我们所有已尝试过的吸引他们进入研究范围的方法都更有效。真是太振奋人心了！

original: LDIsabellaNote03
translation: LDIsabellaNote03

original: Day 53:\n\nJason's recovered and repaired a generator, which should allow us to move this terminal and some of my equipment out to a better position for observation of the group's behavior.
translation: 第53天：\n\n杰森修复了在附近找到的一台发电机，这下我就可以带着电脑终端和其他带来的装备，转移到更有助于观察那个群体行为方式的观测点了。

original: LDIsabellaNote04
translation: LDIsabellaNote04

original: Day 58: \n\nAmazing! Today I was approached by one of them. I've decided to call her "Melinda." I'm not actually sure if there's a way to establish gender, but Melinda moved in a way that appeared very feminine to me. She caught me off guard while I was checking water levels in the experimental basins. For a moment there, I wished I had taken that damned pistol Jason insisted upon me carrying. She grasped my arm, but instead of attacking, she appeared to sniff my arm where some of the scavenged resin I've been using to irradiate the basins had spilled on my suit. Moments later, she was gone. Must consider some way of tagging them.
translation: 第58天：\n\n太刺激了！今天它们中的一个接近了我。我决定为她取名为“梅林达”。事实上它们并没有明显可供分辨的性特征，但梅林达的行动让我感觉充满了女人味。她在我测量试验池水的辐射程度时抓住了我。一刹那，我咒骂自己为什么不带上杰森曾坚持让我随身携带的那把手枪。她抓住了我的胳膊，但她并没有攻击我，而是使劲嗅着从试验池水溅到我外套上的充满腐臭的树脂。片刻之后，她离开了。必须想办法把他们吸引出来。

original: LDIsabellaNote05
translation: LDIsabellaNote05

original:
Day 63: 

No sign of the group for days. Could Melinda have returned to the group with some news of our brief encounter? Perhaps they're scared of us?

Jason's beginning to get concerned, but I believe we're close to learning what we came here for. The poor man's been through Hell for me. I don't know if I could have achieved so much without him, but there's so much left to learn.
translation:
第63天：

连续几天都没有再看到那个群体。是因为我们与梅林达短暂的相遇被它传达给了它的群体吗？难道是因为他们害怕我们吗？

杰森越来越担心了，但我相信我们来这里的目的马上就要达到了。这个可怜的男人陪伴我走过了地狱般的旅程。没有他我无法想象能做到这种程度，但我们未知的仍有很多。

original: LDIsabellaNote06
translation: LDIsabellaNote06

original: Day 67: \n\nI insisted on sleeping at the research site last night, much to Jason's protest. I'm sure I saw motion in the far ruins, but the moon had slid behind a cloud, so I couldn't make out for certain their shapes. I don't think mutants would have moved like that, and most people in the city know enough to hunker down at night. Could it have been our group, returning home?
translation: 第67天：\n\n我没有理睬杰森的抗议，坚持睡在调查点。我确信在远处的废墟中有生物的存在，由于云层阻断了月光，让我看不清他们的形态。我不认为那是变种人的行为方式，而这里的人们在夜晚都会隐藏起来。那它是否是那个群体中的一员而正在回家的路上呢？

original: LDIsabellaNote07
translation: LDIsabellaNote07

original: Day 68:\n\nSlept outdoors again last night. Jason insisted on staying with me this time, and built a camouflage screen for us to sleep in. I irradiated the main body of water as heavily as I could to try and draw them out. My plan seems to have worked, because I saw few - I think Melinda was among them - come into the open at dusk and settle into the water. After dark, one I believe to be the alpha male - I've called him "Samuel" - emerged with the rest of the group. I had to switch my geiger counter off when he arrived to avoid being heard. I can't imagine the radiation levels the glowing ones must be infused with. I think that must be why he's the alpha - the others are so drawn to him because of his immense irradiation.
translation: 第68天：\n\n昨晚又一次露天而眠。这次杰森坚持要陪着我，并用具有伪装效果的遮蔽物做成我们临时的床。我尽可能把整个身体浸入水中试图以身上的树脂味把他们吸引出来。我的计划似乎奏效了，因为黄昏时我发现了一小群 — 梅林达似乎也在其中之一 — 穿过出口来到岸边。天黑后，雄性首领 — 我为它取名“塞缪尔”— 带领着其余的成员出现了。为了不让它听见我必须关掉我的盖革计数管。我无法想象那个发光种的受辐射程度。我认为这一定是它之所以成为首领的原因 — 他散发的庞大的射线量吸引着其他成员自然地听命于他。

original: LDIsabellaNote08
translation: LDIsabellaNote08

original: Day 75:\n\nI need to make contact again. I've coated my suit in resin, and will try approaching the group tomorrow at dusk. Observation hasn't revealed anything new; direct contact is required if I'm going to continue to learn about them. I know Jason would never understand, but this won't work if his suit isn't also irradiated. I'll coat it while he's gone scavenging during the afternoon, and we'll set up camp tonight by the water before dusk.
translation: 第75天：\n\n我需要再次接触。把外套涂满树脂并在次日黄昏接近他们。远距离的观察并没有告诉我更多；如果要更深入了解他们那直接的交流是必须的。杰森也许不会理解，但如果他不穿上涂满树脂的外套一切就无济于事。我会利用他中午进行净化实验时给他的衣服涂上树脂，然后我们会赶在黄昏前在那条河边扎营。

original: MS05RDTerminal04
translation: MS05RDTerminal04

original: Attention all Nuka-Cola Corporation Employees\n\nWe are very proud to announce that R&D has been completed on Nuka-Cola Clear! With an only minimal loss of life, we've been able to modify the look of Nuka-Cola but give it the same great taste. We will be submitting the product to Marketing shortly for bottle design and advertising strategies. From all of us in the Research Department, thanks for the support!
translation: 核子可乐公司全体员工请注意\n\n我们非常自豪地宣布，核子可乐透明型的研发工作已完成！以少许的牺牲，我们改变了核子可乐的外观，同时保留其绝佳的口感。我们将很快向市场部提交该产品，进行瓶体设计和制定广告策略。研究部全体人员感谢你的支持！

original: As Requested
translation: 如你所命

original:
S,

Here's that stuff you wanted. If anyone asks where you got it -- say it was a gift from your grandma.

Happy hunting!

E
translation:
S,

这就是你需要的东西。如果有人问你从哪得到的 — 就说是你祖母送给你的礼物。

狩猎快乐！

E

original: SatComNote01
translation: SatCom笔记01

original: Nothing says “equality” like a fistful of caps. I think these Talon Company mercs are about the most cordial smoothies I've met, as long as their boss is getting paid. Luckily, money's no issue; I've hoarded plenty of it up since before these guys' parents were knee-high on a Brahmin.\n\nOf course, if I succeed in this, it won't matter how many caps any of these rat bastards have.
translation: 没有什么比一把瓶盖更能体现“平等”了。我认为这些鹰爪公司的雇佣兵是我见过的最热情圆滑的，只要他们的老板能拿到钱。幸运的是，钱不是问题；我在这些家伙的父母还没双头牛高时就已经储备好了一批巨款。\n\n当然了，如果我在这方面成功了，这些混球究竟拥有多少瓶盖也不会是问题了。

original: SatComNote01
translation: SatCom笔记01

original: Thanks to a little creative wiring, I was able to tap us into a power source. They're less common up here, but if you know where to look, there are still plenty of live power lines buried all over the Wasteland. For all their arrogance, they knew a thing or two about engineering before the bombs. I have to admit; it's remarkable that there's still power to be had after all these years.\n\nNow that we've got all the power we'd want, I can bring our defensive turret online and try to get the dish motors operational.
translation: 多亏了一些有创意的电线，我才得以接入电源。它们在这里并不常见，只要你知道往哪找，在废土上还是有很多带电的电线的。虽然他们很傲慢，但在炸弹爆炸前，他们对工程学还是有所了解的。我不得不承认；这么多年过去了，还能供电真是了不起。\n\n现在，我们已经得到了所需的能量，我可以让防卫炮塔上线，并设法让碟形天线的电机运行起来。

original: SatComNote01
translation: SatCom笔记01

original: Finally got to begin on my work in earnest today. Dish motivators are offline, but I was able to input some basic coordinates and ping nearby satcom arrays to the southwest and east. There was some interference pinging the NN-03d array. Probably Radroaches or something making a nest in the dishes. It may be worth sending one or two of the mercs over there to clean it out in case I can use those towers to amplify my own signal.\n\nThere were dozens of military satellites in orbit, just from the old records I found in the ruins. There must have been hundreds before the war. If I can find just a few operational platforms...
translation: 今天终于可以认真开始我的工作了。碟形激励器处于离线状态，但我还是输入了一些基本坐标，并与西南和东面附近的卫星通信阵列进行了信号查验。NN-03d阵列受到了一些干扰。可能是辐射蟑螂之类的东西在天线上筑巢。也许值得派一两个佣兵过去清理一下，以便我可以使用那些塔楼来增强信号。\n\n仅从我在废墟中找到的旧记录来看，轨道上就有几十颗军用卫星。战前肯定有几百颗。如果我能找到几个运行平台……

original: SatComNote01
translation: SatCom笔记01

original: First attempts at atmospheric pinging returned negative. Considering that the motivators are still non-functional, it's going to be difficult to catch much of anything that doesn't pass directly over us. Still, I cannot rule out other mechanical failure. I haven't got much astronomical reference material with me, but maybe I can find an old chart and wait until a celestial body passes over to confirm signal. Of course, that may take years. I'll have to keep working on the motivators.
translation: 首次尝试大气信号查验得到无效结果。考虑到激励器仍然无法正常工作，因此很难捕捉到任何没有直接从我们头顶掠过的东西。不过，我不能排除其他机械故障的可能性。我没有带太多的天文参考资料，但也许我可以找到一张旧的星图，等到有天体经过时再确认信号。当然，这可能需要好几年的时间。我得继续研究激励器。

original: SatComNote01
translation: SatCom笔记01

original: What a lucky break! I pinged an orbiting body successfully today. Registration ID is USDOD-21TXH, callsign “Highwater Trouser”. I'll begin tracking it and cross-reference the registration information with the data I've got.
translation: 多幸运的一次突破！我今天成功地探测到了一个轨道天体。注册号是USDOD-21TXH，呼号是“高水裤”。我将开始跟踪它，并将注册信息与我得到的数据进行交叉对比。

original: SatComNote01
translation: SatCom笔记01

original: Turns out I don't have specific data on my satellite, but the registration format suggests that it's a stationary micro-nuclear weapons platform. Tracking data appears to confirm this; the thing hasn't moved in the week I've been tracking it. Without a targeting platform at my disposal, sending an activation code would only cause it to drop a payload directly on top of this area. Not exactly what I'm aiming for, but I'll keep the codes handy just in case.
translation: 事实证明，我没有卫星的具体数据，但注册格式表明它是一个固定的微型核武器平台。追踪数据证实了这点；在我追踪它的这一周，它还未移动过。在我没有瞄准平台的情况下，发送激活代码只会让它直接将有效载荷投掷到这个区域的顶部。我瞄准的也不一定准确, 但我会把代码放在手头边以防万一.

original: SatComNote01
translation: SatCom笔记01

original:
USDOD-21TXH
'Highwater Trousers'
....
Receiving Activation Code:
X948KJ
L4IERU
ER32J7
....
Authentication Successful
TARGETING DATA: NONE
....
Commencing Launch.
translation:
USDOD-21TXH
'高水裤'
....
收到激活代码:
X948KJ
L4IERU
ER32J7
....
验证成功
目标数据：无
....
开始发射。

original: WomensAuxStoryNote01
translation: WomensAuxStoryNote01

original: We were mobilized in the early evening. My security clearance isn't high enough to know this on an official level, but I have it on good authority that we're under threat of a Chinese attack. I don't dare to share this with the girls; most of them are a solid sort, but I can't trust that some won't desert to try and protect themselves or their families, and wind up spreading panic, especially on flimsy rumours based on flimsier intelligence from DoD.\n\nWe haven't been debriefed yet, but it's probably safe to assume we'll be on an evacuation detail in the rural areas. Our unit scored somewhat poorly in the last round of drills, and the high-flyers always get the urban details; we'll be stuck herding farmers and hermits in the hills.
translation: 我们是在傍晚被动员起来的。我的安全级别还不够高，无法从官方层面了解这些情况，但我有可靠消息说，我们正受到中国人攻击的威胁。我不敢告诉女孩们这一情况；她们中的大多数人都很可靠，但我不相信有些人不会为了保护自己或家人而开小差，最终散布恐慌，尤其是根据国防部更不可靠的情报而散布的不可靠谣言。\n\n我们还没有被询问到，但可以肯定的是，我们将在农村地区执行疏散任务。我们的部队在上一轮演习中成绩不佳，而那些野心家们总是能得到城市的详细资料；我们会被骗去山沟里种地放羊。

original: WomensAuxStoryNote01
translation: WomensAuxStoryNote01

original: This can't have happened. We don't even know if it was the Chinese, but DC was hit. My God, Andrea's unit was on evac detail right on the Belt Loop. \n\nDear God. More bombs. What's happening?
translation: 这不可能啊。我们甚至不知道是不是中国人干的，但华盛顿被击中了。我的天，安德烈的部队正在疏散任务，就在环形地带。\n\n老天爷啊。炸弹又来了。到底发生了什么？

original: WomensAuxStoryNote01
translation: WomensAuxStoryNote01

original: Our unit has been assigned to a National Guard Detachment. They drove all night from Pennsylvania. We're doing our best to keep the survivors placated while these boys get their strength up. The looting gets worse every day, and it's a small town. There can't be much left, and there's already been one scuffle at the canteen. These Guardsmen arrived just in time, I fear.
translation: 我们的部队被指派到国民警卫队支队。他们连夜从宾夕法尼亚州赶来。我们正尽力安抚幸存者，让他们恢复体力。抢劫现象每天都在加剧，而这是个小镇。那里剩不下什么东西了，食堂已经发生过一次混战了，恐怕这些卫兵来得正是时候。

original: WomensAuxStoryNote01
translation: WomensAuxStoryNote01

original: Dolores and Rebecca deserted in the night. They had the goodness not to rob us blind on her way out; I had trusted Becky with the keys to the canteen and the artesian well we locked up on Day One.. Several of our survivors were talking rubbish about seeking refuge in a nearby Vault, the girls must have decided to go with them. Damned fools; if anybody made it into those things in time, they bloody well aren't letting any of us in now. I suppose I should just be glad we have a few less mouths to feed.
translation: 多洛雷斯和丽贝卡在夜里逃走了。她们还算有良心，没有在临走时打劫我们；我曾经那么信任贝琪，给她食堂和第一天就锁上自流井的钥匙……我们的几个幸存者曾瞎说在附近的避难所寻求庇护，那些女孩必定是已经决定跟他们一起去了。该死的白痴们；即使有人能及时赶到那里，他们也肯定不会放我们任何一个进去的。我猜我应该庆幸可以少喂几张嘴了。

original: WomensAuxStoryNote01
translation: WomensAuxStoryNote01

original: I took the NCO's advice and set up a quarantine for the worst of the radiation victims. We know better than to think they're contagious, but most of our survivors don't, and it helps keep them calm. We also have an easier time smuggling the bodies out at night. It's not so much that people die; it's how they look when they go. They all think they'll just lose a bit of hair, maybe get a rash. It gets so much worse than that.
translation: 我采纳了军士长的建议，为最严重的辐射受害者设立了隔离区。我们知道他们不会传染，但大多数幸存者都不知道，这有助于安抚他们。我们也更容易在晚上把尸体偷运出去。人死并不可怕，可怕的是他们死后的样子。他们都认为自己只是掉了点头发，或者起了点皮疹。结果却更糟。

original: WomensAuxStoryNote01
translation: WomensAuxStoryNote01

original: We're low on Prussian Blue. Most of them don't know what that really means, for which I'm thankful. One of the local doctors in our camp knows about a cancer treatment facility not too far from here. We're sending some of the guardsmen out to investigate. If they can recover any filgrastim, we might be able to stave off widespread radiation sickness a little longer.
translation: 我们缺少普鲁士蓝。谢天谢地，他们大多不懂这是什么意思。一个我们营地里的本地医生知道离这里不远有一家癌症治疗机构。我们正派一些卫兵去调查，如果他们能找到任何非格司亭，我们就能稍微更长时间的避免大量的辐射病。

original: WomensAuxStoryNote01
translation: WomensAuxStoryNote01

original: These days I feel like more of a preacher than a nurse. We've lost hope that the reservists will be back. I can only hope they died with some scrap of honor and didn't abandon us. Without medication, people are succumbing to radiation sickness, for which there is no hope of treatment. We can do nothing more than make our patients comfortable as we await the end. When the painkillers and whiskey run out, prayer is all we can offer them. I've taken to wearing a headwrap; I don't want them to see how much of my own hair has fallen out.
translation: 这些天往我觉得自己更像是个牧师而不是护士。我们已经不指望预备役军人会回来了。我只希望他们死的荣耀，没有丢下我们。没有药品，人们对辐射病没有任何抵抗力，毫无治愈希望。我们什么也做不了，最多让病人们在等死的时候舒服点。当止痛药和威士忌用完之后，我们只能为他们祈祷了。我戴上了头巾；我不想让他们看到我自己的头发掉了多少。

original: WomensAuxStoryNote01
translation: WomensAuxStoryNote01

original: I suppose it seems only right to say goodbye. I ought to know it's hopeless, but maybe one of my sisters is still out there, and I couldn't go without leaving some kind of farewell. Just know that I did everything I could. I tried, and I only wish that I could be the last to go, so I could have helped all the others before they met their own end.
translation: 我想该是说再见的时候。我应该清楚这是没希望的，但是也许我的一个姐妹还在那，我也不能连再见都不说就走了。我已经做了所有能做的。我试过了，我只希望我是最后一个走的，这样我就算是帮了其它所有人，在他们见到自己的归宿之前。

original: CommuneNote01
translation: 亲密的信01

original: I finally got everyone to agree to let me set up some generators for power. I can understand their nerves, considering what technology did to us all, but not making use of every resource is wasteful, and a sure path to Hell in this situation. Coming out into the light has done wonders for everyone, but we all can get a little stir crazy, even out here. I'm setting this thing up for everyone to use.
translation: 最终，我让所有人都同意我安装一些发电机以获取能源。我能理解他们为什么神经过敏，毕竟科技对我们所有人都造成了影响，但不能将每一样资源物尽其用就是浪费，在现在这种情况下，这很明显，就是自寻死路。产生光对每一个人都有好处，但是我们每一个人都有一些疯狂，即使在这里。我要把这东西建立起来，让每一个人都能使用。

original: CommuneNote01
translation: 亲密的信02

original: We set up an irrigation system! Thank God for Miles' experience on the farm – I never would have thought of this on my own, but what a great idea. I really thought this ground was useless, but the stuff he had us plant in the dirt we dug up is actually sprouting, and the little rivers keep it all nice and wet.
translation: 我们建立了一个灌溉系统！感谢上帝！感谢迈尔斯的农场经验 —— 要是我自己，肯定想不到这一点，但这真是个好主意。我曾以为这块地没有用，但他让我们在挖出来的泥土里种的东西真的发芽了，小河让一切都保持得又湿又好。

original: CommuneNote01
translation: 亲密的信03

original: My turn to be boss this month. Seems stupid to me, I don't want to be in charge. I'm just going to do whatever Jim tells me to.
translation: 这月轮到我作主。看起来很傻，我并不想掌权。我只想做吉姆叫我做的。

original: CommuneNote01
translation: 亲密的信04

original: I want to remind everyone to come by my tent every day for your radiation screening. Even if you don't think you've been exposed to radiation, the test takes only minutes. Take my word for it; you'd much rather be inconvenienced in the morning than come down with a case of radiation sickness. I'm more than happy to give a detailed account of that scenario to the next person who misses an appointment.
translation: 我想提醒每个人，每天都要来我的帐篷进行辐射筛查。即使你认为你并没有暴露在放射线中，检查也只需要几分钟。相信我的话，即使每天早上过来一趟很不方便，也远胜于感染上辐射病。我很乐意为每一个错过了约定的人介绍情况细节。

original: CommuneNote01
translation: 亲密的信05

original: my name is ty an i'm a big dum hed!!!
translation: 我叫做Ty…我是一个大儿！！！

original: CommuneNote01
translation: 亲密的信06

original: Hey Rochelle, remind me what a big stupid head I am the next time you need me to repair you and Vu's distillers, okay? What gives, Edgar? Can't you put a password on this thing?
translation: 嘿，拉洛歇尔。下次当你要我修理你和酿酒炉的时候，提醒我一下，我是头蠢蛋，好吗？那是什么，埃德加？你不能给这玩意儿加个密码？

original: CommuneNote01
translation: 亲密的信07

original: Been a good few months for us since the coming out. Going by the dosimeter tests, we're taking some exposure to radiation, but as long as Doc Johanson keeps folks on their meds, we don't seem to be having trouble with rad sickness. Irrigation and fertilization has been good, and though we lost the goats and chickens, the cows have done good. Those hardy beasts don't seem to mind this new world. Miles and Jacky are devoting some time to husbandry to keep the cows breeding and available.
translation: 我们出来后的这几个月过得不错。根据剂量计测试，我们受到了一些辐射，但只要约翰森医生继续让大家吃药，我们似乎就不会患上辐射病。灌溉和施肥情况良好，虽然我们失去了山羊和鸡，但奶牛的表现不错。这些顽强的野兽似乎并不介意这个新世界。迈尔斯和杰基花了一些时间来饲养奶牛，以保持它们的繁殖能力。

original: CommuneNote01
translation: 亲密的信08

original: I'm trying to fabricate a windmill for us. If anybody spots any long, flat sheets of metal, you let me know. I have most of the other parts I need, but haven't found good metal for the blades yet.
translation: 我想为我们制造一个风力房。如果谁看到一些又长又平的金属板，告诉我一声。其他部分我已经准备好了，但还没有找到适合做叶片的金属。

original: CommuneNote01
translation: 亲密的信09

original: Nobody ought concern themselves too much with Miguel's scouting report. While he did spot some folk out past the valley, they rode by and weren't like to have noticed him or us. Let's all just keep to the homestead for a few days and avoid using open fires for a few days, just to be safe.
translation: 没人应该太在意米格尔的侦察报告。虽然他在山谷那边发现了一些人，但他们骑马经过，不像是注意到他或我们的人。为了安全起见，这几天大家都呆在家里，不要生火。

original: Bounty Notice: Junders Plunkett
translation: 悬赏通告：伦德斯·普朗基特

original:
Notice to all Good Men and Women seeking Lawful Bounties in the Capital Wastes:

Let it be known that the murderous person known as JUNDERS PLUNKETT, of fair complexion, average height, and missing one good eyeball, is offered for bounty, either DEAD OR ALIVE, in the sum of 1,000 caps or similar compensation of expended equipment and/or medical expense.

JUNDERS PLUNKETT was last seen committing theft and murder in the township of Canterbury Commons. The apprehending person should exercise special caution, as the bountied personage is noted for an uncommon aptitude with small, concealable blades.
translation:
谨此通告首都废土中所有寻找合法赏金的先生和女士们：

我们悬赏捉拿一个名叫伦德斯·普朗基特的谋杀犯，白种人，中等身高，是个独眼龙，活要见人，死要见尸，总计1000个瓶盖的奖赏，或者等价的装备与药品物资的补偿。

伦德斯·普朗基特最后一次被发现在坎特伯雷社区，犯下了盗窃与谋杀的罪行。实施抓捕行动的人请务必格外小心，据称该赏金对象拥有一种罕见的本领，精通使用一把小而隐蔽的刀片。

original: Letter from Vault-Tec
translation: 来自避难所科技的信

original:
Dear Mr & Mrs Gomez: 

Congratulations on your family's recent inclusion in the Vault 101 community!

You will find outlined in your application materials a full review of rules and procedures related to preparing for shelter in a Vault-Tec facility, but we will outline a few key points here:

* Vault-Tec provides all clothing, bedding, and accommodations for residents. Personal belongings must be reviewed and approved of by an authorized Vault-Tec hermetics technician before such belongings can be delivered to your reserved quarters within the Vault. In the event of an emergency entrance to the Vault, no personal belongings will be permitted beyond the main door of the facility.
* All Vault residents must attend an orientation seminar. If you did not attend such a seminar as part of the application process, you must make an appointment with your Vault-Tec representative.
* In the event of a Vault activation, whether actual or drill, Vault-Tec will sound a siren audible in the immediate vicinity of the Vault facility entrance, and residents will be contacted via holotape message at the phone number provided in their resident profile records. Please report promptly to Vault 101 to await admittance and processing upon such a notification.

Vault-Tec looks forward to having you and your family as valued residents! Be sure to present this letter to your Vault-Tec representative to receive your special, commemorative Vault Boy bobble-head toy! Sincerely;

Vault-Tec 
Dept of Public Relations
Washington, DC
translation:
亲爱的戈麦斯先生和女士：

祝贺您全家加入101号避难所这个大家庭！

在您的申请材料里，有完整的规章制度以及进入避难所科技公司设施避难前准备工作的相关程序，但我们将在此概述几个要点：

* 所有的服装，寝具以及居住设施均由避难所科技提供。你的私人物品在投递到避难所内预定的住处之前，必须先由避难所科技授权的内部技术人员进行检查与核准。倘若在紧急状态下需要进入避难所，则不允许携带私人物品进入避难所的大门。
* 所有避难所的住民必须参加一个定位研讨会。这个研讨会是申请程序的一部分，如果你还未参加，请与避难所科技的代表进行预约。
* 如果避难所的大门被打开，无论是演习还是实战避难所科技都会拉响警报，在紧邻避难所设施入口处的地方就可以听见，我们将会根据居民档案记录里的编号，经由电话上的全息通讯系统与居民联络。请立即前往101号避难所等待入所批准，并按照以上的注意事项进行下一步的程序。

尊敬的避难所居民，避难所科技期待你和你的家人的到来！请务必将这封信呈交给你在避难所科技的代表，你会收到一个别致而又有纪念意义的小玩具—避难所小子的摇头娃娃！您真诚的；

避难所科技公司 
公共事务部
华盛顿特区

original: Letter from Vault-Tec
translation: 来自避难所科技的信

original:
Dear Safety-Conscious Citizen - 

We are writing to inform you that your family was not selected for inclusion in your chosen Vault-Tec facility. Your deposit has been retained, and your application added to a waiting list for your preferred Vault. In the interest of your family's security in the event of a minor nuclear event, please consider relocating to one of these areas, where Vault-Tec facilities are available without a waiting list:

For a full list of Vault-Tec facilities with available accommodations, in exciting locales such as Oklahoma and newly-annexed Canada, contact your local Vault-Tec representative!

Vault-Tec wishes you and your family the best of luck in the uncertain future. Best regards; 

Vault-Tec
Public Relations Dept
Washington, DC
translation:
亲爱的富有安全意识的市民 - 

我们写这封信是想通知你，你和你的家人未能被选中进入你们当初所挑选的避难所设施。你们的定金将会保留，你们的申请被列入了等候名单，会有更好的避难所供你选择。为了你家人的安全，如果遭受了小规模的核武器打击，请考虑将家人安置在下面这些无需等待，可以立即进入的避难所科技公司设施：

这些避难所科技公司设施里都有可用的居住场所，建造在诸如俄克拉荷马州以及新被吞并的加拿大等等这样激动人心的地方，请与当地的避难所科技代表联系！

避难所科技公司祝你和你的家人在不可预知的未来里能有好运气。真诚的问候；

避难所科技公司
公共事务部
华盛顿特区

original: HamHideNote01
translation: 无线电隐藏笔记01

original: Finally done. Maggie wanted us to sign up at a Vault-Tec shelter, but I've never trusted those bastards. It took a lot of work, but Frank helped me get all the parts together and hauled out to the acreage to build this shelter. Air filtration, chemical toilets, artesian well, the whole nine yards. Frank's connections got us the generator cheap, too. And we don't have to worry about sharing quarters with whoever got their name on some waiting list when the day comes.\n\nWish I could say “if” the day comes, but it just seems like a matter of time now. How could it have come to this?
translation: 完工了。玛姬希望我们能加入某处避难所科技公司掩体，但我却信不过那些混蛋。花费了很多功夫，在富兰克的帮助下，终于把所有要用的东西搬到了我们准备建立住所的地方，并组装了起来。空气过滤系统，盥洗室，饮用水体统等等，一共是九大部分。因为富兰克的关系，我们买到了便宜的发电机。我们不必担心某天需要与名单上某个不速之客分享住所。\n\n我希望能一直维持这样的生活，但这似乎只是昙花一现。为什么会这样？

original: HamHideNote01
translation: 无线电隐藏笔记02

original: Robin wanted to play with the computer for Christmas, so I siphoned some juice from the fusion generator to power this old thing. I know she'd rather be playing outside in the snow, but she's a good kid. Knows that we can't go outside yet. I'll check the fallout levels again tomorrow while she's playing, but I doubt we'll be heading out anytime soon. Damn commies must have hit us hard.
translation: 圣诞节到了，罗宾提出想玩电脑，于是我从核聚变发电机分流出一部分电力启动了那台旧电脑。我十分明白其实她更渴望能去户外玩雪，她真是个懂事的孩子。目前为止我们还不能出门。明天我会趁她玩电脑时再测试下户外的辐射浓度，我猜应该不久就能出门了。该死的共军真是把我们害惨了。

original: HamHideNote01
translation: 无线电隐藏笔记03

original: MARRY CRISMAS! \n\nCute kid, huh?
translation: 圣诞快乐！ \n\n可爱的孩子，嗯？

original: HamHideNote01
translation: 无线电隐藏笔记04

original: I don't believe it. Frank showed up today. He was on a sales trip when the blast hit, selling generators to a mining operation in Pennsylvania. Being in those shafts probably saved his life, but the shock wave also knocked out every power line feeding them light and air. Falling debris killed the foreman standing right next to him. He doesn't even know how long he was crawling around those tunnels before he got outside, the poor bastard. \n\nSounds like the water's boiling. Some hot soup will do him good, even if it's that powdered crap we hauled in here last year.<//end>
translation: 我真不敢相信。弗兰克今天现身了。爆炸发生时他正在做销售，向宾夕法尼亚州的一家矿场销售发电机。在矿井里可能救了他一命，但冲击波也震断了为他们提供照明和空气的所有电线。震落的碎石砸死了站在他旁边的工头。他都不知道自己在隧道里爬了多久，才爬到外面，可怜的家伙。\n\n听起来水开了。喝点热汤对他有好处，即使是我们去年运来的垃圾粉也行。<//end>

original: HamHideNote01
translation: 无线电隐藏笔记05

original: Frank's in bad shape, arms and face are all burned up. He's got a lot of blisters that look infected. He went through hell out there. Hardly anybody alive, and those he met almost did him in. He tried getting into a Vault near Burkittsville. They wouldn't open up and he was almost killed in an ambush on his way out of there. He said those folks wore skins of men. Cannibal bastards must just wait for their next meal to come looking for help at the Vault. Frank steered clear of them and headed straight here after that. He's been on his feet for weeks.
translation: 弗兰克的情况很糟，双臂和脸部都被严重灼伤了。他身上有很多水泡，看起来已经感染了。他从地狱般的地方逃命。侥幸地生还了，在那里他所遭遇的一切都能要了他的命。他试图进入博科思城附近的一处避难所。他不仅没能成功地说服他们开门，还差点死于归路上的一次伏击。他说那些人穿着人皮。那群婊子养的食人族把向避难所求助的人们当成了下一顿肉宴。之后弗兰克设法避开了他们并最终回到了这里。他一直步行了数个星期。

original: HamHideNote01
translation: 无线电隐藏笔记06

original: His hair was falling out within a week of him showing up. I wanted to believe we could save him, but there's no way a few iodine tablets a day was going to reverse the radiation he must have been exposed to out there. He was a good man. He deserves better, but I can't go out there and give him a proper burial. Maggie's going to stay up with Robin and let her play some holotapes loud tonight. That's when I'll take Frank in the back and cremate him. I wish our furnace was big enough to hold him in one piece. God help us. How could it have come to this?
translation: 他出现不到一周，头发就掉光了。我很想相信我们能救活他，但每天吃几片碘片根本无法逆转他在那里受到的辐射。他是个好人。他的命运不应该如此悲惨，但我却连好好安葬他都做不到。玛姬会陪着罗宾，让她今晚大声播放一些全息磁带。到时我就带弗兰克去后面火化他，真希望我们的火炉够大，能把他完整地装进去。上帝保佑我们吧。怎么会变成这样的？

original: 10mm Pistol
translation: 10mm手枪

original:
The N99 10mm sidearm was standard issue military gear following the phase out of the N80 in 2051. The N99 was known for its ability to survive in the harshest of conditions and in many tests, the weapon was able to reliably be restored to working condition after an extended period of time exposed to hard elements and without maintenance. 

The N99 proved to stand up to its claims and as a result, is one of the most common weapons found in use in the Wasteland. While many civilian weapons were ruined beyond use in the exterior conditions following the war, the N99 is commonly able to be easily restored to working order by anyone with the most basic knowledge of firearm mechanics. 

However, an N99 in poor condition can often deliver low target and armor penetration, frequent jamming, and greatly reduced accuracy. Fortunately, the weapon was produced in great numbers and units are available for replacement parts.
translation:
N99 10mm随身武器是在2051年淘汰N80后的标准军用装备。N99以其在最恶劣条件下的适应能力而闻名，在许多测试中，该武器能够在长时间暴露于恶劣环境中且无需维护的情况下可靠地恢复到工作状态。

事实证明，N99经受住了考验，因此成为废土上最广泛使用的武器之一。战后，许多民用武器在恶劣的外部环境中被毁坏，无法使用，而N99通常能够被任何具备最基本枪械机械知识的人轻松修复。

不过，状况不佳的N99通常会导致对目标及装甲穿透性低、频繁卡壳和精度大大降低。幸运的是，这种武器的生产量很大，可以提供替换零件。

original: Assault Rifle
translation: 突击步枪

original:
The R Series of combat assault rifles was used reliably following the discontinuation of the M series in the early 21st century. The R series, produced by civilian manufacturer Stent Security Solutions, was made in many models and variations. The variation most common to the DC Wasteland is the R91 full-auto urban assault rifle. 

This rifle was standard issue for the National Guard during urban pacification operations. Fortunately for our purposes, the Nation Guard had been fully deployed around the DC area during the time of the war. As a result, the R91 is readily available for those willing to search. Although nearly two centuries of scavenging has reduced the numbers of working units, the R91 remains a favorite of Slavers and Raiders. this rifle can also often be obtained from legitimate traders and arms dealers.

Like any firearm, the R91's effectiveness and accuracy can suffer without regular maintenance.
translation:
21世纪初，M系列停产后，R系列战斗突击步枪表现得十分可靠。R系列由民用制造商“支架安全解决方案”生产，衍生了多种型号和变种。在特区废土最常见的变种是R91全自动城市突击步枪。

这种步枪是国民警卫队在城市治安行动时的标准装备。同我们期望的那样，在战争时期，特区附近已经全面部署了国民警卫队。由此，那些寻枪的人随处都可以找的到R91。经过了差不多两个世纪，这些枪被人们捡走了不少，还能使用的数量已经不多了，但R91依旧是奴贩们和掠夺者们喜爱的武器。从合法的商人和军火贩那里也能容易的弄到这种步枪。

与其他枪械一样，如果没有合理的保养和维护，R91的性能和命中率都会受到影响。

original: AEP7 Laser Pistol
translation: AEP7激光手枪

original:
The AEP7 Laser Pistol was put into service to replace the AEP5, a model which was notorious for its problems with overheating. The AEP7 features a new design in the photonic focusing chamber as well as an entirely redesigned focusing crystal pattern. The bulk and weight have both been reduced over previous models and it was likely that within the new few development cycles, the successor to the AEP7 would replace the N99 10mm as the standard issue sidearm for all forces.

The AEP7 took advantage of new manufacturing techniques developed shortly before the Great War. Although many were produced, most did not make it into field service because of logistics problems concerning their deployment during active wartime. 

The AEP7 can be a rare find in the Capital Wasteland, and any models that are produced should be returned to the Citadel for repair and recalibrating before field deployment.
translation:
AEP7激光手枪的投入使用，取代了因过热问题而臭名昭著的AEP5激光手枪。AEP7采用了新的光子聚焦枪膛设计和全新设计的聚焦水晶块。与以前的型号相比，AEP7的体积和重量都有所减轻，在新的几个开发周期内，AEP7的后继型号很可能会取代N99 10mm手枪，成为所有部队的标准随身武器。

AEP7利用了大战前不久开发的新制造技术。虽然生产了很多，但由于战时部署的后勤问题，大多数都没有投入实战。

首都废墟内很难找到AEP7，在实际装备到战场前，所有该型号的手枪都要送回大本营，进行修理和重新校。

original: AER9 Laser Rifle
translation: AER9激光步枪

original:
Unlike many of the weapons in use today, the AER9 is actually not the top laser rifle that was in service at the time of the Great War. The model line went up to the state-of-the-art AER12, which saw service in a handful of specialty units. The reason that the AER9 is much more commonly found is that it was much sturdier and more reliable than the models that followed.

The AER9 features a titanium housed crystal array which proved to withstand long years of exposure to the elements much better than the gold alloy housing of the later models. As a result, the crystal arrays stayed focused within operating parameters, rather than falling completely out of focus like the newer models. 

As with all energy weapons, the AER9 can suffer from poor performance if not properly maintained. The crystal arrays and non-mechanical components are delicate and if not properly serviced can lead to a loss of beam intensity, overheating, and energy regulation failure.
translation:
与今天使用的许多武器不同，AER9实际上并不是大战期间服役的顶级激光步枪。该枪型最为先进的是AER12，在少数特种部队中服役。AER9更常见的原因是它比后面的型号更坚固、更可靠。

AER9的特点是在水晶组上有一层钛覆盖物，经得起长年累月的暴露在外，远比使用金合金覆盖物的新型号要强。因此，水晶组在操作参数范围内保持聚焦，也比像新型号那样完全失去焦点要强。

和所有的能量武器一样，如果保养不当，AER9的性能就会变得很差。水晶组和非机械部件都非常精密，使用不当就会导致光束强度下降，武器过热，能量调控失败。

original: Complaint 0001

Incident Level: 3 (Minor)
Guest Name: Harold Worthington III

Incident:
Mr. Worthington claims that the ice machine on the second floor was leaking water, which caused the tile floor to get wet. He then apparently slipped and fell after "spending the night up in the Alfresco" on the way back to his room. He demanded restitution in the form of free room service or "some more of those damn pillows." I found Mr. Worthington to be quite unreasonable and abusive on the phone.
translation:
事件等级：3 (轻微)
客人姓名：哈罗德·沃辛顿三世

事件：
沃辛顿先生声称2楼的制冰机漏水，导致地板湿滑，造成了他在回房间的路上滑倒，“在露天中过了一夜”。他要求以免费客房服务或“再来几个该死的枕头”的形式获得赔偿，我觉得沃辛顿先生在电话中听起来很粗野而且不可理喻。

original: Complaint 0001

Incident Level: 1 (Major)
Guest Name: Seneca Clarkson

Incident:
Ms. Clarkson was found dead in Room 302 in the bed in a state of undress. She had been suffocated by a plastic bag placed over her head and couldn't help herself from this predicament due to her limbs being tied to the bedposts. The man who reported the incident was takin into custody and told us that "It was only a bit of fun!" Ms. Clarkson is well known to be a highly valued escort for this facility, and it is assumed she perished in the line of duty.
translation:
事件等级：1 (重要)
客人姓名：塞涅卡·克拉克森

事件：
克拉克森女士被发现未着衣衫的死在302房间的床上。她的头部被一个塑料袋套着，双手被绑在床柱上。报告此事件的男子已经被拘押，他告诉我们“只是为了乐一乐”，众所周知克拉克森女士专门提供这类高价服务，因此她很可能是由于尽职而死的。

original: Complaint 0001

Incident Level: 2 (Intermediate)
Guest Name: Wanda Kellendyne

Incident:
Ms. Kellendyne reported the smell of cooking coming from her room (202). We immediately dispatched a security guard to her room to ascertain the source of the smell. After investigating the entire room, the guard discovered that the electric blanket we provided her was malfunctioning and literally burning her legs. When asked why she didn't feel any pain, she immediately replied "Honey, I've been married for 40 years and I raised 8 kids. What the hell is pain?" That and the myriad of empty pill bottles we found seemed to answer the question.
translation:
时间等级：2 (中等)
客人姓名：旺达·凯伦黛

事件：
凯伦黛女士报告她的房间(202)里有烤肉味传出，我们立即组织安全警卫到她房间里去寻找这怪味的来源。在检查完整个房间之后，警卫发现我们提供给她的电热毯由于出现故障正在灼烧着她的腿。当被问及为什么不觉得疼时，她立刻回答“亲爱的，我结婚40多年养大了8个孩子，什么叫做痛？”嗯，不过我们在她房间里发现的上万个空药瓶也许能回答这个问题。

original: Complaint 0001

Incident Level: 3 (Minor)
Guest Name: Harold Worthington III

Incident:
Note this is Mr. Worthington's second incident this month. Apparently he claims that the carpeting on the steps leading to the Alfresco Lounge was coming up which caused him to trip and fall down. He says he was making his way back to his room "after a whole night up in the Alfresco Lounge" and had the accident. 

As before, he demanded restitution in the form of free room service or "some more of those damn pillows." Once again, I found Mr. Worthington to be quite unreasonable and abusive on the phone. I believe we have now relinquished 23 pillows to this hotel regular over the last 10 months.
translation:
事件等级：3 (次要)
客人姓名：哈罗德·沃辛顿 三世

事件：
注意这是沃辛顿先生本月的第二次投诉。他声称通向露天沙龙的台阶地毯翘起来钩住了他的脚，他因此而摔倒。他说这惨剧发生在他在“露天沙龙待了一夜”之后准备回自己房间的路上。

像上次一样，他要求以免费的客房服务或“再来几个该死的枕头”的形式作为补偿。又一次，我觉得沃辛顿先生在电话里粗暴而且不可理喻。我觉得为了使这酒店运转正常，在过去的10个月我们已经付出了23个枕头的代价。

Diagnosis:
Mr. Mallone was admitted by the staff at the Statesman Hotel across the street with an extremely painful pull in the groin region of his body. He indicated he was in the company of one Ms. Seneca Clarkson at the time, but would not disclose what caused it. The muscles affected are the Gracilis Muscle and the Adductor Longus Muscle.

Medicine and physical therapy recommended.

诊断结果：
街对面政治家酒店的职员确认迈仑先生腹股沟部位曾受到痛彻心扉的猛烈拉拽。迈仑先生含糊其辞地表示他当时正与一位塞涅卡·克拉克森小姐在一起，但不愿透露受伤的具体原因。损伤肌肉为股薄肌与长收肌。

Diagnosis:
Mr. Worthington was admitted by the staff at the Statesman Hotel across the street with the aforementioned pains. He claims to have fallen by slipping on some water left on the ground by a faulty ice machine in the hotel. After an overnight stay and extensive testing, we can find no injuries to treat.

Please also note that Mr. Worthington asked for at least 8 pillows to help him sleep and when the room was cleaned the next day after he was discharged, they were all gone.

None.

街对面政治家酒店的职员确认了沃辛顿先生的上述病情。沃辛顿先生声称旅馆内一台错误摆放的制冰机在地板上留下残水，因而致使自己滑倒。但做完整夜留驻的全面检查之后，我们仍找不到需要治疗的伤患部位。

顺带提及，沃辛顿先生曾索要过至少8个枕头以便入睡，第二天他退宿后打扫房间时，这些枕头都不见了。

无。

original: Progress Report 0540
translation: 进展报告 0540

original:
Entry 0540

Sim back up and running after another few days of changes. Chase is running everyone ragged, making tweaks here and there. 
The sim is, without any shadow of a doubt, divorced from reality. I've never seen the classified military reports, but some of the stuff Chase has added to the sim? There's no way it happened like that.
Version 7-36-099 was scrapped after Chase decided his face didn't look just right. I realize progress reports aren't the place for this, but there are concerns that the man is losing it. No one confronts him because everyone is scared. After West-Tek dropped off the grid, there were lots of rumors about the military commandeering private contractors, and no one wants to give Chase a reason to do that here. But really, what's the point in running this sim over and over and over? Any tactical data was mined months ago.
translation:
记录 0540

模拟程序在又修改了几天之后，做好了备份开始运行。蔡斯让大家到处修改，每个人都十分疲惫了。 
这个模拟程序毫无疑问的和现实非常不同。虽然我从来没读过机密的军方报告，但是蔡斯在模拟程序里加的一些东西是不可能发生的。
7-36-099版本程序被放弃了，因为蔡斯说他的脸在程序中看起来有些不对劲。我知道进度报告里不应该写这些，但是有人认为蔡斯快疯了。没人敢面对他，因为每个人都很害怕。在West-Tek销声匿迹以后，出现了不少军方将会强制征用其他私人承包公司的传言，谁也不想让蔡斯有借口对我们下手。但是，究竟为什么一遍又一遍地运行模拟程序呢？所有的战术信息几个月以前就采集完了。

original: Progress Report 0540
translation: 进展报告 0540

original:
Entry 0527

Sim version 7-36-081 was scrapped last week after Chase ran through it himself. Said it didn't "feel right." It was eventually determined he was referring to hardware issues, not anything to do with the software.

Techs have been making modifications on the chair, but some ongoing issues remain problematic. Requests to administration to provide detailed schematics and hardware history have been neglected. Questions about the particular external interface requirements remain unanswered. Techs will attempt to compensate.
translation:
记录 0527

上周，蔡斯亲自运行7-36-081版本的模拟程序后，这个版本被放弃了。他说“感觉不对”。最后发现他所说的是硬件问题，和软件没有关系。

技术人员们正在调整那只椅子，但是还是有一些问题。提供详细设计图和硬件历史的要求被上级忽略了。关于特定外部接口的要求的问题还是没有回答。技术人员将会继续尝试。

original: Ammo Mill Instructions
translation: 弹药轧制机操作说明

original:
Step 1: Load Ammo, Casings, Hulls, Primers, and/or Powder into the Materials Bin.*

Step 2: Use terminal to melt down Items to components

Step 3: Use terminal to craft new Ammo, Casings, Hulls, Primers, and/or Powder

Step 4: Retrieve newly crafted items from Materials Bin.

Unused Materials will be returned to the Materials Bin and can be used again in later Press Orders


*Only works with regular ammo and parts from the two wastelands.
translation:
第一步：把弹药、弹壳、外壳、底火和/或火药装入材料箱里。

第二步：使用终端将物品熔化成元件。

第三步：使用终端机制作新的弹药、弹壳、外壳、底火和/或火药。

第四步：从“材料箱”中取出新制作的物品。

未使用的材料将返回材料箱，并可在以后的新的订单中再次使用。


*仅适用于普通弹药和“两个废土（TTW）”的部件。

original: DLC01DowntownTerminal01Note01
translation: DLC01DowntownTerminal01Note01

original:
Director James,

I am once again writing to encourage you to resign your position following the disastrous reconstruction of the Wabash Bridge. While I understand that it was your desire to unify the city's skyline, we at the Pittsburgh Heritage Society feel that replacing the historical Wabash Bridge with a simple copy of the 10th Street structure was laziness bordering on criminal negligence on the part of the Department of Public Works. As the director of the department, the Society holds you responsible.

I will be addressing this matter at the next meeting of the county administrators.

---
Emily Weise
Pittsburgh Heritage Society
translation:
詹姆斯主任，

我再次写信给您，鼓励您在瓦巴什大桥灾难性的重建之后，辞去您的职务。尽管我明白您统一城市天际线的决心，但我们匹兹堡文化遗产协会认为，用一个简单的第十大街结构的复制品来替代具有深厚历史意义的瓦巴什大桥，这是匹兹堡公共建设局的一种近乎于玩忽职守的懒惰。作为该部门的负责人，我们协会认为你对此负有责任。

我将在下次的全郡行政管理会议上提出这个问题。
---
艾米丽·维泽
匹兹堡文化遗产协会

original: DLC01DowntownTerminal01Note02
translation: DLC01DowntownTerminal01Note02

original: Hadley, come on! You put me next to Jenkins? Seriously? I can't stand that guy. He smells like moldy feet and he chews his damn gum so loud I can't concentrate. I've been here four months longer than Bill. You should switch our desks and make him be near Jenkins.\n\n-Tom
translation: 哈德利，别这样！你把我放到詹金斯旁边了？你是认真的吗？我可没法忍受那个家伙。他闻起来就好像发霉的臭脚，而且他总是把他那该死的口香糖嚼得吱嘎作响，让我没法集中精神。我比比尔早来了四个月。你应该对换我们的桌子好让他挨着詹金斯。\n\n-汤姆

original: DLC01DowntownTerminal01Note03
translation: DLC01DowntownTerminal01Note03

original: I was in your office the other day Hadley and I couldn't help noticing that there's some sort of sound coming from the wall. I think you might have mice. You should get maintenance to check that out.
translation: 有一天我和哈德利在你的办公室里听到墙后面有某种奇怪的声音，我想你那里可能有老鼠。你还是找维护部门检查检查吧。

original: DLC01DowntownTerminal01Note04
translation: DLC01DowntownTerminal01Note04

original: Mr. James,\n\nYour wife called. She wants you to pick up milk and a case of Cram on the way home. Also, Miss Stevens called and thanked you for lunch, and wanted to confirm for the same time next Tuesday.
translation: 詹姆斯先生，\n\n您太太打电话来过，她想让您回家时捎点牛奶和一箱饱饱牌肉罐头回去。还有，斯蒂文森小姐来电感谢您的午餐，并想确认下周二同一时间是否可行。
