translation: DLC01DowntownTerminal02Note01

original: Patient: M. Cramer\n\nSymptoms: Patient complaining of myalgia as well as swollen and enlarged lymph nodes. In addition, patient reports a feeling of "unease". Suspected asymptomatic herpetic infection. Performed AR series of tests and exams. Samples sent to UMS for analysis.
translation: 患者：M.克莱默\n\n症状：患者抱怨肌肉疼痛以及淋巴结肿胀。此外患者还说他有种“焦虑”的感觉。怀疑是无症状的疱疹病毒感染。已施行AR系列测试。样本已送去UMS接受分析。

original: DLC01DowntownTerminal02Note02
translation: DLC01DowntownTerminal02Note02

original: Patient: R. Jenkins\n\nSymptoms: Patient presents runny nose, fever, swollen feet, bad breath, headache, jaundice, and extreme perspiration. Honestly, I have no clue what's wrong with him, but performing tests seems to make his symptoms lessen.
translation: 患者：R.詹金斯\n\n症状：患者流鼻涕，发烧，双脚肿大，呼吸困难，头痛，黄疸，而且还大量出汗。老实说，我也不知道他到底是怎么了，不过做了几个测试后他的症状似乎缓解了。

original: DLC01DowntownTerminal02Note0c
translation: DLC01DowntownTerminal02Note0c

original: Dr. Borman asked me to look into new office space. Being this close to the mills is terrible for the patients. But he says that we can afford a new office now. Ever since the Canadian annex, we've had a lot of vets in the office, so the numbers are looking way up. War might be hell, but it's good for some of us!
translation: 伯曼医生让我研究一下新的办公地点。离那些工厂这么近对患者是很不利的。他还说我们现在能付得起换新办公地点的费用了。自从加拿大被吞并以后，我们的办公室里总是有一大堆退伍老兵，我们的收入也因此而增加。战争可能是地狱，但对我们中的某些人来说却是好事！

original: Trog Research
translation: 兽化人研究

original:
Troglodyte Degeneration Contagion
Research by Dr. Sandra Kundanika

An epidemic of the environs around the Pitt, which I have named Troglitic Degeneration Contagion (or simply "TDC") appears to be the result of intensely concentrated radiation, but the unique toxins and pollutants in the Pitt cause it to be far more pervasive.

Anyone living in TDC-active areas experience skin lesions after a few weeks of exposure, which can clear up after a month or more away from infected areas. For many healthy adults, this is the full extent of the effect. TDc also seems to interact with brain chemistry in a manner that produces a number of psychological effects, even if the subject remains physically healthy. I'll need to recover more information about psychosis before attempting to enumerate those effects. 

Approximately 20% of adults will progress further, losing higher reasoning and motor skills over the course of years, until they have degenerated into a bestial "Trog." No subjects have ever been recovered from full degeneration, although wishful rumors persist of Trog retaining memories and recognizing the faces of loved ones.

More tragic, however, is the fact that children born in TDC-active areas have a (virtually) 100% degeneration rate, often becoming feral within weeks of birth.
translation:
兽化退行性传染病
桑德拉·坤塔妮卡博士

一种流行病正在匹兹堡肆虐，我把它命名为兽化退行性传染病（Troglodyte Degeneration Contagion，或简称 “TDC”），它看上去是由高强度的密集辐射引起的，而匹兹堡独一无二的毒素和污染物使这种传染病更加无孔不入。

任何住在TDC疫区的人，在暴露于辐射几周之后，都会出现皮肤损伤，这些损伤可以在离开疫区一个多月后康复。对于很多成年人来说，这种皮肤损伤是TDC的全部症状。TDC看上去也会与大脑中的化学物质发生作用，从而使感染对象产生一些心理问题，即使他们的身体没有异样。我得在做列举这些影响的尝试前多收集一些关于这种精神疾病的信息。

大约20%的成年人病情会继续发展，在几年内逐步失去思维和运动能力，直到退化成凶残的“兽化人”。从没有感染者能从退化状态康复，尽管有一厢情愿的流言声称兽化人仍保留着记忆并能认出它们曾爱过的人。

然而，更加不幸的是，出生在TDC疫区的儿童（几乎是）100%地会退化，经常在出生的几周后就开始了这一过程。

original: Cure Research
translation: 治疗法研究

original:
Cure Development Progress
Research by Dr. Sandra Kundanika

Observational tests on isolated samples suggest the subject has a natural adaptive immunity to the so called "trog mutation." Furthermore, it appears that this immunity carries on to other forms of radiation-induced diseases - from radiation sickness to larger mutations such as the all-too-common development of a sixth toe.

Attempts to isolate these effects have been slow going, due in part to the delicate nature of testing. Prospects exist for duplication, but the unique and delicate nature of the subject requires utmost care in testing.
translation:
治疗法研发进展
桑德拉·坤塔妮卡博士的研究

对分离样本进行的观察测试表明，试验对象对所谓的“兽化突变”具有天然的适应性免疫力。此外，这种免疫力似乎还可用于其他形式的辐射诱发疾病--从辐射病到更大的突变，如常见的长出第六根脚趾。

分离这些效应的尝试进展缓慢，部分原因是测试的脆弱性。复制的可能性是存在地，但这一课题的独特性和脆弱性要求在测试中极为谨慎。

original: Note from Wild Bill
translation: 狂野比尔的遗书

original: I'm not going to make it, Milly...I'm sorry. I knew everyone thought I could do it, but they don't know what's out here. It's not just Trogs...but others. The Wildmen. Kind of funny considering my nickname 'Wild Bill' back at the mill. Finding the ingots wasn't the hard part...they're everywhere. The problem was trying to make my way back to the mill. My trusty sidearm came in handy more than once, but I soon found myself in more trouble than I could handle. The gunfire alerted the Wildmen and I assume it's only a matter of time before they find me. I'm sorry for letting everyone down at the mill. Let everyone know I tried my hardest. ...Bye.
translation: 我撑不下去了，米莉……我很抱歉。我知道每个人都觉得我能够做到，但是他们不知道这里是怎么回事。这里不光有兽化人……还有别的东西，野蛮人！真是搞笑，我在工厂的时候外号就叫做狂野比尔。找到钢锭不是什么难事，它们到处都是。问题是我没法回到工厂。我可靠的防身武器不止一次地派上了用场，但是很快我就发现我陷入了更加糟糕的问题。枪声引来了野蛮人，我相信不久他们就会发现我。我很抱歉让大家失望了。让大家知道我尽了最大的努力。……再见。

original: DLC01ProtectronTerminalNote01
translation: DLC01ProtectronTerminalNote01

original: In response to the increased number of Protectron related injuries, I've placed a bunch of generic employee IDs next to the Factory Protectron Pod. The thing doesn't know the difference anyway so, please, if you've forgot your ID, just use the ones on the table. Remember to return them before you leave for the day, I only have so many.\n\n- Management
translation: 鉴于由保护者造成的受伤事件不断增加，我放了几组普通员工的ID在工厂的保护者舱。反正那些铁家伙分不清它们有什么不同，所以，如果你忘记了你的ID，就用桌子上的这些吧。记得离开的时候把ID放回去，我只剩这些了。\n\n- 管理部

original: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote01
translation: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote01

original: There have been several complaints in the past couple of weeks regarding the new Factory Protectrons installed throughout the plant. Some of you feel this is the first step in the long process of phasing out the human aspect of the plant. Please be assured that this is not our intention. The new Protectrons are here only to protect you, the workers. Also, please remember to carry your ID with you at all times. The Protectrons are programmed to make sure those present in the plant are valid employees.\n\n- Management
translation: 在过去的几星期里，对于新布置在工厂里的保护者的抱怨层出不穷。你们中的一些人可能认为这是逐步淘汰工厂里的人类的开始。请相信这不是我们的本意。新的保护者只是用来保护你们的，工人们。不要忘记随身携带你们的ID。根据程序设定，保护者要确保只有经许可的员工出现在工厂里。\n\n- 管理部

original: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote03
translation: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote03

original: We've ordered three new Protectrons to be installed immediately in the plant. One will take the place of the recent Protectron that was destroyed by our very own employees, who, let me remind you, are now ex-employees. The other two will take their positions working on the assembly line.\n\n- Management
translation: 我们已经下令立刻把三台新的保护者布置在工厂里。其中一台用来替换最近被我们的员工（有必要提醒你，现在已经是前员工了）毁坏的那台保护者。另外的两台将会被安排在流水线上工作。\n\n- 管理部

original: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote02
translation: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote02

original: Those employees who recently took it upon themselves to incapacitate a Protectron with a bucket of water and sledgehammer have been dealt with and no longer work at the plant. Let this be a reminder to all employees. Those caught harassing and/or damaging the Factory Protectrons will be dealt with swiftly and severely.\n\n- Management
translation: 最近那些承认用水和大锤破坏保护者使之不能工作的员工已经被处分并将不会再为工厂工作了。让这件事给所有的员工们提个醒。那些被抓到骚扰或者破坏工厂保护者的员工将会受到严肃的处理。\n\n- 管理部

original: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote04
translation: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote04

original:
I brought it up with Management today that the men down at the plant aren't taking the new shipment of robots lightly. They fear losing their jobs and I don't blame them. It's my job to make sure morale stays high no matter what happens. It's hard to look each man in the eye and tell him that he has nothing to worry about even though I very well know he'll be unemployed in less than a month. I don't know how long I can continue to lie to these men.

Tom McMullin
Supply Plant Supervisor
translation:
我今天跟管理部提过，在下面工厂里的员工并没有放松对新运来的机器人的警惕。他们怕失去工作，我并没责怪他们。我的职责是不管发生了什么事都要保持员工的士气高昂。很难看着每个人的眼睛，告诉他们没有什么好担心的，尽管我非常清楚他们不到一个月就会失业。我不知道我还能骗这些人多久。

汤姆·麦克马林
供给厂监工

original: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote05
translation: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote05

original:
I've managed to delay a rather large shipment of Protectrons today. I told management that we've been having problems with the previous batch of robots and are not prepared for another batch anytime soon. This is complete bullshit of course, the robots work perfectly. They outperform our best worker by a factor of five. The men continue to lose morale day after day. Some blame me, but they don't understand that this is completely out of my hands. I am doing everything I can to help these men keep their jobs.

Tom McMullin
Supply Plant Supervisor
translation:
今天我设法推迟了一大批保护者的运送。我告诉管理部，之前一批机器人有很多问题，暂时还没有准备好接受新一批。当然这全都是胡扯。它们的工作做的很完美，比我们最好的工人还好上五倍。员工们的士气一天差过一天。有些人责怪我，但他们不知道这件事我说的完全不算。我正尽我所能保住他们的工作。

汤姆·麦克马林
供给厂监工

original: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote06
translation: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote06

original:
Management made a surprise visit to the plant today. I guess they stopped believing what I've been telling them about the robots not performing to standards. They saw first hand the speed and efficiency of the robots. Unfortunately, they also caught two employees in the act of tearing apart a Protectron and smashing it with a sledgehammer. I was to blame of course. The men are starting to believe I'm working closely with the managers and helping them in every way possible to save my own skin.

Tom McMullin
Supply Plant Supervisor
translation:
管理部今天突然视察了工厂。我猜他们不再相信我之前告诉他们关于机器人的表现没达标的事。他们亲眼看到了机器人工作的速度和效率。很不幸地，他们还抓到了两个正用大锤破坏保护者的员工。当然，我受到了指责。工人们开始认为我跟管理层是一伙的，并且用尽手段帮助他们以求自保。

汤姆·麦克马林
供给厂监工

original: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote07
translation: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote07

original:
News broke out today over the loud speakers that everyone needs to vacate the plant by 1 PM. "Due to budget cuts, this plant is shutting down." The men knew at once there was no budget cut. They ultimately decided I was to blame, having seniority in this section of the plant. As soon as I heard the news, I grabbed my pistol and made for the exit. It was quickly barricaded. I turned around and ran into this utility closet and locked the door behind me. I'll stay in here until the men go home.

Tom McMullin
Supply Plant Supervisor
translation:
今天大喇叭突然广播，所有人必须在下午1点前撤出工厂。“由于预算削减，工厂即将关闭。”工人们立刻意识到并没有预算削减这回事。他们最后认为应该找资历最老的我算账。一听到这个消息，我就抓起了手枪奔向出口。但路很快被堵上了。我四处躲藏，最后跑进了这间杂物室并锁上了身后的门。我将呆在这里直到工人们都回家了。

汤姆·麦克马林
供应厂监工

original: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote08
translation: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote08

original:
The men won't leave. They're determined to wait until I come out. Probably going to give me one hell of a beating, that I'm sure of. I wish they understood how hard I worked for them, how I used every opportunity to delay the inevitable. They better get going though, it's almost 1 PM. The robots will be here in a half hour, sooner if management hears of what's happening.

Tom McMullin
Supply Plant Supervisor
translation:
工人们没有离去，他们决定守在这里直到我出去。我敢肯定他们想要狠狠的揍我一顿。我希望他们知道我为了他们付出了多少，我是如何不放过每一个机会为他们推迟着迟早要发生的事情。他们最好快点离开，现在已经下午一点了，机器人会在半小时内到达。如果管理部门听说了这里的情况，他们会来得更早。

汤姆·麦克马林
供给厂监工

original: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote09
translation: DLC01SupplyPlantTerminalNote09

original:
I begged them to leave before the robots got here. They laughed and said they'd take care of the robots, it's me they wanted. Then came the familiar rattle of a Protectron. That got their attention. I soon heard laughter, cursing, and screaming down the hall. I opened the door and stepped outside. A couple of the workers burst around the corner screaming for help. A red laser lashed out from down the hall and severed Tim's right arm in two. I panicked and ran back into the closet and shut the door. The men slammed into the door and begged me to open it. I didn't say a word, just sat stunned, listening to their screams of agony as the robot finished them off one by one. Then silence. I put my ear to the door and listened. I heard the clanking of Protectron feet down the hall. I grabbed my pistol and backed away from the door. No way am I opening this door for anyone or anything! Whoever reads this, let it be known that I did everything in my power to keep everyone's job at the plant. And let this be an example of how not to replace humans with machines.

Tom McMullin
Supply Plant Supervisor
translation:
我求工人们在机器人到来之前离开。他们哈哈大笑，还说他们会收拾好机器人，他们想要的是我。接着传来了保护者那吱嘎作响的脚步声，这引起了他们的注意。紧接着我听到了从走廊尽头传来了笑声，咒骂声，和尖叫声。我打开了门，走了出去。工人们四散躲在角落里，大声呼救。一道红色激光从走廊尽头射来，把蒂姆的右臂切成了两段。我跑回了储藏室然后重新锁上了门，我吓坏了。工人们捶打着门求我把门打开。我一句话也没说，只是惊恐地坐着，听着他们痛苦的嚎叫，听着机器人一个一个地杀掉他们。接着外面静了下来，我把耳朵贴在门上倾听，听到了走廊里机器人的移动时发出的哐啷声。我紧握着手中的手枪，离门远远地。我绝对不会为任何人或者东西开门！不管是谁读到了这些，告诉人们我做了我所能做的一切来保住每一个人的工作。就当这是一个教训，告诉人们为什么不该用机器来代替人类。

汤姆·麦克马林
供给厂监工

original: Encrypted Telemetry Data
translation: 加密的遥测数据

original: Sector 2 Artillery Note
translation: 2区炮兵通知

original:
From Enclave High Command
Artillery Order #553
Sector 2

The Brotherhood of Steel have cleared the outer perimeter of the base. Clearance has been given to use artillery strikes on Sector 2 if, and only if, all other resources have been exhausted and targets are clearly visible. Exercise extreme caution.
translation:
来自英克雷最高指挥部
炮兵命令 #553
第2战区

钢铁兄弟会已经消灭了基地的外围。对第2战区使用炮击的清除令已被下达。假如，只是假如，在所有其他可用物资耗尽且各目标均清晰可见时发动。务必慎重。

original: Deathclaw Officer's Report
translation: 死亡爪官员的报告

original: Our detachment established basecamp outside Olney. The township's been given a wide berth, and we deployed our detainment units behind a slope to avoid being caught upwind of the deathclaw population. We're not sure if these things use pheromones or any other kind of communication, but I'm not taking a chance.
translation: 我们的分队在奥尔尼外建立了大本营。与镇区保持了距离，我们把拘留单位部署在斜坡后面，以免在死亡爪群的上风处被发现。我们不确定这些东西是用信息素，或是其他方式交流，但我不想冒险。

original: Deathclaw Outpost Orders
translation: 关于死亡爪的前哨指令

original:
RRD-HA23-P 
WELCOME: 

1. Establish a perimiter around township of Olney.

2. Verify reports of DEATHCLAW population in township and debrief superiors on your findings.

3. Acquire DEATHCLAW specimens as opportunity allows, minimizing casualties to local DEATHCLAW population and Enclave personnel.
translation:
RRD-HA23-P
欢迎：

1、在小镇奥尔尼附近建立一个大本营。

2、核实关于小镇中死亡爪群落的报告然后在你的调查报告中询问长官任务。

3、在情况允许的情况下抓获一只死亡爪作为标本，尽量减少当地死亡爪和人员伤亡。

original: Incident Report 08-07-07

Incident Report 08-07-77

Reporting Officer: Harold Callahan

Fire alarm was sounded at approximately 10:05 A.M. in the vending area near Cafeteria B3. I immediately rushed to the location and encountered General Robert Dobbs kicking a Nuka-Cola machine repeatedly. General Dobbs ignored my order to stand down from his actions and drew his sidearm. He then proceeded to fire 7 shots into the machine, rupturing several bottles and piercing the coin box. After the coins began pouring to the floor, he picked up one of them and exclaimed "Stealing from a superior officer? Are you out of your MIND, soldier?" He holstered his sidearm and looked at me, then back at the machine and simply stated, "Well don't just stand there, I believe this soldier needs a medic, son."
The general was relieved of his sidearm and placed in our lockup facility until Metro D.C. Police arrived to pick him up.
translation:
事件报告 08-07-77

报告官员：哈罗德·卡拉汉

上午10:05左右，B3自助餐厅附近的自动售货区响起火警警报。我立即赶往现场，发现罗伯特·多布斯将军正在反复踢一台核子可乐贩售机。多布斯将军无视我让他停止行动的命令，拔出随身武器。随后，他向机器开了7枪，打碎了几个瓶子，并击穿了投币箱。硬币倾泄了一地，他捡起了其中的一枚大喊道：“敢偷上级级军官的钱？你疯了么，士兵？”他收起他的佩枪并看着我，而后背对着贩售机轻描淡写的说，“别光在那站着，我认为这个士兵需要个医生，孩子。”
将军被解除了佩枪，并被关进了我们的拘留所，直到华盛顿特区警察将其带走。

original: Incident Report 08-16-07

Incident Report 08-16-77

Reporting Officer: Harold Callahan

Secretary Maybel Meyers from Accounting Division called us down here and reported an altercation between two other secretaries. Sergeant Deke DaSilva and I arrived at the scene to find two female secretaries, Carol Wallace and Isabelle Franks, scuffling on the floor. We broke up the altercation and took their statements. Ms. Wallace was accusing Ms. Franks of being a "...spy for those damn Red bastards!" and stating that she overheard "...secret conversations between Isabelle and her Chinese conspirators!" Ms. Franks simply stated she was "Speaking to her husband about weekend plans." Both ladies were given a warning and sent home for the day by their supervisors.

Tensions have been running high lately ever since the incidents in Alaska, and this is just one example of the effect it is having on everyone.
translation:
事件报告 08-16-77

报告官员：哈罗德·卡拉汉

会计部秘书梅布尔·梅耶斯打电话给我们，报告说另外两名秘书之间发生了口角。我和德克·达席尔瓦警官抵达现场时，发现两名女秘书卡罗尔·华莱士和伊莎贝尔·弗兰克斯在地板上扭打在一起。我们制止了争吵，并为她们做了笔录。华莱士女士指责弗兰克斯女士是“......那些该死的红色杂种的间谍！”并说她听到了“......伊莎贝尔和她的中国同谋之间的秘密谈话！”弗兰克斯女士只是说她“在和丈夫谈论周末计划”。两位女士都受到了警告，并被她们的主管送回了家。

自从阿拉斯加的事件发生后，最近气氛一直很紧张，这只是对每个人造成影响的一个例子。

original: Incident Report 08-22-07

Incident Report 08-22-77

Reporting Officer: Harold Callahan

A silent alarm tripped on Stairwell 117, and I immediately responded. As I approached the stairwell entrance, I heard noises as if someone was in duress. I drew my weapon and entered by kicking open the door. I discovered Ronald Bales from Intelligence and Analysis in a compromising position with Wilma Firestone, a secretary from the Accounting Division. I gave them both a warning, and told Mr. Bales that this is his fifth and final one... the next time he is discovered performing this type of activity on Pentagon property, he'll be fined and disciplinary action will be recommended.
translation:
事件报告 08-22-77

报告官员：哈罗德·卡拉汉

一个无声警报在第117楼梯井响了起来，我立即就去处理它。当我走近楼梯间入口时，我听到了嘈杂声，似乎有人受到了胁迫。我拔出武器，踢开门进入。我发现情报和分析部的罗纳德·贝尔斯正与会计部的秘书威尔玛·费尔斯通处于暧昧状态。我给了他们俩一个警告，并告诉贝尔斯先生，这是他的第五次，也是最后一次……下次再发现他在五角大楼的地盘上进行这种活动，他将被罚款，并建议对他进行纪律处分。

original: Museum Authority Log MA-0089
translation: 博物馆管理处日志 MA-0089

original: Museum Authority Log MA-0089\n\nRemmings over at the Museum of Technology is complaining again about the Planetarium system malfunctioning. I've replaced the playback unit on that thing 3 times now. Seems like the system keeps crashing and trying to restart itself, then crashes again... keeps repeating that cycle until it's completely rebooted. I suggest that we acquire a new type of system in next year's budget. The cost of replacing it now and fitting a new system is cheaper than the amount we've spent shoving in replacement parts.
translation: 博物馆管理处日志 MA-0089\n\n在科学博物馆的游客又在抱怨天文馆系统失灵了。我已经把那个回放单元替换过三次了。看来似乎系统依然会崩溃，并试图自动重启，然后再次崩溃...不断重复这种循环直到它完全重新启动。我建议在明年的预算里加入一项购买新系统的费用。相对于更换它重新安装一个新系统会便宜不少。

original: Museum Authority Log MA-0089
translation: 博物馆管理处日志 MA-0089

original: Museum Authority Log MA-0086\n\nBrantseg over at the National Archives is requesting a new brain software package for their "TJEFF002 Thomas Jefferson" Protectron. The original software was wiped and replaced with a radio uplink and frequency scanning software package which is simply receiving and broadcasting local radio stations. I suggest we encrypt the next brain package so this type of software purchase is not necessary.
translation: 博物馆管理处日志 MA-0086\n\n国家档案馆的布兰特赛格正在申请一个新的脑波软件包给他们的“TJEFF002 托马斯·杰斐逊”型保护者。原有的软件被删除并替换上了一个无线电上行链接及频率扫描软件包用以取代单向接收和发送本地的无线电站点的功能。我建议我们对以后的脑波数据包加密，所以这类软件是没有必要购买的。

original: Museum Authority Log MA-0089
translation: 博物馆管理处日志 MA-0089

original: Museum Authority Log MA-0085\n\nWe've logged a fourth request from Dr. Gillian Taylor over at the National Aquarium regarding a new tank she wishes to be constructed for her whale exhibition. I've already spoken to Director Barnicky, and he maintains that a new exhibit is out of the question and the current one is becoming far too expensive to maintain. Director Barnicky has already spoken to the San Francisco Aquarium, and they have agreed to begin construction of an appropriately sized tank and viewing area for Dr. Taylor's whales. He's also negotiated with that facility to have Dr. Taylor transferred, and I support this decision.
translation: 博物馆管理处日志 MA-0085\n\n我们已经记录第四个关于吉莉安·泰勒博士在国家水族馆建造新型水箱的要求了，她希望能进行鲸鱼展览。我已经和巴尼金主任谈过 ，他坚持认为，进行一个新的展览是不可能的因为当前的维护已经过于昂贵了。巴尼金主任已经和旧金山水族馆交涉过，他们已经同意开始建造一个适当大小的水箱用于展览泰勒博士的鲸。他已经工厂达成协议并移交泰勒博士，我支持这个决定。

original: Entry 1
translation: 记录 1

original: This place is a total disaster. Hopefully I’ll get this distribution system set up soon and I can get back to the Citadel. Shouldn’t take more than two weeks. I’ve already been in consultation with the Rivet City Council. They have tentatively agreed to take over the Water Distribution Network for us once we’ve worked out the kinks. Something tells me there’s going to be more than a few of those.
translation: 这个地方真是一团糟。真希望我能很快建立好配送系统然后回到大本营。完成这件事应该不会用到超过两周的时间。我已经和铆钉城议会开始磋商。他们初步决定在我们解决这个问题后接管供水管网，但是我感觉问题可不止这一点点。

original: Entry 2
translation: 记录 2

original: I think Rothchild is really upset with me this time. He sent me Scribes who apparently failed their Cartography training. I don’t have time for this.
translation: 我想罗斯查得这次是真对我失望了. 他送来的书记官明显连制图学都没过关. 我可没时间为这个磨叽.

original: Entry 3
translation: 记录 3

original: I’m getting practically no cooperation. Rothchild ignores my messages. And the Knights stuck with delivery duties are more than a little resentful. I don’t want to have to send them out anymore than they want to go.
translation: 我几乎得不到任何合作。罗斯查德无视我的信息。而那些负责送货的骑士们更是怨声载道，我不想再让他们去了。

original: Entry 4
translation: 记录 4

original: Dr. Li left today. Went up north to the Commonwealth. What a bitch. She couldn’t handle the fact that even these morons Rothchild sent me were capable of improving upon her work. It’s no wonder she never got the thing working without help in the first place. Anyway, to hell with Dr. Li. Good riddance.
translation: 李博士今天离开了。北上去了联邦。这个烂婊子。事实上她连罗斯查德送来的白痴都可以改善的工作都处理不了。难怪她一开始没有人帮她就做不好这东西。无论如何，去他娘的李博士。老子解放了。

original: Entry 5
translation: 记录 5

original: First casualty reported today. I know compared to the death tolls of the war it will barely register back at the Citadel. But still… I hate being responsible, even indirectly, for another man’s death. It brings back unpleasant memories.
translation: 今天第一份伤亡报告。我明白相比在战争中的死去的人数，这点伤亡几乎不会登记回大本营。但是我依然厌恶背负这责任，即使是间接的。它唤起了我不愉快的回忆。

original: Entry 6
translation: 记录 6

original: So many caravans missing in action. The Rivet City escorts I can understand. They haven’t had much blooding, holed up in that boat of theirs. Sure, I’ve gotten more Initiates than full fledged Knights, since it’s all hands in the war. But still, even a couple of heavily armed Initiates should be able to handle escorting a mule and driver across the wastes.
translation: 这么多运输队在行动中失踪了。我能理解铆钉城的押运队。躲在船里头的他们从来没见过那么多鲜血。当然，鉴于这种全面战争的状态，我手上的新兵比老练的骑士还多。但是即使是一队武装过的新兵也应该可以处理这点护送一队牲口和车夫穿越废土的小事啊。

original: Entry 7
translation: 记录 7

original:
So this Ghoul from Underworld, Griffon, offered to pay me for shipments of water. Lyons wouldn’t approve, but I don’t care. We need the caps and the technology he’s offering. I can use it to fund the other deliveries.

One day Lyons will come to his senses and agree that selling the water is the smartest thing. Let supply and demand fuel the delivery system. This bleeding heart charity of his is going to bring down the Brotherhood. We’re at war! We shouldn’t be expending resources on delivering water. At any rate, we can do that after we wipe out the Enclave. Sometimes I wonder if Lyons has gone senile.

I should delete this entry in case someone important audits my files. Ah, screw it. It might be time for me to leave the Brotherhood, anyway. Not sure where’d I go, though.
translation:
于是这个来着冥界的尸鬼，格里芬，提出花钱雇我运水。里昂斯不同意，不过我才不在乎。我们需要他提供的瓶盖还有科技。我可以用它来筹建另一支运输队。

终有一天里昂斯会明白并同意卖水是最明智的事。让供需来给运输系统增添动力。他的妇人之仁最终将会断送兄弟会。我们正处在战争时期！我们不该在送水的事情上耗费资源。至少，在我们可以在打垮英克雷之后再做。有时我纳闷里昂斯是不是老糊涂了。

我应该删除这个条目以防万一有什么大人物查我的帐。啊，该死的的。总之，或许是我该离开兄弟会的时候了。尽管我不知道自己该何去何从。

original: Entry 8
translation: 记录 8

original: I dno’t rember teh last time I slept for more than tihrty minutes. I’m so damn tired jkhkjkjsdfg sdfgssdfgsd ha. apparently I just nodded off and hit my face on the keyboard. I can’t take this anyomre!!!!11!!
translation: 我都不记得上次我睡够30分钟是哪辈子的事了。我真他妈的累死了jkhkjkjsdfg sdfgssdfgsd哈。看来我是打了个盹脸摔在键盘上了。我再也受不了啦！！！！11！！

original: Entry 9
translation: 记录 9

original: Where the hell is everyone? So many caravans still MIA.
translation: 每个家伙都死到哪里去了？如此多的商队依然音讯全无。

original: Entry 10
translation: 记录 10

original: Lepelletier keeps sending me dispatches requesting additional resources. I don’t have anything for her. Not sure they’ll be able to handle this water distribution after all. Great. I’ll be stuck here forever.
translation: 莱佩莱捷不断送信来向我索要额外的资源。我已经没什么东西好给她了。不知道他们到底能不能处理好这次供水计划。棒呆了。我要永远困死在这儿了。

original: Entry 11
translation: 记录 11

original: I'm ignoring Megaton's requests for more water until I can determine what the hell happened. The caravan reported in, successful. I have no reason to doubt the report.
translation: 在我确定到底发生了什么事之前，我不会理会兆吨镇要更多水的要求。旅队都报告了，事办成了。我没有理由怀疑这份报告。

original: Heard that the kid who helped start the Purifier finally woke up.

original: Entry 13

original: I think Lyons suspects something. He must have a plant here. How the hell would he know about the “missing” water shipments? I’ve been stonewalling him. How the hell does he have time to worry about us with that war going on?
translation: 我认为里昂斯在怀疑着什么。他必须得在这有个工厂。他到底是怎么知道运水货物失踪的破事的？我一直被他碍手碍脚。到底要怎么搞才能让那老鬼有时间去继续操心我们和战争的事？

original: Entry 14
translation: 记录 14

original: I’m seriously considering murdering these Project Purity lab coats. Ungrateful, whining, good-for-nothing, bothersome ingrates the lot of them.
translation: 我曾经考虑过干掉所有参与“净水工程”的研究员。这群忘恩负义，牢骚满腹，又没出息，又烦死人的白痴。

original: Entry 15

original: I wish somebody would fix that damn leak! The dripping is driving me crazy!
translation: 我希望有人能去修修那个漏洞! 滴水声都快把我逼疯了!

original: Entry 16
translation: 记录 16

original: I give up. This is hopeless.
translation: 我放弃。没希望了。

original: Entry 17

original: Wow… Megaton’s gone. I know I was complaining about them… but, all those people! Erased in a single moment in time… I can't imagine.
translation: 哇噢，兆吨镇消失了。我记得我曾经埋怨过他们……但是，所有人! 一瞬间全被核谐了……真是无法想象。

original: DLC03PresMetroMaintNote01
translation: DLC03PresMetroMaintNote01

original: Mechanic: D.T.\n\nWe're still having a bit of trouble getting the new SYL-02 Xoted Mainframe adapted to our train drive systems down here. It's going to take another 72 hours to get it fully up and running. I've been pulling triple shifts for the last two days already AND the supervisors are constantly on our backs blaming us for the delays when THEY bought an incompatible system. I wish that I could get to sleep and just get this over with...this is only high school bullshit. I'm lost, I'm freaking and everybody knows... everybody's watching.
translation: 机械师：D.T.\n\n我们在使新的SYL-02 Xoted主机适配这里的列车驱动系统方面仍有一些问题。还需要72个小时才能完全运行。在过去的两天里，我一直都是三班倒，而主管们却一直在背后指责我们，说我们买了一个不兼容的系统，却造成了延误。我真希望能好好睡一觉，把这一切都解决了……这简直就是高中生的胡闹。我崩溃了了，我吓坏了，每个人都知道……每个人都在看。

original: DLC03PresMetroMaintNote02
translation: DLC03PresMetroMaintNote02

original: Mechanic: D.T.\n\nThe switch track over between Adams Air Force Base and the White House main line is sticking again. I've dispatched a crew to repair it. I expect the line to be down no more than maybe a day. We can shunt all the trains to the alternate inbound line and just run them on half schedule or something for now. Just a suggestion.
translation: 机械师：D.T.\n\n亚当斯空军基地和白宫主干线之间的轨道转换又出问题了了。我派了一组工作人员去修理。我预期线路将在一天之内恢复通畅。现在我们可以分流所有列车入站的备用线并让他们按照列车时刻表的半数运行或诸如此类的临时举措。这只是我的一个建议。

original: DLC03PresMetroMaintNote03
translation: DLC03PresMetroMaintNote03

original: Mechanic: D.T.\n\nAfter debating for a few days, the powers that be have decided to change out the vocal interface on the Xoted Mainframe from male to female. Why? So they can give it a cute acronym and name it "Margot." Then they can trot it around for the press so we can all see where our hard-earned taxpayer dollars went. Wow, what a colossal waste of my time. Now I have to pull the mainframe's circuit array and flush the memory all to get a new voice installed... great, just great.
translation: 机械师：D.T.\n\n经过几天的讨论，当局决定将Xoted主机上的发声界面从男性改为女性。为啥呢？这样他们就能给它取个可爱的缩写并命名为“玛格特”。然后他们就可以在媒体上大肆宣扬，让我们都看看，我们辛辛苦苦挣来的纳税人的钱都花到哪儿去了。哇哦，真是浪费我的时间。现在，我不得不抽出主机电路阵列并清除内存以安装新的音频界面…太棒了，真是太棒了。

original: DLC03PresMetroMaintNote04
translation: DLC03PresMetroMaintNote04

original: Mechanic: D.T.\n\nOh, today was a beauty. I was called up to the Senatorial Lounge near the White House station and someone decided to make a political statement by spray painting graffiti all over the walls inside the Lounge containing more than a fair share of Chinese racial slurs. They must have broken in while it was closed and did the damage. Hooray for security... they really dropped the ball on this one. Never send a robot to do a man's job I say. I spent the better part of the day scrubbing walls clean of that filth and installing new fixtures. Joy.
translation: 机械师：D.T.\n\n嗷，今天真是个好日子。我被叫到白宫站附近的参议员休息室，因为某人决定发表政治声明，在休息室的墙壁上到处喷涂涂鸦，其中不乏对中国人的种族诽谤。他们一定是趁休息室关门的时候闯进去搞破坏的。为安保叫好……他们在这件事上真的掉链子了。我说，永远不要派机器人去做人类的工作。我花了大半天时间把墙壁上的脏东西擦干净并安装了新设备。喜悦。

original: DLC03PresMetroMaintNote05
translation: DLC03PresMetroMaintNote05

original: Mechanic: D.T.\n\nWe got the new Sentinel Unit up and running today. Pretty bad-ass. Not only does it have maintenance capability, so I can remote command it to do repairs, but it also is a great riot suppression unit... we can use it if we ever have any protesters break in down here again. Finally, a worthwhile addition to the robot fleet.
translation: 机械师：D.T.\n\n我们今天启动了新的哨兵单位。漂亮的坏家伙。它不但有维修能力，我能远程操作它进行维修工作，而且还是一个强大的镇暴单位…如果再有抗议者闯入这里，我们就可以用它了。终于，机器人舰队又添一员猛将了。

original: DLC03CommsTransfer
translation: DLC03CommsTransfer

original:
Hey downstairs - 

This new guy you sent to help out is awful. I mean, he can barely tie his shoes. This is advanced technical equipment up here, and I can't have him work on it. He'll probably end up accidentally calling an orbital strike down on the base or something.

Here's an idea - how about you send the guy that cleans the toilets up here and I can give him the job instead. Is it really that hard to find decent help?
translation:
嘿，楼下的 -

你派来的那个新伙计真是太糟糕了。我的意思是，他甚至都没办法绑好自己的鞋带。我这儿是先进技术部门，我可不能让他继续在这儿工作。他很可能一不小心就搞出像让卫星轨道炮发射摧毁这儿或者别的类似的事情。

我有个主意 - 不如你派他去扫厕所怎样?而你再给我再找个能工作的人来替代。这是个两全其美的法子吧？

original: DLC03CommsSatelliteEquip
translation: DLC03CommsSatelliteEquip

original:
Hey downstairs, it's me again - 

Are we ever going to get a tech up here to work on this satellite tracking equipment? I swear it's offline every couple of days, and then it's literally hours of work before I have the system online and linked up to the satellite again.

This is ridiculous.
translation:
嘿，楼下的，又是我 -

到底什么时候在这个卫星追踪设施里我们才能得到一个真正的技术人员？我发誓这玩意儿每两三天就自动离线一次，然后我就得把所有的工作时间花在把系统重新联线到卫星上。

真是荒谬。

original: DLC03CommsMentatsAbuse
translation: DLC03CommsMentatsAbuse

original:
Guys - 

Strike two. This is the second dimwit you've sent up here, and I'm getting tired of it. I thought he was ok at first, but by lunchtime his Mentats had worn off and he could barely hold a conversation let alone work on a satellite control terminal. I can't have a junkie up here spacing out as soon as his pills wear off.

Fix this.
translation:
伙计 -

俩混球了。这已经是你扔到这里的第二个蠢蛋了, 我已经开始烦这套了。一开始我还觉得他蛮不错的，没想到还没等到吃午饭他的曼他特药效就过了，之后他连正常说话都办不到更别说一个人好好待在卫星通讯终端上工作了。我不能忍受一个瘾君子待在我这里，在他的药瘾彻底戒掉前把他带了滚。

快搞定这破事。

original: DLC03CommsRobots
translation: DLC03CommsRobots

original:
ROBOTS ARE FREAKING OUT! - 

About fifteen minutes ago, all of the robots in the place just went haywire and started attacking everyone. The guards and the new guy managed to lock them in the storage area, but we need someone up here to sort them out immediately.

What's going on down there anyway?
translation:
该死的机器人！ -

大约十五分钟前，所有位置上的机器人突然出现故障并开始攻击所有人。警卫和新来的伙计设法把他们锁在了储藏区，但我们需要有人马上把机器人问题彻底解决掉。

究竟发生了什么事情？

original: Obadiah's Letter to Marcella
translation: 奥巴代亚写给玛塞拉的信

original:
Marcella - 

I'm not imagining it; they're getting closer with each passing night. The dogs are gone - or taken for sacrifice, more like. I don't like to rely on superstition to keep them at bay, but there's no way I can fight them off if they take a mind to attack my home.

I don't know who else to turn to, Marcella. I'm skeptical, but I think we may be able to trust this outsider to help.

Obadiah
translation:
玛塞拉 - 

我不是在幻想；每过一个夜晚，它们就会靠近一些。那些狗不见了-- 更像是被拿去献祭了。我不喜欢靠迷信来驱赶它们，但如果它们想袭击我的家，我也没办法。

我不知道还能找谁，玛塞拉。我很怀疑，但我想我们也许可以相信这个外来者能帮上忙。

奥巴代亚

original: Mission Parameters
translation: 任务内容

original:
Bysshe Energy Partners has authorized Natural Gas Survey project MD-16-001 to perform field research. Private Contractor Caroline Saunders shall be present as Principal Geological Chemist on behalf of Bysshe Natural Gas Co. Local authorization for this expedition is granted in agreement with the Isla Negra Real Estate company, with representatives located locally.

Principal Chemist Saunders is to take multiple soil samples and report on concentration of natural gas resources. Her spoken authorization signature will be needed on at least three Survey Sites to conduct further research in this area. Should these authorizations be granted, use this terminal to access expeditionary supplies to continue data gathering while Bysshe Co. extraction crews are assembled.

Intern Research Assistants:
Lovett, K
Roach, M
Rourke, L
Antwon, P
translation:
彼希能源伙伴公司已授权天然气勘查项目MD-16-001进行实地研究。私人承包商卡洛琳·桑德斯将作为首席地质化学家，并代表彼希天然气公司。经与黑岛地产公司（该公司在当地设有代表）协商，本次考察获得当地授权。

首席化学家桑德斯将采集多个土壤样本，并报告天然气资源的浓度。她至少需要在三个勘测点签署口头授权，以便在该地区开展进一步研究。如果这些授权获得批准，则在彼希公司的开采人员集结完毕后，使用该终端获取远征补给，以继续收集数据。

实习研究助理：
洛维特，K
罗奇，M
罗克，L
安特温，P

original: USN DIA Field Report
translation: 美国国防情报局现场报告

original: Local community informants provided intelligence leading to the capture and arrest of a priority person of interest, Wan Yang, aka Five Claw Dragon. Yang is on file with DIA as a Chinese Intelligence field agent, operating within America and Canada over the past decade. Yang has been transferred to Turtledove Detention Camp for interrogation. Our office has so far declined comments to press and diplomats. Please have DoD relations advise regarding a public statement.
translation: 当地社区线人提供的情报帮助抓获并逮捕了一名重点关注人员，即杨婉，又名“五爪龙”。杨作为一名在国防情报局在案的中国情报外勤特工，过去十年来一直在美国和加拿大境内活动。杨已被转移到斑鸠拘留营接受审讯。到目前为止，我们的办公室拒绝向媒体和外交官发表评论。请国防部关系处就公开声明提出建议。

original: Spy Extraction Details
translation: 间谍脱身详情

original:
>>TRANSMIT BEGIN>>
Agent JIANG receive automated correspondence of Chinese Intelligence Ministry.

Remote Positive of Mission Parameters Satisfactory. 

Orbital intelligence verifies SSN-37-1A termination

Please note following from intelligence officer AGENT_ID_UNAVAIL.
/////////////////
"Agent, if you're receiving this message, then our satellites have registered the destruction of your objective. Well done. Please report to my personal bunker, hidden among the grounds of Calvert Mansion. Coordinates have been provided with this transmission. 

The bunker entrance is hidden, of course. Your pair of Cryptochromatic Spectacles have been hidden in the water tank of the toilet in your safehouse. Retrieve them if you haven't already. Here is the sequence code to unlock the bunker:

1 3 2 3 4 4 2

Once inside, the Passphrase is : Seraphim Descending". I look forward to congratulating you personally, agent.
<<<TRANSMIT END<<
translation:
>>传送开始>>
江特工收到了来自中国情报部的自动通信。

远程确认到任务参数满足。

轨道情报核实SSN-37-1A终止。

请注意以下来自情报官员AGENT_ID_UNAVAIL的信息。
/////////////////
“特工，如果你收到了这条信息，那么我们的卫星已经记录到你的目标被摧毁。干得好，请到我隐藏在卡尔弗特公馆地下的私人堡垒报到。坐标已随此传输发送。

当然，地堡的入口是隐藏的。你的那副加密光谱眼镜被藏在安全屋厕所的水箱里。如果还没拿到，就去取出来。下面是解锁地堡的顺序密码：

1 3 2 3 4 4 2

进入后，口令是：撒拉弗降临”。我期待亲自向你表示祝贺，特工。
<<<传送结束<<

original: In compliance with our our parent company, Isla Negra Holdings, we are installing a new security system for our safety-deposit customers. In addition to conventional tumbler locks, the new system will offer a keyless voice-recognition lock alternative.\n\nTellers are asked to encourage both existing and new safety-deposit customers to sign up for this new service.

Civil Defense has asked us to be especially vigilant of customers possessing Chinese Yuan notes. Should you encounter such a customer, trigger the silent alarm and attempt to delay the customer without arousing their suspicion.
translation: 所有出纳都要注意，当顾客要求兑换外币的时候要特别留心。民防部门要求我们特别警惕持有人民币纸币的客户。如果你遇到这样的客户，请触发无声警报，并尝试在不引起客户怀疑的情况下拖延时间。

original: Shift Close Notes
translation: 换班记录

original:
Shift Closing Notes 10/18/77
________________________
Several Large-sum wire transfers today. We need to notify the feds in the AM.

You'll need to replenish large bills. Payday is coming up.

Another complaint about the voice-activated locks in the safety-deposit room. Dorothy came in to fetch Bern's will and we couldn't get the box open because his voice was the only one configured for authorization. I figure it's a long shot, but I told Dorothy to go home and see if she has any holotapes or such of Bern talking. We might get lucky and fool the lock into opening if we play it back in there.
translation:
交班记录 10/18/77
________________________
今天有好几笔大额电汇。我们需要赶在上午完成工作。

你需要补充大量现金。快要到发薪日了。

又有人投诉保险箱室的声控锁了。多萝西来取伯尔尼的遗嘱，但是我们没有声音的认证无法打开门。我估计这不是立马就能解决的，但我还是叫她回家找找，看能否发现录着他声音的磁带。把它拿到这里来播放，如果走运的话，或许我们能骗过声控系统，把门弄开。

original: New Plague Pamphlet

original:
The New Plague and YOU
Copyright and Distributed by Presidential Fitness Program 2059

Know the Signs!
Safeguard yourself and your community by knowing how to identify a person suffering from the New Plague. Common symptoms include:
* Profuse Sweating
* Unexplained Contusions/Swelling
* Massive External Hemorrhaging
* New Ideals, such as socialism

When you believe you’ve come into contact with a person exhibiting one or more or these tell-tale signs, remember to C I R:

C - Confirm Symptoms. 
 Approach the person suffering from symptoms if no Civil or Medical professional is available to do so. Verify that the subject is exhibiting symptoms of New Plague.

I - Isolate!
 Once it’s been established that a case of New Plague may be present, separate yourself and the person exhibiting symptoms from the general population, as the New Plague is notoriously contagious.

R - Report! 
 Report directly to the nearest Federal Fitness Registry of Medical Center and let the professionals handle it from there!

Protect Yourself!
The New Plague is what’s commonly known as a “social disease”. This means that the New Plauge is especially contagious and can be commonly caught in the course of social interactions such as:
* Ice Cream Socials
* Cruising Main Street
* Promiscuous Activity/Sodomy
* Attending Fairs or Festivals

So; what’s the best protection against social diseases? Why not stay home and enjoy a novel or home-cooked meal? Limiting your exposure to other individuals is the best and more surefire way to avoid contracting the New Plague.

Get Registered!
Did you know that your government can protect you from the New Plague and other biological dangers? It’s true, and all you need to do is visit your local Federal Fitness Registry. Friendly Federal Professionals will be on hand to take a few minor samples and enter you in the national registry.

Your compliance with the Federal Registry Program not only keeps medical professionals up-to-date on your medical history and status, but contributes to valuable research programs - and makes you eligible for special prizes, such as fuel rations or vacations to exotic domestic locales!

你与新瘟疫
版权与发布权属于2059总统健康计划

了解如何识别新瘟疫患者，从而保护自己和社区。常见症状包括：
* 大量出汗
* 不明原因的挫伤/肿胀
* 大量外伤出血
* 新理想，如社会主义

一旦你认为你遇见了一个或更多具有以上症状的人，请记住C I R：

C - 确认症状。
 如果没有民事或医疗专业人员，则接近出现症状的人。确认患者是否表现出新瘟疫症状。

I - 隔离！

新瘟疫通常被称为“社会病”。这意味着新瘟疫的传染性特别强，在社交活动中很容易感染，例如
* 冰淇淋社交活动

* 乱交/鸡奸
* 参加集市或节庆活动

来登记吧！
你知道政府可以保护你免于遭受瘟疫或是其他生物疾病的威胁么？这是真的，你所需要做的就是去你当地的联邦健康登记处。热情的联邦专家们将会为你提取一些样本，并帮你成功登入国家信息系统。

original: Victoria was badly wounded today. She took a truck of supplies out to the Ark & Dove Cathedral beyond the river. original:
Michaelson,

I know that this facility was built to withstand the unique pressures of suboceanic earthen construction, but recently I have had a few concerns about the integrity of the initial work. My staff have noticed more than a few leaks without logical source and it has a number of them very nervous and I have to say, I share their apprehension. 

Grohlman at the facilities office assures me that the pumps and pressure regulators will keep this facility dry and clean for hundreds of years on their internal batteries, but given his history with this sort of thing, I'm not exactly comforted by his claims. I am hoping that you can find an inspector with the proper clearances to give us an independent evaluation of the lab. An outside certification will make us all feel better.

Thanks,

Dr. Stewart
translation:
麦克尔森,

我知道，这设备的建立是为了抵挡海底土制建筑的压力，但是最近我开始关心起了初期工程的完整性。我的工作人员发现了不止一处泄漏，而且找不到原因，这让他们很担心。而且我得说，我和他们一样。

设备办公室的格罗尔曼向我保证，那些泵和压力调节器以它们目前的电量，足以确保这设备几百年的干燥清洁；但是考虑到他的出事记录，我对这样的说法并不太相信。我希望你可以找到一个有足够权威的调查者，对我们的实验室进行一次独立的评估。相信一位外来的专家会令我们感觉好点。

谢谢，

斯图尔特博士

original:
To All Level Seven Assistants,

It has been brought to my attention that a number of you have been conversing with test subjects during your off hours. This is a reminder that any attempts at social engagement with clinical participants is a violation of facility rule 47. Social interaction interferes with the cerebral infusion, and can cause a number of potential problems once the procedure reaches completion. 

So, once again. Do not speak to participants and be sure to limit any internal monologue to the list found in section 2.3 of your procedure guides when in their presence. I have little patience for shenaniganery.

Dr. Stewart
translation:
致所有的第七级助手们，

我已经注意到你们中的一些人总是在休息时间偷偷跟实验对象聊天。我必须提醒大家，任何与临床试验对象进行的社交活动，都违反了本设施的规章第47条。人际交流会干涉大脑内的注入物，可能会在进程即将结束时引发潜在问题。

所以，我再次申明，不要和实验对象说话，还有在有实验对象在场的情况下，尽量不要提及工序手册上2、3部分所说的内容。我对你们的欺骗已经没有任何耐心了。

斯图尔特博士

original: DLC04LabTerminalExperementNOTE01
translation: DLC04LabTerminalExperementNOTE01

original:
By using the data that we collected from the researchers at General Atomics at the close of the Robobrain Project, we've been able to fully mimic the brain suspension and isolation technique that makes the Robobrains function. 

What's better: we've make some interesting advances. It turns out that by manipulating the composition of the biomed gel, we are able to produce a number of effects that were previously thought to be impossible. 

It seems that Dr. Stewart was right. Under the right conditions, a subject not only retains full mental capacity, but can project limited images and even thoughts to other minds when the correct conditions are introduced in the biomed suspension. (Details on this composition can be found in Research Archive 51, Section B) This has profound implications for applications from battlefield technology to civilian criminal interrogation. 

Although, one must wonder if years of isolation in a biogel suspension would eventually introduce psychological abnormalities. This merits further study once the full breadth of the current research is explored.
translation:
我们在脑控机器人工程的末期，从来自美国通用原子公司的研究员那里收集了一些数据。通过这些数据，我们能够充分地模仿大脑避震和离析技术，这也正是脑控机器人的工作原理。

更好的是：我们取得了一些有趣的进展。通过操纵生物医学凝胶的成分，我们能制造出一些原先不敢想象的效果。 

看来斯图尔特博士是对的。在适当的条件下，实验对象不仅能保持完整的心理能力，而且在医用缓冲液状态合适的情况下，它还能向其他思想传输有限的图像甚至是思想。（关于这一组成的细节情况可以在研究档案51的B部分找到）这对战争科技乃至罪犯审讯技术都会产生深远的影响。

然而，依然有问题的是，长期隔绝在医用缓冲液内，可能会使得一个人产生心理上的异常。当研究达到了这样的程度时，这个课题值得继续探究。

original: DLC04LabTerminalExperementNOTE02
translation: DLC04LabTerminalExperementNOTE02

original:
Despite the early stage of our research, Dr. Stewart has informed us that Senator Calvert is demanding a full report on our work immediately. It seems that he is sending his brother, a noted researcher in the field of cognitive robotic, to this very lab in order to participate in our study and assist us with the report.

I have to say, I hesitate to show our work to anyone outside the lab. It's still very early and very unstable. It will be decades before we can be sure that the cognitive broadcast technology is stable, let alone ready for implementation.

Perhaps Dr. Stewart can hold off the arrival of Professor Calvert for a few more months. At least that would give us some time to come to better conclusions.
translation:
尽管我们之前的研究已经取得了一定的阶段性成果，斯图尔特博士通知我们，卡尔弗特议员需要一份关于我们目前工作的完整的报告书。看起来他准备派他的兄弟来，他是一位在机器人认知学方面声名卓著的研究者。而且他会带着这份报告来到我们这里参与并指导工作的。

我不得不说我有点犹豫是不是要把我们的进展向这个实验室以外的人透露，现在它还只是初现雏形，而且很不稳定。我们需要数十年的时候才能确定认知广播技术是否稳定，更不要说完成这项工程了。

或许斯图尔特博士可以使得卡尔弗特迟来几个月。至少那可以让我们得出更稳妥的结论。

亨特又在B审讯室跟那个幸存的中国间谍艇员谈了一阵子，海军正试图打捞潜艇。对于一个相对低级的士兵来说，他所表现得异乎寻常的不屈不挠。不得不说中国训练出的军人都是好样的。我相信如果他臼齿里的氰化物胶囊没有失效的话，他现在早就跟他的艇长一个下场了。


亨特申请了B级审讯许可，所以我早晨得去趟匡蒂科把这事儿搞定。

original: USN DIA Field Report
translation: 美国国防情报局现场报告

original:
Federal Agencies have added a new person of interest to our watch list. 

Doctor Jiang is a Chinese National defector. Naturalization agents in Norfolk processed his defection after jumping over from a merchant ship he was stowed away on. Jiang was apparently in communication with a US Naval Intelligence contact for some months prior. He's reportedly brokered an immunity deal in exchange for his help recovering intelligence from the downed submarine off our coast.
 
Jiang is staying in room 1D at the Homestead Motel off the boardwalk. We're explicitly forbidden from issuing a search warrant against this location, but are authorized to monitor his activities in public.
translation:
联邦机构在我们的监视名单上添加了一个新嫌疑人。

江博士是一名中国籍叛逃者。他是从一艘商船上偷渡过来的，诺福克的归化局为其办理了手续。显然，江在几个月前就与美国海军情报局的一名联络人进行了联系。据报道，他促成了一项豁免权交易，作为交换，他将帮助从我国海岸附近被击落的潜艇上获取情报。
 
江住在木栈道边的如家汽车旅馆1D房间。我们被明令禁止对该住处签发搜查令，但我们有权在公共场合监视他的活动。

original: Brenner observed suspicious activity after lights out yesterday. Prisoners apparently snuck into morgue overnight. He had the good sense not to apprehend them before reporting the event. We've known for some time about a septic runoff access point in the basement which would be a good candidate for escapees. The runoff flows southwest of the camp about a quarter of a mile or so. \n\nWe'll keep a low profile about this and post guards in the area. They could make their break any night. Meanwhile I'll try and find an excuse to send somebody down there and check it out without arousing suspicion. I'd rather catch them in the act.
translation: 布伦纳发现昨天熄灯后有可疑活动。显然有囚犯连夜潜入停尸房。他很理智，没有在上报前逮捕他们。我们早就知道地下室有一个化粪池径流入口，很可能是越狱犯的藏身之处。径流流经营地西南方约四分之一英里处。\n\n我们会对此保持低调并派往这一区域加派安保。他们可能说不定哪天晚上就会逃走的。同时我会试着找个借口派人下去调查一下，而又不引起他们的怀疑。我想，最好是能将他们当场抓获。

original: DLC05UnderwoodNote01
translation: DLC05UnderwoodNote01

original: Log Entry 4-11-2063\n\nThey think we're stupid; that we have no idea what they're up to. But we know. Barbed wire topped fences and security cameras be damned! We'll get the truth to come out if it's the last thing we do! The Conspiracy has to end, and we will be the ones who drag it from the shadows and cast it into the spotlight for all to see. They deny everything. They deny the place even exists! But here we are, faced with armed guards who patrol the dunes and robotic sentries calculating our every move. They're careful, but not careful enough. I've found a loophole, a way in, and I mean to exploit it soon.
translation: 日志条目 4-11-2063\n\n他们觉得我们愚蠢，以为我们对他们的勾当一无所知。但我们心里清楚。顶上有带刺铁丝的围栏和监控摄像头都见鬼去吧！哪怕这是我们做的最后一件事，也要让真相大白！这场阴谋必须终结，而我们将把它从阴影中拖出，置于众目睽睽的聚光灯下。他们否认一切，甚至否认那个地方的存在！可我们就在这儿，面对在沙丘上巡逻的武装警卫，还有时刻算计着我们一举一动的机器哨兵。他们小心翼翼，但还不够小心。我找到了一个漏洞，一条进去的路，而且打算尽快利用它。

original: DLC05UnderwoodNote02
translation: DLC05UnderwoodNote02

original: Log Entry 4-15-2063\n\nWe've done it! We have it in our hands! The smoking gun... the evidence we need to prove that everything they've told the world is a lie! Now let's try to see them weasel their way out of this one and make petty excuses. The only reason they've been so successful this long is because of the lack of proof on our part. Now that's all over. As soon as the coast is clear, we're bringing this thing to the press. But for now, we need to lay low. No telling how long it'll take before they discover how we did it.
translation: 日志条目 4-15-2063\n\n我们做到了！弄到手了！这就是实锤……能证明他们向全世界所宣称的一切皆为谎言的证据！现在，且看他们这次如何开脱，找些微不足道的借口。长久以来，他们之所以能得逞，只是因为我们拿不出证据。现在，一切都结束了。一旦情况安全，我们就把这东西交给媒体。但眼下，我们得低调行事。谁也说不准，他们要多久才能发现我们是如何得手的。

original: DLC05UnderwoodNote03
translation: DLC05UnderwoodNote03

original: Log Entry 4-16-2063\n\nThey're closing in! How did they find out? What did we miss? I thought we'd covered our tracks, but there must be something we'd forgotten. The security logs were completely erased, the inventory files were rewritten... that only leaves Doctor Morley! That bastard! He approached us saying he wanted to crack The Conspiracy wide open, and all the while he was playing us like fools! He just wanted to expose us, to bring us out into the open so they could eliminate us! Well, it's not going to work! They'll never find us and they'll never get their hands on the item!
translation: 日志条目 4-16-2063\n\n他们在步步紧逼！他们怎么发现的？我们遗漏了什么？我以为我们已经抹去了所有踪迹，但肯定还是疏忽了什么。安全日志已被彻底删除，库存文件也已重写……那就只能是莫利博士了！那混蛋！他主动找上我们，说想将这场阴谋彻底揭露，可自始至终都把我们当傻瓜耍！他就是想暴露我们，把我们引出来，好让他们将我们一网打尽！哼，这不会得逞的！他们永远找不到我们，也永远别想拿到那件东西！

original: DLC05UnderwoodNote04
translation: DLC05UnderwoodNote04

original: Log Entry 5-01-2063\n\nBanks is dead. Combs is dead. I'm the only member of Quaere Verum left. I'm not certain how much longer I'll be safe here. I'm placing the item inside a specially constructed safe with a remote lock trigger. It'll take a damn genius hacker to get into this terminal and the safe can withstand anything they throw at it. Tomorrow I take the terminal and the safe, and I'm going to bury it out in the desert where they'll never find it. Hopefully, one day, someone else will discover the item and realize that they hold the key to unlocking the truth. All they need to do is succeed where we have failed. Good luck to us all.
translation: 日志条目 5-01-2063\n\n班克斯死了。库姆斯也死了。我是“探寻真相”组织仅剩的成员。我不确定自己还能在这儿安全多久。我要把这件东西放进一个特制的保险箱，它带有远程锁扣装置。得是个天才黑客才有可能侵入这个终端，而且这保险箱能抵御他们使出的任何手段。明天我会带上终端和保险箱，把它们埋在沙漠里，让他们永远找不到。希望有朝一日，其他人能发现这件东西，意识到自己掌握着揭开真相的钥匙。他们只需在我们失败的地方取得成功就行。愿我们所有人都好运。

original: MPLX "Novasurge" Prototype Plasma Pistol
translation: MPLX“新星涌动” 原型等离子手枪

original:
Project Name: MPLX (Military Plasma Experimental) "Novasurge"
Item: Prototype Plasma Pistol
Section: A61
Dept. Head: Doctor Aldwin Morley
Report Number: 040663-02

The Novasurge has proven to be a tough nut to crack. The output is still very high, causing massive injury to targets, but it's drawing far too much power from its energy cells. We also need to get the weight down on the weapon, as it's a bit heavy for a simple replacement sidearm. The problem still seems to be the coolant coils which are accounting for almost 50% of the weapon's weight. The good news is that the housing for the weapon has been approved, and this is likely the final design. Unfortunately, I need to increase our staff's hours to 7 days a week again so we can have the final prototype ready for testing by the end of the year.
translation:
项目名称：MPLX（军用等离子实验）“新星涌动”
物件：原型等离子手枪
部门：A61
部门负责人：奥尔德温·莫利博士
报告编号：040663-02

事实证明，新星涌动是一颗难处理的钉子。输出功率仍很高，能对目标造成重创，但从能量电池中汲取的能量过多。我们还需要减轻武器的重量，因为它作为一款简易替换副武器来说太重了。问题似乎仍出在冷却液线圈上，那几乎占据了武器重量的50%。好消息是，武器的外壳已经获批准，这很可能是最终设计。不幸的是，我又得增加我们人员的工作时间，一周工作7天，这样我们能在年底前准备好最终原型，以供测试。

translation: 那玩意把它们的四肢从身子上卸了下来。你能做一个对人也有效的吗？

translation: 只要把你办公室的钥匙和密码交给我，我就会离开。

translation: 你说服我了。交出你的密码，剩下的路我自己走。

translation: 好吧，我们按你的方式来做。<给他你的武器>

translation: 哈里斯老爹似乎不太开心。

original: Doesn't that make you all cousins?
translation: 是不是说你们都是堂兄妹？

translation: 不，我是说，太亲近了。

original: I guess there are worse things.
translation: 我想这很糟。

translation: 这些家庭看起来太亲近了。

translation: 我来自一个地下避难所，女士。相信我，这地方真烂。

translation: 你知道的，他们似乎有点“疯狂”……

translation: 我还没跟除你之外的其他人聊过。他们都还好说话吗？

translation: 我不知道，这看起来是个挺好的地方。

translation: 是啊……算了吧。我不会碰你的任何东西。

translation: 嗯，见到你很高兴，开膛手“杰克”。

translation: 我想我恐怕弄丢了我的地理测绘仪……

original: As long as the caps flow, you'll get your maps.
translation: 只要给瓶盖不断，你就能拿到地图。

original: Done deal. I'll locate as many as I can for you.
translation: 成交。我会努力找寻更多新地点。

original: What's been happening since you've been back?
translation: 你们回来后都发生了什么？

original: Yeah, I think I'm hurt.
translation: 嗯，我想我受伤了。

translation: MS03RCHistory2Special

original: Rescue Red.

translation: 和莫伊拉·布朗聊聊她写的新书。

translation: （可选）根据其他线索确认铆钉城的历史。

original: Remove the source of the Fire Ants.

translation: 消灭蚁后孵化场中的所有五个巢穴守卫者。

original: Return to Bryan Wilks.
translation: 回去找布赖恩·威尔克斯。

translation: 将布赖恩·威尔克斯父亲的噩耗告诉他。

original: The Church of the Children of Atom believe the war of 2077 was actually a great holy event perpetuated by their god, Atom.
translation: “原子”信徒教堂坚信2077年的大战实际上是他们的神，“原子”，显示的一次神迹。

original: At the center of Megaton's crater sits an undetonated atomic bomb, a remnant of the great conflict that destroyed the world.
translation: 在兆吨镇的弹坑中矗立着一枚未爆的原子弹，是曾清洗这个世界的大战的残留物。

original: Some of Megaton's first settlers were lured by the misguided hope of entering the nearby Vault 101.
translation: 最早的兆吨镇移民是怀着想进入附近101号避难所的空想纷纷而至的。

original: Some Megaton residents wonder who's really in charge -- Sheriff Simms, or saloon owner Colin Moriarty...
translation: 让一些兆吨镇居民不解的是究竟谁在执管此地？-- 警长西姆斯，还是酒馆主科林·莫里亚蒂......

original: The members of the Church of the Children of Atom worship Megaton's atomic bomb.
translation: 原子之子教会的成员们崇拜兆吨镇的原子弹。

original: Word is that Moira Brown, the eccentric owner of Craterside Supply, is looking for assistance on a new project.
translation: 据说“坑边杂货店”的古怪店主莫伊拉·布朗，最近正为一个新研究而招募助手。

original: The residents of Megaton feel safe behind their metal walls. Ironic, considering their proximity to a live atomic bomb.
translation: 兆吨镇的居民在金属墙后感到安全。考虑到他们邻近一颗活原子弹，真讽刺。

original: Underworld was formed in the remains of the Museum of History's special exhibit, which showcased different civilizations' views on the afterlife.
translation: 冥界形成于历史博物馆的特别展览的遗迹，该展览展示了不同文明对来世的看法。

original: With the Action Boy perk, you gain an additional 25 Action Points to use in V.A.T.S.
translation: 有了活力小子这个额外能力, 在避难所科技辅助瞄准系统模式下你能多得25点行动点数。

original: With each rank of this perk, all of your explosive weapons do an additional 20% damage.
translation: 这个能力每升一级, 所有爆破类武器都能提升20%的伤害。

original: With the Mister Sandman perk, when you're in Sneak mode, you gain the option to silently kill any human or Ghoul while they're sleeping. All Mister Sandman kills earn bonus XP.
translation: 有了“睡魔先生”能力，在潜行时，你可以悄无声息地杀死任何睡梦中的人类和尸鬼，以这种方式杀死目标可以得到额外的经验值奖励。

original: The Ninja perk grants you the power of the fabled shadow warriors. When attacking with either Melee or Unarmed, you gain a +15% critical chance on every strike. Sneak attack criticals do 25% more damage than normal.
translation: “忍者”这个能力将赋予你传说中暗影武士的力量。施展徒手或近战攻击时，你的暴击率提高15%。潜行状态下打出的暴击伤害提高25%。

original: Once you have the Contract Killer perk, any good character you kill will have an ear on their corpse. This ear can then be sold to a certain person (whose identity is disclosed when you take the perk) for caps and negative Karma.
translation: 一旦你获得了“契约杀手”额外能力，你杀死任何善良人士之后，在尸体上能得到一只耳朵。这只耳朵可以出售给某人（在你得到该额外能力后，该人的身份会给出）换取瓶盖和恶业。

original: Once you have the Lawbringer perk, any evil character you kill will have a finger on their corpse. This finger can then be sold to a certain person (whose identity is disclosed when you take the perk) for caps and positive Karma.
translation: 一旦你获得了“执法者”额外能力，你杀死任何邪恶人士之后，在尸体上能得到一根手指。这根手指可以出售给某个人（在你得到该额外能力后，该人的身份会给出）换取瓶盖和善业。

original: With the Intense Training perk, you can put a single point into any of your S.P.E.C.I.A.L. attributes.
translation: 有了“训练狂”额外能力，你可以在任一S.P.E.C.I.A.L.属性上投入一点。

original: With the Action Girl perk, you gain an additional 25 Action Points to use in V.A.T.S.
translation: 有了活力女孩这个额外能力, 在避难所科技辅助瞄准系统模式下你能多得25点行动值。

original: You've recovered all the hidden intel from Operation: Anchorage. Good work, soldier!
translation: 你已经找到了《安克雷奇行动》中的所有隐藏情报。干得好，士兵！

original: When you take the No Weakness perk, all S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats that are less than 5 are instantly increased to 5.
translation: 选择“毫无破绽”能力, 你所有尚未达标的S.P.E.C.I.A.L.属性都会立刻提升至5。

original: Take the Almost Perfect perk, and all S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats are instantly raised to 9.
translation: 当获得“几近完美”能力, 你所有尚未达标的S.P.E.C.I.A.L.属性都会立刻提升至9。

original: When you choose the Karmic Rebalance perk, your Karma is instantly set to Neutral.
translation: 当选择了“业力再平衡”额外能力，你的业会立即变为中立。

original: You have unlocked the secret to creating Nuka-Cola Quantum. With this perk, every ten Nuka-Colas in your inventory is immediately converted into a Nuka-Cola Quantum.
translation: 你得到了制造量子型核子可乐的秘方。 拥有了这个能力, 你每得到十瓶核子可乐就会自动转化为一瓶量子型核子可乐。

original: You have learned to exploit the specific weaknesses of Ghouls, and gain a +5 damage bonus when attacking one.
translation: 你已经学会了利用尸鬼的弱点，增加5点对尸鬼的伤害。

original: After hours of studying, you've finally learned to exploit a mirelurk's weaknesses and gain a +5 damage bonus while attacking one.
translation: 经历了数小时的学习之后，你终于发现了泥沼蟹的弱点，并在与它们战斗时获得五5点伤害加成。

original: Your familiarity with alien technology gives you better control over their weapons, increasing their damage output by 20%.
translation: 对外星科技的熟练使得你能够更好掌握他们的武器，增加20%的伤害输出。

original: Grouse is dead!
translation: 葛劳斯死了！

original: The computer has been rigged to explode.\nIt could be possible to disarm and remove the grenade.
translation: 电脑已被安装了爆炸装置。\n也许可以拆除并取出手榴弹。

original: After a few close calls, you manage to stitch up Timebomb's wounds. He should be fine.
translation: 几度险情，你成功缝合了“定时炸弹”的伤口。他会好起来的。

original: This pile of eggs must be how the forager ants sustain their numbers. With a little more insight, you may be able to figure out how to use these eggs to your advantage.\n(Science 70, Medicine 40 or Intelligence 8 required.)
translation: 这堆卵一定是觅食蚁维持数量的方法。只要再多一些洞察力，你也许就能想出如何利用这些卵为自己谋利。\n(需要科学 70，医疗 40或智力 8）。

original: All of Reilly's Rangers have died!
translation: 所有莱莉的游骑兵都死了！

original: You repaired the generator.
translation: 你修好了发电机。

original: Everyone in Big Town is dead!
translation: 大镇的人都死了！

original: Caleb Smith is dead!
translation: 卡勒布·史密斯死了！

original: You examine the broken elevator panel and conclude that it is possible to repair it. Do you wish to repair it?
translation: 你检查了这损坏的电梯面板，断定它是可以修好的。你想要修理它吗？

original: Harold has been killed!
translation: 哈罗德被杀害了！

original: Fawkes has died!
translation: 福克斯死了！

original: Three Dog has been killed!
translation: 三狗被杀害了！

original:
Karma is an overall indication of your sense of good, evil... or neutrality. Your Karma starts at Neutral, and changes based on your actions. It can go up to Good or Very Good, or down to Evil or Very Evil.

Your Karma determines how people treat you, and whether many of them will help you or not.

Achieving a particular Karma level comes with its own set of advantages and disadvantages. Stay Neutral, and you don't have to worry about being hunted by law-abiding Regulators or heartless Talon Company Mercenaries. But, you'll then miss out on the benefits of being Good or Evil, like receiving special items or gaining access to restricted areas.
translation:
业是你的善、恶感……或中立感的总体体现。你的业开始于“中立”，基于你的行动而改变。它能够上升到“善”或“非常善”，或降低到“恶”或“非常恶”。

你的业决定了人们如何对待你，及众人会否帮助你。

达成一个特定的业等级会带来其自有的一系列好处与坏处。保持中立，你就不必担心被守法的监管者或冷血的鹰爪公司雇佣兵猎杀。但是，你随即也会错过成为善或恶的好处，比如收到特别的物品或获得进入限制区域的许可。

original: Shorty has died!
translation: “矮子”已经死了！

original: Sergeant RL-3 has been destroyed!
translation: RL-3中士已经被摧毁！

original: You already have a copy of this holotape.
translation: 你已经有了一份全息磁带拷贝。

original: Hannibal Hamlin is dead!
translation: 汉尼拔·哈姆林死了！

original: Red has died!
translation: 莱德已经死了！

original: All four VIP targets have died!
translation: 所有四个VIP目标已经死了！

original: You cannot help the captive while in combat.
translation: 在战斗中无法帮助俘虏。

original: You examine the broken gas valve and conclude that it is possible to repair it. Do you wish to repair it?
translation: 你检查了这损坏的燃气阀，断定它是可以修好的。你想要修理它吗？

original: Dogmeat has died!
translation: 狗肉已经死了！

original: Your follower has died!
translation: 你的同伴已经死亡！

original: Sergeant RL-3 has returned to Canterbury Commons.
translation: RL-3中士已返回了坎特伯雷社区。

original: Burke has been killed! You can no longer receive a reward for blowing up Megaton.
translation: 伯克已被杀死！炸毁兆吨镇不再能获得报酬。

original: Hannibal Hamlin and Leroy Walker are dead!
translation: 汉尼拔·哈姆林和乐瑞·沃克死了！

original: Mister Crowley is dead!
translation: 克劳利先生死了!

original: Both Lucas and Harden Simms have been killed! You can no longer receive a reward for disarming Megaton's atomic bomb.
translation: 卢卡斯和哈登·西姆斯都已被杀死！解除兆吨镇的核弹不再能获得报酬。

original: Sierra Petrovita has been killed!
translation: 塞拉·派屈维塔已经被杀了！

original: This computer trap is disarmed and won't explode unless it is rearmed.
translation: 电脑陷阱已经被解除，除非重新装置否则不会爆炸。

original: Officer Lepelletier is dead!
translation: 莱佩莱捷警官死了！

original: Griffon is dead!
translation: 格里芬死了！

original: Dogmeat's puppy has died!
translation: 狗肉的小狗已经死亡！

original: The large tome set into this lectern must be the Krivbeknih. It is damp with what appears to be fresh blood.
translation: 诵经台上的这本经书一定是《黯日圣经》。书本潮湿的封面上像是沾满了鲜血。

original: Marguerite has died!
translation: 玛格丽特已经死了！

original: You've found what's left of Agent Yang. Inspecting the remains closely, you discover a false molar tooth. There is a microfilm within that must contain the Self-Destruct Codes for the Chinese submarine.
translation: 你找到了杨特工的残骸。仔细检查遗骸后，你发现一颗假臼齿。里面藏有一份微缩胶卷，一定包含了中国潜艇的自毁代码。

original: Obadiah Blackhall has died!
translation: 奥巴迪亚·布莱克霍尔已经死了。

original: Radiation is being vented into the room through this vent. With a little skill, it could be disabled, stemming the flow of radiation.
translation: 辐射正通过这个通风口排入房间。只要稍微用点技巧，就可以关闭它，阻止辐射的蔓延。

original: Plik has died!
translation: 普利克已经死了！

original: Charging. Please wait.
translation: 充能中。请等待。

original: Elliott Tercorien has died!
translation: 埃利奥特·特克里安死亡了！

original: Somah has died!
translation: 索玛已经死亡！

original: Paulson has died!
translation: 保尔森已经死亡！

original: The assembly line electronics can be wired to overload. However, a higher Repair Skill is needed to set it with a slight delay (Repair Skill of 75 required). An overload should cause a detonation and provide a way through.
translation: 装配线的电子设备可以被接线使其过载。然而，需要更高的修理技能才能将其设置为稍有延迟（需要75%的修理技能）。过载应该会引发爆炸并开辟出一条通路。

original: This water tastes funny.
translation: 这水味道怪怪的。

original: This water makes you feel a little queasy.
translation: 这水让你觉得有点恶心。

original: Upon recovering your piece of mind, you've learned to protect what matters.\nYou now take less damage to your head.
translation: 在取回你的大脑碎片后，你学会了保护重要的东西。\n现在，你的头部受到的伤害更少了。

original: Current weapon is at full condition.
translation: 当前武器处于满状态。

original:
Updated Unofficial Fallout 3 Patch requires FOSE(Fallout Script Extender) latest beta version to function properly.

Either you currently don't have FOSE installed, you have an outdated version, or your mod manager isn't running it.
Please make sure it's installed and running.
translation:
Updated Unofficial Fallout 3 Patch需要FOSE（辐射脚本扩展器）最新测试版才能正常运行。

要么你目前没有安装FOSE，要么你的版本已经过时，要么你的MOD管理器没有运行它。
请确保它已安装并正在运行。

original:
Updated Unofficial Fallout 3 Patch requires Command Extender latest version to function properly.

Either you currently don't have Command Extender installed, you have an outdated version, or your mod manager isn't running it.
Please make sure it's installed and running.
translation:
Updated Unofficial Fallout 3 Patch需要Command Extender最新版本才能正常运行。

要么你目前没有安装Command Extender，要么使用的是过时版本，要么MOD管理器没有运行它。
请确保已安装并运行。

original: Toshiro Kago has died!
translation: 加护俊已经死了！

original: Ammo Press task completed
translation: 弹药轧制任务完成

original:
Updated Unofficial Fallout 3 Patch requires ButcherPete FOSE latest version to function properly.

Either you currently don't have ButcherPete FOSE installed, you have an outdated version, or your mod manager isn't running it.
Please make sure it's installed and running.
translation:
Updated Unofficial Fallout 3 Patch需要ButcherPete FOSE的最新版本才能正常工作。

要么你目前没有安装ButcherPete FOSE，要么你装了一个过时的版本，或者你的mod管理器没有运行它。
请确保它已安装并运行。

original: Hey, now. That's my stuff. If you want something, you gotta buy it.
translation: 嗨。那是我的东西。如果你想要什么，你就得买下来。

original: Whoa, whoa, whoa, hands off the goods.
translation: 哇哦，哇哦，哇哦，别碰那些货。

original: Tamper with that, and we're going to have a problem.
translation: 碰那东西，我们会有麻烦。

original: I really hope you're not thinking of breaking into there.
translation: 我希望你不是打算破门而入。

original: It's locked for a reason. Don't get any ideas.
translation: 它被锁是有原因的。别打什么主意。

original: Yes, that's locked. And yes, I can see you eyeing it...
translation: 是的，那锁了。而且，我能看到你正盯着它……

original: Don't even think of breaking into that.
translation: 想都别想闯进去。

original: That's secure for a reason.
translation: 它被保护起来是有原因的。

original: I don't think you should mess with that.
translation: 我想你不该去碰那东西。

original: That's not yours.
translation: 那不是你的。

original: What the hell do you think you're doing?
translation: 你他妈的在做什么？

original: Don't even think about it.
translation: 想都别想。

original: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在干嘛？

original: I'm watching you.
translation: 我盯着你呢。

original: Keep your hands to yourself.
translation: 管好你自己的手。

original: You won't get away with that.
translation: 你休想逃掉。

original: Not a good idea.
translation: 不是个好主意。

original: Don't touch me.
translation: 别碰我。

original: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在干嘛？

original: Well, hi there! Welcome to Andale! I'm Willy Wilson, though folks just call me Bill. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 你好！欢迎来到安代尔！我是薇柳·威尔逊，不过人们都叫我比尔。有什么可以帮助你的吗？

original: Doctor Barrows at your service. What brings you to the Chop Shop?
translation: 巴罗斯医生为你服务，什么风把你吹到排骨店的？

original: Come to lend me a hand I hope. I can always use fresh human samples.
translation: 我希望你过来帮把手。新鲜人类标本对我来说总是有用。

original: Yes, what is it now? Please, be brief. I'm quite busy.
translation: 是的，什么事？请简要说明。我很忙。

original: I uh... don't feel so good.
translation: 我，呃……感觉不太好。

original: Am I drunk? I think I'm drunk... Do I seem drunk to you?
translation: 我醉了？我想我醉了……你看我醉了吗？

original: Whoa!!! Is it me, or is the world spinning?
translation: 哇！！！是我，还是这世界在转？

original: Who are you again?
translation: 你是谁来着？

original: Good to see you again.
translation: 能再见到你真好。

original: Hey! Is that you?
translation: 嗨！是你吗？

original: Oh, my head's still ringing from that explosion... What happened?
translation: 哦，爆炸以后我的头一直嗡嗡响……发生了什么？

original: Hey, new in town? Good to meet you! I'm Moira Brown. I take care of supplies and repairs here, but what I really do is mostly tinkering and research.
translation: 嗨，刚来镇里的？很高兴认识你！我是莫伊拉·布朗，负责这的供给和修理，但我真正从事的是熔补和研究。

original: Actually, right now I'm working on a book to help the world. And I could use a bit of help. I can pay you, and it'll be fun!
translation: 事实上，我在写本拯救世界的书。我需要些帮助，我可以给你点报酬，而工作会很有趣！

original: Nice party.
translation: 非常不错的聚会。

original: Happy birthday!
translation: 生日快乐！

original: Enjoying yourself?
translation: 玩的开心吗？

original: I guess you'd better be on your way... Sorry for the uhh, for the interruption.
translation: 我想你最好出发。呃……抱歉打扰了你。

original: Thanks for helping us, mungo. You're not so bad for a mungo.
translation: 谢谢你对我们的帮助，毛人，作为一个毛人来说你真不错。

original: We're going home now. You watch out, okay?
translation: 我们现在得回家了。你小心，好吗？

original: Man, that sure was something. You're pretty brave, mungo!
translation: 伙计，真了不起，你真勇敢，毛人！

original: We can make it from here, no problem. But you watch your back. Those Slaver assholes aren't going to forget about you.
translation: 我们在这能搞定，没问题。但小心你的背后，那些混蛋奴隶贩子可不会忘了你。

original: Thanks for getting us out of there, mungo. We're gonna head back home now.
translation: 谢谢你帮我们逃出来，毛人。我们现在得回家了。

original: I'd think twice about coming back here if I were you. These guys aren't going to forget you, y'know?
translation: 如果我是你，就不会再想回到这。这些家伙不会忘了你的，你知道吗？

original: We'll meet you outside, if you can make it!
translation: 如果你搞定了，就到外面来找我们！

original: We'll meet you outside, if you can make it!
translation: 如果你搞定了，就到外面来找我们！

original: We'll meet you outside, if you can make it!
translation: 如果你搞定了，就到外面来找我们！

original: Oh geez, mungo! This is crazy!
translation: 哎呀，毛人！这太疯狂了！

original: We're gonna run for it. You come meet us outside if you make it!
translation: 我们该逃了。如果你搞定了就到外面来找我们！

original: Man, what a mess! Don't get yourself killed, mungo!
translation: 伙计，真是糟糕透了！别送了你的命，毛人！

original: I already shorted out the fence system so our collars won't blow. I bet they won't even notice.
translation: 我已经使栅栏系统短路，这样我们的项圈就不会爆炸。我打赌他们还没注意到。

original: We're getting outta here!
translation: 我们离开这！

original: You got the gate, huh? Okay, we're outta here!
translation: 你打开了门，呃？好，我们离开这！

original: Shoot a couple of those mungo ass-bag Slavers for me, will ya?
translation: 帮我打死那对混蛋毛人奴隶贩子，好吗？

original: Man, you've made a mess. Go get 'em, mungo! Get that key!
translation: 伙计，你搞砸了。干掉他们，毛人！拿到那钥匙！

original: You go take care of the bad guys. I'll just stay out here, and... stay out of the way.
translation: 你去干掉那些坏家伙。我待在这……不挡你的路。

original: I guess you decided to do this your own way, huh?
translation: 我想你决定按你的方式来，呃？

original: Well, now you've really done it. They're gonna kill you if they can, so you better kill them all first.
translation: 好，现在你已经搞定了。他们会竭尽所能杀死你，所以你最好先把他们都杀了。

original: Get the key for the slave pen gate off of the boss mungo, or that Forty asshole. If you can unlock the gate, we'll make a run for it.
translation: 从毛人老大或混蛋弗替那拿到奴隶栅栏门的钥匙。如果你能打开这门，我们就能逃出去。

original: Oh man, they're gonna be mad at you! These Slaver guys are mean!
translation: 哦 伙计，他们被你逼疯了！这些奴隶贩子很小气的！

original: Listen, you gotta help us. Me and my friends... We gotta get home. Can you help? Can you get us out of here?
translation: 听着，你得帮助我们，我和我的朋友……我们想回家。你能帮忙吗？你能帮我们逃出去吗？

original: You gonna help, or what? Squirrel and Penny are still in there.
translation: 你到底要不要帮忙？“松鼠”和佩尼还在里面呢。

original: Well, I guess that's it. Thanks for getting us out of there, mungo.
translation: 好了，我想就这样了。谢谢你帮我们逃出来，毛人。

original: We're going back home now. You ever come out that way, you stop and say hi. I'll tell Mayor not to shoot you okay?
translation: 我们现在得回家了。如果路过，你可以来打声招呼。我叫镇长不要开枪打你，好吗？

original: Well, I guess that's it. Thanks for getting us out of there, mungo.
translation: 好了，我想就这样了。谢谢你帮我们逃出来，毛人。

original: We're going back home now. You ever come out that way, you stop and say hi. I'll tell Mayor not to shoot you okay?
translation: 我们现在得回家了。如果路过，你可以来打声招呼。我叫镇长不要开枪打你，好吗？

original: Not bad, mungo. Not bad at all.
translation: 不错，毛人。很不错。

original: I told you I had a good plan. It sure worked, didn't it? You ever need anything, you go see MacCready in Lamplight. He'll help you out.
translation: 我告诉过你我有万全之策。它成功了，对吧？如果你有什么需要，去小灯镇找麦奎迪，他会帮你。

original: Thanks, mungo.
translation: 谢谢，毛人。

original: Thanks for getting us out of there. If you ever need anything, you come see us.
translation: 谢谢你帮我们逃出来，如果有什么需要，尽管来找我们。

original: Mayor will be nice to you. I'll make sure of it.
translation: 镇长会好好招待你的。我保证。

original: So you got us out of there, huh?
translation: 你帮我们逃出来了，呃？

original: Not so bad for a mungo, I guess.
translation: 我想，作为一个毛人来说你真不错。

original: So, uhh. Thanks and stuff. We're gonna head home soon.
translation: 呃，太感谢了。我们得赶快回家。

original: Is Rory safe yet?
translation: 罗瑞已经安全了吗？

original: I guess it's my turn to thank you.
translation: 我想轮到我谢谢你了。

original: Anyway, the area's secure, so you're free to talk to Three Dog if you need to.
translation: 总之，这区域是安全的。需要的话，你可以随意和三狗谈。

original: By the way, because you helped us I'm going to let you wear that Power Armor. But don't you ever forget where it came from.
translation: 顺便提一下，因为你救了我们，我准备让你穿上动力装甲，但是别忘了它是从哪里来的。

original: I guess it's my turn to thank you.
translation: 我想轮到我谢谢你了。

original: Anyway, the area's secure, so you're free to talk to Three Dog if you need to.
translation: 总之，这区域是安全的。需要的话，你可以随意和三狗谈。

original: Well now, look who made it back.
translation: 现在，看看谁回来了。

original: I'll take those ingots, scab. You just get back in there and get about your business.
translation: 我会拿走那些钢锭，渣滓。你回去忙你的吧。

original: You got a real knack for this! Here, this might help you work a little harder. Original owner can't use it anymore, on account of decapitation.
translation: 你真有一套啊！给，这个也许能让你更卖力点。它原来的主人是用不上了，因为他被砍了头。

original: Well now, aren't you quite the scrapper? Congratulations.
translation: 嗯，你不是很能打嘛？恭喜。

original: You've done well. Ashur wishes to see you. The guards will be told to allow you to pass.
translation: 你做的很好，阿舒尔希望见你。守卫们会被告知并让你通过。

original: HAHA! I love it. Another slave wandered back here, huh? What's wrong, couldn't get over the bridge? You're lucky I don't fuckin' paste you.
translation: 哈哈！我爱这样。又一个奴隶溜回来了，嗯？怎么，连桥都过不去？算你走运，我他妈的没狠狠揍你一顿。

original: Why I should... wait... what the?
translation: 我为什么要……等等……什么玩意？

original: Now would you look at this? Where'd you get all this shit anyway? Whatever. Mine now. Thanks, Scab! I hit the jackpot today!
translation: 你看看这？你从哪搞到的这些破烂的？无所谓，都是我的了。谢了，渣滓！我今天中头奖了！

original: Now get back in there and get to work, or next time I'll just stake you out there for the Trogs.
translation: 现在滚回去干活，要不然下次我会把你绑去喂兽化人。

original: Got to hand it to you kid. That was a brave thing you did, risking your life to start the Purifier.
translation: 不得不佩服你，孩子。你冒着生命危险启动了净化器，真是勇敢无畏。

original: But, do you know you've made my life a living hell? I'm guessing not.
translation: 但你知道你把我的生活搞得一团糟吗？我猜你不知道。

original: The hero of the Wasteland probably has more important things to worry about. Don't you?
translation: 看来我们的废土英雄还有更重要的事要担心。不是吗？

original: Hey, I didn't know you were exploring, too! You don't know where we are, do you?
translation: 嘿，我不知道你也在探索呢！你不会知道我们在哪儿，对吧？

original: ...okay. You got all that? I think you know enough now to at least move around in Power Armor without killing yourself. That’s something, right?
translation: ……好，你都了解了？我看你已经清楚怎样穿着动力装甲才不会送命了。那不赖，对吧？

original: God help us all.
translation: 上帝保佑我们所有人。

original: Please! Don't shoot! Oh man, don't hurt me! I just work here!
translation: 求你了！别开枪！噢老兄！别伤害我！我只是个在这儿干活的！

original: You self-righteous little... Do you have any idea what you've done to my employer's development plan? A word of advice: watch your back.
translation: 你这自以为是的小……你知道你对我老板的开发计划都干了啥吗？给你个忠告：小心点。

original: So. You're the genius who disarmed the bomb. Weeks of waiting and watching, ruined!
translation: 你就是那解除核弹的天才。数周的观望，都白费了！

original: It's a pity you acted so hastily. In the future, best sleep with one eye open.
translation: 都是因为你草率的行动。以后，你睡觉最好都睁只眼睛。

original: You will come to regret your actions.
translation: 你会为你的行为后悔的。

original: You'll live just long enough to regret your error in judgement.
translation: 你将来会有时间后悔你的判断失误的。

original: Who do we have here?
translation: 看是谁来了？

original: My, my. Just when I had all but given up hope. My dear boy, I am very happy to make your acquaintance. I am Mister Burke.
translation: 喔，喔。就在我失去所有希望的时候，我亲爱的孩子。认识你很高兴。我是伯克先生。

original: And you, well, you are not a resident of this putrescent cesspool. That makes you a rather valuable individual.
translation: 你，嗯，你不是这腐臭的污水池的居民。那让你更难能可贵。

original: Who do we have here?
translation: 看是谁来了？

original: My, my. Just when I had all but given up hope. My dear girl, I am very happy to make your acquaintance. I am Mister Burke.
translation: 喔，喔。就在我失去所有希望的时候，我亲爱的孩子。很高兴能认识你。我是伯克先生。

original: And you, well, you are not a resident of this putrescent cesspool. That makes you a rather valuable individual.
translation: 你，嗯，你不是这腐臭的污水池的居民。那让你更难能可贵。

original: Well, hey! How's it going? You need something, you just ask. Disarming that bomb, well... that's something I'm not ever likely to forget.
translation: 嗨！怎么样了？有需要尽管说。解除了核弹，啊……我永远不会忘记。

original: Well, now... how's my favorite explosives expert doing?
translation: 现在……我最爱的拆弹专家在干嘛？

original: Not now!
translation: 现在不行！

original: What you did, it was a great thing. That place, those people... necessary sacrifices. Here's to a better future. Here's to Tenpenny Tower!
translation: 你做的事，是伟大的事。那地方，那些人……必须牺牲。为了更美好的未来，为了特佩尼大厦！

original: Yeah, you're pretty busted up, but you'll live. Stop by the clinic in the morning.
translation: 嗯，虽然你伤得很重的，但你会活下来。早上去诊所吧。

original: You haven't rigged the bomb yet? If it's information you need, get to it. Time is wasting.
translation: 你还没有装配好核弹？如果有你需要的信息，就快点去了解。时不待人。

original: Back again, hmm? Perhaps you've reconsidered my offer?
translation: 又回来了，嗯？或许你已经再次考虑了我的提议？

original: You did it! You disarmed that thing!
translation: 你成功了！你解除了那东西！

original: My dad... he... He would have been real happy about that. Thank you.
translation: 我父亲……他……他一定会为此感到很高兴的。谢谢。

original: He wanted you to have these... a key and the deed to an empty place up behind the Brass Lantern. You can move in there if you want.
translation: 他要你拿着这些……一把钥匙与黄铜灯后一间空房的地契。如果你愿意，可以去那住。

original: Oh, and talk to Moira at Craterside Supply. She can help you decorate the place.
translation: 哦，和坑边杂货店的莫伊拉谈谈。她能帮你装修那地方。

original: My dad told me about how you're going to disarm the bomb. He gave me some stuff for you for when you get it done...
translation: 我爸爸告诉了我你要解除那核弹。他让我在你完成后，把这些东西交给你。

original: Not now!
translation: 现在不行！

original: I'll be damned! You did it, didn't you? You disarmed that thing!
translation: 该死！你做到了，对吧？你解除了那东西！

original: Hell, where's my manners? I'm Lucas Simms, mayor and sheriff. And I'm pleased to say, we've had a reward for fixing up that bomb. Here you go!
translation: 见鬼，失礼了！我是卢卡斯·西姆斯，镇长兼警长。我很荣幸的说，我们要给解除核弹的人报酬。拿着！

original: Y'know, we could use someone like you living in town. We've got an empty place up behind the Brass Lantern.
translation: 你懂的，我们需要你这样的人留在镇里。我们在黄铜灯后有间空房。

original: Here's the key and deed.
translation: 这是钥匙和地契。

original: And heck, Moira over at Craterside Supply can even sell you stuff to help fix the place up.
translation: 坑边供应站的莫伊拉会卖给你家具去装修那地方。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我叫卢卡斯·西姆斯，镇上的治安官。必要时兼任镇长。

original: You got a weird look about you, boy. The kind that means trouble. I give everyone a fair shake. But if you do anything remotely stupid, you're dead.
translation: 你看起来很怪，小子。通常这意味着麻烦。我对每个人一视同仁。但如果你干了什么蠢事，那你就死定了。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我叫卢卡斯·西姆斯，镇上的治安官。必要时兼任镇长。

original: You got a weird look about you, girl. The kind that means trouble. I give everyone a fair shake. But if you do anything remotely stupid, you're dead.
translation: 你看起来很怪，丫头。通常这意味着麻烦。我对每个人一视同仁。但如果你干了什么蠢事，那你就死定了。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我叫卢卡斯·西姆斯，镇上的治安官。必要时兼任镇长。

original: I don't know why, but I like you, boy! Something tells me you're all right. So welcome to Megaton! Just holler if you need something.
translation: 我不知道为什么，但我喜欢你，小子！直觉告诉我你没问题。欢迎来到兆吨镇！需要什么尽管说。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我叫卢卡斯·西姆斯，镇上的治安官。必要时兼任镇长。

original: I don't know why, but I like you, girl! Something tells me you're all right. So welcome to Megaton! Just holler if you need something.
translation: 我不知道为什么，但我喜欢你，丫头！直觉告诉我你没问题。欢迎来到兆吨镇！需要什么尽管说。

original: Name's Lucas Simms, town sheriff. And mayor too, when the need arises.
translation: 我叫卢卡斯·西姆斯，镇上的治安官。必要时兼任镇长。

original: I must be getting slow in my old age. Thanks for saving my hide, there.
translation: 我一定是老得迟钝了。谢谢你救了我。

original: Haven't disarmed the bomb yet? That's some serious Pre-War hardware. So go easy, okay?
translation: 还没把那核弹解除？那可是一大块战前的五金产品，所以放轻松，好吗？

original: You do actually know how to plant mines, right?
translation: 你真的知道怎么埋设地雷，对吧？

original: The robots are over in the junkyard, in case you're wondering.
translation: 你想打听的话，机器人在废物堆积场那。

original: Are you going to show us how to fix the robots?
translation: 你准备让我们见识下怎样修理机器人？

original: So are you going to ever show us how to be sneaky so we can hide from the Super Mutants?
translation: 你是准备给我们演示怎么隐匿，让我们能躲开超级变种人吗？

original: I'm getting bored. I thought you were going to teach us something.
translation: 我开始无聊了。我还以为你会教我们些什么。
