original: Go on, I'm watching. Show us what to do.
translation: 继续，我在看着。告诉我们做什么。

original: I'm confused. What am I supposed to be doing? Can you show me?
translation: 我糊涂了。我该做什么？你能给我演示下吗？

original: We're all watching you waiting to learn something. Well. Get on with it already!
translation: 我们都在看着你，等你教东西。来吧，准备好就开始吧。

original: Go on. I'm paying attention. Show us what to do.
translation: 来吧。我正在看着。告诉我们做什么。

original: Well, hotshot. Are you going to teach us something, or just stand there looking stupid?
translation: 自命不凡的家伙。你准备教我们些什么，还是像蠢货一样站着。

original: Oooh. I can't wait. Show us what to do!
translation: 哦，我等不下去了。教我们怎么做！

original: I'm watching. Go on. Teach us what to do.
translation: 我在看着，来吧，教我们怎么做。

original: What do you want now? Come to make fun of me again?
translation: 这次你要什么？又来耍我？

original: You will come to regret your actions.
translation: 你会为你的行为后悔的。

original: You'll live just long enough to regret your error in judgement.
translation: 你将来会有时间后悔你的判断失误的。

original: You should be proud of your accomplishment.
translation: 你该为自己的成就自豪。

original: Yes friend? Is there something I can assist you with?
translation: 什么事，朋友？有什么需要我协助的？

original: Alright. Let's go.
translation: 好吧。我们走。

original: Hurry and seal that hole from the attic! If you don't have any grenades then see if there's something nearby you can shoot that will explode!
translation: 赶紧封住阁楼上的那个洞！如果你没有手榴弹，那就看看附近有没有什么东西能让你射爆的！

original: Good things, sweetie. Tonic's brewed and bottled.
translation: 好东西，亲爱的。补药已经酿造装瓶了。

original: Here's your pay and cut of the batch. Enjoy it!
translation: 这是你的报酬和你的那份！请享用！

original: Y'ain't have the look of a local, son. Think you could help a sick woman get on the mend?
translation: 你看着不像本地人，孩子。你能帮助一个生病的女人好起来吗？

original: Expulsion Protocol KL-001 in effect. Disengage voice parameters.
translation: 排除协议KL-001生效。脱离语音参数。

original: Yes, fellow employee? What can I do for you on this wonderful day?
translation: 怎么了，同事？在这美好的日子里我能帮你什么？

original: Hello there, fellow employee. I don't believe we've met. I'm your Factory Foreman, Milo. It's a pleasure to meet you.
translation: 你好，同事。我们应该没见过吧。我是你工厂的领班，米洛。很高兴见到你。

original: Please give me your job posting title and employee registration number for my permanent records.
translation: 请提供你的岗位名称和员工注册号，以便我永久记录。

original: Hello again, fellow employee. I still have no record of your posting or employee identification.
translation: 又见面了，同事。我仍然没有关于你的岗位或员工身份的记录。

original: Please give me your job posting title and employee registration number for my permanent records.
translation: 请提供你的岗位名称和员工注册号，以便我永久记录。

original: There you go! I hope you like it.
translation: 给你！我希望你喜欢它。

original: So, it looks like you decided to do things their way huh. How come?
translation: 那么，看来你决定按他们的方式行事了？怎么会这样？

original: Nothing to report.
translation: 没什么要报告的。

original: Carry on. I've got this in hand.
translation: 你继续。我正在忙这事。

original: Kind of busy, here.
translation: 我有点忙。

original: If you're here to help, then help. If not... back off.
translation: 如果你来帮忙那就埋头帮忙。否则…就给我滚。

original: If you didn't notice, I'm busy. Get lost.
translation: 你没看到我在忙吗。走开。

original: Find someone else to bother, local.
translation: 不要来烦我，本地人。

original: You did me a great favor with those keys. How do you like my new armor? Those keys led me right to it.
translation: 很感激你帮我拿到了钥匙，喜欢我的新装甲吗？那些钥匙让我得到了它。

original: The AntAgonizer! You're the awesomest person ever, ever! Can I have your autograph?
translation: 是痛苦蚁后！你是最棒的家伙，最棒的！能给我签个名吗？

original: The Mechanist! You're the awesomest person ever, ever! Can I have your autograph?
translation: 是机械侠！你是最棒的家伙，最棒的！能给我签个名吗？

original: Goodbye, AntAgonizer! I have to go home now!
translation: 再见，痛苦蚁后！我现在该回家了！

original: Goodbye, Mechanist! I have to go home now!
translation: 再见，机械侠！我现在该回家了！

original: No students in Hall without Pass. Visitors must sign in at Administration.
translation: 没有通行证的学生不得进入大厅。访客必须在行政处登记。

original: Finally! Free!
translation: 终于！自由了！

original: I have to get out of here!
translation: 我必须离开这！

original: Please! Help us!
translation: 求求你！救救我们！

original: There's no point...
translation: 没必要……

original: Why bother?
translation: 何苦呢？

original: Where could we go even if we did escape? We'd just die in the Wasteland.
translation: 即使我们逃了我们又能去哪呢？我们只能死在废土。

original: Salutations, Commander! Sergeant RL-3, Gutsy-class robotic soldier, reporting for duty!
translation: 敬礼，指挥官！RL-3中士，“勇敢”级机器人士兵，前来报到！

original: My name's Clover. I hear you're the new man in my life.
translation: 我叫可萝尔。我听说你是我人生中的新男人。

original: You're looking for a bodyguard, and I'm looking for a body. Sounds like we're going to have some fun times, lover.
translation: 你在找保镖，而我在找肉体。看来我们会有些开心的日子，亲爱的。

original: My name's Clover. I hear you're the new woman in my life.
translation: 我叫可萝尔。我听说你是我人生中的新女人。

original: You're looking for a bodyguard, and I'm looking for a body. Sounds like we're going to have some fun times, lover.
translation: 你在找保镖，而我在找肉体。看来我们会有些开心的日子，亲爱的。

original: Yeah? What is it?
translation: 嗯？什么事？

original: Who the hell are you?! Where did you come from?! Did Moriarty send you?!
translation: 你他妈是谁？你从哪来？是莫里亚蒂派你来的？！

original: Here... you've done so much for us. I want you to have this. It's all I have to offer you...
translation: 拿好……你为我们做了很多。我希望你收下。我只有这些了……

original: All of us here thank you for everything you've done. For us... for the Wastes. We pooled together and got you this.
translation: 这里所有的人都感谢你为我们做的一切。为我们……为废土。我们凑了些东西给你。

original: It's the best we could do. Please take it, with our thanks.
translation: 这是我们能做的最好的了。请收下它，还有我们的谢意。

original: I wish there were more people like you in the world.
translation: 我希望这世界能有更多像你一样的人。

original: I want you to have this. I hope it helps keep you safe.
translation: 我要你拿着这。我希望它能帮助保护你。

original: You there. Hold it. Who the hell are you?
translation: 站住。见鬼，你是谁？

original: Ho chum! What's the word?
translation: 噢，好友！什么事？

original: You're brave to keep bothering me. Or stupid.
translation: 你不停地打扰我真是很勇敢。或者说愚蠢。

original: Hey, I've been wanting to talk to you. Leo told me what you said to him. You know, about his problem.
translation: 嗨，我一直想和你说话。利奥告诉我你和他谈过，你知道，他的问题。

original: I just wanted to say thank you. I know I can be rough, but my little brother means the world to me and you may have saved his life.
translation: 我只是想说谢谢。我知道我可能比较失礼，但是我的弟弟对我来说就是整个世界，而你救了他的命。

original: If there's anything that I can ever help you with, just let me know.
translation: 如果还有什么事是我可以帮你的，请尽管告诉我。

original: Hey there, Leo's been doing a lot better. I think we have you to thank for that. How can I help you?
translation: 嗨，利奥现在做得好多了。我想我们该谢谢你。我能帮你什么忙吗？

original: Leo's tickets have stopped coming up short ever since he gave up the chems. Me and my wallet both thank you. What can we do for you?
translation: 自从利奥戒了毒，他不再缺钱。我和我的钱包都很谢谢你。我们能为你做什么？

original: Can't a man eat in peace? Go talk to Jenny or Leo if you need something.
translation: 不能让人安静吃饭吗？如果你需要什么去和珍妮或利奥说。

original: Look, I need to balance these books. If you'd like to order some food, please talk to Jenny or Leo.
translation: 听着，我需要对账。如果你要点吃的，去和珍妮或利奥说。

original: Yep. Still balancing the books. Is there something exciting about watching me? Look: Go talk to Jenny or Leo.
translation: 对。还在对账。你除了盯着我之外就没其他事可做了吗？听着：去和珍妮或利奥谈。

original: You again. Is there something exciting about watching me? Look: Go talk to Jenny or Leo.
translation: 又是你。你除了盯着我之外就没其他事可做了吗？听着：去和珍妮或利奥谈。

original: Hmm? Oh. I'm afraid I'm quite busy right now. If it's food you're after, talk to Jenny or Leo. Otherwise, I can't help you.
translation: 嗯？哦。我恐怕我现在很忙。如果你要些吃的，去和珍妮或利奥谈。否则我没什么可帮你的。

original: You again? Go Bother Jenny or Leo, will ya?
translation: 又是你？去烦珍妮或利奥，好吗？

original: You again? Go Bother Jenny or Leo, will ya?
translation: 又是你？去烦珍妮或利奥，好吗？

original: Hooo weee! Look at you! Now I haven't seen one of those Vault jumpsuits in, wow, a LONG time. Pretty damn good condition, too!
translation: 哇~~！看看你！我多久不见这样的避难所连身衣了。而且状况还真他妈不错！

original: Name's Billy Creel. You call me Billy, all right? I know Megaton looks more like a boneyard than a town, but it ain't all bad.
translation: 我是比利·克里，叫我比利就行。我知道兆吨镇看起来更像是废车场而不是城镇，但是也不是都很糟。

original: Take me and Maggie, for instance. We make do just fine. I trade the stuff I scavenge, and she helps keep me on the straight and narrow. He he he.
translation: 拿我和玛姬举例。我们过得很好。我把收集到的东西拿去交易，而她帮我保持循规蹈矩。呵呵呵。

original: What is it? Can't you see that I'm watching the guards?
translation: 你要什么？快点说，你挡住我视线了。

original: What do you want? Make it quick, you're blocking my view!
translation: 你想干什么？快点，你挡住我的视线了！

original: Get outta here! They see me talking to you, I'm dead!
translation: 滚出去！要是他们看到我和你在说话，我就死定了！

original: You came to visit! You'll never guess what I found out in the Wastes, when I was supposed to be patrolling.
translation: 你来看看！你肯定想不到我在废土巡逻的时候发现了什么。

original: Here. This is for you.
translation: 给。这是给你的。

original: Oh, baby! Let me get you something special. How about a Dukov surprise? Hah ha!
translation: 哦，宝贝！让我给你些什么特别的吧。杜科夫式的惊喜怎么样？哈哈！

original: Never mind. You need a drink. Cherry! Need some fucking booze over here!
translation: 没关系。你需要喝一杯。彻丽！这边来些酒！

original: Hello sweet cheeks! What can old Dukov do for you?
translation: 你好，小甜心！老杜科夫能为你做点什么？

original: Never mind. You need a drink. Cherry! I'm thirsty over here!
translation: 没关系。你需要来杯喝的，彻丽！我渴死了！

original: Have you seen Cherry? I think the bitch ran out on me.
translation: 你看到彻丽了吗？我想这婊子在和我耍花样。

original: Who the hell are you?
translation: 你到底是谁？

original: Never mind. You need a drink. Cherry! I'm thirsty over here!
translation: 没关系。你需要来杯喝的，彻丽！我渴死了！

original: Who the hell are you?
translation: 你到底是谁？

original: Never mind. You need a drink. Fantasia! I'm thirsty over here!
translation: 无所谓。你需要来杯喝的，凡塔西亚！我渴死了！

original: Who the hell are you?
translation: 你到底是谁？

original: Never mind. You need a drink. My women are gone, so help yourself.
translation: 无所谓。你需要喝一杯。我的女人都走了，你自便吧。

original: Whatcha need? How about a drink? No? Suit yourself.
translation: 你要什么？来一杯？不？那你自己看着办。

original: Yeah, yeah, you're my hero. Don't let it go to your head. Seriously though, thank you for getting me away from Dukov.
translation: 嗯，嗯，你是我的英雄。不过不要自大。不过说真的，谢谢你帮我离开杜科夫。

original: So that prick Dukov is dead. Can't say I'll miss him.
translation: 这么说那讨厌的杜科夫死了。不能说我会想念他。

original: Even so, I'm going to need someone to protect me. A girl can't survive by herself in the Wasteland.
translation: 不过，我需要有人来保护我。一个女孩在废土是不能独自生存下去的。

original: Hey, good looking. I'm Cherry. Can I do anything for you?
translation: 嗨，帅哥。我是彻丽。有任何事可以帮你的吗？

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: Hi, sweetie. I'm Cherry. What can I do for you?
translation: 嘿，甜心。我是彻丽。我能为你做些什么吗？

original: Hi, sugar. I'm Cherry. Do yourself a favor. Watch yourself with Dukov. He's all hands.
translation: 嘿，甜心。我是彻丽。你自己动手做吧。小心杜科夫。他什么都做得出来。

original: President Rosie? What's happening around here anyway?
translation: 萝丝总统？这附近到底发生什么事了？

original: Rosie? As President? You've got to be kidding me...
translation: 萝丝？做总统？你在开玩笑吧……

original: Well, now. President Bob. How do you like that? Boy, things are gonna change around here. First step: get rid of all this "Dave" shit.
translation: 好吧。鲍勃总统。你觉得那怎么样？孩子，这的一切都会改变的，第一步就是除去所有与“戴夫”相关的狗屎。

original: The Kingdom of Bob! Or maybe Bobtopia! I'll have to give it some thought.
translation: 鲍勃王国！要么就是鲍托邦！我会考虑下的。

original: But I guess you want something, don't you? Tell you what... Dave kept some old junk in that safe of his... I mean MY office. The code is 1138.
translation: 但是你需要什么，不是吗？告诉你吧……戴夫在他那保险箱放了些旧垃圾……我是说在“我的”办公室。密码1138。

original: Take whatever you want out of there. Consider it a gift from your kind and loving President Bob.
translation: 那的东西你尽管拿。就当是感谢你的对鲍勃总统的友善和热爱的回礼。

original: Maybe we need a flag? One with my picture on it. That could be pretty cool.
translation: 或许我们需要一面旗？上面有我的照片。那样可能很酷。

original: Maybe we need a flag? One with my picture on it. That could be pretty cool.
translation: 或许我们需要一面旗？上面有我的照片。那样可能很酷。

original: First things first, we're gonna have to open up the Museum of Bob.
translation: 当务之急，我们首先必须开放鲍勃博物馆。

original: Do not interfere with security operations.
translation: 不要干涉安保工作。

original: I'm sorry, but I am not at liberty to chat right now.
translation: 抱歉，执行公务中，无法和你交谈。

original: Protect and serve.
translation: 保家卫国！

original: What is it now? Sir.
translation: 有什么事吗，先生？

original: What is it now? Ma'am.
translation: 有什么事吗，女士？

original: Do I look like I have time for idle chitchat?
translation: 我看上去像是有空和你闲聊的样子吗？

original: No time to talk to your type, local.
translation: 没时间和你这种乡巴佬聊天。

original: Why don't you go bother the Brotherhood or something?
translation: 你咋不去纠缠兄弟会啥的？

original: Hey local, shouldn't you be banging rocks together, or something?
translation: 嘿，本地的，你不用去拿石头之类的敲敲打打吗？

original: Don't push your luck out here.
translation: 你最好不要得寸进尺。

original: Keep an eye out for those locals.
translation: 警惕这些原住民。

original: Down with Ashur!
translation: 打倒阿舒尔！

original: Kill the taskmasters!
translation: 杀死工头！

original: Go away! They'll see us!
translation: 走开！他们会瞧见我们的！

original: Go away.
translation: 走开。

original: Impressive, slave. I guess I shouldn't call you that anymore.
translation: 厉害啊，奴隶。我想我不该再那样称呼你。

original: Not bad. Welcome to the club.
translation: 不赖，欢迎来到俱乐部。

original: Welcome to the Chop Shop. I'm Nurse Graves, Doctor Barrows' assistant.
translation: 欢迎来到排骨店。我是格雷芙护士，巴罗斯医生的助手。

original: Don't let our place's name fool you. The Doctor is very good with injuries, dismemberments, and trauma.
translation: 别被我们这地方的名字吓到。医生对内伤、断肢和外伤都很在行。

original: If you require any Stimpaks or Bloodpacks, let me know.
translation: 如果你需要治疗针或血浆袋，就告诉我。

original: And how can we help you today?
translation: 今天我能为你做些什么？

original: Well, I guess you weren't such a jerk after all.
translation: 好吧，我想你不是一个蠢货。

original: Wow, you look like you've been through Hell.
translation: 哇，你看起来像刚从地狱里回来。

original: You sure know your shit. Ever consider joining the Rangers? I bet Reilly would love to have you on our team.
translation: 你还挺能啊。考虑过加入游骑兵吗？我打赌莱莉会很乐意让你加入我们的队伍。

original: Man, what the hell is this place? What do they want with all these people?
translation: 天哪，这到底是什么地方？他们要这些人干什么？

original: Hey, I thought you should know... Someone must've hit a button during the fight just now.
translation: 嗨，有件事得告诉你……刚才混战中肯定有人误触了按钮。

original: If I understood the display correctly, I think we sort of launched a homing beacon of some kind down to the surface. Landed just outside D.C.
translation: 要是我对显示屏的理解没错，我想我们好像朝地面发射了某种归航信标。落点就在特区外。

original: I wouldn't mention it, except that I think... Like I said, I'm not sure... I think it's a way to get back to earth.
translation: 本来不想说的，不过我觉得……就像我说的，不确定……但可能是返回地球的通道。

original: Seems like there's a teleporter in the Captain's quarters... I mean, I guess they're your quarters now.
translation: 舰长舱室里有台传送装置……现在应该说是你的舱室了。

original: So I guess you can go home if you want. Don't worry, I'll stick around up here and keep an eye on things.
translation: 所以如果你想的话，大概就能回家了。别担心，我会留在这儿留意情况。

original: Hito wo azakeru na. Onushi no monoii wa sappari wakaran.
translation: 别耍我，完全不知你说的啥。

original: Sessha wo tasuke takuba, sessha no ken wo sagashi dase!
translation: 想帮在下就把在下的剑找出来。

original: Here it is! This is the stuff I hid in here. You can have all of it, okay?
translation: 就在这儿！这就是我藏在这里的东西。你可以全拿走，好吗？

original: Come on, I'll show you where the stuff is!
translation: 来啊，我给你看看我藏了什么东西。

original: Nope, nope. Not real, none of it is real. It can't hurt me if it's not real.
translation: 不，不。不是真的，一切都不是真的。不是真的，就伤不到我。

original: I wasn't aware that we had anything else to say to each other.
translation: 我不知道咱们还有什么可说的。

original: Welcome back!
translation: 欢迎回来！

original: What are you waiting for? DESTROY HIM!
translation: 你还在等什么？消灭他！

original: Keep your distance. What are you doing in my house?
translation: 保持距离，你在我家干什么？

original: You said you'd mend the still, sweetie. When did you plan on getting' to that, exactly?
translation: 你说过你要修，亲爱的。到底什么时候计划开始呢?

original: Thanks for mending the still, Sweetie. For this fee, the tonic had better taste like honey, though.
translation: 亲爱的，谢谢你的修理。因为这些费用，药剂尝起来更像蜂蜜了。

original: Thanks for mending the still, Sweetie. You're a peach.
translation: 亲爱的，谢谢你的修理。你是个美人。

original: Thanks for mending the still, Sweetie. Here's your pay.
translation: 亲爱的，谢谢你的修理。这是你的报酬。

original: You are welcome to our tribe.
translation: 欢迎来到我们的部落。

original: Tremendous showing! I do hope the experience was worth every cap.
translation: 重大发现！我希望这次经历能够物超所值。

original: Let's commemorate your first safari with a token of our friendship, shall we?
translation: 让我们以此来纪念你第一次狩猎时我们的友谊。

original: This axe was, er, 'misplaced' by one of my other patrons. She won't be needing it anymore, and it's a weapon of gruesome distinction. Enjoy it.
translation: 这斧头是，呃，是我的一个顾客误放在这里的。她不再需要它了，这武器相当卓越。享受它吧！

original: Mr. Plik's really outdone himself this time.
translation: 水疱先生这次真正的克服了自己。

original: Well, hello there young traveler. The fates had told me that I would receive a visitor today.
translation: 好啊，年轻的旅行者。命运之神告诉我，我今天会接待一位访客。

original: But I'm being rude! I am Madam Panada, and this is Madam Panada's House of Wares! For all things a traveler needs, I am here to provide!
translation: 但我太无礼了！我是帕娜达女士，这里是帕娜达女士的杂货铺！旅客需要什么，我就提供什么。

original: Bullets! Stimpaks! Armor! Weapons! Junk! If you need it, Madam Panada has already anticipated your need and procured it months ago!
translation: 弹药！治疗针！装甲！武器！垃圾！尽情挑选，帕娜达女士已经在月前就预先采购好了你所需要的！

original: <There is no answer>
translation: <无人应答>

original: We've got this area locked down.
translation: 我们已经封锁这一区域。

original: Everything's above board.
translation: 一切都光明磊落。

original: We're all clear here.
translation: 这里解决了。

original: We've got this area locked down.
translation: 我们已经封锁这一区域。

original: Not the most exciting job I ever had, but you gotta admit, it beats pulling the floaters out of the Basin. Ha ha ha.
translation: 我这工作说不上有意思，但是你得承认，把漂浮物从池子的水里弄出来可真恶心啊。哈哈哈。

original: Brotherhood assholes! They won't give us enough water to last until the next shipment!
translation: 兄弟会的混蛋！在下一批货之前他们不会提供我们水了！

original: We're not going to let them leave with that water though. We need it.
translation: 我们不会让他们带走水的。我们需要它。

original: What are they going to do, anyway? Kill us for stealing some free water?
translation: 他们想怎么样？因为偷了点免费的水就杀了我们？

original: This is what happens to people who fuck with the Brotherhood.
translation: 这就是跟兄弟会作对的下场。

original: Did you need something?
translation: 你是不是需要些什么？

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: Can I be of assistance?
translation: 我有什么能帮你的么？

original: If there's anything I can do to help, please just say so.
translation: 如果有什么我能帮到你的，请不要客气。

original: Did you need something?
translation: 你是不是需要些什么？

original: Good to see you.
translation: 很高兴见到你。

original: When I first saw you long ago, I thought you were just some trashy Wastelander. I'm glad I was wrong.
translation: 很久之前，我第一次见到你时，我还以为你是个一文不值的废土客。但很高兴我错了。

original: My father thinks the world of you... and so do I. If things were different, maybe we could have had time to become friends...
translation: 我父亲很欣赏你……我也是。如果不是在这种环境下的话，也许我们能有时间交个朋友……

original: Anyway... I wish you the best of luck and I hope you stick around for a while. We need people like you to help us finish what we've started here!
translation: 不管怎么说啦……我还是希望你能平安无事，还有……我希望你能在这里多呆几天。我们需要你这样的人来帮助我们完成未尽的事业！

original: You must cleanse your tongue of unseemly speech by drinking deep of the holy water. Then we may speak.
translation: 你必须饮下圣水，洗净舌头上的污言秽语。然后我们才能谈话。

original: Cleanse your tongue with the holy water. For we must speak with seemly tongues when we make mention of Atom's Light.
translation: 用圣水洗净你的喉舌。因为在我们谈论原子之光的时候必须言辞得体。

original: Grrrrrloooow...
translation: 咯……咯……（光辉）

original: Arrrr-taaahm.
translation: 啊……特姆（原子）

original: Have you heard about that new cult? They took our water!
translation: 你听说过那新兴的邪教么？他们拿走了我们的水！

original: Here, read this. It's one of their pamphlets.
translation: 来，看看这个。这是他们的小册子。

original: Oh, I hadn't seen you in so long. I thought you died. Um... I stopped setting aside money for you.
translation: 噢，很久不见啊。我还以为你死啦。呃……所以我就没留你那份儿。

original: Um, here. Take this. It's all I have to spare.
translation: 嗯，给你。拿着这些。我只剩这些了。

original: Now get out of here before my customers take notice.
translation: 现在在我的顾客们发现之前快点离开吧。

original: Is it that time already? Fine. Here's your money.
translation: 这么快就到日子了？好吧。这是你的钱。

original: Now get out of here. I'm trying to earn some money.
translation: 现在快离开吧。我正在拼命挣钱呢。

original: You found a Tesla Coil?
translation: 你找到特斯拉线圈了？

original: Excellent. I'll see to it that this reaches the scribes immediately.
translation: 好极了。我会确保它立即被送达学士那。

original: You've done good work, soldier.
translation: 你干得很好，士兵。

original: Are you ready for your next assignment? We don't have time to spare.
translation: 你准备好接受下一个任务了么？我们时间紧迫。

original: What is that?? What the hell is going on?
translation: 那是什么？？到底发生什么事了？

original: We need to find out what the hell just happened.
translation: 我们得搞清楚刚才到底发生了什么。

original: There's no time to talk - get your ass inside that base, and help the troops locate the source of their transmission. Now soldier, NOW!
translation: 没时间多说了——麻溜进基地，帮助部队找到他们通讯源。现在，士兵。马上！

original: What the hell...
translation: 这他妈的……

original: They knew we were coming... How did they know we were coming?
translation: 他们知道我们要来……他们怎么知道我们要来？

original: Good work. You're one step away from Ashur... and our freedom.
translation: 干得不错。你离阿舒尔……和我们的自由只有一步之遥。

original: That fight was impressive. One more to go.
translation: 那场战斗很犀利，还剩一个对手。

original: Not bad, grinder. Not bad. The Bear Brothers were some pretty mean sons o' bitches.
translation: 不赖啊，磨工，不赖。贝尔兄弟是一对相当卑鄙的贱人。

original: One more fight and you're free. But I wouldn't plan on making it through the next one.
translation: 再打一场，你就自由了。不过我对下一场没什么指望。

original: Here's a shot for the rads. Come back when you're ready for your last fight.
translation: 给你去掉辐射，准备好了下一场就回来。

original: Wow. Impressive, slave. Those were some of the toughest scabs around here.
translation: 哇哦，令人印象深刻，奴隶。那些可是这里最难缠的渣滓。

original: You've got some fight in you, it seems. But I wouldn't get too excited. I'm sure Ashur's got something special planned for your next fight.
translation: 看来你挺有斗志啊。但我不会太兴奋，我肯定阿舒尔为你的下一场战斗做了特别的安排。

original: Here's something for the rads. Enjoy it while you can. Come back when you're ready for your next fight.
translation: 这是消辐射的。尽情享用吧。等你准备好了下一场战斗就回来。

original: And what're you doing down here, slave? Don't tell me that your pale ass is gonna throw down?
translation: 你到这下面来做什么，奴隶？别跟我说你苍白的屁股要掉地下了？

original: Get in there, or die in here. Either way, I don't care.
translation: 从那里进去，或者死在这。两条路，我不在乎。

original: You again? Back for more, huh?
translation: 你要再来吗？下一场吗？

original: Unless you're looking to get killed, you'll get the fuck out of my Arena.
translation: 除非你找死，不然就他妈的从我的竞技场滚出去。

original: Haha! So you're the dumbass scab that signed up to fight in the Hole, huh?
translation: 哈哈！那么你就是那个签下生死状，要在角斗坑角斗的傻瓜渣滓，对吧？

original: Well, head on down! Faydra's waiting for you! HAHAHA!
translation: 直接下去！费德拉等着你！哈哈哈！

original: You can take weapons into the Hole.
translation: 你可以带着武器进入角斗坑。

original: Talk to Marco and get a weapon... if you haven't already.
translation: 跟马克谈，搞把武器……你要是还没有的话。

original: We're so close...
translation: 我们亲密无间……

original: The first thing I'm going to do once I'm free is burn out Faydra's eyes. She's the worst of them.
translation: 一旦我自由了，我做的第一件事就是烧瞎费德拉的眼睛。她是最坏的一个。

original: I can't stand the fucking bosses. This is disgusting.
translation: 我受不了这些该死的老板，令人作呕。

original: Those bastards. It's bad enough they force us to work, but they expect us to fight for their amusement!
translation: 那些杂种很坏，他们强迫我们干活，却还指望我们为了逗他们开心去角斗！

original: We all knew this was coming but... I dunno... the Hole is terrible.
translation: 我们都知道就快开场了，不过……我不知道……角斗坑中很恐怖。

original: Midea is crazy. This'll never work.
translation: 美狄亚疯了，这绝没有用处。

original: You're fighting in the Hole? Well... good luck with that...
translation: 你要在角斗坑里角斗？那么……祝你好运……

original: You're our best hope.
translation: 你是我们最大的希望。

original: At least they cure your radiation when you come out of the Hole.
translation: 当你从角斗坑里出来，至少他们会治疗你的辐射。

original: Ashur's days are numbered.
translation: 阿舒尔的时代到头了。

original: Thank you for your help with those guys. They finally tracked me down... I thought I'd have more time.
translation: 谢谢你帮忙对付那些家伙。他们还是追到了我……我想我将有更多时间。

original: You've come about the broadcast, right? Risky, I know. But it had to be done. So you know who I am. Who are you?
translation: 你是听到电台赶过来的吧？我知道这很冒险，但总得有人做。那么你知道我是谁了。你又是谁呢？

original: You could have at least helped me with with those guys. They finally tracked me down... I thought I'd have more time.
translation: 你可能至少帮我对付了那些家伙们。他们还是追到了我……我想我将有更多时间。

original: You've come about the broadcast, right? Risky, I know. But it had to be done. So you know who I am. Who are you?
translation: 你是听到电台赶过来的吧？我知道这很冒险，但总得有人做。那么你知道我是谁了。你又是谁呢？

original: This is as far as I can go. It's up to you from here on out.
translation: 我只能走这么远了，现在开始，由你自己做主。

original: If you dress up like a slave, you should be able to get past the gates without a problem.
translation: 你要是穿得像个奴隶，过这些门应该是没什么问题。

original: Once you're inside, find a slave named Midea. She'll be able to help you.
translation: 一旦你进去了，就去找叫美狄亚的奴隶，她会帮你。

original: Remember: your goal is to get access to Ashur and find the cure. After you have it, I'll contact you.
translation: 记住：你的任务是想办法接近阿舒尔，找到解药。得手之后，我会跟你联络。

original: Before we go, there's one last thing.
translation: 我走之前，还有最后的一件事。

original: Head into The Pitt and find the cure. Remember: put the slave clothes on and stash your stuff if you can.
translation: 直接进入匹兹堡，找到解药。记住：穿上奴隶的衣服，尽可能把自己藏好。

original: Please...
translation: 求你……

original: Please help us...
translation: 求你帮帮我们……

original: Oh, what a dear little orphaned child that is. I know a place where she can have a safe home.
translation: 哦，多可爱的小孤儿。我知道个地方可以做她安全的家。

original: And you can be about your business, far, far away from her.
translation: 管好你自己的事，离她远点。

original: You can't make me talk.
translation: 我不能和你谈话。

original: What do you need? Make it fast.
translation: 你要什么？快点。

original: Nice trophy from Ashur you got there. You sure earned it.
translation: 来自阿舒尔的美妙奖励，你肯定赚到了。

original: Oh joy. Our hero.
translation: 哦，太荣幸了，我们的英雄。

original: Kind of busy trying to keep this place in one piece. And here I thought freedom would make things easier...
translation: 有点忙于保持这个地方团结一致。我想自由将是可以更容易的达成这一目标的手段……

original: Do you mind? I've got a lot to do.
translation: 你介意吗？我有许多活得干。

original: Oh, Billy...
translation: 哦，比利……

original: You got a problem?
translation: 你有问题？

original: Are you a hungry pet?
translation: 你是个饥饿的宠物吗？

original: Oh. It's talking to me again.
translation: 哦，它又在跟我说话了。

original: Hey, champ!
translation: 嗨，冠军！

original: Keeping busy? Need a pick-me-up?
translation: 还在忙？要不要来点提神的？

original: Buzz off, new kid.
translation: 走开，菜鸟。

original: I got better things to do than talk with you.
translation: 比起跟你胡扯，我有更重要的事情要做。

original: Hey, meat.
translation: 嗨，肉。

original: I'm told that you might be looking for Marco. Am I right?
translation: 我听说你可能在寻找马可，我说的对吗？

original: All right. All better. But still...
translation: 很好，有所好转，不过还有……

original: You'd better get out of here. They might suspect something.
translation: 你最好离开，他们可能起了疑心。

original: All right. All better.
translation: 很好，有所好转。

original: Now, get out of here before the bosses suspect something. I'll be here if you get hurt again.
translation: 现在，在老板们起疑心之前离开这。你要是再受了伤，来这找我。

original: If you get hurt, come talk to me. I can help you out.
translation: 你要是受了伤，来这找我，我可以帮你。

original: No scabs near the gate. Back off.
translation: 渣滓们不许接近大门，回去。

original: Jackson, man. Don't forget it.
translation: 杰克逊，老兄。别忘了。

original: Go away.
translation: 走开。

original: Good job making it through that simulation. All you have to do now is open the Armory.
translation: 你能通过模拟，干得好。现在你要做的就是打开军火库。

original: And, as agreed, you get your share. Feel free to take whatever you want. If our records are right, there's plenty for all of us.
translation: 然后，根据我们的协议，你将得到你应得的报酬。想要什么就拿什么吧。如果我们的记录没错的话，里面的东西够我们所有人的了。

original: That'll do, soldier. Stand down!
translation: 搞定了，士兵。退后点！

original: The simulation has concluded, soldier.
translation: 模拟程序终止了，士兵。

original: Attacking the Listening Post as ordered, sir. I'll give you a new update when the objective is complete.
translation: 正按计划进攻监听站，长官。当任务完成后我会向你报告最新情况。

original: You're the backup? Great. Just great.
translation: 你是来帮忙的？太好了，真是太好了。

original: All right, follow me. I'll take you to Protector McGraw.
translation: 好吧，跟着我。我会带你去见麦格劳保护者。

original: Who the hell are you, and what do you think you're doing?
translation: 你到底是谁，来这里做什么？

original: You're here to help? Fine, then put this on, get in the chair, and we'll run the simulation.
translation: 你是来帮忙的？好，那穿上这个，坐在那椅子上，我们来运行模拟程序。

original: Come on, let's move it. I ain't got all day.
translation: 快点啊。我可没那么多时间。

original: You getting in there, or what?
translation: 你倒底进不进去啊？

original: This is a Pre-War research facility. There's technology to be had, and I am determined to have it.
translation: 这是一座战前的研究设施。里面有种科技，我决心要得到它。

original: Unfortunately, it's locked up tight. As far as we can tell, it's linked into some kind of simulator.
translation: 不幸的是，它被牢牢锁上了。据我们所知，它被连接在某种模拟器上。

original: But we can't access the simulator, because we lack the proper interface. Your little computer there is exactly what we're looking for.
translation: 我们不能进入模拟器，因为我们缺少适当的操作界面。你那件小电脑正是我们要找的。

original: So, I'll make you a deal. You access the simulator and get us into the rest of this base, and I'll give you a cut of what we find.
translation: 那么，我们来做个交易。你进入模拟器，带我们进入这个基地，我就把找到的东西分一份给你。

original: "Payment for Services Rendered." You help us, and we'll help you.
translation: “交易达成。”你帮了我们，我们也会帮你。

original: Nice work out there, soldier. Thanks for the back-up, but where's the rest of your detachment?
translation: 干得漂亮，士兵。谢谢你支援我，但你的其他队员哪去了？

original: Head on into the base and talk to McGraw. I'll let him know you're coming. Don't worry, they won't shoot you.
translation: 进基地去和麦格劳谈谈。我会告诉他你来了。别担心，他们不会向你开枪的。

original: Could you have been any more useless out there? You don't deserve to wear that armor after that display! Explain yourself, soldier!
translation: 你在那边没事干吗？从你之前的表现来看，你还不够资格穿那件装甲！好好解释一下，士兵！

original: All right, now who the hell are you, and what do you think you're doing wearing that armor?
translation: 好吧，你到底是谁，还有为什么穿着那件装甲？

original: Give me one good reason why I shouldn't put you down right now, outsider.
translation: 给我一个不杀你的理由，外来人。

original: Don't think for one second I didn't see what you're wearing. If you hadn't actually helped out here, I'd have put you down along with these mutants.
translation: 别以为我看不出你这身打扮是做什么的。如果你在这里碍手碍脚的，我就把你的尸体堆在变种人的上面。

original: You've got about three seconds to explain yourself, outsider.
translation: 你有3秒钟时间解释一下在做什么，外来人。

original: Damned guard detail! That sounded like a good ruckus.
translation: 该死的防卫细节！听起来像一堆废话。

original: You can go ahead and stop right there. Who the hell are you?
translation: 你可以向前走，在那里停下。你到底是谁？

original: Well? You headed down or not?
translation: 怎么？你要不要下去？

original: Stick with us until we make it through to the base!
translation: 紧跟着我们一起去基地！

original: Take that elevator and report in to Defender Sibley.
translation: 坐电梯去向西布利捍卫者报到。

original: I think Defender Sibley's going to want to talk with you. Take that elevator down into the base.
translation: 我想西布利捍卫者要和你谈谈。坐电梯到基地中去。

original: So... you're in charge of Patterson's Suicide Squad, huh?
translation: 那么…你是帕特森敢死队的头头，对吧？

original: Congratulations on making it to the HQ. It's pretty fierce out there.
translation: 恭喜你成功到达总部，外面战况很激烈。

original: Here's your chem ration. I'm doctor Adami. Come see me if you need patching up.
translation: 这是你的药品配给。我是奥达米医生。需要包扎的话就来找我吧。

original: Thanks. Look, I've got to get back to HQ. I Found some papers before I got caught. Good hunting!
translation: 谢谢。听着，我得回到总部去。在我被抓之前我找到一些文件。祝你杀敌愉快！

original: Goddamn Commies caught me with my pants down. Don't tell anyone you found me like this, all right?
translation: 该死的中共在我睡觉的时候抓住了我。可别告诉别人你是这样找到我的，好吗？

original: They took us by surprise. I was the lucky one. Thanks for the rescue!
translation: 他们出奇不意地抓住了我们。我比较走运。感谢你们救了我！

original: Thank God! I thought I was a goner.
translation: 感谢上帝！我还以为我没命了。

original: Am I glad to see you!
translation: 很高兴见到你！

original: You enjoy being a "recruiter" for Paradise Falls, eh?
translation: 你很乐意成为天堂瀑的“招募员”，对吧？

original: Here's another collar and some caps.
translation: 这是另一个项圈和一些瓶盖。

original: The slaves keep rolling in. Keep this up and you're going to be rich!
translation: 奴隶源源不断。再这样下去，你就发财了！

original: Here's your caps and another collar.
translation: 这是你的瓶盖和另一个项圈。

original: Tallied the last slave you sent us. You're pretty good at the slaving thing. Keep it up!
translation: 算上你交给我们的最后一个奴隶。你很擅长奴役嘛。继续保持！

original: Here's another collar and pile of caps.
translation: 这是另一个项圈和一堆瓶盖。

original: Keep it up. We all make a ton of caps on every slave you send to us.
translation: 继续努力。你交给我们的每个奴隶，我们都能赚一大笔。

original: Here's your cut and another collar.
translation: 这是你那份和另一个项圈。

original: All better now, you big baby. Can I get back to work now?
translation: 全好了，你这大孩子。现在我能回去工作了吗？

original: Okay, you should be fine, and ready to run off and play.
translation: 好。你没事了，准备出去玩吧。

original: I'll say this; it's easier to work on a mungo, since you're a lot bigger. Easier to find a vein, at least.
translation: 我会这样说：对付毛人更简单，至少，更容易找到血管。

original: Thanks to you, we finally have that sniper, Arkansas, in a collar! You have no idea how many good men that prick put into the dirt.
translation: 谢谢你，我们终于抓住那阻击手阿肯色并给他戴上了项圈！你不知道有多少好手在他手里入了土。

original: I'm tempted not to sell him, just so we can torment him. Use him for target practice or something. Hehehe.
translation: 我真不想卖掉他，这样我们才能折磨他。用他来练习打靶或做其他事。呵呵呵。

original: Here's another collar. Keep those hoochies rolling in and you'll be rich in no time.
translation: 给你另一个项圈。继续努力让私货来得源源不断，很快你就会变得富有。

original: How the hell'd you get old queen Flak, into that collar?! I'm surprised you're still alive!
translation: 见鬼，你是怎么拿下“高炮”弗莱克，并给他戴上项圈的？我很惊讶你还活着！

original: We need to keep a close eye on that one, though. He knows our system too well.
translation: 可是我们要密切注意那家伙。他很了解我们的系统。

original: He sold us out to get into Rivet City. We'll never forget that. And now we'll make sure he never forgets it, either.
translation: 他出卖了我们才进入铆钉城。我们永远不会忘记。现在我们要让他也永远忘不了。

original: Here's another collar. Keep herding the swine in here and you'll have more bottle caps than you'll know what to do with.
translation: 这是另一个项圈。继续努力赶猪，瓶盖会多到你花不掉。

original: I've been wanting to get Red in here for a long time. I have a little something special planned for her.
translation: 我在这等着抓瑞德很久了，我对她有些特殊想法。

original: Take another collar, and keep those puppies coming!
translation: 拿着另一个项圈，继续努力抓那些狗崽！

original: Susan thought she could just up and leave, huh? We showed her different, didn't we?
translation: 苏珊认为她拍拍屁股就能走人？我们让她知道并不是这样的，对吧？

original: She'll think twice about slitting one of our throats now that she's collared! We'll need to come up with something extra special for her.
translation: 现在她被戴上了项圈，再想割我们的喉咙可得三思了！我们得想出点特殊待遇招呼她。

original: Here's another collar. You're a welcome addition to our little operation here.
translation: 给你另一个项圈。欢迎加入我们的小买卖。

original: Hold it right there. Nobody's allowed into Paradise Falls except on Slaver business. And I get to decide what qualifies as Slaver business.
translation: 站住。堕落天堂只允许从事奴隶买卖的人进入。而我来决定什么是奴隶买卖。

original: You didn't really think you could just sneak into Paradise Falls did you?
translation: 你不会真以为你能潜入天堂瀑吧？

original: Do I look like someone who wants to be your friend? Are you a moron? Why do you keep coming around? Piss off already!
translation: 我看上去像是想要成为你朋友的人吗？你是傻瓜吗？为什么还跟着来？你早就可以滚了！

original: Unless, have you changed your mind? Do you want to take me up on the offer of employment?
translation: 除非，你改变了主意？你想接受我提供的工作吗？

original: Please be seated in the nearest available Tranquility Lounger. Thank you for your cooperation.
translation: 请就座于附近空置的宁静巷催眠舱上。谢谢你的合作。

original: Please take a seat in the Tranquility Lounger.
translation: 请找个宁静巷催眠舱就座。

original: Welcome to Vault 112, Resident! According to sensors, you have arrived 202.3 years behind schedule.
translation: 欢迎来到112号避难所，居民！根据传感器显示，你比预定时间晚到了202.3年。

original: Please re-dress in your Vault-Tec issued Vault suit before proceeding.
translation: 在继续之前，请重新穿戴避难所科技发给你的避难所制服。

original: Once dressed, please proceed down the stairs to the main floor so that you may enter your assigned Tranquility Lounger.
translation: 穿戴完毕后，请由台阶下至主楼层，以便你进入分配给你的宁静巷催眠舱。

original: Please dress in your Vault 112 suit. Remove all other articles of clothing to prevent damage to the equipment.
translation: 请穿上你的112号避难所服装。脱掉所有其他服饰物品以免阻碍与损坏设备。

original: Thank you for your cooperation.
translation: 谢谢你的合作。

original: Please dress in your Vault 112 suit. Remove all other articles of clothing to prevent damage to the equipment.
translation: 请穿上你的112号避难所服装。脱掉所有其他服饰物品以免阻碍与损坏设备。

original: Thank you for your cooperation.
translation: 谢谢你的合作。

original: Don't worry, you'll get the hang of it.
translation: 别担心，你会掌握窍门的。

original: Here are some more BBs.
translation: 这还有些BB弹。

original: If you're having trouble, try crouching to steady your aim.
translation: 如果有麻烦，试着弯腰瞄准你的目标。

original: Go ahead. Try out your new gun on those targets over there.
translation: 去吧。试试你的新枪，靶子在那。

original: Before we get started, I wanted to let you know that my father and I have been talking.
translation: 在我们开始前，我想让你知道，我父亲和我谈论过了。

original: The Pride and I have decided that after all you've survived, you've done enough to be an honorary member of Lyon's Pride.
translation: “骄傲”和我一致决定，在你经历过这么多后，你已有资格成为“里昂斯的骄傲”的荣誉成员。

original: So congratulations. Membership comes with some privileges, including our Power Armor. You want the full suit, or the Recon armor?
translation: 那么恭喜你。成员会享受一些特权，包括我们的动力装甲。你想要全套装甲，还是侦察装甲？

original: So, you're back. We had feared both you and the G.E.C.K. were lost. Were you successful?
translation: 那么，你回来了。我们还以为你和G.E.C.K.都完蛋了。你成功了吗？

original: Hold it right there!
translation: 站住别动！

original: You're supposed to be in that holding cell. You're not going anywhere!
translation: 你应该呆在拘留室里。哪儿也不能去！

original: There's a full complement of guards in the next room. As soon as I get them, you're going back to your cell. In a body bag, if necessary.
translation: 隔壁房间有一整队守卫。我一喊他们，你就得回到你的牢房。如有必要的话，就装在尸袋里回去。

original: Why do you insist on making things difficult?
translation: 你为什么坚持要把事情复杂化？

original: Maybe I should start shooting. How much blood you think you can afford to lose before you tell me what I want to know?
translation: 或许我该开始射击。你考虑过在你告诉我我想知道的东西前，有多少血能流吗？

original: Did you really think we would fall for that? I have had ENOUGH of your games.
translation: 你真的以为我们会上当？我受够你的把戏了。

original: I should have killed you right away. We have the G.E.C.K., we'll get the code. We don't need you.
translation: 我应该宰了你。我们拥有了伊甸园创造器，我们会得到密码。我们不需要你。

original: So, you're awake.
translation: 你醒了。

original: Let's keep this nice and simple. You're going to tell me the code for that Purifier, and you're going to tell me now.
translation: 我们就简单明了点吧。告诉我净化器的密码，立刻告诉我。

original: As promised, here's the G.E.C.K. I hope it's worth it.
translation: 按照承诺，这是伊甸园创造器。我希望它对你有用。

original: Well, I'm afraid this is where you and I part company. I'll find my way out of this place, don't worry.
translation: 好吧，恐怕我们该在这分开了。我会找到办法离开这，别担心。

original: Maybe we'll meet again somewhere in the Wasteland.
translation: 或许我们会在废土的某地再见面。

original: Finally... freedom! True freedom! I cannot thank you enough for this gift.
translation: 终于……自由了！真正的自由！我无以回报你的大礼。

original: You have no idea how long I've pictured this moment in my mind... and it feels far better than I'd imagined.
translation: 你不知道我在脑海中，想像这一刻多久了……而这感觉远比我想象中的还要好。

original: Now, for my part of the bargain. Follow me.
translation: 现在，轮到我履行约定了。跟我来。

original: Finally... freedom! True freedom! I cannot thank you enough for this gift.
translation: 终于……自由了！真正的自由！我无以回报你的大礼。

original: You have no idea how long I've pictured this moment in my mind... and it feels far better than I'd imagined.
translation: 你不知道我在脑海中，想像这一刻多久了……而这感觉远比我想象中的还要好。

original: We both know you're here to obtain the G.E.C.K. Now, follow me. I'll retrieve the G.E.C.K. for you.
translation: 我们都知道你来这里是为了获得G.E.C.K.。现在，跟我来。我会为你取得G.E.C.K.。

original: Is there something amiss? The door still seems to be sealed.
translation: 有些不对劲？这门看来仍旧锁着。

original: Back so soon? What is it now? Come to gawk at the caged animal?
translation: 这么快就回来啦？现在干嘛？傻傻地看着笼中困兽？

original: Thanks for getting me out of there. I owe you one.
translation: 谢谢你帮我逃出来，我欠你一个人情。

original: Now you get back in there and make sure Penny stays safe. I'll try and contact her sometime, if I can. I need to lay low for a while.
translation: 现在你回那去确认佩妮的安全。如果可以的话，过段时间我会试着联系她。我需要保持低调。

original: Thanks for getting me out of there. I owe you one.
translation: 谢谢你帮我逃出来，我欠你一个人情。

original: Listen, there are kids in there. You've gotta get them out too, if you can. Just be careful.
translation: 听着，那还有些孩子。如果可以的话，你得帮他们也逃出来。但小心。

original: I'm gonna lay low for a while. As soon as they realize I'm gone, they're going to come looking for me. Thanks again.
translation: 我需要保持低调。当他们发现我跑掉后，会来找我的。再次谢谢你。

original: Thanks for getting me out of there. I owe you one.
translation: 谢谢你帮我逃出来，我欠你一个人情。

original: I'm gonna lay low for a while. As soon as they realize I'm gone, they're going to come looking for me. Thanks again.
translation: 我需要保持低调。当他们发现我跑掉后，会来找我的。再次谢谢你。

original: I gotta get someplace safe.
translation: 我得找个安全的地方。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: So what's the deal, mungo?
translation: 怎么回事，毛人？

original: Well, I guess this is one way to do it. We could've escaped, you know.
translation: 我想这能行。你知道，我们能逃出去。

original: If we're going to leave, then let's get it over with.
translation: 如果我们要走，那就先让我们搞定它。

original: So you gonna take care of that guard, or what?
translation: 你会把那些守卫收拾掉，对吧？

original: My hands are tied here. It's not like I want to be working with a mungo like you, but I got no choice. Come on.
translation: 我的人手不足。我可不想和你这样的毛人合作，不过我没得选择。来吧。

original: Oh God, mister. You gotta help us. You gotta get us out of here!
translation: 哦，天啊，先生！你要帮助我们，你得帮我们逃出这！

original: Oh God, lady. You gotta help us. You gotta get us out of here!
translation: 哦，天啊。小姐，你要帮助我们，你得帮我们逃出这！

original: You have my condolences. Your father was a good man.
translation: 请节哀顺变。你父亲是个好人。

original: May I start by saying that I am sorry for your loss. I was acquainted with your father, many years ago.
translation: 首先请允许我对你亲人的逝世表示遗憾。我多年前就认识你的父亲了。

original: The world has lost one of its few remaining visionaries.
translation: 世上又失去了一位为数不多的远见者。

original: With the fuses in place, you should be able to access the mainframe. No need to come back to the control room; just head straight there.
translation: 接通保险丝后，你就可以进入主机了；无需返回控制室，直接前往即可。

original: You're doing great out there. Keep it up.
translation: 你干得好。继续努力。

original: So the pumps are working, and some of the doors are opened. We're making progress.
translation: 水泵工作了，一些门也打开了。我们进展不错。

original: Problem is that the water shorted out a few key fuse boxes.
translation: 问题是水让一些关键的保险丝盒短路了。

original: Here, take these fuses and replace the ones that have burnt out.
translation: 给，拿这些保险丝去把烧掉的换掉。

original: We can't accomplish anything until we can get inside, but none of us are particularly capable fighters.
translation: 除非我们进到里面，不然我们什么都做不了，但是我们中没有能胜任战士工作的。

original: I hate to ask you to put yourself in harm's way, but you seem to have learned to handle yourself.
translation: 我讨厌将你推入危险的境地，但看上去你懂得怎么处理。

original: I need you to go in and make sure it's safe for Doctor Li and her crew.
translation: 我需要你进去确保李博士和她手下工作人员的安全。

original: Here we are. Where it all began. You remember your mother's favorite passage?
translation: 我们到了。一切开始的地方，你记得你妈妈最喜欢的那段吗？

original: Revelation 21:6. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life, freely.
translation: 启示录21:6。我是阿尔法和欧米伽，是起始，亦是终结。我要将生命水的泉源白白赐给口渴的人。

original: Don't you see? This is what it all means. The water, the purifier. THIS is the water of life. Your mother's dream.
translation: 你看见了吗？这就是它的含义。这水，这净化器。这就是生命之水。你母亲的梦想。

original: No point in wasting time. Let's get to work. There's much to be done.
translation: 别浪费时间了。我们开始工作，还有很多事要做。

original: I'm not trying to put you off, but we need to get to Project Purity. Anything else can wait until later.
translation: 我不想让你失望，但我们要前往净水工程，其他事都得等等。

original: My goodness... You must be James' daughter. You look so much like him.
translation: 我的天……你一定是詹姆斯的女儿。你看起来很像他。

original: I'm surprised to see you here. He gave me the impression that you were... somewhere else, and that we wouldn't be seeing you again.
translation: 见到你在这我很惊讶。他给我的印象是：你在……某处，我们无法再次见到你。

original: If you're here to talk to him, I'm afraid he's come and gone. The last I knew, he was headed back to the lab.
translation: 如果你来着是想和他谈谈，我恐怕他已经走了。据我所知，他回实验室了。

original: My goodness... You must be James' son. You look so much like him.
translation: 我的天……你一定是詹姆斯的儿子。你看起来很像他。

original: I'm surprised to see you here. He gave me the impression that you were... somewhere else, and that we wouldn't be seeing you again.
translation: 见到你在这我很惊讶。他给我的印象是：你在……某处，我们无法再次见到你。

original: If you're here to talk to him, I'm afraid he's come and gone. The last I knew, he was headed back to the lab.
translation: 如果你来着是想和他谈谈，我恐怕他已经走了。据我所知，他回实验室了。

original: Good to see you again, sweetie.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，亲爱的。

original: They say the G.O.A.T. never lies... According to this, you're slated to be the next vault chaplain. God help us all.
translation: 据说G.O.A.T.从不出错……根据结果，你将成为下任避难所牧师。上帝保佑。

original: Well, according to this, you're in line to be trained as a Laundry Cannon Operator. First time for everything, indeed.
translation: 根据结果，你接下来要受训成为一名洗衣机操作员。凡事总有第一次。

original: It's nice to know I can still be surprised. Pedicurist! I might have guessed manicurist or even masseuse, but apparently you're a foot person.
translation: 很高兴我还能感到惊喜。修脚师！我原以为你会是美甲师或按摩师，但看起来你是个脚踏实地的人。

original: It says here you're perfectly suited for a career as a Waste Management Specialist. A specialist, mind you, not just a dabbler. Congratulations!
translation: 结果显示你很适合成为一名废弃物处理专家。专家，看到没，可不是业余的。恭喜你！

original: Huh. "Vault Loyalty Inspector"... I thought that had been phased out decades ago. Well, sounds like a job right up your alley, hmm?
translation: 呃。“避难所忠诚度调查员”……我还以为这职业几十年前就被淘汰了。好吧，听起来是个很适合你的职业，对吧？

original: Interesting. "Clinical Test Subject"... sounds like something you should excel at. I guess you and your dad will be working together.
translation: 有意思。“临床实验对象”……听起来你会干的很出色的。我想你会和你爸爸一起工作。

original: Looks like the diner's going to get a new Fry Cook. I'll just say this once: hold the mustard, extra pickles. Ha ha ha.
translation: 看来我们的餐厅要有一个新厨师了。我只说一次：去芥末，多腌汁。哈哈哈。

original: Thank goodness. We're finally getting a new Jukebox Technician. That thing hasn't worked right since old Joe Palmer passed.
translation: 感谢上帝。我们终于有了个新的点唱机技师。那东西自从老乔·帕尔默死后就无法正常工作。

original: Well, well. Pip-Boy Programmer, eh? Stanley will finally have someone to talk shop with.
translation: 好，好，哔哔小子程序员，对吧？斯坦利总算有说话对象了。

original: Huh. I wonder who will be brave enough to be your first customer as the vault's new Tattoo Artist? I promise it won't be me.
translation: 呃。我很怀疑谁够胆成为你这避难所的新纹身艺师的首个顾客。我保证那不会是我。

original: Apparently you're management material. You're going to be trained as a Shift Supervisor.
translation: 显然你是个搞管理的材料，你会被训练成轮班主管。

original: Could I be talking to the next Overseer? Stranger things have happened.
translation: 难道我在和下任监督者谈话吗？一堆怪事。

original: Wow. Wow. Says here you're going to be the vault's Marriage Counselor.
translation: 哇。哇。结果显示你会成为避难所的婚姻顾问。

original: Almost makes me want to get married, just to be able to avail myself of your services.
translation: 我真想赶快结婚，这样才能享受到你的服务。

original: I always thought you'd have a career in professional sports. You're the new vault Little League coach! Congratulations.
translation: 我一直认为你会从事职业运动。你是避难所的新任小联盟教练！恭喜你。

original: Looks like you'll be putting your ... physical talents to good use as the vault's new Masseuse.
translation: 看上去你要将你的……身体本钱充分用于避难所的新按摩师这职业。

original: Look, I'm not looking to rumble with you. How about we just stay out of each other's business, like usual.
translation: 听着，我不想和你吵架。我们像往常那样井水不犯河水怎么样。

original: <coughs> You'd better stay away... I don't want you to catch what I've got.
translation: <咳嗽>你最好离远点……我不想传染到你。

original: Daddy... why... [crying]
translation: 爸爸……为什么……[哭声]

original: Mommy... why... [crying]
translation: 妈妈……为什么……[哭声]

original: Do you realize what you’ve done? You’ve triggered the Failsafe! Ruined everything! The subjects will die, and I’ll be stuck here in this hell! Alone!
translation: 你意识到你干了什么吗？你触发了故障保险！毁了这的一切！实验对象会死！我会被孤独地困在这地狱里！

original: You've ruined everything! EVERYTHING!
translation: 你毁了一切！一切！

original: Remember what I told you. The Failsafe. You've got to find it!
translation: 记住我告诉你的。故障保险，你得去找到它！

original: What... What the hell is this?
translation: 什么……见鬼，这是什么？

original: Not quite what I had in mind. But you get a chance to try again. Go to it!
translation: 不如我想的那样。但是你有机会再试一次。去吧！

original: You've saved me. I was afraid I'd be trapped in there forever.
translation: 你救了我。我还担心我会永远困在那。

original: It's so good to see you, but... What are you DOING here?
translation: 见到你真是太好了，但……你在这干嘛？

original: Son... You've saved me. I was afraid I'd be trapped in there forever.
translation: 孩子……你救了我。我还怕我会被永远困在那。

original: It's so good to see you, but... What are you DOING here?
translation: 见到你真是太好了，但……你在这干嘛？

original: What's it to be? A few caps to find out where your father went? Or are you going to have a go of it on your own?
translation: 怎么样？花几个瓶盖来打听你父亲的去处？还是你准备自己去找？

original: The Wasteland can be such an unforgiving place...
translation: 废土可是一片无情的地方……

original: Thank God you came along when you did. I don't know what I might have done...
translation: 感谢上帝你赶来，我不知道自己会怎样做……

original: Here. Take the gun. I don't want to find out what I'd do if I still had the gun when my father comes looking for me.
translation: 来，拿着枪。我可不想我父亲来找我时，我手里还拿着枪。

original: You'd better get out of here. I'll try to meet you at the vault door. If I don't make it... good luck.
translation: 你最好离开这。我会设法在避难所大门和你碰头，如果我不行的话……祝你好运。

original: We did it! My mom's gonna be okay! You're the best friend I've ever had, man!
translation: 我们做到了！我妈妈安全了！你是我这辈子最好的朋友，伙计！

original: Hey, I know it isn't much, but I want you to have my Tunnel Snakes jacket. Go ahead, take it.
translation: 嗨，我知道这不算什么，但拿上我的隧蛇帮夹克吧，给。

original: This place is a whole lot quieter, now. Thanks, I guess.
translation: 现在这地方安静多了，大概要谢谢你。

original: I got nothing to say to you.
translation: 我和你无话可说。

original: Well, whaddya know? It worked! I mean, I was pretty sure it would, obviously.
translation: 好啦，你知道什么？它工作了！我的意思是，我早就肯定它行，很明显。

original: Here, take a few radiation Chems with you. I'm sure you'll run into more in the future.
translation: 来，带些抗辐射药品。我肯定你以后会需要更多。

original: Well, you're alive... That's the good news. But there was a little side effect. A teeny, tiny, um, mutation. But it seems to be benign, at least.
translation: 你还活着……真是好消息。但有些副作用。小小的、极小的、呃……突变。但至少，看上去是良性的。

original: Here, take a few radiation Chems, as my little way of saying, "I'm sorry I twisted your DNA like a kitten with a ball of yarn."
translation: 来，带些抗辐射药品。这是说表示“很抱歉我把你的DNA像小猫玩毛线球一样弄糟了”的方法。

original: Okay, I even stitched a little smiley-face in you, to keep up your spirits. It's kind of hard to see from your side, though.
translation: 好了，我还在你身上缝了个小笑脸，让你精神点。虽然从你的角度很难看到。

original: Here, take this environment suit of mine. It will help with medical tasks, and it should help prevent the effects of exposure, too.
translation: 来，拿着我的环境防护服。它会有助于医疗任务，也能防止暴露带来的伤害。

original: Oh, hey! Watch your step, I think one of my test subjects got loose. But don't worry, it's probably harmless.
translation: 哦，嘿！留神脚下，我想我的一试验品松掉了。但别担心，它应该没危险。

original: Hey, don't mind the smell. I was just testing a few chemicals, but it's perfectly safe to breathe. Really!
translation: 嗨，别在意臭味。我在试验一些新的化学药品，但这气体很安全。真的！

original: What's up? Anything interesting out there in the wild Wasteland?
translation: 忙啥呢？荒原上有什么有趣的事？

original: How's it going out there in the Wastes?
translation: 废土现在怎么样了？

original: Hey, don't mind the smoke. It's perfectly safe to breathe. Really!
translation: 嗨，别在意这烟。这气体很安全。真的！

original: What's up? Anything interesting out there in the wild Wasteland?
translation: 忙啥呢？荒原上有什么有趣的事？

original: Oh, hey. What's up?
translation: 哦，嗨，什么事？

original: Hey, someone who doesn't have a cart for me to fix or a brahmin to wash up. That's a nice change.
translation: 嗨，没人要我去修车，也没人叫我去给双头牛搓澡。真是个可喜的变化。

original: Hope you don't mind the smell of brahmin dung. It's been one of those days.
translation: 希望你不介意双头牛的粪便味。每间隔几天就有。

original: Hey. How's the wide, wild Wasteland out there?
translation: 嘿，外面的废土怎么样了？

original: Changed your mind about the job, yet?
translation: 对工作改变主意了吗？

original: Oh my, it's you. I-I wasn't expecting visitors all the way out here.
translation: 哦，是你啊。我……我可没想到在这会有远道而来的来访者。

original: My name's Agatha. What brings you to my home?
translation: 我叫阿加莎，是什么风把你吹到我家来了？

original: My my my. You certainly do look a little bit worn out from your travels.
translation: 喔喔喔，看上去你的旅途很艰辛啊。

original: Oh, just look at my terrible manners! I'm Agatha. It's so nice to meet you.
translation: 哦，看我多没礼貌！我是阿加莎，很高兴见到你。

original: Now, what brings you all the way out here?
translation: 是什么风把你吹到我这来了？

original: Have you decided to find me a violin?
translation: 你决定帮我找小提琴了吗？

original: It was so weird! All of a sudden the ants went nuts and started fighting each other.
translation: 太不可思议了！突然间，蚂蚁们发狂并开始厮打起来。

original: It was like they were totally crazy! It was really scary, but kinda cool at the same time, ya know what I mean?
translation: 就好像它们完全疯了！真的很吓人，不过同时也很酷，你懂我意思吧？

original: It was so weird! All of a sudden the ants went nuts and started fighting each other.
translation: 太不可思议了！突然间，蚂蚁们发狂并开始厮打起来。

original: It was like they were totally crazy! It was really scary, but kinda cool at the same time, ya know what I mean?
translation: 就好像它们完全疯了！真的很吓人，不过同时也很酷，你懂我意思吧？

original: Come on! Tell me already!
translation: 拜托了！快告诉我！

original: Did you change your mind or something?
translation: 你改变了主意还是怎么？

original: Well, don't just stand there. You're distracting me. I must calculate the most efficient way to get to my equipment.
translation: 好了，别站在那，你在分散我注意力。我必须算出拿到我的设备的最佳方案。

original: I'll be damned! You did it, didn't you? You disarmed that thing!
translation: 该死！你做到了，对吧？你解除了那东西！

original: Here's your reward. Hell, why don't you move in? Could use someone like you. Got an empty place here you can use. Here's the key and deed.
translation: 这是你的报酬。见鬼，你干嘛不搬进来？我们需要你这样的人。有间空房你可以拿去用。这是钥匙和地契。

original: It ain't much to look at. But talk with Moira. She's got random odds and ends you might be able to spruce the place up with.
translation: 看起来不怎么样。但和莫伊拉谈谈，她有些零碎东西，你可以拿来装修下那地方。

original: I'll be damned! You did it, didn't you? You disarmed that thing!
translation: 该死！你做到了，对吧？你解除了那东西！

original: And all without asking for pay, too. Hell, why don't you move in?
translation: 完全不求回报。见鬼，你干嘛不搬进来？

original: Here's the key and the deed to an empty house. Consider yourself a Megaton citizen!
translation: 这是一间空房子的地契和钥匙。把你自己当成兆吨镇的镇民吧！

original: Oh and talk with Moira at Craterside Supply. She's got random odds and ends you might be able to spruce the place up with.
translation: 哦，还有去和坑边供应站的莫伊拉谈谈。她有些零碎的东西，你可以拿来装修下那地方。

original: The detonator is right over there. You may have the honor. Hit the switch!
translation: 按钮就在那里。这是你的荣誉。按下开关！

original: Do it! Detonate the bomb and together we'll usher in a new age of prosperity!
translation: 干吧！引爆这核弹，让我们一起进入一个繁荣新时代！

original: My God... what transcendent beauty... what purifying light...
translation: 我的天啊……多么超凡脱俗的美……多么净化人心的光……

original: Ahem... Allow me to collect myself, as I'm sure you're anxious to collect your payment.
translation: 嗯……允许我调整下自己。因为我想你肯定急着想拿到你的报酬。

original: I've been asked to extend to you an invitation to reside at Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 我奉命邀请你住进特佩尼大厦。

original: Here's the key, and deed, to your new master suite. It's on the top floor, first door on your right from the elevator. Enjoy your new accommodations.
translation: 这是你新主卧套房的钥匙和房契。在顶楼，从电梯出来右手边第一扇门。好好享受你的新住处吧。

original: Oh, and if you wish to spruce the place up a bit, speak with Lydia Montenegro in the Boutique le Chic.
translation: 哦，还有，如果你想给那布置得更漂亮些，就和时尚精品店的莉迪亚·黑山谈谈。

original: My God... what transcendent beauty... what purifying light...
translation: 我的天啊……多么超凡脱俗的美……多么净化人心的光……

original: Ahem... Allow me to collect myself, as I'm sure you're anxious to collect your payment.
translation: 嗯……允许我调整下自己的情绪。因为我想你肯定急着想拿到你的报酬。

original: Here's the key, and deed, to your new master suite. It's on the top floor, first door on your right from the elevator. Enjoy your new accommodations.
translation: 这是你新主卧套房的钥匙和房契。在顶楼，从电梯出来右手边第一扇门。好好享受你的新住处吧。

original: I hear that you decided to speak to Ian regardless of my warnings.
translation: 我听说你无视我的警告，决定要和伊恩谈谈。

original: Be that as it may, I am still interested in what you conversed about. Did he come to a decision?
translation: 无论如何，我仍旧对你们谈话的内容感兴趣。他做出决定了吗？

original: Great job kid!
translation: 干得好，孩子！

original: Here, take this mask. It'll keep you safe from the Ferals. Just don't get too close to them, or they'll sniff you out. Don't forget to PUT IT ON!
translation: 来，拿着这面具。这会保护你避免受到狂尸鬼的攻击。只要别靠他们太近，就发现不了你。别忘了戴上它！

original: Don't hurt me!
translation: 别伤害我！

original: Help us!
translation: 救救我们！

original: What's the status on those Tenpenny bigots?
translation: 那些特佩尼偏执狂现在怎样？

original: Well kid, what've you accomplished?
translation: 孩子，你完成了什么？

original: What's the word at Tenpenny, kid?
translation: 特佩尼那有什么消息，孩子？

original: What do you want?
translation: 你要干嘛？

original: I'm really not in the mood, so leave me alone.
translation: 我现在心情不好，所以离我远点。

original: Your constant need to chatter is pressing on my optic nerve.
translation: 我受不了你没完没了的唠叨了。

original: Yes?
translation: 嗯？

original: You have a curious look about you. I presume you have something interesting to tell me?
translation: 你的样子真奇怪。我想你有什么趣事要告诉我？

original: Saints alive! You've done it!
translation: 圣徒还活着！你做到了！

original: Quickly, let me have the ink and I will produce the copy of the Declaration of Independence!
translation: 快，给我墨水，我来做一张《独立宣言》的复制品。

original: Here you are... a perfect copy. That should give ol' George something to think about.
translation: 给你……一份完美的复制品。那可是老乔治想要的。

original: What are the next orders from the Congress?
translation: 国会的下个命令是什么？

original: I can't wait to add the Declaration to the Society's collection.
translation: 我等不及要将《独立宣言》纳入协会的收藏中了。

original: I'm expecting great things from you!
translation: 我很看好你！

original: What wonderful artifacts have you brought me?
translation: 你有什么精美的文物带给我？

original: So, have you decided to become a part of history and triumphantly return with the Declaration of Independence in hand?
translation: 你决定永垂史册，拿着《独立宣言》荣耀而归了吗？

original: Quite an impressive collection, isn't it? Well don't be shy, have a look around.
translation: 很令人印象深刻的收藏品，不是吗？别客气，到处看看。

original: Abraham Washington's the name... curator of this little slice of American History.
translation: 我叫亚伯拉罕·华盛顿……这一小片美国历史的管理人。

original: Go away! Hannibal is waiting for you.
translation: 走开！汉尼拔在等你。

original: What are we going to do? Those Slavers have captured the Memorial.
translation: 我们现在要去干嘛？那些奴隶贩子占领了纪念馆。

original: What? Oh! I didn't see you there. I get that way sometimes when I'm thinking.
translation: 什么？哦！我没看见你在那。当我思考的时候我有时会过于专注。

original: Excuse me, sir. I can't talk now. Slavers could be here any moment.
translation: 对不起，先生。我现在不能聊天。奴隶贩子随时都可能来。

original: Excuse me, ma'am. I can't talk now. Slavers could be here any moment.
translation: 对不起，女士。我现在不能聊天。奴隶贩子随时都可能来。

original: I don't talk to strangers. You need to go talk to Hannibal.
translation: 我不和陌生人说话。你去和汉尼拔谈吧。

original: Please, sir. Help us get rid of all those Slavers in the Memorial.
translation: 求求你，先生。帮我们把那些占领纪念馆的奴隶贩子赶走吧。

original: Please, ma'am. Help us get rid of all those Slavers in the Memorial.
translation: 求求你，女士。帮我们把那些占领纪念馆的奴隶贩子赶走吧。

original: Not now. We can talk after the Slaver attack.
translation: 现在不行。等奴隶贩子攻击结束后我们再谈。

original: Don't you be stopping here, mister. You got to talk to Hannibal first.
translation: 别说了，先生。你先去和汉尼拔谈谈。

original: Don't you be stopping here, lady. You got to talk to Hannibal first.
translation: 别说了，小姐。你先去和汉尼拔谈谈。

original: We've got to get those Slavers cleared out of the Memorial.
translation: 我们必须把纪念堂里的奴隶贩子都消灭了。

original: I'm sure Hannibal is cooking up a plan.
translation: 我确信汉尼拔正在酝酿一个计划。

original: You have a picture! And such a large one, too.
translation: 你有张照片！好大的一张。

original: I'll have no problems restoring the Memorial with this. Thank you!
translation: 对我来说，用这来修复纪念堂一点问题都没有。谢谢！

original: Make it quick. I've got a lot of work to do.
translation: 快点。我还有很多工作要做。

original: Those Slavers are all dead. We must stay vigilant. There may be more of them.
translation: 那些奴隶贩子都死了。我们必须保持警惕。可能还会来更多的。

original: We got wind that the Slavers are going to attack. We could really use your help in the fight.
translation: 我们得到风声，奴隶贩子准备攻击。我们在这场战斗中确实需要你的帮助。

original: I hear you found a great picture for Caleb. Once the Memorial site is safe, we can move there.
translation: 我听说你帮卡勒布找到张很棒的照片。只要纪念堂遗址安全了，我们就能到那去了。

original: So the Super Mutants are dead? This is wonderful news!
translation: 超级变种人死了？真是个好消息！

original: Now all you have to do is get Caleb his picture and we can begin our journey.
translation: 现在你要做的就是帮卡勒布拿到他的照片，然后我们就能开始我们的旅程。

original: We made it! The Memorial is really ours! I cannot thank you enough.
translation: 我们成功了！纪念堂是我们的了！我真不知道该怎么感谢你。

original: Here, take this. It's a token of our thanks.
translation: 来，拿着这。这代表我们的谢意。

original: You have been good to your word. You are welcome at the Temple of the Union anytime.
translation: 你言而有信。欢迎你随时来到联邦圣殿。

original: Take these schematics as a token of our gratitude.
translation: 拿着这些设计图，这是我们给你的谢礼。

original: Yeah, I killed them all after telling you not to.
translation: 嗯，在叫你别动手之后，我把他们都杀了。

original: I just couldn't trust anyone else to do it. I needed to see them dead with my own eyes.
translation: 我只是不能信任其他人去做。我要亲眼看他们死掉。

original: Anyway, the problem has been taken care of. I can go back to Paradise Falls now.
translation: 总之，问题解决了。我现在能回天堂瀑了。

original: I'll make sure they know you're our kind of people. You'll be welcome there any time.
translation: 我会让他们知道你是我们一伙的。那随时欢迎你。

original: Is there something else?
translation: 还有什么事吗？

original: What's your business stranger?
translation: 你有什么事，陌生人？

original: You again. Don't dawdle. Get in here.
translation: 又是你。别浪费时间。快进来。

original: You ain't supposed to be looking at me, to say nothing of talking to me.
translation: 你不该找我，更别说和我谈话了。

original: Now, beat it! Hannibal is waiting for you.
translation: 现在，快去！汉尼拔在等你。

original: Goddamn Slavers have the Memorial.
translation: 该死的奴隶贩子占领了纪念堂。

original: As soon as Hannibal gives the word, we're going to charge in there and take it from them.
translation: 只要汉尼拔一声令下，我们就去进攻那，把它从他们手里夺回来。

original: Stay sharp. The Wasteland is dangerous.
translation: 保持警惕。废土很危险。

original: You don't look like much, stranger. Bet you run from Radroaches.
translation: 你看上去不是很像，陌生人。我打赌你看见蟑螂都会跑。

original: I'm Simone Cameron. Don't fuck with me. Hannibal says I can't shoot you, but I ain't trusting you with a gun to my back.
translation: 我是西蒙妮·卡梅隆。别和我对着干。汉尼拔告诉我不能对你开枪，但你在我身后拿着枪令我不舒服。

original: Are you trying to piss me off?
translation: 你想把我惹火？

original: That's close enough. What the hell are you doing wandering around here?
translation: 真够悬的。见鬼，你在这游荡做什么？

original: I heard you're going to help us get those runaways.
translation: 我听说你准备帮我们抓住那些逃跑的家伙。

original: Make it quick. I'm busy.
translation: 快点，我很忙。

original: Quick! Unlock the door!
translation: 快！开门！

original: You've got to get this door unlocked!
translation: 你得把门打开！

original: We can talk back at Big Town. Let's get out of here!
translation: 我们回了大镇再说。我们快离开这！

original: I'll feel better once we're safe.
translation: 等安全了，我会觉得好些。

original: Thank God! Who are you? Never mind, I don't care right now. Let's go get Red and get out of here!
translation: 谢天谢地！你是谁？别在意，现在我不关心这。我们离开这去找瑞德！

original: Come on, you've got to untie me!
translation: 来吧，给我解开绳子！

original: Thanks! Who are you? Never mind, I don't care right now. Let's go get Red and get out of here!
translation: 谢天谢地！你是谁？别在意，现在我不关心这。我们离开这去找瑞德！

original: You lead. I'll follow. Let's go! Move it!
translation: 你带路，我跟着。我们走！快点！

original: No more talking! Let's get out of here!
translation: 别说了！我们离开这！

original: What's the hold up?
translation: 还在等什么？

original: Thanks for helping us. I just hope we can survive another attack. Probably won't.
translation: 谢谢你帮助我们。我只是希望我们能在下次进攻中活下来。可能不会。

original: Where's Red?
translation: 瑞德在哪？

original: Get the hell out of my face.
translation: 见鬼，离我远点。

original: If you're going to continue to irritate me, I'm not going to be so nice about it.
translation: 如果你还要继续激怒我的话，我就对你不客气了。

original: What... Where am I? What happened?
translation: 什么……我在哪？发生了什么？

original: How long have I been out?
translation: 我晕倒多久了？

original: Yeah? What is it? Ready to help?
translation: 嗯？怎么？想要帮忙？

original: Yeah? What do you want?
translation: 嗯？你要干嘛？

original: Yeah? What do you want?
translation: 嗯？你要干嘛？

original: I'm afraid she's going to be out for a while. She's not well at all.
translation: 恐怕她会晕倒一阵。她的情况不太好。

original: Don't worry though, I'm sure the rest of Reilly's Rangers will show up soon and take her home.
translation: 尽管放心，我肯定剩下的莱莉游骑兵会立刻出现并带她回家。

original: Well, I suppose thanks are in order... and a little something extra for your trouble.
translation: 我想先谢谢你……然后还有一点额外的谢礼。

original: I'm going to head back to Ranger Compound and see if Reilly's back yet. If you make your way there, Reilly will pay you herself.
translation: 我准备回游骑兵营地，看看莱莉是不是回来了。如果你去那里的话，莱莉会亲自给你报酬的。

original: If I can ever be of medical assistance or you need some supplies or repairs, let me or Donovan know.
translation: 如果你需要药品援助、补给或修理，就告诉我或者多诺万。

original: Well done! You have defeated the vile AntAgonizer, and you've brought back her suit so that we may destroy the last taint of her villainy!
translation: 好极了！你打败了卑劣的痛苦蚁后，而且你拿回了她的套装，我们能毁掉她罪恶的最后一个污点。

original: Hand it to me, and I'll make sure that no one else can ever bear the mantle of the foul AntAgonizer!
translation: 把它给我，我保证再也没有人会再次受到这肮脏的痛苦蚁后的阴影笼罩。

original: You had best hand over the AntAgonizer suit. It's too dangerous to let it fall into the wrong hands.
translation: 你最好把痛苦蚁后的套装给我。让它落入别有用心之人手中就太危险了。

original: Oh man! Did you see it? Did you see it? The AntAgonizer was all like, "Fear me!" But the Mechanist was all, "Stop, evil-doer!"
translation: 哦，哥们！你看到了没！你看到了吗？痛苦蚁后都像在喊“怕我吧！”，但是机械侠好像都在喊“住手，恶棍！”。

original: Whew! You wouldn't believe how much trouble those two have caused in this town. We've been looking for someone to get rid of them for a long time.
translation: 哟！你不会相信那两个家伙在这镇上惹了多少麻烦。长久以来，我们一直期待有人出现除掉他们。

original: But you just walked in and cleaned up the town, easy as you please! We're in your debt, that's for sure.
translation: 但你就这么走进去，然后解决了镇子的麻烦，就像玩似的！我们欠你的，真的。

original: I'm mayor of Canterbury Commons, think of me as your own Uncle Roe.
translation: 我是坎特伯雷社区的镇长，就当我是你的罗伊叔叔吧。

original: And take this, as our thanks for cleaning up the town.
translation: 然后拿着这，当作你解决镇子麻烦的酬谢。

original: Whew! You wouldn't believe how much trouble those two have caused in this town. We've been looking for someone to get rid of them for a long time.
translation: 哟！你不会相信那两个家伙在这镇上惹了多少麻烦。长久以来，我们一直期待有人出现除掉他们。

original: But you just walked in, downed one, and drove off the other, easy as you please! That'll be the last we see of them, you can be sure of that!
translation: 但你就这么进去，干掉一个，赶走另一个，跟玩似的！这是我们最后一次见到他们，肯定。

original: I'm mayor of Canterbury Commons, think of me as your own Uncle Roe.
translation: 我是坎特伯雷社区的镇长，就当我是你的罗伊叔叔吧。

original: And take this, as our thanks for cleaning up the town.
translation: 然后拿着这，当作你解决镇子麻烦的酬谢。

original: If you're here with some Quantum, I have caps with your name on them!
translation: 如果你有量子可乐，我就有印有你名字的瓶盖！

original: Please, tell me you have some of the good stuff. I need that Quantum!
translation: 拜托，告诉我你有些好东西。我需要量子可乐！

original: Oh! I hope you're here with some Quantum!
translation: 哦！我希望你有量子版核子可乐！

original: Oh my gosh oh my gosh oh my gosh! Did you find any Quantum?
translation: 我的天哪，我的天哪，我的天哪！你找到量子可乐了吗？

original: Oh! Did you need something else?
translation: 哦！你要些别的吗？

original: Well? What do you think? Will you take my offer?
translation: 那你怎么看？你会接受我的提议吗？

original: As promised... here is a little pick-me-up. An Ice Cold Nuka-Cola! Just look at the frost on the bottle. So cold and delicious!
translation: 按照约定……这是一点提神小物。一瓶冰镇核子可乐！看看瓶子上的霜。真是冰凉可口！

original: Pardon me... I tend to lose myself when I hold onto a Nuka-Cola.
translation: 请原谅我……我一拿起核子可乐就容易忘我。

original: Before I get to the little proposition I have for you let me tell you a little bit about Nuka-Cola Quantum.
translation: 在我给你小提议之前，让我先稍微介绍下量子版核子可乐。

original: So, you ready to hear me out? I have a bit of a proposition for you.
translation: 你准备听我说了？我有个小提议。

original: But before I get to that, let me tell you a little bit about Nuka-Cola Quantum.
translation: 但在我开始前，让我先稍微介绍下量子版核子可乐。

original: Bringing me some Quantum I hope?
translation: 希望能给我带来一些量子可乐吧？

original: Goodbye. We'll miss you.
translation: 再见。我们会想你的。

original: Good riddance. Get out.
translation: 感谢上帝，你要走了。快出去。

original: Hey, if it ain't a fellow Tunnel Snake, slumming it down here with the old crew?
translation: 嘿，要不是隧道蛇的同伙，就和老伙计们一起在这里过穷日子？

original: I thought you'd be out there tearing up the Wasteland and raising Hell!
translation: 我以为你在外面把废土搅得一塌糊涂呢。

original: But if you've gotta be back, might as well make yourself useful. You gotta help us.
translation: 但如果你一定要回来，就得让自己有点用。你得帮我们。

original: I hope you're making progress with my father. I can't imagine anyone else who would convince him we should venture outside.
translation: 我希望你和我父亲之间有进展。我不能想象还有其他人能说服他让我们出去闯荡。

original: Well, if it isn't my star pupil.
translation: 那不是我的明星学生嘛。

original: Yeah! I made it to Big Town! Big Town! Hurray! Now I just need to find Red.
translation: 耶！我到大镇了！大镇！万岁！现在我需要找到瑞德。

original: Glad to see you're finally awake. I can't believe they made you do that stupid ceremony.
translation: 很高兴看到你终于醒了。我不敢相信他们居然要你参加那个愚蠢的仪式。

original: They listen when I talk, but they don't hear... you know what I mean?
translation: 我说话，他们听，但根本没听进去……你懂我意思吗？

original: By insulting the Tree Father, you've insulted us all. You are no longer a guest here. I'd advise you to leave immediately.
translation: 你侮辱“树之父”就是侮辱了我们所有人。你不再是这的客人。我劝你立刻离开。

original: Any chance the Wasteland had for recovery someday is now gone.
translation: 能让废土有朝一日恢复生机的唯一机会就这么消失了。

original: Please... I wish to be alone right now.
translation: 拜托……我现在想一个人待会。

original: <bark>
You did a good thing, delivering that component to Zimmer. Telling him the android was dead. For that, I'm going to entrust you with some information.
translation: 你做了件好事，把那个组件交给了齐默。告诉他仿真人已经死了。为此，我会将一些信息托付给你。

original: The android's transformation was done by a man named Pinkerton, here in Rivet City. He's hidden down in the broken fore section of the ship.
translation: 仿真人的改造是铆钉城一个叫做平克顿的人完成的。他藏在断裂的船头。

original: You'll need to swim to reach him, but if you're inclined, Pinkerton can perform a facial reconstruction on you as well.
translation: 你得游过去找到他，但如果你愿意，平克顿也可以为你进行面部改造。

original: It won't disguise your identity, but you'll be able to experience life in a new skin, and truly understand... that we're all human on the inside.
translation: 那不会改变你的本质，但是你能用新面孔来体验生活，而且请理解……在我们内心，我们都是人类。

original: We'd best not be seen speaking with each other further. If you want a new face, see Pinkerton, down in the flooded fore section of the carrier.
translation: 我们最好不要被人看见再交谈了。如果你要张新面孔，去找平克顿，在航母被淹掉的船体前部。

original: The android's transformation was done by a man named Pinkerton, here in Rivet City. He's hidden down in the broken fore section of the ship.
translation: 仿真人的改造是铆钉城一个叫做平克顿的人完成的。他藏在断裂的船头。

original: You'll need to swim to reach him, but if you're inclined, Pinkerton can perform a facial reconstruction on you as well.
translation: 你得游过去找到他，但如果你愿意，平克顿也可以为你进行面部改造。

original: It won't disguise your identity, but you'll be able to experience life in a new skin, and truly understand... that we're all human on the inside.
translation: 那不会改变你的本质，但是你能用新面孔来体验生活，而且请理解……在我们内心，我们都是人类。

original: I got a lot to thank you for... I don't know how to do it.
translation: 我得好好感谢你……我不知道怎么报答。

original: Here... take this. It's always given me good luck.
translation: 给……拿着这。它一直都给我带来好运。

original: Don't you have something to do?
translation: 你就没有要做的事？

original: How did you get past the guard? What do you want?
translation: 你怎么通过守卫的？你要干嘛？

original: I haven't heard anything about Mister Crowley recently. So what could you possibly want?
translation: 我目前还没有听到克劳利先生的任何消息。你又想知道些什么？

original: Here's the key. He never even noticed.
translation: 这是钥匙。他不会注意到的。

original: How the heck are you?
translation: 你还好吗？

original: Guess we can try living with the Ghouls.
translation: 我想我们能试着和尸鬼一起生活。

original: I hope those Ghouls try to get along with us civilized people.
translation: 我希望那些尸鬼不要打扰我们这些文明人。

original: Hello, hello!
translation: 你好，你好！

original: I'm mighty appreciative of your straightening things out. Perhaps next time I go on safari I'll take you along.
translation: 我非常感激你把事情妥善处理了。或许下次旅行我会把你带上。

original: Is there something you require?
translation: 有什么你需要的东西吗？

original: Good job taking care of our little problem.
translation: 把我们的小问题解决得很好。

original: Thanks for helping those Ghouls. They really aren't so bad.
translation: 谢谢你帮助了那些尸鬼。他们真的不坏。

original: Hey... you're the one with the Ghoul friends... well I guess they're our friends now, too.
translation: 嗨……你是那个尸鬼的朋友……我想现在他们也是我们的朋友了。

original: Good job removing our little pest problem!
translation: 干得好，帮我们清理了害虫！

original: I have nothing to say to you. Except this: Watch your back!
translation: 我没话和你说，除了这句：小心！

original: Hrmph.
translation: 哼。

original: You did it! You got rid of those vile creatures! Good show!
translation: 你做到了！你赶走了那些卑劣的生物！干掉漂亮！

original: You'll get yours soon enough.
translation: 很快你会得到你应得的。

original: Goodbye!
translation: 再见！

original: Hello friend. Ghoul physiology is fascinating!
translation: 你好，朋友。尸鬼的生理机能真令人着迷！

original: Hello friend!
translation: 你好，朋友！

original: Those Ghouls won't be bothering us anymore, will they?
translation: 那些尸鬼不会再打扰我们了，对吧？

original: Hello!
translation: 你好！

original: Come to pour salt into the wound? Well, I won't stand for it!
translation: 想在伤口撒盐？我可受不了！

original: Zombie-lover!
translation: 丧尸迷！！

original: Fabulous!
translation: 难以置信！

original: You think I want to talk to you?
translation: 你觉得我想和你说话？

original: You've ruined my life!
translation: 你毁了我的生活！

original: Hey comrade! Those Ghoul's seem like a real community, hey? Adversity must have made them strong.
translation: 嗨，同志！那些尸鬼看起来是个真正的公社，对吧？曾经的不幸一定让他们变得很强。

original: Hey there!
translation: 嗨！

original: Take a real good look, because you won't be getting any of this!
translation: 好好看一看，因为你不会得到任何东西。

original: Hah! I'm doing just fine, no thanks to you!
translation: 哈！我也能做得同样好，不用谢你！

original: What do YOU want?
translation: 你要干嘛？

original: Glad to see you were able to convince these people to open their minds a little. Those Ghouls will liven things up around here for a long time!
translation: 很高兴看到你能说服这些人稍微开放点他们的思想。那些尸鬼会让这里很长时间都有生气的！

original: Well, it'll take a little elbow grease but then this place will be a true home!
translation: 这会费些体力，但之后这会变成一个真正的家！

original: Bastards. Could have done it the easy way and just let us live here with them. Oh well. Guess we better get started with the clean up.
translation: 杂种。可以让事情更简单的，让我们和他们一起生活。哦，算了。我想我们最好开始把这弄干净。

original: Don't know how you did it. I'd never allow those zombies room and board. But as long as Tenpenny keeps paying me I'll stay.
translation: 不知道你是怎么做到的，我是永远不会允许给那些丧尸提供食宿。但只要特佩尼继续付我钱，我会留下。

original: Good job handling those zombies!
translation: 干得漂亮，处理了那些丧尸！

original: What's up? Kill any more zombies lately?
translation: 什么事？最近杀丧尸了吗？

original: Hey soldier!
translation: 嗨，士兵！

original: The slaves know their place now, thanks to you.
translation: 现在奴隶知道他们的地位了，感谢你。

original: There you go, good as new.
translation: 好啦，一切如常。

original: You're bad. I don't think I should talk to you.
translation: 你是坏蛋。我不想和你说话。

original: Do you like being bad? Or is it just you can't help it?
translation: 你想当个坏蛋？还是你身不由己？

original: I bet you're so bad because your mom didn't love you.
translation: 我打赌你这么坏，是因为你妈妈不爱你。

original: I've heard of you. You're one of the good guys!
translation: 我听说过你。你是个好人！

original: It makes me feel safer knowing you're around.
translation: 你在这让我觉得更安全了。

original: You're my hero, mister. I want to be just like you when I grow up.
translation: 你是我的英雄，先生。我希望长大后像你一样。

original: You're my hero, ma'am. I want to be just like you when I grow up.
translation: 你是我的英雌，女士。我希望长大后像你一样。

original: Hey! It's my favorite wanker! I am so fucking glad I talked you out of putting a bullet in my brain. Hah ha!
translation: 嗨！是我最喜欢的废物！我真他妈高兴我说服了你，别把子弹打进我脑子里。哈哈！

original: Hey! It's my favorite bitch assassin! Hah ha! I am so fucking glad I talked you out of putting a bullet in my brain!
translation: 嗨！是我最喜欢的婊子刺客！哈哈！我真他妈高兴我说服了你，别把子弹打进我脑子里。

original: I presume you are still honoring our previous arrangement? I enjoy being alive, at least for the moment.
translation: 我猜你还在为我们先前的安排而自豪？我很高兴还活着，至少现在是。

original: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a ton of supplies, and now that it’s safe, I’m heading up there!
translation: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了成吨的补给，既然那安全了，我立刻就去！

original: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a bunch of high power explosives!
translation: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了好多高爆炸弹！

original: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a bunch of robot parts!
translation: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了好多机器人零件！

original: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a few Stealth Boys.
translation: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了一些隐身小子。

original: I’m headed to Big Town. There’s good money to be made there. They ordered a bunch of firepower.
translation: 我正准备去大镇。那很好赚钱。他们订了好多军火。

original: I'm heading up to Big Town to see what's left for the taking. I heard everyone up there was either killed or dragged off by Super Mutants.
translation: 我正准备去大镇，看看还有什么剩余东西可以拿。我听说那的人不是被杀就是被超级变种人拖走了。

original: Finders keepers, am I right? Ha Ha...
translation: 谁找到归谁，我说的对吧？哈哈……

original: That thing would have killed us all without your help. Thanks.
translation: 如果没有你的帮助，那东西会把我们都杀了的。谢谢。

original: Listen, you may as well take this map. That's where we were headed, but that Deathclaw cured me of my itch for Wasteland adventure.
translation: 听着，你最好也拿着这地图。那是我们要去的地方，但是死亡爪打消了我们去废土冒险的念头。

original: Grayditch... it's burning... it's burning!
translation: 灰渠……它在燃烧……它在燃烧！

original: Welcome back. Have you been successful in your search for books?
translation: 欢迎回来。你寻找书籍的任务成功了吗？

original: You've returned. Have you brought me any books?
