translation: 你回来了。你给我带回些什么书？

original: You've saved my life. I am in your debt.
translation: 你救了我的命。我欠你的。

original: I am forever in your debt. Thank you.
translation: 我永远欠你。谢谢。

original: We're almost to the door, don't stop now!
translation: 我们快到门口了，别停下！

original: Keep going, we're almost outside!
translation: 继续前进，我们就快出去了！

original: Thank God someone's come! You have to help me! Please!
translation: 感谢上帝，有人来了！你得帮帮我！求求你！

original: Good. He is safe. The Brotherhood are men of their word and so, here is your payment. Spend it well.
translation: 好极了，他安全了。兄弟会是守信用的，这是你的酬劳。好好拿去花吧。

original: Farewell, mercenary. May you find honor in your travels.
translation: 回见，佣兵。在你的旅途中找到你的荣誉吧。

original: Speak with Paladin Hoss.
translation: 和圣骑士霍斯谈谈。

original: You've got some serious stones walking through here by yourself.
translation: 你得有两下子才可以自己一个人通过这。

original: Hey. We grabbed this on our last mission. Thought you might like it.
translation: 嗨。上次任务我们拿了这。我想你可能喜欢它。

original: A badass like you, you deserve a cut of everything around here.
translation: 像你这样的坏蛋，这里的一切都应该分你一份。

original: Take it. It's yours.
translation: 拿着，这是你的了。

original: Check this out. Me and a couple of the boys thought you could use a cut of the loot we picked up.
translation: 看看这。我和几个兄弟认为你该得到一些我们战利品的分成。

original: Whew! I thought I was a goner. You saved my life.
translation: 呼！我以为我死定了呢。你救了我一命。

original: Here, take this. It's the least I can do.
translation: 来，拿着这。这是我唯一能做的。

original: Hello, stranger. I'm Tinker Joe, premier supplier of robotic parts and service throughout the D.C. Wasteland.
translation: 你好，陌生人。我是廷克·乔，特区废土上首屈一指的机器人零件和服务供应商。

original: Thank you! Whoever you are, thank you! The... things they talked about doing to me...
translation: 谢谢！不管你是谁，谢谢！他们正商量要干掉我……

original: Thank you, friend. We won't forget this.
translation: 谢谢你，我的朋友，我们是不会忘记的。

original: Thanks, friend. That was a narrow shave and no mistake. Probably would have eaten us or whatever those damned things do to people.
translation: 谢谢，朋友。那几乎是九死一生。或许我们会被吃或者被做些该死的事。

original: Listen, we got some water we can spare. Go ahead, you earned it.
translation: 听着，我们有一些备用的水。拿去，这是你应得的。

original: Whew. Thanks for the help. I thought I was a goner.
translation: 哟。谢谢帮助。我以为我死定了。

original: You probably saved my life. Here, take this. You look like you may need it more than I will.
translation: 或许你救了我的命。来，拿着。你看起来比我更需要这。

original: Where'd he come from? If you hadn't come along, that ugly brute probably would've eaten me, or dragged me off to wherever.
translation: 他从哪来的？如果不是你来了，这丑陋的畜生已经把我吃了或者把我拖到哪去了。

original: Here, take this. It's the least I can do.
translation: 来，拿着这。这是我唯一能做的。

original: Thanks, stranger. That thing would probably have killed me if it wasn't for you.
translation: 谢谢你，陌生人。如果不是你，这东西或许已经杀了我。

original: I wish I had more, but I want you to have this. And I won't take no for an answer.
translation: 我就这么点了，你都拿去吧。千万别拒绝。

original: It's good to see you back. But you'd better get to the lab right away, and report to Elder Lyons.
translation: 很高兴见到你回来。但是你最好立刻赶去实验室，向里昂斯长老报到。

original: I'm sorry, but I really don't have time to talk right now. Perhaps Scribe Jameson could help you?
translation: 我很抱歉，但我真的没空聊天。或许詹姆森学士能帮你？

original: The Enclave seems to have developed advanced plasma-based weaponry. I need to analyze our Power Armor...
translation: 看来英克雷已经研发了先进的等离子武器。我需要分析我们的动力装甲……

original: What I wouldn't do to get my hands on one of those Enclave vertibirds...
translation: 我怎么都想逮到一架英克雷飞鸟……

original: All this time spent acquiring technology, and we look like cavemen next to the Enclave. That is not acceptable.
translation: 耗费了这么多时间来研发技术，但和英克雷比起来，我们看起来就像穴居人。这不能接受。

original: Super Mutants, Enclave -- they all bleed the same. No worries.
translation: 超级变种人，英克雷 — 他们一样会流血。别担心。

original: Welcome to the Citadel. Just remember -- you're a guest in our home. I expect you to behave yourself.
translation: 欢迎来到大本营。请记住 — 你是我们的客人。我希望你遵守规矩。

original: Welcome to the Citadel, friend of Steel.
translation: 欢迎来到大本营，钢铁之友。

original: You ever seen a Super Mutant's head explode? Hell of a mess.
translation: 你见过一个超级变种人的脑袋爆炸吗？那真是恶心得一塌糊涂。

original: I hear those Enclave soldiers are equipped with Plasma weapons. Lucky bastards.
translation: 我听说那些英克雷士兵装备了等离子武器。幸运的杂种。

original: I will serve the Citadel and Elder Lyons until my dying breath. Is there any better life?
translation: 我会为大本营和里昂斯长老效忠至死。还有比这更好的人生吗？

original: Long live Elder Lyons!
translation: 里昂斯长老万岁！

original: Glad to see you and that egghead Li made it here in one piece. I heard what happened at that purifier. Hell of a thing.
translation: 很高兴见到你和书呆子李安全到了这。我听说净化器那的事。真是见鬼。

original: Initiate! You've got a lot of nerve to interrupt... Oh, my apologies, stranger. I thought you were one of these worthless Initiates.
translation: 新兵！你真有胆量，敢打断……哦，对不起。陌生人。我还以为你是那些没用的新兵。

original: I swear, these kids'd be lost without me here to powder their asses.
translation: 我保证，要是没有我照料的话，这些孩子早就完蛋了。

original: How may I serve you, friend of Steel?
translation: 我能为你做些什么，钢铁之友？

original: "If we value the pursuit of knowledge, we must be free to follow wherever that search may lead us."
translation: “如果我们珍惜对知识的追寻，那我们必须任由研究引领我们前进。”

original: I found that in an ancient book. The words of wisdom of one of the greatest men of the former civilization.
translation: 我在一本古书中找到了这句话。这是前文明中一位伟人的智慧之言。

original: The Elder sent word of your arrival. I am Scribe Peabody. Welcome, et. cetera...
translation: 长老说过你要来。我是博迪学士。欢迎，之类的……

original: Now, I'm really very busy. Is there something you needed?
translation: 现在我真的很忙。有什么你需要的吗？

original: What do you want, outsider?
translation: 你要什么，外来人？

original: I salute you, warrior. You walk among us, but apart from us. How may I aid you?
translation: 向你致敬，勇士。我们理想相同，却不得不分道而行。我能怎么帮你？

original: So what's the deal? You gonna get me some Sugar Bombs or what?
translation: 那么，怎么样？你要给我一些甜麦炮弹还是什么？

original: You're not... not here to try and steal my secrets are you?
translation: 你不是……不是来偷我的秘密的吧？

original: I like these guys, they let me play with their pucks.
translation: 我喜欢这些人，他们让我玩他们的冰球。

original: Hey, I may be just a Winger now, but I'll make Centre soon.
translation: 嗨，我或许现在只是个边锋。不过我很快就会成为中锋。

original: Sorry, we've got practice. Maybe we'll cross sticks again one day.
translation: 抱歉，我们要训练。或许有朝一日我们会有机会切磋球技。

original: I would surely have perished if it wasn't for Mister Tenpenny and his tower.
translation: 如果不是特佩尼先生和他的大厦，我肯定早就死了。

original: So, Crowley is dead, eh?
translation: 克劳利死了，呃？

original: Here's your pay. Now, don't spend it all in one place, unless that place is Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 这是你的酬劳。现在，别在一个地方花光它，除非那地方是特佩尼大厦。

original: Fancy that! A visitor. I seldom get visitors. Which is a tiresome shame because I'm usually relentlessly bored out of my right mind!
translation: 有趣！一个来访者。我很少接待来访者。那很烦人，我经常被无情地打乱正常思维。

original: All of these confounded people fluster about like I'm made of eggshells and about to fall to pieces at any moment. I'm surprised they even let you in.
translation: 所有这些糊涂蛋都很惊恐，好像我是蛋壳做的，随时都会掉在地上摔成碎片。我很惊讶他们居然让你进来。

original: So what do you think of my fine tower here? It's quite the jewel of the Wasteland isn't it? I daresay I'm quite proud of it myself.
translation: 你觉得我可爱的大厦怎么样？它真是废土上的一粒宝石，对吧？我为此感到自豪。

original: Welcome to New Urban Apparel. I carry the finest in Pre-War clothes. Hurry up, let's get you out of those old rags and into something fabulous!
translation: 欢迎来到新都市服装。我有最好的战前衣服。快点，把这些破抹布脱了换上漂亮的新衣服！

original: Hurry up, let's get you out of those old rags and into something fabulous!
translation: 快，让我们把你这身旧抹布换掉，换身动人的！

original: I'm off duty. Come back when... ah, what the hell. Let's just get it over with. I'm Doctor Banfield, what do you need?
translation: 我下班了。等……啊，见鬼。我们快点结束吧。我是班菲尔德医生，有什么事？

original: You look hurt. It's a good thing you've come in.
translation: 看来你受伤了。你来对地方了。

original: I know you. You're that girl. You know, the one that... whatever.
translation: 我知道你，你是那女孩，你知道，就是那……随便是谁吧。

original: Happy Holidays! Care for a drink?
translation: 假日快乐！来杯喝的？

original: Ah yes. Mister Burke is expecting you. He is waiting for you on the balcony.
translation: 啊，是。伯克先生正期盼与你见面。他在阳台等你。

original: Mister Tenpenny isn't taking callers.
translation: 特佩尼先生正在会客。

original: I'm on duty. Can't talk. Direct your security concerns to Chief Gustavo directly.
translation: 我在值班，不方便说话。请直接向古斯塔沃长官反映你的安全顾虑。

original: I'm not here for your entertainment.
translation: 我不是在这陪你玩的。

original: Look, bud. It'd be best if you just drift on by and leave us alone.
translation: 听着，伙计。你最好把自己挪开，让我们自己待着。

original: What's it to be? A few caps to find out where your father went? Or are you going to have a go of it on your own?
translation: 怎么样？花几个瓶盖来打听你父亲的去处？还是你准备自己去找？

original: The Wasteland can be such an unforgiving place...
translation: 废土可是一片无情的地方……

original: No luck finding dear old dad? Can't say it surprises me. Wasteland's a big place. Maybe you need a drink.
translation: 找不到你亲爱的爸爸？我一点都不惊讶。废土可是很大的地方，或许你要杯喝的。

original: You're still standing here, and I can't think why. You know where your father went. Seems to me you ought to be out searching the Wastes.
translation: 你还站在这，我不知道还有什么理由。你知道你爸爸去哪了，我想你该到废土去找他。

original: Boy, you're glowin' like a goddamn reactor core. You need help?
translation: 孩子，你身上发光像个该死的反应堆核心。需要帮助？

original: Girl, you're glowin' like a goddamn reactor core. You need help?
translation: 女孩，你身上发的光像个该死的反应堆核心。需要帮助？

original: Looks like you went and got yourself irradiated. Too bad for you, I'm off duty. Stop by the clinic in the morning.
translation: 看来你受辐射污染了。太糟了，我下班了。明天早上再来吧。

original: What the hell are you standin' there bleedin' on my floor for? If you need help, then ask for it, dammit!
translation: 你他妈干嘛站在我的地板上流血？如果你要帮助就说，见鬼！

original: The Doctor is off duty. Go away.
translation: 医生下班了，走开。

original: Don't shoot! Please! Just tell me what you want!
translation: 别开枪！求你！你说你要什么吧！

original: <sigh> What'll it be?
translation: <叹气> 会是什么呢？

original: Oh, man... I'm glad to see you. Moriarty's been especially nasty lately and I need a friendly face.
translation: 哦，哥们……很高兴见到你。莫里亚蒂近来特别讨厌，我需要友善的面孔。

original: Dad used to say... oh, never mind...
translation: 爸爸常说……哦，算了……

original: Dad usually doesn't like when I talk to strangers.
translation: 爸爸一般不喜欢我和陌生人说话。

original: Be careful, mister. My dad is right over there. Try anything, and I'll yell for him.
translation: 小心，先生。我爸爸就在那。你敢对我怎样我就叫他。

original: Be careful, lady. My dad is right over there. Try anything, and I'll yell for him.
translation: 小心，小姐。我爸爸就在那。你敢对我怎样我就叫他。

original: The noodle stand is closed right now. If you need something, talk to Leo.
translation: 面条摊现在关了。如果你要什么，和利奥说。

original: Oh, look. Another one of your pampered vault assholes. Look here, vault asshole -- I don't like you. Stay clear of me and we'll have no trouble.
translation: 哦，看。又是个暴饮暴食的避难所混蛋。听好，避难所混蛋 — 我不喜欢你。离我远点，我们就不会有麻烦。

original: Have you seen a radiphlange anywhere around here? I could really use one... ah, never mind. What can I get you?
translation: 你在这附近见过电台投射器吗？我真的要用一个……啊，别介意。你要什么？

original: Well goddamn. You're new, right? I've got to admit, the outfit's a little weird, but that's okay, that's okay. Name's Leo Stahl. It's a pleasure!
translation: 该死，你是新来的，是吗？我得承认，这套装有点怪异，但是没关系，没关系。我是利奥·斯塔尔。很荣幸！

original: Well goddamn. You're new, right? Name's Leo Stahl. It's a pleasure! It's a pleasure! Yeah!
translation: 该死，你是新来的，对吧？我是利奥·斯塔尔。很高兴！真的很高兴！耶！

original: <sighs> It's you. I was hoping that you'd have moved on. What do you want?
translation: <叹气>是你。我还指望你走了。你想干嘛？

original: Hey hey! Nice to see you! Everything okay? You doing all right? You need something? Come on, talk to me!
translation: 嗨，嗨！很高兴见到你！都好吧？干得不错吧？你需要东西？来吧，和我谈谈！

original: Alright! Good to see you again! What's new? Feel like having a drink? C'mon, let's talk!
translation: 好吧！再次见到你！有什么新消息吗？感觉想要喝一杯？来吧，我们谈谈！

original: Heya! How's it going?
translation: 你好！你好吗？

original: Hi, I'm Maggie. I live with Billy. Billy Creel. Do you know him? He's not my dad or anything, but he takes care of me now.
translation: 嘿，我是玛姬。我和比利一起住。比利·克里。你知道他吗？他不是我爸爸或什么人，但是他现在照顾我。

original: If you see Nathan, tell that man to get his ass back home.
translation: 如果你见到内森，告诉他滚回家来。

original: You seen Nathan anywhere around here?
translation: 你见到内森在附近什么地方吗？

original: Hi there. I'm Nova. New to Megaton, huh? Do yourself a favor and keep walking. Some of us stay for a few days... and then it's five years later...
translation: 你好，我是诺瓦。刚来兆吨镇的？为你自己好，继续赶路吧。我们当中一些人只想待几天……然后过去了五年……

original: Listen, I'm working right now. So make it quick, okay?
translation: 听着，我现在正在干活。因此动作快点，好吗？

original: I'm just here to guard the goods. That's all.
translation: 我只是来看守货物而已。

original: I'm here to watch over this stuff. Only touch what you've paid for, and we'll have no problem.
translation: 我在这看守。只碰你付过钱的东西，那我们就会相安无事。

original: I've got my eye on you.
translation: 我盯着你呢。

original: This place is so much better than Moriarty's. That place is just filled with scum.
translation: 这比莫里亚蒂那好多了。那都是人渣。

original: Pull up a chair if you want.
translation: 如果需要就拉张椅子过来。

original: Hey there, stranger. Talk to Leo if you need something.
translation: 嗨，陌生人。如果有什么需要就和利奥说。

original: Always good to see a new face.
translation: 很高兴见到新面孔。

original: Leo's a nice guy, a bit twitchy, but nice.
translation: 利奥是个好人，他有点急躁，但是个好人。

original: Don't mind Andy, he's just a busy guy.
translation: 不用介意安迪，他只是有些忙。

original: Welcome to... uh... the Capital Preservation Society.
translation: 欢迎光临……额……首都保护协会。

original: Hi. I'm Angela. My dad runs Gary's Galley. If you want anything to eat, let me know when you are ready to order.
translation: 嗨。我是安吉拉。我爸经营加里厨房。如果你想吃点什么，点餐的时候告诉我一声。

original: Hi. I'm Angela. I run Gary's Galley. Let me know when you are ready to order.
translation: 嗨，我是安吉拉。我经营加里厨房。准备点餐的话就告诉我。

original: Welcome to Gary's Galley. Can I take your order?
translation: 欢迎光临加里厨房。可以点菜了吗？

original: Lay a hand on Doctor Zimmer, and I'll snap your neck like a chicken bone.
translation: 你敢动齐默博士一根汗毛，我就像拧鸡骨一样拧断你的脖子。

original: That's close enough. Keep your hands where I can see them.
translation: 够近了。把你双手放在我能看见的地方。

original: The market is closing soon. You'd better make it quick.
translation: 市场很快就关门了。你最好动作快点。

original: Welcome to Potomac Attire. I am Bannon, proprietor and City Council member.
translation: 欢迎光临波托马克服装。我是班侬，这的经营人和城市议会成员。

original: I carry discriminating attire for discriminating customers.
translation: 我为不同客户准备不同的服饰。

original: I heard that Danvers found a letter from Slavers in Seagrave's room.
translation: 听说丹佛斯在西格雷夫的房间找到一份奴隶贩子寄来的信。

original: That will teach that bastard to mess with me.
translation: 看那杂种还敢不敢找我的麻烦。

original: I think you've earned a permanent discount here.
translation: 我想你已经获得了这的永久折扣。

original: Welcome to Potomac Attire.
translation: 欢迎光临波托马克服装。

original: I think I've seen you in here before. When you're ready to buy, just let me know.
translation: 我觉得之前有在这见过你。你什么时候想买了，就来找我。

original: Have you found anything you like?
translation: 看中了什么？

original: I'm Belle Bonny, and this is the Muddy Rudder.
translation: 我是贝勒·邦尼，这是“泥舵”酒吧。

original: I'll tell you what I tell all the fresh meat. Don't start anything down here or I'll have Brock kick your ass.
translation: 我把丑话说在前面。别在这找麻烦，否则我让布洛克给你好看。

original: I'm Belle Bonny, and this is the Muddy Rudder.
translation: 我是贝勒·邦尼，这是“泥舵”酒吧。

original: I'll tell you what I tell all the fresh meat. Don't start anything down here or I'll have to kick your ass.
translation: 我把丑话说在前面。别在这找麻烦，否则我会给你好看。

original: You're a new one. I'm Belle Bonny of the Muddy Rudder. Make it quick.
translation: 你是新来的吧。我是“泥舵”酒吧的贝勒·邦尼。动作快点。

original: I'm Brock, the bouncer. I take care of the troublemakers. You aren't going to be a troublemaker, are you?
translation: 我是保镖布洛克。我负责处理找麻烦的人。你不想找麻烦，对吧？

original: Don't tell me your problems.
translation: 我不想听你的问题。

original: This place won't clean itself. That's my job.
translation: 这不会自己干净起来的。是我打扫的。

original: Look, I'm busy.
translation: 听着，我现在很忙。

original: This is A Quick Fix. I mean that's the name of our shop. Paulie and mine that is. My name is Cindy. Cindy Cantelli.
translation: 这是“快速修复”。我指的是这商店的名字。我和保利的商店。我叫辛迪，辛迪·坎特利。

original: This is A Quick Fix. I mean that's the name of the shop. My name is Cindy. Cindy Cantelli.
translation: 这是“快速修复”。我指的是这商店的名字。我叫辛迪，辛迪·坎特利。

original: Nice to see you again. Are you looking for a quick fix?
translation: 很高兴再见到你。你需要快速修复吗？

original: Made up your mind yet?
translation: 想好了吗？

original: I'm not supposed to talk to strangers.
translation: 我不能和陌生人谈话。

original: Yes, miss.
translation: 是的，小姐。

original: Maybe you don't know who you're talking to. I'm Commander Danvers, assistant chief of security.
translation: 或许你不知道你正在和谁说话。我是丹佛斯指挥官，警卫助理长官。

original: Have you seen Angela? I need to ask her something about our wedding.
translation: 你见过安吉拉吗？我需要向她询问我们婚礼的事。

original: Oh... never mind. I just remembered. Sorry. I'm so scatterbrained these days. What was it you wanted again?
translation: 哦……没关系。我想起来了。对不起，我最近脑子有点乱。你想要什么来着？

original: You're wounded. Let me bandage that.
translation: 你受伤了。我来给你包扎一下。

original: It's almost closing time. I'd get out of here if I was you.
translation: 快关门了。如果我是你，我就离开这。

original: This here is Flak and Shrapnel's gun shop. Pretty catchy, huh? Take a look around. If you see anything you like, I'll be right over here.
translation: 这是“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的枪械店。很好记，呃？随便看看吧。如果看中什么，就去那找我。

original: Decided to check out the shop, eh? If you want any of this shit, just holler.
translation: 想要在店里看看是吗？如果想要什么东西，叫我一声就行了。

original: Made up your mind?
translation: 想好了吗？

original: I'm Flak. If you want something better than that peashooter, stop by Flak and Shrapnel's.
translation: 我是“高炮”弗莱克。如果你想要比那玩具枪好的武器，来“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的店里看看。

original: I'm Flak. If you want something better than that stick of yours, stop by Flak and Shrapnel's.
translation: 我是“高炮”弗莱克。如果想要比你那棍子好的武器，来“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的店里看看。

original: I'm Flak. If you want a decent weapon, stop by Flak and Shrapnel's.
translation: 我是“高炮”弗莱克。如果你想要件像样的武器，来“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅的店里看看。

original: Let me introduce myself. I am Gary Staley gourmet chef and gourmand. I'll be preparing your meal.
translation: 我先介绍下自己。我是美食家兼厨师长加里·斯塔利。由我来为你准备用餐。

original: My specialty is Mirelurk Cakes. Although the iguana is very popular too.
translation: 我的招牌菜是泥沼蟹饼。鬣蜥类的也很受欢迎。

original: Ah! I knew you wouldn't be able to stay away from my cuisine for long.
translation: 啊！我就知道你不久就会再来光临我的餐馆的。

original: How may I serve you?
translation: 请问能为你做些什么？

original: This isn't a good time. My daughter, C.J. is missing.
translation: 现在不是时候。我女儿长江不见了。

original: If you hear anything, please let me know right away.
translation: 如果你打听到什么消息，请立刻告诉我。

original: This place could use a few more people willing to work. Everything is falling apart. I'm the only one willing to fix it.
translation: 这地方需要更多愿意工作的人。所有东西都快散架了，我是唯一一个愿意修理的人。

original: I'm busy. I've got a lot of repairs to make.
translation: 我很忙。我有很多修理工作要做。

original: I'm scared. Will you take me home? Take me to my Mom.
translation: 我很害怕。你能带我回家吗？带我去见我妈妈。

original: I'm scared. Will you take me home?
translation: 我很害怕。你能带我回家吗。

original: I heard Sister is dead. Thank God!
translation: 听说“修女”死了。太好了！

original: I'd rather be alone just now.
translation: 现在还是让我一个人静一静吧。

original: I wish I had the courage to end it all.
translation: 我希望自己有勇气去结束这一切。

original: I'm just taking things one day at a time.
translation: 我每天就一次。

original: Just leave me alone.
translation: 总之别管我。

original: Haven't seen you in here before. Do you need a fix? I might have what you need. You can always come see Paulie to get what you need.
translation: 之前没见过你。需要修理吗？我说不定有你需要的。有什么需要随时都可以过来找保利。

original: Who are you? Got any Psycho? I could really use a fix, but I'm broke.
translation: 你是哪位？有疯狂药吗？我真想自己来一支，可我身无分文。

original: Ha ha! I run the chem shop, but I'm broke and can't buy chems!
translation: 哈哈！我经营药店，却穷得买不起药品！

original: Looking for a fix?
translation: 需要修理吗？

original: Make it quick, will ya? I'm coming down and I gotta get my fix.
translation: 快点，好不好？我到这来就是让你修一下。

original: How the hell did you get in here? Hmph. I suppose you can't be all that bad if you made it this far without dying.
translation: 见鬼，你怎么进来的？哼。我觉得你既然能够活到现在，相信身手一定不错。

original: This is the part where you tell me what the hell you are doing bothering an old man who obviously wants to be left alone... Get on with it already!
translation: 该你说说为他妈什么来打搅一个显然想独处的老人了……快点啊！

original: You'd better get out of here. The guards are going to close up soon.
translation: 你最好立刻离开，守卫要包围这里了。

original: Howdy. I'm Seagrave. Seagrave Holmes. I have a little of just about everything here.
translation: 你好。我是西格雷夫，西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。我这什么都有点。

original: Hey! I heard that Bannon got caught trying to frame me.
translation: 嗨！听说班侬想要陷害我而被抓了。

original: I also heard you ratted him out. I think you've earned a true, blue friendship discount.
translation: 我还听说你出卖了他。我想你获得了一个真正的友情价。

original: You sneak into my room, steal my property, and then tell the world about it.
translation: 你潜入我的房间，偷走了我的财物，然后大肆宣扬。

original: I'd ban you from my shop if they'd let me. Instead I'll just have to settle for ripping you off.
translation: 如果他们同意，我会把你挡在门外。但我宁愿把你榨干。

original: Take a look around. I got all kinds of stuff in here.
translation: 好好看看吧。我这应有尽有。

original: The shop's closed right now. Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 商店已关门，还有什么能帮到你的吗？

original: We're going to close soon. You'd better get out of here.
translation: 我们就要关门了。你还是快点走吧。

original: They call me Shrapnel. I run this place. Got the best damn armament you'll ever see.
translation: 他们叫我“榴弹”小帅。我经营这地方。你在这可以见到最精良的装备。

original: If you want any of this shit, just say so. Otherwise keep your fingers the hell away from the triggers. I don't want no accidents.
translation: 想要哪件烂货就说出来。否则让你丫的手指离扳机远点。我不想出乱子。

original: Hey, good lookin'. How come you haven't bought me a drink yet?
translation: 嗨，帅哥。为什么你不请我喝一杯？

original: Shit. Just what this hole needs. Another woman.
translation: 狗屎。想什么来什么，又来个女人。

original: Either buy me a drink, or take your skanky ass somewhere else.
translation: 给我买杯喝的，不然你就离我远点。

original: Welcome to the Weatherly Hotel. I'm your hostess, Vera Weatherly.
translation: 欢迎光临韦瑟利旅馆。我是你们的女主人，薇拉·韦瑟利。

original: Welcome back, ma'am.
translation: 欢迎回来，女士。

original: Welcome back, sir.
translation: 欢迎回来，先生。

original: Oh... hey! What do you need, young lady?
translation: 什么……呃？我？你和我讲话吗？啊？你需要什么？

original: I miss Eulogy...
translation: 我要说的，尤勒基先生都已经替我说了。

original: Mr. Eulogy don't like me talking to the johnnies without his permission.
translation: 你想要什么，呆子？

original: What do you want, square?
translation: 告诉你真相，我很高兴那蠢货死了。

original: To tell you the truth, I'm glad that fool is dead.
translation: 尤勒基负责这生意。

original: Eulogy handles the business.
translation: 什么？见到什么喜欢的了吗？

original: Look, nothing personal, but if you need something, talk to the clown in the hat.
translation: 再盯着我看，我就揍你。

original: You're a mess. I hope you brought a lot of money with you.
translation: 你是想把血都撒在我身上，还是想付钱给我来修好你？

original: Are you just going to bleed on me, or are you going to pay me to fix you?
translation: 我喜欢看到跛足废物。对我来说你就像一堆移动的瓶盖。

original: I love the sight of a limping Waster. You just look like a walking pile of caps to me.
translation: 看你跛成什么样了。你给“快刀”阿姨带瓶盖来了吗？

original: Well now, look at you limping in here like that. Did you bring some caps for Auntie Cutter?
translation: 你似乎过了几天好日子。几个瓶盖就可以把你修好。

original: You look like you've seen better days. A few caps'll fix that up for you.
translation: 我们经历了几次战斗，不是吗？那就是为何他们付给我这么多钱……

original: Been in a few fights, have we? Well, that's why they pay me the big bucks...
translation: 没什么能比带有超多瓶盖，并负了伤的奴隶贩子更能吸引我的。但愿你也是那种类型的。

original: Just let me know if you need anything, and I'll do whatever I can to procure it.
translation: 如果你是来谈生意的，我洗耳恭听。

original: <sighs> I'm sure that whatever you have to say is absolutely vital. So let's hear it.
translation: <叹气>我相信无论你要说什么都是至关重要的，说来听听。

original: What. Do. You. Want?
translation: 听好了。我告诉过你。我的名字是弗替。我不想改名，所以除非你有什么好建议，最好讲快点。

original: Look. I told you. My name's Forty. I'm not inclined to change it, so unless you've got something good to say, you'd best make it fast.
translation: 佐敦。

original: Hey. Talk fast, they hate it when I talk to customers.
translation: 嗨。讲快点。他们不喜欢我和顾客聊天。

original: Haha! Hello! I am Ymir!
translation: 哈哈！你好！我是伊米尔！

original: Haha! Good to see you again, little man! Have you come to drink with me?
translation: 哈哈！很高兴再见到你，小伙子！你是来找我喝酒的？

original: Haha! Good to see you again, little girl! Have you come to drink with me?
translation: 哈哈！很高兴再见到你，小女孩！你是来找我喝酒的？

original: Hey sorry, man. Let me get out of your way!
translation: 嗨，不好意思，哥们。我给你让路！

original: Whoa there. Easy, killer. I'm movin', I'm movin'!
translation: 哇。别紧张，杀手。我走了，我走了！

original: Heard about you. You're some pretty slick shit.
translation: 听说过你。你这狗屎。

original: Respect.
translation: 问候下。

original: You look like a damn fool in that Vault Suit.
translation: 你穿着避难所制服太傻了。

original: Nice! Did you get that monkey suit from the Brotherhood?
translation: 不错！你是从兄弟会那搞到这猴子套装的？

original: Sorry, bro. Got nothin' to say to you.
translation: 不好意思，哥们。和你没什么好说的。

original: Sorry, chica. Got nothin' to say to you.
translation: 不好意思，小妞。和你没什么好说的。

original: Keep walkin'.
translation: 继续走。

original: I can't believe that Grouse let you in here.
translation: 不敢相信是那葛劳斯放你进来的。

original: Don't think I won't throw your ass in the pens with the rest of the meat.
translation: 别以为我不会把你和那帮菜鸟一起送进围栏。

original: You don't exactly look like you belong here.
translation: 你看上去不像是这里的。

original: Okay, seriously. Leave me alone.
translation: 好了，真的。不要管我。

original: *sniff* Smells like meat. Move on.
translation: *嗅* 像肉的味道。继续。

original: I'm going on an adventure!
translation: 我就要去冒险了。

original: Hey there. You have any Nuka-Cola? Even just a bit? Can I have some? Be your best friend. Honest. Totally. Not even kidding!
translation: 嗨。你有核子可乐吗？一点也好。我能来一些吗？我最好的朋友。真诚的。完全的。绝不是开玩笑！

original: Oh hey, hi. You again, huh? I thought maybe you'd be blown up or shot or something by now, but I guess not. Not yet, anyway.
translation: 哦，嗨，你好，又是你，呃？我还想可能现在你已经被炸死、被射杀或其它什么，不过好像还没。现在还没。

original: Hey, hi! Hi, lady. Hey there. What's going on? Anything new? You have any good stories? What about Nuka-Cola, you have any of that? Huh, huh?
translation: 嗨，你好！嘿，女士。嗨。怎么了？有什么消息？你有什么好故事？核子可乐，你有吗？呃，呃？

original: Hey, hi! Hi, mister. Hey there. What's going on? Anything new? You have any good stories? What about Nuka-Cola, you have any of that? Huh, huh?
translation: 嗨，你好！嘿，先生。嗨。怎么了？有什么消息？你有什么好故事？核子可乐，你有吗？呃，呃？

original: We didn't need any mungo's help getting outta there, you know?
translation: 我们逃出那里不需要毛人帮，你懂吗？

original: But you did it, so, uh, thanks.
translation: 但是你帮了我们，所以，呃，谢谢。

original: But that means I gotta go back to guarding the back gate with Princess. Ugh.
translation: 但这意味着我得回去和公主一起看守后门。唉。

original: Okay, so you get in, but I got my eye on you.
translation: 好了，你进来吧，不过我会盯你。

original: You don't make any trouble in here, got it? I ain't having no shit-butts making trouble.
translation: 不准在这撒野，明白吗？我不准任何臭狗屎捣乱。

original: What now, mungo?
translation: 现在又怎么样，毛人？

original: Okay, what the hell is wrong with you, mungo? This had better be important!
translation: 好，你到底怎么回事，毛人？这最好是重要事！

original: Whoa, a mungo down here, just walking around!
translation: 哇，这有个毛人，正在到处游荡。

original: Hey, new kid! Try and catch me!
translation: 嗨，新来的！来抓我啊！

original: Tag, you're it!
translation: 碰，该你了！

original: Aw, man! I'm it!
translation: 啊，哥们！我在这！

original: No way, that didn't count!
translation: 不行，那不算！

original: Stay away, mungo, I don't wanna catch old from you!
translation: 走开点，毛人。我不想碰到你变老！

original: Thanks for getting Penny and Squirrel back. And Sammy too, I guess.
translation: 谢谢你救回佩尼和“松鼠”，还有萨米，对吧？

original: Mungo, mungo, smells like dung-o!
translation: 毛人，毛人，闻着像屎！

original: Gosh, you're big.
translation: 天，你很大啊。

original: Nice as the weather is out here, how about you bring me a kid, so I can get back to Paradise Falls?
translation: 外面天气不错，你给我带个孩子过来吧？这样我就可以回到天堂瀑了。

original: Just waiting for you to bring me a new friend.
translation: 就等你给我带个新朋友过来。

original: Mayor said to let you in alive, but he didn't say you had to stay that way. Watch your step, mungo.
translation: 镇长说留你一条小命，但他可没说可以让你恣意妄为，你给我小心点，毛人！

original: I heard how you helped out Timebomb. I'm not sure why you did it, but thanks. I only hope that he lives long enough to appreciate your help.
translation: 我听说过你怎么帮助“定时炸弹”逃走。我不知道你为什么这么做，不过谢谢你。我只希望他能活到能感谢你的那天。

original: Now, did you need something?
translation: 好了，你需要什么？

original: Wow. I can't believe that you were able to help Timebomb. And here I was sure that you were ready to just let him die. I guess I had you wrong.
translation: 哇。我不敢相信你能帮助“定时炸弹”。我本以为你一定会看着他死。看来我错看你了。

original: He still can't fight, but if we survive for a bit longer, he should be back into it soon enough.
translation: 他还不能战斗，但是如果我们能再坚持一段时间，他应该能很快恢复战斗力。

original: Look, you're a better doc than me, that's pretty obvious. But if you need healing, I'll do it for you no charge.
translation: 听着，很明显你的医术比我高超。但是如果你需要治疗，我可以免费提供。

original: What is it?
translation: 那是什么？

original: Woah, looks like you've seen some action. Do you need help?
translation: 哇，看来你见过不少场面。需要帮忙吗？

original: Hey, pal. What's up?
translation: 嗨，伙计。你好吗？

original: Things are looking good here, bud.
translation: 这一切顺利，朋友。

original: Hey. Thanks again, man. I wouldn't be here if it wasn't for you.
translation: 嗨，再次感谢你，哥们。要没你我就完了。

original: Anything for you, man. What do you need?
translation: 随时为你效劳，哥们。你需要什么？

original: Watch the Wastes. Keep track of movement. Uh, what? Did you need something?
translation: 看着废土。跟上节奏。什么？你需要什么吗？

original: I warned you!
translation: 我警告过你的！

original: I guess you're wondering where I'm going. I'm off to annex Old Olney and forge the New Republic of Dave! Don't try to stop me!
translation: 你是在想我要去哪里吧。我要去吞并老奥尔尼，并成立新戴夫共和国！别想阻止我！

original: Yeah? What do you want?
translation: 嗯？你要干嘛？

original: Stop right there, mister! Whatcha think you're doing in the Republic of Dave?
translation: 站住，先生！你知道你都在戴夫共和国做了什么吗？

original: Stop right there, lady! Whatcha think you're doing in the Republic of Dave?
translation: 站住，小姐！你知道你都在戴夫共和国做了什么吗？

original: Dave says you're okay? Fine.
translation: 戴夫说你没问题？好吧。

original: Hey, who are you? What do you want from the Republic of Dave?
translation: 嘿，你是谁？你想从戴夫共和国得到什么？

original: Did Dave say it was okay for you to be here?
translation: 戴夫说过你可以在这吗？

original: Well now... who could have ever thought? Me! President! Things are really going to be different around here.
translation: 现在……谁会想得到？我！总统！真的是变天了啊。

original: Listen, I can't thank you enough. You convinced me that I could do this, and you were right. I want you to have something.
translation: 听着，我对你无比感激。你让我确信自己有这能力，我因此才能成功。我想你能得到些什么。

original: Dave kept some big weapon or something locked up in the safe in his office. The code is 1138.
translation: 戴夫办公室的保险箱里存放着某种大型武器之类的东西。密码1138。

original: It's yours if you want it. We don't need it anymore.
translation: 你想要你就拿去吧。我们不再有用了。

original: I just can't thank you enough!
translation: 不胜感激！

original: Things are going to be different around here!
translation: 真的是变天了啊！

original: Bob as president? I don't know how I feel about that...
translation: 鲍勃当总统？我不知道自己会有什么感觉……

original: President Bob. Well, that's a change. I don't know if it's a change for the better though...
translation: 鲍勃总统。好吧，是个转变。我不知道这是不是朝好方向转变……

original: I heard that Dave allowed you to stay. Well, welcome stranger. Just be mindful of the children.
translation: 听说戴夫允许你留下？那，欢迎你陌生人。留神孩子。

original: Who are you? Is it okay for you to be here?
translation: 你是谁？你可以在这出现吗？

original: What do you want now?
translation: 你现在想干嘛？

original: So Dave gave you the okay, huh? Well, welcome then.
translation: 那么戴夫已经同意了？嗯，欢迎啊。

original: I run the Museum of Dave, where the children of the Republic can learn about their heritage.
translation: 我经营戴夫博物馆，共和国的孩子在这可以学到传统。

original: Dave doesn't like us talking to strangers.
translation: 戴夫不喜欢我们和陌生人谈话。

original: President Daddy says that people from outside the Republic are bad.
translation: 总统爸爸说共和国之外的人都是坏人。

original: Are you really from the Wasteland? Wooooow!
translation: 你真的是从废土来的吗？哇！

original: Hello there, fellah! Good to meet you! Name's Smith, Jack Smith. Welcome to Andale, the best little town in Virginia!
translation: 你好，伙计！很高兴见到你！我叫史密斯，杰克·史密斯。欢迎来到安代尔，弗吉尼亚最好的镇子！

original: Hello there, young lady! Good to meet you! Name's Smith, Jack Smith. Welcome to Andale, the best little town in Virginia!
translation: 你好，女士！很高兴见到你！我叫史密斯，杰克·史密斯。欢迎来到安代尔，弗吉尼亚最好的镇子！

original: Hello there, stranger! Good to meet you! Name's Jack Smith. I hear you've already met my wife. Sweet lady, isn't she?
translation: 你好，陌生人！很高兴见到你！我叫史密斯，杰克·史密斯。听说你已经见过我妻子了。温柔可人的淑女，对吧？

original: But anyway, welcome to Andale, the best little town in Virginia!
translation: 总之，欢迎来到安代尔，弗吉尼亚最好的镇子！

original: Mr. Harris is nice to us, but he doesn't read the stories the same way that my daddy did.
translation: 哈里斯先生对我们很好，但他读故事的方式和我爸爸不一样。

original: I'm not really sure what happened. Mr. Harris said that our parents went away, and they won't be back.
translation: 我不太确定发生了什么。哈里斯先生说我们的父母已经离开了，而且不再回来了。

original: He says that he'll tell me more about it when I'm older but... I miss my mom and dad...
translation: 他说等我大些了再告诉我详细的事不过……我想念我爸和我妈……

original: Mr. Harris is a lot like my dad. I never knew he could be so nice.
translation: 哈里斯先生很像我爸爸。我从来不知道他原来这么好。

original: You're new here, aren't you? Wow! I never get a chance to talk to the new people! Dad always takes care of them before I get a chance.
translation: 你是新来的，对吧？哇！我从没机会和新来的人讲话！爸爸总是在我有机会之前就全关照好他们了。

original: Well, hello! Welcome to Andale! Winner of the best town in the USA contest!
translation: 你好！欢迎来到安代尔！美利坚合众国最佳城镇竞赛冠军镇！

original: Why, hello there. I'd heard there was someone new coming. How can our little family help you?
translation: 噢，你好。我已经听说有个新来的。我们的小家可以帮你什么吗？

original: Busy busy busy, a wife's work is never done!
translation: 忙忙忙，主妇的事永远做不完！

original: I'm not sure why you'd come back here, but I'm glad to see you.
translation: 我不清楚为什么你回来这，但很高兴见到你。

original: Little by little, each day, I'm trying to clean up the mess my family left.
translation: 一点一点，日复一日，我在努力处理我的家人留下的麻烦。

original: Don't you look absolutely... miserable. Pull up a stool and lay down a few caps, tell Uncle Ahzrukhal all about it...
translation: 你看上去真……不幸。搬张凳子，放几个瓶盖，把这些全告诉阿祖卡叔叔……

original: Yeah, what is it- Oh! Oh my! Someone new! I'm so sorry, you must think I'm terribly rude! Welcome! Welcome to Carol's Place! I'm Carol.
translation: 嗯，这是什么 — 哦！天啊！新来的！对不起，你一定觉得我很无礼！欢迎！欢迎光临卡洛尔之家！我是卡洛尔。

original: It's not much, I know, but it's mine! So, if you need anything, just let me know. Greta will get you any food you want, and I handle the rooms.
translation: 地方不大，我知道，但这是我的！那么，如果你需要什么东西，只要告诉我。想吃什么只管找葛丽泰，而我出租房间。

original: It's so good to have someone new here, even if it is an ugly ol' smoothskin! I'm kidding! I'm just kiddin! Don't make that face! You'll love it here.
translation: 在这能见到新人真好，即使是丑陋的光皮肤！我开玩笑！开玩笑的！别拉长着脸！你会喜欢这的。

original: Talk to Ahzrukhal.
translation: 去和阿祖卡谈。

original: No. Go talk to Ahzrukhal.
translation: 不。去和阿祖卡谈。

original: Sorry. I'm on a break. I'll be back in a bit if you need some food.
translation: 对不起。我在休息。你如果需要食物我立刻回来。

original: Hey. I saw you over there talking to Carol. She's friendly, isn't she? But don't you get any ideas about her. Got it? Good.
translation: 嘿。我看见你和卡洛尔说话了。她很友好，对吧？但是你不要打她任何主意。明白了？很好。

original: Now, do you want something to eat?
translation: 好了，你需要什么吃的吗？

original: Oh, you again.
translation: 哦，又是你。

original: ... ... huh? ... Ah! Jesus Christ! Don't... don't sneak up on me like that, the last fella... the last fella to do that damn near lost my arm.
translation: ……呃？……啊！耶稣基督！别……别这样偷偷接近我，最后一次这么做的伙计……最后一次这么做的伙计该死的差点废了我的胳膊。

original: You're new here, yeah... you must be, since you're actually talking to... talking to me... I'm Patchwork... or just "Patches" if... if you like that.
translation: 你是新来这的，对……你肯定是，因为你现在正在和……和我说话……我是“拼盘”……或者就“补丁”，如果……如果你喜欢那样叫。

original: I'm... shit... I forget.
translation: 我……妈的……我忘了。

original: Oh, hello, my boy! You've come back for more stories from ol' Quinn, have you?
translation: 哦，你好，小子！你来是想从老奎因这听更多故事的，对吧？

original: Oh, hello, my girl! You've come back for more stories from ol' Quinn, have you?
translation: 哦，你好，女孩！你来是想从老奎因这听更多故事的，对吧？

original: Didn't you hear me? Leave us alone.
translation: 你没听到吗？离我们远点。

original: Well look who's back. What can I do you for, smoothskin?
translation: 看看谁回来了。我能为你做点什么，光皮肤？

original: What the fuck happened?
translation: 发生他妈什么事了？

original: It's so weird here without Ahzrukhal.
translation: 没有阿祖卡在这里感觉好奇怪。

original: I still can't believe that Charon shot Ahzrukhal. I never saw that one coming.
translation: 我还是不敢相信卡戎向阿祖卡开枪了。我从未想到会发生这样的事。

original: You know, Ahzrukhal was a bastard, but I kind of miss him...
translation: 你要知道，阿祖卡是个杂种，但我有点想念他……

original: Did you see that? Charon just shot Ahzrukhal!
translation: 看到了吗？卡戎刚向阿祖卡开枪！

original: Just stumbled into town? You sure picked a fine day for it, with the crazies out there.
translation: 只是误撞到镇子的？你确实挑了个好日子，和外边的疯子一起。

original: Here, have a drink on the house. Welcome to Canterbury.
translation: 给，在屋里喝一杯。欢迎来到坎特伯雷。

original: I'm Joe Porter. I make sure folks around here can get a meal when they need it.
translation: 我是乔·波特。我要确保这的人们有需要的时候能吃上一顿饭。

original: I hear you're my mysterious investor! With your help, I've collected quite a few toys for myself. But what good are toys if they aren't played with?
translation: 听说你就是我那神秘的投资人！多亏你帮忙，我为自己收集了一些很好的小玩意。但是如果不拿出来玩玩，这些玩意又有什么价值？

original: Thanks to you I have so many, I could hardly play with them all.
translation: 多亏了你，我才拥有了这么多，几乎玩不完。

original: So, I present to you a prize of the collection, a micro-nuke. Enjoy it in safety!
translation: 所以，我送你一款收藏级奖品，一颗微型核弹。请安全享用！

original: A wanderer without a weapon doesn't last long out there. Pick up the best now, while you still can!
translation: 一个手无寸铁的流浪者在这可是活不长的。换上最好的装备吧 — 趁你现在还能做到。

original: Here to shop? Have a look!
translation: 来采购？那就进来看！

original: I hear you're the one who's so deeply invested in my junk. Not as deeply as me, of course, but who is, really?
translation: 我听说了，你就是那在我这杂货铺投资最多的人。当然，我还是最多的，舍我其谁呢，对吧？

original: I picked up some Stealth Boys the other day, and they seemed like just the way to thank you for your investment. Kudos!
translation: 前几天，我买了一些隐身小子，它们似乎是感谢你投资的最好方式。赞！

original: A friend with deep pockets is a friend indeed! Welcome to my shop!
translation: 俗话说得好：“皮夹鼓鼓的朋友才是真正的朋友”！欢迎光临我的小店！

original: Hey, hey! Looking to buy?
translation: 嗨，嗨！想买点什么？

original: My investor arrives at last. This line of work doesn't allow for much sentiment, but how could I not offer you some material token of my thanks?
translation: 我的投资商终于出现了。干我们这行的不能感情用事，但对于你的帮助又怎能没有实质性的回报呢？

original: In that case, here. The gift of health - rarely given in this day and age, but all too often taken...
translation: 如果是那样的话，拿好。以健康为礼物吧 — 这年头很少有人能给，相反，往往被剥夺……

original: Looking for your fix? You came to the right man.
translation: 在找你的瘾品吗？那就找对人了。

original: Here to see the good doctor? Excellent.
translation: 想找个好医生？太棒了。

original: And here you are! The spirits have blessed me with many gifts, but you have given the more marketable gift of monetary investment.
translation: 你来了！神灵赐予了我诸多礼物，但是你给了我更有市场的礼物——金钱投资。

original: Please accept this offering - a mask and helmet made from the hide of the wisest spirits of the wind. May it benefit you as fully as it has myself.
translation: 请收下这份礼物——由风灵之皮制成的面具和头盔。希望它能像庇护我一样庇护你。

original: Searching for a friend out in the Wastes? No one is more reliable than a cold, hard skin of steel.
translation: 想要在这片废土中寻找一个朋友？一块冰冷、坚硬的钢铁皮肤比任何人都可靠。

original: Here to acquire a new mantle of metal or mesh? If you have the caps, I have the merchandise.
translation: 要不要来件崭新的金属或者网状的披风？一手交钱，一手交货。

original: Good morning, madam.
translation: 早上好，女士。

original: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

original: Good evening, madam.
translation: 晚上好，女士。

original: What can I do for you?
translation: 我能为你做什么？

original: Leave me alone! Me and Bob have better things to do than speak to a murderer!
translation: 走开！我和鲍勃才不要和杀人凶手说话！

original: Now go away, never come back!
translation: 滚开，再也不要回来！

original: Shh. Not too loud. I don't really want people to know that we're doin' business.
translation: 嘘。轻点。我可不想让别人知道我们在做交易。

original: There rest of these guys around here might not want anything to do with you, but I got no problem with you... well, not with your caps at least.
translation: 其余那些家伙或许不愿和你打交道，但我可不介意……至少不介意和你的钱打交道。

original: Hey, good to see you again. What do you need?
translation: 嗨，很高兴见到你！需要些什么？

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: Hey there.
translation: 嗨。

original: Watch it, will you?
translation: 小心点，好吗？

original: Neat. What else you got?
translation: 真妙。你还会什么？

original: Stop doing that so close to me.
translation: 离我远点。

original: Take cover!
translation: 找掩护！

original: Watch out!
translation: 注意！

original: Look out!
translation: 小心！

original: Look out!
translation: 小心！

original: Grenade!
translation: 手榴弹！

original: Stop that! Someone could get hurt.
translation: 住手！会伤到别人的。

original: Cool. Can I try?
translation: 酷，我能试试吗？

original: Cut it out, will you?
translation: 叫你住手！听到没？

original: You know what you're doing there?
translation: 你知道自己在干嘛吗？

original: I trust you know what you're doing.
translation: 我相信你知道自己在干嘛。

original: I hope you know what you're doing.
translation: 我希望你知道你在干嘛！

original: Oh come on. Cut it out.
translation: 哦，够了，住手。

original: Put that down, will you?
translation: 把东西放下，好吗？

original: Give it a rest, will you?
translation: 你就不能消停会吗？

original: Is that really necessary?
translation: 真的有必要么？

original: Are you having fun with that?
translation: 你是不是觉得很好玩啊？

original: You're easily amused, eh?
translation: 你真是自娱自乐啊？

original: Is that really necessary?
translation: 真的有必要么？

original: You're kind of weird.
translation: 你这人真古怪。

original: Getting some exercise, are we?
translation: 这是在做运动吗？

original: Watch it, will you?
translation: 看着点，好吗？

original: Oh come on. Pay more attention to what you're doing.
translation: 哦，拜托，你就不能再小心点？

original: Cut it out.
translation: 停下。

original: Hey, be more careful!
translation: 嗨！小心！

original: Why don't you look where you're going?
translation: 你会不会走路啊？

original: What's the big idea?
translation: 你想干嘛？

original: Clumsy local...
translation: 笨蛋本地人…

original: Watch where you're going.
translation: 走路看着点！

original: Be more careful, will you?
translation: 注意点！听到没？

original: Watch where you point that.
translation: 注意你的目标。

original: That's not a toy, you know.
translation: 你要知道，那可不是玩具。

original: Now's not really the time for that, is it?
translation: 现在可不是做那事的时候，对吧？

original: Father and son, side by side. This is the way it should be.
translation: 上阵父子兵，本应如此。

original: My God, can you believe the devastation out here? That's why our work is so important.
translation: 我的天啊，你能相信外面的这一切吗？那就说明了为什么我们的工作如此重要。

original: I'm glad I've got you watching my back. I'm not quite sure I'm cut out for all this excitement. Not anymore.
translation: 很高兴有你协助我。我都不确信我能不能承受这兴奋。

original: Come on, let's keep moving.
translation: 来吧，我们继续走。

original: Not much farther. We'll be at Rivet City before you know it.
translation: 不是很远。我们会在你知道前抵达铆钉城。

original: What a sight we must be! If only your mother could see us now...
translation: 我们一定是一道壮丽的景观！如果你妈妈现在能看见我们……

original: I suppose the dog's coming with us, yes?
translation: 我猜那只狗也会跟我们一起走，对吗？

original: What's up?
translation: 什么事？

original: What do you need, sir?
translation: 你需要什么，先生？

original: Hello, sir.
translation: 你好，先生。

original: Sir.
translation: 先生。

original: Squire.
translation: 扈从。

original: Sir Knight.
translation: 骑士先生。

original: Paladin.
translation: 圣骑士。

original: Sentinel. What can I do for you?
translation: 铁卫。我能为你做些什么？

original: Hello, Elder.
translation: 你好，长老。

original: Time for the G.O.A.T. Find a seat and wait for instructions.
translation: 该开始G.O.A.T 了。找个座位，等着听说明。

original: Almost there!
translation: 几乎都在！

original: Is it safe yet?
translation: 这还安全吗？

original: Welcome back.
translation: 欢迎回来。

original: Stay away from me! I don't want whatever you smoothskins are infecting us with!
translation: 离我远点！我不想被你们光皮肤给传染了！

original: Don't do this. Please tell me the code.
translation: 别这样。请告诉我密码。

original: Keep moving!
translation: 不许停！

original: Get inside!
translation: 进去！

original: Head for the Control Room.
translation: 前往控制室。

original: You're the best mungo ever!
translation: 你是世界上最好的……毛人？

original: I just want Rory to be safe...
translation: 我只希望罗瑞平安无事……

original: Lookin's free, the rest will cost ya.
translation: 看看不要钱，再来就要收费了。

original: Got something on your mind?
translation: 想好了吗？

original: Don't look at me like that.
translation: 不要那样看着我。

original: Got a problem?
translation: 有什么问题？

original: Welcome to Moriarty's Saloon.
translation: 欢迎来到莫里亚蒂的酒馆。

original: Looking for a drink? You've come to the right place.
translation: 想来一杯？你来对地方了。

original: S'matter? Never seen a Ghoul before?
translation: 怎么了？从没见过尸鬼？

original: Yeah, what the hell do you want?
translation: 嗯，见鬼，你想要什么？

original: You want something or you just looking to get your ass beat?
translation: 你是有事找我还是屁股痒了找打？

original: This better be important. I'm a busy man.
translation: 你要说的最好是重要的事，我是大忙人。

original: So, what is it now?
translation: 现在怎么了？

original: If you need something from me, spill it.
translation: 有话快说，有屁快放。

original: Information I got... but it'll cost you.
translation: 你要的消息我有……但是你要为此破费。

original: What do you want?
translation: 你要干嘛？

original: Nice work in there, soldier.
translation: 干得好，士兵。

original: Old games are no match for us Outcasts, huh?
translation: 老把戏难不倒我们放逐者，对吧？

original: You did us proud in there.
translation: 你在那所做的让我们感到骄傲。

original: Good work, for a local.
translation: 就本地人而言，你做得好。

original: Never would have thought a savage could do it.
translation: 从没想过一个野蛮人可以做到这个地步。

original: Thanks, I guess.
translation: 谢谢。

original: What's going on in here, Midea? Who is this scab?
translation: 发生了什么事，美狄亚？这个渣滓是谁？

original: Hello.
translation: 你好。

original: We need to talk.
translation: 我们需要谈一谈。

original: Casdin said you're clear.
translation: 卡斯丁说你没问题了。

original: Stay in line, and you'll be okay.
translation: 规矩点对你有好处。

original: Don't start anything and you'll be fine. Um, probably.
translation: 如果你不惹事你就不会有事。嗯，这也是相对而言。

original: Keep that tech coming, and we'll make it worth your while.
translation: 多带些高科技产品来，我们会酬谢你的。

original: Who do we have here?
translation: 看是谁来了？

original: Put that away. Unless you plan on using it.
translation: 收起来，除非你真的打算用它。

original: I've had guns leveled at me before. If you are wise, you will pause to consider that I am still around to talk about it.
translation: 我以前也被人拿枪指过。如果你还算机灵，在我面前就该收起枪考虑考虑。

original: Only small men require guns to do their persuading.
translation: 只有弱者才会用枪说话。

original: Most civilized people consider waving guns around to be rather uncouth.
translation: 大多数有素质的人都认为玩枪是野蛮人的行为。

original: Why don't you put that away? Or do I need to give you a lesson in manners?
translation: 你怎么不把它收起来？是不是还要我教你一些最基本的规矩？

original: You're not going to ask me to hold your hand through this are you?
translation: 你没打算让我手把手教你怎么做吧？

original: Yes? Are you having trouble with your little assignment? Do I need to find someone else?
translation: 怎么了？布置给你的小任务出问题了？是不是我应该另外找个人来做？

original: Yes?
translation: 嗯？

original: Come on, let me loose!
translation: 拜托，救救我！

original: Time to go yet?
translation: 该出发了吧？

original: You are in the presence of ant royalty!
translation: 你就在蚁后的面前。

original: Nothing new, sir.
translation: 没什么情况，先生。

original: Sir, people are mostly staying quiet.
translation: 平安无事，先生。

original: Humph.
translation: 哼。

original: Welcome to the Capital Preservation Society!
translation: 欢迎来到首都保护协会！

original: Nice work cleaning up the town.
translation: 那镇子的扫荡工作做得不错。

original: Town's a lot safer now. Thanks.
translation: 镇子现在安全多了，多谢。

original: Aw, you made this place get so boring.
translation: 啊，你让这地方变得无聊起来了。

original: Tsk. To think you could have been rich. And now all you'll be is sorry. VERY sorry.
translation: 啧啧。想想你本来可以发财的。现在你只剩下遗憾了。非常遗憾。

original: I would advise staying clear of me for awhile. A LONG while.
translation: 我建议你让我一个人静一会。一大会。

original: Tell me. Do you have a death wish?
translation: 告诉我，你可曾有过想死的念头？

original: It was a wonderful thing you did. Inspirational. Truly.
translation: 你做的真是太棒了。灵气十足，真的。

original: Yes friend? Is there something I can assist you with?
translation: 什么事，朋友？有什么需要我协助的？

original: Thanks again for your part in paving the way towards progress.
translation: 再次感谢你为我们铺平前进的道路。

original: Boy do I breathe a lot easier knowing that thing is truly dead!
translation: 好了，知道那东西完全停止了，我呼吸也顺畅多了！

original: Mighty fine thing you did for this town.
translation: 你为这座镇子做了伟大的事。

original: Hey friend!
translation: 嗨，朋友！

original: Don't you have a component to deliver?
translation: 你不是有什么东西要递送？

original: Oh, great. Just what we need.
translation: 哦，太好了。这正是我们需要的。

original: Keep moving, local.
translation: 走吧，本地人。

original: Please have your password ready.
translation: 请准备好密码。

original: The U.S. Army needs more soldiers like you. Carry on.
translation: 美国陆军需要像你这样的士兵。加油。

original: Let's wrap this thing up, soldier. We're cold, we're tired and we want our goddamn oil back!
translation: 我们来结束这一切吧，士兵。我们很冷，我们很累，我们想要拿回我们该死的油！

original: Damn Chinese Communists are stomping all over us. Time for us to pay them back.
translation: 该死的中共正践踏我们。是时候还给他们了。

original: I think it's time to show those Red bastards what the U.S. Army is all about.
translation: 我想是时候让那些杂种红军尝尝美军的厉害了。

original: Those targets can't secure themselves. You've got a job to do, soldier... now snap to it.
translation: 那些目标无法保护自己。你有活干了，士兵……现在就开始吧。

original: You're doing a man's job, soldier. Keep it up!
translation: 你正在做一件男人的工作，士兵。坚持下去。

original: Carry on, soldier.
translation: 加油，士兵。

original: We owe you so much. The Memorial will be a beacon for slaves everywhere.
translation: 我们欠你很多。无论在何地，纪念堂将会成为奴隶贩子的信标。

original: Everyone is grateful for what you've done for us.
translation: 我们所有人都感激你为我们所做的事。

original: The Slavers will have some goddamn respect for now, huh?
translation: 奴隶贩子现在他妈的会放尊重点了，嗯？

original: It's going to take a lot of work to repair the Memorial. Thanks to you, I'll get to do it.
translation: 看来要花上一段时间来修复纪念堂。谢谢你，我现在就要开始工作了。

original: You're a hero to everyone here, sir.
translation: 你是这的所有人的英雄，先生。

original: You're a hero to everyone here, ma'am.
translation: 你是这的所有人的英雌，女士。

original: Nothing to report, soldier.
translation: 没什么要报告的，士兵。

original: Glad you could join the party!
translation: 很高兴你的加入。

original: Nice to see a friendly faceplate.
translation: 看到友军真令人高兴。

original: All clear, sir.
translation: 都安全了，长官。

original: Good to have reinforcements.
translation: 有援军到来真不错。

original: Don't think I recognize your unit. Must be a new convert from old man Lyons.
translation: 别以为我不知道你哪来的。肯定是刚从里昂斯老头那边投靠过来的。

original: Watch it, local.
translation: 小心点，本地人。

original: If you're here to help, fine. Otherwise, out of my way.
translation: 如果你是来帮忙的，那就好。否则给我滚开。

original: Shouldn't you be huddling in a cave somewhere?
translation: 你是不是应该躲在某个洞里？

original: What are you doing here?
translation: 你在这干嘛？

original: Great, another local.
translation: 太棒了，又来一个本地人。

original: Keep your distance, mutt. No knowing what you've got breeding on you.
translation: 离我远点，混球。和你没什么好说的。

original: Where is this damn place?
translation: 这该死的地方到底在哪？

original: I swear it was this way!
translation: 我发誓肯定是这条路没错。

original: Remember my offer, Outsider: cash for Pre-War books.
translation: 请记住我的提议，外来者：现金换战前书籍。

original: If you have any Pre-War books, I'll take them.
translation: 只要你有战前的书籍，我照单全收。

original: Finding your way about all right?
translation: 找到你对的路了吗？

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: I'll train these marshmallows if it kills me...
translation: 要训练这些菜鸟，这简直要了我的命……

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Presence detected. This unit has activated.
translation: 发现物件。该单位已被激活。

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Outsiders in the Citadel. Such a pleasure...
translation: 大本营里的外来人。幸会……

original: H... Hello...
translation: 你……你好……

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Can I help you, Sheriff?
translation: 有什么能帮你的，警长？

original: I've got the best whores in the Wasteland. The two of them are going to break my bed springs some day. Hah ha!
translation: 我在废土上碰到两个最棒的妓女。她们两个会把我的床折腾地粉碎，哈哈哈！

original: Aren't my party girls sweet? I just want to eat them like candy. Ha ha!
translation: 我的那些女人很甜吧？我真想把她们像吃糖一样吃下去，哈哈哈！

original: I don't have my Cherry pie any more. That bitch ran away.
translation: 我再也见不到彻丽了。那贱人跑了。

original: My women are dead. I'm gonna have to get me some new ones.
translation: 我的女人死了。我准备再找一个。

original: You have my vote, Mister President.
translation: 我投你一票，总统先生。

original: That election is getting pretty close, huh?
translation: 大选很快就要开始了，呃？

original: Who are you going to vote for, Bob?
translation: 你准备选谁，鲍勃？

original: Hey Jessica, you excited about the election?
translation: 嗨，杰西卡，要选举了，你激动吗？

original: Hey Shawna, did you do the early voting?
translation: 嗨，肖纳，你提前投票了？

original: Isn't election time so much fun, Mary?
translation: 选举并不有趣，你说呢，玛丽？

original: Rachael, can you believe you're almost old enough to vote?
translation: 瑞秋，你能相信你都快到投票年龄了吗？

original: Who would you vote for if you were old enough, Flower?
translation: 如果你能投票你会投谁，福劳尔？

original: Don't you just love election time, Ralph?
translation: 你不喜欢选举吗，拉尔夫？

original: Hello Mister President.
translation: 你好，总统先生。

original: Hi, Mister President.
translation: 嘿，总统先生。

original: How's my first lady doing today?
translation: 我的第一夫人今天过得怎么样？

original: Hi Mary. I mean Flower. Rachael!
translation: 嗨，玛丽。我是说福劳尔。瑞秋！

original: Rachael, come play with me!
translation: 瑞秋，来和我一起玩吧！

original: Hey, stranger. C'mon over here, I'd like to talk to you about something.
translation: 嗨，陌生人，到这来。我想和你谈些事。

original: What... who are you?
translation: 什么……你是谁？

original: Why are you still here? Go!
translation: 你为什么还在这？滚！

original: Are you crazy? Get out of here!
translation: 你疯了吗？离开这！

original: Don't be fooled by them!
translation: 不要被他们骗了！

original: It's a fine day, isn't it?
translation: 不错的一天，对吧？

original: Glorious day, isn't it?
translation: 令人愉快的一天，你说呢？

original: Well, hello there!
translation: 嗯，你好！

original: Good to see you!
translation: 很高兴见到你！

original: Welcome to Andale!
translation: 欢迎来到安代尔！

original: The good Lord made Andale for days like today.
translation: 是仁慈的主让安代尔能够有今天这样的生活。

original: <yawns> I could use a nap.
translation: <哈欠> 我得打会盹。

original: <humming a tune>
translation: <哼着小曲>

original: Ahzrukhal, boy, I want to talk to you.
translation: 阿祖卡，孩子，我想和你谈谈。

original: You'll, uh, um, need help with the barricades soon, right Pappy?
translation: 你，呃，嗯，是不是需要人手帮你搭建防御工事，帕匹？

original: Kimba, um, I heard you helped bandage me up when I was on the table. Uh, thank you.
translation: 金巴，嗯，听说我躺在台子上不省人事的时候是你帮我包扎绷带。呃，谢谢。

original: I was thinking of hitting patrol again soon, Flash.
translation: 我计划迟点再去巡逻一遍，福莱斯。

original: Hey Sticky, um, uh, what do you think of Big Town?
translation: 嗨，斯蒂奇，嗯，呃，你觉得大镇怎么样？

original: I wonder if someone should work on the barricades again.
translation: 我不知道是不是该找个人加固防御工事。

original: Hey, Red, can I stop by the clinic later? You know, just in case?
translation: 嗨，瑞德，等下我能不能去下诊所？你知道的，以防万一。

original: Timebomb, I heard you got hurt. Wow... What does it feel like?
translation: “定时炸弹”，我听说你受伤了。喔哦……那是什么样的感受？

original: Hey, Flash. Patrolling sounds like a lot of fun. Maybe I could come out with you.
translation: 嗨，福莱斯。巡逻听起来挺有意思，能不能带上我？

original: Do you have any idea of what I can do in town, Shorty?
translation: 我想做些事，你有什么建议吗，“矮子”？

original: Hey there, Pappy. I was out trying to gather food. Did you know there's not much food out here in the Wastes?
translation: 嗨，帕匹。我刚出去想找点食物。你知不知道这片废土很难找到吃的？

original: Hey there, Kimba. Is there anything I can do around town?
translation: 嗨，金巴。镇里有什么需要我做的？

original: Hey, Red. Is there anything I can do around town to help out?
translation: 嗨，瑞德。有什么我能帮的上忙的？

original: Sticky, it's about time you learned that I'm in charge here.
translation: 斯蒂奇，是时候该让你知道了，我，是这的领袖。

original: I think I should be mayor of this town, Kimba...
translation: 我想我应该做这镇的镇长，金巴……

original: I don't like the looks of the barricades, Pappy. Why don't you redo them?
translation: 我不太喜欢这防御工事，帕匹。你为什么不重新搭建？

original: Timebomb, since you insist on staying alive, why don't you make yourself useful and help me reset the barricades.
translation: “定时炸弹”，既然你坚持活着，为什么你就不能让自己变得有点用处呢？至少能帮帮我搭建防御工事啊？

original: You don't go far out enough on your patrol, Flash. A real patrol would cover a solid half-mile radius.
translation: 你的巡逻范围还不够大，福莱斯。最起码覆盖半径半英里的区域才称得上是真正的巡逻。

original: I'm telling you, Red, just let me run everything. I'll get those barricades twice as high!
translation: 给我听好，瑞德，你应该让我来管理一切。我会把这些防御工事加高两倍！

original: Bittercup, make sure you're paying attention out on patrol. There are dangerous people out there.
translation: “苦杯”，你应该更认真地巡逻，到处都是危险的家伙。

original: Hey, Flash. How are you feeling? Any calluses from stroking that new gun of yours?
translation: 嗨，福莱斯。感觉怎么样？摸你的新枪有没有让手出老茧？

original: How are you feeling, Timebomb? Are those stitches holding together?
translation: 你感觉怎么样，“定时炸弹”？那些缝线伤口愈合了吗？

original: There's my Sticky! How are you doing?
translation: 亲爱的斯蒂奇！你过得怎么样？

original: Hey, Pappy. How's that wound on your arm?
translation: 嗨，帕匹。你胳膊上的伤口怎么样了？

original: Shorty, I want to gather everyone together soon about setting up the barricades higher. I'd really appreciate your, uh, expertise.
translation: “矮子”，我想尽快召集大家把路障设置高一点。非常感谢你的，额，专业知识。

original: Trading caps for crap, step right up!
translation: 卖破烂喽，过来看看！

original: Got some junk to unload? I'm buying!
translation: 有什么不需要的垃圾吗？我要！

original: Welcome, friend. Looking for more appropriate attire?
translation: 欢迎，朋友。想买套合适的漂亮衣服吗？

original: The spirits told me you'd be coming. And that you're looking to buy.
translation: 第六感告诉我你会来，没想到你真的来买东西了。

original: Here for a pick-me-up?
translation: 想把“我”买走吗？

original: If you've got the caps, I've got your fix.
translation: 如果你有瓶盖，我就给你修。

original: Here to pick up a few of my marvelous toys?
translation: 想从我这买点惊人的小玩具吗？

original: Fear not, for Lucky Harith is here to offer you protection for a price!
translation: 不用害怕，幸运哈里斯在这为你提供有偿保护！

original: Looking to make a trade?
translation: 想做些买卖吗？

original: Searching for that special something?
translation: 想买特殊物品？

original: Begone from this place, blasphemer!
translation: 从这滚蛋，亵渎者！

original: Great, here's some of the local wildlife.
translation: 真棒，这有些当地野兽。

original: Back off, local.
translation: 后退，本地佬。

original: You're not involved in this. You want to keep it that way.
translation: 你不该掺和进去。你应该让它顺其自然。

original: Good to see you're holding up alright.
translation: 很高兴见到你又振作起来。

original: Watch your back and keep your batteries dry out there.
translation: 小心背后，保持电池干燥。

original: You're not going to shoot me, are you?
translation: 你不会是想打我吧？

original: Is that loaded? Let me try it!
translation: 弹药装好了？让我试试。

original: Hey, I can almost see right down the barrel!
translation: 嗨，你几乎快瞄着我了。

original: Excuse me.
translation: 打扰一下。

original: Got a minute?
translation: 有空吗？

original: If it isn't MacCready himself...
translation: 如果不是麦奎迪他自己……

original: Looks like something's on your mind, Lucy.
translation: 看上去你想到什么了，露西。

original: What's bothering you, Penny?
translation: 什么事让你烦心，佩尼？

original: Care to talk?
translation: 介意我们谈谈吗？

original: Hey, Zip. Come over here.
translation: 嗨，拉链。到这来。

original: We've gotta get out of here.
translation: 我们必须离开这里。

original: I sure hope we don't get caught!
translation: 我真的希望我们不会被抓住。

original: Anything I can help with?
translation: 我能帮着干点什么吗？

original: I can't get off this ship fast enough.
translation: 我没有足够的时间下船。

original: At least I'm still in one piece...
translation: 至少我还安然无恙。

original: Is everything okay?
translation: 你还好吗？

original: <mumbles to himself>
translation: <自言自语>

original: Now, there's a good pup...
translation: 现在，有一条好狗…

original: <mumbles to himself>
translation: <自言自语>

original: Our business is at an end. Leave this place.
translation: 我们的交易结束了。离开这地方。

original: You should have seen this place thirty years ago.
translation: 你三十年前就该看看这地方。

original: Did you want to talk? I won't bite.
translation: 想谈谈吗？我不咬人。

original: Hail Mary, full of Grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women and blessed is the fruit of your womb, Jesus.
translation: 万福玛利亚，你充满圣宠。主与你同在。你在妇女中受赞颂，你的亲子耶稣同受赞颂…

original: You findin' your way around, sweetie?
translation: 找得到路吗，宝贝？

original: Welcome aboard!
translation: 欢迎上船。

original: I need your help!
translation: 我需要你的帮助。

original: <Whistling tunelessly.>
translation: <难听的口哨。>

original: Step right up.
translation: 迈步前进。

original: Mines help, if you got 'em.
translation: 我的东西有帮助，如果你拿去的话。

original: Warmest regards.
translation: 最温暖的关心。

original: Looking to travel?
translation: 想要旅行吗？

original: Empty your thoughts, child.
translation: 摒除杂念，孩子。

original: The physical world holds nothing for us. Release any lingering connections to it.
translation: 万事皆空，无需流连。

original: Embrace the simple things in life.
translation: 拥抱生命中的朴实吧。

original: Submerge your will in the depths of the astral sea!
translation: 让你的意识湮灭在星海的深渊中！

original: I'm watching you, child.
translation: 我正看着你，孩子。

original: New girl, you try too hard. Be calm.
translation: 新来的女孩，你太卖力了。冷静些。

original: Good to see you still here, my child.
translation: 很高兴你还在这儿，孩子。

original: Have you seen the Chop Shop? Full of sick Ghouls... I wonder who's next?
translation: 你看见排骨店了吗？全都是生病的尸鬼……我不知道下一个会是谁？

original: No offense, but I don't want whatever's going around. So just keep your distance, okay?
translation: 没有冒犯你的意思，但是我不想让任何人靠近。所以请保持你的距离,好吗？

original: You better stay away from me. I think I may be sick. It's like a... burning in my guts. Damn, it hurts!
translation: 你最好离我远点。我想我病了。就好像……我的内脏在着火。该死，真疼！

original: If you feel you're getting sick, quarantine yourself at the clinic, immediately.
translation: 如果你觉得你病了，立刻到门诊来进行隔离，一刻也不要耽搁。

original: Everything should be in place by now. Even if they know we're coming, it won't matter.
translation: 这会儿一切都应该就位了。就算他们知道我们要来了，也没关系。

original: It's good to see you again.
translation: 再见到你真是太好了。

original: Scribe Rothchild is going to need an update on your progress. Have you sent a report recently?
translation: 罗斯查德学士想要知道你的工作进度。你最近发过报告了么？

original: Ahem.
translation: 呃哼。

original: Bigsley could really cut us some slack.
translation: 比格斯利真的可以放我们一马了。

original: What the hell are we doing here, really? We have better things to do.
translation: 说真的，我们他妈的到底在这儿干什么？我们有更好的事要做。

original: Grrrrrloooow...
translation: 咯……咯……（光辉）

original: I don't know why they don't just build a pipeline. Schlepping bottles of water back and forth is the worst kind of stupid.
translation: 我真搞不明白为什么他们不直接建根水管呢。装在瓶子里一车一车地运来运去简直是我见过的最蠢的主意了。

original: Shh. If you spook the lurks I'll never get out of here.
translation: 嘘。如果你惊吓了蟹人，那我就再也出不去了。

original: The lurks get real shy when they're sick. You gotta wait for 'em to poke their noses up.
translation: 蟹人生病的时候会非常的胆小。你得等他们浮出水面。

original: Are you really going to fight in the Hole?
translation: 你真的要去角斗坑里角斗？

original: Hurry over to Haven, kid.
translation: 快去避风港，孩子。

original: Off to talk with Ashur? Lucky you.
translation: 去跟阿舒尔谈话？你真走运。

original: It's about time we had a talk.
translation: 我们是时候谈谈了。

original: Die, you bastard!
translation: 死吧，你这个杂种！

original: You got a funny look on your face. You got something you wanna say?
translation: 你的表情很滑稽，你有什么要说的吗？

original: We never seem to have any alone time anymore.
translation: 我们好像再也没有过独处的时间了。

original: Having a good time?
translation: 过得愉快吗？

original: Scram, before I mess your face up bad as mine.
translation: 在我把你的脸蛋弄得跟我的一样稀巴烂之前，赶紧滚。

original: Do I look like your personal assistant?
translation: 我长得像你的私人助理吗？

original: Another fine day in The Pitt, huh?
translation: 在匹兹堡度过的又一个好日子，对吧？

original: Can't seem to get enough sleep, these days.
translation: 这些天像是没有睡好。

original: Don't you have something you should be doing?
translation: 你难道没有该做的事吗？

original: Keeping busy, meat?
translation: 还在忙，肉？

original: Mind your own business, nebby.
translation: 少管闲事，菜鸟。

original: You want something?
translation: 你想干嘛？

original: Aww, such a sweet face. Get back to work.
translation: 噢，瞧瞧这张脸多么可爱啊。回去干活。

original: Hey, sexy.
translation: 嗨，美人。

original: Hey... Um... Ah, never mind... It's nothing...
translation: 喂……嗯……啊，算了……没事……

original: Show us how smart you are, Wally. What should we call ourselves?
translation: 这是你最擅长了，瓦利。我们应该给我们自己弄个什么名号呢？

original: Hey, Paul, your hobby's open. Whoa, that's your hobby? Ha ha ha ha! Now quick, give me an idea for what to name our gang.
translation: 嗨，保罗，你的兴趣最广泛了。哇，那就是你的兴趣？哈哈哈哈！快点，告诉我你觉得我们的帮派叫什么名字。

original: Ah man, you got a Pip-Boy. I wish I was ten.
translation: 哇，你有哔哔小子了。真希望我也10岁了。

original: Sorry about Butch... Your Dad said we had to invite him.
translation: 我为布奇向你道歉……你爸爸说我们必须要邀请他。

original: Fun party, huh?
translation: 很有意思的聚会，呃？

original: Thanks for coming. Are you having fun?
translation: 感谢你的光临，过得还愉快吗？

original: Thanks for coming. It means a lot to both of us.
translation: 感谢你来参加这聚会。对我们来说你的光临真是意义重大。

original: Hey hey, mungo! We're getting' outta here, right?
translation: 嗨，嗨！毛人！我们是要逃出这地方是吗？

original: Are you all right, Madison?
translation: 你还好么，麦迪逊？

original: Janice, I have something for you.
translation: 贾尼斯，我有东西给你。

original: Janice, a moment please.
translation: 贾尼斯，打扰你一会。

original: Go ahead and take a seat so we can start.
translation: 找个座位，我们开始。

original: George, have you spoken to your son about Old Lady Dithers?
translation: 乔治，你有没有和你的儿子谈谈迪瑟老妈的事？

original: So, heard anything good from Mabel lately?
translation: 最近从梅布尔那得到过什么好消息吗？

original: Say, Martha...
translation: 话说，玛莎……

original: How are you, Mabel?
translation: 你好吗？梅布尔。

original: Hi, honey.
translation: 嘿，亲爱的。

original: Hi, Mommy.
translation: 嘿，妈妈。

original: Hi, Daddy.
translation: 嘿，爸爸。

original: Hi, Martha.
translation: 嗨，玛莎。

original: Hello, Ms. Dithers.
translation: 你好，迪瑟女士。

original: Hi, Mabel.
translation: 嘿，梅布尔。

original: Hi, Janet.
translation: 嘿，珍妮特。

original: Hi, Roger.
translation: 嘿，罗杰。

original: Hi, Pat.
translation: 嘿，帕特。

original: Hi, George.
translation: 嘿，乔治。

original: [crying]
Hiya.
translation: 嗨。

original: Hello!
translation: 你好！

original: Good day.
translation: 日安。

original: Ah, young madam! Very good to see you again. I do suppose you’re looking for your father the doctor.
translation: 啊，年轻的女士！很高兴又见到你。我猜你是来找你的医生父亲吧。

original: Just hold still. Your left stabilizer's been knocked loose.
translation: 别动，你的左稳定器被撞松了。

original: Don't be such an old woman. Just a few more adjustments and you'll be as good as new.
translation: 别像个老太婆一样。再调试两下你就和新的没两样了。

original: You should talk to Sonora.
translation: 你应该和索诺拉谈谈。

original: There's my super-assistant! What's up?
translation: 这不是我的超级助手吗！什么事？

original: Please don't take Ian away from us.
translation: 请不要把伊恩从我们身边带走。

original: Dinner was... well... I was able to finish it.
translation: 晚餐……好……我能吃完。

original: Four Score! Who's a good boy? Who's a good boy?
translation: 四分位！谁是好孩子？谁是好孩子？

original: Good dog, Four Score. You love Bill just as he is, don't you? You don't go judging a man like them others.
translation: 乖狗，四分位。你爱比尔，就因为他是比尔，是吗？你不像其他人那样判断一个人。

original: Hey, Four Score. I don't have time to play fetch today. Go bother Bill.
translation: 嗨，四分位。我今天没空和你玩。去找比尔。

original: Come, boy. If you're good today, I'll give you a treat.
translation: 来吧，孩子。如果你今天表现好，我就给你奖励。

original: Out of my way, mutt.
translation: 滚开，傻子。

original: We should get out of here, don't you think?
translation: 我们该立刻离开这，你认为呢？

original: Whatever you can do to help our town, we'd appreciate it.
translation: 任何事，只要能帮助我们的镇子，我们都会对你心存感激。

original: We appreciate you taking care of our town's little problem.
translation: 我们感谢你帮我们的镇子解决了点小问题。

original: Any luck finding those two troublemakers, yet?
translation: 有没有找到那两个惹事的家伙？

original: When you find those two costumed idiots, put a bullet in their heads for me.
translation: 你要是看见那两个穿着戏服的白痴，帮我朝他们的头上开一枪。

original: Overseer's glad to see everyone staying so calm down here.
translation: 监督者看见大家情绪稳定很高兴，

original: Glad to see you here.
translation: 很高兴见到你。

original: Good to see another rebel.
translation: 又一个反叛的，很好。

original: Still representing the gang? Good to see, man.
translation: 仍是帮派？很高兴见到你，伙计。

original: Good to see you here. Please keep quiet, you never know who's listening.
translation: 在这见到你很高兴。不过要保持安静，隔墙有耳。

original: Hi, Chrissie. Any stories from the weirdo dorm?
translation: 嘿，克里斯。有什么那古怪宿舍的故事吗？

original: Good to see you, Susie!
translation: 见到你很高兴，苏茜！

original: Well, Stanley, how's everything going down in the reactor?
translation: 斯坦利，反应堆那目前怎么样？

original: Tunnel Snakes rule, huh?
translation: 隧蛇帮主宰一切，呃？

original: Man, I sure wish we could blow this joint.
translation: 听我说，我当然希望能离开这地方。

original: Please, be careful.
translation: 千万要小心。

original: I'm sorry. Goodbye.
translation: 对不起，再见。

original: Leave me alone.
translation: 不要理我。

original: Go ahead and start something, I dare you.
translation: 想继续惹事？谅你也不敢！

original: You don't belong here anymore.
translation: 从现在起这不欢迎你。

original: Sigh. This is a long way from the Statesman Hotel. Why are you still here?
translation: 唉。去政要酒店的路途很遥远。为什么你还在这？

original: Whoa. Feel woozy.
translation: 哇，头晕眼花。

original: Why are you just standing around here? My men might be dying!
translation: 为什么你还在这站着？我的人都快死了！

original: Please, don't hang around here... just get out to the Statesman Hotel and rescue my men.
translation: 求你了，不要再在这游荡了……快去政要酒店救出我的人。

original: You're still here?
translation: 你还在这？

original: Find him!
translation: 找到他！

original: If you have any questions about the exhibits, please let me know.
translation: 如果你对这些展品有什么疑问，请告诉我。

original: Do have a look around, but don't touch anything.
translation: 你可以四处看看，但请勿动手。

original: We have the most complete archive of U.S. historical documents in the Wasteland.
translation: 在这片废土上要找美国历史的文件，那就属我们拥有的资料最完整了。

original: There he is!
translation: 看，是他！

original: There she is!
translation: 看，是她！

original: Hey, clown shoes. I hope that key was worth it.
translation: 嗨，乡巴佬。我希望那钥匙是有价值的。

original: Too bad about Crowley. I heard Tenpenny put out a contract on him.
translation: 这下克劳利糟糕了。我听说特佩尼与他签订了一份协议。

original: You're a lowlife, but if you keep your nose clean, we'll let you stay.
translation: 虽然你是个下等人，但如果你能不惹是生非，我们还能愿意让你留下来。

original: You watch yourself. You cause any more trouble and you'll be dead.
translation: 不要轻举妄动。你要是敢惹什么麻烦你就死定了！

original: Those Temple Union slaves got what they deserved.
translation: 那些联邦神殿的奴隶是自作自受。

original: If you're here to give blood, we're always willing to accept... Just kidding!
translation: 如果你来这是想“无偿献血”，我们随时欢迎……哈哈，开个玩笑！

original: Oh, hey there.
translation: 哦，嗨。

original: Crime doesn't pay, it just pisses people off.
translation: 犯罪不能给你带来任何好处，只会激起民愤。

original: Next time you want to talk to someone, stay away from me.
translation: 下次要是你想找个人说话，拜托你不要找我。

original: Just make this fast. I don't like talking to criminals.
translation: 有屁快放。我可不喜欢和罪犯说话。

original: There's a fine line between badass and dumbass, and you crossed it.
translation: 愚蠢和邪恶之间是有明显的界限的，而你已经越界了。

original: Make no mistake. Try something and I drop your ass.
translation: 别做傻事。你敢乱动我就割下你的屁股！

original: We may be alike, but don't take me for stupid. I got my eyes on you.
translation: 我们或许很像，但你别以为我是蠢货。我自己有眼睛。

original: Keep acting the way you've been acting and they'll catch you, lock you up and throw away the key.
translation: 你要是继续这样，他们就会抓住你，把你永远的关起来。

original: I'm not sure I should even be seen talking to you.
translation: 我在想我该不该被人看到和你说话。

original: Oh, it's you. Up to the same old crap, huh?
translation: 哦，是你啊！你就像个老垃圾，呃？

original: Sometimes being bad feels pretty damn good, eh?
translation: 偶尔使点坏感觉真他妈爽，你说呢？

original: You should be ashamed of yourself.
translation: 你真应为你自己感到羞愧。

original: Next time, use your brains... I know you have it in you.
translation: 拜托你下次动动脑子好吗？你那圆脑袋里装的该不会是草吧？

original: What's the matter with you? You can't get away with crap like this.
translation: 我说你是怎么了？你总不至于要带着这样的垃圾离开吧？

original: The way you're acting surprises me.
translation: 你的所作所为让我感到惊讶。

original: Everyone makes mistakes... just don't do it often.
translation: 每个人都会犯错……但你不能老犯同样的错。

original: Your bad deeds surprise me, they really do.
translation: 你的恶行让我感到惊讶，真的。

original: Don't act like you didn't enjoy what you did.
translation: 不要装出一副对你所做的事丝毫不感兴趣的样子。

original: You're as guilty as the rest of us.
translation: 你，还有我们，都是有罪之人。

original: We need more people like you.
translation: 像你这样的人再多点就好了。

original: Bless you.
translation: 上帝保佑你。

original: You're an example to us all.
translation: 你是我们的楷模！

original: It's not easy to be good in this world. I'm glad that someone is.
translation: 在现在这社会做个好人实属不易。但我很高兴还有这样的人存在。

original: I've heard about you. Let it never be said that there aren't some good people left in the world.
translation: 我听说你的事迹了。你让人们相信这世上还是有好人存在的。

original: There's never been anyone like you.
translation: 从没见过像你这样的人！

original: Is everyone from the Vault as kind as you?
translation: 是不是从避难所出来的人都和你一个样？

original: I told you to go.
translation: 我告诉你走开。

original: Remember: cash for scrap metal.
translation: 记住，收集废铜烂铁。

original: Umm... hello there. Right! Uh, don't mind me then. I'm uh... just practicing my hunting skills. Keeps me young and all that. Right. Goodbye now!
translation: 唔……你好！呃，不要在意我。我，呃……只是在练习我的打猎技巧。这样让我保持年轻。再见！

original: Dashwood. What the hell are you skulking about for?
translation: 达什伍德。你鬼鬼祟祟地到底是要干嘛？

original: Hey! What are you up to old man?
translation: 嗨！你在对老人干嘛？

original: Ahem. Dashwood. Don't do anything stupid.
translation: 啊。达什伍德。别做蠢事。

original: You feeling alright, Daring? You having a flash back or something?
translation: “大胆”，你觉得怎样？你是突然想起什么了吗？

original: You're behaving rather oddly, Mister Dashwood. Perhaps you should go lie down for awhile.
translation: 你的举止很古怪，达什伍德先生。恐怕要请你到一边冷静一会。

original: Are you alright, Comrade?
translation: 你还好吧，同志？

original: Daring! What on earth are you up to?
translation: “大胆”！你究竟在干什么？

original: You're up to something. I can tell.
translation: 你在忙。我知道。

original: Daring! What the bloody hell are you up to this time?
translation: “大胆”！你这次又想搞什么鬼？

original: Mr. Dashwood. Perhaps you should go take a nap, dear. You're acting rather peculiar.
translation: 达什伍德先生。恐怕要请你去小睡一会，亲爱的。你的行为实在太“特别”了。

original: Daring... you're up to no good, aren't you? Naughty, naughty old man!
translation: “大胆”……你在做坏事，对吧？顽皮，顽皮的老小孩！

original: What are you doing, Dashwood?
translation: 你在干嘛，达什伍德？

original: Nice to see you. Carry on.
translation: 很高兴见到你。继续吧。

original: Now's not the best time. Perhaps we could parlay sometime later? Thank you.
translation: 现在还不是时候，我看下次吧。谢谢。

original: If you're tired of sleeping in those barracks, let me know.
translation: 如果你厌倦了在兵营里睡觉，告诉我。

original: I made it just like you like it. Enjoy!
translation: 我按你的口味做的，慢用！

original: Chief. I'm concerned some of your men have been sleeping on the job. Well not literally, I just mean, they don't seem that alert.
translation: 长官。你的手下在工作时间睡着了，这让我很难办。可能我言重了，我是想说，他们似乎不那么警惕了。

original: I'm afraid I can't stop and chit chat.
translation: 恐怕我没空停下来闲谈。

original: I'm afraid I can't stop and chit chat.
translation: 恐怕我没空停下来闲谈。

original: Hey.
translation: 嗨！

original: 'can I do for you, Sheriff?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的，警长？

original: You... uh... want a drink?
translation: 你……呃……要不要来一杯？

original: Dad says not to talk to strangers.
translation: 爸爸说不要和陌生人说话。

original: Billy says not to talk to you.
translation: 比利让我不要和你说话。

original: I got nothin' to say to you.
translation: 和你没什么好说的。

original: ...now where has that man got to?
translation: ……那家伙去哪了？

original: You seen Nathan around anywhere?
translation: 你看到过内森吗？

original: I'd put that weapon away if I were you.
translation: 要是我是你，我就会把家伙收起来。

original: I got my eye on you.
translation: 我盯着你呢。

original: Yes?
translation: 嗯？

original: Hrm?
translation: 嗯？

original: Gob. These people aren't nearly drunk enough. Fix it.
translation: 盖博，这些人还没喝够呢，继续上酒。

original: Gob!
translation: 盖博！

original: I want a word with you, zombie.
translation: 我想和你说两句，丧尸。

original: Sheriff Simms...
translation: 西姆斯警长……

original: Nathan.
translation: 内森。

original: Hey.
translation: 嗨！

original: May I take your order?
translation: 你想点些什么？

original: I'll be right with you.
translation: 我立刻就来。

original: The Mirelurks have been quiet lately.
translation: 最近泥沼蟹好像安分很多。

original: I'll have two Mirelurk Cakes, carrots and wine, if you have it, beer if you don't.
translation: 我要两个泥沼蟹饼，胡萝卜和红酒，如果没有红酒，那就来啤酒。

original: Welcome to Potomac Attire.
translation: 欢迎光临波托马克服装。

original: Hmmph.
translation: 哼。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: This is the Muddy Rudder. Cause any trouble, and you'll have to deal with me.
translation: 这是“泥舵”酒吧。如果你惹了什么麻烦，就必须给我个交代。

original: Care for a drink?
translation: 来一杯？

original: Oh! Hello. Are you lost?
translation: 哦！你好，你是不是迷路了？

original: Welcome to A Quick Fix.
translation: 欢迎来到快速修复。

original: Did you need something?
translation: 你是不是需要些什么？

original: Excuse me.
translation: 打扰一下。

original: You're hurt. Fortunately, this is a medical clinic. Why don't you let me take a look at that.
translation: 你受伤了。幸运的是，这就是诊所。为什么你不让我瞧瞧呢？

original: Welcome to Flak and Shrapnel's. Best god damn weapons anywhere.
translation: 欢迎来到“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅。这该死的到处都是上好的武器。

original: Have a seat anywhere. Someone will be with you in a minute.
translation: 随便坐，立刻会有人来招待你。

original: I... never mind.
translation: 我……算了。

original: Yes?
translation: 嗯？

original: Don't mind me, mister.
translation: 不要在意我，先生。

original: Don't mind me, lady.
translation: 不要介意我，先生。

original: This is A Quick Fix. We sell all kinds of chems.
translation: 这是快速修复。我们这出售所有种类的化学品。

original: Hello, Bannon. Anything interesting happen in the last council meeting?
translation: 你好，班侬。最近的那次议会会议上有没有发生什么有趣的事？

original: Hello, Henry. I just got in some new torque wrench and some electrical test equipment. You should take a look at them when you're done eating.
translation: 你好，亨利。我新进了一批扭力扳手和电气测试设备。你吃完饭之后不妨来我店里看看。

original: Welcome to Rivet City Supply. I've got a little bit of everything here.
translation: 欢迎来到铆钉城补给点。我们这应有尽有。

original: Hey, girlie. This ain't a god damn dress shop. There's nothing in here you oughta be buyin'.
translation: 嗨，女孩。这可不是什么该死的服装店，不会有你想要的东西。

original: If you want a gun, you've come to the right place.
translation: 如果你想买把枪，你可算来对地方了。

original: Have you seen my good-for-nothing son, James?
translation: 你有没有看见我那一无是处的孩子，詹姆斯？

original: Hey stranger. Wanna buy a girl a drink?
translation: 嗨，陌生人，不想请女孩喝一杯吗？

original: Can you spare enough for a drink? I could really use one.
translation: 你能不能多留些酒？我真想来一杯。

original: Welcome to the Weatherly Hotel.
translation: 欢迎来到韦瑟利旅馆。

original: Wastelander.
translation: 废土客。

original: Everything looks okay here.
translation: 一切正常。

original: Any trouble in this area?
translation: 这区域有什么问题吗？

original: I'm looking for troublemakers. Have you seen any?
translation: 我在找制造麻烦的家伙。你看见没？

original: Out of the way you rust bucket.
translation: 闪开点，你这生锈的铁桶。

original: I heard that the City Council is debating putting railings on the flight deck.
translation: 我听说城议会在讨论在甲板上装置栏杆。
