original: Did you hear that the Enclave attacked Project Purity? They've taken over the Memorial.
translation: 你有没有听说英克雷攻击了净水工程？他们已经占领了纪念堂。

original: Chief Harkness has vanished. Nobody knows what happened to him.
translation: 哈克尼斯长官失踪了。没人知道他出了什么事。

original: Hey.
translation: 嗨！

original: Sir.
translation: 先生。

original: Ma'am.
translation: 女士。

original: Attention! Officer on deck.
translation: 注意！长官来了。

original: Authorized Civilian. Proceed.
translation: 授权平民，获准通行。

original: Oh... hi!
translation: 哦……嗨！

original: <sniffs> You smell like the Wasteland.
translation: <嗅>你身上一股废土气息。

original: Holy, shit! Where'd you get that gun?
translation: 他妈的！你从哪弄来那枪的？

original: Can't nobody eat fifty eggs...
translation: 居然能吃50个鸡蛋……

original: Yeah, I guess I gotta find my own way.
translation: 嗯，我猜我找到自己的办法了。

original: Psst. Hey. Help me out.
translation: 嘘。嗨。救我出去。

original: Whoa, sorry! I'll get out of your way!
translation: 哇，对不起！我这就让开！

original: Respect, man.
translation: 向你致敬，伙计。

original: Holy shit, it's you!
translation: 他妈的！是你！

original: We should grab a drink sometime.
translation: 我们应该找时间一起喝一杯。

original: What's up, killer?
translation: 什么事，杀手？

original: Hey, welcome, buddy.
translation: 嗨，欢迎你，老兄。

original: You're not so bad from what I've heard.
translation: 我听说你过得还不错。

original: Heh. I've heard a few things about you.
translation: 嘿。我听说了一些你的事。

original: Watch it.
translation: 小心。

original: We don't like outsiders here.
translation: 我们这不喜欢外来人。

original: Get your business done and go.
translation: 干完你的事立刻滚。

original: One wrong move, and you're going in the meat pen.
translation: 要是你干错一件事，就把你剁成肉酱。

original: Watch your step, square.
translation: 小心行事，老古板。

original: Keep walkin'.
translation: 继续走。

original: You don't look like you belong here.
translation: 你看上去不像这的人。

original: Goddamn tin can.
translation: 该死的锈罐头。

original: Looks like one of those Brotherhood assholes...
translation: 看上去像是兄弟会的混蛋……

original: Nice outfit. You raid a vault or something?
translation: 不错的外套。你洗劫了避难所还是别的什么？

original: Fucking Vault brats...
translation: 他妈的避难所捣蛋鬼……

original: Hey, you.
translation: 嗨，你。

original: Um, can I ask something?
translation: 呃，我能问个问题吗？

original: Excuse me.
translation: 打扰一下。

original: Just bring me a nice kid to meet, and I'll take care of the rest.
translation: 你只要带个漂亮的孩子来见我，剩下的事我会料理。

original: Hey, dummy.
translation: 嗨，蠢货。

original: Hey, Sammy.
translation: 嗨，萨米。

original: Hey, squirt.
translation: 嗨，喷射器。

original: Hey, heard the latest tales of the Wastes?
translation: 嗨，听说了废土最新发生的事吗？

original: Hey, sib!
translation: 嗨，兄弟！

original: What's up?
translation: 什么事？

original: So, sis, made any good jokes today?
translation: 姐妹，今天有没有什么有趣的事？

original: Guess what?
translation: 你猜怎样？

original: Mind if I follow you around for a bit? I promise not to bug you! It'll be fun!
translation: 介意我在你后面跟着你吗？我保证不烦你！那一定很有趣！

original: Oh, hey, excuse me, hey!
translation: 哦，嗨！你好，嗨！

original: Somebody said you wanted to see me, E?
translation: 有人说你想要见我，嗯？

original: Joseph, what happens when a person grows up?
translation: 约瑟夫，在一个人成长的过程中会发生什么事？

original: Pardon me.
translation: 原谅我。

original: Tell me more about shooting, Joseph.
translation: 再告诉我些射击的知识，约瑟夫。

original: Excuse me.
translation: 打扰一下。

original: Look alive, you mopey motherfucker, you've got a mayor talking to you!
translation: 快点，你这无精打采的混蛋，那可是镇长要和你谈话！

original: Hey, Princess, give the squirt a fucking break and answer a few questions.
translation: 嗨，公主，让这废人他妈的休息一下再回答问题。

original: Hey, Princess, if you aren't busy daydreaming about me, how about answering a few questions?
translation: 嗨，公主，如果你不是忙于对我想入非非，那么就回答我一些问题怎么样？

original: Eclair, stop trying to make crap taste like sugar and tell me what's going on.
translation: “闪电泡芙”，别再让垃圾尝起来像糖了，告诉我发生了什么事。

original: Anybody break anything important, Lucy?
translation: 有没有人打碎重要的东西，露西？

original: Knock, what's up? And if you say "the sky" I swear I'm gonna kick you in the junk.
translation: 敲门，发生了什么事？如果你敢说“天晓得”我就把你的屁股踢下来。

original: Knick, anything new and fancy in your magic junkpile full of crap?
translation: 敲门，你那神奇的垃圾堆里有什么新奇别致的东西吗？

original: Joe, anything useful you can teach me about how the classes are going?
translation: 乔，你能教我点上课的技巧吗？

original: Well, if it isn't my favorite girl.
translation: 好吧，这不是我最喜欢的女孩吗？

original: Look alive!
translation: 快点！

original: Lucy, can you take a look at this?
translation: 露西，你能不能来看看？

original: Hey.
translation: 嗨！

original: Watch it.
translation: 小心。

original: Mr. Eulogy... uhm... can I talk to you for a second? If, if you're not busy, I mean.
translation: 尤勒基先生…嗯……我能不能占用你点时间？如果，我的意思是，如果你不是很忙的话。

original: If you're not busy, Mr. Eulogy... I... I wanted to talk to you for a second.
translation: 如果你不是很忙，尤勒基先生……我…我想和你谈谈。

original: Grouse.
translation: 葛劳斯。

original: Ug. Get away from me.
translation: 咳。离我远点。

original: Miss Jeanette...
translation: 珍妮特小姐……

original: Pronto...
translation: 普郎托……

original: Richter.
translation: 里克特。

original: Ymir...
translation: 伊米尔……

original: Hey, you're back. You get anything good?
translation: 嗨，你回来了，有什么好消息？

original: You caught anything lately?
translation: 最近你有什么新消息？

original: How'd that roundup go?
translation: 那帮畜生怎么样了？

original: How's the meat?
translation: 肉怎么样？

original: Hey, how'd it go with that blonde thing you brought in here?
translation: 嗨，会怎么处置你在这抓的金发小妞？

original: You went out with Ymir last week, didn't you? Catch anything good?
translation: 你上周和伊米尔出去了，对吧？抓到什么好东西？

original: Catch any good meat lately?
translation: 最近有没有抓到好东西？

original: Things are quiet around here. We haven't had any good roundups in a while.
translation: 最近这很平静，我们有段日子没活动了。

original: S'up.
translation: 什么事？

original: What's goin' on?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Hey.
translation: 嗨！

original: Elder Lyons, SIR!
translation: 里昂斯长老，长官！

original: Elder on deck!
translation: 听候长老的命令！

original: Elder Lyons...
translation: 里昂斯长老……

original: Initiate reporting, Sir Dusk!
translation: 新兵随时汇报，达斯科长官！

original: Knight Captain Dusk, Sir!
translation: 骑士队长达斯科，长官！

original: Damn robot. Worst bedside manner ever.
translation: 该死的机器人。这是我见过最差的态度。

original: Hail, Scribe Bowditch. All is well with your work?
translation: 你好，鲍蒂奇学士。你的工作顺利吗？

original: Hail to you, Scribe Bowditch.
translation: 向你问好，鲍蒂奇学士。

original: Hail, Scribe Bowditch.
translation: 你好，鲍蒂奇学士。

original: Hail, Scribe Peabody. I trust that your research goes well.
translation: 你好，博迪学士。我相信你的研究一定有进展。

original: Hail, Scribe Peabody.
translation: 你好，博迪学士。

original: Hail to you, Scribe Peabody.
translation: 向你问好，博迪学士。

original: Scribe Rothchild, sir.
translation: 罗斯查德学士，先生。

original: Hail, Scribe Rothchild.
translation: 你好，罗斯查德学士。

original: Hail to you, Scribe Rothchild.
translation: 向你问好，罗斯查德学士。

original: Sir Scribe.
translation: 学士先生。

original: Sentinel Lyons, ma'am!
translation: 里昂斯铁卫，女士！

original: Watch it, Squire.
translation: 小心，扈从。

original: Don't you have somewhere to be, Squire?
translation: 扈从，你没有地方可去了？

original: Step lively, Squire.
translation: 加把劲，扈从。

original: Hail, Star Paladin, sir.
translation: 你好，星骑士，长官。

original: Star Paladin Cross, sir!
translation: 星骑士克罗丝，长官！

original: Need something, friend?
translation: 需要些什么，朋友？

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Looks like the Muties missed one.
translation: 看来变种人漏掉了一个。

original: Here to help me out again?
translation: 来这想再帮我一把？

original: Hello, sugar.
translation: 你好，甜心。

original: Are you still here?
translation: 你还在吗？

original: Are you planning on moving in, or what?
translation: 你是打算进来还是怎样？

original: I wish he'd get us some regular clothes. It's cold out here dressed like this.
translation: 我希望他会给我们带点正常的衣服。穿成这样在外面很冷的。

original: Tag! You're it, Ralphie!
translation: 抓到了！该你了，拉尔菲！

original: Come on Mary, let's go play!
translation: 来吧，玛丽，让我们去玩吧！

original: Hello Rosie.
translation: 你好，萝丝。

original: Excuse you.
translation: 失陪。

original: Hey, go clean up after the Brahmin. It's your turn.
translation: 嘿，去把双头牛那儿清理干净。到你了。

original: Man, the Brahmin smell awful today.
translation: 伙计，双头牛的味道可真重。

original: I'm Dave's wife, so don't even think about trying anything...
translation: 我是戴夫的妻子，所以请你不要轻举妄动……

original: Have you heard about Dave, lady?
translation: 你有没有听说过戴夫，女士？

original: Have you heard about Dave, mister?
translation: 你有没有听说过戴夫，先生？

original: You're almost as big as Dave.
translation: 你差不多和戴夫一样大。

original: Hi there, honey. Have you spoken to Dave?
translation: 你好，亲爱的，你和戴夫说过了吗？

original: Mmmm... dinner smells delicious, honey!
translation: 嗯……晚餐闻起来真不错，亲爱的！

original: There's my honey pie!
translation: 我的爱心派！

original: Hi, Mrs. Smith!
translation: 嘿，史密斯先生！

original: Mrs. Wilson...
translation: 威尔逊夫人……

original: I love you, Mommy!
translation: 我爱你，妈妈！

original: My room is all clean, Mommy!
translation: 我的房间都收拾好了，妈妈！

original: Hello, Mr. Harris.
translation: 你好，哈里斯先生。

original: Mommy says that it's almost time for dinner!
translation: 妈妈说差不多该吃晚餐了！

original: I saw you napping, daddy!
translation: 我看见你打盹了，爸爸！

original: Hi there, daddy!
translation: 你好，爸爸！

original: Hi, Bill.
translation: 嘿，比尔。

original: Hello, Bill.
translation: 你好，比尔。

original: Mr. Smith...
translation: 史密斯先生……

original: Hello, Jack.
translation: 你好，开膛手“杰克”。

original: Hi, Jack.
translation: 嘿，开膛手“杰克”。

original: Uh oh, Jenny. Look at you. The boys better watch out!
translation: 哦，珍妮。看看你自己。男孩们得小心了！

original: Hey there, Jenny, sweetheart. Looking gorgeous as usual.
translation: 嗨，珍妮，甜心。你总是那么美丽。

original: Hi there, honey. Don't you look precious today?
translation: 你好，亲爱的。你今天看上去非同寻常。

original: Jenny, you look beautiful today! You're like a little doll!
translation: 珍妮，你今天看上去真漂亮，就像个洋娃娃！

original: Jenny, honey, you look so cute in that dress.
translation: 珍妮，亲爱的，你穿那衣服看上去真可爱。

original: Excellent. Another customer.
translation: 我们这人类可不多……

original: Welcome to my place.
translation: 欢迎，来访者。

original: Do you need something?
translation: 你需要什么东西吗？

original: You gonna stare, or are you gonna order?
translation: 你是准备就这样盯着我，还是有什么吩咐？

original: What is it, human?
translation: 怎么了，人类？

original: Bugger off, ye bastards bugger off... ye'll get nae more this evenin'... how's it go?
translation: 走开，你这杂种给我走开……今晚你别想再得到什么……然后怎么唱来着？

original: <hic>
translation: <打嗝>

original: Do you want to hear a story about the Wastes?
translation: 你想听听一个废土里发生的故事吗？

original: You here to buy, or just looking around?
translation: 你是来买东西的，还是只是来看看的？

original: I got work to do, so if you need something, spit it out.
translation: 我有事情要做，如果你有什么事，快点说！

original: Don't mess with us, we won't mess with you.
translation: 不要打扰我们，我们也不会打扰你。

original: Oh, oh! Mr. Ahzrukhal, I want to ask you something.
translation: 哦，哦！阿祖卡先生，我有些事要问你。

original: Oh, hey... Mr. <coughs> ... Mr. Ahzrukhal... hi.
translation: 哦，嗨……阿……<咳嗽>……阿祖卡先生……嗨。

original: Hey, Mr. Ahzrukhal...
translation: 嗨，阿祖卡先生……

original: Excuse me, Mr. Ahzrukhal...
translation: 打扰了，阿祖卡先生……

original: Ahzrukhal...
translation: 阿祖卡……

original: Hey, robot, have you seen any toes laying around here?
translation: 嗨，机器人，你有没有看见放在这的脚趾？

original: Cerberus! How are you? Programming holding up?
translation: 地狱犬！你好吗？程序运行得怎么样？

original: Heya, Patches. You alright, buddy? You're not lookin' so good.
translation: 你好，“拼盘”。你还好吧，老兄？你看上去不太妙啊。

original: Quinn, no one told me you were back!
translation: 奎因，没人告诉我你回来了！

original: Hey, Quinn.
translation: 嗨，奎因。

original: Hey, Winthrop. How's it going?
translation: 嗨，温思罗普，近来怎么样？

original: Hey, I wanted to tell you, Patchwork got drunk last week and left his booze in the air filter...
translation: 嗨，我想告诉你，“拼盘”昨天喝多了，把他的酒落在空气过滤器里了……

original: Winthrop, I was wondering if you could take a look at the generator down in the common area...
translation: 温思罗普，我想你是不是能去查看下工作间的发电机……

original: Heya, Winthrop. You got a second?
translation: 呀，温思罗普。你有空吗？

original: How's everything? Enjoying your drinks?
translation: 一切顺利？喝得还满意吗？

original: Yes, yes, how is everyone doing? Everything alright? Do you need anything else?
translation: 是的，是的，所有人都好吗？一切都好？你还有什么其他需要？

original: The air is off in the common house again. It stinks of sweaty death down there. I swear, every day it's something new.
translation: 工作间的空气又不流通了。臭气熏天。我保证，每天都会出现新麻烦。

original: What the hell is that smell? I mean, it's not bad, it's just... I don't know... do you smell that?
translation: 那到底是什么味道？我说，其实味道还不赖，就是有点……我说不清楚……你没闻到？

original: Hey.
translation: 嗨！

original: Hey Kimba, thanks for offering to help me in the clinic.
translation: 嗨，金巴。感谢你为我的诊所提供帮助。

original: How are you feeling, Timebomb?
translation: 你感觉怎么样，“定时炸弹”？

original: Hey there, Sticky.
translation: 嗨，斯蒂奇。

original: How are the patrols going, Flash? Are we still safe?
translation: 巡逻进行得怎么样了，福莱斯？看看我们是否依旧安全？

original: I wonder how the Lamplighters are doing...
translation: 我想知道现在点灯人怎么样了……

original: Hey, Red. Do you need any help washing bandages later?
translation: 嗨，瑞德。你迟点需要人帮你洗绷带吗？

original: Hey Shorty. How's our favorite little guy doing?
translation: 嗨，“矮子”。我们至爱的小家伙过得怎么样？

original: How are you doing, Pappy?
translation: 你过得怎么样，帕匹？

original: Hey, Sticky. Keep your stickiness away from me and my new gun. This is a Sticky-free zone!
translation: 嗨，斯蒂奇。让你的口水离我和我的新枪远点。谢绝斯蒂奇靠近！

original: Timebomb! How're you doing? I thought you were dead for sure!
translation: “定时炸弹”！你怎么样？我以为你死定了！

original: Hey Shorty, you should come with me on patrol. The Raiders will never see you coming.
translation: 嗨，“矮子”。你应该和我一起巡逻。歹徒根本看不到你。

original: Hey Red, can I stop by the clinic later? I feel a bit sick.
translation: 嗨，瑞德，迟点我能去诊所看看吗？我感觉有点难受。

original: Wow, you should have seen me on patrol, Kimba, I was all "bang-bang-bang." I must have killed a hundred Raiders!
translation: 哇，你真该来看我巡逻，金巴，我刚才一直在“嘣-嘣-嘣”。我肯定已经杀了100个歹徒了！

original: Red, have you got a sec? It’s about this wound on my arm.
translation: 瑞德，你有时间吗？看看我胳膊上的伤口。

original: We're all going to die here. There's no way we can survive out here in this mess.
translation: 我们都会死在这。我们没法从这堆垃圾中活着出来。

original: Hey there, Kimba.
translation: 嗨，金巴。

original: What do you think of the barricades, Shorty?
translation: 你觉得防御工事怎么样，“矮子”？

original: Hey, Timebomb. You look like you're going to fall over dead.
translation: 嗨，“定时炸弹”。你看上去像要立刻倒地而死似的。

original: Never thought you'd make it, Sticky. Out of everyone who died trying to get here from Lamplight, we get you.
translation: 没人觉得你会成功，斯蒂奇。有很多人试着从小灯镇来这儿却死了，但是你成功了。

original: Anything out there, Flash? The Super Mutants and Raiders are coming back soon, aren't they?
translation: 外边有动静吗，福莱斯？超级变种人和歹徒不久就会回来，对吧？

original: How do?
translation: 好吗？

original: Heya!
translation: 嗨！

original: Hey.
translation: 嗨！

original: I got my eye on you.
translation: 我盯着你呢。

original: <snort>
Rise and shine! How was your night, my boy?
translation: 快起床！晚上怎么样，我的孩子？

original: Evening! Get a lot of work done today, boy?
translation: 晚上好！今天一定干了很多事，孩子？

original: How're you doing, boy? Is everything all right?
translation: 你最近怎么样，孩子？一切都好吗？

original: Hello, Dom. Everyone behaving themselves?
translation: 你好，多米。每个人都在岗位上吗？

original: Dom. Any news I should be worried about?
translation: 多米。有什么需要我担心的吗？

original: Umm... Hi, miss. I mean, Machete. Things okay with the, umm, guarding?
translation: 唔……嘿，小姐。我是说，玛切蒂。这一切都好吧，嗯，在站岗？

original: Hey, Machete. You on guard? I mean, of course you are. I mean, umm, never mind.
translation: 嗨，玛切蒂。你在站岗？我的意思，当然你是。我的意思，哦，算了。

original: Derek, been hearing good things about your work with the traders. Way to go, man.
translation: 德里克，听说你和那些商人处得不错。干得好，哥们。

original: Eating right? Hope so.
translation: 吃饱了吗？希望如此。

original: Hey, Machete. Report in. You see anything odd out there?
translation: 嗨，玛切蒂。向我报告。你看到那边有什么异样吗？

original: Machete, what's the word from your watch?
translation: 玛切蒂，你观察到什么了吗？

original: You're no longer welcome here.
translation: 这不再欢迎你。

original: How can I help you, Outsider?
translation: 我能帮你什么，外来人？

original: Is something amiss?
translation: 有什么事出错了吗？

original: Yes, Outsider?
translation: 什么事，外来者？

original: It appears you've been wounded, sir. May I suggest you utilize your infirmary?
translation: 看来你受伤了，先生。允许我向你建议使用你的医务台？

original: You appear to have been wounded, madam. May I suggest you utilize your infirmary?
translation: 看来你受伤了，女士。允许我向你建议使用你的医务台？

original: It appears you've been wounded, madam. May I suggest you seek medical attention as soon as possible?
translation: 你好像受伤了，女士。允许我向你建议尽快寻找医疗援助？

original: I hope things are going well for you today, madam.
translation: 我希望你今天过得愉快，女士。

original: Welcome home, madam.
translation: 欢迎回家，女士。

original: It's good to see you alive and well, madam.
translation: 很高兴见到你还活得不错，女士。

original: Did you hear about those newbies? The ones who went up north lookin' for raids?
translation: 你听说那些新人了吗？他们要去北方寻找歹徒？

original: Yo.
translation: 哟。

original: Yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: Don't point that thing at me.
translation: 别把那东西对着我。

original: Hey, knock it off.
translation: 嗨，停下！

original: What do you think you're doing?
translation: 你以为你在干嘛？

original: Be careful with that!
translation: 小心点！

original: That's not a good idea.
translation: 那可不是个好主意！

original: Easy there.
translation: 放松。

original: What's going on?
translation: 发生了什么事？

original: Welcome to Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 欢迎来到特佩尼大厦。

original: Charmed, I'm sure...
translation: 幸会，真的……

original: Ah, hello!
translation: 啊，你好！

original: Hey.
translation: 嗨！

original: Evening.
translation: 晚上好。

original: How are you?
translation: 你好吗？

original: Nice to see you. Doing well, I hope?
translation: 很高兴见到你。但愿过得不错？

original: How are things?
translation: 怎么样？

original: And how are you this fine day?
translation: 你今天过得怎么样？

original: Whatever. I need to get back to work.
translation: 不管怎样。我要回去工作了。

original: Please... help me.
translation: 求求你……救救我。

original: Please... God... I just need water.
translation: 求求你……天啊……我只想要点水喝。

original: We'll be here.
translation: 我们会到的。

original: Get outta here.
translation: 闪一边去。

original: Fine, go.
translation: 好的，继续。

original: Don't screw up, okay?
translation: 别搞砸，好吗？

original: The Citadel is our only chance now. We have to make it there.
translation: 大本营是我们现在唯一的机会。我们必须去那。

original: You have lots of work to do!
translation: 你有很多事要去做！

original: Mabel's waiting for you.
translation: 梅布尔正在等你。

original: I look forward to seeing how you deal with this.
translation: 我来看看你是怎么解决这事的。

original: Tell Timmy I said hi!
translation: 告诉提米，我向他问好！

original: Run along now.
translation: 快走开吧。

original: We're counting on you.
translation: 我们都指望你了。

original: Don't let me keep you.
translation: 别让我耽误你。

original: Good luck out there.
translation: 祝你平安。

original: Begone from my sight!
translation: 滚出我的视线。

original: Hurry up!
translation: 快点儿！

original: Let's get to it.
translation: 开始吧。

original: Good luck in the Museum. Bring me back something and I'll let you get a closer look at the Memorial.
translation: 在博物馆里好运。给我带回点东西的话，我会让你仔细看看纪念堂。

original: Sure. Silas will tell them you're allowed up there.
translation: 当然。西拉斯会告诉他们你可以上来了。

original: You know what you need to do.
translation: 你知道你需要做什么。

original: Brand.
translation: 布兰德。

original: Don't get yourself killed.
translation: 别把小命丢了。

original: Go with great care.
translation: 谨慎行事。

original: As you please.
translation: 如你所愿。

original: Have a wonderful and productive day.
translation: 祝你今天过得高效且充实。

original: Yes! They're all dead! And I have the keys. The keys to the... are you still here? Get lost. I have a trip to plan.
translation: 好！他们都死了！我有了钥匙。这钥匙是开……你还在这儿？滚吧。我还要安排旅行。

original: Finally, I have the keys. Your job is done and you've been paid, so move along. I have a trip to plan.
translation: 最后，我得到了钥匙。你的活已经干完并且得到了报酬，走吧。我还要安排旅行。

original: Well, they may not all be dead, but I have the keys. I should have hired a better mercenary. Run along. I have a trip to plan.
translation: 好吧，他们或许没都死，但我还是得到钥匙了。我应该雇个更好的佣兵。走开。我还要安排旅行。

original: Good luck out there.
translation: 祝你好运。

original: Hope you find what you're looking for.
translation: 希望你找到你要找的东西。

original: Keep your head low.
translation: 保持低调。

original: Hail.
translation: 致敬。

original: Yessir, Mr. Moriarty. More drunk customers, coming up!
translation: 遵命，莫里亚蒂先生。好多喝醉的顾客，来吧！

original: Come back... please.
translation: 要来噢……一定噢。

original: Come back if you need something. Not like I'm going anywhere.
translation: 如果你有需要就回来。我会一直在这的。

original: Wha... huh? I don't get it.
translation: 什……呃？我不明白。

original: Y'all come back real soon.
translation: 迟点见。

original: I'll tell Mr. Eulogy that we talked.
translation: 我会告诉尤勒基先生我们聊过了。

original: You'd better go before he sees you.
translation: 快走吧，别让他看见。

original: Yeah. Come back when you've got more injuries. And some more caps.
translation: 嗯。你受伤的时候可以回来。别忘了多带点瓶盖。

original: Paradise Falls is here if you need it.
translation: 如果你需要，天堂瀑就在这。

original: <belches>
translation: <打嗝>

original: Yeah, just behave yourself. The boys up there don't fuck around.
translation: 嗯，老实点。那边那群家伙可不是吃素的。

original: Go, then.
translation: 那走吧。

original: Please... if you get to Underworld, let them know that I'm okay.
translation: 拜托……如果你到了冥界，让他们知道我安好。

original: Hey, man. Come back any time.
translation: 嗨，哥们。欢迎随时回来。

original: Told you: there's nothing exciting down here.
translation: 已经告诉过你：在那没有什么好玩的东西。

original: It's only a matter of time now.
translation: 现在只是时间问题。

original: Come back when you are ready to drink, little man.
translation: 当你想喝点什么的时候就回来，小伙子。

original: Come back when you are ready to drink, little girl.
translation: 当你想喝点什么的时候就回来，小女孩。

original: Thanks. Hopefully, it'll just be skinned knees and bloody noses, today.
translation: 谢谢。但愿今天只是磕破膝盖或鼻子流血。

original: Don't get too hurt out there.
translation: 出门别伤太重了。

original: Come back later. I mean, don't come back later. See if I care.
translation: 回头见。我的意思，回头别见。我不在乎。

original: Watch out for Muties and Raiders.
translation: 小心变种人和掠夺者。

original: If you see anyone from Lamplight, tell them to be careful.
translation: 如果你看到任何从小灯镇来的人，告诉他们小心。

original: We're doomed and so are you if you stick around.
translation: 我们是完了，如果你在这待着，也一样。

original: Don't get yourself hurt. I have enough red on my clothes already.
translation: 别再把自己弄伤了。我的衣服已经够红了。

original: Stay clear of mutants. Especially the big, hungry ones.
translation: 离变种人远点。尤其是那种又大又饿的。

original: All right, I'll just be here doing grown-up stuff.
translation: 好吧，我只是在这做些大人的事。

original: Be careful out there. You don't want to end up on that table in Red's clinic.
translation: 出门小心。你不想最后又躺在瑞德的手术台上吧。

original: Don't be distracted by the size. Stay calm; shoot straight.
translation: 别被体型吓到。冷静；瞄准打。

original: Very well.
translation: 非常好。

original: So long, Bill...
translation: 再见，比尔……

original: So long, Jack...
translation: 再见，开膛手“杰克”……

original: So long, Jenny...
translation: 再见，珍妮……

original: So long, Junior...
translation: 再见，“小子”……

original: So long, Karen...
translation: 再见，卡伦……

original: So long, Linda...
translation: 再见，琳达……

original: So long, Martha...
translation: 再见，玛莎……

original: So long, Mr. Harris...
translation: 再见，哈里斯先生……

original: So long, Tuck...
translation: 再见，塔克……

original: Of course, of course! Don't let me keep you!
translation: 当然，当然！别让我耽误你！

original: Ah, you never any fun.
translation: 啊，你一点都没意思。

original: Ah, never mind! Talk with you is... stupid.
translation: 啊，算了！和你说话真是……太蠢了。

original: Bye.
translation: 再见。

original: Okay, amigo.
translation: 好吧，朋友。

original: Okay, amiga.
translation: 好吧，朋友。

original: All right, man. Later.
translation: 好吧，兄弟，迟点见。

original: All right, girl. Later.
translation: 好吧，女孩，迟点见。

original: Stay safe, brother.
translation: 注意安全，兄弟。

original: Stay safe, girl.
translation: 注意安全，女孩。

original: Yup. Talk to you later.
translation: 是的，回头再聊。

original: Yeah, me too.
translation: 嗯，我也是。

original: Okay, come on!
translation: 好嘞，走吧！

original: You're doing a great job. Really.
translation: 你干得真棒。

original: All right, I'll make sure they don't cut us off.
translation: 好的，我确保它们不会把我们隔断的。

original: First aliens, now Death Rays. This is like a crazy TV show.
translation: 先是外星人，现在是死光。就像一个疯狂的电视节目。

original: You know where to find me.
translation: 你知道在哪能找到我。

original: Well, go on! Get!
translation: 继续！快！

original: Back to business.
translation: 回去干活吧。

original: Come back any time, them swampfolk types are always bringin' me new stuff.
translation: 随时恭候，那些沼泽居民常给我带新玩意来。

original: Hey, before you go. If you ever want to get rid of that scar on your head, just come and see me, okay?
translation: 嗨，你走之前。如果你想去除头上的疤痕，就来找我，好吗？

original: Yeah, enough gabbing. Let's move!
translation: 是啊，说够了。快走吧！

original: Good travels to ya!
translation: 旅途愉快！

original: Yes, away with you!
translation: 是的，走开吧！

original: Come back again soon! Marie and I will be waiting!
translation: 快点回来！玛丽和我等着！

original: Sounds like Ashur's working you pretty hard. Must be so tough for you.
translation: 听起来阿舒尔像是在你身上下了大功夫，你想必很有本事。

original: Yessir.
translation: 遵命长官。

original: Wow, okay, I'm sorry. I was just... kidding...
translation: 哇，好吧，对不起。我只是…开个玩笑…

original: We're not naming ourselves after you. Drop it, all right?
translation: 我们又没跟你混。放弃吧，好吗？

original: I never said I didn't like it. I just haven't made up my mind yet, okay?
translation: 我从没有说过我不喜欢它。我只是还没想好，好吗？

original: Go ahead and punk out if you want. Me and Wally will find somebody else to be in our gang.
translation: 除非你想退出，否则就继续。我和瓦利会找到其他人加入我们的帮会的。

original: I said I'd think about it. Come on, we need some new ones.
translation: 我说过我会考虑的。得了吧，我们需要些新的。

original: No way. Not on my watch. GUARDS!
translation: 没门。在我当班的时候不行。守卫！

original: We must keep moving.
translation: 我们必须继续前进。

original: I really don't want to die down here.
translation: 我真的不想死在这。

original: Be careful.
translation: 小心。

original: Thank you, Janice.
translation: 谢谢，贾尼斯。

original: Bye.
translation: 再见。

original: Good luck, honey.
translation: 祝你好运，亲爱的。

original: Be careful, my son.
translation: 小心，我的儿子。

original: I'll expect to see you in class, Freddie. No excuses. Run along now, son.
translation: 我等你来上课哦，弗雷迪。别找借口。现在走开，孩子。

original: Whatever you say, Mr. Brotch.
translation: 随便吧，布洛彻先生。

original: See you later.
translation: 回头见。

original: Okay, yeah. Thanks for asking. I'll catch up with you later.
translation: 好吧，嗯。谢谢你的邀请。我迟点来找你。

original: I think I'd rather just stay broken than submit to any further indignity.
translation: 我觉得我什么都不做，也比受到更多的侮辱强。

original: Stay righteous.
translation: 维持你的正义心肠。

original: Stay sharp.
translation: 机灵点。

original: Get a move on.
translation: 赶快。

original: Then get moving.
translation: 那快点。

original: Okay. See ya later, pal!
translation: 好吧。回头见，朋友！

original: That's right. And don't come back!
translation: 没错。别回来！

original: Good luck. Careful around that bomb.
translation: 祝你好运。小心那核弹。

original: Please, do what you can to find my brother.
translation: 求你了，尽可能找到我的兄弟。

original: Hey, thanks again for doing this for me, it means a lot.
translation: 嗨，再次感谢你为我这么做，这意味着很多。

original: Remember, my offer still stands.
translation: 记住，我的开价一直有效。

original: Yes, you do.
translation: 是的，没错。

original: Come on, cheer up. Paul wouldn't want you moping around like that.
translation: 加油，振作起来。保罗可不想看见你整天闷闷不乐的。

original: I have no doubt that we shall. No doubt at all.
translation: 我不怀疑我们会的。毫不怀疑。

original: We certainly shall. In time, everything will be solved.
translation: 我想会的。所有的事迟早都会解决。

original: Harrumph.
translation: 哼。

original: He's not listening to me. But there's someone else who might be able to convince him. We'll see.
translation: 他不听我的。但有人能让他明白。我们走着瞧。

original: Sure you will, Butch. Sure you will.
translation: 你当然会。布奇。你当然会。

original: I'll keep myself safe if you do the same, Amata.
translation: 我会注意的，你也是哦，阿玛塔。

original: Don't be silly, Susie.
translation: 别犯傻了，苏茜。

original: All right, dear. Just don't get into any trouble.
translation: 好的，亲爱的。只是别惹麻烦。

original: Get that fission battery then double time it back here!
translation: 拿到裂变电池，然后快点回来！

original: Remember, donations are always welcome.
translation: 记住，随时欢迎捐赠。

original: Remember, bring me back anything interesting you find.
translation: 记住，给我带回你找到的任何有趣的东西。

original: Why won't you just take me to Big Town?
translation: 不如你不把我带到大镇吧？

original: I'll wait over here for you. When you're done playing with the children we'll go to Big Town.
translation: 我会在这等你。等你跟这些孩子玩够了，我们再去大镇。

original: Oh! Okay. Well, anytime you find yourself back in Megaton, be sure and look me up.
translation: 哦！嗯，好吧，如果你回到兆吨镇，就来找我吧。

original: Y'all come back now, y'hea'?
translation: 你们都会回来的，对吧？

original: Back to it.
translation: 再来。

original: Hooah, soldier. Stay straight, once again.
translation: 呼啊，士兵。再次保持挺直。

original: Steel walk with you.
translation: 钢铁兄弟会与你同在。

original: Goodbye.
translation: 再见。

original: Good travels to you, comrade.
translation: 旅途愉快，同志。

original: Bye, dear.
translation: 再见，亲爱的。

original: I'm afraid I can't stop and chit chat.
translation: 恐怕我没空停下来闲谈。

original: A little bit of caps for so much information... think about it.
translation: 一点瓶盖就能换那么多消息……好好想想吧。

original: Careful in D.C. now. Those Super-Mutants can be a prickly bunch. Heh heh heh heh heh.
translation: 在特区小心。那些超级变种人可是块烫手的山芋。呵呵呵呵呵。

original: Now, get the fuck out of me face.
translation: 赶紧的，别在老子面前晃荡。

original: Don't hit me!
translation: 别打我！

original: Sorry!
translation: 抱歉！

original: Remember us if you need something!
translation: 如果有需要的话可以找我们！

original: Any time.
translation: 随时可以。

original: See y'all later.
translation: 回头见。

original: Bye, mister!
translation: 再见，先生！

original: Bye, lady!
translation: 再见，女士！

original: God bless The Enclave.
translation: 上帝保佑英克雷。

original: Take care of yourself, hon.
translation: 你自己保重，亲爱的。

original: Gotcha.
translation: 知道了。

original: Well, back to work.
translation: 好吧，回去工作。

original: Okay, son. Okay.
translation: 好，孩子。好。

original: You got it, buddy.
translation: 你说中了，伙计。

original: You're welcome, you testy old fool. I swear, Nathan, one of these days you're going to give yourself a heart attack, just like Doc Church said...
translation: 不客气，你这个暴躁的老傻瓜。我发誓，内森，总有一天你会心脏病发的，就像丘奇医生说的那样……

original: Stay sharp!
translation: 机灵点！

original: Keep an eye out.
translation: 保持警惕。

original: Bye-bye!
translation: 再见！

original: About time.
translation: 早该如此。

original: See ya around!
translation: 再见！

original: See ya about!
translation: 再见！

original: Okay, see you next time, bye bye!
translation: 好的，下次见，再见！

original: Bye!
translation: 再见！

original: Okay.
translation: 好吧。

original: Bye, then!
translation: 那再见！

original: Yeah, that's nice, scram.
translation: 嗯，很好，滚开。

original: Not for a while, I hope.
translation: 不止一会，我希望。

original: All right.
translation: 好的。

original: Oh, anytime.
translation: 哦，随时。

original: Take care, sugar.
translation: 保重，甜心。

original: Bye, bye, honey.
translation: 再见，亲爱的。

original: Stay away from Dave. He's mine.
translation: 离戴夫远点。他是我的。

original: You're safe as long as Dave says so.
translation: 戴夫说你安全，你便是安全的。

original: Come back and visit the museum anytime!
translation: 随时欢迎回博物馆。

original: Just don't bother me. I've got stuff to do for Dave.
translation: 别烦我。我正在为戴夫做事。

original: I have to go practice my Dave impression, anyway.
translation: 无论如何，我都得让戴夫对我有所印象。

original: Goodbye, Mister Not-Dave.
translation: 再见，不是戴夫先生。

original: That's what Dave always says.
translation: 就像戴夫一直挂在嘴边的那样。

original: I really look forward to preparing you for dinner sometime!
translation: 我真希望能有机会和你共进晚餐！

original: You be careful now.
translation: 小心。

original: Let me know if you have any of that Scrap Metal to sell!
translation: 你有废金属的话，告诉我一声！

original: Come back soon! ...please.
translation: 迟点见！……一定噢。

original: Let me know if you need something.
translation: 缺什么就告诉我。

original: Be back soon! And bring more caps!
translation: 赶快回来！多带瓶盖！

original: I'll be watching you.
translation: 我盯着你呢。

original: Careful out there.
translation: 小心。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: <grunts>
translation: <嘟囔>

original: Come back soon!
translation: 迟点见！

original: See you next time!
translation: 下次见！

original: I suppose there's no chance for a nice conversation today, is there.
translation: 我猜今天没机会好好聊天了，对吧。

original: Well... Good talking with you, boy, as always.
translation: 好吧……很高兴和你谈，小子，一如既往。

original: I'm fine, okay?
translation: 我很好，行了吧？

original: Umm... okay. Bye.
translation: 唔……好吧。再见。

original: You're the boss, man. We can talk about it later, if you want.
translation: 听你的，哥们。我们回头再聊，如果你想谈的话。

original: Sounds like a good plan.
translation: 听起来像一个好计划。

original: You know you can rely on me for that.
translation: 你知道在那方面你能信任我。

original: Okay... if you insist.
translation: 好吧……如果你坚持。

original: You have yourself a fine day, madam.
translation: 祝你今天愉快，女士。

original: If there's anything you require further feel free to ask, madam.
translation: 如果你还有什么需要，请尽管开口，女士。

original: I'll be sure and tidy up while you're away, madam.
translation: 我会在你走后收拾的，女士。

original: Bah! I'm going back to doin'... what I was doin'...
translation: 呸！我要回去做……我本该做的事……

original: Forget it! You too dumb to talk to.
translation: 算了吧！我不要和你这样的笨蛋说话了。

original: Yeah, me too.
translation: 嗯，我也是。

original: Bye-bye.
translation: 再见。

original: See you later, alligator.
translation: 回头见，丑鬼。

original: See you.
translation: 再见。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Bye.
translation: 再见。

original: Later.
translation: 回头见。

original: ...could have sworn I saw some movement back there.
translation: ……我发誓看到那后面有东西在动。

original: One two... got a bullet for you...
translation: 一、二……赏你颗子弹……

original: Let's go, you hairy fucks. I ain't got all day.
translation: 来呀，你这长毛杂种。我都闲了一天了。

original: Fuckin' Yao Guai.
translation: 他妈的妖怪。

original: Get out here, 'Guai. I got a present for you.
translation: 滚到这来，妖怪。我有礼物给你。

original: Come on out, you smelly bastards.
translation: 滚出来，你这臭杂种。

original: I thought I heard something over here...
translation: 我好像听到了什么声音……

original: Yoohoo! Yao Guai! C'mon out!
translation: 啊哈！妖怪！滚出来！

original: I knew we should've never let him in. Said so at the time.
translation: 我觉得我们就不应该让他进来。那时候就该这么说。

original: Don't get me wrong, I love to cause trouble, but you go too far.
translation: 别误会，我确实喜欢惹麻烦，但是你太夸张了。

original: You've changed. I mean, bad is one thing. Evil is another.
translation: 你已经变了。我的意思，坏是一回事。邪恶是另一回事。

original: Did you really have to kill all of those people back there? They didn't seem so bad.
translation: 你真的要回去杀光那里的所有人？他们看起来并不坏。

original: I always knew that you were a teacher's pet.
translation: 我一直知道你是老师的最爱。

original: This do-gooder crap is for the birds.
translation: 这些不切实际的大道理只能骗骗小孩。

original: Man, you're just a little goody two-shoes, aren't you?
translation: 哥们，你真是个伪君子，不是吗？

original: I need some shades or something...
translation: 我需要找个太阳镜之类的……

original: Man, it stinks. The vault never smelled like this.
translation: 哥们，真臭。避难所从没臭成这样。

original: Be cautious.
translation: 小心。

original: I wonder what Eulogy is doing...
translation: 不知道尤勒基在干嘛……

original: I'm bored.
translation: 我很无聊。

original: Goddamn cigarettes are getting' harder to find.
translation: 该死的香烟，真他妈难找。

original: Man... am I out of smokes again?
translation: 不是吧……我又没烟抽了吗？

original: I could use a smoke.
translation: 我想抽支烟。

original: Goddamn collar on this armor is too tight...
translation: 妈的，装甲的领子太紧了……

original: Man, it stinks in here.
translation: 哦，真臭。

original: I'm concerned about this area.
translation: 这地方让我很紧张。

original: Sir, I am on the lookout.
translation: 长官，我正密切留意。

original: Be vigilant.
translation: 警惕点。

original: <bored grunt>
translation: <无聊嘟囔>

original: Huh?
translation: 啊？

original: Nothing like the smell of apple pie, is there? I can't get enough of it.
translation: 没有什么能比得上苹果派的味道，是吗？我总是吃不够。

original: Kill!
translation: 杀啊！

original: Die!
translation: 去死！

original: Never!
translation: 绝不！

original: Pain!
translation: 痛苦吧！

original: Again!
translation: 再来啊！

original: Stop you!
translation: 站住！

original: Human!
translation: 人类！

original: Yeeargh!
Raaagghh!
Raaarr!
Agghh!
Arrggh!
Gary!
translation: 加里！

original: Ga-Gaaary!
Aaah! Aaaah!
Slavers! Kill this asshole!
translation: 奴隶贩子！杀了这混蛋！

original: Eulogy wants this one's head!
translation: 尤勒基想要这家伙的脑袋！

original: I've had enough of you!
translation: 我不能再容忍你了！

original: Vengeance is mine!
translation: 我要复仇！

original: Revenge is sweet!
translation: 复仇是甜蜜的！

original: Imprison me will you?!
translation: 你要监禁我？！

original: Freedom!

original: Buggered off, eh? Fine. I was done playing with you anyway.
translation: 离开了，嗯？很好。我也玩够了。

original: That's right! Don't mess with me!
translation: 没错！不要和我作对！

original: This can't be happening. This just can't be happening.
translation: 这不可能发生。这绝不可能发生。

original: Slippery humans.
translation: 狡猾的人类。

original: Damn... I was hopin' for a fight.
translation: 该死……我还盼能打上一架。

original: Threat analysis: green. No hostiles detected.
translation: 威胁等级：绿色。未检测到敌人。

original: I hope I didn't hurt your feelings with all that shooting and flaming. I'm afraid it's just the way I was programmed.
translation: 我希望所有的冲突并未伤害到你的感情。我担心这只是程序设计使然。

original: Search complete. No hostiles detected. Standing down.
translation: 搜索完成。未检测到敌人。解除戒备。

original: This battlefield now belongs to Uncle Sam!
translation: 这战地现在属于山姆大叔！

original: I guess we ran 'em off.
translation: 我想他们被赶走了。

original: There you are!
translation: 你在这！

original: There you are!
translation: 你在这！

original: There you are!
translation: 你在这！

original: Target sighted!
translation: 发现目标！

original: You can't hide!
translation: 你躲不了的！

original: Aha!
translation: 啊哈！

original: Haha, Gary!
translation: 哈哈，加里！

original: Hooo, Gaary!
translation: 吼，加里！

original: There you is!
translation: 你在那里！

original: Here he is!
translation: 他在这！

original: Here she is!
translation: 她在这！

original: We're all going to die!
translation: 我们都会死的！

original: Got him!
translation: 抓住他了！

original: Zombie, over there. I see you!
translation: 丧尸，在那。我看到你了！

original: Positive contact near the Archives!
translation: 在档案馆附近与敌接触！

original: <screaming in fear>
translation: <惊声尖叫>

original: Spotted, over there!
translation: 已捕获，在那！

original: There you are!
translation: 你在这！

original: Positive ID on lost target acquired!
translation: 失去的目标已重新获取！

original: Reengaging target!
translation: 重新发动攻击！

original: Target found! Firing!
translation: 发现目标！开火！

original: We've got the target!
translation: 我们发现了目标！

original: Target relocated! Engaging!
translation: 新定位目标位置！出击！

original: There you are, you little bitch.
translation: 在这啊，你这小婊子。

original: Your time just ran out!
translation: 你的气数已尽！

original: Fuckin' hide from me? You're dead!
translation: 他妈的躲着我？你死定了！

original: Ha! Found your sorry ass!
translation: 哈！找到你这可怜虫了！

original: Thought you could hide?
translation: 你以为能藏得了？

original: I knew it! Oh I'm gonna tear you apart!
translation: 我就知道！哦 我要把你撕成碎片！

original: Ha ha! I found you!
translation: 哈哈！我找到你了！

original: I've got him. Rally on me.
translation: 我发现他了。跟我来。

original: Target lock acquired. Resuming lethal force neutralization operation.
translation: 目标锁定已获取。继续致命火力压制操作。

original: My search routines are quite advanced, don't you think?
translation: 我的搜索路线很先进，你不这么认为吗？

original: Do not make any further escape attempts, lawbreaker.
translation: 别想再次逃跑，违法者！

original: Your worthless hide is mine!
translation: 你的躲藏毫无意义！

original: So are you going to let me kill you now, or are you going to run away again?
translation: 你是等着现在被我杀掉，抑或要再次撒腿就跑？

original: Over here!
translation: 在这！

original: That's not going to work on me.
translation: 那对我可不奏效。

original: I'm not falling for that.
translation: 我可不会听信那事。

original: Yeah, like you could manage that. You really don't know shit about how we work, do you? But if you're that serious...
translation: 嗯，就像你能应付一样。你对我们怎么工作根本一无所知，不是吗？但如果你是认真的话……

original: I've got some I keep for myself in case there's an accident or something. Will you shut up about this if I give some to you?
translation: 为预防突发事故或者类似状况，我自己还留着些。如果我把它分些给你，你能保证不外传吗？

original: This kind of crap gets around, you know. You try bullying too many people, and it's going to cost you.
translation: 这种事四处传播，你知道的。你试图恐吓太多人，你就会付出代价的。

original: You don't have to lie to make me feel better. I know it's a dumb joke. We don't really tell them to laugh with them - more to laugh at them.
translation: 你不必为了让我好受点而撒谎，我知道这笑话很蠢。与其说是我们让人们跟着它笑 — 不如说是让人们嘲笑它的愚蠢。

original: They're more like a tradition. Most of them were passed down from this book we found down back, called "Vault Boy's Big Book of Laughs for Kids".
translation: 它们更像一种传统。它们大多数是来自我们过去发现的一本书，叫什么“避难所男孩的儿科笑话大全”。

original: They're not really funny, but something about hearing them is a little comforting, you know?
translation: 它们并非真的有趣，但是听听它们有安抚的作用，你懂吗？

original: No. Because I don't trust you.
translation: 不。因为我不信任你。

original: She's a jerk, but she's still one of us.
translation: 她是个蠢货，但她仍是我们中一员。

original: I don't want to talk about it with you.
translation: 我不想与你谈那事。

original: No! I'm not supposed to go outside with strangers!
translation: 不！我不应该和陌生人外出！

original: Sorry friend. You oughta keep better track of your loved ones.
translation: 很抱歉，朋友。你更应该跟紧你的爱人。

original: My only secret is patience. If I could share it with you, I would.
translation: 我唯一的秘密就是耐心。如果我能与你分享的话，我会的。

original: Your voice stress patterns indicate you are telling a falsehood. This is in violation of Protocol NC-01.
translation: 你话语中的重音模式显示了你正在撒谎。这违反了NC-01协议。

original: I'm sorry. You have now exceeded 2 demerits. Now instituting Expulsion Protocol KL-001.
translation: 很抱歉。你已超过2次记过。现在开始执行驱逐协议KL-001。

original: I'm sorry, your voice stress patterns indicate you are telling a falsehood. This is in violation of Protocol NC-01.
translation: 很抱歉，你话语中的重音模式显示了你正在撒谎。这违反了NC-01协议。

original: One demerit will now be issued. Note that further demerits can cause your expulsion from this job posting.
translation: 现在记过一次。请注意，再记过可能导致你被从当前岗位开除。

original: As previously stated, please identify yourself.
translation: 如前所述，请表明你的身份。

original: You're... You're lying! He may be crazy, but he'd never try to destroy the Vault like this!
translation: 你……你在撒谎！他或许很疯狂，但他绝不会去破坏避难所的！

original: Only an outsider would do something like that. Someone like... you!
translation: 只有一个外来人会做出这样的事。就是……像你这样的家伙！

original: I'd deal with you myself, except these people are going to need someone to watch out for them out there.
translation: 我想亲自对付你，不过这些人需要有人照看。

original: As for you... You can stay down here and die, for all I care. If you ever talk to me again out there, I'll kill you.
translation: 至于你……你可以留在这等死，那与我无关。可如果你到了外面再找我废话，我会杀了你。

original: But we don't want to give up the safety of the Vault. We just want to end its isolation.
translation: 但我们不想放弃避难所的安全。我们只想终止它与世隔绝。

original: That's what you and my father don't seem to understand!
translation: 那是你和你父亲不明白的地方！

original: But we can't stay isolated forever, or eventually all we'll have left is a handful of inbred remnants!
translation: 但我们不能永远与世隔绝，不然最后我们只会剩下一帮近亲交配的后代了。

original: You may think Vault security is just bunch of chubby guys in padded helmets, but I promise you, most of them aren't as friendly as you remember.
translation: 你或许认为避难所警卫都是一些套着头盔的胖家伙，但我可以肯定的对你说，他们中的多数并不像你印象中的那么友善。

original: Don't worry about it; I won't tell the Overseer if you won't. To tell the truth, I'm glad she did.
translation: 别担心。如果你不做，我是不会告诉监督者的。告诉你实话，我很高兴她的所为。

original: Heck, maybe you can even put all this trouble to rest once and for all.
translation: 见鬼，或许你甚至可以一劳永逸地解决所有麻烦。

original: Even they aren't foolish enough to destroy their homes just to prove a point. It could only have been you!
translation: 即使是他们，也没蠢到为证明这点而毁坏自己的家园。这只有你才做的出！

original: How many of them do you think will survive out there? Still, better a few of them stay alive out there than have them all die down here.
translation: 你认为去到外面，他们有多少人能幸存下来？然而，就算幸存者很少也比全部在这等死好。

original: The evacuation will begin immediately. But you won't be joining them outside. I'll see to that myself!
translation: 立即开始疏散。但你不许在外面与他们汇合。我会盯着的！

original: The previous Overseers were idiots, and we nearly died because of their naivete. I'm simply trying to make up for their mistakes.
translation: 之前的监督者都是白痴，他们的天真差点让我们丧命。我只不过是在补救他们的过错。

original: In a generation or two, no one will remember it ever happened, and we'll still be the safest, purest humans left.
translation: 再过一两代人，没人会记得这一切，我们仍会是最安全、最纯洁的人类。

original: But for that to happen, we can't let ourselves be further tarnished by outsiders.
translation: 但要做到这一点，我们就不能再让自己被外人污染了。

original: We can make more. That's what humanity does. It survives.
translation: 我们可以制造更多。那就是人类的本领。适者生存。

original: No, I'm sorry. I will not force her to awaken. I can't predict the effect it may have on her system.
translation: 不，很抱歉。我不会强迫她醒来。我无法预见那会对她的生理造成什么影响。

original: I'm not stupid, and I'm not falling for your tricks. Forget it!
translation: 我可不蠢，不会上你当的。算了吧！

original: That's sweet of you trying to keep my hopes up, to convince me he's still alive. But I can tell you're not telling me the truth.
translation: 你想着法子叫我相信他还活着，好让我继续满怀希望，这真美好。但我能看出来你没跟我讲实话。

original: Bill's dead, isn't he? Actually, I don't want to hear anymore. Thank you for your help. I need to let the others know what happened to Bill.
translation: 比尔死了，是吗？事实上，我不想再听了。谢谢你的帮忙。我得让其他人知道比尔出了什么事。

original: Here, take these stimpaks. It's all I have.
translation: 给，拿着这些治疗针。我只有这些了。

original: How dare you talk like that! Bill's dead, isn't he?
translation: 你怎么敢那样说！比尔死了，对吗？

original: Actually, I don't want to hear anymore. Thank you for your help. I need to let the others know what happened to Bill.
translation: 事实上，我不想再听了。谢谢你的帮忙。我得让其他人知道比尔出了什么事。

original: Sorry, smoothskin. I can't take the risk. Moriarty will beat the shit out of me for even talking to you!
translation: 很抱歉，光皮肤。我不能冒这险。仅仅是和你说话，莫里亚蒂就会把我打个半死！

original: I'm not buying it. I mean, I know it's scary, but you can't half-ass something like this, you know?
translation: 我不吃这套。我想说，我知道可怕之处，可你不能做什么都这样畏首畏尾，你懂吗？

original: Now, go on out there walk through that Minefield like a real researcher!
translation: 现在，去穿越那片雷区吧，像个真正的研究员那样！

original: I'm not buying it. I mean, I know it's scary, but you can't half-ass something like this, you know?
translation: 我不吃这套。我想说，我知道可怕之处，可你不能做什么都这样畏首畏尾，你懂吗？

original: Now, go on out there walk through that Minefield like a real researcher!
translation: 现在，去穿越那片雷区吧，像个真正的研究员那样！

original: Not an option, I'm afraid. We aren't exactly rolling in cash, down here.
translation: 恐怕，你别无选择。我们并不富足。

original: Last time I checked, I was the man in charge around here. Now get out of my face. I have things to do.
translation: 上次我核实，我是这的老大。现在从我面前消失。我还有事要做。

original: Why can't man follow the ant's example? They work together as a team... every waking moment dedicated to the colony.
translation: 为什么人类不能效仿蚂蚁呢？他们团队般的协作……醒着的每一刻都奉献给蚁群。

original: They require no wealth or material items... everything they need is provided for them by their fellow insects.
translation: 它们对金钱与物质没有追求……它们所需的一切都由昆虫同伴提供。

original: But I digress. If it's payment you need, all I can offer is one of my Mutagenic Bioenhancers.
translation: 但我跑题了。如果你需要报酬，我所能提供的只有我的诱变生物增强剂。

original: If I had a cap for every punk that tried that line on me, I'd be rich.
translation: 如果我能从每个那样对我的废物那得到一个瓶盖，我会变得很富有。

original: Well, I don't give a shit. Take him somewhere else... we're closed.
translation: 与我无关。把他带到别处去……我们关门了。

original: Ha ha. Really now? I'm afraid you aren't as agile tongued as you'd like to think.
translation: 哈哈。真的？我担心你的舌头并非你所想象得那般灵巧。

original: Uh... do I look like I have any money on me? I'm sorry, I can't pay you anything.
translation: 唔……我看起来像是有钱人吗？对不起，我什么也给不了你。

original: Hm? What was that?
translation: 呃？那是什么？

original: Hello? Who's there?
translation: 喂！谁在那？

original: What was that?
translation: 那是什么？

original: I thought I heard something.
translation: 我觉得我听到了什么。

original: Is someone there?
translation: 有人吗？

original: At least I can finally see where I'm going.
translation: 至少我终于能看清是什么情况了。

original: Somethin there?
translation: 那有什么？

original: Hello? Someone there?
translation: 喂？有人吗？

original: No hostiles detected. Continuing perimeter sweep.
translation: 没有侦测到敌人。继续防线巡视。

original: Where are you?
translation: 你在哪？

original: Please step into the open and identify yourself. Law-abiding citizens have nothing to fear.
translation: 请现身并说明你的身份。守法公民无需恐惧。

original: I'm going to look over here now.
translation: 我现在去检查下这边。

original: Are you afraid of me? You should be because I'm going to kick your ass when I find you!
translation: 你是怕了我吗？应该的，因为我一旦发现了你，准会教训你。

original: This is crazy. I'm going to get myself killed.
translation: 这太疯狂了，我会丧命的。

original: I do so enjoy a good hunt!
translation: 我喜欢一场刺激的狩猎！

original: I'll find you, and then you'll be sorry!
translation: 我会找到你，那时候你就该后悔了！

original: I'm growing tired of this little game of ours. Show yourself!
translation: 我开始对这游戏感到厌烦了。快出来！

original: Anybody there?
translation: 有人吗？

original: Where are you?
translation: 你在哪？

original: Hunh? Gary?
translation: 呃？加里？

original: You can't hide from me forever.
translation: 你躲不了一世。

original: Come out, come out, wherever you are!
translation: 快出来，快出来，不论你在哪！

original: Ollie ollie oxen free...
translation: 奥利奥利公牛被放出来了…

original: It's all a big mistake! Come with me and we'll figure it out together!
translation: 这是个彻头彻脑的错误！和我一起来，我们一起来解决

original: Gonna find you soon, human!
translation: 我会尽快找出你的，人类！

original: Here human, human, human. I got a treat for you!
translation: 给，人类，人类，人类。我要款待你！

original: Come out, come out wherever you are! Ha ha!
translation: 快出来，快出来，不论你在哪！哈哈！

original: Alert. Hostile remains at large. Recommend non-combatants seek secure location.
translation: 警告。敌人仍在逃亡。建议非战斗人员寻求庇护。

original: Are you still there?
translation: 你还在那吗？

original: Continuing search for fugitive.
translation: 继续寻找逃亡者。

original: Come on, people, I need a target!
translation: 来吧，大家，我需要个靶子！

original: I do so enjoy a good hunt!
translation: 我喜欢一场刺激的狩猎！

original: I'll find you, and then you'll be sorry!
translation: 我会找出你，然后你就会感到很抱歉的！

original: I'm growing tired of this little game of ours. Show yourself!
translation: 我开始对这游戏感到厌烦了。快出来！

original: I've got something for you...
translation: 我为你准备了些东西……

original: Don't forget to sign out.
translation: 别忘了签退。

original: Gotcha. We'll see you next time... leech...
translation: 抓住你了。我们会再见的……小偷……

original: Try not to break it, outsider.
translation: 小心别打破，外来者。

original: You must come back soon.
translation: 有空再来。

original: It's been a pleasure doing business.
translation: 做生意令人快乐。

original: Enjoy your meal.
translation: 慢慢吃啊。

original: You done? Good.
translation: 吃完了？好的。

original: That it?
translation: 完了？

original: Enjoy!
translation: 玩得愉快！

original: Come back if you're still hungry!
translation: 饿了再来！

original: See you soon, drunky.
translation: 回头见，醉鬼。

original: Come back when you're sober.
translation: 酒醒了再来吧。

original: That should liquor you up for a while.
translation: 那应该够你喝一顿了。

original: Come back anytime!
translation: 随时欢迎再来！

original: Enjoy the drinks.
translation: 畅饮愉快。

original: Enjoy the ride.
translation: 旅途愉快。

original: You'll be higher that a fucking kite.
translation: 你会比一只该死的风筝还高。

original: Good hunting!
translation: 祝好收获！

original: Don't hurt yourself!
translation: 别伤着自己！

original: You'll shoot your eye out!
translation: 你会射到自己的眼睛的！

original: Come again! I should have more stuff in soon.
translation: 欢迎再来！我应该很快就补充货物了。

original: Always a grab bag with my stuff, see?
translation: 我的货里总有个摸彩袋，看见了吧？

original: Come back later. Never know when I'll get another big find!
translation: 欢迎再来。天知道我什么时候又有大发现！

original: What wonderful items for the Museum of Dave!
translation: 对戴夫博物馆来说，这是绝佳的物品！

original: Yeah, yeah. I hope you choke on it.
translation: 嗯，嗯。你怎么不呛死。

original: Don't like your deal? Tough shit.
translation: 对你的交易不满？活该。

original: No refunds, asshole.
translation: 恕不退款，混蛋。

original: Let me know if you need anything else.
translation: 如果你还有什么其他需要就告诉我。

original: A pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 和你做交易很开心。

original: Another satisfied customer.
translation: 又一个满意而归的顾客。

original: Give me a shout if you need anything else.
translation: 如果你还有什么其他需要就吱一声。

original: Thanks.
translation: 谢谢。

original: This is madness...
translation: 这太疯狂了……

original: This isn't right.
translation: 这可不对。

original: This is what we've come to.
translation: 这是我们此行的目的。

original: So much violence in the world these days.
translation: 最近这世道啊，太多暴力了。

original: Yeah! Awesome!
translation: 耶！棒极了！

original: Fight!
translation: 打啊！

original: Ain't none of my business!
translation: 与我无关！

original: Get out of here.
translation: 从这出去。

original: Time for you to go.
translation: 你该走了。

original: I'm locking up, so you'll need to leave.
translation: 我要关门了，你必须走了。

original: We stand now at the precipice.
translation: 我们现在站在悬崖边上。

original: This is the Overseer.
translation: 我是监督者。

original: This is the Overseer.
translation: 我是监督者。

original: Outside of the Pitt, the world lies in ruins and survivors scratch in the dirt without dreams. But in the Pitt, we can live and rebuild with purpose.
translation: 匹兹堡外边，世界一片废墟，幸存者们在尘土中苟延残喘，没有梦想。但在匹兹堡，我们可以活着，有目的地重建家园。

original: <unintelligible>
translation: <莫明其妙的>

original: All peace-loving peoples must join together to stop the war of aggression being waged by the Wall Street gang!
translation: 所有热爱和平的人民应当紧密团结起来，遏制由华尔街罪恶组织发动的侵略战争！

original: What's up Wastelanders? This is Three Dog, and you're listening to GNR! That's Galaxy News Radio, in case you forgot...
translation: 废土人，最近过得咋样？这里是三狗，你正在收听的是银新台！全称银河新闻电台，免得有人忘了……

original: This is Tenpenny Tower radio, music and inspiring talk for forward thinking people.
translation: 这是特佩尼大厦电台，献给超前思想人士的音乐与鼓舞人心的对话。

original: Did you know -- the Vault-Tec/RobCo partnership is considered the most successful joint venture in the history of American industry?
translation: 你知道吗——避难所科技/RobCo的合作被公认为是美利坚工业史上最成功的合资。

original: You can't be serious.
translation: 你是开玩笑吧。

original: Yeah, right. I'm not holding out hope for the cavalry to come save the world.
translation: 嗯，没错。我对装甲兵拯救世界早已不抱幻想了。

original: I hope you're right. I really do. But after 200 years, don't you think they'd have done something by now?
translation: 我希望你是对的。我真的希望。但你不觉得200年来他们应该已经做了些什么吗？

original: "We have come from God and unto him we shall return..."
translation: “我们自主而来，亦将复归主去……”

original: Well, okay. But you better not be lying, or else we'll shoot you.
translation: 好吧。你最好别撒谎，不然我们把你射成马蜂窝。

original: Well, okay. But you better not be lying, or else we'll shoot you.
translation: 好吧。你最好别撒谎，不然我们把你射成马蜂窝。

original: Okay, if you say so...
translation: 好吧，如果你这么说……

original: Come on. Let's get the gate open for you, mungo.
translation: 来吧。我来把门给你打开，毛人。

original: You sure about that? It's scary in there. Even I don't like going in there, and I'm really brave.
translation: 你确定吗？那很可怕的，像我这么勇敢的人都不会轻易去。

original: Nuh-uh. Door works fine. Computer's broke.
translation: 不。门没问题，电脑坏了。

original: Well, maybe not broke, but it sure don't work right. I turned it off because it was just wasting power.
translation: 嗯，或许不是坏了，但现在确实不能用。我把它关上了，不然纯粹是在浪费电。

original: Outside of Megaton? Any place other than here sounds like heaven to me. Fuck this place.
translation: 兆吨镇以外的地方？除了这以外的任何地方对我来说都是天堂。这鬼地方。

original: If it weren't for you Wasteland types coming through with your caps, I'd be out of here in a second. Assuming that I could convince Jenny and Leo.
translation: 要不是你们这些废土人带着瓶盖路过这，我立马就走。前提是我能说服珍妮和利奥的话。

original: I spent a lot of time out there and I've left a lot of ghosts in my path. Some of them, well... they're coming a bit close to catching up to me.
translation: 我在那度过了很长时间，枪下也添了不少冤魂。当中有些人，唉……差点就把我干掉了。

original: I've said just about all I'm going to say about that.
translation: 我要说的已经全说了。

original: It's called "The Wasteland" for a reason. But there are settlements, too, spread all around. The human race is stubborn like that.
translation: 这被称作“废土”是有原因的。但到处都有新的定居点，人类就是这么顽强。

original: To the south you got Rivet City, but don't bother going to D.C. The place is a warzone.
translation: 往南走你能找到铆钉城，但没事别去特区，那是战区。

original: It's a hole. A dead end. So why do I stay? Well... it's a hole that makes me money.
translation: 这是个破坑。一条死路。那我为什么还留在这？哼……这是个能让我赚钱的坑。

original: Stay the fuck out of me business, don't go where you don't belong, and buy your drinks here. That's all you need to know.
translation: 少他妈掺和老子的事，别去不该去的地方，要喝酒就这儿掏钱。这就是你该知道的。

original: Some people hate this place, but I guess that's their right, what the hell do they want out of life? Food, shelter and safety. Works for me.
translation: 有些人讨厌这，但我想他们有权讨厌。除了活下去以外他们还想要什么？吃的，住的，还有安全感，至少对我是这样。

original: Are you joking? Yes, there's a bar -- The Brass Lantern. It's easy to find since you're standing in it.
translation: 你开玩笑吧？是的，有个酒吧 — 黄铜灯。它很好找，因为你正站在里面。

original: I apologize, but I cannot encourage the consumption of alcohol. Alcohol impedes our personal quest for the Grand Division.
translation: 抱歉，但我不鼓励喝酒。酒精会妨碍到我们执行防卫的任务。

original: Sure is -- Moriarty's. The entrance is on the top level, opposite the Main Gate.
translation: 当然有 — 莫里亚蒂那。入口在最上层，正对着兆吨镇的大门。

original: Just be careful. Moriarty is NOT your friend, no matter what he may say, so don't fall for his lies. And for god's sake, don't trust the man.
translation: 只是要当心，不管莫里亚蒂说什么，他都不会成为你的朋友，所以别被他的谎话骗了。看在上帝的份上，别相信那人。

original: Seek out Moira at Craterside Supply, although the true pilgrim relies on Atom to supply all that he needs.
translation: 去坑边杂货店找莫伊拉，尽管一个真正的信徒会仰仗原子来满足他需要的一切。

original: Moira sells all kinds of stuff at her place, Craterside Supply. Take a guess where it is? Heh heh heh heh.
translation: 莫伊拉的店，坑边杂货店，里面什么都卖。猜猜在哪吧？呵呵呵呵。

original: Seek out Moira at Craterside Supply. She's a darling girl.
translation: 去坑边杂货店找莫伊拉。她可是个可爱的女孩。

original: You'll want to see Doc Church next to the Crater. Take your time.
translation: 你可以去找弹坑边的丘奇博士。不用着急。

original: Atom can only heal the wounds of the soul. For wounds of the body, you should see Doc Church. His clinic is directly to the north the Church.
translation: 原子教只能医治灵魂上的创伤。肉体上的，你得去找丘奇博士。他的诊所在弹坑正北方。

original: Our clinic is down in the crater, by the bomb. Doc Church is a little rough around the edges, but the man's got talent and compassion.
translation: 我们的诊所在弹坑边，核弹旁。丘奇博士可能会稍微有点粗暴，不过他挺聪明，也挺热心。

original: You'll want to see Doc Church next to the Crater. You can't miss it.
translation: 你可以去找弹坑边的丘奇博士，很容易找到的。

original: My God... It's you. The little baby boy, all grown up. Persistent little bastard, ain't ya? Then and now, it would seem. It's been a long time, kid.
translation: 我的天啊……是你。小男孩彻底长大了，都成了小帅哥了。估计以后会越来越帅。时间过得真快，孩子。

original: Oh, your daddy passed through here, all right. Here and gone. Got what he came for, and then left. I'm assuming you'll do the same, correct?
translation: 哦，你父亲来过这，是的。来了又走了。得到了他想要的随后就离开了。我猜你跟他一样，对吧？

original: My God... It's you. The little baby girl, all grown up. Persistent little flower, ain't ya? Then and now, it would seem. It's been a long time, kid.
translation: 我的天啊……是你。小女孩彻底长大了，都成了小美女了。估计以后会越来越美。时间过得真快，孩子。

original: Oh, your daddy passed through here, all right. Here and gone. Got what he came for, and then left. I'm assuming you'll do the same, correct?
translation: 哦，你父亲来过这，是的。来了又走了，得到了他想要的随后就离开了。我猜你跟他一样，对吧？

original: Oh, yeah! I do remember a guy like that.
translation: 哦，耶！我确实记得这样一个人。

original: Honestly, I usually keep my head down. I tend to get smacked around if I look customers in the eyes. But talk to Moriarty, he'll know more.
translation: 坦白说，平时我都是低着头的，如果盯着顾客看我会被揍的。去找莫里亚蒂谈吧，他知道得更多。

original: I can't talk about that anymore. Moriarty will beat me again if I do.
translation: 我不能跟你多说，否则莫里亚蒂又会打我了。

original: Not in here, I haven't.
translation: 我没见过。

original: Many of the transient visitors end up at one of Megaton's seedier establishments.
translation: 很多匆匆的旅行者都最后选择在兆吨镇的某个破房子里定居了。

original: I suggest you speak to Colin Moriarty and continue your search there.
translation: 你要想继续找寻，我建议去科林·莫里亚蒂那。

original: Oh man, you're looking for your dad? That is so sweet! Did he run out on you when you were a kid or something?
translation: 哦，伙计，你在找你父亲？听起来真亲切！他在你还是个孩子的时候就抛下你走了吗？

original: Our parents died when we were kids. My brother Leo, he's the oldest, he raised my brother Andy and me. It was hard on him, but we turned out okay.
translation: 我们的父母在我们还小的时候就死了。我的哥哥利奥，他是家里最大的了，抚养安迪和我长大。对他来说这很不容易，但我们还是活下来了。

original: But God, you don't want to hear about that. I'm sorry, but I haven't seen your dad. He didn't eat at the Brass Lantern. I'd remember if he did.
translation: 可是，天啊，你不会希望听到这些的。我很抱歉，我没见过你父亲。他没在黄铜灯里吃过饭，否则我会知道有那么个人的。

original: I usually avoid most of the Wasteland types that come through here, but there was one guy.
translation: 一般我不愿意跟那些从废土来这的人打交道，但有一个人例外。

original: Unlike most of the wannabe heroes that come in, he looked like he could actually read a book without giving himself a headache.
translation: 跟那些梦想成为英雄的人不同，他看上去能静下心来读一本书而不会感到头疼。

original: He spent a bunch of time at Moriarty's before moving on. I'd try talking to Colin.
translation: 他离开之前在莫里亚蒂那待了好一阵子，去找科林谈谈看吧。

original: I usually avoid most of the Wasteland types that come through here, but there was one guy.
translation: 一般我不愿意跟那些从废土来这的人打交道，但有一个人例外。

original: Unlike most of the wannabe heroes that come in, he looked like he could actually read a book without giving himself a headache.
translation: 跟那些梦想成为英雄的人不同，他看上去能静下心来读一本书而不会感到头疼。

original: He spent a bunch of time at Moriarty's before moving on. I'd try talking to Colin.
translation: 他离开之前在莫里亚蒂那待了好一阵子，去找科林谈谈看吧。

original: Well, come to think of it, I do remember a stranger coming through here. Had a look in his eye. You know the kind a man gets when he's got a purpose.
translation: 细想一下的话，我确实记得有个外来人来过。我注意到他的眼神。你知道当人怀有某种目的的时候眼神是特别的。

original: Spent some time up in the saloon. Might want to check with Moriarty. Just watch yourself. That man's trouble.
translation: 在酒馆待了一会，或许你可以去问问莫里亚蒂，但你自己要当心，那家伙可不好惹。

original: Could be the guy I saw at Moriarty's Saloon not too long ago. I'd ask there.
translation: 可能是不久之前我在莫里亚蒂的酒馆里见到的那个人。你去那问问。

original: So that's the way it's gonna be, huh? That's fine. That's fine...
translation: 那就这样了，嗯？好吧，很好……

original: Just as long as we understand each other. This here is my town. These are my people. You so much as breathe wrong, and I'm gonna fuckin' end ya.
translation: 只要我们彼此明白就好。这是我的镇子，他们是我的镇民。你要是敢惹麻烦，我就他妈的干掉你。

original: Go see Moira at Craterside Supply. She sells some weapons. Makes some too, from what I hear. Her place is down by the crater.
translation: 去坑边补给点找莫伊拉。她有些武器卖，我还听说她也自己制作一些。她的店就在下面的弹坑边。

original: You'll probably want to see Moira at Craterside Supply. She sells some weapons. Makes some too, from what I hear. Her place is down by the crater.
translation: 你或许应该去坑边杂货店找莫伊拉。她有些武器卖，我还听说她也自己制作一些。她的店就在下面的弹坑边。

original: Well I'll be! I could have sworn I heard this corpse speak! But that's impossible. Dead men don't talk, do they? They LISTEN. They OBEY.
translation: 活见鬼了！我发誓刚才听见这具腐尸说话了！但这不可能啊。死人不会说话，对吧？他们只该听着，只会服从。

original: Food, Jericho. It's all I had for you yesterday. It's all I have for you today. It's all I'll ever have for you.
translation: 食物，耶利哥。这是我昨天能为你准备的，这也是我今天能为你准备的，这同样会是我以后能为你准备的。

original: Yeah, Leo... what do you need?
translation: 嗯，利奥……你想要什么？

original: What is it, Leo?
translation: 怎么了，利奥？

original: Oh, heya Nathan. Sorry, I got lost in my work. What do you need?
translation: 哦，嗨呀，内森。抱歉我光忙自己的了。你需要什么？

original: You said we could take that trip. Up north, you know? To see one of the old towns? Come on, dad, you promised...
translation: 你说过我们可以去旅行的。去北方，你知道吗？去看一个古老的城镇？拜托了，爸爸，你答应过的……

original: We still haven't built that model, you know. The Corvega? You told me we could do it this weekend...
translation: 你知道吗，我们还没做好那个模型。那辆科维加？你跟我说过我们这周末可以的……

original: I set that special wine aside for you. The one you said makes you really... uninhibited.
translation: 我把那种特别的酒放在你边上了，就是你说的那种使你……天不怕地不怕的。

original: You look beautiful today, Nova. Just like always.
translation: 你今天看上去真漂亮，诺瓦。一如往常。

original: Now, I know you've turned me down before, but I'm gonna ask again -- what would you think about goin' out sometime?
translation: 现在，我知道你之前拒绝过我，但我还想再问一次 — 你愿意找个时间和我一起出去吗？

original: I heard something about you, boy. I heard that you was a scout for the Raiders, here to recoin.. recon... err... check out our defenses. That true?
translation: 我听说过你的事，小子，我听说你是那些掠夺者派来的探子，到这来刺……刺……嗯，刺探我们的防卫情况，没错吧？

original: Yeah. Good idea. Not gonna happen.
translation: 嗯，好主意。没事的。

original: And where do you propose that we pick one of those up? We'd have to pay the caravan scavengers, and who knows what they'd bring back.
translation: 你觉得我们去哪能找个商队保镖来？我们要付钱拾荒人，但谁知道他们会有什么贡献。

original: Sure thing! ... you miserable drunken asshole ...
translation: 没问题！……你这烂醉如泥的混蛋……

original: One more drink, coming up! ... shitbird ...
translation: 再来一杯，快点！……傻鸟……

original: We should stay our course, dearest husband. Atom's power penetrates us all, does it not? Soon, every soul of Megaton will revel in His glory!
translation: 我们应该坚持下去，亲爱的老公。原子的力量会渗透我们所有人，对吧？很快，兆吨镇的每个灵魂都会陶醉于他的光辉之下。

original: Do not despair, dearest husband. Soon, all of Megaton will bask in Atom's glow.
translation: 别灰心，亲爱的老公。很快，兆吨镇的一切都会沐浴在原子的光辉下。

original: Always with the nagging... I'll do what I do when I do it, woman.
translation: 别老是唠叨……我知道什么时候该干嘛，女人。

original: Who told you that?
translation: 谁告诉你的？

original: Me? A Raider? Are you joking? I'm not a Raider! I've never even met a Raider before!
translation: 你说我？掠夺者？你开玩笑吧？我不是掠夺者！我甚至都没见过掠夺者！

original: I'm not a Raider! I swear! Who told you that? They're lying!
translation: 我发誓，我不是掠夺者！谁告诉你的？他们撒谎！

original: Me? Working with Raiders? Hell no! I just want to get a place here in Megaton, and I'll kill any Raider who shows up here to prove it!
translation: 我？为掠夺者工作？瞎说！我只是要在兆吨镇找个住处，我愿意干掉闯入这里的掠夺者来证明！

original: Oh! Sorry, I guess I got ahead of myself, huh? Maggie's nine, sweetest little girl you'd ever care to meet. We take care of each other.
translation: 哦！抱歉，我只顾自言自语了，呃？玛姬只有九岁，一个你肯定想见见的可爱小女孩，她和我相依为命。

original: I ain't never had a daughter, but if I did, I'd want her to be Maggie. I took her in when her parents got killed by Raiders. That was two years ago.
translation: 我没有过女儿，但如果有的话，我希望就是玛姬。在她父母被歹徒杀害以后我收养了她，那是两年前的事了。

original: It was a pretty bad scene. Small settlement up north. I'd stopped in to trade some salvage, and the whole place had been wiped out.
translation: 当时可是一片惨象。北面有一块小型定居点，我曾到那去倒卖废品，却发现那已被屠戮一空。

original: I found Maggie hiding under a bed, in the same room where her parents had been butchered. We've been together ever since.
translation: 我发现玛姬藏在床底下，就在她父母被屠杀的那间房子里。从那以后，我们一直生活在一起。

original: Please, do what you can to find my brother.
translation: 求你了，尽你所能找到我的兄弟。

original: Hey, thanks again for doing this for me, it means a lot.
translation: 嗨，再次感谢你为我们做的这些，对我们很重要。

original: Remember, my offer still stands.
translation: 记住，我的提议仍然有效。

original: The Family has become our moniker because that is exactly what we are... related by blood.
translation: 家族成为了我们的绰号，正因为我们是为了……该死的血液而活。

original: Even if all of us look different on the outside, we all have had the same vice infesting our insides.
translation: 即便我们外表并不相同，但同样的邪恶在我们体内滋长。

original: But now, through my teachings, these subjugated people have come together and formed a bond stronger than mere friendship.
translation: 但现在，在我的教导之下，这些顺民被一种比友谊更强的纽带维系在一起。

original: I haven't seen any of the Wests since we were told to head indoors.
translation: 我自从被告知待在屋里后，就再没见过任何维斯特家的人。

original: Nope. Everyone stays inside, except Evan King of course.
translation: 没有，所有人都待在屋里，当然除了埃万·金。

original: If I recall he and the boys are probably at the lake fishing. Those rapscallions! There's no telling what monkeyshines they'll get into next!
translation: 如果没记错他和那群人应该在湖边打鱼。那群流氓！谁知道他们下一步会做出什么来！

original: I had always assumed if a human happened upon our home, it would be for the purpose of our extermination.
translation: 我一直以为如果有人类接近我们的家，就是来屠杀我们的。

original: It appears my fears were ill-placed. It is a pleasant surprise to meet someone as amenable as yourself.
translation: 看来我的担心是错误的。能碰见像你这样通情达理的人真是让人惊奇。

original: Very well. I will allow you to speak to Ian. Perhaps you can help him come to grips with his greatest enemy. Himself.
translation: 很好，我会让你去找伊恩谈。或许你能帮他对付他最大的敌人。他自己。

original: I believe I was very clear when I said you are not welcome to see him.
translation: 我想我说的很清楚了，我们不欢迎你去见他。

original: Ah yes, my newest charge. What would you want with him?
translation: 啊，是的，那个新来的孩子。你找他做什么？

original: I'm afraid Vance has him in isolation and there's no way I'm going to override Vance's orders.
translation: 恐怕万斯正让他独处，我可不会违抗他的命令。

original: He's a good kid. I think Vance will set him along the correct path soon... like he did for all of us.
translation: 他是个好孩子，我想万斯会引导他走上正路的……就像他引导我们那样。

original: Like I said, he's in isolation. It's his time to meditate and reflect.
translation: 我说过，他在独处，这是他专门用来冥想和反省的时间。

original: Vance has him in meditation right now. No one's supposed to be in there.
translation: 万斯正让他冥想，不许任何人进去。

original: Poor kid... he looks like he could use another friend.
translation: 可怜的孩子……看上去他需要一个朋友。

original: Nope. Like I told ya, Vance has him in meditation right now. No one's supposed to be in there.
translation: 不行，我告诉过你了，万斯正让他冥想，不许任何人进去。

original: I don't have any authority here. I'm pretty new myself.
translation: 我在这没有任何权力，我只是个新人。

original: Justin's been trying to talk to Ian; make him feel better. Maybe you should speak to him.
translation: 贾斯汀正试着跟伊恩谈话使他好过一些。或许你应该去找他。

original: Do I look like a fucking babysitter? I don't know where he is. Even if I did, I wouldn't tell you anyway.
translation: 我他妈的像个保姆吗？我不知道他在哪，就算知道，也绝不会告诉你。

original: Ian, Ian, Ian! Is that all you've got to say? Sheesh.
translation: 伊恩，伊恩，伊恩！你就只会说这些吗？天啊。

original: Ian? What do you want from him?
translation: 伊恩？你找他干嘛？

original: No, just that Vance said he isn't to be disturbed while he's in meditation.
translation: 不，只是万斯说过他在冥想的时候不能被打扰。

original: Moriarty pisses in his still -- crazy bastard thinks it's hilarious. Besides, you'll get your throat cut in that pit. You're much better off here.
translation: 莫里亚蒂往他的酒里撒尿 — 这疯子认为这很搞笑。除此之外，你还可能在他的酒窖里被干掉，所以你最好离开这。

original: Hey, maybe I'll put that on the sign out front: "The Brass Lantern: Cleaner, safer, and less likely to have piss in the drinks".
translation: 嗨，或许我应该在这前面竖块牌子：“黄铜灯：更清洁，更安全，酒里面的尿更少”。

original: People've been sayin' that there's somethin' wrong with the water purifier. But Ol' Walter's been keepin' that thing runnin' for decades.
translation: 人们都说净化器出了什么问题，但老沃尔特已经让那东西连续运转几十年了。

original: I'm not worried. No reason it'd pick now to go down for good... would it?
translation: 我不担心，那东西没理由会在这时候出问题……对吧？

original: I own a saloon, kid. Rumors are part and parcel. So I'll give you this one for free...
translation: 我开着酒馆呢，孩子。闲话就跟常客似的。所以这条免费送你……

original: Not sure if you've met her, but Lucy West, that pretty young thing? She's afraid. Of what, of who, I couldn't say. But you can feel the fear on her.
translation: 不知道你见过她没，露西·维斯特，那个小美女？她很害怕。怕什么，怕谁，我说不上。但你能感觉到她的害怕劲儿。

original: I already told you about the Stahl boy's drug problem. You said you wanted to help.
translation: 我已经告诉过你斯塔尔那孩子嗑药的事了，你说过你会帮忙的。

original: That's about all the confidences I'm going to break for you, stranger.
translation: 这就是所有我能对你敞开的心里话了，陌生人。

original: I ain't heard much. Truth be told, I don't really ever leave the Lantern. Too much work, too few hours in the day, ya know?
translation: 我没听到多少。老实讲，我没什么机会离开黄铜灯，工作太多而时间太少，懂吗？

original: Remember what I told you, kid: Moriarty keeps his money locked up right next to his bed.
translation: 记住我告诉你的，孩子：莫里亚蒂把钱锁在他床头右侧的柜子里。

original: There's only one thing that concerns me in this town these days: what my damn fool husband is doing.
translation: 这几天镇子里唯一让我心烦的事就是：我那该死的白痴老公在干嘛。

original: He wanders around here all day and all night, preaching about the Enclave and tryin' to get parts for his guns.
translation: 他白天晚上都在这附近转来转去，一边向人讲述英克雷的故事，一边收集他那把枪的零件。

original: I'm not sure who's the bigger fool, him or me. After all, I married him.
translation: 我不知道他和我哪个更傻，毕竟，我嫁给了他。

original: I'm not one to gossip, but I do know a few things. For instance, did you hear that Lucas wants someone to disarm our bomb?
translation: 我不是爱说闲话的人，但我确实知道些什么。比如，你听说卢卡斯在找人拆除那核弹吗？

original: Imagine the blasphemy! I can't believe it! I mean, I don't believe it. He would never do that to us.
translation: 那是种侮辱！我无法相信！嗯，我根本不相信！他绝不会对我们做这种事的。

original: I couldn't tell you, really. I'd talk to Manya if you care that much. She's lived in Megaton longer than anyone.
translation: 我真的没法告诉你。如果你那么在意应该去找曼雅，她在兆吨镇里住得比任何人都久。

original: It used to be that you could ask Manya just about anything. Now that she's gone, I don't know what to tell you...
translation: 以前你可以去问曼雅任何事，现在她死了，我不知道我还能告诉你什么……

original: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Oh, kid... ah... I'll let that one go, chalk it up to youthful arrogance.
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！哦，孩子……啊……我就饶了你这次，算是原谅年轻人的傲慢吧。

original: Listen carefully. I don't know what Sheriff Simms told you, but this is my town. Simms, he's a facade. An illusion of order I allow to exist.
translation: 仔细听着，我不知道西姆斯警长跟你说了什么，但这是我统治的镇子。西姆斯，他只是个傀儡，一个我允许存在的傀儡。

original: I was slinging drinks and killing Raiders here in Megaton when the good sheriff was just an idiot kid with cowboy fantasies.
translation: 当那大警长还是个沉迷装扮成牛仔的小屁孩的时候，我就在兆吨镇里买醉和杀掠夺者了。

original: Raise a hand to me, and you'll never leave this town alive. Now, as for your dad... 100 caps, and I sing.
translation: 要你敢对我动手的话，我会让你直着进来，横着出去。至于你父亲的事……100个瓶盖，我就说。

original: Ha ha ha ha ha! God in Heaven, would you listen to yourself? Do you honestly believe that's true? The lies they've put into that head of yours...
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈！天上的主啊，你听听你自己在说什么？你真的相信那是真的吗？他们灌输给你的谎言……

original: Your father brought you to the Vault right after you were born. To keep you safe, you see. I remember it well -- you stayed in my saloon, after all.
translation: 在你出生后不久，你父亲就带你去了避难所。这是为了你的安全，我记得很清楚——你毕竟在我的酒吧里待过。

original: That's right. Your father, his Brotherhood of Steel friend, and you, the suckling babe with nary a tit to suckle. Sorry about your mum. Truly.
translation: 是的，你父亲，他钢铁兄弟会的朋友，还有你这乳臭未干的小子。至于你的母亲，真的很遗憾。

original: But, no matter. That big round door has opened now, hasn't it? Daddy's gone, and you need to know why. Could be I know where, and why...
translation: 但无所谓，那扇大圆门已经打开了，对吧？父亲出走了，而你想知道为什么，而我则是那个知道他去了哪以及为什么去的人……

original: Ah, temper, temper. And your father was so reserved. Take after our mum, do we? God rest her soul.
translation: 啊，火气，火气，想想你父亲多稳重。是不是像我们的妈妈啊？愿她安息。

original: But at least you've got balls. Yeah, I know your dad, met him when you were just a baby, when you two passed through here on your way to the Vault.
translation: 但至少你有种。嗯，我认识你爸爸，在你还是婴儿的时候就见过他。你们俩去避难所的时候路过这里。

original: You look shocked. You didn't think you were born in that hole, did you? Good Christ, boy. Know the truth, and it will set you free.
translation: 你看上去挺惊讶的。你不会认为自己是在那洞里出生的，对吗？上帝保佑，明白真相会让你解脱的。

original: Ah, temper, temper. And your father was so reserved. Take after our mum, do we? God rest her soul.
translation: 啊，火气，火气，想想你父亲多稳重。是不是像我们的妈妈啊？愿她安息。

original: But at least you've got spunk. Yeah, I know your dad, met him when you were just a baby, when you two passed through here on your way to the Vault.
translation: 但至少你有胆量。嗯，我认识你爸爸，在你还是婴儿的时候就见过他。你们俩去避难所的时候路过这里。

original: You look shocked. You didn't think you were born in that hole, did you? Ah, Lord... Know the truth, and it will set you free.
translation: 你看上去挺震惊的。你不会以为自己是在那洞里出生的吧？啊，上帝……了解真相，就能获得自由。

original: Is that what your father told you? That you were born in that hole? That HE was born there as well?
translation: 你父亲那么跟你说的？说你是在那洞里出生的？而且他也是的？

original: Oh, the lies we tell to those we love.
translation: 哦，我们总是对所爱的人撒谎。

original: Your father brought you to the Vault right after you were born. To keep you safe, you see. I remember it well -- you stayed in my saloon, after all.
translation: 在你出生后不久，你父亲就带你去了避难所。这是为了你的安全，我记得很清楚——你毕竟在我的酒吧里待过。

original: That's right. Your father, his Brotherhood of Steel friend, and you, the suckling babe with nary a tit to suckle. Sorry about your mom. Truly.
translation: 是的，你父亲，他钢铁兄弟会的朋友，还有你这乳臭未干的小子。至于你的母亲，真的很遗憾。

original: But, life goes on. Daddy lied. Life's full of little disappointments. And now... you're all grown up, and wondering where he's gone to...
translation: 但，日子总要过下去。爸爸撒谎了。生活中总是有这样那样的小失望。现在……你长大了，想知道他去哪儿了……

original: Sorry, hon. The noodle stand is closed. If you want something, ask Leo in the restaurant.
translation: 抱歉，亲爱的。面馆关门了。要是你想吃点什么，去饭馆问问利奥吧。

original: Then you best unhear it. I know all about you, old man. I'd be careful before I went around town spreading rumors about Raiders. You dig?
translation: 那你最好什么也没听见。我知道你的一切，老头。在我往镇子上散布掠夺者的传闻前最好小心，你懂了吗？

original: Yeah, well I'm the one accountable for this place -- not you.
translation: 嗯，我是这地方的负责人 — 不是你。

original: All right, all right! Stop your pathetic sniveling and just do what you're fucking told.
translation: 好了，好了！别哭得那么惨了，你他妈的该干嘛就干嘛。

original: Gob? If I hear one more excuse come out of that rotting mouth, I'm going to sew it shut. Okay? There's a good zombie.
translation: 盖博？如果我再听到你那烂嘴里吐出借口，就会把你的嘴缝起来，听到了吗？当个好丧尸就行。

original: Now don't you go getting all mushy on me! We just... We got to look out for each other, right?
translation: 别总来我这撒娇！我们得……我们得互相照料，对不对？

original: Hey, if we ain't going to look out for each other, what's the point? You think Colin gives a shit about us, Gob? Come on, sweetie, wake up.
translation: 嗨，如果我们不互相照顾的话，还能怎样？你难道觉得科林会把我们当回事，盖博？拜托，甜心，醒醒。

original: It's important, Leo! I have to keep our head above water here. Please, just try to be more careful.
translation: 这很重要，利奥！我不能让我们欠债，拜托，尽量小心。

original: I hear things. I know a few people. What of it?
translation: 我听说过一些事，也知道一些人。怎么了？

original: Aw, Nova. I'd do anything for you. Well... I don't want to keep you. You're always so busy and...
translation: 哦，诺瓦。我愿意为你做任何事，嗯……我不会一直打扰你的，你一向很忙而且……

original: Anything for you, Nova. Anytime.
translation: 诺瓦，愿意效劳，随时都行。

original: Will you? Well, good luck with that. So far as I know, I'm the only one your Dad told where he was going.
translation: 真的？好吧，祝你好运。据我所知，我是你爸爸唯一告诉过他要去哪的人。

original: So, when you change your mind, come see me. I'm usually at the saloon. 100 caps... Daddy wouldn't think twice if it were you out there...
translation: 那好，如果你改变主意了，就来找我。我通常都在酒吧里。100个瓶盖……如果失踪的是你，你父亲可不会为这犹豫的……

original: Excellent! Your dad raised a smart kid. Really no substitute for the love of a father, now is there?
translation: 很好！你父亲有个很聪明的孩子。父爱的确是无价的，不是吗？

original: Speaking of dear old dad, he went southeast, into D.C. to the Galaxy News Radio station. Good luck now.
translation: 你亲爱的爸爸，他往东南方到特区去了，目的地是银河新闻电台，祝你好运。

original: All right, kid. Let me help you out, you know... for old time's sake.
translation: 好了，孩子。让我帮帮你吧，嗯……看在和你爸的老交情的份上。

original: If you don't have the caps to pay for the information, then maybe you could do a little favor for me.
translation: 如果你没有足够的钱用来交换信息，那么或许你可以帮我点小忙。

original: No problem at all. I'll take care of you until that lazy zombie wakes up to do his job.
translation: 完全没问题。在那懒散的丧尸起床工作之前让我为你服务吧。

original: Tell it to Gob, he'll get you whatever you need.
translation: 跟盖博说去，他会给你弄想要的。

original: Then you need to talk to Gob. Don't worry, he doesn't drip into the drinks... much.
translation: 你需要去找盖博，别担心，他不会喝醉的……至少不会太醉。

original: Shut up, butt wipe.
translation: 闭嘴，擦屁虫。

original: Stop saying that, butt face.
translation: 别说了，屁脸。

original: Oh, yeah? I'll show you! I'll show all of you. My mother will be sorry.
translation: 哦，嗯？我会让你瞧瞧！让你们都瞧瞧。我母亲会后悔的。

original: Welcome to Tenpenny Tower! Don't do anything stupid.
translation: 欢迎来到特佩尼大厦！记住千万不要做蠢事。

original: Can't you tell the difference between me and a feral? Fine. I'll show you the goddamn difference! Just you wait! You'll get yours. All of you!
