translation: 你分不出我和狂尸鬼的区别吗？好。我会告诉你他妈的区别！等着瞧吧！你会得到报应的。你们所有人！

original: Is that so? And why should I believe that? You ever kill a Ghoul before?
translation: 真的吗？我们凭什么相信你？你以前杀过尸鬼吗？

original: Bah! I thought you were more interesting than that.
translation: 呸！我还以为你会更有趣呢。

original: Fine. But you better not get caught with that!
translation: 好吧。但你最好别被人发现！

original: Son of a bitch!
translation: 混蛋！

original: That's behind the Back Door! The Back Door is my job, and I do it really well!
translation: 就在后门外。守卫后门也是我的工作，我也一直做得很好！

original: See what happens is, Mayor says he wants the door open. Then I help him because I'm good at it. It takes two of us to do it.
translation: 是这样的，镇长说他想把这扇门打开，我就帮他打开。我对这可很在行。这需要我们两个人来完成。

original: But only Mayor can say it's okay. You gotta talk to him, and then I'll help him.
translation: 但只有镇长才能批准。你得去找他谈，然后我才会帮他。

original: Not much, really. Mayor has us steer clear of the door to Murder Pass, just in case. If you go near it, you can hear them howling.
translation: 知道的不多。镇长让我们远离通往杀戮通道的门。如果你走近那，还能听见他们的嚎叫。

original: Can't hear much around the other door, though. I guess maybe there aren't as many back there. Doesn't matter much, though.
translation: 但是，在另一扇门附近听不到什么。我猜这是因为那边没有多少。不过这不重要了。

original: Yeah, I know that place. Yep, sure do. Monsters back there. Big, scary monsters. Lots of them. Tons, even.
translation: 嗯，我当然知道哪个地方。后面是些怪物，很大，很吓人的怪物。很多，甚至上千。

original: Are you going there? Are you? Are you gonna shoot 'em dead? I bet you are. That'll be so cool. Unless they eat your face. They do that, you know.
translation: 你要到那去？你确定？你要去干掉他们？你肯定是。那就太酷了，除非他们把你脸啃掉。嗯，他们会那样做的。

original: That's where the monsters come from. We don't go back there. It's called Murder Pass for a reason, you know?
translation: 怪物们就是从那来的。我们不到那后面去。那儿叫做杀戮通道是有原因的，你懂吗？

original: If you go that way, you're probably gonna get hurt. I can patch you up as long as it's not real bad.
translation: 你如果走那条路很可能会受伤的。只要不是特别严重，我倒是可以帮你包扎。

original: I don't know what that is, mister.
translation: 先生，我不知道那是什么。

original: No... not really. Maybe my letters just aren't arriving. Whatever you can do to get it there would sure be appreciated.
translation: 不……并不是。没准只是我的信没寄到。你要是能帮我送过去，我会非常感激的。

original: Great! I'd like you to deliver this message to my family in the Arefu Settlement. I haven't heard from them in months and I'm worried.
translation: 好极了！我需要你帮我给在阿雷富聚集地的家人送个信。我已经有几个月没跟他们联系了，很担心他们。

original: As soon as you get there, talk to Davis West. He'll be glad to pay you for the trip.
translation: 你一到那边就去找戴维斯·威斯特，他会很乐意付你报酬。

original: Today we hear the story of Saint Monica.
translation: 今天我们要讲圣莫尼卡的故事。

original: She was born in Great Lanta on the shores of the Ocean.
translation: 她在海边的大兰达出生。

original: Her parents were both Ghouls. Yes, that’s right, I said Ghouls.
translation: 她的双亲都是尸鬼，是的，我说的是尸鬼。

original: That she was conceived at all was a miracle. That she was born unafflicted was an even greater miracle.
translation: 她的父母能怀上她实在是个奇迹，而她被顺利生下来是个更大的奇迹。

original: God tested Saint Monica. She did not lead an easy life.
translation: 上帝锤炼着圣莫尼卡，她的一生充满坎坷。

original: Sold into slavery by Raiders, she was forced to sell her body.
translation: 被掠夺者卖身为奴后，她被迫出卖自己的肉体。

original: They took her only son, Ehren, from her and sold him.
translation: 他们从她身边抓走了她唯一的儿子，艾仁，并把他卖掉了。

original: She prayed every night to God for his safety. She did not pray for herself, although her burden was great.
translation: 她每晚都向上帝祈祷她儿子能够平安。尽管她肩上的担子够重了，但她从不为自己祈祷。

original: Each night she would preach the word of God to the Slavers.
translation: 每天晚上她都要向上帝祈祷惩罚那些奴隶贩子。

original: After sixteen years, God provided a miracle.
translation: 16年之后，上帝恩赐了一个奇迹。

original: One of the Slavers repented his wicked ways and helped her to escape.
translation: 其中一个奴隶贩良心发现，帮她逃了出来。

original: Four years she looked for Ehren. Four years she wandered the Wasteland.
translation: 她花了四年去找艾仁。四年间，她在废土上到处流浪。

original: God looked over her in those years.
translation: 那些年来，上帝一直眷顾着她。

original: When she found her son, she found he was a wicked man.
translation: 当她最终找到她儿子时，却发现他已经变成了一个恶棍。

original: Ehren had overthrown his masters and taken their place. He was an owner of men.
translation: 艾仁推翻了他的主人并占据了他们的地盘，他拥有其他的人。

original: Ehren took his mother to be his slave, even knowing who she was, for Ehren blamed her for his painful early life.
translation: 即便知道她的身份，艾仁还是把他的母亲抓住当奴隶，因为艾仁认为自己童年的不幸是她的错。

original: Each day Ehren would think of a new and wicked trial to put her through.
translation: 每天艾仁都想尽办法折磨着她。

original: She would only smile at him and say, "I forgive you."
translation: 而她只是微笑着对他说，“我原谅你。”

original: Each morning she would be miraculously healed as if nothing had happened.
translation: 每天早上，她都会奇迹般地痊愈，就像什么也没发生过一样。

original: When Ehren truly realized her love and God's love was boundless, he flung himself at her feet and begged for Saint Monica’s forgiveness.
translation: 当艾仁最终意识到她的爱，还有上帝的爱是多么宽广的时候，他扑到她脚下，请求圣莫尼卡宽恕自己。

original: Ehren released all of his slaves, and they rejoiced.
translation: 艾仁释放了所有奴隶，大家欣喜若狂。

original: He repented all his wicked ways.
translation: 他为自己过去的恶行忏悔。

original: Who among us is without sin? Who among us can claim to be innocent?
translation: 咱们谁没有罪？谁敢说自己是无辜的？

original: Come, brothers and sisters, let us pray to God and Saint Monica for deliverance from our sins, as Ehren was delivered from his.
translation: 来吧，兄弟姐妹们，让我们祈祷上帝和圣莫尼卡宽恕我们的罪恶，就像艾仁救赎了他自己一样。

original: Amen. Let us pray.
translation: 阿门，让我们祈祷吧。

original: Don't let me keep you.
translation: 别让我耽误你。

original: Time is wasting.
translation: 你在浪费时间。

original: You did WHAT? Are you out of your goddamned mind? Do you have any idea how long we've pained to put this plan into motion?
translation: 你做了什么？你该死的疯了吗？你不知道我们为了实施这计划付出了多大代价吗？

original: Weeks of preparation, destroyed. No words of mine can express my utter contempt for you.
translation: 经过数周的准备后，却被毁掉了。我已经无法形容对你厌恶的程度了。

original: You have made a very poor error in judgment, my friend. One day... one day it WILL come back to haunt you.
translation: 你做了一个错误的判断，我的朋友。有朝一日，你会得到报应的。

original: I thought you knew what you were doing. If it's just nerves, maybe some chems will help. But if you can't handle it, don't go fiddling with it!
translation: 我想你知道你的情况，如果你只是紧张，吃点药就好了。但如果你没这本事，就别乱动那东西。

original: Excellent! I had a feeling about you.
translation: 很好！我没看错你。

original: Here's the Fusion Pulse Charge. It needs to be installed inside the bomb.
translation: 这是核聚变脉冲炸药，需要安装在核弹内部。

original: When it's done, meet me at Tenpenny Tower. It's southwest of here, well out of harm's way. You can't miss it. Questions?
translation: 搞定后来特佩尼大厦见我。它在这的西南方，一个很安全的地方，你不会找不到的。还有问题吗？

original: Oh. I see. I didn't realize Megaton had any guardian beyond its intrepid sheriff. Very well, then. I'll take my leave, as you suggested.
translation: 哦，我知道了。我从没想到兆吨镇除了那位勇敢的警长以外还有其他守卫。那好，我会按你说的很快离开。

original: Well played! An extra 500 caps, in addition to the base fee, when Megaton lies in ruins.
translation: 干得好！当兆吨镇成为废墟以后我会再付你额外的500个瓶盖。

original: Here's the Fusion Pulse Charge. Place it in the bomb.
translation: 这是核聚变脉冲炸药，去安到那核弹上。

original: When it's done, meet me at Tenpenny Tower. It's southwest of here, well out of harm's way. You can't miss it. Any questions?
translation: 搞定后来特佩尼大厦见我。它在这的西南方，一个很安全的地方，你不会找不到的。还有问题吗？

original: It seems I have misjudged you. Very well. I'll simply find someone with more entrepreneurial spirit. Good day.
translation: 看来我高估你了。好吧，我会去找其他更有创业精神的人，再见。

original: No, no, I'm merely a recruiter. YOU get to have the real fun.
translation: 不，不，我只是个猎头而已。是“你”来完成这有趣的工作。

original: The undetonated atomic bomb for which this town is named is still very much alive. All it needs is a little motivation.
translation: 这个小镇因未引爆的核弹而得名，而这颗核弹现在仍然充满活力。它需要的只是一点动力。

original: I have in my possession a Fusion Pulse Charge. Once rigged to the bomb, it will be detonated, by you, at a secure location. Easy money, my friend.
translation: 我这有一个核聚变脉冲炸药。只要安在那核弹上，它就可以被引爆。这件事由你来做，而你不用冒任何风险。这钱好赚得很啊，我的朋友。

original: The undetonated atomic bomb for which this town is named is still very much alive. All it needs is a little motivation.
translation: 这个小镇因未引爆的核弹而得名，而这颗核弹现在仍然充满活力。它需要的只是一点动力。

original: I have in my possession a Fusion Pulse Charge constructed for a singular purpose -- the detonation of that bomb.
translation: 我这有一个核聚变脉冲炸药。这东西的用途只有一个——引爆那核弹。

original: You'll rig it to the bomb. Then you'll get paid. Handsomely. What do you say?
translation: 你把它安到那核弹上，然后就有报酬，非常丰厚。听起来怎么样？

original: He owns this building. We get our caps from him, and don't you forget it.
translation: 他是这幢楼的主人。我们从他那领工资，这一点你可要记好了。

original: A very well dressed gentleman, when he bothers to get dressed. He hardly ever leaves his penthouse suite.
translation: 他特意着装的时候，是一个很得体的绅士。但他很少离开自己的套间。

original: He stays in his penthouse suite most of the time. So long as we pay the rent, he lets us live here.
translation: 大多数时候他都在自己的套间里待着。只要我们按时付房租，他就允许我们住下去。

original: He's the landlord, although you hardly ever see him. I had to treat him once for bed sores, if you know what I mean.
translation: 他是这的房东，尽管你很难见到他。我曾经帮他治疗褥疮，你知道吧。

original: Wait... don't tell him I said that.
translation: 等一下……别告诉他那是我说的。

original: Every day it's the same thing. The man has no imagination with his meals.
translation: 每天都是老一套，这人在吃食上没半点新花样。

original: But it's his building, so everyday I make that damned "Iguana Bits sandwich, no salt, with a peeled pear on the side. Send it up to the penthouse."
translation: 但整栋楼都是他的，所以每天我还是得照做——见鬼的“鬣蜥肉丁三明治，免盐，配削皮梨。送至顶楼套房。”

original: He is the right lord and master of Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 他是特佩尼大厦合法的房东和主人。

original: Or at least that's what my files say.
translation: 至少我的文件里是这么说的。

original: It's named after Allistair Tenpenny, who runs this building. Got a bunch of rich guys that pay him to live in it.
translation: 这是以这幢楼的所有人奥利斯特·特佩尼来命名的。找了一群富人住在这给他付房租。

original: We're here to make sure that people like you don't mess up his deal.
translation: 我们在这的任务是确保像你这样的人不会妨碍他的交易。

original: Some might say that Tenpenny Tower is my crowning achievement. But no! No, my dear girl, it is just the beginning!
translation: 有些人可能说特佩尼大厦是我最高的成就。但不是！不，我亲爱的姑娘，这只是个开始！

original: I only carry the finest garments.
translation: 我只有最好的衣服。

original: My Boutique has many unique items for the discerning customer.
translation: 我的精品店有很多独特的货物，是专门为有眼光的顾客准备。

original: What are you in the mood for?
translation: 你想要来点什么？

original: Enjoy the holiday discount, compliments of Mister Tenpenny!
translation: 请享受节日折扣，这是特佩尼先生的恩赐！

original: And what will our most distinguished guest be having today?
translation: 我们今天最尊贵的客人想来点什么？

original: I have an excellent selection of thirst quenchers.
translation: 我有上选的解渴饮料。

original: I have some first aid supplies I can sell.
translation: 我有些急救用品可以出售。

original: I guess we could do a little trading. Here's what I got.
translation: 我想我们可以做点交易。这是我的货。

original: Here's what I got.
translation: 这是我的货。

original: Really? Oh, thank you! I just know I can seduce Diego with this.
translation: 真的吗？哦，谢谢！我就知道我能用这个勾引迭戈。

original: Then he'll have to marry me. We'll be so happy!
translation: 然后他就会娶我。我们会很幸福的！

original: Your words impress me, human. Perhaps I misjudged you when we first met.
translation: 你的话打动了我，人类。或许初次见面时我误会了你。

original: If you wish to speak to Ian, you are free to do so.
translation: 如果你想见伊恩，请自便。

original: Here is the code to the area in which he is meditating.
translation: 这是他的房间密码，他在那里冥想。

original: The hunger that drives us must be kept in check. It is one of the most difficult things to teach.
translation: 我们必须控制自己不被欲望驱使。这是最难被教导的事之一。

original: Ian lost control because no one was around to guide him. His own family was alien to him.
translation: 因为没有人在身边指引他，伊恩无法控制自己。他觉得自己的家人都是异类。

original: He had a moment of weakness, and it was fatal.
translation: 他有一阵子很虚弱，那对他是致命的。

original: Medical procedures initiated. Administering treat... ERROR ERROR!
translation: 医疗程序启动。实施治疗……错误 错误！

original: Medical procedures initiated. Administering treat... ERROR ERROR!
translation: 医疗程序启动。实施治疗……错误 错误！

original: Medical procedures initiated. Administering treatment. Please stand still.
translation: 医疗程序启动。实施治疗。请别动！

original: You think I don't know that? You think I don't know what I did?!
translation: 你以为我不知道？你以为我不知道我做了什么？

original: Possibly. I'm afraid I won't be able to assist you directly; the news Doctor Li has brought will require me to be elsewhere.
translation: 可能吧。恐怕我不能直接帮助你；鉴于李博士带来的消息，我得到别处去处理。

original: I can, however, give you access to an old Pre-War computer from Vault-Tec. It may have the information you need.
translation: 不过，我可以让你使用一台战前的避难所科技旧电脑。里面可能有你需要的信息。

original: You'll find the terminal in the archives in the A ring.
translation: 你能在A环的档案室里找到那台终端。

original: Right. The flooding shorted out some of the fuse boxes downstairs, including one that controls some of the automatic doors.
translation: 对，溢水导致有些保险丝盒短路被烧掉了，包括控制某些自动门的。

original: Here, take these fuses. The box is back down in the sub-basement, near the eastern end of the level.
translation: 把这些保险丝拿去。保险丝盒在地下室的深处，接近那一层东头。

original: Once the fuses are replaced, you'll be able to get to the mainframe.
translation: 换上这些保险丝之后你就能够进到主控制室里了。

original: Oh my gosh! Oh my gosh! A real Quantum! Yummie yum yum!
translation: 哦，上帝！哦，上帝！一瓶真正的量子可乐！耶耶耶！

original: Okay, I guess I can talk to you some more. Just be nicer next time!
translation: 好了，我想我可以跟你多说一些，不过下次对我好点！

original: Now, do you want to take the tour?
translation: 现在你愿意谈谈你的经历吗？

original: Oh my gosh! Oh my gosh! A real Quantum! Yummie yum yum!
translation: 哦，上帝！哦，上帝！一瓶真正的量子可乐！耶耶耶！

original: Okay, I guess I can talk to you some more. Just be nicer next time!
translation: 好了，我想我可以跟你多说一些，不过下次对我好点！

original: Now, do you want to take the tour?
translation: 现在你愿意谈谈你的经历吗？

original: Well, here we are. Nestled all safe and snug inside Vault 101. It's so cold down here. Colder still with Catherine gone...
translation: 嗯，我们到了。栖身在安全又干净的101号避难所内。这里可真是冷，凯瑟琳不在后就更冷了……

original: Oh, Catherine... I so wish you were here with me. How the hell am I supposed to do this by myself? Live down in this hole. Take care of our child...
translation: 哦，凯瑟琳……我真希望你能在这陪着我。我一个人怎么能行啊？住在地洞里面，照看我们的孩子……

original: But this is our life now, so I guess I'd better get used to it. The Overseer who runs the place is an overbearing bully, but I've dealt with worse.
translation: 但这就是我们现在的生活，所以我还是得赶快适应。负责的监督者是个专横傲慢的人，不过我以前遇到过更差劲的。

original: I... Oh. Oh my...
translation: 我……哦。哦，我的……

original: Root level access granted. Override O-923. Authorization J-512. Self-destruct sequence initialized.
translation: 系统管理授权获准。撤销-923。授权码J-512。自毁序列初始化。

original: Civilian is requested to secure FEV vial and vacate the facility at once.
translation: 那人被要求拿取FEV病毒试剂瓶并立刻撤离本设施。

original: We'll do our best, is what we'll do. Me and the kids here in Andale... what's left of it, anyway.
translation: 我们会尽力的，这就是我们要做的。我和孩子们在安代尔……不管怎么说，这里还剩下什么。

original: It'll be hard goin', but we'll do the best we can.
translation: 以后的日子将会很艰难，但我们会尽力的。

original: I just hope that one day, these kids'll grow up to go some good for this place, after all the evil that's been done here.
translation: 我只希望有一天，孩子们长大了，能为这做些好事，毕竟这曾经是充满罪恶的地方。

original: It's okay, I guess. There aren't a lot of kids around here and no one who comes to visit stays around long.
translation: 还好吧，我想。就是周围没什么小孩子，访客也待不久。

original: Dad says it could be worse; that there are a lot of starving kids in other places. But still, I wish I had more kids to play with.
translation: 爸爸说这已经算好了：别处总有小孩饿死。但我还是希望能有更多小孩和我一起玩。

original: Command accepted. Security program disengaged.
translation: 指令收到。安全程序已解除。

original: Yes, fellow employee? What can I do for you on this wonderful day?
translation: 怎么了，同事？在这美好的日子里我能帮你什么？

original: Very well. Give me a few moments to bring the system online.
translation: 好吧，我这就登陆系统。

original: I'm sorry, but that's...
translation: 我很抱歉，但那是……

original: We're underground. No one's been down here for a long time. Odds are we're not alone. Understand me?
translation: 我们在地底下，这很久没人来过了。很可能有什么怪物，明白了吗？

original: We don't have time to waste. We need to get moving.
translation: 我们没时间浪费了，得快点上路。

original: I believe I can handle things from here.
translation: 我想我能处理这的事。

original: Your mother, she... she was beautiful. But... beyond the beauty you've seen. There's just so much those old photos can never show.
translation: 你母亲，她……她很漂亮。但……除了你看到的美丽之外。那些老照片根本无法展现她的美。

original: And she was passionate. About life, about love. But most of all, most of all she was passionate about you.
translation: 同时她也充满了热情，对生命，对爱情。但最重要的是，她对你所倾注的感情。

original: When she became pregnant, it was the happiest I had ever seen her. Ahhhh... she had great things in mind for you...
translation: 当她怀孕的时候，是我见过的她最开心的时刻。啊……她为你设想了很多美好的事情……

original: And so! Time for you to stop stalling and get to class! Please, honey, please take these achievement tests seriously.
translation: 所以！是时候停止拖延，该去教室了！拜托，宝贝，请认真对待这些成绩测试。

original: The last thing I need is you mother's ghost haunting me because her only child became a garbage burner.
translation: 我最不愿意看到是，她唯一的孩子成了个垃圾焚烧工，以致你母亲的灵魂为此来埋怨我。

original: Your mother, she... she was beautiful. But... beyond the beauty you've seen. There's just so much those old photos can never show.
translation: 你母亲，她……她很漂亮。但……除了你看到的美丽之外。那些老照片根本无法展现她的美。

original: And she was passionate. About life, about love. But most of all, most of all she was passionate about you.
translation: 同时她也充满了热情，对生命，对爱情。但最重要的是，她对你倾注的感情。

original: When she became pregnant, it was the happiest I had ever seen her. Ahhhh... she had great things in mind for you...
translation: 当她怀孕的时候，是我见过的她最开心的时刻。啊……她为你设想了很多美好的事情……

original: And so! Time for you to stop stalling and get to class! Please, son, please take these achievement tests seriously.
translation: 所以！是时候停止拖延，该去教室了！拜托，儿子，请认真对待这些成绩测试。

original: The last thing I need is your mother's ghost haunting me because her only child became a garbage burner.
translation: 我最不愿意看到是，她唯一的孩子成了个垃圾焚烧工，以致你母亲的灵魂为此来埋怨我。

original: This ain't over, daddy's girl.
translation: 后会有期，乖乖女。

original: Fine. Let's go. I was done here, anyway.
translation: 好了，我们走吧。怎么说我也完事了。

original: Are you sure? Butch? Um... okay. Whatever you say, Wally. Tunnel Snakes rule!
translation: 你确定吗，布奇？呃……好吧，听你的吩咐，瓦利。隧蛇帮主宰一切！

original: Don't know who put you in charge. I say we're done. Let's go, Paul.
translation: 我不知道谁派你来的。我说我们完事了。走吧，保利。

original: Done? We're not done! I say when we're done.
translation: 好了吗？我们完事了！我说我们完事了。

original: We're done here.
translation: 我们完事了。

original: What? What kind of shit is that? No one talks that way about Wally Mack!
translation: 什么？这是什么话？没人敢这么跟瓦利·麦克说话！

original: He's not the boss of me! Nobody's the boss of me! I'm out of here.
translation: 他不是我的老大！没人是我的老大！我要离开这。

original: Whoa, take it easy. No need to go all psycho on me again. We were just joking with her.
translation: 哇，别生气。不用替我喊医生，我们只是跟她开玩笑。

original: Get away from me!
translation: 离我远点！

original: You think you're special because your daddy is the Overseer?
translation: 你觉得爸爸是监督者就高人一等了？

original: She's nothing, Butch!
translation: 布奇，她什么也不是！

original: Let's go into the storeroom, Amata. I'll show you a good time...
translation: 阿玛塔我们去储藏室吧，我会让你很爽的……

original: Show it to her, Butch!
translation: 布奇，给她看看！

original: I can understand that you're angry. You have a right to be.
translation: 我知道你为什么生气，当然你也确实有权利生气。

original: Perhaps the choice I made wasn't the right one. At the time, I thought I was doing what was best for you.
translation: 或许当时我做了个错误的选择。当时，我以为为你做的一切都是最好的。

original: I wouldn't be here if I didn't. With what I've learned from Doctor Braun, I know it can work.
translation: 如果我不会，就不会站在这。我从布劳恩博士那学习了怎么操作。

original: That's why it's so important to find a G.E.C.K. as soon as possible. It's the key to Project Purity.
translation: 它之所以那么重要，是因为这是净水工程的关键，我们要尽快找到关键的伊甸园创造器。

original: Doctor Li. My heart... I must rest.
translation: 李博士，我的心脏……我必须得歇会。

original: Okay, tough guy. Say what's on your mind.
translation: 好吧，难缠的家伙，告诉我你有什么想法？

original: Well now, looks like she's got some spice. Say what's on your mind.
translation: 她好像找到些有趣的东西，你怎么看？

original: Our new neighbors aren't so bad after all. And they have big appetites, so that's good for the cafe!
translation: 我们的新邻居也不是很坏，他们只是胃口很大，这对餐厅而言也算是件好事！

original: It's swell. Those new neighbors of ours like to drink almost as much as I do… and boy, do they have some real good stories!
translation: 真不错。我们的新邻居和我一样爱喝酒，他们还有好多故事讲！

original: People are happy and healthy for the most part. And those Ghouls make great case studies! Did I mention I'm working on an important dissertation...
translation: 最重要的是人们健康幸福。而且那些尸鬼也是很好的研究对象！呃，我和你说过我正在写一篇很重要的论文么……

original: Things are going well, I'd say. We've all learned a thing or two about what makes a real community. Don't you think, comrade?
translation: 现在一切都不错，我们都认识到了什么才是一个真正的公社所应具备的。你说呢，同志？

original: I guess I don't mind those Ghouls as much as I thought I would.
translation: 我想我并不像之前想象中那样介意这些尸鬼。

original: Those Ghouls are disgusting, so I just spend all my time up here.
translation: 那些尸鬼令人作呕，我只好在这消磨时间。

original: I'm surprised by my fellow tenants. I used to think they were all closed minded idiots. Turns out they aren't so bad after all.
translation: 我对那些住户感到吃惊，我曾经认为他们是顽固的白痴。不过事实上，他们还不算太糟糕。

original: Beats the Wasteland and dirty tunnels, that's for damn sure!
translation: 不用再住在废土和肮脏的隧道里了，这确实是真的！

original: It's wonderful. Roy was right. This is the way to live!
translation: 太棒了！罗伊是对的，这才叫生活！

original: It's weird actually. I used to vacation here before the bombs dropped. Used to be a resort for the wealthy and powerful.
translation: 其实感觉有点奇怪。核弹落下前我曾到这度过假。这曾是有财有势者的休养圣地。

original: I never thought I'd be the one fighting to get in here. Guess way back it used to be a plantation. Ironic isn't it?
translation: 我从没想过有一天要一路厮杀才能到这来。我猜再往前这曾是一片种植园。很讽刺，对吧？

original: I guess I shouldn't be surprised. I'm sure Evan King is pretty pissed right about now.
translation: 我想我不应该感到惊讶，我敢说埃万·金现在肯定很恼火。

original: I bet he has the entire town out looking for me. He's worse than my parents.
translation: 我打赌他已经让整个镇子的人都在找我了，他比我的父母还可恶。

original: Biding our time, making plans, getting ready. Tenpenny and his pack of elitist wannabes can't keep us out of that tower forever.
translation: 等待时机，制定计划，做好准备。特佩尼和他的那群崇拜者别想把我们永远挡在大厦的外面。

original: We got rights. And we'll take them if they aren't given to us.
translation: 我们有权利。如果他们不给，我们就会去夺取。

original: Biding our time, making plans, getting ready. Tenpenny and his pack of elitist wannabes can't keep us out of that tower forever.
translation: 等待时机，制定计划，做好准备。特佩尼和他的那群崇拜者别想把我们永远挡在大厦的外面。

original: We've got rights. And we'll take them if they aren't given to us.
translation: 我们有权利。如果不给我们，我们就会去争取。

original: What about it?
translation: 怎么了？

original: Roy is coming up with a plan to get us into that tower. Tenpenny's. Says it's only a matter of time.
translation: 罗伊正在拟定一个让我们进入特佩尼大厦的计划，他说住进去只是时间问题。

original: He's strong like that. He never gives up. The kind of guy who makes things happen, Roy is. That's why the others follow him.
translation: 他很坚强，从不放弃。策划者，这就是罗伊。这也是为什么其他人都追随他。

original: Me, I just like the way he looks at me. Makes me feel pretty again. I'd go anywhere with him.
translation: 我，我喜欢他看我的样子，这让我觉得自己又漂亮了，我会追随着他到天涯海角。

original: I've been stomping around with Roy and his gang of misfits. Roy's a no nonsense, take no prisoners kinda guy.
translation: 我一直和罗伊还有他那帮痞子一起厮混，罗伊是那种说一不二的人。

original: He heard about this Tenpenny asshole, and now he's trying to get us in that tower. He's hatching some kind of plan to kill all those bigot bastards.
translation: 他听说过那混蛋特佩尼，现在他试着要带我们潜入那幢大厦。他在拟定一个计划，要干掉塔里那群种族分子。

original: Believe it or not, I used to vacation there.
translation: 信不信由你，我曾经在那度过假。

original: You got balls. Really big ones. I'll assume you're kidding 'cause no one shit talks me and lives.
translation: 有种，你真有种。我只当你是开玩笑，因为还没哪个混蛋能这样和我讲话后还有命的。

original: We Ghouls are just like the rest of you: Shit out of luck and doing our best to make it.
translation: 我们尸鬼和你们一样：运气像狗屎，还在拼命挣扎。

original: Maybe I misjudged. Pardons. So yeah, people treat us like shit. But it just makes us stronger.
translation: 或许我判断错误了，请你原谅。就是啊，人们对我们就像对待狗屎一样，但这也让我们更强大。

original: Otherwise we ain't no different than anyone else that had the misfortune to live past infancy.
translation: 否则我们就和其他人没有区别了，活在过去遭遇的不幸里。

original: Uh-huh? Fine, whatever. Being a Ghoul ain't anything worse than any other thing somebody's got to deal with.
translation: 呃？好的，随便。做尸鬼和其他人要面对的难题一样。

original: Like your stupidity, for example. You can't help it. You were born stupid, or dropped on your head as a kid.
translation: 举个例子吧：你这愚德行。那是没办法的事。不是你天生就笨，就是小时候碰坏头。

original: Either way it ain't nothing you can change. So you deal with it.
translation: 不论如何，你都无法改变现状。因此你只有面对。

original: Sure, whatever you say. You pretentious two-faced asshole.
translation: 当然，随便你说什么，你这自负、伪善的混蛋。

original: Listen good. I'll say this only once. I can respect a man's privacy. But I don't put up with bullshit.
translation: 好好的给我听着，我只说一遍。我能尊重别人的隐私，但我不能容忍胡言乱语。

original: Keep to yourself and we'll be fine. Cause any trouble for me or mine, and I'll end you. We understand each other?
translation: 别惹其他人，咱们就没事。因为任何给我和我的人惹任何麻烦的话，我就干掉你。明白了吗？

original: Oh... my... I guess... I was just trying to be nice. Am I babbling again? I tend to do that when I'm nervous.
translation: 噢……我……我想……我只是想有点礼貌啊。我是不是又胡说了？我一紧张就会这样。

original: Oh - you don't make me nervous. I mean, Roy says not to show weakness...
translation: 哦 — 你不会让我感到紧张，我是说，罗伊说不要轻易暴露自己的弱点……

original: Have you met Roy? He's killed lots of people before. I'm his gal. He protects me. So better not try anything.
translation: 你见过罗伊吧？他以前干掉了很多人。我是他女人，他照顾我，最好别胡来。

original: Harmless? Well, you're lucky I don't stick you and take your shit. Watch yourself, we don't take kindly to strangers, 'specially sweet-talking ones.
translation: 没危险？得了吧，我没抢你的垃圾已经算你走运了。你自己小心，我们不会对陌生人示好，尤其是那些油腔滑调的家伙。

original: What? Those gangers? I knew if he got mixed up with the wrong crowd this could happen! Why didn't I do anything to stop him?
translation: 什么？这些帮匪？我就知道他跟那些家伙在一起会发生这种事！我为什么没有去阻止他？

original: I... I don't know what to say. I... can't believe this is happening to me. My entire family... gone. I...
translation: 我……我不知道该怎么说，我……不敢相信这些会发生在我身上，我的整个家庭……都毁了。我……

original: Please, just go. Don't say anything, don't look back. Just go.
translation: 你走吧，别再说了，别回头，走！

original: Well, maybe that's because I don't want to be found.
translation: 嗯，或许是因为我不想被找到。

original: Why the heck are you looking for me anyway?
translation: 你到底他妈的为什么要找我？

original: Oh that sounds bad. I need my head. Where's Paradise Falls?
translation: 噢，这听起来很糟。我需要我的脑袋。天堂瀑在哪？

original: Nothing personal? But I'm a person! ... I'm going, I'm going... don't hurt me!
translation: 不是个人恩怨？但我是一个人啊！……我走，我走……别伤害我！

original: My stuff? Okay.
translation: 我的东西？好吧。

original: Okay, okay. Here.
translation: 好的，好的。给。

original: A slave? I don't remember being a slave... Which way is that again?
translation: 一个奴隶？我怎么不记得自己变奴隶了……再说一遍去哪？

original: The Slavers? I'm a slave? How did this happen?!
translation: 奴隶贩子？我是奴隶？怎么会这样？！

original: I... I don't know... Where am I?
translation: 我不知道……我这是在哪？！

original: Huh? Maybe... Yeah...
translation: 呃？或许……是的……

original: Sure... what's this thing for anyway?
translation: 当然……这是怎么回事？

original: Whoa! What is it? It's heavy! Oh... What friends are you talking about? Do I know them?
translation: 哇！这是什么？真沉！噢……你们说的那朋友是谁？我们认识吗？

original: Yeah... Good idea. Okay. Here you go. I'm pretty tired all of a sudden. I can't even think straight.
translation: 是……好主意。好吧，就照你那么做吧。猝然间我感觉思维混乱，已经不能正常思考了。

original: Huh? ...I do? I don't think so, but go ahead and take a look if you want.
translation: 呃？……我是吗？我可不这么认为，但如果你这么想的话，就过来。

original: A thief? Yeah... I'm feeling a little out of it... Maybe you better hold onto this stuff, you know, to keep it safe or whatever.
translation: 小偷？是啊……我觉得有点不对劲……也许你最好保管好这些东西，你懂的，为了安全什么的。

original: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

original: Atom be with you.
translation: 原子与你同在。

original: Bless you, child.
translation: 保佑你，孩子。

original: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

original: Atom be with you.
translation: 原子与你同在。

original: Bless you, child.
translation: 保佑你，孩子。

original: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

original: Atom be with you.
translation: 原子与你同在。

original: Bless you, child.
translation: 保佑你，孩子。

original: Why yes, we do. How much would you like to donate?
translation: 噢，好的，你想捐赠多少？

original: Well, Moriarty thinks he is, but Lucas Simms is the law around here and everyone knows it.
translation: 嗯，莫里亚蒂觉得自己说了算，不过卢卡斯·西姆斯才是这儿的法律，这点大家都清楚。

original: Yeah. Enjoy. Dick...
translation: 好。请慢用。老兄……

original: Plannin' on goin' out and getting' shot up, eh?
translation: 打算出去挨子弹，嗯？

original: Yeah? What do you need?
translation: 嗯？你需要什么？

original: Not quite as good as that vault stuff you're used to, but it'll do you.
translation: 虽然没有你以前用的避难所物品好，但对你来说也足够了。

original: Well, you're standing fine, but you could use some switching up. That'll be 50 caps.
translation: 你看上去不错，但你还可以更好。这需要50个瓶盖。

original: Your vitals are fine, but you could use some stitches on those cuts. Tell you what, 50 caps sound good?
translation: 你的要害都正常，但是我可以帮你把伤口缝得更好，只收你50个瓶盖，这听起来很棒吧？

original: Look at you! You're fine! Don't come in here wasting my time with your hypochondria. I've got actual patients to see to.
translation: 你自己看看！再正常不过了！别在这浪费我的时间来讨论你的疑心病，还有真正的患者在等着我。

original: Oh, you do not. Just suck it up, you big baby.
translation: 哦，别那么干。面对现实吧，你这大小孩。

original: Alright, you're not that banged up -- a couple of pain killers should do you fine. That'll be 50 caps.
translation: 好吧，你还不算太糟糕 — 两粒止痛药能帮你缓解很多，大概要50个瓶盖。

original: You know, all things considered, you could be worse off. I can stitch you up for 50 caps.
translation: 你要知道，考虑到多种因素，你的情况可能恶化。如果你需要我缝合伤口的话，得拿出50个瓶盖。

original: Let's see... moderate lacerations, maybe a broken bone or two... I should be able to do you up for 75.
translation: 让我看看……中度撕裂，或许一两根骨头断裂……要痊愈你得支付75个瓶盖。

original: Well now, let's take a look at you... some 2nd degree burns... a couple of flesh wounds... it'll take some work but I can fix you up for 75.
translation: 好吧，来看看你的情况……部分二度烧伤……还有几处皮外伤……需要耗费我一些时间，但是我要收你个75瓶盖。

original: Good lord, this'll take some work... 100 caps worth of work.
translation: 我的上帝啊，这可得耗费我不少时间……价值100个瓶盖的工作。

original: I'm surprised you made it in here. I can fix you up, but it'll run you 100 caps. What do you say?
translation: 你还能活着走到这，真令我很吃惊。我会帮你痊愈的，不过你得给我100个瓶盖，你说呢？

original: Well, you're standing fine, but you could use some switching up. That'll be 50 caps.
translation: 你看上去不错，但你还可以更好。这需要50个瓶盖。

original: Oh, you do not. Just suck it up, you big baby.
translation: 哦，别那么干。面对现实吧，你这大小孩。

original: All right, you're not that banged up -- a couple of pain killers should do you fine. That'll be 50 caps.
translation: 好吧，你还不算太糟 — 两粒止痛药就会让你好受点。大概要50个瓶盖。

original: Well now, let's take a look at you... some 2nd degree burns... a couple of flesh wounds... it'll take some work but I can fix you up for 75.
translation: 好吧，来看看你的情况……部分二度烧伤……还有几处皮外伤……需要耗费我一些时间，但是我要收你个75瓶盖。

original: I'm surprised you made it in here. I can fix you up, but it'll run you 100 caps. What do you say?
translation: 你还能活着走到这，真令我很吃惊。我会帮你痊愈的，不过你得给我100个瓶盖，你说呢？

original: That takes a lot of nerve, threatening to bury us all alive and then crawling to me for help. As RJ would say, "Fuck off, mungo."
translation: 你还真有勇气啊，先威胁要活埋了我们，然后又爬着求我帮助你。就像镇长会说的：“滚你妈的蛋，毛人。”

original: Sure thing. Run into a bit of trouble out there?
translation: 当然。在外面遇到麻烦了？

original: You're lucky you're one of us. I'd be charging you through the nose, otherwise.
translation: 幸运的是你是站我们这边的，不然我肯定把你的鼻子打爆。

original: Got scraped up a bit out there, huh?
translation: 在外面受了伤，呃？

original: Yeah, but only because you saved three of ours.
translation: 嗯，但是仅仅是因为你救过我们三个人。

original: Looks like it's just a scrape. I can take care of it for 50 caps.
translation: 看起来好像只是擦伤。我可以治好，这需要50个瓶盖。

original: Okay, but it'll cost you. Every spare cap I get from you is more medicine for these germ-magnets.
translation: 可以，但要你花些钱。从你那里挣的每个瓶盖，对这些“病菌磁铁”来说就是更多的药品。

original: Looks like it's just a scrape. I can take care of it for 50 caps.
translation: 看起来好像只是擦伤。我可以治好，这需要50个瓶盖。

original: Yeah, but only because you saved three of ours.
translation: 嗯，但是仅仅是因为你救过我们三个人。

original: That looks pretty bad. For 75 caps, I can take care of that.
translation: 你的情况看起来很糟糕。需要75个瓶盖，我才能帮你治疗。

original: Okay, but it'll cost you. Every spare cap I get from you is more medicine for these germ-magnets.
translation: 可以，但要你花些钱。从你那里挣的每个瓶盖，对这些“病菌磁铁”来说就是更多的药品。

original: That looks pretty bad. For 75 caps, I can take care of that.
translation: 你的情况看起来很糟糕。需要75个瓶盖，我才能帮你治疗。

original: Yeah, but only because you saved three of ours.
translation: 嗯，但是仅仅是因为你救过我们三个人。

original: This is going to be tricky. And not at all pleasant. And it'll cost you 100 caps.
translation: 这非常棘手。并且令人不愉快。需要的费用为100个瓶盖。

original: Okay, but it'll cost you. Every spare cap I get from you is more medicine for these germ-magnets.
translation: 可以，但要你花些钱。从你那里挣的每个瓶盖，对这些“病菌磁铁”来说就是更多的药品。

original: This is going to be tricky. And not at all pleasant. And it'll cost you 100 caps.
translation: 这非常棘手。并且令人不愉快。需要的费用为100个瓶盖。

original: Maybe you should have been more careful down here, mungo. You're on your own.
translation: 或许你本应该更小心，毛人。你是一个人。

original: Unless you've got hurt feelings, there's not a damn thing wrong with you. Come back when you've got some injuries that I can earn some money from.
translation: 你什么该死的毛病也没有，除非你伤了心了。有伤在身再来找我，这样我才可以赚你钱。

original: Hey, if you needed help, I'd gladly take your money, but you're just fine, buck-o. Now stop wasting my time.
translation: 嗨，如果你需要帮助，我会很乐意收取你的费用，但你确完全健康。他妈的，混蛋。别浪费我的时间。

original: Let's see, a few Stimpaks and a couple of stitches should get you goin'. And it'll only run you 50 caps.
translation: 让我看看，一些治疗针和几下缝合，你就可以痊愈了，仅需50个瓶盖。

original: All right, a few stitches and a couple of bandages should fix you up. Let's call it 50 caps. Sound good?
translation: 好吧，缝几个伤口再绑上绷带，你就全好了。就收50个瓶盖吧，听起来不错吧？

original: A few broken bones, a couple of cuts... I should be able to do you up for 75.
translation: 断了些骨头，两处割伤……花费75个瓶盖，我能帮你治愈。

original: Sure, I'll help you. If you have the caps. Looks to me like you're pretty banged up, though. Let's say... 75 caps and I'll fix you good as new.
translation: 当然，我会帮助你，只要你有瓶盖。你看起来伤得还挺重的。就付……75个瓶盖吧，我就能把你治得像什么事也没发生过一样。

original: You know, when I saw you limping in here, I knew that I smelled money. That'll be 100 caps. Or you can just bleed to death. Your choice.
translation: 你要知道，当你跛着脚进来的时候，我就知道生意上门了。那需要100个瓶盖，否则，你就只能失血过多而死，你自己选择吧。

original: Well, hello, meal ticket. 100 caps. Or I can just wait for you to die and take it.
translation: 你好啊，送钱来的。100个瓶盖。否则我就等你死，然后再来拿走你的钱。

original: Don't think because I'm a Ghoul, I'm stupid. You're fine.
translation: 别看我是个尸鬼就以为我是蠢货。你没毛病。

original: Is this a trick question? I don't even see a scratch on you.
translation: 开什么玩笑？我甚至没有看到一处伤痕。

original: Injured... ha! This is just a nick. If you can't tough it out and you want to be fixed up it'll cost you 50 caps.
translation: 受伤了……哈。这只是划伤了。如果你感觉到难以忍受而要治疗的话，则要花费50个瓶盖。

original: I'd hesitate to even call this a wound, but if you insist. 50 caps should cover my expenses.
translation: 我甚至怀疑这是不是可以算是伤口，如果你仍旧坚持认为。50个瓶盖应该就差不多了。

original: Yeah, you could do with some work. It'll set you back 75 caps, but well worth it.
translation: 嗯，治疗你需要耗费一些时间。让你康复痊愈需要75个瓶盖，这应该很值得的。

original: This is pretty bad, but I've seen worse. Still, it's going to cost 75 caps to get you back on your feet.
translation: 这简直糟透了，但我见过更坏的情况的。但要让你重新站立得花75个瓶盖。

original: Yeah, you look almost as bad as I do. Of course, I'm supposed to look this way and you aren't. 100 caps will do it for my expenses.
translation: 嗯，你看起来和我差不多了。当然，我就该这样，而你不是的。100个瓶盖足够我的医疗开销了。

original: Did you get the number of that Brahmin that trampled you? Sheesh! If you want me to stitch you back together, it'll be 100 caps.
translation: 你知道伤的像你这样的双头牛有多少吗？嘘！如果你想让我把你缝好，要花100个瓶盖。

original: For you? No problem. Now, hold still.
translation: 给你？没问题。别乱动。

original: I don't see anything wrong with you.
translation: 我看你不像有什么问题。

original: I don't see anything wrong with you.
translation: 我看你不像有什么问题。

original: Sure, I could patch you up. Nothing too serious. I don't work for free though. Let's say 75 caps.
translation: 当然，我能把你治好，并不算太严重。但我不会白干，我们说好，就75个瓶盖吧。

original: Sure, I could patch you up. Nothing too serious. I don't work for free though. Let's say 75 caps.
translation: 当然，我能把你治好，并不算太严重。但我不会白干，我们说好，就75个瓶盖吧。

original: You're right. You do need a doctor. Lucky I happened along. But first let's discuss my fee... 100 caps ought to cover it.
translation: 没错，你的确需要一位医生。能遇到我算你走运，但首先让我们来谈谈价钱……应该只需100个瓶盖就够了。

original: You're not kidding. You're in bad shape, friend. I'd be happy to fix you up... for 150 caps.
translation: 你还真不是在开玩笑。朋友，你的情况不佳。我很乐意来医治你，150个瓶盖。

original: Well now. That's a surprise! I'm used to every asshole smoothskin in this town giving me shit just because I look like a corpse.
translation: 诶呀。这倒稀奇！我都习惯了，因为自己像具活尸就被镇上的光皮肤找茬。

original: I'm glad to see that there are a few worthwhile people around here.
translation: 很高兴这附近还有几个像样的人。

original: Listen... Moriarty'd have my head if he caught me selling at a discount, but for you, I'll risk it.
translation: 听着……要是莫里亚蒂发现我打折卖货，非拧下我的头不可。但为你，我豁出去了。

original: Well now. That's a surprise! I'm used to every asshole smoothskin in this town giving me shit just because I look like a corpse.
translation: 诶呀。这倒稀奇！我都习惯了，因为自己像具活尸就被镇上的光皮肤找茬。

original: I'm glad to see that there are a few worthwhile people around here.
translation: 很高兴这附近还有几个像样的人。

original: For you, a discount.
translation: 给你打个折。

original: Well now. That's a surprise! I'm used to every asshole smoothskin in this town giving me shit just because I look like a corpse.
translation: 诶呀。这倒稀奇！我都习惯了，因为自己像具活尸就被镇上的光皮肤找茬。

original: I'm glad to see that there are a few worthwhile people around here.
translation: 很高兴这附近还有几个像样的人。

original: For you, a discount.
translation: 给你打个折。

original: <sighs> I suppose I was wrong... should have known better.
translation: <叹气>我想我错了……我早该知道。

original: I guess they don't have a lot of Ghouls in the Vault.
translation: 我猜避难所里并没几个尸鬼吧。

original: Me? I deal with the caravan suppliers. I used to ride with those guys, so they cut me some good deals. Helps keep the town supplied.
translation: 我？我和商队做买卖，我以前跟他们一起混，因此他们时常给我一些特价。这帮助我维持小镇的补给。

original: But more importantly, I take care of Maggie. Of course, she's getting' a little old to have Billy lookin' over her shoulder all the time...
translation: 但更重要的是，我照顾玛姬。虽然，她已经过了需要寸步不离看着的年龄了……

original: Me? I don't do a damn thing. Well, unless you count staying piss drunk and making Moriarty rich as something.
translation: 我？闲人一个什么也不干。除非你把当酒鬼和给莫里亚蒂送钱也算工作。

original: Sure, I'm the best shot in town with a rifle, so everyone comes running to ol' Jericho when the Raiders show up.
translation: 当然，我可是镇里使步枪使得最准的。所以每当歹徒出现的时候，大家都会跑去找老耶利哥。

original: But between raids, they're content to take my money and drag me home when I've had too much. Hahaha!
translation: 不过在平时，他们都很乐意在我喝多了的时候拿走我的钱再把我丢回家。哈哈哈！

original: You're goddamn right "never mind".
translation: 你他妈说对了，“算了吧”。

original: Wow, you sure about that? Okay...
translation: 哇，你确定？好的……

original: Hmm, okay. Never used one of these before, but I can probably figure it out.
translation: 嗯，好吧，我以前从来没有用过，但我大概能搞明白。

original: I'm not sure the silencer will do me much good, but I'll take it. Thanks.
translation: 我并不认为这消音器会很管用，但我会用它的，谢谢。

original: Sure. Beats having nothing, doesn't it?
translation: 当然了，总胜过赤手空拳，不是吗？

original: I guess it's better than nothing. Thanks.
translation: 我想有总比没有好！谢谢。

original: Okay. If you find one, let me know.
translation: 好的，如果你找到了，请告诉我。

original: I... Normally I would never approve of this. If the situation weren't so serious...
translation: 我不太赞同，要是处境不是那么危急的话……

original: If you think this is the best course of action, we'll do it. I hope this isn't a mistake.
translation: 如果你认为这是最应该做的事，那么我们将会做到这一点，我只希望这不是一个错误。

original: Yes, this looks to be enough. He'll need medical attention once we've reached the Citadel, but this will get him there.
translation: 嗯，看起来足够了。我们抵达大本营后，他还需要接受医疗护理，但这足够他撑到那里了。

original: Thank you. Give me a moment, and we can continue.
translation: 谢谢。给我几分钟时间，我们就可以继续了。

original: What'll it be?
translation: 那会怎么样？

original: Yeah, sure thing.
translation: 嗯，当然没问题。

original: What am I gonna say? No? You've got me over a barrel.
translation: 我还能说什么呢？说不吗？你让我别无选择。

original: Look. Keep your bullshit judgments to yourself, man. Just don't tell Jenny or Andy and we'll be fine.
translation: 听着。留着你那毫无依据的判断吧。只要你不告诉珍妮和安迪，我们之间就没有麻烦。

original: I hope you're not thinking of doing anything dishonest. You gave me your word.
translation: 你要向我发誓，你不会做不守信的事。

original: Yes, I'd imagine it would fetch an incredible sum of caps to someone that was knowledgeable in musical history.
translation: 是的，我可以想象，如果是对音乐史有研究的人，它一定会拍出令人难以置信的天价。

original: I doubt the average merchant would even realize what they're holding.
translation: 我怀疑一般的商人根本不会意识到他们手里拿的是什么。

original: Well, from my great-great-grandmother's diaries, I have deduced that she had a special pressurized case created for it.
translation: 从我高祖母的日记来看，我可以推断她一定为她的日记本做了一个特殊的加密码的盒子。

original: Hopefully, the Soil Stradivarius was in the case when she... well, you know.
translation: 希望她……嗯，你知道的，索耶尔·斯特拉迪瓦里当时就在琴盒里。

original: Not too much I'm afraid. It was fabricated way back in 1714 by a famous italian craftsman named Antonio Stradivari.
translation: 恐怕不会太多。早在1714年，意大利著名工匠安东尼奥·斯特拉迪瓦里就制作了这把琴。

original: He had made a bunch of Stradivarius violins actually, and each one was individually named over time to identify them.
translation: 他制作了好几把斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴，每一把都以制作时间来命名。

original: They are regarded as the most outstanding instruments ever made... and no two sound alike they say. Incredible.
translation: 他们被誉为最不同凡响的乐器, 所演奏出的两个音阶丝毫不共鸣……如他们所说：好到难以置信。

original: Since the bombs fell laying waste to most of the world, it may be safe to say that this could be the last surviving violin of its kind.
translation: 核弹落于废土，祸及世界上的大部分国家和地区。可以肯定地说， 这是最后一把斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴了。

original: I understand. Please don't mistake my evasiveness for mistrust. I am merely being cautious.
translation: 我理解。请不要误认为我是不值得信任的，我回避你的问题，那只是持种谨慎的态度。

original: Take your time, by all means.
translation: 随你，喜欢就好。

original: Oh, I don't think I've been this happy in years!
translation: 哦，我想我有好几年没有如此开心了！

original: As promised, here's the key to the ammunition box. It's right under the radio table.
translation: 按照约定，这是弹药箱的钥匙。就在电台桌底下。

original: Before you leave, I have some information that may help you. At least a place to begin.
translation: 在你离开前，我有些消息也许能帮到你。至少给你一个着手点。

original: It all starts with my great great grandmother Hilda back in 2077 before the bombs fell...
translation: 这一切都始于2077年我的高祖母时代，当时核弹还没有落下……

original: Oh, I don't think I've been this happy in years!
translation: 哦，我想我有好几年没有如此开心了！

original: I have some information that may help you. At least a place to begin.
translation: 我有些消息也许能帮到你。至少给你一个着手点。

original: It all starts with my great great grandmother back in 2077 before the bombs fell...
translation: 这一切都始于2077年我的高祖母时代，当时核弹还没有落下……

original: Yes. My husband was very proud of the setup. He tinkered with that thing for years to get it working.
translation: 没错，那套设备是我丈夫的骄傲，他修修补补弄了好几年才终于让那东西运作起来。

original: I've tried to use it to get whatever I need, but I've never gotten a reply.
translation: 我试着用它来获取我需要的东西，但从来没有得到过回应。

original: Great! Go ahead and see what you can do. Just be careful.
translation: 好极了！让我看看你都会做些什么，小心。

original: That's pretty steep... Fine. Do it and you'll get your money. Don't screw up, though, or we'll ALL regret it.
translation: 确实麻烦……好吧，你完成工作我就付给我钱。可别搞砸了，不然我们全得后悔！

original: I knew I shouldn't have trusted you. Dammit, boy! You picked the wrong man to mess with. Now I've got to put you in the ground.
translation: 我知道我不应该信任你，该死的家伙！但是你选错人来耍了，我现在不得不杀了你。

original: I knew I shouldn't have trusted you. Dammit, girl! You picked the wrong man to mess with. Now I've got to put you in the ground.
translation: 我知道我不应该信任你，该死的家伙！但是你愚弄错对象了，我现在不得不杀了你。

original: Yep. He's a bit cranky, but he means well. Just make sure there's something actually wrong with you before you bother him.
translation: 对。他有些怪癖。但是人还不错，在打扰他之前确认你真的不舒服就行了。

original: You'll find him down in the plaza at the bottom of the hill, across the way from The Brass Lantern.
translation: 穿过黄铜灯来时的路，你能在小坡下的广场找到他。

original: It takes some stones to admit a mistake. Maybe you're not so bad, stranger. Tell you what, buy me a drink sometime and we'll call it even.
translation: 道歉需要勇气。陌生人，或许你没有那么糟糕。跟你说吧，给我买杯酒我们就算扯平了。

original: So, what do you want that's worth pissing me off over?
translation: 你要怎样才肯滚蛋？

original: Try loosening your grip, maggot. Hold the weapon higher -- see nothing but the sight and the target. Try to screw it up this time.
translation: 别握得那么紧，菜鸟。把武器再端高些 — 专心看你视野中的目标。这次别再搞砸了。

original: This has been a Tenpenny Truism.
translation: 这已经是特佩尼的老生常谈了。

original: The poor man wonders why he is poor. The rich man knows why he is rich.
translation: 穷人不明白他们为什么穷，富人知道他们为什么富。

original: And now a Tenpenny Truism.
translation: 现在是特佩尼的老生常谈。

original: All right, I suppose someone with medical training has to have at least a bit of compassion. And maybe you can talk some sense into the boy.
translation: 好的，我想受过医疗训练的人多少有些同情心。或许你可以和这男孩好好谈谈。

original: Leo Stahl... that boy got hisself a problem with Jet. I've caught him in here two to three times tryin' to steal what I keep around for anesthetic.
translation: 利奥·斯塔尔…… 那男孩吸杰特上瘾了。他想偷我这的麻药时被我抓住过几次。

original: Not even his own family knows it. He goes up to the water treatment plant at night to get high... I dunno... I can't reach him. Maybe you can.
translation: 连他的家人都不知道这事。他晚上去水处理厂吸杰特……我……我说不动他，或许你能。

original: All right look, I'm only tellin' you this because you seem like an okay sort and I'm hopin' maybe you can talk some sense into the boy.
translation: 好的，我之所以告诉你这些因为你看起来不错，我希望你可以和这男孩好好谈谈。

original: Leo Stahl... that boy got hisself a problem with Jet. I've caught him in here two to three times tryin' to steal what I keep around for anesthetic.
translation: 利奥·斯塔尔…… 那男孩吸杰特上瘾了。他想偷我这的麻药时被我抓住过几次。

original: Not even his own family knows it. He goes up to the water treatment plant at night to get high... I dunno... I can't reach him. Maybe you can.
translation: 连他的家人都不知道这事。他晚上去水处理厂吸杰特……我……我说不动他，或许你能。

original: For those answers I shall direct you to my husband, Confessor Cromwell.
translation: 关于这个问题的答案，我推荐你去见我的丈夫，忏悔者克伦威尔。

original: Sigh. Look... you can call me crazy if you want but there is something odd about those creeps.
translation: 唉。听着……你想叫我疯子也行，但我就是觉得有些东西不对劲。

original: I mean, they got the guns and they got the muscle. Why don't they just bust down our doors and take us out already?
translation: 我意思是，他们有枪又有肌肉。为什么他们不打破门，把我们带走？

original: We're really in a bad way, and could use some help.
translation: 我们已经很惨了，需要些帮助。

original: Look, pal. If you think I'm gonna get my ass shot off playing the hero, you're dead wrong.
translation: 听着，伙计。如果你认为我会逞英雄招来子弹，那你就大错特错了。

original: If I know they're coming, I lock myself inside like everyone else. We're really in a bad way, and could use some help.
translation: 如果我知道他们来了，我会像其他人一样把自己锁在屋里。我们已经很惨了，需要帮助。

original: The door on the left goes to the stairwell. From there, just keep heading west.
translation: 左手的门通到楼梯间，到楼梯间再转西。

original: At the stern. That's the west end to you.
translation: 在船尾。在你的西面。

original: The same things that all parents do! My mom cooks and cleans the house and my dad goes to work with Mr. Wilson.
translation: 跟别的父母一样！我妈做饭打扫房子，我爸和威尔逊先生一起工作。

original: They work in the basement, or sometimes in Mr. Wilson's shed. Dad says that when I'm older, I'll come to work with him and learn the family business!
translation: 他们在地下室工作，有时在威尔逊先生的工棚。爸爸说等我大一点的时候，我可以跟着他干，学着打理家里的事。

original: That's all of 'em.
translation: 那是他们所有人。

original: Looks that way.
translation: 看那边。

original: Negative.
translation: 不行。

original: Now knock that off. You're wasting ammo.
translation: 停一下，你在浪费子弹。

original: We need to sweep the area. You think those were all the Uglies in D.C.? You take the east side, I'll go west.
translation: 我们得清理干净这区域。你以为华盛顿的丑八怪只有这么点吗？你去东面，我去西面。

original: Once we're inside, then we'll celebrate.
translation: 一旦进去，我们就要大干一场了。

original: Yeah, I know. God DAMMIT!!
translation: 嗯，我知道。该死啊！！！

original: Is this the idiot who blew our ambush?
translation: 这是让我们的埋伏暴露的白痴吗？

original: Good.
translation: 不错。

original: Jennings?
translation: 詹宁斯？

original: Just a stray we picked up. The one that blundered into the Uglies over on 42nd.
translation: 只是要找一个走散的伙伴。在42街冒失地冲进丑八怪中去的那个愣头青。

original: All right. It's the usual drill. Reddin, you just do whatever Paladin Vargas says and keep your mouth shut.
translation: 好的。这是平常任务。瑞丁，你执行瓦尔加斯圣骑士的命令就行了，并且闭好你的嘴。

original: Okay, the outpost is just to the south of us. Colvin, you're the eyes.
translation: 好，敌人的前哨站就在我们南面。科尔文，你负责侦查。

original: Vargas, Reddin, secure this building.
translation: 瓦尔加斯，瑞丁，防守建筑。

original: It's not your fault, Vargas. Reddin was good enough for the Pride, and she proved it here today.
translation: 这不是你的错，瓦尔加斯。瑞丁配得上“里昂斯的骄傲”这称号，她今天证明了这点。

original: When we get back to the Citadel, I'll talk to the scribes. Let it be chronicled that Paladin Reddin passed her test.
translation: 等回到大本营以后，我会和学士说。瑞丁圣骑士通过了测试，载入编年史。

original: So how'd I do, Vargas? I pass my little trial run? Come on, Lyons' Pride needs me and you know it! That Citadel guard duty is such bullshit.
translation: 那么我做得怎么样，瓦尔加斯？我通过小测试了吗？拜托，你知道的“里昂斯的骄傲”需要我！守卫大本营的任务太他妈傻了。

original: Aw, come on. We just kicked their asses!
translation: 加油，我们只是挠了挠痒！

original: Okay, okay.
translation: 好的，好的。

original: Holy shit! What was that?
translation: 他妈的！那玩意是什么？

original: Talk to Scribe Jameson. She is our keeper of the Scrolls. She will want to know what you have found.
translation: 和詹姆森学士谈谈。她是我们的卷轴保管人，她会想知道你找到了什么。

original: You have? Oh my. This brings to light a sad affair for the Brotherhood. But perhaps it is something that you can assist us with.
translation: 你有吗？天啊。这对兄弟会来说是件悲伤的事。但这有些事或许你能帮忙。

original: If you have the time, I have an offer for you.
translation: 如果你有时间，我有个提议。

original: All clear, Sentinel. Five mutants released from their torment. The rest are keeping their heads down.
translation: 警报解除，铁卫。超渡了五个变种人。其他的都跑了。

original: A new recruit?
translation: 一个新兵？

original: Welcome!
translation: 欢迎啊！

original: Oh my goodness! I must see it... please!
translation: 天啊！我一定要看一看…… 请让我看看吧！

original: Oh my... it's more beautiful than I could have ever imagined!
translation: 噢，天啊…… 它的美丽完全超出我的想象！

original: I can't thank you enough. I wish I had something to give you, a more suitable reward for all your efforts.
translation: 我无法表达我的谢意。我想我可以给你些什么，相对你的辛劳更适合的报酬。

original: All I can give you is the frequency to my radio set. Tune in whenever you feel like listening to the strains of an old woman's violin playing.
translation: 我所能给你的就是我的电台频率。无论何时你想听的时候就调到这频率，来收听一个老妇人的小提琴演奏。

original: Ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈！

original: You're all right for a mungo, you know that?
translation: 你这个毛人还不错，你知道吗？

original: Why don't you come in. I think we can trust you.
translation: 为什么你不进来呢，我想我们能信任你了。

original: Ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈！

original: You're pretty funny for a mungo.
translation: 你是个非常有趣的毛人。

original: Why don't you come on in?
translation: 为什么你不进来呢？

original: Ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈！

original: You're pretty funny for a mungo.
translation: 你是个非常有趣的毛人。

original: Why don't you come on in?
translation: 为什么你不进来呢？

original: Here's a menu.
translation: 拿好菜单。

original: If I must.
translation: 如果必须的话。

original: For you, I always offer my best price.
translation: 我一直给你最优惠的价格。

original: Straight to the point. I like that.
translation: 开门见山。我喜欢这样。

original: What'll you have?
translation: 你要什么？

original: Commin' up.
translation: 就来。

original: We've got all kinds of chems.
translation: 我有各种药品。

original: Need to do some killin' eh?
translation: 想杀点什么人？

original: Here is our menu, sir.
translation: 先生，给你菜单。

original: Here is our menu, ma'am.
translation: 女士，给你菜单。

original: Let's get high.
translation: 咱们来开心吧。

original: After what you did? Only because I have to.
translation: 在你做了那事之后？只是因为我必须。

original: Anything for you! You sure fixed Bannon good.
translation: 愿为你效劳！你真把班侬给修理了一顿。

original: I've got a little bit of everything.
translation: 我各种货品都有一点。

original: Whatchya lookin' for?
translation: 你在找什么？

original: Take a look at our menu.
translation: 看看我的菜单。

original: Please place your order.
translation: 请决定你要什么。

original: One, one thousand. Two, one thousand... Come on!
translation: 一零零一，一零零二……拜托！

original: Hang on, Catherine! Hang on...
translation: 坚持住，凯瑟琳！坚持住……

original: You were supposed to stay put. You could've had a good life in the Vault.
translation: 你本该待在那。你本可以在避难所里过上安稳的生活。

original: But I suppose it's too late to go back now, isn't it? The Overseer would likely have us shot on sight.
translation: 但我想现在回去也太晚了，不是吗？监督者见到我们就会开枪。

original: Well then, you'll just have to come with me to Rivet City. You've certainly proven yourself capable enough.
translation: 嗯，那你就跟我去铆钉城吧。你已经证明了自己的能力。

original: You can do it!
translation: 你能做到！

original: All right. Come on. Let's go see if your little friend Amata wants to play...
translation: 好的，来吧。让我们去看看你的小朋友阿玛塔想不想玩玩……

original: Authorized ticketholders, please proceed to the main platform.
translation: 持票者验证通过，请前往主月台。

original: I know, I was thinking about that. The lab at the facility had some old Pre-War computers that we scavenged. One of them might be useful.
translation: 我知道，我也在想这个问题。在工厂的实验室里有几台我们搜索到的战前旧电脑。其中一台可能会有用。

original: It's as important to me as ever, Madison. I know it's important to you too. Let's finish it together.
translation: 这对我来说像过去一样重要，麦迪逊。我知道对你也很重要。让我们一起完成它。

original: You haven't lost any of your passion, have you James?
translation: 你的激情没有被岁月磨灭，对吧，詹姆斯？

original: If only your mother...
translation: 如果你母亲……

original: ...The Enclave? What are they doing here... They're where? Madison, lock the door!
translation: ……英克雷？他们在这干嘛……他们在哪？麦迪逊，关门！

original: Please remain in your assigned areas while we get this sorted out...
translation: 在我们弄清楚之前，请留在指定的区域……

original: Everyone, listen; it seems we have some visitors. I don't know who they are or what they want.
translation: 大家听着，看来我们有客人来了。我不知道他们是谁，也不知道他们想要干什么。

original: We have a singular opportunity here; a chance to make the Wasteland a better place for... what? What's that?
translation: 我们现在有一个千载难逢的良机，一个让废土变的更加美好的机会，让……等一下，那是什么？

original: I'd like to thank you all for returning to this project after so many years. I know some of you thought; like me, that this day would never come.
translation: 我要感谢大家在这么多年后重返这个工程。我知道你们有些人认为这一天永远不会到来。

original: Once the mainframe is online, we'll be able to access the database, and hopefully learn where we can find a G.E.C.K.
translation: 主机一旦上线，我们就能访问数据库，希望能找到G.E.C.K的下落。

original: There's a lot of deterioration in the pipes, and some damage to the substructure, but it's nothing we can't fix.
translation: 管道有很多老化的地方，下部结构也有一些损坏，但是没有什么是我们修复不了的。

original: We've restored power to the mainframe, which is coming online now.
translation: 我们已经恢复了主机的供电，它正在联机中。

original: All right everyone, you should be able to hear me now.
translation: 好了，各位，你们应该能听到我说话了吧。

original: I think we're out of wine, but I'll check.
translation: 葡萄酒好像没了，我要看一下。

original: He's not like that, dad. Diego's a gentleman... unfortunately.
translation: 他不是那样的人，爸爸。迭戈是个绅士……可惜。

original: I like sitting next to you. I... never mind.
translation: 我喜欢坐在你旁边。我……算了。

original: I am...I mean, thank you, Mr. Holmes.
translation: 我是……我意思是，谢谢你，福尔摩斯先生。

original: Oh. So you did.
translation: 噢。所以你这么做了。

original: Not yet, sweetheart. Finish your meal first.
translation: 还不行，亲爱的。先把饭吃完

original: Don't make a fuss over it. Their just kids. Besides, maybe C.J. will rub off on James and not the other way around.
translation: 别大惊小怪。他们不过是孩子。还有长江没准会让詹姆斯改好，她不会变坏的。

original: Amen. We have each other, and we have C.J.
translation: 阿门。我们拥有彼此，我们拥有长江。

original: The transformer is still touch and go. Doctor Li hopes her most recent tests will be good.
translation: 变压器仍不稳定。李博士希望她最近的测试结果能让人满意。

original: Give me a Brahmin steak, potato, and a beer.
translation: 给我双头牛肉排，土豆，还有啤酒。

original: Fucking junk heap. I should start eating at Gary's.
translation: 他妈的垃圾。我要去加里厨房吃饭了。

original: James? Who knows where that little shit has run off to. Mind your own business, Brock. I'm going to get a drink.
translation: 詹姆斯？谁知道这小崽子跑哪去了。管好你自己的事，布洛克。给我来点喝的就好。

original: Huh? I don't get it. Never mind. Just buy me another drink.
translation: 呃？我没明白。没关系。再请我喝一杯吧。

original: Your food is very nourishing, Vera.
translation: 你这的食物都很有营养，薇拉。

original: I suppose you're right. Being back here after all this time, I can't help but be a little concerned.
translation: 我猜你是对的。你终于回来了，我没帮上忙，只能聊表关心。

original: I'm already taking care of that. I'll let you know if there are any abnormal results.
translation: 我已经注意到了。如果有什么异常结果，我会告知你。

original: Doctor Li asked me to keep an eye on the power relays in level 3, but I'll take care of that for you.
translation: 李博士让我留意三层的动力继电器，但我要帮你留意这。

original: Yes sir. I'll attend to that in just a moment.
translation: 是的，长官。稍后我会留意的。

original: It's fine, Madison. Everything is taken care of. There's no reason to be nervous.
translation: 很好，麦迪逊。都在掌握中，不必紧张。

original: We haven't forgotten anything. We're on top of the situation. Come on, we're professionals!
translation: 我们什么都没有忘。我状态良好。来吧，我们是专家！

original: Make sure to stay in contact with Daniel and Alex. I'm waiting for a report from them.
translation: 确保和丹尼尔与亚历克斯的联系。我正等待他们报告。

original: When you have a moment, can you check the pressure on tanks 3 and 4? I'm concerned there may be a leak.
translation: 如果你有空，能不能检查下3号和4号罐的压力？我担心那有泄漏。

original: Did we forget to compensate for the power fluctuations in our last calculation? I'd hate to see us short something out now.
translation: 我们上次计算是不是忘了需要补偿的能量波动？我痛恨我们总是丢三落四。

original: I'm concerned that we're overlooking something, James. I don't want us to be too hasty.
translation: 我现在关心的是我们期待已久的东西，詹姆斯。我不希望我们太过草率。

original: Yes, Doctor?
translation: 博士，什么事？

original: Out already? Something wrong with the sights on that thing?
translation: 已经用完了吗？瞄准器有问题吗？

original: Here you go, honey.
translation: 甜心，拿好。

original: Out already? Something wrong with the sights on that thing?
translation: 已经用完了吗？瞄准器有问题吗？

original: Here you go, son.
translation: 小子，拿好。

original: Since when? Regardless, I think you'll like this one. You're getting older, and you've got your Pip-Boy. I figure you're old enough for this, too.
translation: 什么时候开始的？不管怎样，我想你会喜欢这个。你够大了，你也有了你的哔哔小子。我认为你也到了用它的年纪。

original: Your own BB gun! It's a little old, but it should work perfectly.
translation: 你有BB枪了！尽管有点旧，不过应该很好用。

original: Jonas found it down here. It was in pretty rough shape -- took us a good three months to find the parts to get it working again.
translation: 乔纳斯在这下面找到它。它锈得不行 — 我们用了整整三个月来找零件修好它。

original: You know how tough it is to find a spring that small? Good thing Butch "misplaced" that switchblade of his. Ha ha ha!
translation: 你知道找到个这么小的弹簧有多难？还好布奇把他的弹簧刀“放错了”地方。哈哈哈！

original: So, what do you think? Want to give it a try?
translation: 怎么样？想试试吗？

original: The Overseer gave you your Pip-Boy, and you're old enough to do some work. So I figure you’re old enough for this.
translation: 监督者给你一个哔哔小子，你也够大了，可以做些工作了。因此，我觉得这件事你也够年龄了。

original: Your own BB gun! It's a little old, but it should work perfectly.
translation: 你有BB枪了！尽管有点旧，不过应该很好用。

original: Jonas found it down here. It was in pretty rough shape -- took us a good three months to find the parts to get it working again.
translation: 乔纳斯在这下面找到它。它锈得不行 — 我们用了整整三个月来找零件修好它。

original: You know how tough it is to find a spring that small? Good thing Butch "misplaced" that switchblade of his. Ha ha ha!
translation: 你知道找到个这么小的弹簧有多难？还好布奇把他的弹簧刀“放错了”地方。哈哈哈！

original: So, what do you think? Want to give it a try?
translation: 怎么样？想试试吗？

original: God and Saint Monica hear my sermons. That's good enough for me.
translation: 上帝和圣莫尼卡听到我的布道。这对我就足够了。

original: Head on in, partner. Ya’ll enjoy your stay now.
translation: 进去吧，伙伴。祝你们住得愉快。

original: That zombie's a real corpse now!
translation: 那丧尸现在是真的尸体了！

original: One less of those things to deal with.
translation: 又少了一个那种玩意。

original: Damn it. I kill one and three more show up!
translation: 该死。我杀了一个，又冒出三个！

original: How many of these things do we have to kill?
translation: 我们有多少这些东西要杀？

original: He's down!
translation: 他倒下了！

original: We was kin!
translation: 我们是主宰者！

original: You killed him!
translation: 你杀了他！

original: Make you regret that...
translation: 你会为此后悔的…

original: This ain't over yet!
translation: 这没完！

original: You'll pay for that!
translation: 你要为此付出代价！

original: No... NO! You bastards!
translation: 不…不！你们这些混蛋！

original: Man down!
translation: 有人阵亡！

original: It's not over... you hear me!?
translation: 这事可没完…听到了吗！？

original: Sons of bitches!
translation: 狗娘养的！

original: They killed him!
translation: 他们杀了他！

original: He's dead!
translation: 他死了！

original: They killed her!
translation: 他们杀了她！

original: Nooo!
She's dead!
translation: 她死了！

original: Man down, man down!
translation: 有人员伤亡，有人员伤亡！

original: Bastard! You'll pay for that!
translation: 杂种！你会付出代价！

original: I'll make you pay for that!
translation: 我要让你血债血偿！

original: Damn it!
translation: 该死！

original: Shit. Lost one.
translation: 狗屎。敌人不见了。

original: Gah!
translation: 嗨！

original: A Brother has fallen!
translation: 一个兄弟会的倒下了！

original: You dare take the life of a Brother of Steel!
translation: 你敢夺走钢铁兄弟会的人的性命！

original: His was a good death.
translation: 他死得其所。

original: Focus, Brothers. Focus on the enemy!
translation: 注意，兄弟们。注意敌人！

original: Let his death not be in vain!
translation: 不要让他死的毫无价值！

original: Hell yeah! How do you like me now!
translation: 见鬼！你怎么做的和我一样！

original: Thought you could take me, did you?
translation: 觉得你能干掉我，对吧？

original: Dead!
translation: 死了！

original: He'll be remembered.
translation: 我们会记住他。

original: I will avenge you.
translation: 我要为你报仇。

original: There's no place for disgrace.
translation: 耻辱无处容身。

original: Man down! Man down!
translation: 有人阵亡！有人阵亡！

original: Unit down!
translation: 倒下一个！

original: Rest easy, soldier!
translation: 平安无事，士兵！

original: Reporting in... we're down a man.
translation: 报告……我们失去了一个人。

original: We have a casualty!
translation: 我们有一个伤员！

original: You've done your deed for God and country.
translation: 你是为上帝和国家捐躯的。

original: Dumbass.
translation: 闭嘴。

original: More loot for me!
translation: 我要更多的战利品！

original: Dammit! They owed me 50 caps!
translation: 她妈的！他们欠我50个瓶盖！

original: Goddamn, I'm glad that wasn't me!
translation: 该死，很高兴那不是我！

original: Oh, you're gonna pay for that.
translation: 哦，你要为此付出代价。

original: <sound of spitting>
Now I'm REALLY mad!
translation: 现在我“真的”疯了！

original: Son of a bitch!
translation: 狗娘养的！

original: You'll pay for that!
translation: 你要为此付出代价！

original: This ain't over yet!
translation: 这没完！

original: Dammit! That was our fourth for poker!
translation: 妈的！他倒了我们就三缺一了！

original: Man down! Man down!
translation: 有人阵亡！有人阵亡！

original: Man down!
translation: 有人阵亡！

original: We've lost one.
translation: 我们失去了一个人。

original: Reporting in... we have a soldier down.
translation: 报告……我们的一个士兵倒下了。

original: No! Dammit...
translation: 不！她妈的……

original: I'll make them pay for that.
translation: 我要让他们付出代价。

original: Go in peace, Brother.
translation: 安详地去吧，兄弟。

original: You can't kill us all!
translation: 你不可能杀了我们所有人！

original: Nooooo!
translation: 不！

original: He is fallen!
translation: 他倒下了！

original: Dead! No!!
translation: 死了！不！！

original: Bastard! You'll pay for that!
translation: 杂种！你会付出代价！

original: I can't look!
translation: 我看不下去了！

original: No!
translation: 不！

original: Oh no!
translation: 哦，不！

original: This can't be happening!
translation: 这不可能！

original: Please no!
translation: 请不要！

original: Somebody help!
translation: 快来帮忙！

original: Damnit. I'm just trying to keep the peace.
translation: 该死。我只是想维持和平。

original: Goddamnit. Everyone stand the hell down! Let's solve this peacefully.
translation: 该死。见鬼，都闭嘴！让我们和平地解决它。

original: Dead. Great.
translation: 死了。太好了。

original: Now I'm pissed.
translation: 现在我怒了。

original: Argh!
translation: 啊！

original: There. You see? Natural selection at its finest.
translation: 你看到了吗？物竞天择，适者生存。

original: Death can be so messy, can't it.
translation: 死相真是难看，对不。

original: I hope someone deals with that body soon. I detest the smell of rotting flesh.
translation: 我希望有人立刻处理下尸体。我讨厌腐尸的味道。

original: Death is such nasty business.
translation: 死亡是这么肮脏的事。

original: Oh my God!
translation: 哦，我的天啊！

original: No!
translation: 不！

original: Oh no!
translation: 哦，不！

original: This can't be happening!
translation: 这不可能！

original: Please no!
translation: 请不要！

original: Somebody help!
translation: 救命！

original: They killed him!
translation: 他们杀了他！

original: They killed her!
translation: 他们杀了她！

original: Nooooooo!
Move... MOVE!
translation: 走……快走！

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Moooove!
Heads down!
translation: 低头！

original: Watch out!
translation: 注意！

original: Nooooo!
translation: 不！

original: Whoa!
translation: 哇！

original: Duck!
translation: 卧倒！

original: Protect yourself!
translation: 保护自己！

original: It's live!
translation: 会爆炸的！

original: Get back!
translation: 回来！

original: Get away from it!
translation: 离开它！

original: Watch your ass!
translation: 当心后面！

original: Well get going, then! Open the door! What's taking you so damn long? Hurry up!
translation: 快啊！开门！怎么他妈的花了这么长时间？快点！

original: I'll be damned. Really? Good job kid! I was willing to unleash the Ferals and kill all those bigots. Guess I don't have to now.
translation: 该死。真的？做的好，孩子！我当时还想让那些狂尸鬼杀了那些种族分子。现在看来不用了。

original: Here's a little something for your troubles, it'll help you deal with our Feral brethren if you meet any.
translation: 这有样东西报答你，它能让你不用再担心我们的疯狂兄弟。

original: Try it if you like. Go talk to Tenpenny. Ask him he wants us living there. It won't work. So when you fail, we can do it my way.
translation: 如果你想就试试吧。去和特佩尼谈谈。让他同意我们住进去。不过这是没用的，要是你失败的话，再按我的方法做吧。

original: It won't work. So when you fail, we can do it my way.
translation: 没用的。要是你失败的话，再按我的方法做吧。

original: Ha! Those snooty bitches probably can't stand living with each other, let alone with us.
translation: 哈！那些傲慢的混账们相互间都快无法忍受了，更别说和我们住在一起。

original: But by all means, try talking to Tenpenny if you like. But it won't work. Then we'll do it my way.
translation: 话说回来，这也是个办法，你可以试着努力和特佩尼谈谈。但是要是不成，那我就按我的方法做。

original: You get that escape door in the Tenpenny basement open, and I'll unleash those ferals on 'em!
translation: 你把特佩尼地下室的逃生门打开，那我就能放那些狂尸鬼进去了！

original: Ha! Those snooty bitches probably can't stand living with each other, let alone with us.
translation: 哈！那些傲慢的混账们相互间都快无法忍受了，更别说和我们住在一起。

original: It won't work. Then we'll do it my way.
translation: 没用的话，那我们就按我的方法做。

original: You get that escape door in the Tenpenny basement open, and I'll unleash those ferals on 'em!
translation: 你把特佩尼地下室的逃生门打开，那我就能放那些狂尸鬼进去了！

original: Honey? Over here; the intercom.
translation: 亲爱的？来对讲机这。

original: Son? Over here; the intercom.
translation: 儿子？来对讲机这。

original: Rubbish! You must be daft. Look around! Where else in the Wasteland have you seen such magnificence, I ask you?
translation: 垃圾！你一定很愚蠢。到处看看！我问你，在废土上你还看到过这样富丽堂皇的地方吗？

original: I had the great fortune to run into Mister Burke, an absolute gem of a man. He certainly has a way of getting done what needs to get done, doesn't he?
translation: 我很幸运地遇到了伯克先生，他绝对是个好人。他总是有办法完成要做的事，不是吗？

original: Then it was a matter of getting the right type of tenants with the right type of assets, and the rest is, as they say, history.
translation: 接下来重要的就是为房产找到合适的住客，至于其他，如他们所说，都已经是历史了。

original: I say! Must you be so caustic? Come now, a lot of work went into turning this husk of a tower into a place people can call home.
translation: 我说！你非得这么刻薄吗？拜托，要想把这废弃的大厦变成一个人们可以称之为家的地方，要花不少心血的。

original: I've had help, of course. Especially in Mister Burke, an absolute gem of a man. He certainly has a way of getting done what needs to get done.
translation: 当然喽，我有帮手的。尤其是伯克先生，一个人才。他总是有办法完成要做的事。

original: Then it was a matter of getting the right type of tenants with the right type of assets, and the rest is, as they say, history.
translation: 接下来重要的就是为房产找到合适的住客，至于其他，如他们所说，都已经是历史了。

original: Righto! When I saw this place jutting up out of the horizon, I knew what I had to do! I hired some muscle and we got this place fixed up right quick.
translation: 对头！当我看到这地方从地平线冒出来的时候，我就知道该怎么做了！我雇了些肌肉男，然后很快就把这地方搞定了。

original: I had the great fortune to run into Mister Burke, an absolute gem of a man. He certainly has a way of getting done what needs to get done, doesn't he?
translation: 我很幸运地遇到了伯克先生，他绝对是个好人。他总是有办法完成要做的事，不是吗？

original: Then it was a matter of getting the right type of tenants with the right type of assets, and the rest is, as they say, history.
translation: 接下来重要的就是为房产找到合适的住客，至于其他，照他们的说法，都已经是历史了。

original: Please explain, but I warn you, I am well versed on the tactics of the underhanded Redcoat spy. You'd do well to remember that.
translation: 请解释，但我警告你，我很熟悉红衣军间谍的阴险伎俩。你最好记着这一点。

original: James, this is wrong. You can't do this.
translation: 詹姆斯，这样不好。你不能这么做。

original: Madison, please. Now's not the time. I'll get the information the Colonel needs, but I need you to...
translation: 麦迪逊，求你了。现在不是时候。我会给上校他需要的信息，但我需要你……

original: I won't help you do this James. Not after everything it took to get here.
translation: 我不会帮你的，詹姆斯，我付出了这么多才来到这里。

original: I need you to monitor the output levels on pumps three and four. Please step over to the panel and keep an eye on them, will you?
translation: 我需要你监控三号和四号泵的输出水平。请到控制台那里看着它们，可以吗？

original: What? What are you talking about? That doesn't even make sense...
translation: 什么？你在说什么？这甚至毫无意义……

original: Madison, please. It's very important that you do this right now. Just step over to the panel while I access the computer in the control booth.
translation: 麦迪逊，拜托。你现在这么做很重要。我访问控制室的电脑的时候，你只要走到控制面板那边就行了。

original: James, I...
translation: 詹姆斯，我……

original: Please. Just monitor the pumps.
translation: 拜托。只要盯着水泵就好。

original: Back off, man. That's my stuff.
translation: 退后，伙计。这是我的东西。

original: Hey buddy, Bar's over here if you need something.
translation: 嗨，伙计，吧台在这，你要是需要什么的话，只管说。

original: Stacey! Open the gate, and let this mungo in!
translation: 斯泰西！开门，让毛人进去！

original: Yeah right. Good luck soldier. I'm not coming after you to rescue your ass if you get in trouble. You're on your own.
translation: 是嘛，祝你好运，士兵。如果你遇到麻烦，我也不会去救你。你自求多福吧。

original: Roy Phillips and his gang are somewhere in Warrington Station Metro tunnels. They've barred the main entrance. Try going through the train yard.
translation: 罗伊·菲利普斯和他的那伙人在沃灵顿站地铁隧道里。他们封锁了主入口。试试从火车站那边进去吧。

original: Yeah right. Good luck soldier. I'm not coming after you to rescue your ass if you get in trouble. You're on your own.
translation: 是嘛，祝你好运，士兵。如果你遇到麻烦，我也不会去救你。你只求多福吧。

original: Here, you can take this rifle and ammo. But don't waste it shooting at shadows.
translation: 给，你可以拿上这把步枪和子弹。不过别放空枪。

original: Roy Phillips and his gang are somewhere in Warrington Station Metro tunnels. They've barred the main entrance. Try going through the train yard.
translation: 罗伊·菲利普斯和他的那伙人在沃灵顿站地铁隧道里。他们封锁了主入口。试试从火车站那边进去吧。

original: Here, you can take this rifle and ammo. But don't waste it shooting at shadows.
translation: 给，你可以拿上这把步枪和子弹。不过别放空枪。

original: Well... maybe you're right. It was something I was going to have to do eventually anyway. How about another 200 caps?
translation: 好吧……也许你是对的。反正这事我迟早都得去解决。再多200瓶盖怎么样？

original: And here. You can take this rifle and ammo.
translation: 还有，给。这把步枪和弹药给你。

original: But you better not screw this up!
translation: 但你最好别搞砸了！

original: Roy Phillips and his gang are somewhere in Warrington Station Metro tunnels. They've barred the main entrance. Try going through the train yard.
translation: 罗伊·菲利普斯和他的那伙人在沃灵顿站地铁隧道里。他们封锁了主入口。试试从火车站那边进去吧。

original: Well... maybe you're right. It was something I was going to have to do eventually anyway. How about another 200 caps?
translation: 好吧……也许你是对的。反正这事我迟早都得去解决。再多200瓶盖怎么样？

original: And here. You can take this rifle and ammo.
translation: 还有，给。这把步枪和弹药给你。

original: But you better not screw this up!
translation: 但你最好别搞砸了！

original: Like I tell my men: Don't bother reporting in, unless it's to tell me you got the job done.
translation: 像我告诉我弟兄们的：别费心向我汇报，除非是告诉我你完成任务了。

original: Really? You? You're welcome to give it a try. But don't come crying to me when you get hurt.
translation: 真的？你？欢迎你去试试，但受伤了可别来找我哭诉。

original: They've holed up in the nearby metro tunnels. They're living with packs of Feral Ghouls. Be careful, Roy seems damn close to turning zombie himself.
translation: 他们躲在附近的地铁隧道里，和一堆狂尸鬼生活在一起。小心点，罗伊自己似乎也快变成丧尸了。

original: I suppose you won't be doing this out of the kindness of your heart, huh?
translation: 我猜你这么做不是出于好心吧？

original: How's 500 bottlecaps sound? Payable upon termination of that damn Ghoul, Roy Phillips, and all his followers.
translation: 500个瓶盖怎么样？杀了该死的尸鬼罗伊·菲利普斯，和他所有的手下，就给钱。

original: Really? You? You're welcome to give it a try. But don't come crying to me when you get hurt.
translation: 真的？你？欢迎你去试试，但受伤了可别来找我哭诉。

original: Be careful, Roy seems damn close to turning zombie himself.
translation: 小心点，罗伊似乎就快变成丧尸了。

original: I suppose you won't be doing this out of the kindness of your heart, huh?
translation: 我猜你这么做不是出于好心吧？

original: How's 500 bottlecaps sound? Payable upon termination of that damn Ghoul, Roy Phillips, and all his followers.
translation: 500个瓶盖怎么样？杀了该死的尸鬼罗伊·菲利普斯，和他所有的手下，就给钱。

original: You're out of line. Those filthy bitches can stay living in those metro tunnels. They'll move in here over my dead body.
translation: 你过分了。那些肮脏的婊子只能住在那些地铁隧道里。不然就让他们跨过我的尸体住进来。

original: Well... not exactly. But my colleagues have published papers...
translation: 嗯……还没有。但我的同事发表了篇论文……

original: I suppose someone ought to verify their findings... Perhaps I'll do that. Who knows? I might even finally get published!
translation: 我猜有人会去核实他们的发现……也许就是我。谁知道呢？我的论文可能也会出版！

original: Ahem. I advise you to speak more civilly. Perhaps you can go enlighten Chief Gustavo. I have pressing "evil minion" things to do.
translation: 哼。我建议你说话再讲礼些。你可能得去启迪一下古斯塔沃长官。我还有些“魔鬼仆从”的事要做。

original: If you can do a better job than Chief Gustavo, perhaps you can go enlighten him. I have important matters to attend to. If you'll excuse me?
translation: 如果你能比古斯塔沃长官做得更好，或许你可以给他些指导。我还有别的要事要办。不介意吧？

original: That damn Roy Phillips won't take no for an answer. Keeps showing up, looking for a handout. He and his kind aren't wanted. End of story.
translation: 该死的罗伊·菲利普斯可不接受不行这个答案。常来寻求施舍，自讨没趣。他和他那类东西是不会被我们接受的。故事结束。

original: If I were a betting man, I'd place a stack of caps on him trying something violent soon.
translation: 如果我是赌鬼，我会把大把的钱押在他身上，赌他要不了多久就会使用暴力。

original: And that would make Tenpenny nervous. I don't like it when Tenpenny gets nervous.
translation: 那会让特佩尼紧张。特佩尼紧张的时候，我可不喜欢。

original: But I can't spare the manpower to go hunt down Roy Phillips and his band of misfits, or I'd gladly end this thing once and for all.
translation: 但是我不够人手去清除掉罗伊·菲利普斯和他那帮废物，否则我会很高兴地结束这件事。

original: If they got in here, they'd get their filth over everything. You can smell them a mile away!
translation: 要是他们住了进来，那这儿的一切都会被弄得污秽不堪。你能在一里外闻到他们的臭味！

original: I hope they come back and get killed by security.
translation: 我希望他们回来，然后被警卫干掉。

original: They were told they can't live here. But those zombies are too stupid to understand.
translation: 我们已经说过他们不能住进来。但是这些丧尸太愚蠢，听不明白。

original: They live in their own filth, squatting in the nearby metro tunnel. Security keeps shooting them, but they keep coming back.
translation: 他们住在他们的垃圾堆里，蜗居在附近的地铁隧道里。警卫见到他们就朝他们射击，但是他们总是又跑回来。

original: Don't you worry about any such thing, sir. Care to wet your whistle?
translation: 你不用担心这种事，先生。要不要来杯喝的？

original: Don't you worry about any such thing. Care to wet your whistle?
translation: 你不用担心这种事。要不要来杯喝的？

original: I'm sure it will end in bloodshed. It's serious business, comrade.
translation: 我肯定这事最后会造成流血冲突。这是很严肃的事情，同志。

original: They're living in the nearby tunnels. They scare me!
translation: 他们住在附近的隧道里。他们让我感到害怕！

original: Why doesn't somebody do something!
translation: 为什么没人去解决这事！

original: Are you going to do something about the problem, or not?
translation: 你要去把这问题解决掉，是吧？

original: Some Ghouls moved into the nearby Metro tunnel. There's a bunch of the so-called Feral Ghouls in there, but a handful seem the sociable type.
translation: 有一群尸鬼搬进了附近的地铁隧道。里面大部分是所谓的“狂尸鬼”，但也有少数看起来能正常交流的。

original: I've tried explaining to my fellow tenants that not all Ghouls are monsters. But they don't seem to care.
translation: 我试着跟其他住户解释并非所有尸鬼都是怪物。但他们似乎根本不在乎。

original: The intelligent ones should stay away from our trigger happy protectors. If there're enough feral ones though, they could overwhelm security.
translation: 有智慧的本应远离我们这些爱扣扳机的保安。但要是发狂的数量够多，他们可能会突破安保。

original: We have the situation... contained.
translation: 我们已经抑制了情况……的恶化。

original: Chief Gustavo assures us that he's increased the number of the security team, and will kill any zombies on sight.
translation: 古斯塔沃长官向我们保证，他已增派安保队，见到丧尸即刻击毙。

original: We haven't discussed this already? Apparently there's a pack of zombies living in the tunnels. Gustavo says he has it under control.
translation: 我们还没谈过这事吗？显而易见，隧道里住着一群丧尸。古斯塔沃说他已经控制了局势。

original: On the bright side, it's given me another reason to hit the drink!
translation: 令人高兴，这给了我们另一个干杯的理由！

original: There's a pack of zombies living nearby in some old tunnel. They asked to move in. Naturally, they were told to go to hell.
translation: 有一群丧尸住在附近的旧隧道里。他们想住进来。当然，我们叫他们滚蛋。

original: Gustavo's hired some additional goons. Seems to be working. Still, makes one a bit fidgety having those loathsome creatures around.
translation: 古斯塔沃又雇了些打手。似乎有点用。不过，有这些可恶的家伙在身边，还是让人有点不安。

original: I wouldn't even want them as slaves!
translation: 让他们当奴隶我都不要！

original: Again with the Ghouls! It's all anyone will gossip about. I can't help thinking about them... doing things to us. Let's talk about something else.
translation: 又是尸鬼！大家都在说闲话。我不禁想到他们……对我们做的事。还是说点别的吧。

original: My current theory is that the destructive disease of the Ghoul condition will always eventually render him little more than a mindless killer.
translation: 我现在的理论认为尸鬼身体所受的严重缺陷最终会导致他变成一个冷血的杀手。

original: The proverbial Wasteland "zombie" with a predilection for raw human flesh.
translation: 众所周知，废土上的“丧尸”嗜好吃活人肉。

original: They can't be cured. And there's nothing to alleviate the symptoms. All in all, it seems rather sad, really.
translation: 他们不能被治愈。也没什么东西能减轻他们的症状。总而言之，他们真的很可悲。

original: It's a piece of Utopia jutting up from the Wasteland. Tenpenny is a true visionary. I do my part to assist him in unfolding his Master Plan.
translation: 这儿就像是废土中的乌托邦。特佩尼是个真正的梦想家。我尽职尽责帮他扩展他的宏伟蓝图。

original: This tower is the symbol of true progress in this world! People are dying to get in here. Just ask those Ghouls.
translation: 这大厦真是世界进步的象征！人们拼了命也想住进来。比如那些尸鬼。

original: Whoa, twenty caps! Look at the big spender! Alright then, I can see you're in it for the big money, so I'll tell you all about Moriarty's.
translation: 哇，20个瓶盖！看看这大富翁！好吧，看在你出这钱的份上，我会告诉你所有莫里亚蒂的事。

original: Moriarty, he's a ratfuck bastard for sure, but he's also paranoid as all hell. So paranoid that he don't let no one handle the cash around here.
translation: 莫里亚蒂就是他妈个混蛋，也是他妈个偏执狂，所以他不会让任何人碰他的钱。

original: Every night, he takes what Gob and Nova earn and locks it in a file cabinet next to his bed.
translation: 每天晚上，他拿走盖博和诺瓦赚的钱，锁到他床边的一个柜子里。
