original: Ha ha! You're gonna have to do better than that, kid! Thanks for the drink, though.
translation: 哈哈！孩子，你其实应该再大方一点！不管怎么样，谢谢这杯喝的。

original: Don't care. The only way those Ghouls are getting in is over my dead body.
translation: 那不关我事。除非我死了，不然尸鬼别想进来。

original: I guess so.
translation: 我想是的。

original: Ha! I don't suppose I'd mind terribly if Ghouls were to live here. And it'd be a good bit of sport hunting them down if they misbehaved.
translation: 哈！我在想我允许尸鬼住进来后会出现什么麻烦。如果他们犯错的话，那会是个不错的狩猎机会的。

original: I dare say though, you'll have a bit of trouble convincing certain residents to go along with your novel proposition.
translation: 我敢这么说，要是你去游说住客同意你天方夜谭式的想法的话，会惹大麻烦的。

original: Tell you what. If you can convince Mr. and Mrs. Wellington, Mr. Ling, Ms. Montenegro, and Ms. Lancaster, those Ghouls can live here.
translation: 告诉你吧。如果你能说服威灵顿夫妇，林先生，黑山小姐和兰卡斯特小姐，那些尸鬼就可以住进来。

original: Have you seen me shoot? I'm quite proficient, if I do say so myself.
translation: 没见过我射击吗？如果让我评价自己的话,我会说非常的准。

original: In time, after Tenpenny's projects have come to fruition, things like Ghouls and other aberrations of nature will be a thing of the past.
translation: 假以时日，在特佩尼的计划取得成果后，像尸鬼和其他自然界的畸形生物将成为过去。

original: These times are the crucible for a glorious future. One shouldn't be overly concerned with who gets burned in the process.
translation: 这个时代是辉煌未来的熔炉。在这个过程中，我们不应该过分在意谁会被烧死。

original: Really? Well... As long as they don't bother me... I guess, I really don't care.
translation: 真的？好吧……只要他们不打扰我……我想，我真的不在乎。

original: I'm afraid I can't abide by that. I can't imagine Tenpenny would allow it. But I certainly won't.
translation: 我恐怕无法容忍这种行为。我不能想象特佩尼会同意。但是我可不会同意。

original: Ha! I think I know a fair share more than some vagrant blown in off the Wastes. You are simply mistaken.
translation: 哈！我想我认为公平分享要比在废土流浪要好吧。你犯了个小错。

original: They may appear nice, but deep down they want to kill. It's common knowledge among the educated.
translation: 他们看着不错，但是内心深处，他们想杀人。从以往的经验看，这是显而易见的。

original: You clearly don't know what you are talking about!
translation: 你完全不知道你在说什么！

original: Well... If they don't mind me giving them a thorough exam and if they agree to follow any directives I give them regarding health and hygiene...
translation: 好吧……如果他们不介意我给他们作彻底的检查，还有如果他们同意遵从我的任何指导，包括健康和卫生方面……

original: I suppose I wouldn't mind too terribly. It'd give me a chance to study Ghoul physiology.
translation: 我想我并不特别介意。这也给我机会研究尸鬼生理学。

original: I think you must have been out in the sun too long. Perhaps I could sell you a nice hat to keep your brain from frying?
translation: 我想你一定是在太阳下待的时间太久了。看来我可以卖你一个不错的帽子，防止你的脑袋烤晕？

original: Why would you hang out with dirty vermin like that? You enjoy sifting through feces?
translation: 你为什么不和那些肮脏的歹徒住在一起？你很享受泡在粪池里的感觉吧？

original: You know it's only a matter of time before they get hungry and eat you. You're crazy. Ghouls will never live in Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 你要知道他们因为饿了而来吃你只是时间问题。你疯了。尸鬼决不能住进特佩尼大厦。

original: Well, perhaps you're right, comrade. Some of these folk have a few things to learn about camaraderie, that's for sure.
translation: 好吧，可能你是对的，同志。这些家伙需要学习友情，一定要学。

original: Well... alright. I'm willing to give them a chance.
translation: 好吧……好的。我愿意给他们一个机会。

original: Well... you seem like you know what you're talking about. I guess I'd be willing to give it a try. I might not spend much time with them.
translation: 好吧……你好像知道你在说什么。我想我愿意给你个机会试试。我可能不会花太多时间和他们在一起。

original: And if they do anything stupid, I'm sure they'll get kicked out. Fine, it's ok.
translation: 如果他们做任何愚蠢的事情，我一定把他们踢出去。好的，没问题。

original: Well, if you don't mind their stink, then you should go squat with them in their dirty tunnels, and leave us civilized people alone.
translation: 好吧，如果你不介意他们身上的臭味，那么你就和他们蹲到肮脏的隧道里去吧，离开我们这些文明人。

original: Well... As long as they don't bother me... I guess, I really don't care.
translation: 好吧……只要他们不打扰我……我想，我真的不在乎。

original: I'm afraid I can't abide by that. I can't imagine Tenpenny would allow it. But I certainly won't.
translation: 我恐怕无法容忍这种行为。我不能想象特佩尼会同意。但是我可不会同意。

original: Ha! I think I know a fair share more than some vagrant blown in off the Wastes. You are simply mistaken.
translation: 哈！我想我认为公平分享要比在废土流浪要好吧。你犯了个小错。

original: Deep down they want to kill. It's common knowledge among the educated.
translation: 在内心深处，他们想杀人。这是受过教育的人的常识。

original: You clearly don't know what you are talking about!
translation: 你完全不知道你在说什么！

original: Well... If they don't mind me giving them a thorough exam and if they agree to follow any directives I give them regarding health and hygiene...
translation: 好吧……如果他们不介意我给他们作彻底的检查，还有如果他们同意遵从我的任何指导，包括健康和卫生方面……

original: I suppose I wouldn't mind too terribly. It'd give me a chance to study Ghoul physiology.
translation: 我想我并不特别介意。这也给我机会研究尸鬼生理学。

original: I think you must have been out in the sun too long. Perhaps I could sell you a nice hat to keep your brain from frying?
translation: 我想你一定是在太阳下待的时间太久了。看来我可以卖你一个不错的帽子，防止你的脑袋烤晕？

original: Why hang out with dirty vermin like that? Sifting through feces?
translation: 为什么要和那种肮脏的害虫混在一起？筛粪便？

original: You know it's only a matter of time before they get hungry and eat you. You're crazy. Ghouls will never live in Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 你要知道他们因为饿了而来吃你只是时间问题。你疯了。尸鬼决不能住进特佩尼大厦。

original: Well, perhaps you're right, comrade. Some of these folk have a few things to learn about camaraderie, that's for sure.
translation: 好吧，可能你是对的，同志。这些家伙需要学习友情，一定要学。

original: Well... alright. I'm willing to give them a chance.
translation: 好吧……好的。我愿意给他们一个机会。

original: I guess I'd be willing to give it a try. I might not spend much time with them.
translation: 我想我愿意试一试。我可能不会花太多时间和他们在一起。

original: And if they do anything stupid, I'm sure they'll get kicked out. Fine, it's ok.
translation: 如果他们做任何愚蠢的事情，我一定把他们踢出去。好的，没问题。

original: Then you should go squat with them in their dirty tunnels, and leave us civilized people alone.
translation: 那么你就和他们蹲到肮脏的隧道里去吧，别来烦我们这些文明人。

original: HELL NO! Tenpenny won't allow it. And I take my orders from him.
translation: 见鬼，不行！特佩尼不会允许的，我听命于他。

original: After Tenpenny died, I assumed full command. And since I hate Ghouls, I guess the answer to that question is pretty damn clear.
translation: 特佩尼死后，我全权负责。因为我恨尸鬼，所以我猜你能非常他妈的清楚我会回答你什么。

original: Those Ghouls can live here over my goddamn body!
translation: 那些该死的尸鬼要住进来，只能跨过我的尸体！

original: I spend most of my days out acquiring and managing various... assets for Mister Tenpenny. So it matter's little to me personally.
translation: 我每天大部分时间都在为特佩尼先生获取和管理各种……资产。所以这对我个人来说并不重要。

original: However, the Ghoulish state is a bitter reminder that things aren't yet in line with Mister Tenpenny's vision for a pure and stainless future.
translation: 不管怎样，尸鬼的凄惨状况，提醒我们事情并没圆满到像特佩尼先生展望的那纯净无瑕的美好未来。

original: So you see, Ghouls living here is simply out of the question.
translation: 你也知道，让尸鬼住在这简直不可能的。

original: I know you've been pressuring people into allowing Ghouls to live here.
translation: 我知道你在给大家施压，想让尸鬼住进来。

original: Who do you think you are, harassing honest people like that? You should be ashamed of yourself! I certainly won't allow Ghouls to live here.
translation: 你以为你是谁，这样打扰正直的人们？你应该为你感到羞耻，我当然不允许尸鬼住进来。

original: My neighbors might be out of their minds, but I am not. Those Ghouls will NOT be living here.
translation: 我的邻居可能疯了，但我没有。那些尸鬼不能住进来。

original: Ah yes. I was wondering when you'd try me.
translation: 是的。我正在想，你什么时候会来问我。

original: You may be able to coerce the others, but I'm not such a pushover. Your zombie buddies will need to find someplace else to live.
translation: 你可以去强迫其他人，但我不是懦夫。你的丧尸伙伴还是找其他地方。

original: It's my turn, eh? Well, you won't be getting me to go along with your ridiculous plan.
translation: 到我了，呃？好吧，你不要妄想我能配合你荒谬的计划。

original: Ghouls aren't human. They live in filth. They eat their own babies. You're out of your right freaking mind!
translation: 尸鬼不是人类。他们生活在污秽中。他们吃自己的孩子。你疯了吧！

original: I know all about your plan to get your Ghoul pals in here, and I'm putting a stop to it. You can't just go around pushing us around like that!
translation: 我知道你全盘计划，让你的尸鬼伙计住进来，我劝你放弃吧。你不能这样四处活动来强迫我们同意！

original: I've dealt with people like you before... people who think they know what's good for everybody else. I know what's best for me, and that's no Ghouls.
translation: 我以前也这样……人们总以为知道什么对别人好。我知道什么对我最好，其中不包括尸鬼。

original: So you can run along and tell your Ghouls they'll just have to find somewhere else to squat. Or better yet, to go off and die somewhere.
translation: 你可以去告诉你的尸鬼朋友，他们去找其他地方吧。或者出去死在哪更好。

original: Oh, I know you've been lobbying for those Ghouls... and I've already been thinking it over. I guess I would be willing to give it a try.
translation: 哦，我知道你在四处为那些尸鬼游说……我已经想过了。我想我愿意给他们机会。

original: I know you've been talking to the others about the Ghouls... and I've been mulling the whole thing over a few cocktails... well more than a few...
translation: 我知道你一直在和其他人谈尸鬼……我得喝几杯鸡尾酒才能搞明白整个事情……可能不止几杯……

original: And I've decided that I'd be willing to give it a go. Having Ghoul neighbors, I mean.
translation: 我决定了，我同意。我意思是同意让尸鬼做邻居。

original: I knew it was only a matter of time before you asked me about that... I've decided I want to do my own study of Ghoul physiology.
translation: 我知道你来问我只是时间问题……我已经决定了我想做我的尸鬼生理学研究。

original: Who knows, I could even publish my findings!
translation: 谁知道那，我甚至可能把我的发现出版！

original: You've finally got around to asking me, comrade.
translation: 你最后还是来问我了，同志。

original: I've given it a lot of careful thought. I would welcome these Ghouls into our community.
translation: 我认真想过了。我会欢迎尸鬼来我们的公社。

original: I've already formed a welcoming committee!
translation: 我已经成立了个欢迎委员会！

original: It's my turn, eh? I'm still worried, but if the others are willing to let them live here, I guess I could try it. But they better behave!
translation: 到我了，呃？我仍然担心，但是如果其他人愿意让他们住进来，我想我也可以试试让他们进来。但是他们要表现良好！

original: I've heard they carry diseases. I'd have to sanitize everything after them all the time. Besides, they are dangerous, aren't they?
translation: 我听说他们带着疾病。我必须每时每刻都跟在他们后面打扫。而且他们很危险，对吧？

original: You've heard the stories I'm sure. About the mindless ones eating brains and the like. Well, I'm not sure I'm comfortable with all that.
translation: 我知道你一定听过那些故事。他们随意吃人脑之类的事情。所以和他们一起，我不可能感到舒适。

original: Haha. You're joking right? You're serious? Of course not! Ghouls can't live here. They're dirty loathsome creatures.
translation: 哈哈。你开玩笑吗？你认真的？当然不行了！尸鬼不能住这。他们是肮脏讨厌的生物。

original: Dear lord. Are you serious? Ghouls living here? With us? That's simply out of the question.
translation: 上帝。你认真的？尸鬼和我们住一起？和我们？这绝不可能。

original: I'm not sure. My first responsibility is the health and welfare of the residents of Tenpenny Tower.
translation: 我不确定。我的首要责任是特佩尼大厦居民的健康和安全。

original: Ghouls often carry diseases due to radiation damaging their immune systems.
translation: 尸鬼经常带着疾病，因为辐射破坏了他们的免疫系统。

original: You're being serious? That's out of the question. What an absurd notion!
translation: 你认真的？这不可能。太荒谬了！

original: You can't be serious. Ghouls aren't human. They live in filth. They eat their own babies. You're out of your right freakin' mind!
translation: 你不是认真的吧。尸鬼不是人类。他们居住在污秽中。他们吃自己的小孩。你疯了吧！

original: Don't have any data in my files about that.
translation: 我是绝对不会同意的。

original: Ghouls wouldn't make the best of neighbors, comrade.
translation: 尸鬼不能成为最好的邻居，同志。

original: I don't know. I mean, they're all deformed and scary looking. I bet they're really mean, too.
translation: 我不知道。我意思是他们都畸形而且丑陋。我敢打赌他们一定很卑鄙。

original: I've come too far to share my digs with some droopy Ghoul!
translation: 我和它们差的太多了，不可能和这些猥琐的尸鬼分享住所！

original: Well, I wouldn't mind. But they'd better be civilized. The tenants here are real uppity and most wouldn't take kindly to Ghouls living here.
translation: 好吧，我不介意。但是他们最好文明点。这的住户都很傲慢，而且大多数人对尸鬼住在这并不欢迎。

original: I've already told you no!
translation: 我告诉过你，不行！

original: I believe I've told you NO!
translation: 我不是告诉了你不行吗！

original: It's not happening.
translation: 不可能。

original: I will not allow Ghouls to live here.
translation: 我不允许尸鬼住这。

original: I'm really tired of you and your Ghoul crusade.
translation: 我真的厌烦了你和你的尸鬼运动。

original: I wouldn't mind. It would certainly liven things up around here, that's for sure!
translation: 我不介意。这里生活用品很齐备，没问题！

original: I'm willing to give it a try... On a trial basis.
translation: 我愿意试试……当然是在试试的基础上。

original: Oh what the hell? It's not like anything interesting happens around here anyway.
translation: 噢，搞什么啊？这可不是件有趣的事情啊。

original: It would give me a chance to do my own study of Ghoul physiology.
translation: 那会给我个机会让我进行尸鬼生理学研究。

original: It's not really fair to deprive anyone of a community, is it? So we really ought to welcome them as comrades, shouldn't we?
translation: 剥夺任何人进入公社的权力都不公平，不是吗？所以我要欢迎他们来做我们的同志，对吧？

original: If they behave, I suppose it'd be okay with me.
translation: 如果他们表现良好，我想我同意。

original: Well! The founding fathers would be disappointed in your fiery tone.
translation: 好吧！国父一定会对你急躁的腔调失望的。

original: However, a deal is a deal. Here is your reward.
translation: 不过我说到做到，这是你的报酬。

original: Oh my lord, I never expect... I mean, I am utterly shocked!
translation: 噢，天啊，我从没想到……我意思是，我太震惊了！

original: You have earned your place in the annals of American History, yes indeed. You will be remembered for this great day!
translation: 你在美国历史中已经赢得一席之地了。你会和这个伟大的日子一起被铭记！

original: I understand the road was difficult, so allow me to present you with an extra bonus to perhaps whet your appetite for future endeavors.
translation: 我知道世道艰难，所以请收下这额外的报酬，或许能激励你未来能更加努力。

original: Enjoy your reward, my friend. You've earned it.
translation: 享受你的报酬吧，朋友。你应得的。

original: Oh my lord, I never expect... I mean, I am utterly shocked!
translation: 噢，天啊，我从没想到……我意思是，我太震惊了！

original: You have earned your place in the annals of American History, yes indeed. You will be remembered for this great day!
translation: 你在美国历史中已经赢得一席之地了。你会和这个伟大的日子一起被铭记！

original: I understand the road was difficult, so allow me to present you with an extra bonus to perhaps whet your appetite for future endeavors.
translation: 我知道世道艰难，所以请收下这额外的报酬，或许能激励你未来能更加努力。

original: Enjoy your reward, my friend. You've earned it.
translation: 享受你的报酬吧，朋友。你应得的。

original: Alright, alright, I'm just fucking with you.
translation: 好啦，好啦，我是在逗你。

original: Hrm... lemme think. No. Consider it a fee for the lesson you've learned -- don't be such a tightass next time.
translation: 嗯……让我想想。不。就把它作为你这次教训的学费 — 下次不要这么吝啬。

original: Anytime. It'll be worth it to see the look on that asshole's face.
translation: 不用谢。看看那混蛋的脸色也值得。

original: He'll probably blow your head off. That is, unless you can draw faster than a pissed off Irishman.
translation: 他可能会打掉你的脑袋。当然，除非你跑得比个发飙的爱尔兰人还快。

original: My robbin' days are over, kid. I'm just here to drink and stink.
translation: 我抢掠的日子结束了，孩子。我只能在这喝酒，发臭。

original: It's dangling around Colin's neck. Get it... if you can.
translation: 当然是挂在科林的脖子上。去拿吧……你有这能耐的话。

original: I have been a part of the Brotherhood for many years. Enough that I was here when Project Purity first began.
translation: 我作为兄弟会的成员很多年了。当净水工程刚开始的时候，我就在那。

original: I did not work directly with your father; he and his team valued their independence, and I respected that.
translation: 我并没有和你的爸爸一起工作；他和他的团队希望独立工作，我尊重他们。

original: I find your attitude and lack of respect insulting.
translation: 我发现你的态度无礼，缺乏应有的尊敬。

original: Well, I must speak to my husband about that. We could bring it up at the next homeowner's association meeting.
translation: 呃，这我得跟我丈夫说一下。我们可以拿到下次业主委员会上讨论。

original: Ah, I do love meetings so much. I think I'll bring muffins!
translation: 啊，我很喜欢这些会议。我想我会带松饼去！

original: No. Thanks, but no. I got myself into this problem, I need to get myself out.
translation: 不。谢谢，但是不用了。我自己陷入了这困境，我需要自己摆脱。

original: I'll figure something out. Look, I want to thank you for your help. I guess it took a complete stranger to show me what an ass I've been.
translation: 我会解决。听着，我想谢谢你的帮助。想不到居然是一个陌生人让我看到自己曾是一个怎样的混蛋。

original: Take this key, it's to my private stash in the water treatment plant. Just get rid of the stuff, burn it, sell it -- I don't care what happens to it.
translation: 拿着钥匙，它可以开启我在水处理厂里的隐秘藏匿处。把里面的东西处理掉、随便你是烧了也好卖了也好 — 我不关心你用什么办法。

original: I just don't know what to say. I've been stealing from both of them for years to get my fix. Where do I even start?
translation: 我只是不知道说什么。我以前从他们那偷东西来换取我的毒品。我要怎么重新开始？

original: Well, I'll figure something out. Look, I want to thank you for your help. I guess it took a complete stranger to show me what an ass I've been.
translation: 我会解决。听着，我想谢谢你的帮助。想不到居然是一个陌生人让我看到自己曾是一个怎样的混蛋。

original: Take this key, it's to my private stash in the water treatment plant. Just get rid of the stuff, burn it, sell it -- I don't care what happens to it.
translation: 拿着钥匙，它可以开启我在水处理厂里的隐秘藏匿处。把里面的东西处理掉、随便你是烧了也好卖了也好 — 我不关心你用什么办法。

original: Yeah, I can. Just please... Don't tell Andy or Jenny. And don't ask me about it when I'm at the Brass Lantern.
translation: 嗯，我能。只是请……不要告诉安迪和珍妮。我在黄铜灯的时候也不要问我这事。

original: I'll only sell to you when my shift is over. Meet me in the water treatment plant if you need something.
translation: 我只在我轮班结束后才会卖给你。如果你需要什么就到水处理厂找我。

original: I can hook you up. A solid chem dealer is hard to find out here in the Wastes, trust me. I know.
translation: 我能帮你联系。一个靠得住的药贩子在废土上是很难找的，相信我，我很了解。

original: I can only sell to you when my shift at the Lantern is over. Meet me up at the water treatment plant if you need something.
translation: 我只在我黄铜灯的轮班结束后才会卖给你。如果你需要什么就到水处理厂找我。

original: Yes, well... I am afraid that with the emergence of the Enclave, the Brotherhood is rather busy right now.
translation: 是的，好吧……恐怕由于英克雷的紧急状况，兄弟会现在相当忙。

original: I elected to take time from my responsibilities to assist you. Perhaps I was in error. Nonetheless, we may have what you seek.
translation: 我决定在我工作之余花时间来帮助你。可能我是错的。不过，我可能有你要找的东西。

original: In the archives upstairs is an old, Pre-War Vault-Tec terminal. I will send word that you need access to it.
translation: 在楼上档案室有一个旧的战前避难所科技终端。我会通知他们，让你可以登入该终端。

original: Oh, I don't know, Daring darling. I find the Ghoul's instincts to be... frighteningly accurate.
translation: 哦，我不知道，亲爱的“大胆”。我发现尸鬼的直觉……准得吓人。

original: Just over here! This large boulder! And now... the secret knock. And... voila!
translation: 就在这！那大石头！现在……用暗号敲击它。然后……看那！

original: Well, I got news for you. You're stuck up here like the rest of us. There's no going back the way you came.
translation: 好吧，我有消息给你。你像我们一样困在这了。这没有回头路。

original: So what'll it be? You going to help us get off this roof or what?
translation: 那怎么样？你帮我们离开楼顶还是不管？

original: She didn't send you? Dammit, that means she might be dead.
translation: 不是她派你来的？该死，那意味着她可能死了。

original: Forget it then, we can talk shop later. Can you help us get out of here?
translation: 算了吧，我们迟点再说。你能帮我们离开这吗？

original: She's our commander. I hope she's still alive. When I saw you come up here, I assumed she'd sent you.
translation: 她是我们长官。我希望她仍然活着。我看到你来，以为是她派你来的。

original: Well, we can chit-chat about all that later. Right now, can you help us get off this damn roof?
translation: 好吧，我们可以迟点再说。现在，能帮我们离开这该死的楼顶吗？

original: When you first arrived I was suspicious of your intentions. I can see now it was an error in judgement.
translation: 你刚来的时候我还怀疑你的目的。看来我的判断有错误。

original: I can assure you Ian will be well cared for and safe with the Family.
translation: 我保证家族会照顾好伊恩，并确保他的安全。

original: Please, I want you to take this. Consider it as an apology to you for all the hardships you had to endure finding this place.
translation: 请你拿着这些，把它当作是我对你费劲艰辛寻到此地的歉意。

original: Goodbye, human. Our time together has been rather... educational.
translation: 再见，人类。我们在一起的时间相当……有意义。

original: It saddens me to lose one of my flock, but I believe everyone has to follow their own path.
translation: 我们失去一员我很悲痛，但我相信每个人都有自己的路要走。

original: All I was attempting to do was guide him. Now it seems that responsibility has fallen upon you. I hope you will be more successful.
translation: 我所做的只是尝试引导他。现在这责任落到你身上了。希望你比我更成功。

original: Please, I want you to take this. Consider it as an apology to you for all the hardships you had to endure finding this place.
translation: 请你拿着这些，把它当作是我对你费劲艰辛寻到此地的歉意。

original: Goodbye, human. Our time together has been rather... educational.
translation: 再见，人类。我们在一起的时间相当……有意义。

original: See? That. Right there. That's the sort of shit that'll land a little girl like you in the infirmary.
translation: 看？那，就在那。那破玩意能让你这样的小女孩躺进医务室去。

original: See? That. Right there. That's the sort of shit that gets a man injured.
translation: 看？那，就在那。那破玩意能让男人受伤。

original: Brothers, today I offer a simple prayer.
translation: 兄弟，今天我将做一个简短的祷告。

original: Hail, Creator. Blessed is your power and mighty is your gift of Steel.
translation: 万岁，造物主。福佑是你的能量，非凡是你赐予钢铁兄弟会的礼物。

original: Bless us today, your noble warriors who dwell in this hall.
translation: 祝福我们吧，保佑大厅里你的战士。

original: Let us ride upon wings of thunder and chariots of glory, to bring destruction to your enemies.
translation: 让我们插上闪电的翅膀，驾驶荣誉的战车，为敌人带去毁灭。

original: To bring destruction upon your wicked enemies."
translation: 为邪恶的敌人带去毁灭。”

original: Brothers, as we take our meal this day, let us reflect upon the words of Elder Patrocolus of the Montana Bunker.
translation: 兄弟，就在我们今天就餐前，让我们回忆蒙大拿地堡的普特洛克勒斯长老的教诲。

original: "It is in service of Steel and guardianship of one's Brothers that each man finds his purpose. My friends, stand with your Brothers. Guard them...
translation: “为钢铁兄弟会服务，保护自己的兄弟，在这之中每个人都能找到他的目标。我的朋友们，和你的兄弟并肩作战、保卫他们……

original: ...guide them. And in each of them find purpose." Look around this table, my Brothers. Look into the eyes of each man and woman seated here today.
translation: ……指引他们吧。愿他们每个人都能找到目标。”看着桌前，我的兄弟。注视在座每位的眼睛。

original: Pledge in your hearts and minds, pledge by your guns that you will stand with them in battle until the end. Trust each of them with your life.
translation: 用你的心灵承诺，用在战场上伴你战斗到底的钢枪承诺。用你的生命去信任他们每一个人。

original: And earn the trust of each in turn. Eat well, my friends.
translation: 同时赢得每个人的信任。开始用餐吧，我的朋友们。

original: I hope you're willing to pay for the parts -- you're not getting them from our supplies.
translation: 我希望你愿意为零件付钱 — 否则从我这你得不到任何东西。

original: What do you need?
translation: 你需要什么？

original: What is it?
translation: 怎么了？

original: What else would I be doing back here?
translation: 回到这我还能做什么？

original: Oh, the new kid? Yeah, Vance said we should be expecting someone soon.
translation: 哦，新来的小孩？嗯，万斯说不久就会有人找上门来。

original: You can head on in, but I would speak to Vance first if I was you. You can find him on the mezzanine overlooking the common area.
translation: 要是我的话，在四处晃荡前会先和万斯谈谈。你能在上面俯瞰这个区域的平台上找到他。

original: Oh, sure. Look, I don't have time for your bullshit. Turn around and go back the way you came.
translation: 好的，没问题。我没有时间听你胡扯。哪来的就回哪去吧。

original: Otherwise, they'll be scraping you up with a shovel.
translation: 否则，他们会拿铲子把你砍了。

original: Finally! Someone with some balls around this place!
translation: 终于！来了个有胆量的家伙！

original: Here's the password to that little pipsqueak's room... why don't you go knock some sense into him? Ha ha ha!
translation: 这是那小家伙房间的密码……为什么你不去和他讲讲道理？哈哈哈！

original: Then that is a mystery you will have to solve on your own.
translation: 那是一个秘密，你需要自己去找到答案。

original: In ceremony, each member of the Family must speak one of the Laws... it is theirs to remember and to enforce.
translation: 每当举行典礼的时候，我们当中的每个人都要说出法则中的一条。……那是他们必须记住和坚持执行的法则。

original: Perhaps from these Laws you can discover what we are. Return to me when you are ready.
translation: 可能从这些法则之中，你能发现我们是什么样的人。若你准备好就回来找我。

original: Indeed! Everyone who lives here has worked hard to get here.
translation: 确实如此！住在这的每个人都是通过努力工作才能来这。

original: That's why we can't just let those Ghouls in. They demand the right to live here, but what have they done to prove themselves worthy?
translation: 这也就是为什么我们不能让那些尸鬼进来。他们非要住在这的权利，但他们做了什么来证明自己有资格？

original: That's terrific! A real man of action. That's just what we need!
translation: 太好了！一个真正的实干家。这就是我们要的！

original: That's terrific! That's just what we need!
translation: 太好了！那就是我们要的！

original: Well. Then you know that some Ghouls aren't feral, and can be reasoned with.
translation: 嗯。那你该知道有些尸鬼并非发狂的，是可以讲道理的。

original: Those Ghouls that keep trying to get into Tenpenny. They need to stop, before someone gets hurt. I think they live in the nearby Metro tunnels...
translation: 那些老想闯进特佩尼大楼的尸鬼。他们得收手了，免得有人受伤。我觉得他们住在附近的地铁隧道里……

original: Saints alive! It is both an honor and a privilege, sir. I was hoping this day would arrive.
translation: 圣人降临了！这既是荣誉又是责任，先生。我知道这一天会来。

original: I hope these fortifications are up to your high standards, sir. All of my men await your command to push and retake the Capital!
translation: 我希望这些防御工事能达到你高标准的要求，长官。我的人都在等你命令前进发、夺回华盛顿！

original: May I ask where you intend to bring the document?
translation: 我能问下你要带文献去哪吗？

original: Thanks, I'll use it right away.
translation: 谢谢，我立刻使用。

original: Saints alive! It is both an honor and a privilege, madam. I knew the day would arrive that Jefferson would send someone to help!
translation: 圣人降临了！这既是荣誉又是责任，先生。我知道这一天会来。

original: I hope these fortifications are up to your high standards, madam. All of my men await your command to push and retake the Capital!
translation: 我希望这些防御工事能达到你高标准的要求，女士。我的人都在等你命令前进发、夺回华盛顿！

original: May I ask where you intend to bring the document?
translation: 我能问下你要带文献去哪吗？

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: Alright. One moment.
translation: 好的，稍等一会儿。

original: Yes sir.
translation: 是的，先生。

original: Yes ma'am.
translation: 是的，女士。

original: Chief Harkness meets with Doctor Li and Bannon to discuss security matters.
translation: 哈克尼斯长官会与李博士和班侬会面，讨论安全事务。

original: It's a waste of a good Monday morning if you ask me. They should just let Chief Harkness call the shots.
translation: 要我说，那只是浪费一个美好的礼拜一早晨而已。他们应当都交给哈克尼斯长官处理。

original: Chief Danvers meets with Doctor Li and Bannon to discuss how to run this tub.
translation: 哈克尼斯长官会与李博士和班侬讨论如何管理这大铁罐。

original: It's a waste of a good Monday morning if you ask me. They should just let Chief Harkness call the shots.
translation: 要我说，那只是浪费一个美好的礼拜一早晨而已。他们应当都交给哈克尼斯长官处理。

original: Doctor Li, Chief Harkness and I are all on the council. We meet every Monday morning.
translation: 李博士、哈克尼斯长官和我都在议会。我们周一上午会面。

original: I can be very influential, if you know what I mean. Far more than Seagrave Holmes.
translation: 我非常有影响力，你懂吧。我的影响力远远超过了西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。

original: Doctor Li, Chief Harkness and I are all on the council. We meet every Monday morning.
translation: 李博士、哈克尼斯长官和我都在议会。我们周一上午会面。

original: I can be very influential, if you know what I mean.
translation: 我非常有影响力，你懂吧。

original: Doctor Li, Chief Danvers and I are all on the council. We meet every Monday morning.
translation: 李博士，哈克尼斯长官和我都在议会。我们周一上午会面。

original: I can be very influential, if you know what I mean. Far more than Seagrave Holmes.
translation: 我非常有影响力，你懂吧。我的影响力远远超过了西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。

original: Doctor Li, Chief Danvers and I are all on the council. We meet every Monday morning.
translation: 李博士，哈克尼斯长官和我都在议会。我们周一上午会面。

original: I can be very influential, if you know what I mean.
translation: 我非常有影响力，你懂吧。

original: Bannon and Doctor Li and I all meet on Monday mornings to talk about city wide issues.
translation: 班侬和李博士还有我在周一上午会面谈论城里的事情。

original: It's pretty informal. The council doesn't have much real power.
translation: 那不是太正式的。议会没有太多真正的权力。

original: Someone told Father Clifford that Diego and I were... you know.
translation: 有人告诉克利福德神父，迭戈和我……你知道。

original: Father Clifford expelled Diego. So now we can get married!
translation: 克利福德神父开除了迭戈。现在我们能结婚了！

original: What are you talking about? I'm a man of the cloth! Well, I will be as soon as Father Clifford...
translation: 你在说什么？我是个牧师！呃，只要克利福德神父……

original: Never mind. It doesn't matter what Angela thinks. Soon I will take vows of chastity.
translation: 没关系。安吉拉怎么想不重要。不久我要履行纯洁的誓言。

original: I... I don't know what came over me. I just lost control and seduced her.
translation: 我……我不知道中了什么邪。我就失控了，引诱了她。

original: But I am an honorable man. I will make her an honorable woman. We're going to get married.
translation: 但我是个有体面的人。我会让她成一个体面的女人。我要娶她。

original: I thought I would be more upset about leaving the church, but she makes me so happy.
translation: 我本以为离开教堂我会更难过，但是她让我很幸福。

original: I'm collecting artifacts. Historical artifacts. Um... all sorts of things from old D.C.
translation: 我收集文物。历史文物。唔……老特区的各种东西。

original: It's important work. Because...well, it just is.
translation: 这是重要的工作。因为……呃，它就是很重要。

original: Bah! Sometimes I feel like it's hopeless.
translation: 呵！我有时感觉很无望。

original: Oh, it's so good to finally meet... I mean, to yet again meet someone who actually cares about history!
translation: 哦，终于能遇到……我意思是，能遇到真正关心历史的人！

original: Why, of course I do!
translation: 噢，当然！

original: If these items were lost to time, how would we ever be able to explore our heritage or appreciate the sacrifices our founding fathers made?
translation: 如果这些东西随时间丢失，我们怎么探寻我们的传统或者继承我们开国者为之奉献的事业？

original: Well, now that we brought back the Declaration, I think I'll take my cut of the earnings and head out to get drunk.
translation: 噢，我们找回了《独立宣言》，我要拿上我那份，然后去喝个够。

original: Look me up in the Underworld if you ever need me. I usually hang there since the Ghouls don't hit on me all the time.
translation: 如果需要我就去冥界找我。我通常都在那，因为尸鬼从来不攻击我。

original: Well, that's a shame for you, isn't it? You don't have the caps, and I guess I don't have the information. Disappointment all around.
translation: 噢，太遗憾了，不是吗？你没有那么多瓶盖，我想我也没有信息给你。大家都很失望。

original: Nothing like the sound of caps jingling in your pocket is there? Always brightens my day.
translation: 有什么会比瓶盖落到口袋里的声音更好听？这让我过得很快乐。

original: And to brighten your day, here's what I know. Your dad said he was headed southeast, into the city. He was aiming for Galaxy News Radio.
translation: 为了让你也过得快乐，我告诉你我所知道的。你爸爸说他要东南方，去城里。他的目标是银河新闻电台。

original: No idea what he wants with them, but you can ask him all about it when you find him. Good luck with that, by the way.
translation: 不知道他为了什么要找他们，不过等你找到他，你可以自己问他。顺便祝你好运。

original: Well, I suppose it was. All right; because I'm such a softy, I'll honor our original agreement.
translation: 呃，我想是。好把；因为我心软，我尊重我们最初的约定。

original: Your dad came through here, all right. Didn't stay long, though. Said he had some important business to attend to, and headed off to the city.
translation: 你爸爸确实来过这。但待得时间不长。他说有些重要的事情要处理，就一直向城那边走了。

original: Something to do with Galaxy News Radio. Guess that'd be the place for you to start. Good hunting, and thanks for the caps.
translation: 和银河新闻电台有点关系。我想你应该从那里着手。祝你好运，另外谢谢你的瓶盖。

original: Let's just see what we can do... mmm-hmm. Yep, just as I thought.
translation: 看看我们能做什么……嗯。是的，和我想得一样。

original: Whoops, butterfingers! Hold on just a second... okay, got it. You're not feeling lightheaded, are you? Great.
translation: 哎呀，笨蛋！坚持一会……好的，好了。你不再感到头晕了，对吧？太好了。

original: That's strange. Wait. Your left, my right. Okay, got it. There... we... go!
translation: 奇怪。等会。你左边，我右边。好了。就那样……成了！

original: You weren't kidding. You love the smack, all right.
translation: 你不是开玩笑吧。你喜欢这东西，好的。

original: I'm taking food out of the mouths of some poor dealer's kids right now, you know.
translation: 你知道，我正从一些穷商人的孩子嘴里抢吃的。

original: That burning sensation you feel, all over your body? That's my patented Addiction-Be-Gone treatment at work!
translation: 你有感到燃烧的感觉传遍全身吗？那是我专有的成瘾去除疗法在起作用！

original: You alright up there. Need another painkiller?
translation: 你还好吧。还要止痛药吗？

original: Alright, hold still.
translation: 好的，别动。

original: This may sting a little...
translation: 这可能有点疼……

translation: 见鬼，那为什么要浪费我的时间？

translation: 很高兴能帮上忙。

translation: 你真不幸。

translation: 这会疼，你最好别哭。

original: You may want to look away. I don't want you throwing up, on top of all this.
translation: 你可能想把脸转过去。我可不想你吐出来，你够倒霉了。

original: You should come back and see me when you have enough money for the supplies.
translation: 等你有钱了再回来买东西。

original: For crying out loud. Get out of my face then.
translation: 哎呀。那就从我眼前消失。

original: You mean, like fix stuff? Nah.
translation: 你的意思是贩毒？不。

original: I just hang out, dude. I've got enough chems to last a while. Oh, yeah!
translation: 我就是闲逛，伙计。我的药品足够维持一阵了。哦，耶！

original: No point in getting all worked up. I get three squares, I got a place to crash, and nothing's trying to eat me.
translation: 没必要这么激动。我三餐不愁，有窝避雨，而且又没东西要吃掉我。

original: I'm his second in command. I run the night shift and he runs the day shift.
translation: 我是他的副手。我管夜班，他管白班。

original: Is this conversation going somewhere? Because I've got things to do.
translation: 你要说些什么？我还有事要做。

original: Let's keep it that way.
translation: 那就这样。

original: Belle can mix almost anything, as long as it's beer or whiskey.
translation: 只要它是啤酒或者威士忌，贝勒能把任何东西混在一起。

original: Thanks, man. I really need this fix.
translation: 谢谢，哥们。我真的需要这货。

original: Nobody does. I'm not very memorable.
translation: 没人记得。我不太能给人留下印象。

original: Don't worry, it won't be a problem for much longer.
translation: 别担心，以后这就不是一个问题了。

original: Thank you! I'll go to Flak and Shrapnel's just before closing.
translation: 谢谢！我要在“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅关门前，去他们店里。

original: I don't have anything to give you, but I think I can trust you with a secret.
translation: 我没什么给你的，但是我想我能信任你保守我的秘密。

original: If you ever go up north, there is a secret slave hide out called Temple of the Union. You might find them useful.
translation: 如果你往北走，那有一个秘密的奴隶隐藏地，叫联邦圣殿。你会发现他们很能干。

original: Thank you! I'll go to Flak and Shrapnel's just before closing.
translation: 谢谢！我要在“高炮”弗莱克和“榴弹”小帅关门前，去他们店里。

original: I... I am at your mercy.
translation: 请……请高抬贵手。

original: Whoa! Why is the room spinning?
translation: 哇！房子怎么晃起来了？

original: You're nice. I can tell you a secret. I'm drunk. No no, that's not the secret. I have another secret.
translation: 你真好。我要告诉你一个秘密。我醉了。不不，那不是那秘密。我还有个秘密。

original: Now that's what I like in a man. Enough caps to buy a lady a drink.
translation: 这就是我最喜欢的人。用足够的瓶盖请女士喝酒。

original: I guess you're okay. Thanks for the drink.
translation: 我想你算个好人。谢谢你请的酒。

original: Figures.
translation: 好的。

original: I'm going to the Muddy Rudder for a drink later. If I see you down there, you can buy me a drink.
translation: 过一会我要去“泥舵”酒吧。如果碰到你，你可要请客哦。

original: Alright, if you say so boss. But if we get to Big Town and she isn't there, I'll kill you.
translation: 好吧，既然你这么说了，老大。但是如果我们去大镇而她却不在那，我会杀了你。

original: Alright! Move it!
translation: 好的！行动！

original: That sucks! Really? She's dead? Damnit. Let's get out of here, and maybe we can kill a few Super Mutants on the way out! Come on!
translation: 真糟糕！真的吗？她死了？该死。让我们离开这，或许我们可以在出去的路上干掉一些超级变种人！来吧！

original: The Super Mutants took Red along with the others. She was the only person that really ever listened to me.
translation: 超级变种人把瑞德带走了。她可是唯一一个听我说话的人。

original: Don't tell Sticky, though. He's liable to kill himself if he knew Red was gone. And that would conflict with my own suicide plans.
translation: 不过别告诉斯蒂奇，因为如果他知道瑞德不在了，他有可能会自杀。这就与我自己的自杀计划冲突了。

original: Okay, fine. But just this once.
translation: 好的，没关系。但是下不为例。

original: Here's another collar. Be more careful this time.
translation: 这是另一个项圈。这次多加小心。

original: Try to be more careful next time.
translation: 下次多加注意。

original: Good choice. Pride has taken down more Brothers than I can count. You'd best remember that.
translation: 明智的选择。“里昂斯的骄傲”损失的兄弟多到我都记不清了。你最好别忘了。

original: He's one of God's creatures, just like you and I.
translation: 他是神造的生灵，就像你我一样。

original: He wanted new memories and a new face. Sadly, I couldn't help him. He left to look for a tech, someone with Pre-War skills.
translation: 他想要新记忆和一张新面孔。不幸的是，我帮不了他。他离开了，去寻找一个拥有战前技能的技术员。

original: That Commonwealth robot was real! I have proof. Listen to this!
translation: 联邦机器人是真的！我有证据。仔细听着！

original: Some say it was all a hoax. But it's real.
translation: 有人说这一切都是恶作剧。但这是真的。

original: Here. Check out this holotape I found. That Commonwealth robot was real!
translation: 给。看看我找到的全息磁带。那联邦机器人是真的！

original: Some say it was all a hoax. But they're wrong. I've seen diagrams of that Neuralizer, it's real. And so is that android!
translation: 有人说这一切都是恶作剧。但他们都错了。我见过那神经器的示意图，它是真的。那仿真人也是真的！

original: Most believe it's a hoax.
translation: 大多数人认为这是一个恶作剧。

original: Here's some evidence for you to consider for yourself. Take this holotape.
translation: 这里有一些证据供你自己参考。拿着这盒全息磁带。

original: I used to think it was all so much bullshit. But then I got this holotape.
translation: 我以前觉得这都是胡扯。但后来我拿到了这盒全息磁带。

original: Here, listen to it yourself.
translation: 来，你自己听听。

original: Ah maaaan. I wish it wasn't just a giant practical joke.
translation: 啊妈呀 ，我真希望这不是个恶作剧。

original: Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. Think how cool it would be if it were true!
translation: 这有一张那老全息磁带的复制品。想想如果它是真的该有多酷！

original: Have you heard the so called "android recording?" It sounds like an ordinary man!
translation: 你听过所谓的“仿真人录音”吗？听起来像个普通人！

original: Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. It's a hoax for sure.
translation: 这是旧全息磁带的额外拷贝。这无疑是个恶作剧。

original: It's a hoax. Here listen to this "android recording." We analyzed it. That's clearly a human man speaking.
translation: 只是个恶作剧。听听这“仿真人磁带”。我们对它进行过分析，那确实是个人类在说话。

original: A bunch of bullshit, that's all that was.
translation: 完全是胡扯，完全是。

original: Here, take this old holotape. It's just some guy pulling a clever prank. Had lots of folk convinced though.
translation: 给你，拿着这老全息磁带。这就是一些家伙玩的恶作剧，很多人信以为真。

original: I heard old Pinkerton at Rivet City had a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous.
translation: 我听说在铆钉城的老平克顿有脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。如果说我不羡慕他，那一定是在撒谎。

original: I heard old Pinkerton at Rivet City had a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous.
translation: 我听说在铆钉城的老平克顿有脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。如果说我不羡慕他，那一定是在撒谎。

original: Old Pinkerton over at Rivet City's rumored to have done it. Damn fool. High risk of infection and death. Though, I admit, I'm slightly jealous.
translation: 有传闻说钉城的老平克顿有。很容易感染致死。不管怎么说，我承认有点羡慕他。

original: Probably down at Rivet City. Anything that has any use out here, they snatch up for themselves. That damn Pinkerton don't share nothin'.
translation: 或许在铆钉城有。他们把这有用的东西都夺走了。那该死的平克顿什么都不愿意跟大家分享。

original: Dammit! Why are you wasting my time? I already told you, ask Pinkerton down at Rivet City.
translation: 该死！为什么你要浪费我的时间？我已经告诉你了，去铆钉城问平克顿。

original: If you are lookin' to change your face, I'd try Pinkerton at Rivet City. That boy's got no sense of ethics. And you're a fool if you try it.
translation: 如果你想改变你的容貌，我建议你去铆钉城去找平克顿，那家伙毫无道德。如果你够傻，就去试试。

original: They say old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow got his hands on a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. Amazing really.
translation: 据说铆钉城的平克顿用某种方法搞到了去脂整形机和微型植皮器，真的太神奇了。

original: They say old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow got his hands on a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. Amazing really.
translation: 据说铆钉城的平克顿用某种方法搞到了去脂整形机和微型植皮器，真的太神奇了。

original: Pinkerton's the only surgeon crazy enough to try it. Too risky. Go to Rivet City if you want. But don't expect to come out looking better than me.
translation: 平克顿是唯一疯狂到去试验的外科医生。风险太大了。如果你想做的话就去铆钉城，但不要指望到时会比我帅。

original: Try Pinkerton at Rivet City. Heard he has the goods. Hope he doesn't try to actually use them on anyone. Bet he would though. He's nuts.
translation: 到铆钉城找平克顿试试，听说他会用。希望他没有在某人身上实际用过。但是我打赌他会的，他是疯子。

original: Try Pinkerton at Rivet City. Heard he has the goods. Hope he doesn't try to actually use them on anyone. Bet he would though. He's nuts.
translation: 到铆钉城找平克顿试试，听说他会用。希望他没有在某人身上实际用过。但是我打赌他会的，他是疯子。

original: I tell these assholes to just stop looking in the mirror. But if you want to mess up your face, try Pinkerton at Rivet City. He's crazy enough.
translation: 我告诉这些混蛋别再照镜子了。但是如果你想改变容貌，去铆钉城找平克顿试试。他是个十足的疯子。

original: Guess old Pinkerton at Rivet City has some shiny Pre-War tech. He might have what you're looking for.
translation: 我猜铆钉城的老平克顿一定有些很强的战前技术。他或许会有你想要的东西。

original: Guess old Pinkerton at Rivet City has some shiny Pre-War tech. He might have what you're looking for.
translation: 我猜铆钉城的老平克顿一定有些很强的战前技术。他或许会有你想要的东西。

original: Guess old Pinkerton at Rivet City has some shiny Pre-War tech and knows how to use it. He could probably rearrange your face for you if you wanted.
translation: 我猜铆钉城的老平克顿一定有些很强的战前技术。并且知道怎样使用它。如果你需要的话，他可以给你的脸部整形。

original: I heard a rumor that old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow conjured up a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer.
translation: 有传闻说铆钉城的老平克顿有神奇的去脂整形机和微型植皮器。

original: I heard a rumor that old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow conjured up a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer.
translation: 有传闻说铆钉城的老平克顿有神奇的去脂整形机和微型植皮器。

original: Pinkerton's the only surgeon crazy enough to try a facial reconstruction. I'd advise my patients against it. Due to high risk of deadly infection.
translation: 平克顿是为一个疯狂到敢于做面部整形的外科医生。我建议我的病人不要做，因为感染致死的风险很高。

original: Rumor had it Pinkerton at Rivet City found a Lipoplasticator and Graftilizer. Good luck to any fool that let Pinkerton test them on him though.
translation: 有传闻说平克顿在铆钉城找到了去脂整形机和植皮器。祝那些让平克顿在他们身上做实验的傻瓜们好运。

original: Rumor had it Pinkerton at Rivet City found a Lipoplasticator and Graftilizer. Good luck to any fool that let Pinkerton test them on him though.
translation: 有传闻说平克顿在铆钉城找到了去脂整形机和植皮器。祝那些让平克顿在他们身上做实验的傻瓜们好运。

original: I know it's foolish to cut into the body unnecessarily. Leads to infection. Heard Pinkerton's willing to give it a try though. Try him at Rivet City.
translation: 我认为在身体上添无谓的伤口是愚蠢的，那还会导致感染。听说平克顿想要做些实验。到铆钉城找他。

original: Facial surgery's too dangerous. Plus you need some specialized Pre-War equipment. Hmm. That reminds me of an old hoax.
translation: 面部整形太危险了，而且你需要一些特殊的战前仪器。嗯，这让我想起了一个老恶作剧。

original: Here's a copy of that holotape.
translation: 这就是那全息磁带的拷贝。

original: Need specialized equipment and expertise. It's also prone to infection. Too dangerous.
translation: 需要专门的仪器和技术。还很容易被感染。太危险了。

original: Damn stupid idea. That reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 该死的馊主意。那让我想起了这老恶作剧。

original: Here, take a listen to this crusty holotape and see for yourself.
translation: 给，你自己去听听这盘老掉牙的全息磁带吧。

original: Medicine is an important art and science. Shouldn't be wasted on vanity. Hey, but that reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 医学是一门重要的艺术和科学，不应被虚荣所糟蹋。嘿，但它让我想起了个老恶作剧。

original: Here, listen to this holotape.
translation: 给，听听这全息磁带。

original: Hmm... that reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 嗯……它让我想起了个老恶作剧。

original: Here, listen to this. It's clearly a joke. No one's got the tech to do that without risking infection.
translation: 给，听听这全息磁带。这显然是个玩笑。没人可以冒被感染的风险。

original: Oh if I got my hands on the right gear I might try it. It's dangerous though. Prone to infection. Reminds me of an old hoax.
translation: 如果我手头有合适的仪器我会试试。但那太危险了，很容易被感染。让我想起了个老恶作剧。

original: Listen to this holotape.
translation: 听听这全息磁带。

original: Facial surgery's way too dangerous to try. Need special equipment and expertise. Hmm. Reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 面部整形太危险了，需要特殊的仪器和技术。嗯。让我想起来一个老恶作剧。

original: Here, listen to this holotape.
translation: 给，听听这全息磁带。

original: Nah. You need specialized gear that doesn't exist anymore. And why risk infection? That reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 没。你需要专门的装备，而那东西已经不存在了。并且为什么要冒感染的风险呢？那让我想起了这老恶作剧。

original: Here, listen to this holotape.
translation: 给，听听这全息磁带。

original: Have you heard the so called "android recording?" Didn't know what to make it of myself.
translation: 你听过所谓的“仿真人录音”吗？我自己也不知道该怎么说。

original: Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. Take a listen.
translation: 这是旧全息磁带的额外拷贝。听听吧。

original: Thought that hoax was long in the grave.
translation: 想来那传闻已经很长时间没人提了。

original: Here take this holotape and hear it for yourself. That was just some bored prankster. Forget about it.
translation: 拿着这全息磁带自己听听，就是些无聊的家伙搞的恶作剧。忘了它吧。

original: I've learned a thing or two about not taking things on appearances. That was an elaborate hoax.
translation: 我曾经学过不能以貌取人，以表观物。那是个精心策划的恶作剧。

original: Take this holotape and give a listen. Clearly fake.
translation: 去听听这全息磁带，很显然是假的。

original: That old "android recording?" Some of the boys took that seriously. Clearly it was a hoax.
translation: 那旧“仿真人录音”？有些人很认真地对待这事。很显然这是个恶作剧。

original: Here's a copy of the holotape. Listen for yourself.
translation: 这是一份全息磁带的拷贝，自己好好听听吧。

original: Oh you mean that old "android recording?" Have you heard it? It's great.
translation: 哦，你是说那旧“仿真人录音”？你听过了吗？很棒。

original: Here's a spare copy of that old holotape. It's either real or a great joke.
translation: 这是旧全息磁带的额外拷贝。要么是真的，要么是个大笑话。

original: That old story? Well, now... I haven't heard talk of that in quite some time. It was all just a rumor. A hoax. Someone's idea of a practical joke.
translation: 那老故事？嗯，现在……最近一段时间还真没人谈论这事情了。这完全是传闻而已，一个恶作剧。某些人精心策划的玩笑而已。

original: Story was there was an android, escaped from the Commonwealth up north. From someplace called the Institute.
translation: 据说有一个仿真人，从北方的联邦逃了出来。从一个叫学院的地方。

original: There was a holotape that got circulated. I think I've got a copy of it...
translation: 有个四处传播的全息磁带。我想我有过一份……

original: Yeah, here it is. Give it a listen. That's a man's voice! Hoax for sure!
translation: 嗯，给，去听听。那是个人类的声音！毫无疑问是个恶作剧！

original: I had forgotten about that old hoax. Have you heard it?
translation: 我已经忘了这老恶作剧了。你听说过吗？

original: Here's a copy of that old "android holotape." It's just some practical jokester.
translation: 这有一份那旧“仿真人磁带”的拷贝，只是些精心策划的玩笑罢了。

original: This could be an opportunity of a lifetime for you! I've misplaced some very sensitive property. And you will help me find it!
translation: 这对你来说是个千载难逢的好机会！我丢失了一些非常重要的财产。你可以帮我找到它！

original: Oh! Well... Thank you! Your words are... very kind. Kinder than those I usually hear... Is there... something I can help you with?
translation: 哦！这个……谢谢你！你的话……很好。比我通常听到的话要好得多……是否……有我可以帮你的地方？

original: Well... yes. If I may speak my will. You do, sort of. We don't have many guests in the Citadel.
translation: 嗯……是的。请恕我直言：在某种程度上，是你。我们在大本营没有太多的客人。

original: And when we do, they're usually visiting Brothers. Outsiders are not to be trusted, so says the codex.
translation: 有客人的时候，也通常是来访的兄弟会的人。外人是不可信的，法典上是这么说的。

original: "Shield yourself from those not bound to you by steel, for they are the blind. Aid them when you can, but lose not sight of yourself".
translation: “屏蔽那些没有和你一样用钢铁保护自己的人，因为他们是盲目的。尽量协助他们，但不要迷失自己。”

original: So what do you think? Can we take these Enclave guys?
translation: 那么你是怎么想的？我们能对付这些英克雷的家伙吗？

original: Does this sound noble enough? "Quail before me, foul Super Mutant! Thine end is at hand! Yield, that I may ease thine suffering!"
translation: 这么说够高贵吗？“在我面前发抖吧，愚蠢的超级变种人！尔等死到临头了！屈服吧，我会让尔等死得痛快些！”

original: Good, 'cause this isn't going to be easy.
translation: 很好，因为这事将会很难。

original: Galaxy News Radio is my baby. I love it, I feed it, I keep it changed. But there's one problem, no one outside of D.C. can hear her cry.
translation: 银河新闻电台是我的宝贝。我热爱它，哺育它，并不断更新。可是有个问题是，在首都特区上没人能够听见她的呼唤。

original: You see, some brainless Super Mutant thought it would be funny to shoot at the shiny round thing on the Washington Monument.
translation: 你瞧，一些蠢货超级变种人觉得向华盛顿纪念碑上面的闪光处射击是件好玩的事情。

original: Good, 'cause this isn't going to be easy.
translation: 很好，因为这不会很容易。

original: Galaxy News Radio is my baby. I love it, I feed it, I keep it changed. But there's one problem, no one outside of D.C. can hear her cry.
translation: 银河新闻电台是我的宝贝。我热爱它，哺育它，并不断更新。可是有个问题是，在首都特区上没人能够听见她的呼唤。

original: You see, some brainless Super Mutant thought it would be funny to shoot at the shiny round thing on the Washington Monument.
translation: 你瞧，一些蠢货超级变种人觉得向华盛顿纪念碑上面的闪光处射击是件好玩的事情。

original: Hey, I may be the biggest mouth in the Capital Wasteland, but I've also got the biggest ears.
translation: 嘿，我或许是首都废土最大嘴的人，但我也有最大的耳朵。

original: All sorts of people pass through our little oasis in the rubble and tell all sorts of interesting things.
translation: 各类人等经过我们的小小绿洲，告诉我们各种有趣的事。

original: You want to know something? Ask and we'll work it out.
translation: 说你想知道的，交给我们搞定。

original: Goodbye. Remember to keep us tuned in while you're out there, and watch yourself.
translation: 再见。到那里后记得调好频率和我们保持联系，还有照顾好自己。

original: You've never heard of Rivet City? Wow. Just... wow.
translation: 你没听说过铆钉城？哇。真是……哇。

original: Well, a whole bunch of people got together and turned a beached aircraft carrier into a town. Pretty cool, huh?
translation: 嗯，一群人合力把一艘搁浅的航母改造成了一座城镇。真酷，呃？

original: Just follow the river south from here... there's no way you can miss it.
translation: 只要沿着这河往南走……你不会错过的。

original: Well, if you check out your radio, you can hear pretty good in this place. Get a few blocks away, still not too bad, maybe a little static.
translation: 嗯，如果你检查下你的电台，在这收听效果非常好。再走几个街区，也不会太糟，或许会有些小静电。

original: Step outside the city limits, and it's snake city... nothing but "hissssssss."
translation: 走出城区，就是蛇城了……除了“嘶嘶嘶”，什么都没有。

original: With the relay back on, you'll hear GNR clearly in the whole Capital Wasteland area like it used to be.
translation: 随着中继恢复，整个首都废土地区都能清晰地收听银新台的声音，就像以前一样。

original: And what makes you so certain about that? I can't imagine you're still so naive after spending time in that hell outside.
translation: 你凭什么这么肯定？我无法想象你去过外面那样的地狱，居然还如此幼稚。

original: None of them know what the outside is like, and most of them would die out there. Then the rest of us inside would eventually die out, too.
translation: 他们不知道外面是什么样子，多数人还会送命。然后我们这里剩下的人也会死光。

original: I won't risk all of our lives just for a few people's passing fancy of taking a Wasteland vacation. I hope you can understand that.
translation: 我不会以大家的生命为代价，让少数人心血来潮的人去废土度假。我希望你能理解。

original: G.E.C.K.? We never had one of those things in the first place. We weren't supposed to ever leave, remember?
translation: 伊甸园创造器？我们一直没有得到过这件东西。我们原本就不该离开的，记得吗？

original: But take this Modified Utility Jumpsuit. I guess the rebels thought it would be useful when they left. Obviously, that won't be happening now.
translation: 但是拿上这件改良的工作服。我猜那些反叛者认为在他们离开的时候会有用。显然，那不会发生了。

original: Congrats, you saved the Vault. Now, get out.
translation: 祝贺你拯救了避难所。现在，出去。

original: I'm afraid that, instead of a G.E.C.K., our Vault was supplied with technology better suited to functioning indefinitely.
translation: 恐怕是这样的，我们没有得到伊甸园创造器，而持续避难所运转的科技。

original: But take this Modified Utility Jumpsuit. It seems the rebels thought it would be useful when they left. Obviously, that won't be happening now.
translation: 但是拿上这件改良的工作服。我猜那些反叛者认为在他们离开的时候会有用。显然，那不会发生了。

original: Thank you for saving our Vault. Now, you'll have to leave.
translation: 谢谢你拯救了我们的避难所。现在，你得走了。

original: Sure, fine. As it turns out, Brotch modified himself a utility jumpsuit for survival in the Wastes. As if he was ever getting out there.
translation: 当然，好的。原来是这样，布洛彻为了在废土生存，为他自己准备了工作服。就像他能够离开似的。

original: Here, it's yours. Don't say I never repaid a favor. Now, get the hell out of my Vault.
translation: 给，它是你的了。别说我没有还你人情。现在,从我的避难所滚开。

original: I think we may have just the thing, taken from the rebels not long ago. Edwin Brotch modified a utility jumpsuit for "survival in the Wastes."
translation: 我想我们刚好有那东西，不久前从反叛者那得到的。德文·布洛彻为“废土生活”而改制的一件工作服。

original: It was a foolish idea, but that seems par for the course for them. I suppose they'd be happy to think it found its intended use, eventually.
translation: 这是个愚蠢的主意，但是看起来跟他们很搭调。我想，它最终物尽其用，他们也会高兴的。

original: But enough of that. Thank you for saving our Vault. Now, you'll have to leave.
translation: 不多说了。谢谢你拯救了避难所。现在,你必须从这离开。

original: That would be where you're wrong. By locking down this Vault, I'm protecting its future.
translation: 这你就错了，年轻人。封闭避难所，我才能保护它的未来。

original: In fact, I was protecting its future when I had to make those unpleasant choices the night you and your father abandoned us.
translation: 事实上，你和你父亲将我们抛弃的那天晚上，我不得不做那些不愉快的决定时，我就在保护它的未来。

original: I only wish I could have stopped your father before he left. If anyone's to blame for the unpleasantness, it's him.
translation: 我真希望能阻止你父亲离开。如果谁该为这不愉快的事负责，那只能是他。

original: Ah, of course. The basic currency of a lawless society. Maybe you'd like a few pointed sticks and fighting dogs, as well?
translation: 啊，当然。这是混乱地方的基础货币呢。要不要再来些尖棍和斗犬？

original: We don't have much ammunition down here, but we should be able to spare some packaged meals.
translation: 我们这没有多少弹药，但我们应该可以分你一些备用的压缩食品。

original: Here, perhaps it'll be of some comfort to you once you return to the Wastes. Now, go.
translation: 给，但愿回到废土它会让你舒服些。现在，走吧。

original: But... why?
translation: 但……为什么？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: Well, you do what you have to, I suppose. But the offer'll still be open, if you change your mind.
translation: 嗯，你尽管做你该做的,我想。但这仍然有效，如果你改变了想法的话。

original: Oh sure, because the angel of death really needs a helping hand out there. I guess "almost everyone in the world" didn't quite meet his quota.
translation: 哦，当然，因为外面的死神真的需要个帮手。我猜“几乎世界上的所有人”都不会同意他的话的。

original: Just stay out of my way until you reconsider that, okay? Some of us actually give a damn about the survival of the species.
translation: 在你重新考虑前别挡我的路，好吗？我们中的一些人真的关心物种的存亡。

original: Let's see, dealing with radiation, testing an experimental device, and I won't lie, it may include some reading. That sort of stuff, you know?
translation: 让我看看，处理辐射，测试实验装置，我不骗人，可能包含了些数据。关于那些，你懂吗？

original: But for all that, I can pay you with caps, meds, chems, and maybe even a few of those unique inventions, if you do a good job. Interested?
translation: 但所有的一切，如果你干得好的话，我可以付给你钱、药品、化学品，甚至是一些独一无二的发明。感兴趣吗？

original: "Target"? Whoa, no, no, no! It's not that sort of job! No, I'm talking about researching things like surviving in the Wastes and such.
translation: “靶子”？哇，不，不，不！不是那种工作！不，我在研究怎么在废土生存这样的事。

original: And I can offer caps and meds and a few of my inventions in return. I guess I can even get you some ammo, if that's more your style.
translation: 我可以用钱或者是我的一些发明作为回报。我想我甚至可以给你些弹药，如果是你需要的类型的话。

original: It's things like bottlecaps, and property, and ownership and all that nonsense that makes a person think he's better than another. Bah!
translation: 就像瓶盖、财产、所有权，以及所有让人觉得比别人要优越的无聊玩意。呸！

original: But I'll take your caps just the same. This android came in as one person, and he left as someone else. I replaced his face AND his memories!
translation: 但我还是会收下你的瓶盖。这仿真人来的时候是一个样子，而离开时却变了样子。我换了他的脸和记忆！

original: Don't believe anyone's done that before. Certainly not down here. That Commonwealth tech isn't all that fancy when it comes down to it.
translation: 别相信以前没人这么做过。当然不是在这里。说到底，联邦的技术也没那么玄乎。

original: I'm also the only one in the Wasteland with the skill and the nerve to perform facial surgery. That android flesh ain't so different than ours.
translation: 我也是废土上唯一有技术和胆量做整形手术的人。那仿真人的肉体和我们的区别不大。

original: You want proof? I documented the whole thing. So I could rub it in the face of Dr. Li when I need to rankle her feathers. I hate that snooty bitch.
translation: 你要证据吗？我都记录下来了。这样我就可以在需要激怒李博士的时候，把东西甩她脸上。我讨厌那自大的婊子。

original: Fine, whatever. This android, calls himself Harkness now, comes in and wants a memory job. I took new memories, and replaced his old ones.
translation: 好的，随便你。这个仿真人，现在自称哈克尼斯，来做记忆手术。我植入新的记忆，替换了他的旧记忆。

original: Don't believe anyone's done that before. Certainly not down here. That Commonwealth tech isn't all that fancy when it comes down to it.
translation: 别相信以前没人这么做过。当然不是在这里。说到底，联邦的技术也没那么玄乎。

original: I'm also the only one in the wasteland with the skill and the nerve to perform facial surgery. That android flesh ain't so different than ours.
translation: 我也是废土上唯一有技术和胆量做面部手术的人。那仿真人的皮肤和我们并没太大的区别。

original: You want proof? I documented the whole thing. So I could rub it in the face of Dr. Li when I need to rankle her feathers. I hate that snooty bitch.
translation: 你要证据吗？我都记录下来了。这样我就可以在需要激怒李博士的时候，把东西甩她脸上。我讨厌那自大的婊子。

original: What're you talking about, boy? I don't know anything about any of that, and a what-did-you-call-it? An android? What's that?
translation: 你在说什么呢，小子？我什么都不知道，你刚说什么？仿真人？那是什么？

original: What are you talking about, girl? I don't know anything about any of that, and a what-did-you-call-it? An android? What's that?
translation: 你在说什么呢，姑娘？我什么都不知道，你刚说什么？仿真人？那是什么？

original: Harkness, you say? Yes... Yes, that makes sense. He used to work for a special branch of the Commonwealth Police, after all...
translation: 你是说哈克尼斯？对……对，这说得通。他过去曾在联邦警察的特别处工作，毕竟……

original: And he's right here in Rivet City! Excellent! I must wait... find an opportune moment to confront him...
translation: 而他就在铆钉城！太好了！我必须等待……找一个可以当面对质的机会……

original: Thank you for your discreet assistance, and continued discretion regarding this matter.
translation: 谢谢你周到的帮助，并继续谨慎处理此事。

original: And now for your payment. This combat module will directly affect your central nervous system. I think you will find it quite beneficial.
translation: 现在该给你报酬了。这个战斗模块将直接影响你的中枢神经系统。我想你会发现它非常有用。

original: Not soon enough! I don't think I can stand another day in this barbaric backwoods...
translation: 太慢了！我想我在这野蛮的地方一天也待不下去了……

original: Ah, a woman of action. I knew I picked the right person for the job! Let me be clear, you won't be looking for a lost puppy or family heirloom.
translation: 啊，一个行动型的女人。我知道我为这工作选对了人！让我说清楚些，你不是要寻找一个走失的小狗或是传家宝。

original: You'll be searching for an android! Do you know what an android is? No, I imagine you don't.
translation: 你要寻找一个仿真人！你知道仿真人是什么吗？不，我想你不知道。

original: You see, we've moved beyond those primitive buckets you call robots, and have created Artificial Intelligence. Sentient machines!
translation: 你看，我们的科技已经超越了那些你称为机器人的人造人，并且创造了人工智能。有感知的机器！

original: Artificial persons that think and feel what we program them to. Occasionally their programming miscalculates, they get confused and wander off.
translation: 人造人思维感知的东西都是我们安排给他们的。有时计算失误，他们就会失控。

original: You think I asked those Super Mutants to wait until I got all my caps together before abducting me?
translation: 你觉得我可以要求那些超级变种人让我拿到我所有钱后再抓我吗？

original: Don't get me wrong. I'm terribly grateful. I'll gladly give you a reward. But let's get out of here first.
translation: 不要误会我，我真的很感激你。我很乐意给你报酬，但先让我们离开这儿。

original: Then let's get out of here! Don't forget we've got to get Red, too. She's still upstairs in the holding pens.
translation: 让我们从这离开！别忘了我们得去找瑞德，她就在楼上的栅栏里。

original: You don't have to tell me twice. Let's get out of here!
translation: 你不用告诉我两次。让我们离开这！

original: That isn't funny! We've got to get out of here before the Super Mutants come back to have me for lunch!
translation: 一点都不好玩！在那些超级变种人回来把我当作午餐前，我们还是立刻离开这吧！

original: What does it look like? The Super Mutants raided Big Town and dragged me off here. I'm sure they're about to eat me. You can't just leave me here!
translation: 你觉得呢？超级变种人突袭了大镇把我拖到了这。我肯定他们会吃了我。你不能就这么把我扔在这！

original: But... but... why?
translation: 但……但……为什么？

original: This is no time for games! This is my life we're talking about here! Look, are you ready to go? Let's just get out of here.
translation: 没时间开玩笑了！现在是性命攸关的时候！听着，你准备走了吗？让我们离开这。

original: Wow... that's... that's easy. Now at least I can shoot back at those mutant bastards. Are you ready?
translation: 哇…… 这真是……简单。现在我至少可以回击那杂种了。你准备好了吗？

original: Wow... that's... that's easy. Now at least I can shoot back at those mutant bastards. Are you ready?
translation: 哇…… 这真是……简单。现在我至少可以回击那杂种了。你准备好了吗？

original: You can mock me all you want, I don't care. Just get me out of here.
translation: 你可以随意嘲弄我，我不介意。把我从这弄走就行。

original: He's had enough training that he should know that when facing overwhelming odds, a Brother's best recourse is to wait for reinforcements.
translation: 他受过足够的训练，应该知道在面对压倒性优势时，兄弟会最好的办法就是等待援军。

original: I suspect that he is making a stand inside of that building, but an Initiate won't be able to stand for long against those Mutants.
translation: 我怀疑他是在那栋楼里建立阵线，但一个新兵是无法与那些变种人对抗太久的。

original: I'll show you. I'll show all of you!
translation: 我会让你看到。我会让你们所有人看到！

original: When I'm gone, my mom will really miss me.
translation: 如果我走了，我妈妈会非常想我的。

original: Oh yeah? Well... well you're an asshole.
translation: 是吗？嗯……嗯，你是个混蛋。

original: What did you say about my mother? You... you take that back!
translation: 你怎么能这样说我妈妈？你……你必须收回这话！

original: Poor James. His mother drinks too much. When she does, she doesn't treat him very well.
translation: 可怜的詹姆斯。他妈妈酗酒。每当她喝酒后，对他就很不好。

original: Personally, I think she blames him for his father leaving her, which is ridiculous.
translation: 我个人认为，她是把他父亲的离开归咎到他头上，这太荒谬了。

original: James' mom, Tammy, is a real bitch. She treats him like crap.
translation: 詹姆斯的母亲，塔米，是个十足的婊子。她对他很恶劣。

original: I think it's because she drinks too much.
translation: 我想这可能是因为她酗酒。

original: That poor child. His mother, Tammy Hargrave, is a very troubled woman.
translation: 那可怜的孩子。他的母亲，塔米·哈格雷夫，是个很麻烦的女人。

original: She spends too much time down in the Muddy Rudder, drinking and using foul language.
translation: 她大部分时间都待在“泥舵”酒吧里喝酒和骂人。

original: I feel so sorry for him. I think CJ is a good influence on him, but I do worry about the two of them.
translation: 我为他感到非常难过。我认为长江会给他树立一个好榜样的，但是我也确实担心他们两个。

original: He's trouble, that's what he is.
translation: 他就是个麻烦，这就是他的本质。

original: I don't trust him, and neither should you.
translation: 我不相信他，你也不该信他。

original: His mother is a drunk. Spends all her time in the Muddy Rudder.
translation: 他母亲是个酒鬼，一天到晚都待在“泥舵”酒吧里。

original: The more I think about it, the more that recording haunts me. It sounds pretty bad for people -- androids -- like me in the Commonwealth.
translation: 我越想，那段录音就越让我心神不宁。这对联邦里像我这样的人——仿真人——来说糟透了。

original: But I clearly can't stay here where Zimmer can find me and expose my true nature. I'll figure something out.
translation: 但我显然不能留在这，齐默会找到我并揭露我的真实身份。我会想办法的。

original: Thanks for warning me. Here's a little token of my gratitude. The best weapon I've ever had. Seems like I've had it forever, come to think of it...
translation: 谢谢你提醒我。这是我的一点心意。我拥有过的最好武器。回想起来，它似乎陪了我相当长的时间……

original: You're right. I have friends here. And Rivet City needs me to protect it.
translation: 你是对的。这有我的朋友。铆钉城需要我来保卫。

original: Even if they found out, they know me. They won't care if I'm made of real flesh and bone, or synthetic parts. Right?
translation: 即使他们发现了真相，他们也了解我。他们不会在乎我是由真正的血肉之躯还是合成部件构成的，对吗？

original: I'll need to take care of Zimmer, though, one way or the other.
translation: 我必须处理掉齐默，不管使用什么方法。

original: Thanks for warning me. Here's a little token of my gratitude. It's the best weapon I've ever had. And it seems like I've had it forever.
translation: 谢谢你提醒我。这是我的一点心意。我拥有过的最好武器。而且它似乎陪了我相当长的时间。

original: You're right. It's not safe for me here. I don't know what I'll face in the North, but from the way Zimmer talks about it, it sounds like a paradise.
translation: 你是对的。我在这不会安全。我不知道在北方会遇到什么，但听齐默的口气，那里就是个天堂。

original: Why would he go through such lengths to retrieve me -- or rather, the other me -- if he didn't care? I'll go back with Zimmer. I'll make a new life.
translation: 如果他不在乎，又为什么要大费周章地找我——或者，另一个我？我会跟齐默回去的。我会开始我的新生活。

original: Thank you for helping me make the right decision. Here's a little token of my gratitude. It's the best weapon I've ever had. And I've had it forever.
translation: 谢谢你帮我做出了正确的决定。这是我的一点心意。我拥有过的最好武器，陪了我相当长的时间。

original: Go tell Zimmer I'm ready to go home.
translation: 去告诉齐默，我已经准备好回家了。

original: Thank you. I'm really not sure how people would react if they found out I'm, you know... not entirely human.
translation: 谢谢你。我真的不知道如果人们发现我，你知道的……不完全是人类，他们会作何反应。

original: Here's a little token of my gratitude. Best weapon I've ever had, and I've had it forever.
translation: 这是我的一点心意。我拥有过的最好武器，陪了我相当长的时间。

original: I suppose if I'm careful I could trump up some charges and throw him out...
translation: 我想如果我谨慎些的话，我可以捏造一些罪名把他赶走……

original: I want to thank you for warning me about Zimmer, and for keeping this a secret.
translation: 我要感谢你提醒我关于齐默的事，并保守这个秘密。

original: Here's a little token of my gratitude.
translation: 这是我表达感激的一点心意。

original: Thank you for warning me about Zimmer, and for keeping this a secret.
translation: 谢谢你提醒我关于齐默的事，并保守这个秘密。

original: Here's a little token of my gratitude. Best weapon a man could ask for.
translation: 这是表达我感激的一点心意。个人能得到的最好武器。

original: Just do me a favor and don't go blasting up my boat. People discharging weapons on my boat tends to get me nervous.
translation: 就帮我一个忙，别把我的船给炸了。有人在我的船上开枪会让我很紧张。

original: Unless I'm the one doing the shooting. To kill dangerous thieves from the Commonwealth, for instance.
translation: 除非是我自己在开枪。比如，为了除掉来自联邦的危险小偷。

original: Hmmm... He is a security threat, isn't he? All right. I authorize you to carry out Doctor Zimmer's execution.
translation: 嗯……他确实是个安全威胁，对吧？好吧。我授权你执行对齐默博士的处决。

original: Don't think this gives you license to run around shooting anyone you want. Just Zimmer, and that bodyguard, if he gets in the way.
translation: 别以为这给了你随意射杀任何人的权利。只针对齐默，还有那个保镖，要是他妨碍你的话。

original: Here, use my weapon. I've had it forever, and it's never let me down. Consider it a token of my appreciation.
translation: 给，用我的武器吧。我用它很久了，它从来没让我失望过。就当是我表达感激的一点心意吧。

original: See you tomorrow night, Diego.
translation: 明晚见，迭戈。

original: Shit. I've got a Council meeting.
translation: 狗屎。我还有一个议会的会议。

original: Time for the Council meeting. Don't want to be late.
translation: 议会会议时间到了，我不想迟到。

original: I'm done, mom. I'm going to go play with C.J.
translation: 我已经干完活了。我要去找长江玩。

original: I'm done, mom. I'm going to go play.
translation: 我已经干完活了。我要去玩。

original: I've got to go home, or my mom will kill me.
translation: 我要回家了，否则我妈妈会杀了我的。

original: Almost out of caps. I'd better go.
translation: 我已经快没钱了。我最好离开。

original: Time to get drunk.
translation: 该去大醉一场了。

original: You got a Pip-Boy. Tune into Galaxy News Radio and listen. It's the only radio station in the Capital Wasteland that really tells it like it is.
translation: 你有一台哔哔小子。把它调到银河新闻电台的频率然后听听。它是首都废土上唯一报导真事的电台。

original: Power systems are 90% at startup, but are running at 37% efficiency after coming fully online. I'm looking into what might be causing the leak.
translation: 能源系统在刚开始运作的时候处于90%的功率，但是当系统全部上线之后只有37%的有效输出。我现在正在调查泄漏的原因。

original: Damn it. Well, he's not loaded but I still don't like the idea of him viewing us all as targets. See if you can lock it down.
translation: 该死。他虽然没有装弹，但是我不喜欢他把我们当做目标锁定。试试把它关掉。

original: One of the Brotherhood guys that passed through here mentioned seeing a dish in one of D.C.'s old museums.
translation: 路过这的一位兄弟会兄弟提过，他在华特区的一个老博物馆里看到过碟形天线。

original: It's the dish off the old Virgo II Lunar Lander in the Museum of Technology.
translation: 那是个在科技博物馆的室女II月球着陆器上的通讯碟形天线。

original: I want you to get it and bring it to the Washington Monument to replace the bad one. That's it.
translation: 我想让你找到它，并带到华盛顿纪念碑去换了那个坏掉的。

original: Yes sir! I'll have the techs come down and remove it immediately, sir.
translation: 是的，长官！我会立刻解除这些技术限制。

original: Actually, I am proctor of the Order of the Quill. I oversee the Archives and Library here in the Citadel.
translation: 事实上，我是羽之修会的监理。我在大本营里负责管理档案室和图书馆。

original: We are dedicated to preserving the history of the Brotherhood as well as unearthing the secrets of the pre-war civilizations.
translation: 我们专注于保护兄弟会的历史，并且同时出土战前文明的秘密。

original: We have a single field associate: Scribe Yearling. She operates out of the former Library of Congress to the northeast.
translation: 我们只有一个外勤准会员：伊尔琳学士。她在东北地区国会图书馆工作。

original: Indeed I can!
translation: 我当然能！

original: Pay no heed to those headstrong Knights, with their pop guns and bravado.
translation: 别理那些刚愎自用的骑士，整天端着枪虚张声势。

original: It is the Scribes, the Scribes who make the Brotherhood what it truly is! The brawn is useless without the brain, hmm? He he he.
translation: 是学士，学士才缔造了兄弟会！四肢再发达，无脑也不行，对吧？呵呵呵。

original: Each Order of Scribes is dedicated to a unique field. All equally important. All more important than those dim-witted grunts.
translation: 每个学士的修会都专注于不同的领域之中。它们同等重要。都远远比那些头脑简单的大兵强多了。

original: Ah, one of my favorite subjects, of course! What would you like to know?
translation: 啊，这可是我最爱的话题，当然！你想要知道些什么呢？

original: Listen. There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。

original: That's exactly what I had in mind.
translation: 我就是这么想的。

original: Listen. There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。

original: Fine. Fine. Here, this is all I have left to feed myself, you selfish asshole!
translation: 好吧，好吧。给，这是我的全部，用来养活我自己的，都拿去吧，你这该死的混蛋！

original: I don't care anymore. I just want to know where my brother is.
translation: 我已经不在乎了，我只想知道我弟弟在哪。

original: Lucky for you, I know another way through. There's a secret tunnel that runs from the Overseer's Office to the Vault door!
translation: 你很幸运，我知道另外一条路。那有一个秘密的地道连接监督者的办公室和避难所大门！

original: Security doesn't even know about it. Nobody except my father -- and me. "One of the Overseer's secrets," he says.
translation: 警卫甚至都不知道这件事。除了我父亲 -- 和我。“这是监督者的秘密之一，”他说。

original: Lucky for you, I know of another way in.
translation: 你很幸运，我知道另外一条路。

original: There's a secret tunnel that runs from the Overseer's Office to the Vault door!
translation: 那有一个秘密的地道连接监督者的办公室和避难所大门！

original: Security doesn't even know about it. Nobody except my father -- and me. "One of the Overseer's secrets," he says.
translation: 警卫甚至都不知道这件事。除了我父亲 -- 和我。“这是监督者的秘密之一，”他说。

original: Not exactly an apology, but probably the best I can expect.
translation: 你这也叫道歉，但是总比没有强。

original: You'd better listen, because you'll never escape without my help.
translation: 你最好听着，因为没我的帮助你永远也逃不出去。

original: There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。

original: Was that an actual apology? From you? Wow. You must really be desperate.
translation: 那就是你的道歉？你说出来的？哇哦。你肯定是真的被逼急了。

original: You're right though. You do need my help. You'll never get out of here on your own. You're lucky I'm such a good friend.
translation: 你是对的。你确实需要我的帮助。你自己一个人根本逃不出去。你很幸运，有我这么个好朋友。

original: There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这进到我父亲的办公室。就像我经常干的。

original: Good. Now will you shut up and listen to me for a second?
translation: 很好。你现在是否可以闭上嘴，安静地听我说话了？

original: There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这个密码进入到我父亲的办公室。我经常这么干。

original: I don't have time to explain everything. You're just going to have to trust me this time.
translation: 我没时间跟你解释了，这次你必须要相信我。

original: Listen. There's a secret tunnel that leads directly from my father's office to the exit. You'll have to hack the computer in his office to open it.
translation: 听着。在我父亲的办公室有一个秘密的通道可以直接逃到出口。但你必须先想办法破解我父亲的电脑，打开秘密通道的入口。

original: Use these to get into his office. That's how I always get in.
translation: 用这进入到我父亲的办公室。就像我经常干的。

original: If you have a better plan, let's hear it! Look, I know for a fact that the office isn't guarded -- everyone's out looking for you.
translation: 如果你有更好的办法，我洗耳恭听！你看，我知道办公室肯定没人，因为所有守卫都出去找你了。

original: Here, you'll probably need these to pick the lock on the office door. They've always worked for me.
translation: 给，你很有可能需要他来撬开办公室的门锁。以前我都是这么干的。

original: Access his computer to open the door to the tunnel -- you'll either have to hack it or find his password. I know he hides it in his office somewhere.
translation: 用他的电脑打开通往地道的门 — 你要么破解电脑，要么找到密码。密码肯定藏在办公室的某个地方。

original: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

original: I'll be keeping my father from catching you hacking into his computer.
translation: 我会拖住我的父亲，这样你就可以有足够的时间入侵电脑了。

original: Here, you'll probably need these to pick the lock on the office door. They've always worked for me.
translation: 给，你很有可能需要他来撬开办公室的门锁。以前我都是这么干的。

original: Access his computer to open the door to the tunnel -- you'll either have to hack it or find his password. I know he hides it in his office somewhere.
translation: 用他的电脑打开通往地道的门 — 你要么破解电脑，要么找到密码。密码肯定藏在办公室的某个地方。

original: Oh, one more thing. I stole my father's pistol. I hope you won't need it, but you'd better take it just in case.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。我把父亲的手枪偷出来了。我希望你不会用它，但最好还是拿着以防万一。

original: I hope by "something to do" you mean a job, otherwise you want to talk with Nova.
translation: 我希望你所谓的“找事做”是指工作，否则你还是去找诺瓦吧。

original: I'm looking for someone to make a delivery. Interested?
translation: 我正好需要找个人帮我捎个东西，感兴趣吗？

original: We hope you've enjoyed our tour today. If you have any further questions, please take a brochure from our helpful Vault-Tec guides.
translation: 我们希望您喜欢今天的参观。如果您还有什么其他问题，请向避难所科技导游索取手册。

original: Should the unlikely event arise that the planet is laid to waste, you'll feel happy knowing your family will be safe in a Vault-Tec Vault.
translation: 如果万一发生了使地球被毁的事，您会高兴地知道您的家人在避难所科技的避难所里是安全的。

original: Concerns about security? Our Eye-On-You Cameras enable the Vault's leader to watch your every move. You'll never be alone again!
translation: 担心安全问题？避难所的领导会通过监视牌摄影机注视你的一举一动，你将永不孤单！

original: Bored? Don't be! Step into our Entertainotron Room and watch the latest holotapes or perhaps listen to a symphony. Another Vault-Tec innovation!
translation: 无聊？不会的！去我们的娱乐室看最新的全息录影带，也可以听听交响乐。另一项避难所科技的革新！

original: Moms will love how our Culinator 3000 Kitchen System makes cooking a breeze. Mmmmm, I can smell the muffins baking now!
translation: 母亲们肯定会爱上这烹调3000厨房系统，它可以让做饭变得十分简单。嗯……，我都已经可以闻到烤甜饼的香味了！

original: The living sections make use of our revolutionary Floorsuck Autocleaner System for those darned messy kids. Never sweep again!
translation: 我们的生活区将使用革命性的楼层自动清洁系统，这系统是为那些可恨肮脏的孩子们而设计的。从此再不用打扫卫生了！

original: Being underground got you down? Smile! Our SimuSun Lighting mimics the feeling of being outside with only a fraction of the sunburn potential.
translation: 在地下待着感觉很糟？呵呵！我们的微阳灯让你仅有少量晒伤的情况下拥有在户外的感觉。

original: Sleep in quiet comfort knowing that our impenetrable vault doors can withstand a direct hit by an atomic bomb with only a projected 2% failure rate.
translation: 安心的睡吧，我们坚不可摧的避难所大门可以抵御原子弹的直接冲击，预计故障率仅为2%。

original: Triple-S Technology is Vault-Tec's convergence of the three most important parts of apocalyptic endurance: Safety, Survivability and Sanitation!
translation: “3S科技”是避难所科技三项最重要的末日耐用性的集中体现，这三项科技是：安全性，生存性和卫生性！

original: Vault-Tec welcomes you to our new line of subterranean vaults featuring our patented Triple-S Technology.
translation: 避难所科技欢迎您使用我们的新地下避难所系列，该系列采用了我们的“3S科技”专利。

original: Haven't we been through this already?
translation: 我们之间的问题难道还没解决吗？

original: Nope. No one knows his name, where he comes from -- nothin'. He's a mean little bastard for sure.
translation: 没有。他叫什么，从哪来，没人知道。但我肯定他是个混蛋。

original: He'd be a Paladin by now for sure, except that he ain't got no interest in leadin'. Only killin'. I'm just glad he's on our side.
translation: 以表现而论他已经能成为圣骑士了，只不过他只喜欢杀戮，对带队不感兴趣。我很高兴他和我们是一路的。

original: Oh man, there's something wrong with that boy. Ain't nobody around here that even knows his real name.
translation: 哦，老兄，那家伙肯定有病。这的人没人知道他到底叫什么。

original: We got a betting pool in the pride, whole pot goes to the first person who can find out his real name.
translation: “里昂斯的骄傲”有一个赌约，谁先知道他的真名谁就可以拿走所有的钱。

original: I don't talk to most of them. Billy says that I have to be careful, even when people seem nice. And I'm especially not allowed to talk to Mr. Jericho.
translation: 我跟他们绝大部分人都不怎么说话。比利告诉我说要小心点，即使那些人看上去是好人。并且别人跟我说绝对不要和耶利哥先生说话。

original: I usually play with Harden most days, when his dad isn't taking him out to learn to shoot or something.
translation: 我一般跟哈登在一起玩，通常他爸爸总是让他学习射击什么的。

original: Billy says that he's going to teach me to shoot one day too!
translation: 比利告诉我，他也会找个时间教我怎么射击！

original: There's the Stahls. They run the Brass Lantern. I go there to eat with my dad sometimes. Doc Church runs the clinic.
translation: 有斯塔尔一家。他们经营黄铜灯。我有时候和我爸爸在那吃饭。丘奇医生经营一家诊所。

original: The Confessor is a little weird. But him and mother Maya are always nice to me.
translation: 忏悔者那人有点怪。但是他和玛雅修女总是对我很好。

original: There's also Moriarty, but dad says that I'm not allowed to talk to him.
translation: 这还一个叫莫里亚蒂的人，但是爸爸不让我跟他讲话。

original: It's great! My dad says that one day, I'm gonna get to be sheriff, just like him!
translation: 这儿棒极了！我爸爸说过，总有一天我也会成为这儿的警长，就像他那样！

original: A long, long time ago, he saved me from Raiders!
translation: 很久很久以前，他把我从掠夺者手中救了出来！

original: They... killed my real parents. But Billy showed up before they got me, and now he's like my daddy... sort of...
translation: 他们……杀了我的亲生父母。但是比利在他们杀我之前出现了。现在，他就像是我父亲一样……

original: Later.
translation: 回见。

original: *Sigh* It's one thing after another in this place, isn't it? Anyway, I should get going.
translation: *叹气*在这地方事总是没完没了，对吧？不管怎样，我得走了。

original: Hm hmm.
translation: 唔嗯。

original: Walter sure is a grumpy old bastard. But he keeps that crusty old plant running, so I guess we have no choice but to put up with him.
translation: 沃尔特确实是一个脾气暴躁的老混蛋。但是他是照看着那些老水管，所以我们不得不忍。

original: Busted up my knee the other day, so I went to see Doc Church. He needs to work on his bedside manner -- my own mother never chewed me out like that!
translation: 那天我把膝盖摔坏了，所以我就去找丘奇医生。他需要改善一下对待患者的态度 — 就连我的母亲都没有像他那样严厉的训斥我！

original: I swear to God, Moira's crazy. She sold me this thing the other day, I didn't even know what the hell it was. Damn good saleswoman though. Damn good.
translation: 我发誓，莫伊拉是个疯子。她有一天把这卖给我，我甚至都不知道那东西是什么。该死的女人。真该死。

original: What is with those Church of the Atom lunatics anyway? They're all fucked in the head... drinking the bomb water, praying for another war?
translation: 原子教堂是怎么回事？里面的人是不是都疯了……估计是喝核弹旁的水太多了，居然祈祷另一场战争？

original: Manya and Nathan are both gone... what's happening around here?
translation: 曼雅和内森都走了……这地方出了什么事？

original: With Walter dead, we're screwed. No one else can keep that treatment plant running.
translation: 沃尔特死后，我们就完蛋了。没人能继续经营这。

original: We'll catch up later.
translation: 迟点见。

original: Hey. How's it going?
translation: 嗨，进展得怎么样？

original: Can't say that there's much going on.
translation: 算不上有什么大事。

original: Nada.
translation: 没什么。

original: Not much.
translation: 没什么。

original: Nothing. We'll talk later.
translation: 没什么，迟点再说。

original: Hello, my child.
translation: 你好，我的孩子。

original: Good evening.
translation: 晚上好。

original: Oh! Hi!
translation: 哦！嘿！

original: What's up?
translation: 什么事？

original: Look, I told you people: I'm busy. Leave me alone.
translation: 听着，我跟你们说过：我正在忙，离我远点。

original: Look, I'm a little busy...
translation: 听着，我现在有点忙……

original: I'm bored. Let's see if I can lighten things up around here.
translation: 我很无聊。我看看这周围有什么能让大家激动一下的不。

original: Then you don't have to hear it. The hell with you.
translation: 你可以不听，该死的家伙。

original: Hey, you wanted to hear it.
translation: 嗨，是你自己想听的。

original: We've got slavers! Grab your guns!
translation: 找到奴隶了！拿起武器！
