original: It most certainly does. And if I keep writing in the style of some of your reports, this is going to be one mighty slick book!
translation: 确实，如果我继续按你的报告写下去，这将会是一本非常圆滑的书！

original: Here, for your services, I've saved up quite a few stimpaks. Of course, you may need them: we've still got two more chapters to go.
translation: 给你一些我攒下的治疗针。当然，你会需要它们的：我们还有两章要写。

original: Smooth, suave, and done with a smile. I swear I picked up a few pointers from your style, myself!
translation: 文雅，温和且面带微笑。我发誓我借鉴了你的语言风格！

original: For all your hard work, I want you to have this Mini Nuke. I kept meaning to use it to dig a well, but honestly, it just makes me nervous.
translation: 为了感谢你的辛勤付出，我希望你收下这颗迷你核弹。我本想用它打井，但坦白说，这东西只会让我紧张。

original: Now, I just need to do a few last tweaks and it'll be ready to print and distribute! Thanks for all the help!
translation: 现在，我只需要做一些调整，然后就可以拿去印刷并分发！感谢你所作的一切！

original: It definitely is. I'm trying to put that same great sense of humor you've got into the book. Keep it up, and it'll inform and entertain!
translation: 毫无疑问，我也想把你绝妙的幽默感写入书中。保持住！这样一来读者在获知信息的同时也能得到娱乐！

original: Here, for your services, I've saved up quite a few stimpaks. Of course, you may need them: we've still got two more chapters to go.
translation: 给你一些我攒下的治疗针。你当然会需要它们的：我们还有两章要写。

original: Oh, you. Of course we are. And I think I'm really capturing that snide wit of yours. So, for all your snippiness, I think it'll help with the book.
translation: 哦，你啊。当然了。而且我想我已感受到了你的含沙射影。你的尖酸刻薄会对写书有帮助的。

original: Still, I can put up with plenty of your little jabs, as long as the research is good.
translation: 不管怎么说,我还是可以帮上点小忙的,只要你的研究是出于善意的。

original: And, yes, you'll still get paid. Here: nothing says loving like big boxes of ammunition, right? Now, on to the next chapter?
translation: 是的，你还是能拿到报酬。拿着，没有什么比成箱的弹药更可爱了，对吧？现在继续下一章？

original: Well, lucky for you, we're done! And for all your nasty attitude, I think the quips made it a lot more entertaining to read. That's bound to help.
translation: 嗯，你很走运，我们搞定了！我想你冷嘲热讽的态度更能吸引读者。那肯定会有所帮助。

original: For all your hard work, I want you to have this Mini Nuke. I kept meaning to use it to dig a well, but honestly, it just makes me nervous.
translation: 为了感谢你的辛勤付出，我希望你收下这颗迷你核弹。我本想用它打井，但坦白说，这东西只会让我紧张。

original: Now, I just need to do a few last tweaks and it'll be ready to print and distribute! Thanks for all the help!
translation: 现在，我只需要做一些调整，然后就可以拿去印刷并分发！感谢你所作的一切！

original: We did it!
translation: 我们做到了！

original: Take that, Muties!
translation: 看那，变种人！

original: I didn't think that'd work!
translation: 我没想到它能有用！

original: Die Mutants, DIE!!!!
translation: 该死的变种人，去死！！！

original: You mean, we're still alive?
translation: 你是说，我们还活着？

original: Hurray!
translation: 太好啦！

original: Yeah baby!
translation: 耶！

original: Yay!
translation: 耶！

original: Our hero returns!
translation: 我们的英雄回来了！

original: Our heroine returns!
translation: 我们的英雌回来了！

original: Did he rescue them?!
translation: 他救了他们？！

original: Did she rescue them?!
translation: 她救了他们？！

original: Bleh! He's coming to tell us he failed!
translation: 噗！他是来告诉我们他失败了！

original: Bleh! She's coming to tell us she failed!
translation: 噗！她是来告诉我们她失败了！

original: What? Don't I count for something? He rescued me at least!
translation: 什么？我一点价值都没吗？至少他救了我！

original: What? Don't I count for something? She rescued me at least!
translation: 什么？我什么都不是？至少她救了我！

original: I told you he could do it, but you didn't listen to me! You never listen to me!
translation: 我说过他能做到，但你们都不听我的！你们从来不听我的！

original: I told you she could do it, but you didn't listen to me! You never listen to me!
translation: 我说过她能做到，但你们都不听我的！你们从来不听我的！

original: Hurray!
translation: 太好啦！

original: Alright! Welcome back!
translation: 很好！欢迎回来！

original: Yea!
translation: 耶！

original: Yeah. Yeah. Go on up, hotshot. Just don't screw around, or things will get ugly. No second chances. Got it?
translation: 嗯。嗯，进去吧，高手。别乱来，否则事情会变得很糟糕。没有第二次机会，明白吗？

original: I'm glad to see you are a sensible person.
translation: 很高兴你是个开明的人。

original: Now, get me out of this place. I can't stand it anymore!
translation: 现在，放我出去吧，我再也待不下去了！

original: It was taken from a historical entry in the computer. The name comes from a man who was willing to fight and die for what he believed in.
translation: 它取自电脑中的一个历史条目。这个名字来源于一个愿意为自己的信仰战斗和牺牲的人。

original: I felt it was appropriate given my circumstances.
translation: 我觉得这名字适合我的处境。

original: Yes. I suppose it is. When my captors placed me here, they were too stupid to realize this room contained a working terminal.
translation: 我觉得也是。当抓住我的人把我扔在这以后，他们愚蠢到没发现这房间里有个工作终端。

original: I've spent all my life teaching myself to read and speak based on the information stored on the Vault's Mainframe.
translation: 我花了所有的时间来阅读和背诵避难所主机上的信息。

original: Ironic, isn't it? Surrounded by the world's history and yet my world consists of this tiny room.
translation: 很讽刺，不是吗？我能看到全世界的历史，但我的世界却只有这房间。

original: No, please. I haven't had a civil conversation all my life! Don't go!
translation: 别，求你了。我这辈子都没好好说过话！别走！

original: I could help you!
translation: 我能帮上你！

original: Ugh. Must you use that vulgar term?
translation: 呃，你非要那么粗俗地称呼我嘛？

original: Yes, I was born in the F.E.V. Chambers but a Super Mutant I certainly am not. I prefer the term Meta Human. Suits me better don't you think?
translation: 是的，我是因F.E.V.测试出现的，但我不能算是超级变种人。我会称呼自己为蜕变人类。你觉得是否更适合我？

original: Perhaps I'm getting ahead of myself. The name's Fawkes.
translation: 或许我超越了自己。我的名字是福克斯。

original: What's the matter with you? I assure you I'm unlike the others in this dank place.
translation: 你有病吗？我保证我和这阴冷之地的其他所有人都不同。

original: The name's Fawkes. I'd shake your hand, but this room happens to be my prison cell.
translation: 我的名字是福克斯。我想和你握手，但恐怕这房间是关押我的牢笼。

original: Me? You care who I am?
translation: 我？你居然在乎我是什么？

original: Forgive me, but I'm not used to pleasantries. I'm more used to grunts and being struck about by the others.
translation: 原谅我，但我从没开过玩笑。我之前一直都是吼吼和被别人攻击。

original: My name's Fawkes. I've lived in this... cage all my life.
translation: 我的名字是福克斯。我一直都住在这……牢笼里。

original: I had hoped to do it myself, so I'm only paying half because you didn't follow orders.
translation: 我曾想亲自去做，我只付你一半钱，因为你没按规矩去干。

original: At least those slaves have been stopped. Paradise Falls still owes you a debt of gratitude. Come by and see us sometime.
translation: 至少已经阻止了那些奴隶。天堂瀑依然欠你一份情。以后别忘了回来看看我们。

original: Everyone get ready!
translation: 大家准备好！

original: Have you? It saddens me to hear of my fallen brethren, but their names and deeds shall be records. Tell me, how many have you found?
translation: 是吗？我为我逝去的兄弟感到难过，但他们的名字和事迹都该被记录下来。告诉我，你找到了多少？

original: They are on our fallen Brothers throughout the D.C. Ruins. However, I can't give you a full report on the locations of all of our operations.
translation: 在特区的废墟中，我们牺牲的兄弟身上。不过我无法向你全面报告我们的所有行动地点。

original: As I said, many of the units in the field operate independently, sometimes not reporting into the Citadel for weeks or months.
translation: 就像我说的，许多外勤部队都是独立行动，数周或数月都不会向大本营发回报告。

original: ... okay... well... as you can see, we're having trouble keeping track of our soldiers in the field.
translation: 好吧…呃…你也能看到……我们在追踪我们的士兵上有些小麻烦。

original: And worse than that problem, a Brother fallen in the field would have no one to carry word of his death back to me.
translation: 最糟的是，战场上倒下的兄弟，可能没人把他的死讯传给我。

original: In calmer times, we could send detachments and messengers to learn their fates, but with our manpower stretched thin, we have no such luxury.
translation: 在平静时期，我们可以派遣小分队和信使去了解他们的命运，但现在我们人力紧张，无法享有这种奢侈。

original: Which is why I must now ask you for your help. Each Brother wears a Holotag like the one you found.
translation: 这就是为什么我请求你的帮助，每个兄弟会成员都会佩戴一个全息标识牌，跟你找到的这些东西一样。

original: Should you find any of the fallen Brethren in the field, I ask that you return their tags to me, so that I might record their deeds in the scrolls.
translation: 当你在外面找到我们阵亡的兄弟时，我希望你能取下他们的军牌并带给我，这样我就能把他们的死亡记录在卷轴上。

original: I would ask that you respect the Elder as you would your own father. And rude as you may be, you are correct. We can't keep track of them.
translation: 我希望你像尊重自己的父亲一样尊重长老。虽然你的话很无礼，但你说得对。我们没法追踪他们。

original: And worse than that problem, a Brother fallen in the field would have no one to carry word of his death back to me.
translation: 最糟的是，战场上倒下的兄弟，可能没人把他的死讯传给我。

original: In calmer times, we could send detachments and messengers to learn their fates, but with our manpower stretched thin, we have no such luxury.
translation: 在平静时期，我们可以派遣小分队和信使去了解他们的命运，但现在我们人力紧张，无法享有这种奢侈。

original: Which is why I must now ask you for your help. Each Brother wears a Holotag like the one you found.
translation: 这就是为什么我请求你的帮助，每个兄弟会成员都会佩戴一个全息标识牌，跟你找到的这些东西一样。

original: Should you find any of the fallen Brethren in the field, I ask that you return their tags to me, so that I might record their deeds in the scrolls.
translation: 当你在外面找到我们阵亡的兄弟时，我希望你能取下他们的军牌并带给我，这样我就能把他们的死亡记录在卷轴上。

original: Exactly. A Brother fallen in the field may have no one to carry word of his death back to me.
translation: 没错。战场上倒下的兄弟，可能没人把他的死讯传给我。

original: In calmer times, we could send detachments and messengers to learn their fates, but with our manpower stretched thin, we have no such luxury.
translation: 在平静时期，我们可以派遣小分队和信使去了解他们的命运，但现在我们人力紧张，无法享有这种奢侈。

original: Which is why I must now ask you for your help. Each Brother wears a Holotag like the one you found.
translation: 这就是为什么我请求你的帮助，每个兄弟会成员都会佩戴一个全息标识牌，跟你找到的这些东西一样。

original: Should you find any of the fallen Brethren in the field, I ask that you return their tags to me, so that I might record their deeds in the scrolls.
translation: 当你在外面找到我们阵亡的兄弟时，我希望你能取下他们的军牌并带给我，这样我就能把他们的死亡记录在卷轴上。

original: Very well. It's as simple as this. I need someone to collect Holotags from our fallen brethren in the field.
translation: 很好，就这么简单，我需要有人去收集我们战死兄弟的全息标识牌。

original: Bring them to me so that I can record the fallen Brothers in the Scrolls, and I will reward you. And that's all that you need to know.
translation: 把它们带给我，这样我就能把他们的死亡记录在卷轴上，我会付你报酬的。这就是你需要知道的。

original: Good. As I'm sure you've noticed, the Brotherhood operates all over the D.C. ruins, often detached from the main base here at the Citadel.
translation: 那就好，我相信你注意到了，兄弟会的活动范围遍布整个特区废墟，经常会和大本营的主基地断联。

original: We're short on communication equipment, so many of the groups in the field operate as independent cells without standing orders.
translation: 我们相当缺乏通信设备，所以很多外勤小队都是独立行动的，没固定指令。

original: Sometimes... I'm afraid that their missions end in their deaths. As keeper of the Scrolls, it's my charge to write of each fallen Brother's deeds.
translation: 有时候……我担心他们的任务会以死亡告终。作为卷轴的保管者，我的职责就是记录每个牺牲的兄弟的事迹。

original: She spends most of her time in the Archives. You'll find them in A Ring, near the great hall.
translation: 她大部分时间都在档案室里。你会在楼的A环找到她，就在大厅附近。

original: My God, you're a coldblooded little shit, aren't you? I think you'd actually do it.
translation: 我的天啊，你是个冷血的小杂种，对吧？我相信你说的出做的到。

original: Here. Leave the Vault. I'll have you shot on sight if you ever come back.
translation: 给。拿着这些离开避难所。我只要一看到你再回来就会射杀你。

original: Oh, is that all? Is there anything else I can get you while you're here?
translation: 哦？就这样？你还在这的时候我是否能得到些什么呢？

original: You'll get nothing from me. I'll die before I see the safety of the Vault compromised again.
translation: 你从我这什么都得不到。即使以生命交换避难所的安全我也乐意。

original: Oh, is that all? Is there anything else I can get you while you're here?
translation: 哦？就这样？你还在这的时候我是否能得到些什么呢？

original: You'll get nothing from me. I'll die before I see the safety of the Vault compromised again.
translation: 你从我这什么都得不到。即使以生命交换避难所的安全我也乐意。

original: I don't think I like your tone. There's nothing wrong with me, we've lived this way for decades.
translation: 我不认为我喜欢你的腔调。我一点错都没有，我们已经这样生活十几年了。

original: After the war, four families survived. They continued on just like we have. But when their shelters ran out of food, they need to eat something.
translation: 战后活下来四家人。日子照样要过，可能吃的都吃完之后，总要填饱肚子吧。

original: Family is everything, my friend. I wouldn't expect a wasteland wanderer like you to understand.
translation: 家庭就是一切，我的朋友。我不指望像你这样的废土客能理解。

original: Okay, that's it. I warned you. Normally, I wouldn't hit a lady, but you're over the line, missy.
translation: 好吧，就这样吧，我警告过你了，现在要让你吃点苦头了，女士。

original: I don't think I like your tone. There's nothing wrong with me, we've lived this way for decades.
translation: 我不认为我喜欢你的腔调。我一点错都没有，我们已经这样生活十几年了。

original: After the war, four families survived. They continued on just like we have. But when their shelters ran out of food, they need to eat something.
translation: 战后活下来四家人。日子照样要过，可能吃的都吃完之后，总要填饱肚子吧。

original: Family is everything, my friend. I wouldn't expect a wasteland wanderer like you to understand.
translation: 家庭就是一切，我的朋友。我不指望像你这样的废土客能理解。

original: Now, let's just forget that this happened and we'll have no problem, right?
translation: 现在，如果你忘了这些那就一点问题都没有，好吗？

original: I'm disappointed in you stranger -- so quick to judge us. Did you ever stop to think that I have a family to support here?
translation: 我对你很失望，陌生人 — 这么急于下判断。你就没想想我还有一大家子要养活吗？

original: "Judge not, lest ye be judged" as the good book says. Honestly, how many people have you killed?
translation: “不要批评别人，免得将来也被别人批评。”就像书里说的。坦白说，你杀了多少人？

original: The only difference between us is that I'm bringing home the bacon for my family.
translation: 我们唯一的不同就是我把这些肉带回去给家人吃而已。

original: I'm disappointed in you stranger -- so quick to judge us. Did you ever stop to think that I have a family to support here?
translation: 我对你们这些陌生人真失望 — 这么快就来审判我们了。你就没想想我还有个家庭要支撑吗？

original: "Judge not, lest ye be judged" as the good book says. Honestly, how many people have you killed?
translation: “不要批评别人，免得将来也被别人批评。”就像《圣经》里说的。坦白说，你杀了多少人？

original: The only difference between us is that I'm bringing home the bacon for my family.
translation: 我们唯一的不同就是我把这些肉带回去给家人吃而已。

original: Why, it's a place to settle down and raise a family. Of course, we don't just let anyone in here. The home owners association is very clear on that.
translation: 噢，这是一处移居地和家庭住地。当然，我们不让外人来这里。这的家庭联系很紧密。

original: Besides, there's no room! As amazing as Andale is, is it any wonder that all the houses would be full of happy families?
translation: 再说，也没空房间了！安代尔如此神奇，所有房子都住满了幸福的家庭，有啥奇怪？

original: Andale: greatest place there is. We win town of the year every year, we've got no end of food, and no troubles at all.
translation: 安代尔：最棒的地方！我们每年都赢得年度最佳镇子，我们不缺食物，从无麻烦。

original: Yep, there's no better place to raise a family.
translation: 耶，没有更好的地方来养育家庭。

original: It's swell! Except... I wish there were more kids. And my dad says that I'm gonna have to marry smelly ol' Jenny Wilson some day.
translation: 它很不错！除非……我还希望有更多的孩子。我的父亲说我以后必须和难闻的老珍妮·威尔逊结婚。

original: He keeps saying stuff to my mom about keeping the family going, and how when him and Mr. Wilson were brothers, they didn't want to get married.
translation: 他一直跟我妈说要让这个家延续下去，他和威尔逊先生还是兄弟的时候，他们并不想结婚。

original: It's weird... that means that Mr. Wilson is my uncle and Jenny is... something. I don't know. It seems weird to marry her.
translation: 感觉有些奇怪……这就是说威尔逊先生是我的叔叔，珍妮是……什么来着。我忘了，总之和她结婚感觉很怪。

original: Do you think I'm scared of a snotnosed punk like you? I was running this Vault when you were still crying for your dead mother.
translation: 你觉得我会害怕像你这样的鼻涕虫吗？你还在为为母亲死亡大哭时我就在经营整个避难所了。

original: You'll get nothing from me. I'll die before I see the safety of the Vault compromised again.
translation: 你从我这什么都得不到。即使以生命交换避难所的安全我也乐意。

original: Do you think I'm scared of a snotnosed punk like you? I was running this Vault when you were still crying for your dead mother.
translation: 你觉得我会害怕像你这样的鼻涕虫吗？你还在为为母亲死亡大哭时我就在经营整个避难所了。

original: You'll get nothing from me. I'll die before I see the safety of the Vault compromised again.
translation: 你从我这什么都得不到。即使以生命交换避难所的安全我也乐意。

original: Thank you. That will make this easier. Guards! Help me!
translation: 谢谢你。这样就容易多了。守卫！救救我！

original: I can't say that I know what you're talking about, but I sure as heck don't like your tone. You've got no business coming in here and judging us.
translation: 我不知道你在说些什么，但我很讨厌你嚼舌根。你没有权利到这来评判我们。

original: We're four hard working American families. I work hard to put food on the table for my family, so do all the men here.
translation: 我们是四个努力工作的美国家庭。我努力让家人都能吃上饭，这里的男人都是这样的。

original: It's not easy living the American dream but dammit, we're doing the best we can.
translation: 在这里生活可不像该死的美国梦，我们都只是尽力而已。

original: Oh, someone spilled our beans, didn't they? Well, Andale has been four families and only four families for a very long time.
translation: 哦，总有人会露馅的，对吧？嗯，安代尔最初只有四个家庭而且持续了相当长的一段时间。

original: Two families marry into one another, take a new name, and start a new life. There's nothing wrong with that, is there?
translation: 两户人家结为一家，换了一个名字，开始了新的生活？这没有错吧？

original: Well... I never! The nerve of some people! At least some of us know how to take the high road.
translation: 不！有些人真是精神病！至少我们还有人知道怎么上高速公路。

original: Did you want something, Mr. Fancy Underground Vault, or did you just come here to turn your nose up at us?
translation: 你想干嘛？痴迷地下避难所先生，还是说你只是跑来窥视我们的？

original: Well... I never! The nerve of some people! At least some of us know how to take the high road.
translation: 不！有些人真是精神病！至少我们还有人知道怎么上高速公路。

original: Did you want something, Miss Fancy Underground Vault, or did you just come here to turn your nose up at us?
translation: 你想干嘛？痴迷地下避难所小姐，还是说你只是跑来窥视我们的？

original: No! Well... yes. But it's all a trick. Don't you know anything? Does that number on your back mean that you just crawled out of a vault or something?
translation: 不！好……吧。但那是一个骗局。你知道什么？你背上那数字表示你刚从哪个避难所还是别的什么地方爬出来的？

original: Just about everyone in the wasteland knows to avoid Andale, and they're right to do it. People wander in here, and they don't wander back out.
translation: 废土上的每个人都知道要避开安代尔，他们是对的。人们游荡到这里，就不会再游荡出去。

original: Well, they're not! They're killers! Every one of 'em! Run! Get out while you can!
translation: 嗯，他们不是！他们是杀手！每个都是！快跑！跑得越远越好！

original: Don't believe me, do you? Just check out the basement, or that shed! There's a reason they're locked!
translation: 你不相信我，对吧？去看看地下室，或是那工棚！它们被锁起来是有原因的！

original: Well, now. I'm sure that your home town is just so much better than our little Andale.
translation: 现在好了。我相信你的老家一定比我们的小安代尔好多了。

original: Suit yourself, but you don't know what you're missing.
translation: 随便你，但你不知道自己错过了什么。

original: Linda's meatloaf is the best in the country. And her mince meat pie has won first prize at the town fair three years running.
translation: 琳达的肉卷是全国最好吃的，她的碎肉派连续三年获得镇上集市的一等奖。

original: But the invitation still stands, if you ever change your mind. But listen to me go on, did you need something else?
translation: 我们的邀请还算数，你随时都可以回心转意。现在，听我说，你还需要什么吗？

original: And it's good to meet you too! Feel free to stay in Andale as long as you'd like. Heck, stop by the house for dinner sometime if you like.
translation: 我也很高兴见到你！你想在安代尔待多久都行。诶呀，如果你愿意，还可以来我家吃晚饭。

original: Just let Linda know beforehand, so that she can make enough for four!
translation: 不过要提前通知琳达，她才能准备足够的四份！

original: Well, this is the last one I have. If you lose this, you're shit out of luck.
translation: 嗯，这是我手头上的最后一个，别再弄丢了，要不然你也太背运了。

original: Okay, but I only have two left. So try and be more careful.
translation: 行，不过我只剩下两个了，你小心点。

original: That's okay, here's another. Just be careful, they don't grow on trees you know.
translation: 没关系，这里还有一个。小心点，你知道它们不是长在树上的。

original: Here, take this geomapper. Please don't lose it. Donovan spent a year developing it and I only have a few.
translation: 给，拿着这地理测绘仪，请不要再弄丢它。多诺万花费了整整一年时间制造它们，而我手头上也仅有几个而已。

original: It will offload all of the map data you collect from your Pip-Boy automatically. When you come back, I can take the data from it and you get paid.
translation: 我将会从你的哔哔小子上下载所有收集的地图数据，这是自动的，只要你弄到新地图我就付钱。

original: Here, take this geomapper. Please don't lose it. Donovan spent a year developing it and I only have a few.
translation: 给，拿着这地理测绘仪，请不要再弄丢它。多诺万花费了整整一年时间制造它们，而我手头上也仅有几个而已。

original: It will offload all of the map data you collect from your Pip-Boy automatically. When you come back, I can take the data from it and you get paid.
translation: 我将会从你的哔哔小子上下载所有收集的地图数据，这是自动的，只要你弄到新地图我就付钱。

original: I don't know. I'm not sure I'm cut out for this kind of job anymore.
translation: 我不知道。我不知道自己是否还能再做下去。

original: I almost got everyone killed in Vernon Square. What kind of a responsible leader does that? It was one bad decision after another.
translation: 我几乎让所有人都牺牲在了弗农广场。我算是什么领袖？只会做出一个接一个的错误决定。

original: That's funny, you look fine to me. Maybe you should just get some rest.
translation: 这真可笑，你看起来很好。或许你需要休息一下。

original: Yeah, you look like you need some work.
translation: 嗯，你看起来需要开始工作了。

original: All right, hang in there. Let me see what I can do for you.
translation: 行，等等，让我来看看我能为你做些什么。

original: Rescue whoever the hell you like, but they aren't my friends. I don't NEED friends. Though I'm sure someone will pay you if you succeed.
translation: 你想救谁就救谁吧，但他们不是我的朋友。我不需要朋友，不过如果你救了他们，我想会有人会付钱的。

original: Oh. Well... If you change your mind... we'd be awfully grateful. Those are our friends...
translation: 哦……如果你能改变主意……我们会非常感激。那是我们的朋友。

original: Yeah... Yeah! They went northeast... probably to the Germantown Police Headquarters. They have guns. And they're mean. So you better careful.
translation: 嗯……是的！他们去了东北方……好像是日耳曼镇警察总部。他们有枪而且很厉害，你得小心。

original: You going to rescue them, or what?
translation: 你是要去救他们，还是怎么？

original: Have you changed your mind? Are you going to rescue our friends? I'd given up hope. It's so hard here in the Wasteland. Not like when we were young.
translation: 你改变主意了吗？你会去救我们的朋友吗？我已经放弃希望了，毕竟在废土生活太艰难了，比不得我们年轻的时候。

original: What? You never seen a Super Mutant before?! They're mean and ugly and scary as hell!
translation: 什么？你从来没见过超级变种人？他们丑陋而庞大，吓死人了！

original: They came and rounded up a bunch of us and carried them off! God! They must be doing awful things to them.
translation: 他们袭击我们并带走了一部分人！天啊！不知道这些人受到了什么样的折磨。

original: I'd go rescue them, but then who'd defend Big Town? I patrol every day now.
translation: 我能去救他们，但是谁来防卫大镇？每天都需要我巡逻。

original: And I got a little present for those Muties when they come back. You know what it is? This kick-ass gun. That's what! Yeah baby!
translation: 那些该死的变种人要是回来，我为他们准备了一个小礼物。知道什么吗？他妈的枪，就是这，可爱的宝贝！

original: Aww, I'm blushing!
translation: 啊，我脸都红了！

original: That's so nice of you to say! Thank you!
translation: 你太会说话了！谢谢！

original: Oh, you're embarrassing me!
translation: 哦，你真让我难为情！

original: Why thank you!
translation: 太感谢你了！

original: Fine. This will just take a second.
translation: 好的。很快就会完成。

original: Shouldn't take but a moment. Hold still please.
translation: 稍后再来拿。耐心等候。

original: Sigh. Come back when you do.
translation: 唉。当你完成后再回来吧。

original: Thanks. Now hold still, you don't want me to slip when holding sharp objects.
translation: 谢谢。现在拿好，你不会希望在你拿着尖物时，我刚好滑倒吧。

original: Good, good. Now let's see if we can fix you up quickly.
translation: 好，好。现在看看我们能不能治好你。

original: I'm not a charity worker. Come back when you have the caps, and we'll do business.
translation: 我并不是教堂义工。等你有瓶盖时再回来找我吧。

original: Good. Now, hold still. This is going to hurt like hell.
translation: 好。现在别动，会很疼，但要忍住。

original: Bite down, this is going to hurt.
translation: 咬住，这会很疼的。

original: Sigh. Come back when you do!
translation: 唉。等你决定后再回来吧！

original: Well, I'm not a charity worker. Especially with humans. You want me to fix you up, bring caps next time.
translation: 嗯，我可不是教堂义工。特别对一个人类来说。你需要我修好你，那就得付瓶盖。

original: Certainly, we can help you. Please speak to Doctor Barrows.
translation: 当然，我们可以帮助你，请和巴罗斯医生谈谈。

original: Oh, and we only take caps... no barter.
translation: 哦，我们只收瓶盖……不讨价还价。

original: Neither have I. Well, I mean I talk to Herbert, but he never really says anything back. Do ya Herbert?
translation: 我也没有。呃，我是说我会跟赫伯特聊天，但他从没真正回应过什么。是吧，赫伯特？

original: He kept growing around me, maybe for calling him Herbert all the time. His name's really Bob. I think it's funny when I call him Herbert though.
translation: 他一直在我身边生长，或许是因为我总叫他赫伯特吧。他的真名叫鲍勃，但我觉得称他赫伯特很有意思。

original: The front desk computer has access to the card catalogs, but it appears that it's lost the connection to the main archives.
translation: 前台电脑可以访问卡片目录，但似乎失去了与主档案库的连接。

original: Here's the password. Now, you might be able to find the central computer further in there, but I'm afraid you'll have to do that without me. I'm a scholar, not a fighter.
translation: 这是密码。现在，你也许能在里面找到中央电脑，但恐怕得你一个人进去了，我毕竟是学者，不是战士。

original: I know it was a lot to ask, but we made a great piece! And it's bound to help humanity, you know.
translation: 我知道这要求可能有点过分，可我们是在做大事！并且人类必须得到帮助，你知道的。

original: I'll share these with the traders, and soon, everyone will know about the Wasteland Survival Guide!
translation: 我会与商人分享这些，很快的，每个人都会知道《废土生存指南》！

original: But before that, here's your complimentary copy, complete with my compliments. Good work, Wasteland survival assistant!
translation: 在这之前，我先给你一本赠送版本，作为我对你的感激。你干得很好，真是个废土生存助手！

original: And if it wasn't for that fearless fortitude and sacrifice for science, it wouldn't have been made. It'll be a tremendous boon to humanity, you know.
translation: 要不是因为有着大无畏的坚韧，还有对科学所做出的牺牲，我们根本不可能做到。这将是对人类巨大的恩惠，你知道吧。

original: I'll share these with the traders, and soon, everyone will know about the Wasteland Survival Guide!
translation: 我会与商人分享这些，很快的，每个人都会知道《废土生存指南》！

original: But first, here -- the very first copy of our book goes to you. I couldn't have done it without you, my Wasteland survival expert!
translation: 在这之前，给你 — 我们共同出版的第一本书。我一个人是不可能完成这本书的，我的废土生存专家！

original: And those risks will have saved hundreds -- no, thousands of lives! Your quality research really took it to the next level, you know!
translation: 并且你所冒的风险将会拯救成百上千人的性命 — 不，是成千上万人的性命！要知道你的品格已经达到了另一个境界！

original: I'll share these with the traders, and soon, everyone will know about the Wasteland Survival Guide!
translation: 我会与商人分享这些，很快的，每个人都会知道《废土生存指南》！

original: But now, the very first copy of our book goes to you. It wouldn't nearly be as good without your input. You're the real Wasteland survival guru!
translation: 但现在，我们这本书的第一本要交给你。没有你的意见，我们的书不会这么好。你才是真正的废土生存权威！

original: Oh my... It's... it's brilliant! Even I'm astounded by my genius! Oh no, no, it's more than that. By OUR genius!
translation: 哦，天啊……这……这真是太棒了！连我都被自己的天才所震惊！哦不，不仅仅是我，是我们的天才！

original: I'll share these with the traders, and soon, everyone will know about the Wasteland Survival Guide!
translation: 我会与商人分享这些，很快的，每个人都会知道《废土生存指南》！

original: But now, the very first copy of our book goes to you. It wouldn't nearly be as good without your input. You're the real Wasteland survival guru!
translation: 但现在，我们这本书的第一本要交给你。没有你的意见，我们的书不会这么好。你才是真正的废土生存权威！

original: She did? Well, suppose I've picked up a lot over the years. I mean, no one's spent more time tinkering on this old girl than I have!
translation: 她真这么说？嗯，我在她身上花了好多年心思了。我的意思是，有谁能比我打理这老女孩的时间多啊！

original: Oh, Rivet City, I mean. Not Vera. I mean, Vera's not old. And I haven't tinkered on her, obviously. Not that I wouldn't... I mean, umm... No.
translation: 哦，铆钉城，我的意思是。不是薇拉。薇拉并不老。我也没打理过她，显然的。并不是说我不会去这么做的，唔……不会的。

original: Anyway, you might find some clues in Pinkerton's place, in the broken-off bow. He was around before me, and used to store stuff there before he left.
translation: 总之，你可以在平克顿那找到线索，在断裂的船头。他之前一直在那，离开前他把东西都存那儿了。

original: Hah! Sounds like you've been poking around, all right. I'm surprised any of those reprobates even remember me.
translation: 啊哈！看来你一直在四处打听，好吧。那帮无赖竟然还记得我，让我很吃惊。

original: Maybe they still laugh about how they edged me out of the council, back then. But you can set the record straight!
translation: 或许他们还在笑话当年如何把我挤出议会的事。但你可以澄清事实！

original: Well, yes, but it was hardly any place of importance until I arrived on the scene. That's all ancient history now. No one would ever care about it.
translation: 嗯，是的，但在我到来之前，它几乎没什么重要性。那都是陈年旧事了。没人会关心的。

original: If you insist on wasting your time on that, you could try that bartending old crone down below, Belle Bonny.
translation: 如果你坚持要在这上面浪费时间，可以去下面找那个调酒的老太婆，贝勒·邦尼。

original: Well, yes, but it was hardly any place of importance until I arrived on the scene. That's all ancient history now. No one would ever care about it.
translation: 嗯，是的，但在我到来之前，它几乎没什么重要性。那都是陈年旧事了。没人会关心的。

original: If you're going to waste someone's time on that, go bother that idiot, Seagrave Holmes. He spends all his time in the bowels of this place.
translation: 如果你想浪费别人的时间的话，去烦那个白痴，西格雷夫·福尔摩斯。他把所有时间都花在这个地方了。

original: Well, yes, but it was hardly any place of importance until I arrived on the scene. That's all ancient history now. No one would ever care about it.
translation: 嗯，是的，但在我到来之前，它几乎没什么重要性。那都是陈年旧事了。没人会关心的。

original: Last feller I remember from back then was Mr. Pinkerton, and he must've left about a decade ago, after that spat with the science team.
translation: 我记得那时的最后一位是平克顿先生，他肯定十年前就离开了，在与科学小组的争吵之后。

original: He used to have a storage shed in the broken-off bow of the ship; we always thought he was crazy for keeping stuff there.
translation: 他以前在断裂开的船头有一个储藏室；我们一直以为他疯了，把东西放在那里。

original: Might have kept a couple records down there, I guess. Careful, though; ship's a bit treacherous down there in her belly!
translation: 我猜，他可能在那里保存了一些记录。不过要小心，船腹下层有点危险！

original: I heard the place was settled by mercenaries who used to scavenge D.C. But I don't really know.
translation: 我听说这个地方是以前在特区搜刮的雇佣兵定居的地方，但我真的不了解。

original: Oh, it's not the past of the city that I dwell upon, but the future of its inhabitants.
translation: 哦，这我没有研究过，我只仔细研究过现在的这些居民。

original: But if you're interested, I believe Miss Weatherly or Mr. Bannon would be glad to speak with you on the subject.
translation: 但是如果你感兴趣的话，我相信韦瑟利小姐或者班侬先生可能会很高兴跟你谈论这种话题。

original: Oh, it's not the past of the city that I dwell upon, but the future of its inhabitants.
translation: 哦，这我没有研究过，我只仔细研究过现在的这些居民。

original: But if you're interested, I believe Mr. Bannon would be glad to speak with you on the subject.
translation: 但是如果你感兴趣的话，我相信班侬先生可能会很高兴跟你谈论这种话题。

original: No, thank you. Please leave Mr. Zimmer and myself alone.
translation: 不，谢谢。请让齐默先生和我独自待会。

original: It's not garbage! But don't be fooled - it is junk. It's just junk that's pretty important stuff, you know?
translation: 这些不是破烂！不要被骗了 — 是废物，是非常有用的废物，你懂吗？

original: Junk can be turned into all sorts of useful things. And sometimes, even something wonderful.
translation: 破烂可以变成很多很有用的东西。甚至还可以做出非常棒的东西。

original: And junk's all we've got left after the world blew up. Everyone's trying to fix it like it was, but nobody's trying to make something that's better.
translation: 在世界崩坏之后，我们所能找到的就只有破烂了。每个人都在尝试着把这世界修复，但是没有人去把它变成比以前更好的世界。

original: No. It's like... Did you ever try to put a broken piece of glass back together? Even if the pieces fit, you can't make it whole again the way it was.
translation: 不是的。我做的这些更像是……你曾尝试过把碎了的玻璃重新拼接起来吗？即使这些小碎片互相吻合，你也不能把这些碎玻璃还原成原来的模样了。

original: But if you're clever, you can still use the pieces to make other useful things. Maybe even something wonderful, like a mosaic.
translation: 但如果你要是聪明点的话，你可以用这些废铜烂铁来做一些有用的东西。或许能做出相当不错的东西，像镶嵌画什么的。

original: Well, the world broke just like the glass. And everyone's trying to put it back together like it was, but it'll never come together the same way.
translation: 嗯，这世界就像是玻璃一样碎了。每个人都在想尽办法把支离破碎的世界重新拼接起来，但是它已不可能恢复到原本的样子了。

original: All right, here you go. I hope it fits.
translation: 好吧，给你，希望合身。

original: So you think you can handle this?
translation: 那你怎么办？

original: Sure thing. Hopefully it'll give you a bit of an extra edge.
translation: 好吧。希望这对你有所帮助。

original: Okay, so do you think you can hold it together for this?
translation: 好吧。你觉得能把这放在一起？

original: Get some suppressing fire over there, now!
translation: 马上过去压制火力！

original: No offense, kid, but you're not exactly the type I'm used to runnin' with.
translation: 没有恶意，孩子，一般来说我是不会和你这种人打交道的。

original: I've heard about you -- a lil' goody two shoes out of the Vault. I don't think our styles would really mesh.
translation: 我听说过你 — 在避难所你一直是个两面派。我认为像你这样的人，和我是合不来的。

original: Nah, it ain't so bad here. I got some good memories, but that's all I got. No sense in ruining the good ones, you know?
translation: 不，这其实也不错。我也有些好的回忆，但那是我的所有了。没理由破坏美好的东西，是吧？

original: No offense. You seem okay, kid. But your friend there, well... I'm used to working in smaller groups.
translation: 没有恶意，你看起来不错，孩子。但你那些朋友……嗯，我习惯在规模小一点的队伍里做事。

original: Come back when you're alone and maybe we can work something out.
translation: 你独自回来的话，或许我可以考虑下。

original: Yeah, I am. But I'm gonna need 1,000 caps for supplies before I head out with you.
translation: 嗯。但在我跟你走之前，我需要1000个瓶盖来购买补给。

original: Why the fuck would you start saying it if you weren't going to finish. Back out where? What are you talking about?
translation: 你他妈的不想把话说完，就别和我废话。还能去哪？你在说什么？

original: I see how it is. You'd best think twice before fucking with me again.
translation: 我明白了。在你他妈的惹我之前，最好给我想清楚了。

original: Because you've always been a goody two-shoes, so when I need help, it's what you're gonna do, right?
translation: 因为你总是充好人，所以当我需要帮助时，你就会帮我，对吧？

original: You're going to help Amata anyway, right? Just make it so we can leave the Vault, and I'll leave and never bother you again.
translation: 反正你也要帮阿玛塔，对吗？帮帮我们，这样我们就可以离开避难所，我也不会再来烦你了。

original: Look, I know I've been kind of a jerk. But I don't deserve to be stuck down here forever. Not when I could have a real life up there like you.
translation: 你看，我知道我曾经很混蛋。但是我也不应该在这里被关上一辈子。我现在有机会跟你一样，到外面去过真正的生活。

original: I mean, you're kind of a jerk sometimes, and you make it work up there. So why not me?
translation: 我是说，你有时候也挺混蛋，这在外面就派上了用场。我怎么就不能呢？

original: Just make it so we can leave the Vault, and I can go out there for my new life. Heck, maybe we could form a gang, huh?
translation: 帮帮我们吧，好让我离开避难所，到外面开始新的生活。对了，或许我们可以成立一个帮派，呃？

original: You left this place, so I bet you hate it as much as I do. So you can imagine how crappy it'd be to be stuck down here forever, yeah?
translation: 你离开了这里，所以我打赌你和我一样，恨透了这里。你应该能想象出来在这下面被困一辈子有多糟糕，对吧？

original: Are you gonna force all of us to live like that, now that we've learned we could actually leave and try for something new?
translation: 现在我们已经知道我们可以离开，去接触新的环境，你却还要迫使我们像这样生活吗？

original: Just make it so we can get out of this vault, and I'll be gone, man. Then you don't ever need to see me again, okay?
translation: 帮帮我们,好让我们离开这里，然后我就远走。你再也不必见到我，好吗？

original: I beg to differ. The Enclave is at the height of its power.
translation: 我不敢苟同。英克雷正处于鼎盛状态。

original: Once this facility is operational, the masses will flock to the Enclave for fresh water, protection, and a plan for the future.
translation: 一旦这个设施投入使用，人们就会蜂拥而至，向英克雷寻求淡水、保护和对未来的规划。

original: Okay, I'll bite. Here's 50 caps. Now where are those damn runners?
translation: 好的，我会给你报酬。50个瓶盖，现在快告诉我，那些逃跑的奴隶在哪？

original: Oh no no, don't worry about them. When you decide to go down there, I'll have a little chat with Birch and the rest of the gang.
translation: 哦不不，不必担心他们。等你决定下去的时候，我会跟伯奇以及其他成员谈谈这件事。

original: They usually don't understand a word I say, but I'll make em' come around.
translation: 他们通常听不懂我说的话，但我会让他们明白的。

original: Oh no, no, no, no, no. It wouldn't be murder. You'd be doing me a favor.
translation: 哦不，不，不，不，不。这不算谋杀。你这是在帮我。

original: You see, I've been stuck here for over two decades now... rooted right into the ground.
translation: 你瞧，我被困在这儿已经二十多年了……牢牢地扎根在地里。

original: The only friends I've got are Bob and those weirdos out there who think I'm a god.
translation: 我仅有的朋友就是鲍勃，还有外面那些把我当成神的怪人。

original: Yes, you're right of course, of course, I completely agree. Or I guess WE completely agree... me and Bob that is.
translation: 没错，你当然说得对，我完全同意。或者该说我们完全同意……我和鲍勃都同意。

original: I had you brought in here to ask a very simple favor.
translation: 我把你带到这来，只是想请你帮个非常简单的忙。

original: Would you please kill me?
translation: 你能杀了我吗？

original: Whoa-ho! Check out the brain on this guy!
translation: 哇！快看那家伙的头！

original: It was a long time ago... I tend to lose track.
translation: 那是很久以前的事了……我都有些记不清了。

original: I was exploring some sort of a military base with some other people... I think it was called Mariposa.
translation: 我当时和其他人一起在探索某个军事基地……我记得那地方叫马里波萨。

original: We were pretty deep inside and we found some weird vats of this nasty green goo. Right when we were about to leave, I think we were attacked.
translation: 我们深入基地内部，发现了一些大缸，里面装着恶心的绿色黏液。就在我们准备离开的时候，我想我们遭到了袭击。

original: Last thing I remember before blacking out was something knocking my friend into the stuff.
translation: 在我昏过去前，我记得的最后的一件事就是，我的朋友被什么东西砸到了那黏液里。

original: No offense, kid, but you're not exactly the type I'm used to runnin' with.
translation: 没有恶意，孩子，一般来说我是不会和你这种人打交道的。

original: I've heard about you -- a lil' goody two shoes out of the Vault. I don't think our styles would really mesh.
translation: 我听说过你 — 在避难所你一直是个两面派。我认为像你这样的人，和我是合不来的。

original: Nah, it ain't so bad here. I got some good memories, but that's all I got. No sense in ruining the good ones, you know?
translation: 不，这其实也不错。我也有些好的回忆，但那是我的所有了。没理由破坏美好的东西，是吧？

original: No offense. You seem okay, kid. But your friend there, well... I'm used to working in smaller groups.
translation: 没有恶意，你看起来不错，孩子。但你那些朋友……嗯，我习惯在规模小一点的队伍里做事。

original: Come back when you're alone and maybe we can work something out.
translation: 你独自回来的话，或许我可以考虑下。

original: Yeah... yeah! You know, I think I'll take you up on that.
translation: 呃……耶！你知道的，我想我会接受你的建议。

original: Tell you what, drop 1,000 caps on me for supplies and I'm in.
translation: 跟你说，丢下1000个瓶盖，让我去买点补给，我就跟你。

original: Sure. Have a look. I guess folks in Megaton won't be needing them anymore.
translation: 当然。看一下吧。我猜兆吨镇的居民再也用不上它们了。

original: I have a few things. May as well sell them to you as cart them all the way back to Megaton.
translation: 我有一些东西。与其把它们装车运回兆吨镇，还不如卖给你。

original: Take a look. Welcome to ... Godforsaken Hellhole! Not much to look at, but it's all mine. Ha ha ha!
translation: 看看。欢迎来到……遗弃之所！看起来很一般，但这些全都是我的。哈哈哈！

original: Everything has its price. Take a look and make me an offer.
translation: 任何东西都有个价。都看看吧，然后出个价。

original: A few odds and ends.
translation: 一些零碎的东西。

original: If the price is right. Make me an offer.
translation: 如果觉得价钱合适，就告诉我吧。

original: Various things. You never know what might come in handy.
translation: 各种各样的货物，没准有些你能用上。

original: You might be surprised at what you can use to keep a robot working.
translation: 你或许会对这拿来维持机器人工作的东西感到惊讶。

original: Have a look and see for yourself.
translation: 随便看看，给自己挑点东西吧。

original: Various things. You never know what might come in handy.
translation: 各种各样的货物，没准有些你能用上。

original: You might be surprised at what you can use to keep a robot working.
translation: 你或许会对这拿来维持机器人工作的东西感到惊讶。

original: Have a look and see for yourself.
translation: 随便看看，给自己挑点东西吧。

original: Haha! This is gonna be great! Some good ol' fashioned violence!
translation: 哈哈！这真是好极了！来点痛快时尚的暴力美学吧！

original: Well what'd you get my hopes up for? I can't head out there without supplies, now can I?
translation: 那么，你又为什么要重燃我的激情呢？没有补给我就没法出去闯荡，我的补给呢？

original: Tell you what: the offer's open. Just come back when you've got the thousand.
translation: 跟你说吧：大门是敞开的。搞到1000后回来找我。

original: You're welcome. Just keep it clean and repaired and it will never let you down.
translation: 别客气。只要及时保养并清理，它就永远不会让你失望。

original: Now, scoot. I have to get cracking on this music notation.
translation: 出发吧，就现在。我要花些时间钻研这些音符了。

original: Nonsense. I've never fired a gun before in my life and I'm not about to start any time soon.
translation: 荒唐。我这辈子从来没开过枪，而且也不准备去试试开一枪。

original: You take this thing and use it to protect yourself while you're out there. I'll be just fine.
translation: 你在外面的时候，拿着这个保护自己。我不会有事的。

original: Here. Now, scoot. I have a lot of music to write.
translation: 给，那就走吧。我还有很多音乐要创作。

original: Manners are not your strong suit, are they?
translation: 你好像不知道什么叫礼貌，不是吗？

original: Here, take this pistol. It's all I have left. Use it to protect yourself, or shoot yourself in the foot for all I care.
translation: 给，把这手枪拿去，孩子。我就这么点东西了。用它来保护自己，或者朝自己脚趾头放枪什么的，我也就能操这么点心了。

original: Now if you don't mind, I need to get some things done. Goodbye.
translation: 现在如果你不介意的话，我还有事要忙。走好。

original: I'm speechless. Thank you.
translation: 我没话说了。谢谢你。

original: You're welcome here any time. Consider my house as a safe haven if you're ever in the area.
translation: 无论何时都欢迎你回来，当你经过这时，请将这当作自己的家。

original: Now, let me get writing. So much to do!
translation: 现在，让我开始写吧。还有很多要做的呢！

original: My word! You actually found some REAL music paper? I didn't even think it possible.
translation: 我的天啊！你真的找到一些真正的乐谱纸？这我可连想都未曾想过。

original: Yet here it is. You've really outdone yourself this time. I knew getting the Stradivarius was a challenge, but this is just incredible.
translation: 现在事实摆在眼前。你这次真的让人刮目相看。我知道取得斯特拉迪瓦里小提琴是个很大的挑战，但这真是让人难以置信。

original: This is all too much... you deserve more than just a pat on the back.
translation: 这太多了……你应该得到比拍肩鼓励还多的东西。

original: Well, I suppose I could. They aren't my pieces of music by any stretch of the imagination though.
translation: 嗯，我想我可以。尽管那些并不是我自己想像的音乐。

original: You hacked my computer? You've got some skills. It's been a while since I've met someone smart enough to best me. So I'll let that slide.
translation: 你破解了我的电脑？还真有两下子。我很久没见过能和我相提并论的聪明人了。所以我就不追究了。

original: I documented the whole thing. So I could rub it in the face of Dr. Li when I need to rankle her feathers. I hate that snooty bitch.
translation: 我把所有的东西都存档了。如果我想激怒她，我就在李博士的面前戳她的痛处。我讨厌那自大的婊子。

original: You're in for a treat, the finest food in D.C. Four stars.
translation: 请上座，这是全华盛顿特区最好的料理。四星级水准。

original: If you're lucky, maybe it's gone rancid already. MmmmMmmmm...
translation: 如果你运气够好，或许那上面的腐臭味道已经消散了。唔…………

original: Let ol' Uncle Ahzrukhal help you get rid of the pain.
translation: 让阿祖卡大叔帮你解除痛苦吧。

original: That's right. As long as you don't bother us, we won't bother you. Feel free to come and go, trade, sleep, whatever.
translation: 是的。只要你不找我们的麻烦，我们也不会打搅你。往来自便，不管交易还是住宿，什么都行。

original: Just make sure that you leave whatever trouble is following you at the door, because we don't want it.
translation: 进门前请确认自己没有麻烦缠身，因为我们不想有麻烦。

original: So, enjoy your stay, smoothskin.
translation: 那么，祝您愉快，光皮肤。

original: Bastards. They don't seem to be able to tell us apart from the Super Mutants. Or, maybe they just don't care. They see us and shoot on sight.
translation: 这些禽兽！他们似乎看不出我们与超级变种人的区别。或者，他们根本就不在乎。反正他们一看见我们就开枪。

original: At least they have the common courtesy to miss most of the time. Still... bigots.
translation: 至少他们有礼貌，大部分时间都打不中，但还是……偏执狂。

original: You got wax in your ears? We're Ghouls -- mutants with rotting flesh. It's not a big deal, I got used to it. So will you.
translation: 你耳朵堵上了？我们是尸鬼 — 一种表皮腐烂的变种人而已。这没什么大不了的，我已经习惯了，你也会的。

original: You know, never mind. I'm a Ghoul. Everyone down here: Ghouls. That's what we are. And before you ask "what's a Ghoul", lemme tell you.
translation: 好吧，别在意。我，一个尸鬼。这里所有的人，一群尸鬼。就是我们啦。在你问“尸鬼是个什么”之前，我先告诉你。

original: We're not the walking dead, despite the rotten flesh and the smell. We're mutants... sort of. At least, I think we are.
translation: 我们不是那种行尸，尽管表皮腐烂有异味。我们只是变种人……的一种。至少，我认为是……

original: Are you kidding me? It's a dream come true, man! Butch the Hairdresser is no more, now I'm gonna be Butch the Wasteland Wanderer!
translation: 你开玩笑吗？这简直是梦想成真，哥们！理发师布奇已经是历史了，现在我是废土客布奇了！

original: Maybe I can form a gang of my own. Maybe call it the Wasteland Radicals, or maybe the Rad Scorpions. Hey, wanna join?
translation: 或许我可以自己成立个帮派。我们可以叫废土激进分子，或者辐射蝎。嗨，你想加入吗？

original: What?! This is terrible! The vault will become uninhabitable!
translation: 什么？！这太可怕了！避难所将变得不能居住！

original: How the hell can this be happening?
translation: 这怎么可能？

original: What?! This is terrible! The vault will become uninhabitable!
translation: 什么？！这太可怕了！避难所将变得不能居住！

original: How the hell can this be happening?
translation: 这怎么可能？

original: Oh my god. The Vault's doomed. Everyone has to evacuate, and there's no way most of them will survive out there.
translation: 我的上帝啊，避难所完蛋了，所有人都必须撤离，而出去之后大多数人都无法生存。

original: How did this happen?
translation: 这一切是怎么发生的？

original: Congratulations, young man! I don’t have to tell you how special this day is, do I?
translation: 祝贺你！小伙子！我不用说今天有多么特别了吧？

original: Congratulations, young lady! I don’t have to tell you how special this day is, do I?
translation: 祝贺你！小姑娘！我不用说今天有多么特别了吧？

original: Down here in Vault 101, when you turn 10, well, you’re ready to take on your first official Vault responsibilities.
translation: 在101号避难所里，一旦10岁，就要承担第一份正式的避难所的职责了。

original: So here you are. As Overseer, I hereby present to you your very own Pip-Boy 3000! Get used to it.
translation: 给你。作为监督者，我将授予你哔哔小子3000！好好使用它。

original: Talk. To. Ahzrukhal.
translation: 去跟阿祖卡说。

original: I don't care.
translation: 我不在乎。

original: I don't care.
translation: 我不在乎。

original: Well now! Young people were more polite back in my day. Respected their elders. Of course, we had a real Overseer back then. Worthy of respect.
translation: 这样啊！在我们那年代，年轻人更有礼貌，更懂得尊敬长辈。当然，那时我们也有一个货真价实的监督者，值得尊敬。

original: Not like that one over there, with his rules and his secrets. Why, I have half a mind to just up and tell you...
translation: 不像那边那家伙，有一堆自以为是的规定和见不得人的秘密。噢，我只是随口说说而已……

original: Oh my, there I go again with my old lady talk and you still waiting patiently for your present.
translation: 天啊，我又犯喜欢唠叨的老毛病了，而你还是如此耐心。

original: I suppose you could have asked more politely, but it is still your birthday, so here you go: a nice sweetroll I baked just for you.
translation: 我想你可以问得更礼貌些，但今天还是你的生日，所以给你：我为你烤的美味甜卷。

original: Fiddlesticks! What 10-year-old doesn't like presents?
translation: 胡说！哪有不喜欢礼物的10岁孩子。

original: I was 10 once, believe it or not! My goodness, the Vault was practically crowded back then.
translation: 我也曾有过10岁，信不信由你！天啊，那时候避难所里好多人啊。

original: Not like today. So few young people now... But here I am rambling on again, and you listening so politely.
translation: 不像现在。只有很少年轻人……我怎么又开始唠叨了，你倒一直很有礼貌的听着……

original: Here you go, a nice sweetroll that I baked for you just this morning. And it's all for you -- no sharing required today!
translation: 给你，我今天早上刚烤好的甜卷。而且这是给你的 — 今天用不着分给别人！

original: Such a nice polite young man you are! Don't ever lose your gift of speaking your mind so directly. We could use more of that down here.
translation: 真是个懂礼貌的年轻人！不要丢掉你直言不讳的性格，在这我们需要像你这样的。

original: Here you go, a nice sweetroll that I baked for you just this morning. And it's all for you -- you're the birthday boy, no sharing required today!
translation: 给你，我今天早上刚烤好的甜卷。而且这是给你的 — 你是小寿星，今天用不着分给别人！

original: Such a nice polite young lady you are! Don't ever lose your gift of speaking your mind so directly. We could use more of that down here.
translation: 真是个懂礼貌的年轻人！不要丢掉你直言不讳的性格，在这我们需要像你这样的。

original: Here you go, a nice sweetroll that I baked for you just this morning. And it's all for you -- you're the birthday girl, no sharing required today!
translation: 给你，我今天早上刚烤好的甜卷。而且这是给你的 — 你是小寿星，今天用不着分给别人！

original: Ha ha ha! You told her, Butch!
translation: 哈哈哈！你跟她说了，布奇！

original: Or else what? Yeah, thought so.
translation: 不然怎样？嗯，我想也是。

original: Shut up.
translation: 闭嘴。

original: I can't believe it's only a couple of days away.
translation: 难以置信才过去这么几天。

original: Glad to hear that.
translation: 听见这些很高兴。

original: Crazy how it sneaks up on you, y'know?
translation: 那些东西悄悄地靠近你，这太疯狂了，你懂吗？

original: That's none of your business.
translation: 那与你无关。

original: Um, yeah.
translation: 嗯，是的。

original: Was I supposed to do it? I didn't hear Dave saying we had to!
translation: 我一定要这么做吗？我没听戴夫说过我们要这样！

original: Yeah, but it'd be better if I could vote.
translation: 嗯，但是如果我能投票的话更好。

original: Ugh why can't I just vote now?
translation: 呃，为什么我不能现在就投票？

original: Santa Claus.
translation: 圣诞老人。

original: Um, I guess so.
translation: 唔，我猜是的。

original: Hmm, maybe you're right. More trouble than it's worth.
translation: 呃，或许你是对的。它带来的麻烦更甚于它的价值。

original: I'm too young! I can't even vote yet.
translation: 我太年轻了！我现在还不能投票。

original: No way! You'd have to be crazy to run against him.
translation: 没门！你和他竞选简直就是疯了。

original: Believe it or not, I used to lead a group bigger than this one on an old caravan route.
translation: 信不信由你，以前我曾领导过一个比这还大的商队。

original: I did it for years... and we did pretty well for ourselves.
translation: 我干了好几年……而且我们干得很出色。

original: But what am I talking about? Running against Dave would be like betraying him.
translation: 但是我在说什么啊？跟戴夫竞选不就等于是背叛他吗？

original: Man, I'd love to be the president. Everybody would have to listen to me or I could just exile them to the Wasteland.
translation: 天啊，我好想当总统。所有人都得听我的，要不我就把他们流放到废土上去。

original: And the first thing I'd do is make myself the permanent leader so they couldn't vote me out in some other election.
translation: 而且首先我要让自己成为永远的领袖，这样他们就不能靠选举让我下台。

original: But there's no need for me to run. One year Dave is just going to make me the leader, just like my Grandpa Tom did for him.
translation: 但是我没必要参选。总有一天戴夫就会让我成为领袖，就像我的爷爷汤姆当年做的那样。

original: I'm sorry, but the president must be a citizen of the Republic to run for office. So you do not qualify.
translation: 我很遗憾，但是总统必须由共和国公民来担当。因此你不具备资格。

original: Um, did Dave say you could do that?
translation: 啊，戴夫允许你那样做了？

original: Wow, really? I've always said that she'd make a great leader, and we've never had a woman lead us before...
translation: 哇，真的么？我总是说她会成为一个好领袖，而且我们还从没有过一个女领袖……

original: He is? Wow... Dave must be upset.
translation: 是吗？哇……戴夫这下一定要紧张了。

original: Wow, this is the first time we've had so many choices!
translation: 哇，这是第一次我们有这么多的选择！

original: Hmm, I don't know that he stands much of a chance against Dave.
translation: 嗯……我不觉得他对戴夫有什么胜算。

original: Isn't he a bit young? I mean, Dave's been running the Republic since before Bob was born...
translation: 他不会太年轻了么？我的意思是，在鲍勃出生之前戴夫就已经是总统了……

original: Well then, there you go. An election is what separates a president like myself from a monarch like my father.
translation: 那好，随你。正是选举将我这样的总统和我父亲那样的国王区分开来。

original: Assassin? And you really thought you could succeed against the Army of Dave?
translation: 刺客？你真的觉得你能对付戴夫的军队？

original: Thought you'd get out of here, did you? You little shit. Get back inside, now.
translation: 你以为你能从这跑了？你这小混蛋！滚进去，快！

original: You! Get back here now!
translation: 你！立刻回来！

original: You're fuckin' dead, you hear me? Dead!
translation: 你他妈的死定了。你听见了没？你死定了！

original: Run Sammy, run! We can make it!
translation: 萨米快跑，快跑啊！我们能做到！

original: Yeah, right. Thanks, loser. Oh, and happy birthday, ha ha ha ha!
translation: 嗯，对了。谢谢你，废物。哦，生日快乐，哈哈哈哈！

original: "Mrs. Palmer said I didn't have to share"... Who's talking about sharing, moron? I want the whole thing.
translation: “帕尔默夫人说我不用和别人分享”……谁说要分享了？白痴，我要全部。

original: Now are you going to give me that sweetroll, or am I going to have to give you a knuckle sandwich?
translation: 现在你把甜卷给我，否则我给你个大耳光尝尝？

original: Gah! I don't want your nerd-cooties! You're going to be sorry you did that. We'll see how tough you are later when the grownups aren't around.
translation: 恶！我不要你这恶心的东西！你会为你做的后悔的。等旁边没有大人，我们就走着瞧！

original: I'm doin' fine... fine indeed. How are you? ... I said how are you? What? Are you ignoring me? Stupid asshole robot...
translation: 我很好……真的很好。你呢？……我说你好？什么？你无视我？蠢货机器人……

original: She's dead, you know that. Lousy old data tapes...
translation: 她已经死了，你知道的。惹人厌的老古董……

original: Oh, it's great. Everything is perfect. Greta takes good care of us.
translation: 哦，一切正常，所有事情都很完美。葛丽泰将我们照顾的很好。

original: And a hello to you, ma'am.
translation: 向你问声好，女士。

original: Scanning... target identified as "Patchwork". Hello, Patchwork. I trust that all is well with you.
translation: 扫描…… 对象确认：“拼盘”。您好，“拼盘”。我相信你一切都好。

original: Scanning... target identified as "Patchwork". Hello, Patchwork. How are you?
translation: 扫描…… 对象确认：“拼盘”。您好，“拼盘”。你好吗？

original: Hello. How is everything?
translation: 你好。别来无恙？

original: Hi there, enjoying yourself?
translation: 你好，感觉还好吗？

original: Stop by the clinic, Patchwork. Greta found one of your fingers over in Carol's Place.
translation: 去诊所看看吧，“拼盘”。葛丽泰在卡洛尔之家找到了你的一根手指。

original: Come by the clinic some time, you're overdue for a sewing.
translation: 有空到诊所来下，你早该缝几针了。

original: Yes, yes, hello. We covered that already.
translation: 是，是，你好。我们已经搞定那些了。

original: Haven't lost anything permanently. Not yet.
translation: 还没有永久性地丢过任何东西，目前为止。

original: Hey there, long time, no see! I've got some good stories to tell you later!
translation: 嗨，很久不见了啊！我有一些很棒的故事等会跟你说！

original: Hey there, you should check out the new stuff I have at the store.
translation: 嗨，你应该看看我们商店的新货。

original: Hey, do you know how to reroute a fan belt? You know, never mind. I'll do it myself.
translation: 嗨，你知道怎么换风扇皮带？嗯……没关系，我自己来吧。

original: Hey, you.
translation: 嗨，你。

original: Yeah... kinda like onions... that's so strange...
translation: 啊……就像是洋葱……真奇怪……

original: Actually, I haven't noticed. At all.
translation: 老实说，我没注意。根本没在意。

original: I've forgotten the taste of good liquor.
translation: 我已经不记得好酒的味道了。

original: Dude. Harshing the buzz. Minus five points.
translation: 老兄，触响警报。减去5分。

original: Well, aren't you a ray of sunshine?
translation: 嗯，你难道不是一缕阳光吗？

original: Ah, yes! Of course, of course, my friend. See me later tonight. We'll make sure that you have all the pick-me-ups that you need.
translation: 啊，没错！当然，当然，我的朋友。晚上见。我保证给你你所需要的提神剂。

original: Shhh, say no more. See me later, I'll make sure that you want for nothing.
translation: 嘘，别说了，待会见，我保证你到时会别无所求。

original: No need to be shy, my friend. I'll make sure that you have everything that you ever need, so long as you have the caps to pay for it, that is.
translation: 别不好意思，我的朋友，我能满足你的一切需求，只要你身上的瓶盖够多，就是这样。

original: I was wondering if I could get... you know... one of the special drinks.
translation: 不知我能不能得到……你知道……一杯特别的饮料。

original: I'm all out of the stuff you sold me yesterday. I need more. Fast.
translation: 你昨天卖我的东西已经用光了。我需要更多。赶快！

original: Some people...
translation: 有些人……

original: I suppose I can accept that. It's a deal; the kids are yours. I'll have them delivered to the front gate for you.
translation: 我想我能接受。成交，这些小孩都是你的了。我会把他们送到前门等你。

original: If I may, you might want to keep a close eye on them. They can be willful at times. Good luck.
translation: 我建议，你可能得盯着他们。他们有时会很任性，祝你好运。

original: Fair enough. It's a pleasure to do business with you again.
translation: 很公平，与你做生意是件愉快的事。

original: I'll have the kids delivered to the front gate. And, may I recommend keeping a close eye on them? They're clever little bastards.
translation: 我会把孩子送到前门。同时，我能建议你看紧些吗？他们可是群聪明的小杂种。

original: A wise decision. It's a pleasure to do business with you.
translation: 明智的抉择。跟你做生意真是很愉快。

original: I'll have the kids delivered to the front gate. And, may I recommend keeping a close eye on them? They're clever little bastards.
translation: 我会把孩子送到前门。同时，我能建议你看紧些吗？他们可是群聪明的小杂种。

original: The little shits are your problem now. I see 'em around here again, I'm gonna shoot 'em. We clear?
translation: 那些小混蛋交给你了。要是我再看见他们在附近游荡，就朝他们开枪，明白了吗？

original: R... really? No monsters?
translation: 真……的？没有怪物？

original: Then you can make these things go away!
translation: 你把那些东西赶走吧！

original: Humph... you don't gotta be such a jerk about it.
translation: 哼……你还不是太蠢。

original: There's an old portashelter next to the diner near my house. I'll be waiting inside for you to come back.
translation: 在我家与餐厅旁有一个圆形遮蔽所。我在那等你回来。

original: And don't you dare leave me alone!
translation: 还有你别想把我一个人扔在这。

original: Well, there is the personal shelter next to the old diner.
translation: 嗯，有一个圆形遮蔽所就在餐厅旁。

original: Pappa always said to stay away from it... but, I guess it's supposed to be safe.
translation: 爸爸总是让我离那远点……但我觉得那里面很安全。

original: I'll head over there and wait inside. Hurry back!
translation: 我会躲在那里面。快点回来！

original: You will? Really? Thanks a whole lot!
translation: 你要帮我找爸爸？真的？太谢谢了！

original: My house is the one closest to the huge sign and the old diner.
translation: 我家是离那大标记和旧餐厅最近的那间。

original: Please... find my pappa and make him come back!
translation: 拜托……找到我爸爸并带他回来！

original: What're you suggesting, you little brat? I may not be on the science team anymore, but I still know how to keep records!
translation: 小毛孩，你在暗示什么？我虽然不再在科学团队了，但我仍知道怎么做记录！

original: Here! They probably don't even remember, but I kept the records of that first council meeting. Take them, if it'll put them in their place!
translation: 给！他们可能都不记得了，但我还保存着首次议会会议的记录。要是能让他们摆正位置，就拿走！

original: Of course I do! A good scientist always keeps track of their data!
translation: 当然有！一个优秀的科学家总是保存着所有的数据资料。

original: Here! They probably don't even remember, but I kept the records of that first council meeting. Take them, if it'll put them in their place!
translation: 给！他们可能都不记得了，但我还保存着首次议会会议的记录。要是能让他们摆正位置，就拿走！

original: That lasted until about 18 years ago, when those ambitious backbiters like Li and her little team showed up.
translation: 那持续到大约18年前，像李和她的小团队那样野心勃勃的反叛者出现了。

original: She came in with her big "Purity Project" pipe dream, and my whole staff started working with her, those traitors!
translation: 她带着宏伟的“净水工程”白日梦而来，我的所有员工都开始为她工作，那帮叛徒！

original: She even took my seat on the council. By then, I was glad to leave it behind. But hell if I'm leaving the city I made great!
translation: 她甚至占据了我在议会的席位。那时，我很高兴能离开那。但要我离开这座我一手缔造的城市，见鬼去吧！

original: Are you kidding? Dave is dead. How can there be an election with a dead candidate?
translation: 你开什么玩笑？戴夫都已经死了。难道死人还能进行选举？

original: I'm going to win this.
translation: 我会赢的。

original: Hmm. I suppose voting for Dave is the patriotic thing to do.
translation: 嗯。我想投戴夫的票是爱国行为。

original: All done! Dave is the best!
translation: 搞定！戴夫最棒！

original: Fingers crossed.
translation: 老天保佑。

original: Good luck, Dave. You have my vote.
translation: 好运，戴夫。我投了你一票。

original: Ah, Dave. Lead our Republic to glory!
translation: 啊，戴夫。领导我们迈向荣耀！

original: Let's see what we have here.
translation: 让我们看看投票结果。

original: A vote for me...
translation: 投我的一票……

original: And another vote for me...
translation: 我又得到一票……

original: A vote for Rosie?
translation: 投给萝丝的一票？

original: Bob!?
translation: 鲍勃！？

original: Wait a minute, has somebody tampered with the ballot box?
translation: 等等，有人在投票箱上动过手脚吗？

original: Hmm... after counting the votes, the president is...
translation: 嗯……统计投票完毕，选出的总统是……

original: Well, looks like another triumphant victory for myself.
translation: 嗯，看起来我又一次胜利了。

original: Well, despite the hiccup, it looks like I am still declared the winner.
translation: 嗯，尽管有些小问题，但我最终还是顺利当选。

original: Well, despite the hiccup, it looks like I am still declared the winner.
translation: 嗯，尽管有些小问题，但我最终还是顺利当选。

original: ROSIE? Rosie can't be president! NO! This is unfair! This can't be! FINE! I'm LEAVING! See how you people do without me! Enjoy your new president!
translation: 萝丝？萝丝不可能当上总统的！不！这不公平！这不可能！好吧！我走！看没有我你们怎么活！为你们的新总统高兴吧！

original: BOB? Bob can't be president! NO! This is unfair! This can't be! FINE! I'm LEAVING! See how you people do without me! Enjoy your new president!
translation: 鲍勃？鲍勃不可能当上总统的！不！这不公平！这不可能！好吧！我走！看没有我你们怎么活！为你们的新总统高兴吧！

original: Stop messing with that radio.
translation: 不许再碰那收音机了。

original: Hey, leave that radio alone.
translation: 嗨，离那收音机远点。

original: You too, stranger. I know a lot of people around here don't take kindly to humans wandering around, but I've met a lot of your people in my travels.
translation: 我也很高兴，陌生人。我们这的多数人都对来这的人类不太友好，但是我在旅途中遇到过很多像你这样的人类。

original: Me? No, not at all. I'm used to your people. Truth is, I spend most of my time away from Underworld.
translation: 我？不，毫无关系。我习惯和你们在一起了。老实说，其实我很少待在冥界里。

original: Who, me? Yeah... yeah... I'm fine. I guess. No... Yeah. I'll be okay. I just... I just need to try not to lose any more of my parts this time...
translation: 谁，我？嗯……嗯……我很好。我想。不……是的……我会没事的。我只是……只是想这回不要再掉些什么零件出来了。

original: Doc Barrows says that he's... he's getting' tired of puttin' 'em back on... me. So, you know... if you see any, just bring 'em back.
translation: 巴罗斯医生说他……他试着把我掉下来的那些身件零件再装回去……所以……你看……如果你找到我身上的东西，就拿来给我。

original: I think I can help you out.
translation: 我想我能帮到你。

original: Be careful with these. They're not toys, you know.
translation: 小心使用。你要明白，它们可不是玩具。

original: Yes, what do you need?
translation: 嗯，你要什么？

original: Very well. What do you require?
translation: 很好。你有什么需要？

original: This place is coming down around our ears.
translation: 这地方就在我们眼前。

original: It a miracle that some of this shit works in the first place. I guess it's just a matter of time...
translation: 想让这堆垃圾运作起来简直就是奇迹。我想这迟早会……

original: You... you know what you are? You're a big asshole! That's right... an asshole! My pappa said never to say that word, but you deserve it!
translation: 你……你知道你这算什么？你这大混蛋！没错……混蛋！爸爸告诉我不要说脏话，但是这词对你正合适！

original: Now what am I going to do? My pappa's dead... poor pappa...
translation: 现在我该怎么办？爸爸死了……可怜的爸爸……

original: He's... he's dead?
translation: 他……他死了？

original: I guess I already knew. Besides, I'm too tired to cry anymore.
translation: 我想我已经猜到了。还有，我太累了，已经不想再哭了。

original: He's... he's dead?
translation: 他……他死了？

original: I guess I already knew. Besides, I'm too tired to cry anymore.
translation: 我想我已经猜到了。还有，我太累了，已经不想再哭了。

original: Not yet. Rosie still hasn't voted.
translation: 还没。萝丝还没投票。

original: Good, the votes are in. If you'll excuse me, I'll be getting started on tallying the numbers.
translation: 好的，所有人都投票了。失陪，我要开始统计票数了。

original: Oh yes, I almost forgot. Here's your caps. Keep this up and I may deign to make you a citizen, in a few years.
translation: 哦，对了，我几乎忘了。这是你的瓶盖。拿着吧，过几年或许我会让你也成为这的公民。

original: Rosie somehow came up with the most votes.
translation: 萝丝不知何故获得了最多选票。

original: There must be some kind of bug in the voting system.
translation: 投票系统肯定出了问题。

original: Somehow Bob won the election.
translation: 鲍勃居然在选举中胜出。

original: I should have known the little bastard was conspiring against me.
translation: 我就应该知道那小杂种要密谋造反。

original: Dave won again? Well, he's the best choice.
translation: 戴夫又赢了？嗯，他的确是最佳选择。

original: He did? Wow, I'd of never guessed that possible.
translation: 是他吗？哇，我从没想过有这种可能。

original: Yes, but it's still quite a shock.
translation: 是的，但还是让人震惊。

original: I won it? Are you sure?
translation: 我赢了？你确定？

original: Oh man, I can't believe it. I won't let the voters down, I promise!
translation: 天啊，我不敢相信……我不会让选民们失望的，我保证！

original: I can't believe my ears.
translation: 我简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

original: Dave won it I'm sure.
translation: 戴夫肯定赢了。

original: Rosie won, huh? She better not try and boss me around, that's for damn sure.
translation: 萝丝赢了，呃？她最好不要想来命令我，决不！

original: I knew I'd win it.
translation: 我就知道我会赢。

original: Now I just got to name this place after me.
translation: 现在我要将这地方改成我的名字。

original: Hurray!
translation: 太好啦！

original: Why, did Dave get too old?
translation: 噢，是戴夫太老了吗？

original: Did Dave win it again? I'd have voted for him if they'd let me.
translation: 戴夫又赢了吗？如果他们让我投票，我也会投他。

original: Did Dave win it again? I voted for him you know.
translation: 戴夫又赢了吗？你知道我又投给他了。

original: Rosie's going to be the new leader? What will Dave do?
translation: 萝丝是新领袖？那戴夫怎么办？

original: He actually won?
translation: 他真的赢了？

original: You just saved my life. I won't forget it.
translation: 你刚刚救了我一命。我不会忘记的。

original: You got it.
translation: 你说对了。

original: <sighs> I was saying that you need to get some rest, Carol. You hardly ever sleep at night, don't think that I haven't noticed.
translation: <叹息>我的意思是你得休息，卡洛尔。你经常睡眠不足吧，别以为我不知道。

original: Hrm? Oh, hey Greta... what were you saying?
translation: 嗯？哦……你好，葛丽泰……你说什么了？

original: Good. I'm glad we're clear on that.
translation: 好的。很高兴我们在这点上澄清了。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: Are you blind? Never mind, don't bother grunting a response. You need to watch these assholes better. Some stuff has turned up missing.
translation: 你瞎了还是怎么？算了，别想借口了。你盯紧这些混蛋，店里已经开始丢东西了。

original: <grunts>
translation: <嘟囔>

original: What... what do you mean? I'm not... I'm not... I'm not even drunk right now!
translation: 你……你什么意思？我……我还……我还没醉呢！

original: I... I can't talk about it. Not yet.
translation: 我……我不能谈这事。还不行。

original: She'll be missed.
translation: 我们会想念她的。

original: I... I can't talk about it. Not yet.
translation: 我……我不能谈这事。还不行。

original: She'll be missed.
translation: 我们会想念她的。

original: Sounds like you need some of Ahzrukhal's special cough medicine.
translation: 听起来你需要阿祖卡的特效咳嗽药。

original: Poor doc Barrows, you people are falling apart without him, aren't you?
translation: 可怜的巴罗斯医生，没了他，你们这帮人就不行了，不是吗？

original: <sighs> You're a terrible conversationalist, Cerberus.
translation: <叹息> 你真是不会说话，地狱犬。

original: You really suck at conversation, robot.
translation: 你说的话真难听，机器人。

original: Command not parsed. Please restate command.
translation: 命令无法分析，请重新输入……

original: Well, that's good. That's good to hear, Cerberus. Anything else going on?
translation: 嗯，好的。听起来很好，地狱犬。还发生了什么？

original: Threat level alpha. Disturbance level zero.
translation: 警戒级别A。骚乱级别0。

original: Dammit. I thought I fixed that. No time now, resume your patrol Cerberus. I'll deal with it later.
translation: 真该死，我以为我修好了。现在没时间了，继续巡逻，地狱犬。我迟点再来处理。

original: Damn worthless... it never ends with you, does it? Just resume your patrol, I'll take you offline for service later.
translation: 该死，这没用……它从来就没好用过，不是吗？继续巡逻，迟点我让你离线服务器。

original: For Christ's sake, that's the fourth time this month. Just go back on patrol, I'm sure you'll be fine.
translation: 老天，这月第四次了。继续巡逻，我确信你一定会好的。

original: Unit weapon system 2B ammunition level low. Please service at earliest convenience.
translation: 单位武器系统2B弹药量低。请尽快补充。

original: Unit cognition system experiencing fluctuating contact. Unable to determine source of failure.
translation: 单位认知系统发现接触波动。无法确认错误来源。

original: Unit target recognition system contains failure of an unknown class. Advise immediate unit service for repair.
translation: 单位目标识别系统包含未知等级错误。建议单位立即维护送修。

original: Unit locomotion system contains a class two failure. Currently operable. Failure will escalate to class one with a 47% probability.
translation: 单位动力系统包含一个2级错误。正在执行，错误上升至1级的可能性：47%。

original: Well, give the report, you old bucket of bolts. I haven't got all day.
translation: 嗯，给我报告，你这堆废铁。我可没太多闲工夫。

original: Well? Do you think I asked just out of curiosity? Give me the report, dammit.
translation: 嗯？你认为我只是好奇才问的？该死，给我报告。

original: Unit diagnostics system compiling... diagnostics system ready. Running level 2 diagnostics... complete. Report prepared.
translation: 单位诊断系统编译中……诊断系统就绪。运行2级诊断……完毕。报告就绪。

original: Unit diagnostics... running... running... complete. Report prepared.
translation: 单位诊断……运行……运行……完毕。报告就绪。

original: Thanks, Greta.
translation: 谢谢你，葛丽泰。

original: Wow. Well, okay. I'll go have a look.
translation: 哇。嗯，我去看看。

original: I could go for some noodles. You got any?
translation: 我想要点面条，你有吗？

original: No refunds if you don't keep it down this time. Now, what can I get you?
translation: 这次不小声点可不退款，你需要什么？

original: I'll just be here sobering up until you get back.
translation: 在你回来前，我在这儿清醒一下。

original: Thanks, Greta.
translation: 谢谢你，葛丽泰。

original: Sure, if you don't mind waiting a few minutes.
translation: 当然，如果你不介意等一会。

original: You got it.
translation: 你说对了。

original: I don't care, really. Whatever takes the pain away.
translation: 我不在乎，真的。任何能止痛的东西都行。

original: That's what I'm here for.
translation: 我就是为此而来。

original: <sigh> Fine. I'll have the... squirrel. Cooked, please.
translation: <叹息>好吧。我就来……松鼠吧。请煮熟。

original: Well then, what are you complaining about? Oh, I forgot, you're a bitter bastard. Just tell me what you want to eat.
translation: 那个，你在抱怨什么？哦，我忘了，你是个该死的混蛋。就直说你想吃什么吧。

original: Very funny, Greta. I'd happily prepare my own meals if I could ever get anything was wasn't moldy, rotten, or still squirming.
translation: 很有趣，葛丽泰。如果能搞到任何没有发霉、发臭或腐烂的东西，我很高兴自己做了吃。

original: If you don't like what we have, Crowley, you can always go hunt rats in the tunnels with the ferals.
translation: 如果你不喜欢我们的菜，克劳利，你可以自己去满是野兽的隧道里抓老鼠。

original: Yep.
translation: 对。

original: Excellent. I'll have another task for you soon.
translation: 棒极了。我很快就会有第二个任务给你。

original: I've got something on my mind, Charon. I had asked you to do something and you never reported back to me. You did it, didn't you?
translation: 我突然想起来了，卡戎。我让你做些事情，可你从来没向我报告。你搞定了，对吧？

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: You know that I can't stop worrying about you. Just think about it, okay?
translation: 你知道我没办法不担心你。好好想想，好吗？

original: They don't need to worry about me, Greta, and neither do you. I'll be okay.
translation: 他们不必担心我，葛丽泰，你也一样，我会没事的。

original: C'mon, Carol. It's me, I can see through you. It's gotten so bad that the customers have started to notice.
translation: 别这样，卡洛尔。是我，我太了解你了。你状况太糟，连顾客都注意到了。

original: Oh, Greta, baby. You don't need to worry about me, I was just lost in my thoughts. You know how it is.
translation: 哦，葛丽泰，孩子，你用不着为我担心，我只是想得有些入神了，你知道的。

original: Oh, you'd be surprised. I may be old, but this place'd shut down without me. Just think about what I said, we'll talk later.
translation: 哦，估计会让你感觉惊讶。我可能已经老了，但这地方没了我恐怕就要关门了。想想我说的话，我们可以迟点再说。

original: Don't you threaten me. You wouldn't dare do that, these people would have your head.
translation: 你别想来威胁我，你不敢的，这些人立刻就能要了你的脑袋。

original: Sure, sure, you're here to make money, and I fix all of your crap so that you can keep right on making that money. What would happen if I stopped?
translation: 好吧，好吧，你是来赚钱的，而我得先修好你那堆废物，你才能继续赚钱。如果没有我，你会怎样？

original: Stop serving him? This is a bar. How am I supposed to make money if I'm not serving booze? If he's got money, I'll give him whatever he asks for.
translation: 不卖东西给他？这是酒吧。我不卖酒怎么赚钱？如果他有钱，他要什么我就卖他什么。

original: It's about Patchwork. You need to stop feeding him booze, Ahzrukhal. The boy can barely stand most of the time, and you just keep serving him.
translation: 是关于“拼盘”的。你别再继续卖酒给他了，阿祖卡，那孩子已经站立不稳，你却还不停地卖酒给他。

original: I want you to stop giving Patchwork booze when he's already drunk. You're gonna kill the boy.
translation: “拼盘”已经醉了，你别再卖酒给他了。你是想杀了这孩子吧。

original: No time to talk right now, Winthrop. Come back later.
translation: 现在没空聊天，温思罗普。我们迟点再见。

original: Well, with the terminal, I can turn off the collars and open up the gate. But they're not gonna just let us walk out of here, you know?
translation: 嗯，有了终端，我就能关闭项圈，并把门打开。但他们也不会就这么让我们随便走出去，你懂吗？

original: There's always at least one guard near the pen, and someone's gotta get rid of him.
translation: 围栏旁总是至少有一个守卫，得有人收拾他。

original: Since we can't just walk around like we own the place, you're gonna have to do it. You get me?
translation: 在这我们可不能像在家里一样随意走动，得靠你去解决，明白吗？

original: Alright sure, why not. The people have a tendency to wait until the last minute to vote, but I'd like just to get it over with.
translation: 当然，为什么不呢。人们倾向于到了最后的时刻才投票，而我希望能尽快。

original: I'll spare a few caps if you just tell each of the adults to get over to the voting booth sometime today so I cinch the victory.
translation: 如果你让其它的成年选民来投票，让我顺利当选，我就给你报酬。

original: Not that I have anything to worry about. The people know who their leader is in this Republic.
translation: 不是说我在担心。大家都知道谁才是这个共和国的领袖。

original: So who can tell me how Dave saved the people from the wrath of Tom?
translation: 谁能告诉我戴夫是怎样从汤姆的魔爪下拯救人民的。

original: Somebody name three things Tom did wrong before Dave became the president.
translation: 谁能给出戴夫当总统之前，汤姆做的三件错事。

original: Anybody know what year Dave took back the government for the people?
translation: 谁知道戴夫是在哪一年为人民带来了民主共和制度？

original: I hope you're paying attention, Rachael. I'll give another pop quiz. I'll do it.
translation: 希望你专心听讲，瑞秋。我会再做一次突击测验。我会的。

original: Remember your homework is to prepare a speech on the "Merits of Dave."
translation: 记住你的作业就是准备一次“戴夫的伟大功绩”的演讲。

original: All right, all right. I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我看看我能做些什么。

original: Keep moving.
translation: 继续行动。

original: If only we were all so lucky. I have work to do.
translation: 要是大伙都那么走运就好了。我还有工作要做。

original: You know me, Dusk. I was born ready for anything!
translation: 达斯科，你是了解我的。我一生下来就准备好了！

original: For someone who should be preparing for an assault, you seem to have a lot of time to be social.
translation: 对于一个应该时刻准备突袭的人来说，你还差远了。

original: A few people. But I don't get tired of hearing it.
translation: 有几个。但是我还没听够呢。

original: You're really scary, Dusk. Has anyone ever told you that?
translation: 你真疯狂，达斯科。有人告诉过你吗？

original: You're a frightening woman, Dusk. Anyone ever tell you that?
translation: 你是个好斗的女人，达斯科。有人这么跟你说过吗？

original: I care. If I were aiming for his nose, that'd be fine. But I wasn't. I was going for the eye. Sloppy...
translation: 我在乎。如果我当时瞄准的是他的鼻子就好了。但我瞄的是眼睛。晕……

original: A couple of inches? So you'd have taken out his nose instead of his eye? So what!
translation: 几英寸？你宁愿打下他的鼻子而不是眼睛？那又怎样！

original: Bullshit. That third shot dropped by a couple of inches.
translation: 胡说。第三枪打偏了几英寸。

original: Carry on.
translation: 快点。

original: Meh. Been better.
translation: 嗯，已经好多了。

original: I haven't heard a damn thing.
translation: 我没听到什么。

original: Nothing at all.
translation: 什么事也没有。

original: Nice night.
translation: 晚上好。

original: Oh, don't worry about me. You just go enjoy your drink.
translation: 哦，别担心我。你好好品尝美酒吧。

original: I'm fine, I'm just fine. Thank you for your concern. I'm fine.
translation: 我很好，我真的很好。多谢关心。我很好。

original: Yes, I am, Mr. Ahzrukhal.
translation: 是的，阿祖卡先生。

original: Well... I mean, yeah. I ain't exactly in charge here, but I'm Eulogy's right-hand man.
translation: 嗯……我是说，是的。我并不是这里的主管，但是我是尤勒基的得力助手。

original: Some other jackass should be pulling nighttime guard duty. Maybe I'll go have a little chat with Eulogy about that.
translation: 该让别的家伙来值夜岗。或许我应该和尤勒基谈谈这事。

original: Yeah, so maybe I get a raw deal sometimes. Everybody does out here. That's the way shit goes.
translation: 嗯，或许有时我受到一些不公平待遇。但是这的每个人都这样。在这就是这样。

original: But maybe it's time that changed. Maybe I go see Eulogy about that right now, in fact.
translation: 或许是时候要改变了。事实上我得立刻去找尤勒基谈谈。

original: Maybe... And maybe it's time to see Eulogy about a raise.
translation: 或许……是的，或许是时候找尤勒基谈谈加薪的问题了。

original: Oh, dear. Well, I guess the dangers around those old supplies keeps it from being smooth sailing. Otherwise, they'd already have been looted, huh?
translation: 哦，亲爱的。嗯，我想因为这些补给品还在这里就是因为周围充满了危险。要不然它们早就被洗劫一空了，呃？

original: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
translation: 嗯，你的就留着吧。我自己也刚换了一大批食物。

original: Here, take a bit, my treat - taste kind of grates after a while.
translation: 拿着，吃一点，我请客 - 过会儿口感就不好了。

original: Oh, and take this! It's an old Food Sanitizer. Just carry it with you, and it should automatically make most food and drink more, um... better.
translation: 噢，拿着这个。这是一台旧食品消菌器。带上它，能自动让大部分食物和饮料都更，呃……好。

original: That's a pretty good way of putting it. I think I'll use that in the book. Maybe I should credit you as a co-author, instead of just a researcher?
translation: 把这记下来非常有价值。我想把这些写进那本书里。在那本书里我或许该把你作为合著者，而不仅仅是一名研究员。

original: I know you may not want to see any more explosives for a while, but obviously you know your way around them.
translation: 我知道你现在再也不想看到任何炸弹了，不过很显然你知道怎么处理它们。

original: Have a couple rainy-day toys of mine. And looking at this landmine, it gives me an idea. It's a terrible device that does terrible things, of course. But it's easy to make your own, too.
translation: 拿几件我的应急玩具吧。看看这地雷，它给了我一个灵感。当然，这可怕的装置会造成可怕的后果。但是这东西制作简单，连你也能做。

original: Oh my, Raiders had set up camp there? I'm guessing you didn't just negotiate with them, did you?
translation: 哦，天啊，掠夺者在那里扎营了？我猜你不会只是和他们谈判吧？

original: Well, keep what you got. Just traded for a big food shipment, myself.
translation: 嗯，你的就留着吧。我自己也刚换了一大批食物。

original: Here, take a bit, my treat -- taste kind of grates after a while.
translation: 拿着，吃一点，我请客——过会儿口感就不好了。

original: Oh, that isn't what I want at all. People already have all sorts of ways to kill them. We don't need a more lethal Mole Rat trap. Just a better one.
translation: 哦，那不是我想要的。人们已经知道了所有杀死它们的方法。我们不需要更致命的地鼠陷阱。我们只需要更好的。

original: I guess it's back to the drawing board for that repellent. I wonder if I can make it into some sort of fuel. Anyway, I'll just take that.
translation: 我想我必须要重新设计这些驱鼠剂。我想知道能否能把它做成一种燃料。总之，就这样吧。

original: Oh, but for your trouble, umm... Here, have the leftover chems from working on the repellent. I'm sure you can find some use for them.
translation: 哦，不过麻烦你了，唔……拿着，这是造驱除剂剩下的化学品。我相信你会用到它们的。

original: Hrm. Well, I knew that. But I guess it does raise the question of whether or not they have a language. Maybe I should study that later.
translation: 嗯，我早就知道。但我认为他们到底有没有自己的语言还是个疑问。或许我应该迟点再去研究。

original: I wish we could have gotten more information, but this'll have to do for the book.
translation: 我希望我们得到更多的信息，但这对写书就够了。

original: Here's your pay. Maybe they'll help you be sneakier next time.
translation: 这是你的报酬，希望日后会助你潜行更隐秘。

original: That'd hardly be ethical, really. But if there's nothing more factual to go on...
translation: 这可不合情理。但如果没有更实际的方法了……

original: Oh well. Still, for your help, have a few of these. They may help out next time you need to talk to a few folks.
translation: 好吧，为了感谢你的帮助，拿着这些，它们在你下次与人交谈时会有点帮助的。

original: I suppose it wouldn't hurt to add a nice story to it. And it'd be a nice little reward for your hard work to include you as a hero.
translation: 我想加一个动听的故事进去不会有什么坏处。而且我会把你作为一个英雄编进去，作为你努力工作的报酬。

original: Oh, I don't know about that. But I guess you do. And it's a good enough example for the book, I suppose.
translation: 哦，我说不好，但你肯定清楚。我认为这作为书中一个案例还是不错的。

original: It helps to have the right tool for the job. Failing that, go with the right tool to cheat at the job. Like a pulse grenade.
translation: 工欲善其事，必先利其器。失败的话，就得拿正确的工具去完成它，比如脉冲手榴弹。

original: Here, have a couple.
translation: 来，拿几个吧。

original: Well, maybe the Raiders will try reading a few of the books. Maybe it'll open their eyes to a few things.
translation: 嗯，或许歹徒会读书。或许他们的眼界会变得开阔。

original: Still, it's good to know it's standing. Maybe I'll inspire someone to take care of the place.
translation: 不过，还是很高兴知道它还在。或许我该鼓励其他人去保护那。

original: Have some caps as payment for that little bit of hope.
translation: 给你些瓶盖作为这一线希望的报酬。

original: Don't take too long. The sooner the book's done, the more people we can save with it!
translation: 别太久。这书越快写完，我们就可以拯救更多的人！

original: Well, okay... but it's nothing special.
translation: 嗯，好吧……不过没什么特别。

original: I was born in 2051, so yes, that makes me a Pre-War Ghoul.
translation: 我生于2051年，所以是的，我是战前尸鬼。

original: Not going to talk about it. Don't ask.
translation: 不想说。别问了。

original: Not your business.
translation: 与你无关。

original: Certainly, my friend.
translation: 当然，我的朋友。

original: I must ask that you speak to no one about our transactions.
translation: 我必须要求你不要把这次交易告诉任何人。

original: Ah, back for more... excellent.
translation: 啊，你又回来了……很好。

original: His company is rather refreshing, isn't it? But don't mistake his brevity for stupidity. That would be very unwise.
translation: 他的陪伴令人耳目一新，不是吗？不过别把他的言简意赅误认为是愚笨，那是非常不明智的。

original: Underestimating an opponent has been the last mistake of far too many individuals throughout history.
translation: 低估对手是历史上太多人所犯下的最后一个错误。

original: Fine, in a little bit. Geez.
translation: 好的，就一点。天啊。

original: I bet Ralph isn't doing anything, why don't you ask him?
translation: 我敢说拉尔夫现在没事，为什么你不去问问他呢？

original: Why don't you ask Rachael if she can play?
translation: 为什么你不问问瑞秋能否和你玩呢？

original: That's it, huh? Just toss me out of the box and into the meat grinder?
translation: 就这样，呃？刚把我从“盒子”里救出来，又把我扔进绞肉机？

original: Thanks for nothing, asshole.
translation: 谢谢你什么也没干，混蛋。

original: Okay, if you say so. I'll be right behind you. If you can get me to the front gate, I can take it from there.
translation: 好吧，既然你这样说。我会跟在你后面。如果你能把我带到前门，在那我就能自己走了。
