original: You got it. I'll stay right with you. Get me to the front gate, and I can make a run for it from there.
translation: 好吧。我会紧跟着你。把我带到前门，我就可以自己走了。

original: If the Capitol Building does not meet your incredible standards, feel free to escort yourself out. In fact, just leave now.
translation: 如果国会大厦不符合你那超高的标准，那你就把自己送出去吧。实际上，你快走吧。

original: Right behind you.
translation: 紧跟着你。

original: "A slice of melon may be divine, but lest you spoil the meal, mind the rind"
translation: “一小片甜瓜味道不错，但小心瓜皮，会破坏肉香”

original: Stand clear, vagabonds, rapscallions and Ne'erdowells.
translation: 流浪汉、恶棍和饭桶站开。

original: Time for your walk, family pet.
translation: 该去散步了，宠物。

original: I do... I was in a shelter with my father when the bombs hit. In D.C., we had the luxury of getting a warning after the west coast was... gone...
translation: 我记得……当核弹落下时我和父亲在庇护所。在特区我们幸运地得到了警报，在美国西海岸……消失后……

original: I was just a little girl then. We couldn't afford a space in one of the Vaults. I remember filing down into that shelter, my father rushing me in.
translation: 那时我还只是个小女孩。我们承担不起在居住到避难所的花费。我记得我父亲把我推进那躲避处。

original: He stopped to help this one family, and I looked up and called his name... there was a flash of light, brighter than anything you can imagine.
translation: 他再也无法帮助唯一的家人了，我向上望并呼喊着他的名字……一道亮光闪过，比你能想象的一切都亮。

original: I woke up a few hours later. The first thing I did was run up to where my father had been. He... he was gone. But the strangest thing...
translation: 几小时后，我醒过来。我第一时间跑到我父亲之前站的地方。他……他不见了。但最意想不到的是……

original: There was his shadow, burned into the wall, so crisp and clear like he was standing next to me. The heat had burned it into the concrete...
translation: 那有他的影子，在墙上烧出的印记，那么诡异却又那么清晰，好像他就站在我身边。那热量把它烧进了墙里……

original: There's no way you could have gone there and gotten back already.
translation: 你不可能在这么短的时间内往返一次。

original: It's got to take at least a day to get there and back. Now get going!
translation: 从那往返至少要一天时间。现在就去！

original: I appreciate the landmine, but there's just no way you could have gotten to Minefield and back already!
translation: 我很感激你送给我的地雷。但在这么短的时间内，要从雷区拿到地雷再返回，这不可能办到！

original: I mean, it's got to take at least a day or so to get there and back! So get going!
translation: 我的意思是，从那往返至少要一天时间。现在就去！

original: Oh, great! And you look like it went fine! So, how was it?
translation: 哦，好极了！看上去很顺利！办得怎么样？

original: My very own landmine! Just what I've always wanted. Well, always since I sent you out on this, anyway.
translation: 我的地雷！就是我一直想得到的。嗯，至少是我派你去拿之后我一直想得到的。

original: Now, tell me all about it. What was it like going through there? What's it like disarming a landmine?
translation: 现在，和我谈谈。经历如何？解除地雷的感觉是什么样的？

original: Oh, come on. You barely even left! I can't imagine you tested it on a reasonable number of subjects so quickly. It can't have been a good sample size.
translation: 哦，拜托。你都没怎么离开呢！我无法想象你能这么快地对合理数量的目标进行了测试。不可能有一个很好的样本量。

original: Oh yeah?
translation: 嗯？

original: Now that I think about it, Forty has been lookin' mighty fine lately. Workin' out extra.
translation: 现在回想起来，弗替最近变强壮了。他加强了锻炼。

original: Maybe I'll go see if there's anything I can do for him. You keep this between me and you. Clear?
translation: 或许我会到那看看有什么能帮他的。你不能把这事告诉别人。明白吗？

original: Well, I'll be damned... That little so-and-so... why didn't I think of that when I was sixteen?
translation: 嗯，真想不到……这些细节……我16岁的时候怎么没考虑过那些问题？

original: Okay, okay!
translation: 好的，好的！

original: Don't follow me. You go out the normal way, and meet Sammy and me outside.
translation: 别跟着我。你不动声色地出去，然后再和我、萨米会合。

original: You saved him? Really?
translation: 你救了他？真的吗？

original: Thank you so much. I'll make it up to you somehow, I promise.
translation: 非常感谢你。我保证我会报答你的。

original: Now I have to get out. Don't follow me; you go out the normal way. We'll meet outside.
translation: 现在我得走了。别跟着我；你不动声色地出去。我们在外面会合。

original: Of course. I know this is an unusual request, but hey, I'm an unusual tree huh?. Well, Bob is anyway...
translation: 当然。我知道这是不寻常的要求，但是，嘿，我是棵不寻常的树，对吧？嗯，反正鲍勃是……

original: We'll just keep it an open invitation then. I don't want to wait until the next person visits, it could be years... you're all I've got.
translation: 那我们就把这事当长期有效的邀请吧。我可不想等到下一个人来访，那可能得好几年……现在就指望你了。

original: Of all the Wastelanders I had to bump into it has to be one with a conscience.
translation: 那么多废土客中，我偏偏碰到了个有良心的人。

original: Let's keep it an open invitation then. I don't want to wait until the next person visits, it could be years.
translation: 那就算是长期有效的邀请吧。我可不想等到下一个人来访，那可能是好几年后了。

original: Just, just, think about it, okay?
translation: 就，就，考虑一下，好吗？

original: You will? Oh, oh! You've... you've made us so happy! Isn't that right Bob?
translation: 你愿意？哦，哦！你……你让我们太开心了！对吧，鲍勃？

original: Just give me a little time to say goodbye to good old Bob and then I'll be ready.
translation: 给我点时间跟老伙计鲍勃道个别，然后我就准备好了。

original: Officer Kendall! Help!
translation: 肯德尔警官！快来！

original: No! There is no way my guys are dead!
translation: 不！我的人不会死的！

original: If there's even the slimmest chance of surviving, they'll do it.
translation: 即使只有一线生机，他们也会去尝试的。

original: If you won't go, stop wasting my fucking time and find me someone who will!
translation: 如果你不愿意去，就别他妈浪费我的时间，找个愿意去的人！

original: Are you completely stupid?
translation: 你傻了吗？

original: I can barely walk right now, let alone climb a skyscraper. If I could even hold a pistol, I would go get my guys right now!
translation: 现在我几乎无法行走，更别提爬上摩天大楼。如果我现在能拿起手枪的话，我会立刻救回我的人！

original: I'm using everything I've got just standing here talking to you. Get the point?
translation: 我正在用所有力量为了在这和你说话。懂了吗？

original: Heh, I feel worse than I look, but that doesn't even matter to me. I'm just worried about the rest of the Rangers.
translation: 呃，我的感觉比外表还糟，但我不在乎。我只是担心其他的游骑兵。

original: I don't even know if they're still alive.
translation: 我甚至不知道他们是死是活。

original: You know why. We can't start the purifier without it. The longer the purifier isn't running, the more people suffer.

translation: 你把佩尼，萨米和“松鼠”带回来了？太好了，我猜那会让你成为一个超级大英雄。谢谢！

original: I'm Lucy, and I'm pretty much the mom around here. And that means I spend a lot of time kissing boo-boos and making things all better.
translation: 我是露西，我几乎成了这地方的妈妈。这也意味着我要花很多时间来照顾伤患，这样他们才能好起来。

original: So, if you ever get any scrapes or bruises - or if you get shot, stabbed, or radiated - stop by and I'll do what I can, big hero.
translation: 哦，如果你被擦伤或撞伤 — 或者被射伤、刺伤，辐射 — 就到我这来，我会尽我所能为你疗伤，大英雄。

original: Well, if you brought them back, then I guess that explains why RJ let you in. So, I guess that does make you a big hero.
translation: 好极了，你把他们带回来了，我就说为什么镇长会让你进来。看来你要成大英雄了。

original: I'm Lucy, and I'm pretty much mommy to the folks here. I try to keep them safe, and when that's not enough I patch up their cuts and bruises.
translation: 我是露西，我几乎成了这群家伙的妈妈了。我尽力保护他们，并且还得帮他们包扎被割伤和撞伤的伤口。

original: And when that's not enough, I make sure they get a funeral. Thanks for making sure I didn't have to do that for three more of mine.
translation: 但那还没完，我还得安葬不幸死去的人。谢谢你，让我不用多做三次。

original: That was you? Well, you brought my sister Penny back, so sure, I'll call you a big hero. Thank you very much.
translation: 是你？嗯，你把我的妹妹佩尼带回来了，你是我的大英雄。非常感谢你。

original: I'm Joseph, and as the oldest kid in Lamplight, I'm pretty much a teacher by default. I also try to keep the kids clean and fresh-faced.
translation: 我是约瑟夫，作为小灯镇里年龄最大的小孩，我几乎是默认的老师。我也会让他们保持清洁和精神饱满。

original: I'm not sure if there's anything I can teach you, but if you need a haircut or the like, just say the word. And thanks again.
translation: 我不能确定还能教你什么，但如果你想理发或类似的事，和我说下就行。还有再次谢谢你。

original: Oh, really? So you're saying you brought back three more hungry mouths, too? Great, you're just making my day better and better!
translation: 哦，真的？你是说你还带回了三张饥饿的嘴？太好了，你让我的日子更好过了！

original: Look, I'm Eclair, and I'm in charge of the crap we call food down here. And we've got precious little enough to go around as it is.
translation: 听着，我是“闪电泡芙”，我管理着我们称为食物的垃圾。我们很珍惜这些恰好足以维持生命的垃圾。

original: So, yeah, thanks for bringing those folks back alive, but don't expect me to throw you a big party over it.
translation: 嗯，感谢你把那些人活着带回来，但别指望我为你开一个大的庆功宴。

original: You saved Penny and Sammy and Squirrel? I can see why RJ let you in! Thanks, for all of us!
translation: 你救了佩尼、萨米和“松鼠”？我明白为什么麦迪让你进来了！谢谢，代表我们所有人！

original: I'm Lucy, and I pretty much spend my days playing mommy around here. I spend a lot of time kissing boo-boos and making things better.
translation: 我是露西，我大部分时间都在扮演妈妈的角色。花费大量时间来亲亲伤口，让一切都好起来。

original: If you get a scraped knee or stubbed toe, come see me. Same if you get shot in the face or burns all over, but I can only promise so much.
translation: 如果你擦伤了膝盖或被踩伤了脚趾，就来找我。如果你脸部被射伤或全身烧伤，你也可以来找我，但我可能什么也做不了。

original: That was you? Well, my most sincere thanks, then. You brought my sister Penny back to me, and I couldn't ask more than that.
translation: 那是你？嗯，请接受我最诚挚的感谢。你把我的妹妹佩尼带回来了，我无法要求你做得更多。

original: I'm Joseph, and if there's ever anything I can do for you here, just name it!
translation: 我是约瑟夫，如果有什么是我能为你做的，尽管开口！

original: As the oldest kid in town, I spend most of my time teaching, but I do what I can to keep the kids clean and fresh-faced.
translation: 作为镇里最年长的孩子，我花费大部分时间用于教学，不过我也尽可能地确保孩子的卫生和健康。

original: Say, if you're ever looking for a haircut, I'd be glad to offer my services. You only have to ask!
translation: 如果你想理发，我很乐于为你服务。尽管开口！

original: Oh, you think Sammy and the rest wouldn't have gotten back on their own eventually? I taught him better than that.
translation: 哦，你觉得萨米和其他人最终没法自己回来？我的徒弟可比你想象的要强。

original: Well, if you're sticking around, you ought to know that I'm Princess, and I call the shots around here.
translation: 嗯，如果你老在这里转悠，你该知道我是公主，还有在这我说了算。

original: And don't forget it, mungo!
translation: 别忘了，毛人！

original: That's good, they don't like me having my gun in town, so I gotta turn it in first, so if I had to shoot you you'd have to wait a bit.
translation: 那很好，他们不喜欢我在镇里携枪，因此我事先上交了，所以如果我不得不向你开枪，你还得在这等我一会儿。

original: My name's Zip. I don't think that's short for anything, because I don't know what it'd be short for. Zippy? Zipperick? Ziptholomew?
translation: 我的名字叫拉链，我觉得我的名字不是缩写，因为我不知道它是什么的缩写。吉帕？吉帕瑞克？吉帕多罗买？

original: So yeah, it's good to meet you, big kid, and maybe you've got big stuff on top of you. Do you have any Nuka-Cola, maybe? Yes? Please?
translation: 嗯，很高兴见到你，大孩子，也许你身上还有大东西呢。有核子可乐吗？有吧？

original: Oh, that's good because Mayor MacCready says I can't have my gun in town anymore, not since last time, but that was totally an accident anyway!
translation: 哦，那很好，因为自从那次以后，麦奎迪镇长说我不能再在镇里携枪了，可那纯粹是场意外啊！

original: That reminds me, got any Nuka-Cola? 'Cause if I'm not gonna have a gun in town, then it must be okay for me to have more Nuka, right?
translation: 那提醒了我，有核子可乐吗？因为既然我不能再在镇里携枪，那么我应该可以拿更多核子可乐，对吧？

original: Anyway, everyone calls me Zip, you know, like a zipper, only not really like that because I'm not made of metal, but I do go up and down, I guess.
translation: 总之，每个人都叫我拉链，你知道，像一条拉链。我猜他们之所以这样叫我，是因为虽然我不是用铁做的，但我总是像拉链一样上下走动。

original: Really? Because I heard from the mayor about the sorts of deals you make when you trade. None for you.
translation: 真的？因为我听镇长说过你做交易时的事情。没你份。

original: Sure thing, pal! Special deals for us kids!
translation: 当然，伙计！对我们这些孩子来次特别交易！

original: I hope you brought me some cool stuff!
translation: 我希望你会带给我一些很酷的东西！

original: Yeah, I heard about the sorts of things you'd do for this fungus. Well, you're cut off. Go scrounge your own food.
translation: 嗯，我听说你为了蘑菇所做的事。嗯，这不欢迎你。自己去找食物吧。

original: Bon appetit.
translation: 祝你胃口好。

original: Sure thing, mungo. We don't have much to spare, so get ready to pay.
translation: 当然，毛人。我们剩得不多，所以准备付钱吧。

original: Enjoy, if you've got the caps.
translation: 好好享受，如果你有瓶盖的话。

original: All right. Now, hold still.
translation: 好。现在别动。

original: Certainly. How would you like to look?
translation: 当然。你打算怎么做？

original: I don't need to explain myself to you, mungo. Shut up and get lost.
translation: 我不需要向你解释，毛人。闭嘴，消失。

original: In fact, don't you ever bother me about something as stupid as nicknames again!
translation: 事实上，别拿绰号这类蠢事再来打扰我！

original: Why Zip? Or why do I have a nickname at all? I mean, why don't people just call me Ricky? Or Yancy? Or Eustace P. Vanderbanger the Third?
translation: 为什么叫拉链？还是为什么我会有绰号？我的意思是，人们为什么不叫我瑞基？或是杨西？又或是尤斯塔斯·P·范德邦赫？

original: I mean, they say it's because I'm so fast, but that doesn't make sense because I don't think I'm all that fast, it's just that they're all so slow!
translation: 我的意思是，他们说我语速很快，可是我不觉得自己有多快，只是他们太慢了！

original: I guess it's just one of those mysteries that'll never really get answered, sort of like how people made the bubbles in Nuka-Cola. Say, got any Cola?
translation: 我想那是个永远无从知晓的谜，就像人们怎么在核子可乐里弄出泡泡。说到这，有可乐吗？

original: I hold open classes every morning for anyone who's got an interest in learning about a subject. Obviously, voluntary attendance is usually low.
translation: 我每个早上都为所有有兴趣学习某个科目的人上课。显然，自觉上课的人总是很少。

original: I wouldn't normally let someone like you sit in, but since you saved Penny's life, it's the least I can offer.
translation: 通常情况下我是不会让像你这样的人坐进来的，不过既然你救了佩尼的命，我只能以此回报了。

original: Would you like to hear our history? It's something of a favorite.
translation: 你想听听我们的历史吗？那充满了乐趣。

original: Right here. Welcome to our fungus pools. Eat up!
translation: 嘿，这儿。欢迎来到我们的蘑菇池。随便吃！

original: Hee hee! Okay, later then!
translation: 嘿，嘿！好的，迟点！

original: Okay. See you later, and don't get too bashed up.
translation: 好的，迟点见，别被揍得太厉害。

original: I understand. Well, take care.
translation: 我明白。嗯，小心。

original: I hear that. Anyway, gotta be on my way. Later.
translation: 我听见了。总之，该上路了。迟点见。

original: Oh, okay. Umm, bye!
translation: 哦，好的。再见！

original: Okay, whatever you say. Bye.
translation: 好的，随你怎么说，再见。

original: All right then! See ya!
translation: 好！再见！

original: Okay, then! See ya!
translation: 好的！再见！

original: Umm... Okay, yeah, bye bye now!
translation: 嗯……好的，嗯，再见！

original: That makes sense. Talk to you later.
translation: 有道理。迟点和你谈。

original: Fine. Bye now.
translation: 好。再见。

original: Yeah, I see. Catch you later, I guess.
translation: 嗯，我明白。迟点找你。

original: Yeah, yeah, fine. Catch ya later.
translation: 嗯，嗯，好的。迟点找你。

original: 'Kay, bye.
translation: 再见。

original: Okay. Bye.
translation: 好的。再见

original: Meh.
translation: 哦。

original: Busy, like always. Somebody's always got a tummy ache or a runny nose or a knife wound. You know how it is.
translation: 忙，总是这样。总有些人肚疼，或是流涕，又或是刀伤。你知道的。

original: I'm fine. It's another fine day, underground.
translation: 我很好。地下的又一天。

original: Doing good. I could do with better food, but couldn't we all?
translation: 还行。要是有更好的食物就好了，谁不是呢？

original: I'm fine, thanks!
translation: 我很好，谢谢！

original: Doing better than a dog in a bone-yard!
translation: 比一条垃圾场的狗好！

original: Happier than a Ghoul wallowing in sludge!
translation: 比一个烂泥里的尸鬼快活！

original: Just fine! Been all over today, and you wouldn't believe the cool stuff I did!
translation: 很行！今天状态平平，你不会相信我干那些酷事！

original: It's always nicer to be in here than out there.
translation: 在这总比在外边好。

original: I'm fine.
translation: 我很好。

original: I think I'm catching a cough. But I'll be fine.
translation: 我想我感冒了，不过我会好起来的。

original: Oh, not yet I'm not.
translation: 哦，我还没有。

original: We're in the best fucking place in the world! You better believe I feel great!
translation: 我们在世界上他妈的最好的地方！你最好相信我感觉超棒！

original: I'm okay!
translation: 我很好！

original: I'm okay.
translation: 我很好。

original: Oh hey! How're you doing? Doing okay?
translation: 哦，嗨！最近怎么样？过得好吗？

original: Hello. How are you doing?
translation: 你好。最近怎么样？

original: Hello. How's it going?
translation: 你好。最近怎么样？

original: Hey there! You doing alright?
translation: 嗨！你过得还好吧？

original: Hey! How's Lamplight life treating you?
translation: 嗨！你在小灯镇过得怎么样？

original: Heya. Are you feeling alright? You look a little stiff.
translation: 嘿。你感觉还好吧？你看起来有些拘谨。

original: Hello, there. Are you okay?
translation: 你好。你还好吗？

original: Hey. How you doing?
translation: 嗨，最近怎么样？

original: Hello. How are you?
translation: 你好。

original: Hrmf. What're you so happy about?
translation: 嘿。你在高兴什么？

original: Beat it, squirt.
translation: 滚，小毛孩。

original: How do, pal?
translation: 怎么样，伙计？

original: How do ya do, pal?
translation: 最近怎么样，伙计？

original: Hewwo. How're you?
translation: 你豪。最近怎么样？

original: Hey, how are you?
translation: 嗨，你好吗？

original: Well... I guess I could make an exception. 50 caps -- but that's my final offer.
translation: 嗯……我想我可以例外一次。50个瓶盖 — 不过那是我最终出价。

original: All right. But don't let it get around, or I'll have every dirty waster begging me for help.
translation: 好吧。不过别传出去，不然每个肮脏的废物都会来求我帮忙。

original: Fine. 100 it is. But don't think this makes us friends. This is a special, one-time offer, understand?
translation: 好的。100个。不要以为我们是朋友了，这是特殊的、一次性的，明白吗？

original: All right.
translation: 好吧。

original: I'll see you in hell, coward.
translation: 我们地狱见，胆小鬼。

original: Okay, I got it.
translation: 好的，我知道了。

original: I guess if this doesn't work, we're screwed anyway, right?
translation: 我想如果这不行，我们就有大麻烦了，对吧？

original: Okay, I got it.
translation: 好的，我知道了。

original: Tell my father... Tell him I love him, will you?
translation: 告诉我的父亲……告诉他我爱他，好吗？

original: You're going to have to be quick about it. If the radiation is bad enough, you won't have much time.
translation: 你一定要尽快。如果辐射太强，你不会有很多时间。

original: I won't forget what you've done here. No one will. Thank you.
translation: 我不会忘记你所做的事。没人会忘记。谢谢你。

original: I suppose I can spare a few stimpaks. It's not much, but it might make things easier for you.
translation: 我想我有多余的治疗针。虽然不多，但能让你舒服些。

original: We're running out of time. You need to get in there.
translation: 我们没有时间了。你必须进去。

original: Get in the airlock. I'll cycle it for you so you can enter the code.
translation: 进到气密门里去。我会开启它，以便你可以输入密码。

original: You have to get in the airlock before I can cycle it and let you in there.
translation: 在我开启气密门之前，你必须进到气密门里去。

original: We're running out of time! You need to get in that airlock now!
translation: 我们快没时间了！你必须现在就进入气密门！

original: God help me. I found Dad today... I didn't think it was him, but... the face. The zombies didn't touch him. I think… he was becoming like them.
translation: 上帝保佑。我今天找到了爸爸……我以为不是他，但……那张脸。丧尸没有碰他。我想……他已经变得和他们一样了。

original: Didn't know it was him until I found that old book near him. No more killing. I just need to go. Can't forget the book. All I have left of him.
translation: 直到在他身边发现那本旧书，我才知道那就是他。不必杀戮。我只需要离开。不能忘了那本书。我只剩下他了。

original: It's warm against the stone. I'll just rest a while...
translation: 靠着岩石很暖和。我只想休息会……

original: Don't like the look of this place... don't like the smell. Gives me the creeps.
translation: 不喜欢这地方的样子……不喜欢这味道。让我起鸡皮疙瘩。

original: Don't want to risk a shot at the crows until I know what’s in there. Sneaking in tonight.
translation: 在我知道那有什么之前，不要贸然开枪。今晚潜入。

original: He must have been trying to trap food here. I recognize his snares. I can make out a building on the horizon. That must be where he headed.
translation: 他肯定在这试着捕食。我认得他的陷阱。我能辨认出地平线上的那座建筑。他肯定朝那去了。

original: If not, at least I get a roof tonight.
translation: 如果不是，至少今晚我能有瓦遮头了。

original: Hit a caravan today. Trev didn't see the kid and got popped. I took care of Tawny right then, and put one in Thor before he saw her fall.
translation: 今天遇到了商队。特雷弗没看见那孩子并且被他打中了。我那时正顾着喝酒，在托尔看到她倒下前把酒放在了他那。

original: That earned me some grub from the traders. Even better, they saw dad. He was in pretty rough shape, and still has the goddamn book.
translation: 这使我从商人那得到了一些食物。更棒的是，他们见过爸爸。他的样子很糟，仍然拿着那该死的书。

original: Trader says it gave him the creeps. Me too. But it's good to know he's still alive. Still headed south.
translation: 商人说他让人起鸡皮疙瘩。换我也会。但很高兴知道他还活着。继续朝南方去。

original: Gee, thanks! I have to admit, most of them aren't really funny. At least, not ha-ha funny.
translation: 谢谢！我必须承认，它们大部分并不真正好笑，至少，没法令人哈哈大笑。

original: They're more like a tradition. Most of them were passed down from this book we found down back, called "Vault Boy's Big Book of Laughs for Kids".
translation: 它们更像一种传统。其中大多数是从我们过去发现的一本书，叫什么“避难所男孩的儿科笑话大全”里流传下来的。

original: They're not really funny, but something about hearing them is a little comforting, you know?
translation: 它们并非真的有趣，但是听一听也能令人欣慰，你懂吗？

original: I know. And really, we're lucky we didn't lose more people in that attack.
translation: 我知道。实际上，我们非常幸运，在那次袭击中没有损失更多人。

original: But we can't risk that a second time. I've got to stay extra vigilant on watch. Thanks for reminding me of that.
translation: 不过，我们不能再冒险，我们要加倍留神。谢谢提醒。

original: Now leave me alone. No distractions!
translation: 现在让我一个人静一下，我不想分心！

original: Somebody needs to guard the front gate, and no one else is doing it. So I will. Even if it sucks for me, I don't mind.
translation: 有些人需要守卫前门，但没有其他人做了。所以我做。虽然这让我很不开心，但我不介意。

original: Some things just have to be done, and they just have to be done right. Because if they aren't, you can't ever get back what you lose.
translation: 有些事情是一定要做的，而且一定要做对。否则一旦失败，有些东西失去了就永远找不回来了。

original: Besides, Caps would want it like that.
translation: 此外，“帽子”会希望我这样的。

original: No. Not anymore, they don't.
translation: 不。再也不会那样了，再也不会了。

original: Now, stop distracting me from my job.
translation: 现在，别让我在工作时分心。

original: Except... I was supposed to be on guard when they attacked. I should have been here to help Caps.
translation: 除了……在他们袭击时，我应该在这守卫。我应该在这帮助“帽子”。

original: It really is my fault she died.
translation: 她的死确实是我的错。

original: Now I'm the only front gate guard, so it's my responsibility to make up for that.
translation: 现在我是唯一的前门看守，弥补过错就是我的职责。

original: Oh, is that how it's going to be, then? Well then, how's this deal?
translation: 哦，然后怎样？成交？

original: Rather than you wasting the explosives to try to close all of our exits, just for us to burrow out again, you get my private stash of fungus.
translation: 与其你浪费炸药试图封死我们所有出口，让我们再钻出去，还不如让你得到我私藏的小蘑菇。

original: Here. But I wouldn't expect much goodwill in town after this, you shit-sucking mungo bastard.
translation: 给。之后我再也不会相信这个镇子里人的信誉了，你这吃屎的毛人杂种。

original: Well, it lighten the load for our scav team out a lot. And since you're pretty much one of us, here's the deal...
translation: 这很大程度上减轻了我们拾荒队的负担。你帮了我们那么多，拿着……

original: For every piece of strange meat or Buffout you bring in, you'll be repaid with one cube of fungus. You couldn't ask for a better deal.
translation: 你每带回一片奇怪的肉或者壮大灵，都会得到一块蘑菇作为报。这交易太划算了。

original: Talk with Eclair for the strange meat, or to Lucy about the Buffout. They've got uses for them.
translation: 和“闪电泡芙”谈谈奇怪的肉，或和露西谈谈壮大灵。这些东西对他们来说很有用。

original: That's not a terrible deal. And it'd mean more of those dumbasses can stay safely down here, instead of scavving all the time.
translation: 这交易不错。这意味着那些傻瓜中有更多人可以安全地待在这，而不用整天拾荒。

original: Okay, for every two bits of strange meat or Buffout, I'll make sure you get a piece of fungus. Not too bad, huh?
translation: 好的，每两片奇怪的肉或者壮大灵，我都会换给你一块蘑菇。不错吧，呃？

original: I'll spread the word to and Lucy and Eclair. They've got uses for them, so they'll make the trade, and we'll all be happy, okay?
translation: 我会通知露西和“闪电泡芙”。他们有用到，如果买卖成了，我们都开心，好吧？

original: More stuff for us, and more chance of you getting shot, stumbling back here, choking on your own blood while we point and laugh? Sounds good.
translation: 给我们东西越多，你中枪的几率就越大，蹒跚而回，被自己的血呛到，而我们在一旁指指点点，哈哈大笑？听起来不错。

original: How about this: for every three pieces of strange meat or Buffout doses you bring in, you'll get one piece of fungus. Take it or leave it.
translation: 这样如何：你每带回来三片奇怪的肉或者壮大灵，你都可以得到一块蘑菇。同不同意随你。

original: Just talk to Lucy or Eclair about what they need, and stop bothering me about it.
translation: 去和露西或者“闪电泡芙”谈他们的需求，别烦我。

original: It's not that complex. Any kid can say they want to be mayor here. It's just that most don't want to bother with the responsibility of leading.
translation: 没有那么复杂。这里所有孩子都能竞选镇长。只是大多数人都不想承担领导的责任。

original: Most of the time, they last until the kids get tired of them, then they get kicked out on their ass by the new mayor. One only lasted 5 minutes.
translation: 大部分情况下，他们的任期直到其他孩子厌烦他们为止，然后他们就会被新镇长赶下台。其中有一个只坚持了5分钟。

original: Of course, I've kept this place going strong for three years. To most kids, that makes me Mayor For Fucking Life. Fine by me, I say.
translation: 当然，我已经让这个地方坚挺了三年。对大多数孩子来说，这让我成为了“他妈的终身镇长”。我是说，我觉得没问题。

original: Great stuff! Talk with you later, sis!
translation: 好东西！等会再谈，姐妹！

original: Not if I could help it! Made any good trades today?
translation: 除非我能帮忙！今天有什么好买卖？

original: You getting a nickname any time soon? Maybe you can get one that helps people figure out you're not a girl.
translation: 你能否尽快取个绰号？或许你该起个能让别人明白你不是女孩的绰号。

original: Now you're just making up words, aren't you? Here's your standard.
translation: 你在捏造词汇，对吧？你也就这水平。

original: So, cave fungus in sauce? Coming right up.
translation: 用了酱料的洞穴蘑菇？拿来。

original: Just like you're keeping them alive, Lucy. Here you go.
translation: 就像你让他们活了下来，露西。好了。

original: Sure thing, dear.
translation: 当然，亲爱的。

original: Nice try, but you're still getting the same muck as everyone else.
translation: 干得好，但你给我的是和其他人给的一样的垃圾！

original: Hell, I'd be happy with a clean set of spoons. Enjoy the meal.
translation: 见鬼，我真高兴有一套干净的汤匙。痛快的吃吧。

original: Yeah, yeah, I know. Here's your "fun-guy." Should be as good as your jokes.
translation: 嗯，嗯，我知道。给你“有趣的人”。应该和你的笑话一样有趣。

original: Yeah, yeah, I get it, Zip. Here, knock yourself out.
translation: 嗯，嗯，我做好了，拉链。给，自便。

original: Calm down, Zip. It's not getting any blander. Here.
translation: 冷静，拉链。它已经不会更淡了。给。

original: Sure thing, Penny.
translation: 当然，佩尼。

original: Toughen up, Squirrel. The dirt adds flavor.
translation: 坚强点，“松鼠”。尘土增添了风味。

original: I can't believe you like this shit, RJ.
translation: 我不相信你会喜欢这垃圾，麦迪。

original: Just like you're keeping them alive, Lucy. Here you go.
translation: 就像你让他们活了下来，露西。好了。

original: Here. Now, get.
translation: 给。拿着。

original: People don't have the same sort of safety and freedom to run around and play like you can here. They have to work hard for food and safety.
translation: 其他人可不像你在这里一样安全，能自由地四处奔跑、无忧无虑地玩耍。他们必须为食物和安全努力工作。

original: Out there, grown ups - or "mungos" as we call them - do all sorts of terrible things to each other, like when they kidnapped Penny and Sammy.
translation: 在外面，大人-或者按我们的说法“毛人” — 对其他人做各种各样可怕的事，就像他们抓走佩尼和萨米时所做的。

original: Uncle Joseph, could you explain more about the outside?
translation: 约瑟夫叔叔，你能多说点外面世界的事吗？

original: Uncle Joseph, I still don't understand what outside's like. Can you explain more?
translation: 约瑟夫叔叔，我还是不明白外面世界是什么样的。你能多说点吗？

original: That isn't so! I just... didn't want to do it anymore, and...
translation: 不是这样的！我只是……不想再当了，而且……

original: Just shut up! This isn't fair! A big, mean mungo is picking on me! I hate you!
translation: 闭嘴，这不公平！一个卑鄙的大毛人找我茬！我恨你！

original: Just leave me alone! Go away! Go!
translation: 离我远点！滚开！滚！

original: Oh, sure, like I should believe you. Why are you even wasting your time over here?
translation: 哦，当然，好像我该相信你似的。你为什么还在这浪费时间？

original: Scram, get out of my face, go!
translation: 滚，从我面前滚开，滚！

original: That's not true! You're a liar! Shut your stupid face, liar!
translation: 那不是真的！你是个骗子！把你的蠢脸挪开，骗子！

original: I know RJ likes me! He really does! Really!
translation: 我知道麦迪喜欢我！他真的喜欢！真的！

original: Just leave me alone, you mungo jerk! I hate you!
translation: 离我远点，你这毛人混蛋！我恨你！

original: That isn't so! Stop lying! Stop being such a big mungo liar!
translation: 别再这样！停止撒谎！别跟个大毛人骗子似的！

original: This isn't fair! A big mean mungo picking on me! I hate you!
translation: 这不公平！一个卑鄙的大毛人找我茬！我恨你！

original: You... You jerk! Just shut up and leave me alone! Go away!
translation: 你……你这混蛋！闭嘴，离我远点！滚开！

original: We can always use 'em.
translation: 我们总是需要它们。

original: We can always use 'em.
translation: 我们总是需要它们。

original: We can always use 'em.
translation: 我们总是需要它们。

original: We can always use 'em.
translation: 我们总是需要它们。

original: We can always use 'em.
translation: 我们总是需要它们。

original: I sure am, sonny. What've you got for me?
translation: 不错，男孩。你给我带来了什么？

original: I sure am, missy. What've you got for me?
translation: 不错，女孩。你给我带来了什么？

original: Well, it's no secret that the ol' water treatment plant is on its last legs. And I'm the only one in town that can keep the damn thing running.
translation: 嗯，众所周知水处理厂已经快不行了。而我是镇里唯一一个还能让这该死的东西运作的人。

original: I spend so much time up in the plant, that I can't take care of the leaks that keep springing up in the pipes around town.
translation: 我在这厂里花费大量时间，无暇顾及镇里管道不断出现的泄漏。

original: Now, I don't expect much from strangers, but if you've got the know-how, I need someone to hunt down and repair those leaks.
translation: 现在，我对陌生人没太大期望，但如果你有专门技术，我需要有人去找到并修复那些泄漏的管道。

original: Well, I'll be... the pressure's up in the plant. It looks like all the leaks have been fixed. Thank you, stranger! Thank you!
translation: 嗯，我会……厂里的压力上升了。看来所有泄漏的管道都已经修复了。谢谢你，陌生人！谢谢！

original: But listen, it's only a matter of time before they burst again, and someone like you might not be around to fix 'em. I'll make you a deal.
translation: 但听着，它们再次泄漏只是时间问题，而且不会恰好有像你这样的人去修复。我想跟你做个交易。

original: I'll give you caps for any Scrap Metal you can bring me. You'll find it all over the place out there in the Wastes.
translation: 我会为你带给我的每块废金属付瓶盖。你在废土各处都能找到它们。

original: If I have a steady supply of scrap, I can keep the plant running and the pipes should be just fine. We got a deal?
translation: 如果废料补给稳定，我就能维持水厂运作，保持管道完好。成交？

original: Good! This just keeps looking better! Those parts will keep this place running and the town in fresh water! Hurry back as soon as you find some!
translation: 好的！这一来好多了！那些零件会使这维持运作以使镇子有淡水供应！你找到后赶快回来！

original: Alright... alright... relax. But all you've done is delay the inevitable. Without those parts, the plants gonna croak sooner or later.
translation: 好吧……好吧……放松。但你所做的一切只是推迟必然发生的事。没有那些零件，水厂迟早会停止运作。

original: But what do you care? You just want your money.
translation: 但你在乎什么？你只想要钱。

original: Here, take it and get out.
translation: 给，拿了就滚。

original: Alright... alright... relax. But all you've done is delay the inevitable. Without those parts, the plants gonna croak sooner or later.
translation: 好吧……好吧……放松。但你所做的一切只是推迟必然发生的事。没有那些零件，水厂迟早会停止运作。

original: But what do you care? You just want your money.
translation: 但你在乎什么？你只想要钱。

original: Here, take it and get out.
translation: 给，拿了就滚。

original: You're wrong. Humans are cruel, hurtful beasts! They can't be saved... we can't be...
translation: 你错了。人类是残酷而凶恶的野兽！他们不能被拯救……我们不能……

original: I can't... I can't go back. But I can't keep doing this. I can't be as bad as they were. Not if someone like you believes in me.
translation: 我不能……我不能回去。但我无法继续。我不能和他们一样坏。没人像你这样相信我。

original: Please... I think I've made some terrible mistakes. If you really think I still have a chance, just let me go.
translation: 拜托……我想我犯了些可怕的错。如果你真的觉得我还有机会，让我走吧。

original: I'll give you the suit. No one ever has to see the AntAgonizer again. Just please, let me have another chance.
translation: 我会给你这件套装。没有人会再见到痛苦蚁后。拜托，再给我一个机会。

original: You're wrong. Humans are cruel, hurtful beasts! They can't be saved... we can't be...
translation: 你错了。人类是残酷而凶恶的野兽！他们不能被拯救……我们不能……

original: I can't... I can't go back. But I can't keep doing this. I can't be as bad as they were.
translation: 我不能……我不能回去。但我无法继续。我不能和他们一样坏。

original: Please... I think I've made some terrible mistakes. If you really think I still have a chance, just let me go.
translation: 拜托……我想我犯了些可怕的错。如果你真的觉得我还有机会，让我走吧。

original: I'll give you the suit. No one ever has to see the AntAgonizer again. Just please, let me have another chance.
translation: 我会给你这件套装。没有人会再见到痛苦蚁后。拜托，再给我一个机会。

original: Is... Is that true? Have I really become a threat to the town? Do you really feel that way?
translation: 这……这是真的？我真的成了镇子的威胁？你真的这么觉得？

original: Am I really the villain, here? Does this mean I should stop myself?
translation: 我在这真的是个恶棍吗？这是不意味着我该收敛？

original: I... I guess I could just give up my suit and stop being the Mechanist. But I couldn't face the town after causing that much trouble.
translation: 我……我想我可以放弃我这件套装，不再做机械侠。但造成这么多麻烦后，我没法面对镇子。

original: Here, please. Take the suit. I don't want to think about it anymore.
translation: 给。拿走这套装。我再也不想看到它。

original: Is... Is that true? Have I really become a threat to the town?
translation: 这……这是真的？我真的成了镇子的威胁？

original: Am I really the villain, here? Does this mean I should stop myself?
translation: 我在这真的是个恶棍吗？这是不意味着我该收敛？

original: I... I guess I could just give up my suit and stop being the Mechanist. But I couldn't face the town after causing that much trouble.
translation: 我……我想我可以放弃我这件套装，不再做机械侠。但造成这么多麻烦后，我没法面对镇子。

original: Here, please. Take the suit. I don't want to think about it anymore.
translation: 给。拿走这套装。我再也不想看到它。

original: Is... Is that true? Have I really become a bigger problem for the town than her?
translation: 这……这是真的？对镇子来说，我真的成了比她还大的麻烦？

original: Am I really the villain, here? Does this mean I should stop myself?
translation: 我在这真的是个恶棍吗？这是不意味着我该收敛？

original: I... I guess I could just give up my suit and stop being the Mechanist. But I couldn't face the town after causing that much trouble.
translation: 我……我想我可以放弃我这件套装，不再做机械侠。但造成这么多麻烦后，我没法面对镇子。

original: Here, please. Take the suit. I don't want to think about it anymore.
translation: 给。拿走这套装。我再也不想看到它。

original: He's a darling. Always watching out for me, and more importantly keeping the collection safe!
translation: 他很贴心。总是照顾我，更重要的是确保了收藏品的安全！

original: Like once, there was these Raiders that came by. There were three of them and their leader was named like Lug-Nut or something...
translation: 像有一次，这来了一些掠夺者。他们有三个人，带头的像是叫“轮毂螺母”还是什么……

original: Anyone seen Forty? He wanted to talk to me.
translation: 有人见到弗替了吗？他想和我谈谈。

original: Pronto said he wanted to talk to me about something. Keep up, ladies.
translation: 普郎托说他想和我谈谈。跟上，女士们。

original: I need to see our good doctor.
translation: 我要见我们的好医生。

original: Let's leave our employees to their recreation. There's a business to run.
translation: 让我们的雇员自娱自乐吧。我们有生意了。

original: Ladies, to the bar.
translation: 女士们，去酒吧。

original: Let's see what's going on over at the bar.
translation: 看看酒吧发生什么事。

original: Nothing going on here. Let's go.
translation: 没事了。走吧。

original: Let's go, ladies. Keep up.
translation: 走吧，女士们。跟上。

original: I'm headed over to the block to see what's going on.
translation: 我被派到这街区来了解发生了什么。

original: Well, they haven't killed each other yet. Always a plus.
translation: 他们还没自相残杀，能做到这点难能可贵。

original: C'mon. Time to check on the stock.
translation: 来吧。该核查现货了。

original: Alright, I've had enough. Let's do something else.
translation: 好吧，够了。去做其他事。

original: I'm heading to the deck. I need some air. Ladies, follow me.
translation: 我要到甲板上。我需要些新鲜空气。女士们，跟着我。

original: Let's go up top. I want to see what these fools are up to.
translation: 到上面去。我想看看这些家伙是否合乎标准。

original: Everyone calls me Zip, and I think that's because I'm always wearing pants, and those have zippers, but it's not like I'm the only one with pants.
translation: 所有人都叫我拉链，我想是因为我一直穿裤子，而裤子都有拉链，但好象不是只有我穿裤子。

original: You've done it! My machine is finally full!
translation: 你做到了！我的机器终于装满了！

original: Well, like I promised, here's the schematic for the Nuka Grenade. You've sure earned it!
translation: 嗯，遵照我的承诺，这是核子手雷的设计图。你应得的！

original: If you find any more bottles, be sure and bring them by. I'll be glad to keep paying for them.
translation: 如果你再找到，一定要把它们带来。我会乐于为它们付钱。

original: You've done it! My machine is finally full!
translation: 你做到了！我的机器终于装满了！

original: Well, like I promised, here's your surprise... the schematic for the Nuka Grenade! You've sure earned it!
translation: 好了，遵照我的承诺，这是给你的惊喜……核子手雷的图纸！这是你应得的！

original: If you find any more bottles, be sure and bring them by. I'll be glad to keep paying for them.
translation: 如果你再找到，一定要把它们带来。我会乐于为它们付钱。

original: My machine's almost full you know. That's over 25 bottles of Quantum!
translation: 你看，我的机器快满了。那超过了25瓶量子可乐！

original: Get me to 30 and you'll have the surprise reward I promised! Hehe! I love surprises!
translation: 给我带回30瓶，我承诺我会给你惊喜的报酬！嘿嘿！我爱惊喜！

original: Over twenty bottles already? Incredible! Keep 'em coming!
translation: 已经超过20瓶了？难以置信！继续努力！

original: Oh my word! Do you realize you've brought me back over ten of the Nuka-Cola Quantums?
translation: 我的天！你意识到你给我带回了十多瓶核子可乐量子版吗？

original: I knew you were the right person for the job.
translation: 我知道你适合这工作。

original: Wow. I can't believe you've found over five of the Quantums. I've never even seen that many before. Good job!
translation: 哇。我不敢相信你已经找到了超过5瓶量子可乐。我以前从没见过这么多。干得好！

original: Yay! I knew I could count on you! I promise to put them to good use.
translation: 耶！我知道我可以信任你！我保证会好好利用它们。

original: Well, this should be enough to fill that stupid machine of hers. Thanks for all your help, but our transaction is done.
translation: 嗯，这应该能塞满她那蠢机器。谢谢你的大力帮助，但我们的交易完成了。

original: I'll take any extras off your hands for now, but then I'm done with these disgusting drinks. They taste horrible!
translation: 我会处理剩下的事，但我得搞定这些恶心的饮料。它们太难喝了！

original: Now to put the moves on my lady. Come and watch an expert at work.
translation: 现在该对我的女士采取行动了。等着瞧好戏吧。

original: Won't be long before I'm ready to spring my surprise on Sierra. She's gonna give it up for me for certain for this. Heck, she'd better!
translation: 不用多久，我准备给塞拉一个惊喜。她肯定会为了我而放弃它。见鬼，她最好那么做！

original: I'm glad you're seeing things my way. Nice job.
translation: 很高兴你能理解我的想法。干得好。

original: More, huh? Good. This will make Sierra very happy.
translation: 更多，呃？好的。这会让塞拉非常高兴。

original: Keep the bottles coming, I'll keep the caps flowing.
translation: 继续努力，我会继续付瓶盖。

original: This facility is a stunning accomplishment by the creative minds at the Nuka-Cola Corporation.
translation: 这工厂是核子可乐公司创新性思维的惊人成就。

original: We use cutting edge equipment to keep the world's most popular soft drink in full production 24 hours a day.
translation: 我们采用最尖端设备，确保这款世界上最受欢迎的软饮料能够24小时不间断生产。

original: This unit prides itself on over 457 days without a single death or major limb loss of any personnel.
translation: 本工厂自豪地宣布，已超过457天未发生任何人员伤亡或重大肢体损伤事故。

original: This product is the pinnacle of taste sensation.
translation: 这款产品是味觉的极致。

original: Seventeen fruit flavors and that signature cola taste blend to form the perfect refreshing soft drink.
translation: 十七种水果风味与独特的可乐口感完美融合，打造出极致清爽的软饮料。

original: With its new Strontium additive, its got that unique kick to keep you on your toes.
translation: 加入全新锶添加剂后，它带来了一种独特的刺激感，让你精神振奋。

original: In fact, I do! Ha! Surprised you didn't I?
translation: 事实上，我有！哈！意不意外？

original: Your best bet would be to find the ruins of the D.C. Nuka-Cola Bottling Facility. Find the shipping manifests inside.
translation: 你最好的选择是找到特区核子可乐灌装工厂的废墟。找到里面的货运清单。

original: With them in hand, you should have a good clue as to where the Quantum was delivered.
translation: 有它们在手，你就知道量子可乐被发往哪了。

original: While you're there, you may even be able to find some bottles of Quantum!
translation: 你到那里时，兴许还能找到几瓶量子可乐！

original: Oh, what happened to you, dear?
translation: 哦，你怎么了，亲爱的？

original: Poor kid, just be careful from now on, okay?
translation: 可怜的孩子，以后小心，好吗？

original: Come here, I'll make it all better.
translation: 来这，我会让它好转的。

original: Oh, I found a lucky bullet this morning!
translation: 哦，今早我找到一枚幸运子弹！

original: It's just a measly old 10 mil, but I know for sure it's lucky, 'cause it was sitting there all alone out of its clip and not fired off. Want it?
translation: 虽然只有区区的旧10密耳，但我可以肯定它很幸运，因为它一直孤零零地放在弹夹外，没有发射过。想要吗？

original: I got an old mag full of 5.56s! Is that good enough for you?
translation: 我得到一个装满5.56子弹的旧弹夹！够你用了吧？

original: Last time I was out looking, I found some of this mutfruit. It's not as sweet as Nuka, but maybe you mungos like that sort of thing?
translation: 我上一次出去侦查，找到些这种变异果。它没有核子可乐那么甜，不过可能你们毛人喜欢这类东西？

original: Well, I've got these pills that say "Mentats", but Lucy says they taste yucky and that I shouldn't take them. Maybe you want them?
translation: 嗯，我拿到的这些药片写着“曼他特”，但露西说它们尝起来很恶心，而且我不该拿它们。或许你想要？

original: Well, I didn't want to trade it, but I've got a stimpak Lucy said I'm supposed to carry around with me. Is it worth a Nuka?
translation: 嗯，一开始我本不打算拿来交换的，但是我有一个治疗针，露西劝我应该留着它的。你说这东西值不值一瓶核子可乐呢？

original: Oh, check this out, it's my most, most prized possession I found! Squirrel says it's a micro fusion cell. Is it worth a Nuka?
translation: 哦，看看，这是我发现的最最有价值的东西了！“松鼠”说这是微型核聚变电池。这值不值一瓶核子可乐呢？

original: Yeah, and I got lots to trade. But if you got no Nuka, you're not getting nothing, no way!
translation: 唔，我有很多东西，如果你没有核子可乐，那么你什么也得不到，绝对！

original: Yeah, more Nuka's always good! It's definitely always gooder than less, because no Nuka's no good at all! Got any Nuka for me?
translation: 唔，多多益善！有就好，没就坏！还有核子可乐给我吗？

original: I'll trade you whatever I've got for more Nuka-Cola! Anytime! Nuka 4 Zip! Nuka 4 Zip!
translation: 我会用我手上的任何东西来换核子可乐的！任何时候！核子可乐给拉链！核子可乐给拉链！

original: That's all I got right now. Come back tomorrow, maybe I'll have more, and you can have more Nuka for me to have more Nuka? Yeah?
translation: 这就是我有的全部了。你明天再来，或许我会有更多，或许你会有更多的核子可乐给我，而我就会有更多的核子可乐？对吧？

original: I did yesterday, I am today, and I probably will be tomorrow! Well, unless I die from too much Nuka. But that can't happen. Everyone knows that!
translation: 昨天是，今天是，估计明天也是！嗯，除非我死于核子可乐。但那是不可能发生的，所有人都知道！

original: Stand down, squishy. Present your ID on the double.
translation: 站住，脓包。出示你的证件。

original: ID accepted. Resume your duties.
translation: 身份确认。回到岗位。

original: Halt, intruder! Unauthorized personnel will be handled with extreme violence.
translation: 站定，入侵者！未经授权的人员将会给予极端暴力处罚。

original: Initiating Combat Protocol: Charlie Zulu 4.
translation: 战斗程序初始化：笨蛋祖鲁4。

original: Yeah, lemme see what you have.
translation: 好的，让我看看你有些什么。

original: I tell you, for a bunch of dumbass wasters, the boys pull some good stuff off of the new meat.
translation: 我告诉你，对于一个从废土来的女人，那些男孩总是充满兴趣。

original: Money first, then you'll get the goods.
translation: 先给钱，后给货。

original: Are you kidding me? You've never heard of Paradise Falls? Oh, right. The suit. You're right out of the vault, aren't you? Great.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？你没听说过天堂瀑？哦，对了，那套装，你是从避难所来的，对吧？好极了。

original: Shit, you're lucky you're not up there in the pens, dumbass. I can't believe you. Anyway, Paradise Falls is home to the Slavers.
translation: 妈的，你该庆幸自己没被关在那栅栏里，傻瓜。真不敢相信你。总之，堕落天堂是奴隶贩子的家。

original: Up there, we sell the slaves that we capture out in the Wastes. So, unless you're either buying or selling, piss off.
translation: 在那上面，我们贩卖从废土抓来的奴隶。所以如果你不是来做买卖，就给我滚。

original: You think I didn't know that? I've been hiding in this place for days!
translation: 你以为我不知道吗？我已经在这里躲了好几天了！

original: There's an old portashelter next to the diner near my house. Those stupid things will never get me in there.
translation: 在我家附近的餐厅旁有一个旧庇护所。在那儿那些蠢东西绝对抓不到我。

original: I'll head over there and wait inside. Hurry back!
translation: 我会躲在那里面。快点回来！

original: In fifteen feet, make a right turn.
translation: 在15英尺的地方，向右转。

original: The left path is the right path, if you get my meaning.
translation: 向左转是正确的路，你明白我的意思了吧。

original: You'll never get here at this rate...
translation: 照这速度，你是回不来的……

original: Keep it up. You're almost here.
translation: 继续，你就快到了。

original: Remote link activated. Scan complete. Thank you.
translation: 远端连接启动。扫描结束。非常感谢。

original: Im sorry, but I could not scan your Pip Boy. Please stand by for additional scan.
translation: 抱歉，但我无法扫描你的哔哔小子。请准备再次接受扫描。

original: No valid Pip-Boy detected. Please surrender for further scanning.
translation: 没有发现有效的哔哔小子。请交出，以便进一步扫描。

original: Remote start activated, loading Vault protocols. Please hold.
translation: 远程启动已激活，正在加载避难所协议。请稍候。

original: Hostile resident detected. Prepare to be subdued.
translation: 发现敌对居民。准备应对策略。

original: Stand back citizens. It is my goal to reduce collateral damage.
translation: 请退后，公民。我的目的是减少连带损伤。

original: The Overseer asks that you vacate the area while this scuffle is brought under control.
translation: 监督者要求你在恢复秩序时离开这里。

original: Scan accepted. Move along.
translation: 扫描通过。继续前进。

original: Yes, sir.
translation: 是的，长官。

original: Mr. President, I'm sorry to bother you. This is Lieutenant Williams. I have an unauthorized individual here who's supposed to speak with you.
translation: 总统先生，很抱歉打扰你。这是威廉中尉，我这有个未经授权就想要和你说话的人。

original: What? No one sees the President except Colonel Autumn.
translation: 什么？除了奥特姆上校没人可以去见总统。

original: Stand right there while I check this out.
translation: 你站在那别动，我先询问一下。

original: Receiving Sewer Maintenance Routine. Please Hold. Link Terminated.
translation: 接收下水道常规维护。请稍等。连接终断。

original: Critter of unusual size detected. Running Program: Extermination.
translation: 发现异常体型的生物。运行程序：消灭。

original: The immediate area has been quarantined. Please exit swiftly.
translation: 周边区域已经被隔离。请立刻离开。

original: We apologize for the inconvenience. Disregard the mess.
translation: 我们对不便之处感到抱歉。请忽视混乱。

original: Greetings fellow office employee. Please present your valid ID.
translation: 你好，办公室职员。请出示合法的身份证明。

original: Scanning for office ID... ID accepted. Have a nice day.
translation: 扫描办公室身份证明……身份确认。祝你过得愉快。

original: Running default office protocol... ERROR. Loading daily agenda... ERROR.
translation: 运行默认办公室协议……失败。装载日常议程……失败。

original: Security breach detected. Please stand back.
translation: 检测到安全漏洞。请退后。

original: Please vacate the area in an orderly fashion. Work will resume in 3.756 minutes.
translation: 请按序地撤离这个区域。工作将在3.756分后恢复。

original: Sorry for the ruckus. Please vacate the immediate area.
translation: 对于骚动很抱歉，请撤离相关区域。

original: I'm sorry. The name's Reilly. Yeah, THE Reilly as in Reilly's Rangers.
translation: 我很抱歉。我的名字叫莱莉。嗯，莱莉的游骑兵里的莱莉。

original: If time wasn't so precious right now, I wouldn't be so on edge either. I need to get help for the rest of the Rangers, and fast.
translation: 如果不是时间宝贵，我也不会这么着急。我要为剩下的游骑兵寻求帮助，而且要快。

original: It takes a big man to apologize... I respect that.
translation: 只有大人物才懂得适时道歉……我尊重这点。

original: If time wasn't so precious right now, I wouldn't be so on edge either. I need to get help for the rest of the Rangers, and fast.
translation: 如果不是时间宝贵，我也不会这么着急。我要为剩下的游骑兵寻求帮助，而且要快。

original: I guess you're okay after all, mungo.
translation: 我想你可以了，毛人。

original: You can come in, but you better not piss me off.
translation: 你可以进来，但你最好不要惹我生气。

original: I, uhh... I have somewhere else to be.
translation: 我，呃……我还有些别的事想做。

original: Lieutenant Williams. I'm ordering you to stand down at once.
translation: 我是威廉中尉。我命令你立刻站住。

original: Yeah, fine, just remember next time, okay?
translation: 嗯，好吧，下次别忘了，好吗？

original: Yes, sir!
translation: 是，长官！

original: He's not your uncle, Bumble!
translation: 他不是你叔叔，小咕嘟！

original: Here's food, Princess.
translation: 给你食物，公主。

original: Here, happy?
translation: 给，开心了？

original: Override activated. New Protocol acquired. Updating target list.
translation: 撤销程序，获得新协议。更新目标清单。

original: Security Lockdown in effect. Hostile Target acquired.
translation: 安全封锁生效。敌对目标已捕获。

original: As long as you don't mind cooking it yourself.
translation: 只要你不介意自己烹饪。

original: Sure. You may want to grill it up sooner rather than later, if you know what I mean.
translation: 当然。如果你明白我的意思，你或许该尽快把烧烤架子搭起来。

original: As long as you aren't a vegetarian.
translation: 只要你不是个素食主义者。

original: Yeah. Of course. With Megaton gone, it's hard to make an honest living these days.
translation: 嗯。当然了。如果没有兆吨镇，想诚实地过活是很难的。

original: Ah, got a taste for it, now, do you?
translation: 啊，你想尝一尝吗？

original: Take a look. It's always fresh.
translation: 看看，都是新鲜的。

original: What's mine is yours, friend.
translation: 我的就是你的，朋友。

original: Well, this is rather embarrassing so you'll have to forgive me, but it appears that I've made a slight miscalculation in my mutagen samples.
translation: 嗯，这有点尴尬，请原谅我，但看来我在诱变剂样本的计算上出了点差错。

original: Instead of lowering the size of the ants, the brood hatched and developed a new biomechanism.
translation: 蚂蚁的体型并没有缩小，相反新孵化出来的蚂蚁产生了基因突变。

original: I call their genetic aberration pyrosis; the ability to emit flame from their bodies.
translation: 我把这基因突变叫做“胃灼热”：一种可以从体内喷出火焰的能力。

original: I may be able to correct this error, but I can't get near my equipment.
translation: 我或许能纠正这错误，但我没办法接近我的设备。

original: Well, yes. I suppose I am.
translation: 嗯，是的，我想我是。

original: Doctor Weston Lesko's my name and it's good to make your acquaintance. What brings you to my little experimental ecosystem?
translation: 我是莱斯科·韦斯顿博士，很高兴认识你。是什么风把你吹到我这小小的生态实验室里来的？

original: Override granted. User access allowed.
translation: 允许覆写。允许用户访问。

original: Special needs students must be chaperoned at all times. Allow me to escort you back to class, child.
translation: 特需学生必须受到全天候陪伴。请允许我护送你返回教室，孩子。

original: Intruder on campus! Students, remain in your classrooms.
translation: 校园出现入侵者！学生们，留在你们的教室里。

original: Ten demerits! Back to class with you, rapscallion!
translation: 扣10分！回到教室里去，流氓！

original: And when the time comes, you'll grow up and leave Lamplight and meet me in Big Town, too. It won't be that long, I promise.
translation: 而且到你长大时，也可以离开小灯镇去大镇找我。不会太久的，我保证。

original: And when I grow up, I can come join you there, too!
translation: 而且到我长大时，也可以去那找你！

original: The good people of this country cannot regain control while mutation runs rampant through our land.
translation: 只要突变体还在我们的大地上肆虐，这个国家的好人民们就无法掌控事态。

original: My soldiers cannot stem the tide, nor can the cult you've come into contact with, this Brotherhood of Steel.
translation: 我的士兵无法阻止事态恶化，你接触到的邪教组织，钢铁兄弟会也一样无法阻止。

original: Mutations like the "Super Mutants" and Ghouls must be purged from our society, our world, before we can proceed anew.
translation: 在我们重建世界前，必须从我们的社会里净化“超级变种人”和尸鬼这类突变体。

original: Where others have failed, I believe your father's work can succeed.
translation: 其他人都失败了，但我相信你父亲的工作能成。

original: I dunno... I kinda' don't like it in here. Gonna be really lonely.
translation: 我不知道……我有点不喜欢这里。会很孤单的。

original: I guess this is goodbye then. Come back and visit me.
translation: 我想这就是告别了。记得回来看我。

original: Really? You mean it!?
translation: 真的？你是认真的！？

original: Oh boy! Thank you so much! I'll wait in my old house for you to come back... I need to bury my pappa anyway.
translation: 天呐！太感谢你了！我会在我的老房子里等你回来……我还要埋了我爸爸。

original: Just don't forget about me!
translation: 别忘了我就行！

original: Really? You mean it!?
translation: 真的？你是认真的！？

original: Oh boy! Thank you so much! I'll wait in my old house for you to come back.
translation: 哦，天啊！太感谢你了！我会在我的老房子里等你回来。

original: Just don't forget about me!
translation: 别忘了我就行！

original: Good. Here's your caps. Pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 好的。这是你的瓶盖。和你做生意真愉快。

original: Now all you gotta do is put this collar on him and tell him to run his ass on over here. We'll do the rest.
translation: 现在你要做的就是给他带上项圈，告诉他滚到这来。剩下的我们会处理。

original: You drive a hard bargain, but it's still well worth it.
translation: 你的要价的真高，不过这也是值得的。

original: Here you go. Now all you gotta do is put this collar on him and tell him to run his ass on over here. We'll do the rest.
translation: 给你。现在你要做的就是给他带上项圈，告诉他滚到这来。剩下的我们会处理。

original: All right, all right. He'll fetch a good price in the long run.
translation: 好吧，好吧。从长远来看，他会卖个好价钱的。

original: Here you go. Now all you gotta do is put this collar on him and tell him to run his ass on over here. We'll do the rest.
translation: 给你。现在你要做的就是给他带上项圈，告诉他滚到这来。剩下的我们会处理。

original: Thank you. I'll see to it that it's disposed of properly, once the Scribes have had time to analyze it.
translation: 谢谢你了。我会尽快妥善处理它的。

original: Perhaps we have underestimated the Enclave. Sarah may be right; an attack may be necessary now.
translation: 也许我们低估了英克雷。莎拉或许是对的：现在看来，一次进攻势在必行。

original: You've done the right thing. I'll turn this over to the Scribes for analysis.
translation: 你做得对。我会把它交给学士分析的。

original: We need to decide on a plan of action...
translation: 我们需要制定一个行动计划……

original: You are either very lucky, or very resourceful. You're the first I've heard to come out of there alive.
translation: 你要么非常幸运，要么非常机智。你是我听过的第一个从那活着出来的。

original: It's good to have you back, but I wish you had brought better news. We need to revise our strategy...
translation: 你能回来真好，但我希望你带来更好的消息。我们需要修正部署……

original: You were? And yet you stand here before me. I find this hard to believe.
translation: 真的？你现在就站在我面前。我难以相信。

original: What has happened?
translation: 发生了什么？

original: Really... Do go on.
translation: 真的……那继续吧。

original: Authorized ticketholders, please proceed to the main platform.
translation: 持票者验证通过，请进入站台。

original: Scanning for valid ticket... verified. Thank you for riding with Metro.
translation: 扫描车票有效性……核实。欢迎乘坐地铁。

original: Thanks! Nuka for me!
translation: 谢谢你给我核子可乐！

original: Hooray! I win the Nuka-Cola game! What's the prize? Nuka-Cola!
translation: 万岁！我赢得了核子可乐游戏！奖品是什么？核子可乐！

original: Yay! Nuka-Cola, Nuka-Cola, makes a stomach bubbly and the world so jumbly, yay!
translation: 耶！核子可乐，核子可乐，让胃里起泡，让世界混乱，耶！

original: There... there used to be another guard. She was named Caps.
translation: 这……这曾经还有另一个守卫。她叫“帽子”。

original: She used to take care of me. She liked my company guarding. She liked it when I used to tell jokes.
translation: 她以前照顾着我。她喜欢和我一起守门。她很喜欢听我说笑话。

original: Then, some Raiders attacked. And I was the only guard left.
translation: 后来，一些掠夺者袭击了这。而我成了唯一剩下的守卫。

original: We don't use it much. We don't let many visitors in, and the scav teams usually use crawlspace exits to the surface, so they can't be followed.
translation: 我们不常使用它。我们不让很多访客进入，而拾荒队通常从缝隙出口到地表去，因为这样他们不会被人尾随。

original: The only times this gate opens is when we've got big cargo to bring in or if we're letting in a mungo. Neither happens often.
translation: 只有在大型货物进入或允许毛人进入时才会打开大门。但都很少发生。

original: We usually use crawlspaces so mungos can't follow. This gate doesn't get used much, except letting in big cargo or mungos. Both are rare.
translation: 我们通常经由缝隙出入，所以毛人无法尾随。大门不常使用，除了让大型货物进入或允许毛人进入。但都很罕见。

original: We used to have two guards here, but we can make do with one, as long as I'm vigilant. We don't have much choice.
translation: 以前这里都有两个守卫，但只要我保持足够警惕，我一个就够了。我们没有太多选择。

original: Until the water purifier is secured, I am not going to risk the stability of the Enclave by countermanding a direct order from their superior.
translation: 在水源净化器确保安全前，我不会撤销他们上级的直接命令来威胁英克雷的稳定。

original: Likewise, I cannot request that Colonel Autumn issue new orders without alerting him to our little plan.
translation: 同样，我也不能要求奥特姆上校发布新命令，而不让他知道我们的小计划。

original: So, we'll just have to make do with what we have.
translation: 所以，我们只能将就了。

original: Yeah, yeah. I'm fine, Red. Super fine. Super duper fine. That Wastelander saved me!
translation: 嗯，嗯。我很好，瑞德。超好。超得隆咚好。那个废土游民救了我！

original: Fine. Fine. I'm all... fine. Super fine.
translation: 好的。好的。我很……好。超好。

original: Yeah, so did I! You ever think about helping me! Huh!? Asshole!
translation: 嗯，我也是！你有想过要帮助我吗！呃！？混蛋！

original: I'm having a great time, here, Timebomb. But is everyone always this glum?
translation: 我在这过得很愉快，“定时炸弹”。但每个人都是这么忧郁吗？

original: Great, Red. Hey, can I stop by the clinic later? I wanted your help picking my new nickname. You know, for Big Town.
translation: 好极了，瑞德。嗨，我迟点可以去诊所吗？我想让你帮我取个绰号。你知道的，为了大镇。

original: Come on, Flash. I'm not a little kid anymore. You can stop calling me Sticky.
translation: 拜托，福莱斯。我不再是小孩了。别再叫我斯蒂奇。

original: Aww, quit it. I'm not a kid anymore! Call me by my real name, would ya?
translation: 啊，去死。我不再是小孩了！叫我原名，行吗？

original: Well, you could help ME by resetting the barricades.
translation: 嗯，你可以帮我来重设防御工事。

original: The alignments are all wrong, the walls are too short, and you're stupid-looking.
translation: 凹凸不平，墙也太矮，而且你们一副蠢样。

original: Why? Because I'm short? Who are you calling short!?
translation: 为什么？因为我矮？你在叫谁矮子！？

original: Little? Who you calling little! I was running this town long before you guys showed up!
translation: 小子？你在叫谁小子！在你们这些家伙来之前，我就已经运作这镇子很久了！

original: That sounds fine, Timebomb. Just take it easy when I bring out the surgical tools. I've never heard anyone scream that loud before.
translation: 听起来不错，“定时炸弹”。不过我拿出外科工具后，你要保持冷静。我从未听过有人叫得这么大声。

original: Not right now, Sticky. I'm a little busy. Can we talk later?
translation: 现在不行，斯蒂奇。我有点忙。我们能迟点再说吗？

original: I'm not sure everyone would agree with you, Shorty. And besides, don't you think the barricades are high enough for you?
translation: 我不认为每个人都同意你，“矮子”。此外，你不认为这些防御工事对你来说足够高了吗？

original: No thanks, Kimba. Could you check in on Pappy, though? He's about as happy as a dead Brahmin lately.
translation: 不了，谢谢你，金巴。你能去看看帕匹吗？他最近总是开心得像只死双头牛。

original: Pappy, I told you last time and the time before that. It's a scratch. You're not going to die.
translation: 帕匹，我之前告诉你很多次了。这只是擦伤。你不会死的。

original: That takes forever, Shorty. Several hours at least.
translation: 总是没完，“矮子”。至少几个小时。

original: I swear it's infected, Red. I think you might need to amputate.
translation: 我发誓伤口已经感染了，瑞德。我认为你需要截肢。

original: Do you know how to use it?
translation: 你知道怎么使用它吗？

original: Everyone eventually finds their place in town, Sticky. Don't worry about it.
translation: 每个人最后都能镇里找到自己的位置，斯蒂奇。不必为此担心。

original: Shorty, you were never mayor, remember? The other kids would just pick you up and throw you.
translation: “矮子”，你从来也不是镇长，记得吗？其他孩子会把你丢在一旁。

original: That's great, Flash. Amazing how you could do that with only 10 bullets.
translation: 好极了，福莱斯。想不到你只用了10发子弹就做到了。

original: Hey, Pappy.
translation: 嗨，帕匹。

original: A one-half mile radius? What does that even mean?
translation: 半径1.5英里？那到底是什么意思？

original: Maybe they'll be scared off by your makeup first.
translation: 或许他们会先被你的化妆吓跑。

original: Me and my new gun haven't seen anything, Pappy.
translation: 我和我的新枪没见到任何东西，帕匹。

original: Eh. You people and your demands. "Pay attention on patrol. Set up the barricades. Stop sleeping during your patrol!"
translation: 嗯。你的人和你的要求。“巡逻时保持警惕。修好防御工事。别在巡逻时睡觉！”

original: You better get started then. Hurry up! I don't like to wait.
translation: 你最好立刻开始。赶快！我不喜欢等待。

original: What are you implying?
translation: 你在暗示什么？

original: Oh, some other time Sticky. I have plans tonight. How about tomorrow?
translation: 哦，改天吧，斯蒂奇。我今晚有事。明天怎么样？

original: The barricades should be fine, for now.
translation: 防御工事现在看上去很好。

original: You don't seem to understand. This gun is bad-ass. Yeah!
translation: 看起来你没明白，枪是个坏家伙。耶！

original: Well, I still think it looks pretty bad.
translation: 嗯，看上去还是很糟。

original: Stupid looking? What’s that got to do with it? And who are you to say that the walls are too short... Shorty?
translation: 我们一副蠢样？这是什么意思？你有什么资格说墙太矮……“矮子”？

original: That’s funny, I thought we were an autonomous collective.
translation: 那真有趣，我一直以为我们是集体自治。

original: Oh, that? Come on Red, Pappy's never been happy.
translation: 这个啊？得了吧，瑞德。帕匹从未高兴过。

original: Ah, but that sounds boring! I know -- think of something cooler, and I'll come back later.
translation: 啊，但这听起来很无聊！我知道 -- 想点更酷的，我迟点再来。

original: You're damn right you do! 'Cause I'm the only one who can really keep this town safe.
translation: 你他妈的说对了！因为我是唯一能确保这镇子安全的人。

original: Well, Pappy, when the arm falls off and you're rolling on the ground in agony, I'll come take a look at it.
translation: 帕匹，要是这胳膊掉了，而你痛得在地上打滚，我就会来看看。

original: That just means they're getting ready. They'll come for us, I know it.
translation: 那就意味着他们正在准备。他们会来找我们，我知道的。

original: I don't know, Pappy. I just don't know.
translation: 我不知道，帕匹。我真不知道。

original: Whoa, whoa. Calm down. Never mind.
translation: 哇，哇，冷静。别介意。

original: Only your complete and utter lack of importance.
translation: 你才无关紧要呢。

original: Jerk. I'm glad we broke up.
translation: 蠢货。我很高兴我们分手了。

original: Ha! I think I will. And that is why you are the best boy a Slaver could ever ask for.
translation: 哈！我想我会。那就是你能成为奴隶贩子最棒的儿子的原因。

original: What is it, my boy?
translation: 怎么了，我的孩子？

original: I swear, boy, you are going to be the greatest Slaver that ever lived!
translation: 我发誓，孩子，你会成为最伟大的奴隶贩子！

original: It's just that if you're bored all the time, you're not appreciating how good we have it.
translation: 如果你一直都很无聊，是不会感受到我们所拥有的是多么美好。

original: That's more like it! Show some initiative, dammit, before I sell you off and give one of those fools in the cage your job!
translation: 这才像话！在我贱价卖你笼里那些家伙前，该死，表现得积极点！

original: Forty, if you were any dumber, I'd make a signpost out of you.
translation: 弗替，如果你是个笨蛋，我给你做个标牌怎样。

original: Okay, okay. I'm sorry...
translation: 好的，好的，我道歉……

original: Yes, daddy. I'm sorry, daddy.
translation: 是的，爸爸。对不起，爸爸。

original: Yes, sir. Sorry, sir.
translation: 是，先生。对不起，先生。

original: Nah. I know you run your shit straight. Keep up the good work.
translation: 不。我知道你做人很正经。做好你的工作。

original: Ahh, doc. You keep us walking around and making money. That's why we keep you around.
translation: 啊，医生。你总是能让我们赚到钱。这就是为什么我们需要你。

original: Keep running your mouth, Crimson. That's why he don't like you no more.
translation: 说个不停，奎默森。那就是为什么他不再喜欢你。

original: Hrmph. It's not my fault that I'm the favorite. You don't need to be so bitter.
translation: 哼。我受欢迎又不是我的错。你不必这么耿耿于怀。

original: Why do you always have to try to prove something to me? Do you think I care who Eulogy likes better? Seriously?
translation: 为什么你总是想向我证明一些事？你认为我会在乎尤勒基更喜欢谁吗？你是认真的？

original: Clover, I will smack the shit out of you. Can't you just shut up and leave me alone?
translation: 可萝尔，我会揍你一顿的。你就不能闭上嘴离我远点吗？

original: <sigh> I'm sorry.
translation: <叹息> 对不起。

original: <grumble> Sorry, Eulogy.
translation: <嘟囔> 对不起，尤勒基。

original: Please forgive me, daddy. It won't happen again, just tell me what you need. Anything! I'll do anything!
translation: 请原谅我，爸爸。不会再发生了，你只要告诉我你想要怎样。怎样都行！我什么都肯做！

original: I'm sorry! I'm so sorry! Let me make it up to you! Tell me what you want!
translation: 对不起！对不起！我会补偿！告诉我你想要怎样！

original: Why do you have to be like that? I'm just trying to talk to you and you have to come at me with that shit?
translation: 你为什么要那样做？我只想跟你谈谈，难道你一定要伤我的自尊？

original: Wha... bitch, you're lucky Eulogy protects your ass, or I'd leave you bleeding in the street.
translation: 什……婊子，你很幸运有尤勒基保护，否则我会让你在街上流血。

original: See? This is what I mean. But you know what they say about mean women? Sooner or later, someone will accidentally shoot them while on a mission.
translation: 看？这就是我的意思。但你知道他们怎么说刻薄的女人？迟早会有人在任务中意外地射中他们。

original: Why are you always so mean? All I ever am is nice to you, but it's always "Ymir go away, you smell" or "Ymir, get me a drink and then go away".
translation: 你为什么总是这么刻薄？我一直对你很友好，但总是“伊米尔，滚开，你很臭”或“伊米尔，给我酒然后滚开”。

original: Good, Bronson. Don't let me down.
translation: 好的，布朗森。别让我失望。

original: Alright, Bronson. No screw ups this time, got it?
translation: 好的，布朗森。这次别搞砸了，懂了吗？

original: I've been alive far too long to let some crazy plan get my head blown off. It ain't a bad life, you know. One you get used to it.
translation: 我已经活得太久了，不想因为疯狂的计划而掉脑袋。这的生活不坏，你知道的。适应就好。

original: Well, look... don't answer me now, just keep it in mind. If you find some and you've had a change of heart, I'll still buy 'em.
translation: 嗯，听着……现在不用回答我，你只要记得。如果你找到并改变了主意，我仍然会买下它们。

original: Oh, and I wouldn't bother running back to Sierra and warning her. She won't even understand what you're talking about.
translation: 哦，我不会跑回塞拉那警告她。她甚至没明白你在说什么。

original: She may be a hottie, but she's a bit vacant in the smarts department.
translation: 她或许很火辣，但她的脑子里一片空白。

original: Thought you might. Good. I'll see you soon then.
translation: 你可能会的。好的。我很快就会再见到你。

original: All right, suit yourself.
translation: 好吧，随你便。

original: I was going to make you an offer that could earn you some caps, but if you don't have the time to listen...
translation: 我本有个能让你赚些盖子的提议，但如果你没空听的话……

original: You do! You darling!
translation: 你真好！你真贴心！

original: Well, as always, I'll be glad to take them off your hands. And now that my machine is full I can drink these to my heart's desire!
translation: 嗯，一如往常，我很想买下它们。而我的机器会装得满满的，够我喝好久！

original: Goodie! I was hoping you'd bring me more!
translation: 好！我一直期望你会带给我更多！

original: Keep it up, there's probably plenty more out there.
translation: 继续努力，外面大概还有更多。

original: I was just wondering when I'd see you again, and poof, here you are!
translation: 就在我想什么时候能再见到你的时候，你出现在了我面前！

original: Ohhhh sweet Quantum, come to mama!
translation: 哦，宝贝量子可乐，到妈妈这来！

original: I'm amazed you're finding so many more bottles of Quantum out there. Imagine that.
translation: 我能惊讶你能在外面找到这么多瓶量子可乐。难以置信。

original: Well, don't give up looking. Keep finding more and bringing it to me.
translation: 嗯，不要放弃寻找。继续努力，找更多给我。

original: Not bad, man. Not bad at all.
translation: 不错，哥们。很不错。

original: Swell.
translation: 漂亮。

original: Peachy.
translation: 真棒。

original: Get the fuck away from me, meat.
translation: 他妈的给我滚，肥猪。

original: Hahahaha! Yeah, right.
translation: 哈哈哈哈！嗯，对。

original: Oh, please. Kid, come back after your balls have dropped.
translation: 哦，拜托。小子，等你长大了再来。

original: Hello yourself.
translation: 你好。

original: Keep walkin', boy.
translation: 继续走，男孩。

original: <grunts>
translation: <嘟囔>

original: Hello there, little man.
translation: 你好，小家伙。

original: Hello there, pretty girl.
translation: 你好，小美女。

original: Hey there.
translation: 你好啊。

original: S'up?
translation: 什么事？

original: Hello.
translation: 你好。

original: Hey.
translation: 嗨！

original: All right! I'll tell you! Please, just don't hurt me!
translation: 好吧！我会告诉你的！请不要伤害我！

original: Moriarty keeps a computer terminal in the back. On it, he keeps all of the dirty secrets of Megaton.
translation: 莫里亚蒂在后面有个终端机。里面记录了兆吨镇所有的肮脏秘密。

original: If you can get onto that terminal, I bet he has information on your Dad.
translation: 如果你能进入那终端，我打赌肯定有你父亲的讯息。

original: Now, get away from me, smoothskin. If Moriarty even suspects I told you this, I'm a dead Ghoul.
translation: 现在，离我远点，光皮肤。如果让莫里亚蒂知道是我告诉了你这些，我就是死尸鬼了。

original: Moriarty is your best bet. I wish you luck. Now, I have to get back to work, or I'll be answering to him too.
translation: 能回答你的只能是莫里亚蒂了吧。祝你好运。现在，我要回去工作了，否则我就得去回答他了。

original: I was like you once. I wandered into town looking for an escape from this stupid joke of a body I'm trapped in. Now look at me.
translation: 我曾跟你一样。想要进入镇子，找到一个让这身体不受歧视的世外桃源。现在你看到我怎样了。

original: Very well. Moriarty keeps a computer terminal in the back. On it, he keeps all of the goings on in Megaton.
translation: 好吧，莫里亚蒂在后面有个终端。里面记录了兆吨镇所有发生过的事情。

original: If you can get onto that terminal, I bet he has information on your Dad.
translation: 如果你能进入那台终端，我打赌你肯定有你父亲的讯息。

original: Now, get away from me, smoothskin. If Moriarty even suspects I told you this, I'm a dead Ghoul.
translation: 现在，离我远点，光皮肤。如果让莫里亚蒂知道是我告诉了你这些，我就是死尸鬼了。

original: Look, smoothskin. I've told you all I dare. Moriarty doesn't like me chatting with the customers like this.
translation: 听着，光皮肤。我把我能说的都告诉你了。莫里亚蒂不喜欢我和客人这么交谈。

original: If he even thought I was talking to you, he'd tan my hide!
translation: 如果他光是以为我和你聊过，他都会扒掉我的皮！

original: Let me get back to work now before he sees us.
translation: 在他发现我们前，我得回去工作。

original: Sigh. That's his way. Always putting caps before people's lives.
translation: 唉。那就是他的方式。钱总摆在命前面。

original: I wish someone would stand up to him one day. Oh my... I shouldn't be saying all of this!
translation: 我希望有人能出来收拾他。哦，天啊……我不该说这些！

original: I'm sorry, I really must get back to work. I can't get involved. I'm so sorry.
translation: 对不起，我真的必须去工作了，我不想被牵连。对不起。

original: Well then, let's make a deal!
translation: 让我们做个交易！

original: Finally! Let's get down to business.
translation: 终于！你开始认真考虑生意了。

original: Feeling a bit nostalgic are we?
translation: 有点怀旧的感觉，对吧？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记着，一旦购买了一个主题，你就不能再把它卖给我，不过你可以随时购买一个新的主题。

original: Still want to live in the past, huh? Well, forget it. Those days are long gone.
translation: 仍然想活在过去，呃？嗯，忘了它吧。那种生活已经一去不复返了。

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记着，一旦购买了一个主题，你就不能再把它卖给我，不过你可以随时购买一个新的主题。

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记着，一旦购买了一个主题，你就不能再把它卖给我，不过你可以随时购买一个新的主题。

original: I complained off hand one day about how I thought that heap of metal on the horizon was a bit of an eyesore. Mister Burke offered to take care of it.
translation: 有一天，我随口抱怨说，我觉得地平线上的那堆金属有点碍眼。伯克先生主动表示要处理这事。

original: Burke is such an agreeable man, isn't he? I don't know how I got along without him. I practically don't have to think about things anymore.
translation: 伯克真是个讨人喜欢的人，不是吗？我都不知道没有他我是怎么过的。我几乎不用考虑任何事。

original: He takes care of everything. I seldom even have to ask. He's a real go-getter, that one. We need more men like him if we're going to rebuild the world.
translation: 他面面俱到。我很少过问他做的事情。他真的非常能干。如果我们想要重建这世界，就需要更多像他那样的人。

original: Why, anything I want, dear boy. Anything I want... Wasteland safari. Very relaxing.
translation: 怎么了，我随心所欲，亲爱的小子。随心所欲……废土狩猎之旅。很放松。

original: Why, anything I want, dear girl. Anything I want... Wasteland safari. Very relaxing.
translation: 怎么了，我随心所欲，亲爱的丫头。随心所欲……废土狩猎之旅。很放松。

original: Paul, it's me. Tina. I heard back from my sister Candace. We couldn't get into a Vault. 101, 87, didn't matter -- all full to capacity.
translation: 保罗，是我。蒂娜。我姐坎达斯给我回话了。我们进不去避难所，101，87，无所谓了——全满人了。

original: But my brother Alex is a soldier and... he sort of stole the pass code for a secure Army bunker. He did it for the family. But they caught him.
translation: 但我哥哥亚历克斯是个军人……他偷到了军队安全地堡的密码。他是为了家人才这么干的，但他被抓了。

original: Before they took him into custody, Alex he sent each of us one number of the four-digit code. That way, we all have to be together to get in.
translation: 在他被羁押前，亚历克斯给我们每人发了四位数密码的一个数。这样，我们必须一起才能进去。

original: He gave me number "5" -- the day of my birth. So I guess what I'm saying is... I'm still leaving. It's been fun. Kind of.
translation: 他给我的数字是“5”——我出生的日子。所以我想我得说……我还是走了。这很有趣。算是吧。

original: Oh, and I'm not pregnant. So no worries.
translation: 对了，我没有怀孕。所以别担心。

original: Jesus! Gimme that thing!
translation: 天啊！把那东西给我！

original: Let's go find this Burke character. You're about to get an education in Wasteland justice.
translation: 让我们去找这个伯克。你会受到废土正义的洗礼。

original: Jesus! Gimme that thing!
translation: 天啊！把那东西给我！

original: Thanks. If Burke steps within a mile of Megaton, he's a dead man.
translation: 谢谢你。如果伯克敢步入兆吨镇一英里以内，他就死定了。

original: Good point. Come with me. You're about to get an education in Wasteland justice.
translation: 说得对。跟我来。你会经历一次废土正义的洗礼。

original: Simms is an idiot. He prides himself on his position as mayor and sheriff of this scrapyard.
translation: 西姆斯是个蠢货。他对作为这垃圾场的镇长和警长而感到骄傲。

original: Five hundred you say? Well... Um... Yes. Yes, I think that can be arranged.
translation: 你说500个？嗯……嗯……可以。可以，我觉得可以考虑。

original: I must admit. I find you... enchanting. Do this for me, and there's no telling how far my gratitude will reach.
translation: 我必须承认。我发现你……很迷人。为我做这事，我的谢意难以言表。

original: Take the Fusion Pulse Charge. Place it into the bomb. Then meet me at Tenpenny Tower. There I will show you what true power is.
translation: 拿着核聚变脉冲炸药，把它装到核弹上。然后到特佩尼大厦来见我。我会展现给你看什么是真正的力量。

original: Let's do it, then!
translation: 那就来吧！

original: I ain't killed a drifter in weeks. This should be fun!
translation: 我都有一星期没杀流浪者了。这真有趣！

original: Well I'll be damned. You're from that vault! Vault 101! Ha ha! I ain't seen one of those jumpsuits in a LONG time!
translation: 我的天啊。你是从避难所来的！101号避难所！哈哈！我很多年没见到你那种工作服了！

original: I heard what my husband wanted you to do. What I propose is an alternative.
translation: 我听到了我丈夫想让你做的事。我有个别的提议。

original: The same person that created the sap also created this Liniment. If you can reach His heart, it will assist in making His influence increase.
translation: 制作那汁液的人，同样也制作这种搽剂。如果你能抵达祂的心脏区，这将有帮祂扩大影响。

original: Instead of centuries, the Wasteland will become green in mere decades! Just imagine how glorious that would be!
translation: 无需数世纪，只要几十年，废土便会遍布绿色的生机！想象下那是多么壮观！

original: I heard what my husband wanted you to do. What I propose is an alternative.
translation: 我听到了我丈夫想让你做的事。我有个别的提议。

original: The same person that created the sap also created this Liniment. If you can reach His heart, it will assist in making His influence increase.
translation: 制作那汁液的人，同样也制作这种搽剂。如果你能抵达祂的心脏区，这将有帮祂扩大影响。

original: Instead of centuries, the Wasteland will become green in mere decades! Just imagine how glorious that would be!
translation: 无需数世纪，只要几十年，废土便会遍布绿色的生机！想象下那是多么壮观！

original: I heard what my husband wanted you to do. What I propose is an alternative.
translation: 我听到了我丈夫想让你做的事。我有个别的提议。

original: The same person that created the sap also created this Liniment. If you can reach His heart, it will assist in making His influence increase.
translation: 制作那汁液的人，同样也制作这种搽剂。如果你能抵达祂的心脏区，这将有帮祂扩大影响。

original: Instead of centuries, the Wasteland will become green in mere decades! Just imagine how glorious that would be!
translation: 无需数世纪，只要几十年，废土便会遍布绿色的生机！想象下那是多么壮观！

original: You misinterpret His words, my friend. He wants you to extinguish that which seeks to make Him vulnerable.
translation: 我的朋友，你误解了祂的话。祂希望你消除那些会让祂受到伤害的因素。

original: If the same sap that you drank to purify yourself could be applied to His heart, it should stop the spread.
translation: 那种你喝了能净化自身的汁液，要是能用到祂的心脏，应该能阻止这种扩散。

original: I can promise you no harm would come to Him. That's all I ask of you, Outsider. Nothing more, nothing less.
translation: 我向你保证，祂不会受到任何伤害。外来者，这就是我对你的全部请求。不多也不少。

original: If the same sap that you drank to purify yourself could be applied to His heart, it should stop the spread.
translation: 那种你喝了能净化自身的汁液，要是能用到祂的心脏，应该能阻止这种扩散。

original: I can promise you no harm would come to Him. That's all I ask of you, Outsider. Nothing more, nothing less.
translation: 我向你保证，祂不会受到任何伤害。外来者，这就是我对你的全部请求。不多也不少。

original: He he! I sure know how to pick 'em!
translation: 呵呵！我真会挑人！

original: You're going to be the best thing that ever happened to Galaxy News in a long time.
translation: 你将要成为银河新闻最棒的长期新闻人物了。

original: If you need any more info, I'll be here waiting for you.
translation: 如果你需要更多讯息，我会在这里等着你。

original: Oh come on. You're a spitting image of the guy. He's been here before, and now you're here. Doesn't take a genius to figure it out.
translation: 哦，拜托。你和他就像是一个模子里刻出来的。你们两人都曾站在这个位置。简直像得令人难以分辨。

original: You want to find your dad, and it just so happens his location is known to yours truly.
translation: 你想找到你的父亲，而碰巧我知道他在哪。

original: But if you want to know more, you're going to have to contribute to the Good Fight.
translation: 但如果你想再打听什么，就得先为正义之战做点贡献。

original: Well, holy shit! Aren't you a chip off the old block? You ARE as smart as your dad.
translation: 见鬼！你们是同一模子里刻出来的吗？你和你爸爸一样聪明。

original: Since you know all about this cause, no need to explain the effect. Let's get you on your way.
translation: 既然你已经很清楚了，也就不必再废话。我告诉你该怎么做。

original: Imagine a picture, okay? A picture of the Capital Wasteland. All that brick and rock. A whole lot of nothing, right?
translation: 设想一副画面，好吗？首都废土的画面。饿殍遍野，满目疮痍，对吧？

original: There's people out there trying to just barely make it from day to day. Fighting to stay alive and make something out of what they got.
translation: 那里的人们勉强度日。为了活命而奋斗，为了有所作为而奋斗。

original: But then you've got all kinds of shit... Slavers, Super Mutants, Raiders... They all want a slice of the pie too and aim to take it by force.
translation: 然后你又遇到了各种渣滓……奴隶贩子、超级变种人，掠夺者……他们也都想分一杯羹，都想用武力夺取这块蛋糕。

original: Oh, sure. I mean, if you're going to be my assistant, it's in my best interest that you stay alive, right?
translation: 哦，当然。我的意思是，如果你成为我的助手，你的生存就成了我最感兴趣的事，对吧？

original: Besides, I guess the original owner isn't coming back to pick it up, so you're the closest thing to an inheritor. Here!
translation: 此外，我想原主人不会回来取了，你就是最合适的继承者。给！

original: Oh, I don't know. I don't wear a watch, they're pretty rare you know. Ask someone else.
translation: 哦，我不知道。我没戴表，你也知道那很奢侈。问别人吧。

original: I'm watching the patrols, what do you think I'm looking at?
translation: 我正看着巡逻队，你以为我在看什么？

original: They switch it up a little bit every day, but just a little. There has to be some sort of pattern to it, it's just a matter of watching and waiting.
translation: 他们每天都在成长，但很缓慢。他们总会长大，习惯了就好。

original: I can only offer my thanks. My people are getting accustomed to using these as a substitute for live prey.
translation: 我谨表示感谢。我的人习惯于用它们取代捕食。

original: As compensation for your effort, allow me to at least give you something in return.
translation: 作为对你贡献的补偿，请允许我至少给你一些物品作为回馈。

original: Again, many thanks. Here is your compensation.
translation: 再次，非常感谢。这是你的报酬。

original: I heard tell of a scavenger tried that up Canterbury way. They found his body a week later, scorched with plasma bolts.
translation: 我听过一个拾荒人想在坎特伯雷的路上这么做。一周后他的尸体被发现，已经被等离子武器给烧焦了。

original: I don't know, but I'd stay away from it. No telling what those Enclave types will get up to next.
translation: 我不知道，不过我会远离它。没人能告诉你英克雷下次什么时候来。

original: Me neither. I like the music, though. Kind of nice to hear something more cheerful than what those hippies on GNR always play.
translation: 都不。我喜欢音乐，但听一些欢快的，可比银河新闻电台里老放的那些嬉皮的强多了。

original: What the hell? You get me all worked up and then cut me off? Well... look... if you ever need a hand out there, you know where to find me.
translation: 见什么鬼？你让我为你干活，然后又把我一脚踢开？嗯……听着……如果你需要人手，你知道在哪能找到我。

original: Yeah... thanks. I guess.
translation: 嗯……谢谢。

original: You've made a grievous error in judgement. Watch your back.
translation: 你做了个错误的选择。以后走路小心点。

original: Ha ha ha. The very best kind.
translation: 哈哈哈，这是最好的。

original: Try some, you've never tasted sweeter, I'll warrant.
translation: 尝尝吧，我敢保证，你从未尝过这么好的味道。

original: <grumble>
translation: <咕哝>

original: You've either got a death wish, or a pair of stones bigger than hand grenades.
translation: 你不是想找死，就是胆生毛。

original: Say, you seem to have some smarts in you, and with your sort of guts, maybe you can help us out. Interested in collecting technology for us?
translation: 我说，你看起来有点头脑，再加上你的胆量，不如帮我们个忙吧。有兴趣帮我们收集科技吗？

original: <grumble>
translation: <咕哝>

original: You've either got a death wish, or the biggest pair of stones ever sported by a woman.
translation: 你不是想找死，就是胆生毛。

original: Say, you seem to have some smarts in you, and with your sort of guts, maybe you can help us out. Interested in collecting technology for us?
translation: 我说，你看起来有点头脑，再加上你的胆量，不如帮我们个忙吧。有兴趣帮我们收集科技吗？

original: Well yes, of course I do. Don't you know who I am? I suppose James never told you. Typical.
translation: 哦，是的，当然。你不知道我是谁吗？我想詹姆斯从未告诉过你。他一向如此。

original: I'm Doctor Madison Li. I worked with your father many years ago. Your mother as well, in fact.
translation: 我是麦迪逊·李博士。很多年前与你父亲一起工作过，事实上，还有你母亲。

original: You'll have to forgive me. This has all been very stressful, what with your father suddenly showing up here after being gone for so long.
translation: 你得体谅我。你父亲在消失了那么久后，突然又在这出现，太让我们紧张了。

original: You have to understand that I... We put all of that behind us. Project Purity, our work, all of it. We've moved on, even if your father hasn't.
translation: 你必须得明白，我……我们不愿想过去的一切，净水工程、我们的工作、所有的一切，我们都不管了。人必须往前走，尽管你父亲没有。

original: Well, the miserable bastard is hard on all of us. But Gob gets it the worst. I guess just because he's different, you know?
translation: 哼，那杂种对我们所有人都很差。不过盖博的处境最糟。我想都是因为他有点不同，对吧？

original: With Gob? Well, he's sweet... and I know that he'd like to, it's just... well...
translation: 和盖博？喔，他很温顺……我知道他很愿意，只是……这个……

original: I don't want to sound shallow or anything, I mean, I'm a whore, my standards aren't exactly high.
translation: 我不是说我自己很肤浅或者什么的，我的意思是，我是做这行的，我的标准并不高。

original: But there are places even I won't go. Johnnies that are squishier than me are one of 'em.
translation: 即使这样，也有我不愿做的。比我还多愁善感的男人我是不碰的。

original: He don't talk about it much but apparently, there's a whole city of Ghouls somewhere down in D.C.
translation: 他没有说过太多，不过很显然，在华盛顿特区某处的地下有一个满是尸鬼的城市。
