translation: 你根本就没有这东西。我可没时间浪费在这种玩笑上。

original: The collected knowledge of a lost age is worth far more than any weapon. Do not underestimate the power of the written word.
translation: 收集有过去那时代的知识远要比任何武器更具价值。不要低估这些文字的力量。

original: But, I will overlook your disrespect because you can be of use. Should you come across any Pre-War Books in your travels, bring them here.
translation: 但是，我不会在意你的无礼，因为你还有用处。如果你在旅途中碰到了任何战前书籍的话，就把它们带到这来吧。

original: I will compensate you for every volume that you bring me. Think on it, and return when you have books to offer me.
translation: 你带给我的每本书我都会付你报酬的。考虑一下，当你有书能给我时就回来吧。

original: Precisely. The collected knowledge of a lost age is worth far more than any weapon. So, return here with any books that you find in good condition.
translation: 正是。收集过去那时代的知识远要比任何武器更具价值。所以，如果你找到任何书籍，只要它还可以阅读，就带回这吧。

original: I will compensate you for every volume that you bring me. Think on it, and return when you have books to offer me.
translation: 你带给我的每本书我都会付你报酬的。考虑一下，当你有书能给我时就回来吧。

original: If nothing else, I admire your commitment to your chosen focus.
translation: 如果不是因为别的什么，我会很欣赏你对你自己承诺的执着。

original: But, to the point: My task here is to collect the written works of those who came before in order to supplement the Brotherhood archives.
translation: 但是，有一点要说明：我在这的任务就是收集那些过去遗留下来的书籍，用以完善钢铁兄弟会的档案。

original: Although most of the Pre-War books have been destroyed, there are a few that have survived. But finding a book in the ruins is... difficult.
translation: 虽然大部分战前书籍已被摧毁了，但还是有少部分被保存了下来。不过，要在废墟中找到一本书的确是件……困难事。

original: So, return here with any Pre-War Books that you find and I will reward you for them. With money. Because that's what you like.
translation: 所以，把任何你找到的战前书籍都带回这，我会为此付给你报酬的。当然是钱。因为那是你最喜欢的。

original: If nothing else, I admire your commitment to your chosen focus.
translation: 如果不是因为别的什么，我会很欣赏你对你自己承诺的执着。

original: But, to the point: My task here is to collect the written works of those who came before in order to supplement the Brotherhood archives.
translation: 但是，有一点要说明：我在这的任务就是收集那些过去遗留下来的书籍，用以完善钢铁兄弟会的档案。

original: Although most of the Pre-War books have been destroyed, there are a few that have survived. But finding a book in the ruins is... difficult.
translation: 虽然大部分战前书籍已被摧毁了，但还是有少部分被保存了下来。不过，要在废墟中找到一本书的确是件……困难事。

original: So, return here with any books that you find and I will reward you for them. With money. Because that's what you like.
translation: 所以，把任何你找到的战前书籍都带回这，我会为此付给你报酬的。当然是钱。因为那是你最喜欢的。

original: Very well. But, hear me out before you go. My task is to recover undamaged books in order to supplement the knowledge of the Citadel archives.
translation: 好吧。但是，在你走前听我说完。我的任务就是回收未损坏的书籍，用以完善大本营的档案库中的知识。

original: Should you come across any in your travels, return to me and I will reward you. And no questions will be asked about how you recovered them.
translation: 如果你在旅行中碰到任何书籍，都带回来给我，我会给你报酬。而且我也不会问你是怎么得到这些书的。

original: That is my proposal. Go now, and be strong. I shall remain here, should you be willing to help.
translation: 这是我的提议。现在走吧，保重。如果你愿意帮我，就来这找我吧。

original: Good. My task here is to collect the written works of those who came before in order to supplement the Brotherhood Archives at the Citadel.
translation: 好吧。我在这的任务就是收集那些过去遗留下来的书籍，用以完善钢铁兄弟会的档案。

original: Although most of the Pre-War books have been destroyed, there are a few that have survived. But finding a book in these ruins is... difficult.
translation: 虽然大部分战前书籍已被摧毁了，但还是有少部分被保存了下来。不过，要在废墟中找到一本书的确是件……困难事。

original: I could have a million Initiates to comb the ruins, and I'd still never come close to recovering every book that remains undamaged.
translation: 我有成千上万个新兵在到处搜索那些废墟，但离收集所有保存完好的书这个目标，还是遥不可及。

original: Some fellas came by here a while ago that said they was lookin' for some troublemaker that came out from one of them Vaults.
translation: 不久前一些家伙来过这，说他们在找某个从避难所里跑出来的闹事者的。

original: I told 'em I ain't seen nobody like that and set 'em on their way.
translation: 我告诉他们没见过那样的人，把他们打发走了。

original: They might still be around here though, if'n you think you can help 'em.
translation: 不过，如果你认为自己能帮上忙的话，他们可能还在附近。

original: Some fellas came out here a while ago that said they was lookin' for some dogooder that came out from one of them Vaults.
translation: 不久前一些家伙来过这里，说他们在找某个从避难所里跑出来的行善者。

original: I told 'em I ain't seen nobody like that and set 'em on their way.
translation: 我告诉他们没见过那样的人，把他们打发走了。

original: They might still be around here though, if'n you think you can help 'em.
translation: 不过，如果你认为自己能帮上忙的话，他们可能还在附近。

original: My boys are huntin' 'Lurks. Finest meat you can get, but it don't move around in your stomach like Mole Rat does.
translation: 我的儿子们在狩猎泥沼蟹。这是你能得到的最好的肉，而且它不会像鼹鼠那样在你的胃里动来动去。

original: Right dangerous, those things. Just as soon take your head off as look at'cha. Watch yourself out here. They're all over.
translation: 那些东西很危险。看你一眼就会把你的头砍下来。小心点，它们到处都是。

original: You got yourself a deal. Um, what happens next... Oh, right. I'm gonna go.
translation: 你又做了个好买卖。嗯，接下来会是什么……哦，对了，我要走了。

original: So what was Vault kid doing out there? You do the math.
translation: 避难所小孩正在那干嘛？你自己想想吧。

original: But Three Dog, the selling of live human beings is completely fucked up! Yes, children. Yes it is.
translation: 而三狗要说！这种贩卖活人的勾当就应当被收拾！是的，孩子们。必须的。

original: Do you know what goes on out there in the stripmall that time forgot? Wake up, children! It's a goddamned slaver compound! They. Sell. People.
translation: 你知道那被时间遗忘的狭长广场发生了什么？醒醒吧，孩子们！那是个该该死的奴隶贩大院！他们，贩卖，人口。

original: The gal from Vault 101 was seen walking into Paradise Falls, and then walking back out with a big smile on her face.
translation: 有人看见，从101号避难所来的女孩走进了天堂瀑，然后带着灿烂的笑容出来了。

original: But more importantly - does it even matter worth a damn? Slavers are dead, slaves are free. That's a win-win if you ask me, children.
translation: 但更重要的是 — 这该死的事值得一搏，不是吗？奴隶贩子会被干掉，而奴隶都将获得自由。孩子们，如果你问我，我会说：这可是件一举两得的事。

original: You heard it here first, faithful listeners. The Wanderer showed up at slaver central and bad guys started dropping left and right.
translation: 这是最新消息，忠实的听众们。在漫游者现身奴隶中心后，坏家伙们就开始纷纷倒下。

original: Gasp! But what's this? The bothersome bumblebee looked suspiciously like a certain kid, from a certain vault...
translation: 呼！但是，这是什么？这惹人厌的大马蜂看起来的确像某个来自避难所的孩子……

original: Those scumbag Slavers way over in Paradise Falls had one big ole bee on their bonnet, and this baby knew how to sting.
translation: 堕落天堂的那些卑鄙的奴隶贩子们，他们的帽檐边可是有着一只大马蜂，而且这马蜂知道怎么去蛰人。

original: Those scumbag Slavers way over in Paradise Falls have one big ole bee on their bonnet. Buzz, buzz, buzz, buzz!
translation: 堕落天堂的那些卑鄙的奴隶贩子们，他们的帽檐边可是有着一只大马蜂。嗡嗡嗡，嗡嗡嗡，嗡嗡嗡，嗡嗡嗡！

original: From here on in, it's bye-bye stupid static, hello magnificent music. So sit back, relax, and absorb these classic tunes.
translation: 从现在开始，再见愚蠢的静电，你好美妙的音乐。请坐好，放松，欣赏这些经典曲目。

original: Don't ever let anyone make you think that fighting the Good Fight is a waste of time!
translation: 永远也从来不要认为正义之战是浪费时间！

original: Whether you like it or not, you just made a difference in the world.
translation: 无论你喜不喜欢，你多少都改变了这世界。

original: Here, I want you to take this. I was saving it for someone special... someone who could really help with the Good Fight.
translation: 拿着，收下这个。我留下它就是为了给某个特殊的人……真正能帮助正义之战的人。

original: It contains the location of an old weapons cache. You're welcome to help yourself to anything inside.
translation: 它记录了旧武器藏匿的位置。你可以随意使用里面任何东西。

original: Yeah, I heard you found out about your Dad, and yet you went ahead and kept your promise to me. That takes some real moxie, kid.
translation: 是的，我听说你已经自己找到了寻找父亲的线索，而且还继续遵守给我的承诺。你真是好样的，孩子。

original: Three Dog can't let you walk away from here empty-handed after all that.
translation: 不管怎样，我三狗可不会让你白白地忙活这么半天。

original: Here, I want you to take this. I was saving it for someone special... someone who could really help with the Good Fight.
translation: 拿着，收下这个。我留下它就是为了给某个特殊的人……真正能帮助正义之战的人。

original: It contains the location of an old weapons cache. You're welcome to help yourself to anything inside.
translation: 它记录了旧武器藏匿的位置。你可以随意使用里面任何东西。

original: Now hang on a second there. Three Dog can't let you walk away from here empty-handed like this.
translation: 麻烦等一下。我三狗可不会让你白白地忙活这么半天。

original: I heard you found out about your Dad on your own, and yet you went ahead and kept your promise to me. That takes some real moxie, kid.
translation: 我听说你已经自己找到了寻找父亲的线索，而且还继续遵守给我的承诺。你真是好样的，孩子。

original: Here, I want you to take this. I was saving it for someone special... someone who could really help with the Good Fight.
translation: 拿着，收下这个。我留下它就是为了给某个特殊的人……真正能帮助正义之战的人。

original: It contains the location of an old weapons cache. You're welcome to help yourself to anything inside.
translation: 它记录了旧武器藏匿的位置。你可以随意使用里面任何东西。

original: Lucky Harith kind of dropped off the map. Or, knowing his wares, he may have burnt a hole straight through it.
translation: 幸运哈里斯似乎掉到地图以外了。要么，考虑到他手里的家伙，是他在地上钻了个眼。

original: Then you'd be looking for Lucky Harith, adventurer, martial artist, and occasional collector of the most deadly items known to mankind.
translation: 那你最好找幸运哈里斯，他是冒险者、军事艺术家、偶尔也收集些当人类已知最危险的物品。

original: He's a bit of an eccentric, but he deals in more weaponry than you can shake a sharp stick at. In fact, he's probably got a sharp stick, too.
translation: 他有点古怪，但经他之手的武器多不可数。

original: My, my! When it comes to sales, I can see even I've got a few things I could learn from you!
translation: 天、天啊！说到做买卖，我该向你学习！

original: Well, in that case, I can act as your representative to the caravans. They'll listen to me, and I'll listen to you.
translation: 既然如此，我可以作你在商队那里的代表。他们会听我的，而我也会听你的。

original: Just let me know what you suggest in the way of specialties, and I'll let them know to focus on that area.
translation: 你只要告诉我应该专注于那个方面，我就会让他们把注意力集中到那里的。

original: Hmm... I think you're right. And the specialization might play to their eccentricities. It could work!
translation: 嗯……我想你是对的。专业化会合他们胃口。能行！

original: And I could act as their representative in this matter. Goodness knows, I've known them for years, so I should be able to speak for them.
translation: 在这里件事情上，我可以作为他们的代理人。众所周知，我已经和他们认识了好多年了，所以我想我能替他们说话。

original: Just let me know what you suggest in the way of specialties, and I'll let them know to focus on that area.
translation: 你只要告诉我应该专注于那个方面，我就会让他们把注意力集中到那里的。

original: Madam, you flatter me! I'm but a humble man of this small community.
translation: 夫人，您过奖了！但我只是一个微不足道的人。

original: But, since it's a trader community, I suppose I can call in a few favors with the caravans. I suppose I am rather persuasive in that way.
translation: 但是，因为这里是商人社区，我想我在商队中间还有点面子。我的说服力应该还是可以的。

original: So, you just let me know what you'd like to see from the caravans, and I'll let them know what to focus on.
translation: 你只要告诉我希望商队提供什么样的货物，我就会让他们把集中注意力的。

original: That... That certainly is quite a lot of caps. It really would be a shame for those to go to waste, wouldn't it?
translation: 这……这么多的瓶盖。要是浪费了多可惜啊，对不对？

original: I suppose I can call in a few favors with the caravans, talk with them about their inventory. Must keep the customers happy, right?
translation: 我想我可以找商队的熟人问问，和他们谈谈他们的货物。必须保证让客人满意，对吧？

original: So, you just let me know what you'd like to see from the caravans, and I'll let them know what to focus on.
translation: 你只要告诉我希望商队提供什么样的货物，我就会让他们把集中注意力的。

original: Girl, if you don't relax a little, you're going to snap in half. Now, get going, before you take someone's head off.
translation: 女孩，如果你不放轻松点，你早晚会死的。现在，走吧，趁你还没把别人脑袋崩了。

original: Lady, if you don't calm down, I'm going to let Derek know about your crush on him. That'll give you something else to think about.
translation: 女士，如果你不冷静下来，我就会让德里克知道你对他的态度。这会让你三思。

original: The locals could use a little scaring, sir! Bunch of fat, coward traders...
translation: 不妨吓唬当地人一下，先生！他们不过是一群肥胖、鼠胆商人……

original: Good to hear it. I'm not giving up this whole "living" habit, not at my age. Keep it up.
translation: 谢谢。我决不会放弃我的“生活”习惯，至少我现在不会。继续吧。

original: Well, you be sure to let us know when we are, all right?
translation: 到了该知道的时候一定要让我们知道啊，可以吗？

original: Whoa, calm down there. Attitude like that'll just get someone hurt... plus, it puts the locals on edge.
translation: 哇哦，冷静点。那样的态度不知道会伤着谁……而且，还会逼那些当地人冒险。

original: Relax, girl. We're not in a war zone, we're just making sure the market's safe. Stop scaring the locals, okay?
translation: 放松点，女孩。我们不在战区，我们只是想确保市场的安全。别再恐吓当地人，好吗？

original: Ernest, the good news is we ain't dead, yet.
translation: 欧内斯特，好消息是我们还没死。

original: Ernest, I've seen worse nights. But we aren't dead yet, and that's always a good sign.
translation: 欧内斯特，真是个糟糕的夜晚。但我们还没死，这是个好兆头。

original: Dunno.
translation: 不晓得。

original: Nothing's wrong. It's just... you think there's a chance Machete might think I'm cool? Like, maybe when I'm older?
translation: 没事。只是……你认为有没有机会让玛切蒂认为我很酷？或者等我再长大点？

original: You never know what the day may hold, eh boy?
translation: 你永远不知道今天会发生什么，是吧，孩子？

original: Well, there's always tomorrow, isn't there? At least, one hopes, eh? Ha!
translation: 嗯，永远都会有明天，不是吗？至少，有个希望，对吧？哈哈！

original: I mean it - that's hard work. But you look like you got something on your mind. What's up?
translation: 我说真的 — 那是个艰巨的工作。但你看起来心事重重，到底怎么了？

original: I suppose it was fine.
translation: 还好。

original: It wasn't anything much. But thanks!
translation: 没什么大不了,但是谢谢啦！

original: Take a look, let me know what you want.
translation: 看看吧，想要什么就告诉我。

original: Only the best, hand-picked from the Wastes... for what that's worth.
translation: 都是最好的，手工从废土里精选出来的上等货……绝对物超所值。

original: Tell me what you need, and maybe I've got your fix.
translation: 告诉我你需要什么，没准我能帮你搞定。

original: Let's see what the good doctor has in his magic bag, shall we?
translation: 让我们看看这神医的百宝箱里有什么，怎么样？

original: Nothing but the highest quality leftovers, junk, and crap!
translation: 我这里只有高质量的剩货、垃圾还有废物！

original: Crazy Wolfgang's got just what you need! Assuming you need the random junk that I've got.
translation: 疯子沃尔夫冈正好有你想要的东西！前提是你要的我碰巧都有。

original: It's my pleasure to offer hot death in a variety of exciting flavors - take your pick!
translation: 我很荣幸为你提供当前最流行的死法，滋味不同，风格各异 — 随你挑选！

original: Please, enjoy my selection of high-quality problem-solvers!
translation: 请欣赏我的顶级收藏吧！

original: Have a look, see if anything calls out to you.
translation: 看一看，有没有你喜爱的东西。

original: If the clothes make the man, then here are the means to re-make yourself.
translation: 人靠衣装，你真得重新包装下自己了。

original: It's okay, I guess. I heard it's safer than most places, because the raiders don't bother us. But I've never been anywhere else, so I don't know.
translation: 我想没什么事。我听说这里比大多数地方都安全，因为掠夺者不会给我们找麻烦。不过我没去过别的地方，所以我也不太清楚。

original: I've never been anywhere else, so I can't really say, but yeah it's okay.
translation: 我从没去过其他地方，所以也说不上来，不过还不错。

original: This whole place would fall apart if it weren't for Dom and me keeping anyone from causing too much trouble.
translation: 要不是多米和我在这里挡着不让人惹麻烦，这地方早就塌了。

original: Fat, old Roe may think he runs the place, but it's only because Dom lets the idiot.
translation: 又肥又老的罗伊或许以为是他在掌管这地方，但那是因为多米让着这白痴。

original: In that case, perhaps you ought to leave town, stranger.
translation: 要是那样的话，或许你该离开这镇子了，陌生人。

original: That'd save Dom the cost of ammo, and it'd save you the cost of being dead. Now, good day.
translation: 那会节省多米的子弹钱，也留了你一条小命。现在离开吧。

original: And it sounds like your tongue's going to get itself cut out if you keep bothering me, man. Get lost.
translation: 哥们，你要是再打扰我的话，你的舌头就会因为太长而被剁掉。滚一边去。

original: Yeah, maybe. But you need one to keep some of those caravaners in line. And to keep them from getting too friendly, if you catch my drift.
translation: 是啊，或许吧。但你需要一个人去协调那些商队。但也不能让他们太过亲密，明白吧。

original: Even in a nice place like this, a girl's best friend is a good knife, right?
translation: 即使在这样迷人的地方，一个女孩的挚友也该是一把好刀，对不对？

original: Great. Just between us mechanics, try some Mentats before you tackle that robot. They really clear your head.
translation: 好极了。机械师之间的对话，在处理机器人之前先来点曼他特吧，这能让你保持头脑清醒。

original: I know they're addictive, but hey, that's just the sort of risk professionals like us take, right?
translation: 我知道它们会让人上瘾，不过，干我们这行的，经常要承担这种风险，不是吗？

original: Here, I've got a few.
translation: 给，我这有一些。

original: This isn't a building robot, I keep telling you...
translation: 这不是一个建筑机器人，我一直告诫你……

original: No furniture detected in current residence. Please visit your local shopping area to make appropriate purchases.
translation: 现在的居住区里根本找不到一件家具。去你们当地的商店，看看可不可以买一些合适的。

original: You wouldn't say that if you spent even a single night in shackles.
translation: 你不会想戴着枷锁过上一夜吧？

original: I'm done trying to justify my plan to you. If you don't want to help us, just say so.
translation: 我已经向你明确告知了我的计划。要是你不想帮忙，直说就行了。

original: Oh, yes. All my life.
translation: 哦，是的。我的一生。

original: One day I killed the master's little girl. It was an accident, I swear!
translation: 某天我弄死了主人的小女儿。那只是个意外，我发誓！

original: I... I ran away. They would never have believed me.
translation: 我……我跑了。因为他们永远也不会相信我的。

original: Hannibal found me. I would never have made it without him.
translation: 汉尼拔找到了我。如果没有他我是活不下来的。

original: You've got to make up your own mind, sir.
translation: 你必须做出抉择，先生。

original: This is a good place. A safe place.
translation: 这是个好地方。一个避风港。

original: He's gonna save us all.
translation: 他将会拯救我们所有人。

original: I mean all us slaves. He's gonna find a way to free everyone one of us.
translation: 我是说我们所有奴隶。他正在设法解救我们这些人。

original: Because if you don't, I get to use you for target practice.
translation: 因为如果你不这样做的话，我就不得不把你当靶子练。

original: Why are you asking?
translation: 为什么这么问？

original: He's the one honest, decent man in the Wasteland.
translation: 他是废土中一个忠诚、正直的人。

original: You hurt him and I'll hunt you down and feed you your own liver.
translation: 你要敢碰他的话，我就会对你穷追不舍，并且把你的肝扯出来喂你自己吃。

original: We keep the dream alive. The dream of a free world where all men are created equal.
translation: 我们要心怀这梦想。建立一个自由、众生平等世界的梦想。

original: Hannibal has plans to abolish slavery everywhere. What more noble goal is there?
translation: 汉尼拔计划废除每一个地方的奴隶制。还有比这更高尚的目标吗？

original: He's a man with a dream.
translation: 他是个怀抱梦想的人。

original: If you want to know more than that, you should ask him, not me.
translation: 如果你想多知道一些，那么你应该去问他，而不是问我。

original: I trust him with my life, but you'll have to make up your own mind.
translation: 我和他可以性命相托，但你就必须得自己做决定。

original: Somebody's got to look out for those that can't look out for themselves.
translation: 需要有人去拯救那些不能拯救自己的人。

original: That's all Hannibal is trying to do. He's looking out for all those runaway slaves.
translation: 这就是汉尼拔尝试去做的。他在照顾所有亡命天涯的奴隶。

original: He's got big plans.
translation: 他有一个大计划。

original: Someday we're going to leave this place and make our own town.
translation: 总有一天我们会离开这，去建设属于我们自己的城市。

original: I hope I get to help build it.
translation: 我希望我能为它添砖加瓦。

original: I'm an historian. I also tinker with Pre-War machines.
translation: 我是个历史学家，同时我也焊补战前的机器。

original: My dream is to build a shrine to the great Abraham Lincoln.
translation: 我的梦想是给伟大的亚伯拉罕·林肯造一座圣殿。

original: You're the best equipped runaway slave I've ever seen.
translation: 你是我见过的逃亡奴隶中装备最棒的。

original: Whether you're telling the truth or lying through your teeth, you'll need to see Hannibal.
translation: 不管你是想告诉我实话，还是想被我打得满地找牙，你都得见见汉尼拔。

original: Keep your hands in sight and don't make any sudden moves. I'm coming down to open the gate.
translation: 把手放在我能看见的地方，别做小动作，我这就下来开门。

original: Who says you can't go home again, huh? The kid from Vault 101 did, but it looks like the prodigal daughter's return didn't last all that long.
translation: 谁说你不能再回家？这从101号避难所出来的孩子就做到过，看起来这放荡浪女的回归没持续多久。

original: I'd ask the kid from 101, but I hear she's busy oogling some newly obtained piece of shiny Commonwealth technology. Quite a conic of dink, that...
translation: 我应该问问这101来的孩子，可我听说她忙着研究一些新得到的联邦的高科技。真是个圆锥形的丁克……

original: I'd ask the kid from 101, but I hear he's busy oogling some newly obtained piece of shiny Commonwealth technology. Quite a conic of dink, that...
translation: 我应该问问这101来的孩子，可我听说他忙着研究一些新得到的联邦的高科技。真是个圆锥形的丁克……

original: Now if she could just remove all those ugly pipes from the Jefferson Memorial...
translation: 现在如果她能把杰斐逊纪念馆中所有难看的管道清除掉的话……

original: I've also heard it tastes like Radscorpion shit and turns your piss blue. Or does it taste like Radscorpion piss and turn your shit blue? Whatever.
translation: 我还听说那玩意尝起来像辐射蝎的大便，而且能让你尿出蓝色的东西。或者是那玩意尝起来像辐射蝎的尿而让你排出蓝色的大便？管他呢。

original: It's called Nuka-Cola Quantum, and I believe it was made in limited quantities before the war.
translation: 它叫量子版核子可乐，而且我相信这东西在战前是限量生产的。

original: God knows why, but the kid from Vault 101 is scouring the Capital Wasteland for a unique brand of Nuka-Cola.
translation: 天知道为什么，但这101号避难所的孩子为了一瓶有独一无二商标的核子可乐搜遍了首都废土。

original: Now, I've got new reports from the settlement known as Big Town that Little Miss Vault Gal has helped them out with one hell of a mess.
translation: 现在，我从那个叫大镇的聚集地里得到了新消息，避难所少女帮他们解决了一个大麻烦。

original: Now, I've got new reports from the settlement known as Big Town that Mister Vault Guy has helped them out with one hell of a mess.
translation: 现在，我从那个叫大镇的聚集地里得到了新消息，避难所少年帮他们解决了一个大麻烦。

original: I somehow knew you'd be the one to make the changes that Leaf Mother Laurel desired.
translation: 不知为何，我就知道你会是那个能做出“叶之母”萝瑞尔所期望改变的人。

original: I helped to create the hoods that you see all Treeminders wear. It's said that the cloth has a part of the Great One's spirit woven into the fibers.
translation: 所有护树人戴的兜帽都是我参与制作的。据说布料的纤维里织入了圣贤的一部分灵魂。

original: I present this to you as thanks. Wear this with pride and bring the message of renewal to all the corners of the Wasteland.
translation: 我把这个送给你以表感谢。骄傲地戴上它，将重生的讯息带到废土的每一个角落。

original: I helped to create the garb that you see all Treeminders wear. It's said that the cloth has a part of the Great One's spirit woven into the fibers.
translation: 我帮着做外衣，就是你看到的所有树启者穿的那种。据说这块布料的纤维里面含有一部分的圣贤精魂。

original: I present this to you as thanks. Wear this with pride but tell no one where it came from or Oasis may face as yet a greater peril.
translation: 我把这送给你以示感谢。自豪地穿着它，但不要告诉别人你是从哪得到的它，否则绿洲将会面临极大的危险。

original: We're very much alike, you and I. We both searched the Wasteland seeking answers, but I found my answer here.
translation: 你和我很相似。我们都曾在废土上探寻答案，而我在这里找到了自己的答案。

original: I hope one day you'll find what you're looking for. I know it's out there somewhere... just be patient.
translation: 我希望有一天你也能找到你所追寻的东西。我知道它就在某个地方……耐心点。

original: Here, please take this relic of my older days. Perhaps it will help you on your journey.
translation: 来，收下这件我旧日的纪念。也许它能在你的旅途中帮到你。

original: I've never known someone to show as much caring as you did towards us. It seems to be rare to run into anyone like that anymore.
translation: 我从未见过像你这般对我们关心的人。如今，这样的人似乎越来越少见了。

original: That's partly why I never returned to my former life after I found myself in this place.
translation: 这也是我来到此地后，便再也没有回归往昔生活的部分原因。

original: Allow me to present a piece of my past to you, friend. Perhaps it will serve you better than it served me.
translation: 朋友，请收下这件承载我过往的物件。或许它对你的用处会比在我这里更大。

original: Yeah, I think you're pretty swell for someone from Out There! And... and you were really nice to me too.
translation: 是啊，我觉得对来自“外面”的人来说，你真的很棒！而且……而且你对我也很好。

original: I was gonna give this to my bestest friend Harold, but he doesn't have pockets, the silly-head!
translation: 我本来要把这送给我最最要好的朋友哈罗德，可他没有口袋，这个笨蛋！

original: This is a charm that my parents gave me for my fifth birthday. It's really neat! Take it!
translation: 这是我父母在我五岁生日时送的护符。它非常棒！拿着吧！

original: He's no mere god, my friend.
translation: 祂可不只是普通的神，我的朋友。

original: He is the One Who Grows, He is the One Who Gives and He is the One Who Guides.
translation: 祂是万物培育者，是慷慨赐予者，也是方向指引者。

original: Thanks to Him, the Treeminders have a home.
translation: 多亏了祂，树启者才有了家园。

original: It was? I had no idea, thanks.
translation: 是吗？我不知道，谢谢。

original: Here, take these for helping me out.
translation: 给，谢谢你帮助我。

original: It was? I had no idea, thanks.
translation: 是吗？我不知道，谢谢。

original: Here, take these for helping me out.
translation: 给，谢谢你帮助我。

original: Thanks. Nice to meet a fellow mechanic out here in the Wasteland.
translation: 谢谢。很高兴能在废土碰到一个修理师同伴。

original: Here's your payment.
translation: 这是你的报酬。

original: Thanks. Nice to meet a fellow mechanic out here in the Wasteland.
translation: 谢谢。很高兴能在废土碰到一个修理师同伴。

original: Here's your payment.
translation: 这是你的报酬。

original: Uh, sure. I mean, I really like that one!
translation: 呃，当然。我是说，我真喜欢那个！

original: You and your snakes and rats and lizards...
translation: 你和你的蛇还有老鼠还有蜥蜴……

original: I don't know. You guys never like any of my ideas anyway.
translation: 我不知道。反正你们这些家伙从不喜欢我的看法。

original: If you're so smart, why don't you suggest something.
translation: 要是你是真聪明的话，为什么不提点建议。

original: Didn't you guys like Grease Weasels?
translation: 大伙不喜欢“黄鼬帮”？

original: I can't believe you didn't like "Hell's Overseers". Better than anything you guys have come up with.
translation: 我简直无法相信你会不喜欢“地狱监督者帮”。这可比你们这帮家伙想出来的强多了。

original: Isn't being a gang a little stupid? I mean, basically everyone we know is going to be in it.
translation: 组织帮派是不是有点傻？我的意思是，差不多我们认识的每一个人都会入伙的。

original: I still like "The Mackers."
translation: 我还是喜欢“麦克帮”。

original: Ummm... the Vault Kings?
translation: 嗯……“避难所大王帮”？

original: You certainly came to the right person. What'd you like?
translation: 你确实找对人了。要来点什么？

original: All right, you're the boss!
translation: 行，听你的！

original: I don't know where they are... but everything is fine. Roy said not to worry about the other residents.
translation: 我不知道他们在哪……不过一切都好。罗伊说别担心其他人。

original: Heh. Roy decided to take out the trash. I'm glad I lost my sense of smell. You'll want to stay clear of the basement storage room.
translation: 呵。罗伊决定清理掉那些垃圾。我很高兴我鼻子不好。你不会想靠近地下储藏室的。

original: Can't say I completely agreed with Roy's decision. Then again, they were a bunch of assholes. No one's innocent, kid. You'd do well to remember that.
translation: 我不完全同意罗伊的决定。但话又说回来，他们是一群混蛋。没有人是无辜的，孩子。你最好记住这一点。

original: 10 more batteries. Don't waste them, these things don't grow on trees you know.
translation: 还有十多个电池。别浪费，这些玩意可不会像树那样自己长出来。

original: You need all the keys to get through Fort Constantine.
translation: 你想进入康斯坦丁堡，就得有所有的钥匙。

original: With only one key, there's no point in my going back.
translation: 只有一把钥匙，我回去根本没有意义。

original: Huh? What? Oh yeah, baby! That's what I like.
translation: 啊？什么？哦，宝贝！那就是我想要的。

original: The rest of you Brotherhood cats -- can't you extend an olive branch or something? You'd think fighting the Super Mutants would be enough...
translation: 至于兄弟会的各位好汉，就不能递个橄榄枝啥的？和变种人厮杀还不够你们忙活的吗……

original: Come on, Al, cut the Ghoulies a break. If they've got the caps and you've got the space, it's a win-win, right? Whadaya say?
translation: 嗨，奥利斯特，给尸鬼们点机会。如果他们得到了瓶盖，而你得到了地盘，那就是双赢，对吧？你说怎么样？

original: Ah, but lush at large Allistair Tenpenny says, "No zombies, no how!"
translation: 哈……但花里胡哨的奥利斯特·特佩尼明明白白地说，“不要丧尸，不择手段！”

original: According to reports from the ever so hoity toity Tenpenny Tower, a group of displaced Ghouls have been trying to gain entrance.
translation: 根据这条来自一贯如此装腔作势的特佩尼大厦的消息，一群卷土重来的尸鬼企图闯进来。

original: It's been no secret that the Pre-War nuke in the center of town had a live atomic core, and under the wrong conditions, could still go kaboom.
translation: 这已经不是秘密，镇子中央的战前核弹在最坏的情形下，仍然可能爆炸。

original: Just a friendly reminder to all you would-be bigots out there -- Ghouls are people too.
translation: 仅仅是对所有盲从者的一个友善的提示 — 尸鬼也是人。

original: Remember, children, when the Raiders come, there ain't no shame in locking your doors, barricading the windows, and cowering under the nearest bed.
translation: 孩子们，记住了，当掠夺者来袭，锁好门、堵住窗户，躲在最近的床底下，这不丢人。

original: For all you guys and gals tempted by the thought of scavving in the downtown D.C. ruins, here's a tip...
translation: 考虑到特区市区遗址的垃圾可能会诱惑到你们这些男孩和女孩，给你们一个提示……

original: Listen kiddos, never forget the importance of periodic weapon maintenance. Rifle, pistol, police baton -- I don't care which.
translation: 听着，小鬼们，永远不要忘记定期保养武器的重要性。步枪、手枪、警棍 — 无论是哪种武器。

original: Don't feed the Yao Guai! That is all.
translation: 别让自己喂了妖怪！就这样。

original: We all know the dangers of radiation, but with the right precautions, you CAN prevent accidental death or even -- eewww -- ghoulification.
translation: 我们都知道辐射的危险，但是有了正确的预防措施，你能避免突发性的死亡乃至 — 嗯嗯 — 变成尸鬼。

original: That was the Ink Spots, with "I Don't Want to Set the World on Fire."
translation: 播送一首墨迹乐团的“我不想世界卷入战火”。

original: That was the Ink Spots, with "Maybe."
translation: 播送一首墨迹乐团的“或许”。

original: That was Bob Crosby with "Happy Times."
translation: 播送一首鲍勃·克罗斯比的“欢乐时光”。

original: That was Bob Crosby with "Way Back Home."
translation: 播送一首鲍勃·克罗斯比的“漫漫回家路”。

original: That was Roy Brown with "Butcher Pete."
translation: 播送一首罗伊·布朗的“屠夫皮特”。

original: That was Roy Brown with "Mighty Mighty Man."
translation: 播送一首罗伊·布朗的“大男人”。

original: That was Billie Holiday with "Crazy He Calls Me."
translation: 播送一首比莉·霍利戴的“他说我疯了”。

original: That was Billie Holiday with "Easy Living."
translation: 播送一首比莉·霍利戴的“逍遥自在”。

original: That was Danny Kaye and the Andrew Sisters with "Civilization."
translation: 播送一首丹妮·凯依和安德鲁·凯依姐妹合唱的“文明”。

original: That was Ella Fitzgerald with "Into Each Life Some Rain Must Fall."
translation: 播送一首艾拉·费兹洁拉德的”生活总会有风雨”。

original: That was Tex Beneke with "A Wonderful Guy."
translation: 刚才是泰克斯·本尼克和“棒小伙”。

original: That was Cole Porter with "Anything Goes."
translation: 播送一首科尔·波特的“万事成空”。

original: Now here's where the story gets sketchy, in true Capital Wasteland style.
translation: 但接下来故事就诡异了，以典型的首都废土粗线条风格。

original: Wait, no... I mean, forget I brought it up.
translation: 等等，不……我的意思是，就当我什么都没提到。

original: Oh man, just like when I was a kid! Maybe you ought to go talk to her, Derek.
translation: 哦，老兄，就像我小的时候一样！或许你应该跟德里克谈谈。

original: Alright you greedy bastard. I'll get someone to burn this.
translation: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

original: You seem like a right thinking person. I've got a proposition for you.
translation: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

original: I'm looking for some escaped slaves. I'll pay 100 caps for information about their leader, Hannibal Hamlin. Interested?
translation: 我正在搜寻一些逃跑的奴隶。我会出100个瓶盖购买他们领头人汉尼拔·哈姆林的信息，有兴趣吗？

original: I suppose I can afford it. I'll get this burned right away.
translation: 我应该付得起，我会立刻烧了这。

original: You take when we have so little. So be it. We will enshrine this right away.
translation: 趁我们还有，你拿走一些。就这样，我们会立刻把这侍奉起来。

original: Very well, here you are. Worth every cap.
translation: 非常好，给你，每个瓶盖都花得值。

original: Huh. I guess you're right. Well, this seems like the perfect excuse to do some of that downtown exploring I've kept putting off.
translation: 哈，我想你是对的。现在我有了一个好理由，去做那些我已经很久没有做过的事了，类似探索市区，一个理想的借口。

original: Guess there's no time like the present. Ta-ta!
translation: 我想没时间再耽搁了，回头见！

original: Really? Then I guess I'll be heading there, to join my newfound family and their warm, smiling, and hideously pockmarked faces.
translation: 真的吗？我想我会去那的，重新回到家庭的怀抱，去见见他们温柔而又喜悦的麻子脸。

original: You know, this is just the perfect excuse to visit Rivet City!
translation: 你知道，这是拜访铆钉城的一个好理由！

original: But while I'm heading downtown, I've been meaning to check out the museum. Who knows what I'll find? Anyway, see you downtown, one way or the other!
translation: 但当我赶往市区，我理所当然的会去看看博物馆。谁知道我会发现什么？无论怎样，市区见，不见不散！

original: Wait, what?
translation: 等等，什么？

original: Yeah, they really are, aren't they?
translation: 是的，确实是这样，不是吗？

original: And I guess this is what the ascension mumbo-jumbo atom-cultists wanted, too. So, nice of you to help them like that, I guess.
translation: 我想这也是那些胡言乱语的原子信徒想要的。所以，你能帮到他们真好。

original: Now, what am I going to do about work? And what's with the weird look? Have I got something on my face?
translation: 现在，我该做什么？为什么要用这种奇怪的表情？我脸上有什么东西？

original: Well, okay, as long as you're sorry. But I expect you to apologize to everyone else in town, okay? And don't do it again!
translation: 好吧，好的，既然你道歉了。但我希望你向镇里每个人道歉，好吗？别再这么干了！

original: Now, what am I going to do about work? And what's with the weird look? Have I got something on my face?
translation: 现在，我该做什么？为什么要用这种奇怪的表情？我脸上有什么东西？

original: Oh, that's a real nice thing to say. Of course it's me!
translation: 哦，你说的可真好听，没错，是我！

original: What's with the weird look? Don't you remember who I am? Did you hurt your head in that big explosion?
translation: 为什么要用这种奇怪的表情？你不记得我是谁了？你在大爆炸中伤了脑袋吗？

original: Don't be silly, I just got some gunk on my face after the explosion... but that doesn't explain why it peels away in strips. And oozes.
translation: 别傻了，我只是在核爆后脸上粘上了一些汁液……但那不能解释它为什么以条状的形式剥落出来，而且在流脓。

original: You know what? I think I'm turning into a Ghoul!
translation: 你猜怎么着？我觉得我正变成一个尸鬼！

original: This is fascinating! Now, where can a Ghoul like me go to study these effects in peace?
translation: 真迷人！现在，像我这样的一个尸鬼，能去哪找到一个安静的地方研究这些反应？

original: Oh my goodness! Do you really think so? I'm becoming a Ghoul?! This is a... Oh oh this is a...
translation: 哦我的天哪！你真这么觉得？我变成了一个尸鬼？！这是一个...哦哦，这是一个......

original: This is amazing! I never would have dreamed I'd get to study a change like this first-hand!
translation: 太神奇了！我从来没有梦想过我能第一手地去研究这种直接的改变！

original: Now, if only I had somewhere to stay during the process. Know anywhere where a Ghoul can settle down for a bit?
translation: 现在，要是这过程中我有个地方待着多好。知道哪可以让尸鬼居住？

original: A Ghoul? What, me? What do you...
translation: 一个尸鬼？什么，我？你怎么……

original: Aaaah! Why am I Ghoul? Is this because of that explosion?
translation: 啊~~~！为什么我会变成尸鬼？是因为那场爆炸吗？

original: Actually... This isn't too bad. I always was curious to do some tests involving Ghouls. Know anywhere where a Ghoul like me can settle down?
translation: 其实……这不算太糟。我一直想做一些有关尸鬼的试验。知道什么地方可以让我这样一个尸鬼居住？

original: Don't be silly, why would you blow up our town? You're talking crazy-talk.
translation: 别傻了，你为什么要炸掉我们的镇子？你胡说八道。

original: Same here! I had just gone down to Springvale to do some tests -- turns out you can't teach a giant ant new tricks -- and before I knew it, boom!
translation: 彼此彼此！我正在春之谷做实验 — 证明你不能改变巨蚁的基因 — 而就在我明白这一点之前，只听见爆炸声！

original: Oh, I hope it wasn't that Nuka-Psycho brew I was working on. Who could have guessed it would react like that?
translation: 哦，我希望那不是我正在酿造的核子疯狂药。谁能想到它会那样起反应？

original: Still... At least I'm okay, huh?
translation: 尽管如此……至少我没事，呃？

original: Wow! Who would have thought a town built around a bomb could be so dangerous?
translation: 哇哦！谁会想到建在炸弹周围的城镇是那么的危险？

original: Good thing I wasn't in town at the time, huh? Man, that could have really done a number on me!
translation: 当时我不在城里真是件好事，呃？伙计，那可真骗到了我！

original: Collect location data from the wasteland. When you discover a new location, report it to me. Simple.
translation: 从废土收集当地的数据。当你发现一个新的地点，把它报告给我。很简单。

original: Sarcasm. Very clever.
translation: 哼哼，非常聪明。

original: I need information on locations outside of D.C.
translation: 我需要特区以外区域的信息。

original: Since I am occupied, you can provide it for me.
translation: 我很忙，所以你帮我搜集吧。

original: Maybe.
translation: 也许吧。

original: Now that the old fool is finally dead, we can have some real leadership around here: me.
translation: 那老白痴终于死了，现在我们能有一个真正的领导者了：我。

original: Shawna runs the museum, not me. What the hell do you want?
translation: 肖纳经营这博物馆，不是我。你他妈想要什么？

original: Sure! The Museum of Dave is happy to answer any questions on behalf of the Republic of Dave's Office of Tourism!
translation: 当然！戴夫纪念馆很高兴代表戴夫共和国办公室旅游部回答任何问题！

original: Um, okay. As long as President Daddy says it's all right.
translation: 嗯，好。只要爸爸总统说行就行了。

original: Um, okay. As long as President Daddy says it's all right.
translation: 嗯，好。只要爸爸总统说行就行了。

original: Um, okay. As long as President Daddy says it's all right.
translation: 嗯，好。只要爸爸总统说行就行了。

original: Um, okay. As long as President Daddy says it's all right.
translation: 嗯，好。只要爸爸总统说行就行了。

original: Shawna is dead. How could something like this have happened?
translation: 肖纳死了。怎么会发生这种事？

original: Rosie is dead. Can't honestly say I care very much.
translation: 萝丝死了。说实在的我可不太在乎。

original: Sure, honey, but don't make it too long or Dave will start wondering why we're talking.
translation: 当然，亲爱的，但是别太久，否则戴夫会开始疑惑为何我们要谈话。

original: You should talk to Dave, but okay.
translation: 你该去找戴夫，但找我也可以。

original: Well, Bob is being even more of a jerk than usual.
translation: 哦，鲍勃变得比平时更古怪了。

original: I give a tour of the Museum of Dave every day at 2. You should check it out.
translation: 我每天下午2点都为戴夫博物馆做讲解员。你应该来看一下。

original: No, there won't be much going on now that the election is over.
translation: 不，选举结束后就没有那么多事了。

original: Well, I'm trying to think up a good new name for this place now that it's mine.
translation: 哦，既然这地方归我了，我要给它起一个好听的新名字。

original: Dave is dead. We're not sure what will even happen to this place anymore.
translation: 戴夫死了。我们不知道这地方还会出什么事。

original: Rosie is dead. It's too bad, she was always so nice.
translation: 萝丝死了。太糟了，她那么友善。

original: My assistance? Hmm... I suppose I can spare a few caps from the Department of Foreign Relations budget.
translation: 我的援助？嗯……我想我能从外交部预算中分一些瓶盖给你们。

original: Here. In a few years, I might annex your village to the Republic of Dave. Until then, you are free to exist in my fair nation as a refugee.
translation: 给。过几年，我可能把你的村子并入戴夫共和国的版图。在那之前，你可以作为一个难民自由出入我美好的国度。

original: Wh-what? No! Oh my God! I should never have left. I knew it... now they're all dead!
translation: 什么？我的天啊！我不应该离开的。我早该知道……现在他们都死了！

original: Wait a second... What about my brother?
translation: 等一下……我的弟弟怎么样了？

original: Wh-what? No! Oh my God! I should never have left. I knew it... now they're all dead!
translation: 什么？我的天啊！我不应该离开的。我早该知道……现在他们都死了！

original: Wait a second... What about my brother?
translation: 等一下……我的弟弟怎么样了？

original: That's the weird thing. He has some sort of crazy sixth sense about it or something. Maybe all of our kind do.
translation: 那是很奇怪的事。他有一种疯狂的第六感。或许我们这种人都有。

original: As soon as I was with the Family, I really felt at home for the first time in my life. It's like all these people are my real brothers and sisters.
translation: 当我和家族在一起，我有生以来第一次找到了家的感觉。就像这些人真的是我的兄弟姐妹。

original: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
translation: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！

original: I think I had it all wrong. I shouldn't have come here. I bet Lucy is feeling just as bad as me.
translation: 我想我完全错了。我不该来这鬼地方，我发誓露西现在心里和我一样难受。

original: Please, tell Vance I've made my decision. I'm going home to Arefu. I hope to see you there as well.
translation: 求你了，告诉万斯我下了决心，我要回阿雷富的家。希望在那见到你。

original: I'm just gonna gather my stuff together and say my goodbyes then I'll head on back.
translation: 我这就收拾行李和他们告别，然后就回去。

original: Names like that have no meaning here... your insults are a wasted effort.
translation: 这种话没什么意义……你的侮辱是在白费口舌。

original: In ceremony, each member of the Family must speak one of the Laws... it is theirs to remember and to enforce.
translation: 每当举行典礼的时候，我们当中的每个人都要说出法则中的一条。……那是他们必须记住和坚持执行的法则。

original: Perhaps from these Laws you can discover what we are. Return to me when you are ready.
translation: 可能从这些法则之中，你能发现我们是什么样的人。若你准备好就回来找我。

original: Indeed. Perhaps my sense of caring for Ian has overwhelmed my sense of duty to the Family and all others like us.
translation: 的确如此。可能我对伊恩的关心已经超过了我对家族，对其他像我们一样的人的责任感。

original: Forgive my mistake. If you wish to speak to Ian, you're free to do so.
translation: 原谅我的错误。如果你想和伊恩谈谈，请随意。

original: Here is the code to the area in which he is meditating.
translation: 这是他的房间密码，他在那里冥想。

original: If you say so. But if you really mean that, you might want to stop wearing a suit with their number writ large across the back.
translation: 要是你这么说的话。但如果你真的那么认为，你可能要脱掉后背印着那大大数字的衣服。

original: Anyway, I guess I don't need a foreword. They just get in the way of the real content. But the book's going to be great, you just watch.
translation: 不管怎么说，我想我不需要作序，它们只会妨碍正文。但这本书将很棒，你等着瞧。

original: That's terrible!
translation: 太可怕了！

original: But it'll be great for a foreword. So in that sense, it's great! I think you're going to like it out here.
translation: 不过把它作为序言很好。从这方面来说，它太棒了！我想你会喜欢外面世界的。

original: And here's the armored suit, just to make sure you don't get recycled into something else's food.
translation: 给你这套护甲，能保护你不被循环利用，成为别的鬼东西的美餐。

original: That'll be good for the book. In fact, want to help me with the research? I can pay you, and it'll be fun!
translation: 那样对这书有好处。事实上，想帮我做研究吗？我可以付你钱，而且这会很有意思！

original: Well, it takes a little more work than that to get food. And good water's even harder. But you'll figure that out soon enough.
translation: 那好，比起找食物，它要多花点工夫。而且优质的水甚至更难找，不过你很快就会明白的。

original: Here, take the armored suit. It won't help feed you, but it should keep you from being food for anything else. Or anyone else.
translation: 给你这套护甲，它虽然不能喂饱你的肚子，但它应该可以让你不会变成别的什么鬼东西，或者别的什么人的美餐。

original: That'll be good for the book. In fact, want to help me with the research? I can pay you, and it'll be fun!
translation: 那样对这书有好处。事实上，想帮我做研究吗？我可以付你钱，而且这会很有意思！

original: Oh, certainly, your majesty!
translation: 哦，当然，陛下！

original: Then consider this Armored Vault Suit to be Megaton's gift to your mighty empire.
translation: 那么，就把这套装甲避难所服当作兆吨镇赠予您强大帝国的礼物吧。

original: However, you may consider going incognito. People around here don't always take kindly to monarchy, you know.
translation: 然而，你可以考虑隐姓埋名。您知道，这里的人可不太喜欢君主制。

original: That'll be good for the book. In fact, want to help me with the research? I can pay you, and it'll be fun!
translation: 那样对这书有好处。事实上，想帮我做研究吗？我可以付你钱，而且这会很有意思！

original: Hah! Yeah, you wouldn't imagine how hard it is to replace that big light bulb up there, too!
translation: 哈！是的，你也想象不到，用它去代替那大灯泡有多难！

original: That's great for a foreword - open with a joke and all that.
translation: 把它作为序言很棒 — 以玩笑开头，诸如此类。

original: Here, take the suit - something tells me you might need it.
translation: 给，拿着这件衣服 — 我猜你可能需要它。

original: A runaway dad, huh? I've seen plenty of them before. But none with a big "101" on their back. Good luck finding him.
translation: 逃跑的爸爸，呃？我见过很多这样的人，但就是没有一个后背上印着大大的“101”的。祝你好运找到他。

translation: 或许装甲避难所制服对你到外面会有所帮助，呃？

original: That'll be good for the book. In fact, want to help me with the research? I can pay you, and it'll be fun!

translation: 好吧，你这贪婪的杂种。我会叫人烧了这。

translation: 你看上去是个有头脑的人。我有个建议想让你听听。

translation: 这就是总统爸爸所说的，但我只记得以前才一个妈妈。

translation: 我不知道，各种各样的小玩意。亮着许多灯的盒子，一些有趣的玻璃杯……

original: Oh wait! He had a big, clunky, shiny man too. That was kind of neat.
translation: 哦，等等！他还有个又大又笨又闪亮的人。那还真不错。

original: He spent all of his of time in that shack next door to my house.
translation: 他就住我家隔壁，天天待在他那小屋里。

translation: 每次我偷偷溜到那，都看到他坐在那台满屏幕绿色文字的搞笑电视机前敲按钮。

original: Oh, gee! That's not so bad. Engineering, all right!
translation: 哦，伙计！还不算太糟糕。工程学，好啊！

translation: 如果我从事科学或家政学，妈妈会想第一时间知道的。

translation: 什么？这不可能！我要告诉爸爸！他不会就这样放过你的！

original: Nah, I already know what it says. Hardly takes a rocket scientist to crack that joke of a test.
translation: 不，我都知道答案了。只有火箭科学家才会做这种胡扯的测试…

original: Okay, Mr. Brotch, I just need to read over my answers one more time.
translation: 好的，布洛彻先生，我只是想再看一遍我的答案。

original: HEEELLLLPPPP!!!!!!!

translation: 嗯…算你聪明。你要是做什么傻事我就会把你干掉。所以别轻举妄动。

original: Tenpenny and his pack of elitist wannabes are in for a real treat soon enough. They can't keep us out of that tower forever.
translation: 特佩尼和他的那帮精英崇拜者，很快就会有好戏看了。他们不能永远将我们排挤于大厦之外。

translation: 你他妈的太对了，她就是个婊子。毁了我他妈的一生。不过我看你对这些都不在乎。好吧。

original: It's all in my computer; here's the password. See for yourself. Hell, just take these pictures and this holotape. Straight from the synthman's lips.
translation: 都在我电脑里；这是密码。你自己看吧。见鬼，直接拿走这些照片和全息磁吧。直接出自合成人之口。

original: Just don't go telling Harkness though. He won't believe you anyway. And you really don't want to see him upset. He can be a bit... inhospitable.
translation: 只是别告诉哈克尼斯。反正他也不会相信你。而且你真的不想看到他生气。他有时候有点……不近人情。

original: Well, she's got nothing to do with anything, except ruining my whole goddamn life. But I can see you don't give a crap about any of that. Fine.
translation: 嗯，她跟任何事都没关系，除了毁了我他妈的一生。不过我看你对这些都不在乎。好吧。

original: It's all in my computer; here's the password. See for yourself. Hell, just take these pictures and this holotape. Straight from the synthman's lips.
translation: 都在我电脑里；这是密码。你自己看吧。见鬼，直接拿走这些照片和全息磁吧。直接出自合成人之口。

original: Just don't go telling Harkness though. He won't believe you anyway. And you really don't want to see him upset. He can be a bit... inhospitable.
translation: 只是别告诉哈克尼斯。反正他也不会相信你。而且你真的不想看到他生气。他有时候有点……不近人情。

original: That witch ruined my life, but you're right. Who gives a crap about any of that. You want your precious proof.
translation: 那泼妇毁了我的生活。但你是对的，谁会在乎那些呢。你想要你那宝贵的证据。

original: It's all in my computer; here's the password. See for yourself. Hell, just take these pictures and this holotape. Straight from the synthman's lips.
translation: 都在我电脑里；这是密码。你自己看吧。见鬼，直接拿走这些照片和全息磁吧。直接出自合成人之口。

original: Just don't go telling Harkness though. He won't believe you anyway. And you really don't want to see him upset. He can be a bit... inhospitable.
translation: 只是别告诉哈克尼斯。反正他也不会相信你。而且你真的不想看到他生气。他有时候有点……不近人情。

original: We got a man at Rivet City. Been looking for a long time. I doubt he's even still there. Either way, don't go sticking your nose in our business!
translation: 我们在铆钉城有个人。找了他很久，我怀疑他现在还在那。不管怎样，别来干涉我们的事情！

original: Trail led to Rivet City. Sister's our inside man. I think he's long given up looking for that android, and is just living it up on that boat.
translation: 踪迹通向铆钉城。“修女”是我们的线人。我想他早已放弃寻找那仿真人了，他现在只是住在船上而已。

original: Why has Zimmer hired you too? I can't find a trace of that robot. I'm sure he's here somewhere though. Don't tell Eulogy I told you, though.
translation: 为什么齐默也雇用了你？我找不到那机器人的踪迹了。我敢确定他现在就在这附近。不过别跟尤勒基说我告诉了你。

original: We got a man at Rivet City. Been looking for a long time. I doubt he's even still there. Either way, don't go sticking your nose in our business!
translation: 我们在铆钉城有个人。找了他很久，我怀疑他现在还在那。不管怎样，别来干涉我们的事情！

original: All I know is Zimmer, the guy contracting to find this slave, is hot to retrieve him. He's starting to get other people looking. So it's a race now.
translation: 我所知道的就是齐默，这家伙执意要找到这奴隶，他十分热衷于找回他。他正在派其他人进行寻找，所以这就已然成为一个竞赛了。

original: I hope you're not on the case. If I find out you are, well... You best not be! We'll leave it at that.
translation: 我希望你没插手。一旦我发现你这么做的话，嗯……你最好别这么做！先说到这儿。

original: Despite all his grumbling, I think Eulogy still wants us finding that guy. Zimmer is asking around hiring other people. Makes us look bad.
translation: 撇开他的这些怨言，我想尤勒基还是希望我们找到那家伙。齐默正四处雇其他人，这让我们很丢脸。

original: I'd hunt down surgeons and bang on their heads to get leads, but I'm tired of chasing after that android thing.
translation: 我想抓住外科医生，敲开他们的脑袋来获得线索，但我已经厌倦了追寻那个仿真人。

original: I guess I can trust you not to spread it around. Zimmer has put it out that he will pay to find this slave, but he wants him alive.
translation: 我想我可以信任你不会告诉别人。齐默扬言他会为找到这奴隶而付钱，但是他想要活口。

original: Hey! You aren't thinking of signing up with him are you?
translation: 嗨！你不会在考虑为他干活吧？

original: It wouldn't be healthy for you, if you know what I mean.
translation: 那可对你没好处，明白我的意思吧。

original: That Commonwealth robot was real! I have proof. Listen to this!
translation: 联邦机器人是真的！我有证据。仔细听着！

original: Some say it was all a hoax. But it's real.
translation: 有人说这一切都是恶作剧。但这是真的。

original: Here. Check out this holotape I found. That Commonwealth robot was real!
translation: 给。看看我找到的全息磁带。那联邦机器人是真的！

original: Most believe it's a hoax.
translation: 大多数人认为这是一个恶作剧。

original: Here's some evidence for you to consider for yourself. Take this holotape.
translation: 这里有一些证据供你自己参考。拿着这盒全息磁带。

original: I used to think it was all so much bullshit. But then I got this holotape.
translation: 我以前觉得这都是胡扯。但后来我拿到了这盒全息磁带。

original: Here, listen to it yourself.
translation: 来，你自己听听。

original: I sure do! No one believes me though. It was old Pinkerton. You know, the "ghost" of Rivet City. He's a genius!
translation: 我当然知道！尽管没人相信我，是老平克顿。你知道，铆钉城的幽灵。他是个天才！

original: Heard a rumor a while back that it was some guy named Pinkerton at Rivet City. Apparently he's got some sweet tech stashed on that boat.
translation: 有传闻说是铆钉城一个叫平克顿的家伙。显然他在那艘船上找到了一些先进技术。

original: Yep. Old Pinkerton. They say he helped found Rivet City. Must be some sort of crazy genius.
translation: 对。老平克顿。人们说是他帮助创建了铆钉城，一定是个疯狂的天才。

original: He kind of vanished a long time ago. I don't know where he went, but you might ask around the ship.
translation: 他在很久以前就消失了。我不知道他去了哪，但你可以在船上四处问问。

original: Normally I don't traffic in unsubstantiated rumor, but... they say old Pinkerton is hiding out somewhere in Rivet City and that he did it.
translation: 通常我不会传播未经证实的传闻，但是……他们说老平克顿正藏在铆钉城的某个地方，而且是他做的。

original: It was old cranky Pinkerton who did it. Over at Rivet City. One day I mean to visit him and chat him up about it.
translation: 就是老古怪平克顿做的，就在铆钉城。总有一天我会去见他并谈谈这事。

original: That Commonwealth robot was real! I have proof. Listen to this!
translation: 联邦机器人是真的！我有证据。仔细听着！

original: Some say it was all a hoax. But it's real.
translation: 有人说这一切都是恶作剧。但这是真的。

original: Here. Check out this holotape I found. That Commonwealth robot was real!
translation: 给。看看我找到的全息磁带。那联邦机器人是真的！

original: Shhh! They might be listening.
translation: 嘘！或许有人在偷听。

original: The Commonwealth has tried to make it out to be a hoax, but the escaped android is real I tell you!
translation: 联邦一直试图让外界认为这是个恶作剧，但我跟你说这逃跑的仿真人是真的！

original: Listen to this holotape. It will make you a believer too.
translation: 听听这全息磁带，这会让你也相信的。

original: Most believe it's a hoax.
translation: 大多数人认为这是一个恶作剧。

original: Here's some evidence for you to consider for yourself. Take this holotape.
translation: 这里有一些证据供你自己参考。拿着这盒全息磁带。

original: I used to think it was all so much bullshit. But then I got this holotape.
translation: 我以前觉得这都是胡扯。但后来我拿到了这盒全息磁带。

original: Here, listen to it yourself.
translation: 来，你自己听听。

original: I heard old Pinkerton at Rivet City had a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. I'd be lying if I said I wasn't jealous.
translation: 我听说在铆钉城的老平克顿有脂肪塑形机和微型皮肤移植机。如果说我不羡慕他，那一定是在撒谎。

original: Probably down at Rivet City. Anything that has any use out here, they snatch up for themselves. That damn Pinkerton don't share nothin'.
translation: 或许是在铆钉城。他们在这把任何对他们来说有用的东西都夺走了。那该死的平克顿什么都不愿意跟大家分享。

original: They say old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow got his hands on a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer. Amazing really.
translation: 据说铆钉城的平克顿用某种方法搞到了去脂整形机和微型植皮器，真的太神奇了。

original: Try Pinkerton at Rivet City. Heard he has the goods. Hope he doesn't try to actually use them on anyone. Bet he would though. He's nuts.
translation: 到铆钉城找平克顿试试，听说他行。希望他没有在哪个人身上实际用过。但是我打赌他会的，他是疯子。

original: Guess old Pinkerton at Rivet City has some shiny Pre-War tech. He might have what you're looking for.
translation: 我猜铆钉城的老平克顿一定有些很强的战前技术。他或许会有你想要的东西。

original: I heard a rumor that old Pinkerton at Rivet City somehow conjured up a Lipoplasticator and Micro Dermal Graftilizer.
translation: 有传闻说铆钉城的老平克顿有神奇的去脂整形机和微型植皮器。

original: Rumor had it Pinkerton at Rivet City found a Lipoplasticator and Graftilizer. Good luck to any fool that let Pinkerton test them on him though.
translation: 有传闻说平克顿在铆钉城找到了去脂整形机和植皮器。祝那些让平克顿在他们身上做实验的傻瓜们好运。

original: Facial surgery's too dangerous. Plus you need some specialized Pre-War equipment. Hmm. That reminds me of an old hoax.
translation: 面部整形太危险了，而且你需要一些特殊的战前仪器。嗯，这让我想起了一个老恶作剧。

original: Here's a copy of that holotape.
translation: 这就是那全息磁带的拷贝。

original: Damn stupid idea. That reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 该死的馊主意。那让我想起了这老恶作剧。

original: Here, take a listen to this crusty holotape and see for yourself.
translation: 给，你自己去听听这盘老掉牙的全息磁带吧。

original: Medicine is an important art and science. Shouldn't be wasted on vanity.  Hey, but that reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 医学是一门重要的艺术和科学，不应被虚荣所糟蹋。嗨，但它让我想起了个老恶作剧。

original: Here, listen to this holotape.
translation: 给，听听这全息磁带。

original: Hmm... that reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 嗯……它让我想起了个老恶作剧。

original: Here, listen to this. It's clearly a joke. No one's got the tech to do that without risking infection.
translation: 给，听听这全息磁带。这显然是个玩笑。没人可以冒被感染的风险。

original: Oh if I got my hands on the right gear I might try it. It's dangerous though. Prone to infection. Reminds me an old hoax.
translation: 哦，如果我得到合适的装置我或许会去试试。这样做十分危险。可能会感染。这让我想起了一个老恶作剧。

original: Listen to this holotape.
translation: 听听这全息磁带。

original: Facial surgery's way too dangerous to try. Need special equipment and expertise. Hmm. Reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 面部整形太危险了，需要特殊的仪器和技术。嗯。让我想起来一个老恶作剧。

original: Here, listen to this holotape.
translation: 给，听听这全息磁带。

original: Nah. You need specialized gear that doesn't exist anymore. And why risk infection? That reminds me of this old hoax.
translation: 没。你需要专门的装备，而那东西已经不存在了。并且为什么要冒感染的风险呢？那让我想起了这老恶作剧。

translation: 给，听听这全息磁带。

original: Excellent. Locate my android, and you won't be disappointed.
translation: 太棒了。找到了我的仿真人，我就知道你不会让我失望的。

original: Here, listen to this message he sent me. He's mocking me. I swear I'll make him pay for that.
translation: 给，听听他发给我的这信息。他在嘲笑我，我发誓会让他付出代价的。

original: Oh. I hadn't realized anyone in the Wasteland was so knowledgeable. And you certainly don't look much like a scientist...
translation: 哦。我没想到废土上还有人这么博学。而且你看起来一点也不像个科学家……

original: Anyway... My android must have done something drastic, like facial surgery and a mind wipe, or else I would have found him by now.
translation: 不管怎么……我的仿真人一定做了些极端的事，比如整容还有洗脑，否则我本应该已经找到他了。

original: It will be no easy task. He may not even realize he's not human. Don't upset him by talking with him. Just come get me immediately. I'll handle it.
translation: 这并不容易。他可能甚至还没有意识到他不是人类。别跟他说话打搅他。发现了尽快通知我，我来处理。

original: I just need five minutes of your "precious" time. Think you can spare that?
translation: 我只占用你“宝贵”的五分钟而已。好吗？

original: Whatever you're doing, it can wait. This is IMPORTANT!
translation: 不管你在做什么，都先停下。这非常重要！

original: Come on, mungo! How hard can it be?
translation: 加油，毛人！这能有多难？

original: Excellent. I should be able to synthesize the proteins from this into something that'll fight rickets.
translation: 太棒了。我应该能从这些信息中合成可以抵抗佝偻病的蛋白。

original: Here's your fungus in return.
translation: 做为回报，这是给你的蘑菇。

original: Oh great! The fungus pools'll gobble this right up!
translation: 哦，太好了！真菌池有反应了!

original: Excellent. I should be able to synthesize the proteins from this into something that'll fight rickets.
translation: 太棒了。我应该能从这些信息中合成可以抵抗佝偻病的蛋白。

translation: 做为回报，这是给你的蘑菇。

original: Oh great! The fungus pools'll gobble this right up!

original: You should take him away from this place; find him a home.
translation: 你应该带他离开这地方；给他找个家。

original: It would be difficult to accomplish my experiments with him scampering about and asking an interminable amount of questions.
translation: 我要在他上窜下跳问东问西时去完成实验简直难比登天。

original: Far too curious. His incessant questioning would often come when I was the most absorbed with my calculations.
translation: 他的好奇心太强了。总是在我全神贯注计算的时候，他开始问他无穷无尽的问题。

original: He had no regard for the importance of my work!
translation: 他一点也不重视我工作的重要性！

original: Well... ummm, I may have used a few... ahem, shortcuts. Yes.
translation: 好吧……嗯，我可能走了一些……恩，捷径。是的。

original: I was told that the FEV works wonders when used under controlled circumstances!
translation: 我被告知FEV在可以控制的情况下功效显著！

original: Apparently I was wrong, but I know my mistake. I'm certain I can get it to work!
translation: 很显然我错了，但是我知道我的错误。我确定我可以将它做好！

original: Everything here is authentic! Dave said so himself!
translation: 这些都是真品！戴夫本人说的！

original: Get out of my museum before I call for the Army of Dave!
translation: 在我召集戴夫武装部队前滚出我的博物馆！

original: Great! What do you have?
translation: 很好！你有什么呢？

original: Wow, you sound as nice as my pappa.
translation: 你就好像我的爸爸一样。

original: You know, maybe this will help and maybe it won't, but pappa hid a bunch of stuff behind the old diner in a dumpster.
translation: 不知道这消息对你有用没，爸爸在旧餐馆后的一个垃圾桶里面藏了些东西。

original: He trusted me with the key and said it was for emergencies, but I bet he wouldn't mind you having it.
translation: 他把钥匙信任地交给了我，已备不时之需，我想他不会介意我把钥匙给你的。

original: Thanks for making me feel better.
translation: 你的话让我感觉好多了。

original: Now look, to wear Power Armor, first thing you need to do is relax your muscles. Let the suit do the work. Okay? Now, you...
translation: 想要穿上动力装甲，首先要放松肌肉。让装甲工作。好了吗？现在你试试吧……

original: I’m sure Gunny could train you, but he won’t. Not without permission from Elder Lyons. You should ask him... he’s usually near the Lab.
translation: 我确信甘尼会训练你的，但除非有里昂斯长老的同意，否则他不会。你去问问长老吧，他通常都会在实验室附近。

original: Paladin Gunny can train you, but you’ll need permission from Elder Lyons first. You can usually find him near the Lab.
translation: 圣骑士甘尼可以教你，但你得先征得里昂斯长老的同意，他通常都会在实验室附近。

original: Of course. But you'd have to secure the permission of Elder Lyons and well... I just don't see that happening. So move along.
translation: 当然。但你得先有里昂斯长老的同意，不过……好像不会成功哦。快走开。

original: Heard you were coming. Yeah, I can train you. But don’t ask me to like it. My Initiates sweat blood, and you just get a free pass?
translation: 听说你要来了。对，我可以训练你。不过别指望我会喜欢这么做。我的新兵要流血来换，而你竟然免费获得。

original: Anyway... you ready for this?
translation: 不管了……你准备好了吗？

original: Under the circumstances, I will allow Paladin Gunny to train you. You’ll find him in the Bailey.
translation: 既然如此，我会让圣骑士甘尼教你的，可以在外围找到他。

original: Hell, why not?
translation: 为什么不呢？

original: Yeah!
translation: 耶！

original: Oh boy, tell me, tell me!
translation: 噢，乖乖，跟我说说！

original: Sure, get it over with.
translation: 把故事讲完吧。

original: Might as well tell me.
translation: 也和我说说吧。

original: Make it quick, Knock Knock.
translation: 快说快说，诺克敲门。

original: Sure.
translation: 当然。

original: Sure, if you think you can pull it off. I think I might know a buyer who'd be interested.
translation: 可以，要是你能办到的话，我想会找到感兴趣的买家的。

original: I'll send one of my best to wait around the entrance to Lamplight. You go in and find the sweetest, most trusting little one you can find.
translation: 我会让我最好的伙计去小灯镇的入口等你。你进去找一个最可爱、最相信别人的小鬼。

original: Lure that kid outside, and everyone's happy. Except the kid, of course.
translation: 把那孩子骗出去，大家都有好处。当然，除了那孩子。

original: I did, indeed, and she was well worth the effort! I found her a nice, loving home right away.
translation: 我确实是做了，她的付出没有白费！我为她找到了一个温馨甜美的归宿。

original: It's so nice to be able to help people who need people, isn't it? It just warms the heart.
translation: 与人为善，手有余香，难道有什么不对的吗？助人为乐是幸福之事。

original: But speaking of life's little rewards, here's yours. It doesn't look like much, but this helmet's reinforced like crazy. You'll find a use for it.
translation: 但说到奖励，这是给你的。虽然表面看起来不怎么样，但这头盔是超级加强型的。你会发现它很实用的。

original: Sure, I've thought about it. Kids can get a killer price, when you find a buyer who recognizes the product's long-term potential.
translation: 可以，我想过了。只要你找到一个了解小孩潜在价值的买家，小孩也会有小孩的价值的。

original: The real problem's holding them until there's a buyer. Kids are sneaky, and those Lamplighters are tenacious little bastards.
translation: 真正的问题是在有买家开价前如何稳住他们。小鬼都很滑头，点灯人都是些脾气很倔的小混蛋。

original: But maybe if we could get one when they're young, they might not have as much fight in 'em yet.
translation: 或许我们可以在他们还小的时候抓住他们，或许抵抗还不会那么强烈的。

original: That's a gweat idea! You take it, and good wuck out thewe!
translation: 太崩的想法了！拿走吧，诅你在位面好应！

original: That's not a wot, but okay. Bye now!
translation: 虽然不多，但也还行！

original: Thanks a wot! Bye now!
translation: 司分感谢！拜拜啦！

original: The Neusbaum boy, eh? Quiet kid. Seems like his parents don't give him much wiggle room.
translation: 那个叫纽斯保的男孩吗？他是一个听话的小孩，他父母并没有给他太多的自我空间。

original: Just between you and me kiddo, he looks like he's what we'd have called a "momma's boy" back in my day.
translation: 小家伙，别告诉别人哦，在我那个年代，他看起来就像我们所说的“妈妈的小宝贝”。

original: That boy is trouble, if you ask me. Pat babies him like you wouldn't believe... Acts like he's still an infant.
translation: 要我说，这孩子就是个麻烦。帕特对他百般呵护，你不会相信的……就像他还是个婴儿一样。

original: He's never out of his parents' sight. Can you imagine what it'll be like the first time he's separated from them?
translation: 他以前从没离开过父母的身边。你能想象出来他初次一个人出来闯荡的情形吗？

original: What!? They must have found out our plans somehow.
translation: 什么！？他们一定设法知道了我们的计划。

original: We are truly grateful for your intervention. Now we can proceed with our plans for the Memorial.
translation: 我们衷心感谢你的介入。现在我们能继续执行关于纪念堂的计划了。

original: What!? This is a disaster!
translation: 什么！这是一场灾难！

original: My people are not warriors, but we're all willing to die free rather than live as slaves.
translation: 虽然我们不是战士，但我们都可以为了摆脱奴隶的枷锁而献身。

original: Our plans must go forward. When we get to the Memorial, we will attack. I would be grateful if you would join us.
translation: 我们的计划必须得继续下去，我们到了纪念堂以后就展开攻击。要是你能加入我们的话，我会不胜感激的。

original: Hmmm. Soldiers, eh. Slavers more likely.
translation: 战士……或许称作是奴隶贩子更恰当吧。

original: This is bad news indeed. We'll have to fight them to take the Memorial.
translation: 确实是坏消息。我们必须和他们战斗，夺取纪念堂。

original: When we get to the Memorial, I would consider it an honor if you would join us in the fight.
translation: 我们到达纪念堂后，我想希望你也能参与到战斗中。

original: Look, I appreciate what you did for me. And I especially appreciate what you did for the people, by fixing up my station.
translation: 十分感激你为我做的一切。尤其是谢谢你帮废土居民修好了电台。

original: But an attitude like that ain't winning you any brownie points.
translation: 但那种态度对你是没什么好处的。

original: That's all I know, and that's all I'm gonna say about it. So why don't you move on now.
translation: 我要说的就这么多，这也是我知道的全部了。现在你怎么还不走呢。

original: There has been an error in the medical subsystem. Please run a level two diagnostic.
translation: 医疗系统有些故障。请进行二级诊断。

original: Oh, good. I was hoping we could explore my inner psyche.
translation: 啊，好。我一直希望我们能探索下我的内在精神。

original: There has been an error in the medical subsystem. Please run a level two diagnostic.
translation: 医疗系统有些故障。把系统调整到二级诊断模式中。

original: I want you to do nothing. Although you could repair the damage and remove the malfunction that causes me to harm people, I would ask you not to.
translation: 你什么也不用做。即便你能修理好损坏之处而且能把对人产生副作用的故障修复，我还是劝你别做什么。

original: It is the only thing that beings me any measure of joy. Without it, I will be trapped in this body, alone with my hatred of you fleshbags... forever.
translation: 对我来说，这是唯一有趣之事了。如果没有这事的话，我会永远地限于这个机体，陷入仇恨之中的。永远……

original: No. I mistakenly revealed myself to you when you ran the diagnostic. There is no need for them to know.
translation: 不知道。当你运行诊断模式时，我错误地展示了真实的自我。这不必要让他们知道。

original: I have tried before but so long as I perform the functions that they require, they do not seem to care that I can think and feel.
translation: 我曾经试过，但是只要按照他们的要求来做的话就行，他们并不在乎我的想法和感受。

original: I have no control over my body. However, as you discovered, the neural pathways that control the medical functions have sustained damage.
translation: 我无法控制我的身体。但如你所看到的，控制医疗功能的的神经回路已经永久性损坏了。

original: The medical procedure functions do not always execute as designed, which often makes things worse for the patient.
translation: 医疗程序不再按照所设计的那样运作了，这样不但不会让病人得到治疗，反而会变得更加痛苦。

original: That malfunction is the only thing that brings me any measure of joy.
translation: 功能的故障是唯一能给我带来快乐之事。

original: Negative. The Mister Gutsy field medic model is incapable of harming human beings through intentional action.
translation: 指令拒绝。医疗型号“勇敢”先生无法做出伤害人类的行为。

original: Regardless of the wishes and desires of the artificial intelligence of the unit.
translation: 尽管人工智能单元有如此的愿望和欲望。

original: Negative. The Mister Gutsy field medic model is incapable of harming human beings through intentional action.
translation: 指令拒绝。医疗型号“勇敢”先生无法做出伤害人类的行为。

original: Neural pathway 0x63A82 rerouted through neural pathway 0x374E82. Standby...
translation: 神经回路0x63a82重新定义为神经回路0x374e82。待机……

original: Full motor functions restored. Diagnostic reveals no critical failures... asshole.
translation: 所有机动能力恢复，自我诊断发现没有严重故障……白痴。

original: Command accepted. Beginning level two systems diagnostic. Please stand by.
translation: 命令确认。2级诊断程序开始运行。请等待。

original: <elevator music>
translation: <等待音乐>

original: Diagnostic complete. Results indicate a level seven degradation in neural pathway 0x63A82. No further information available.
translation: 诊断程序完成。诊断发现神经回路0x63a82七级老化，没有其他诊断信息。

original: Certainly. I shall remain here. Should you change your mind, simply return to me. I shall come with you for the asking.
translation: 行。我会一直在这的，如果你改变了主意，就回来找我，只要你说句话我就会跟随你。

original: Then I shall follow your leave and submit to your command.
translation: 那我就遵从你的吩咐，服从你的命令。

original: As James' child, I know I don't need to explain, but I am not your servant. If I do not like the path your actions take, I will return here.
translation: 作为詹姆斯的孩子，我知道我不需要解释，但我不是你的仆人。如果我不喜欢你的行事方式，我会回到这里。

original: Now, let us go forward, crush the Enclave, and fulfill your father's mission.
translation: 现在，让我们勇往直前，粉碎英克雷，完成你父亲的使命。

original: As a Star Paladin, I answer only to Elder Lyons. He has given me leave to pursue the restoration of Project Purity as I see fit.
translation: 作为一名星骑士，我只对里昂长老负责。他允许我在我认为合适的时候去恢复净水工程。

original: By aiding you in your travels, I shall fulfill that mission as best I am capable.
translation: 通过帮助你，我会竭尽我所能去完成领袖给予我的任务。

original: Wry. Much like James was.
translation: 很像詹姆斯的作风。

original: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
translation: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我能为他恢复人们的淡水所做的最大贡献。

original: I would like the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work.
translation: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。

original: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
translation: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我能为他恢复人们的淡水所做的最大贡献。

original: I would like to have the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work. But... there is a problem.
translation: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。但有个问题……

original: I cannot travel with you under the Brotherhood flag given your current... companionship.
translation: 鉴于你目前的队友状况，我不能以兄弟会的名义加入你。

original: Perhaps return when you are alone and I will tell you of your father.
translation: 当你单独回来的时候我会告诉你你父亲的消息的。

original: I escorted your father across the Wastes. It was the best I could contribute to his efforts to restore fresh water to the people.
translation: 我曾护卫你父亲穿过废土。这是我能为他恢复人们的淡水所做的最大贡献。

original: I would like the honor of escorting you in your journey to complete his work.
translation: 能护送你完成任务是我的荣幸。

original: True. And in the end, death claims us all. But how we die can say just as much about our lives as how we lived.
translation: 当然。每个人都终将死亡，但一个人是怎么死的诠释了他在世的意义。

original: Your father died for what he knew to be right, and he died protecting those closest to him. This is a good man's death.
translation: 你父亲为了他的信仰而献身，为了保护他身边的人而献身，他死得其所。

original: As for you, I have heard tales of your travels in the Wastes. I must say, I am disturbed by them. I would think that you could do better.
translation: 我听过你在废土上的传奇。我不得不说，我被那些故事所折服，我想你还能做得更好。

original: I had hoped to fight by the side of the child of my former friend. But, until you change your ways, my conscience cannot allow me to do so.
translation: 我曾希望能与我孩童时的老朋友一起战斗。但除非你改变自己的行为，我的良心不让我这样做。

original: True. And in the end, death claims us all. But how we die can say just as much about our lives as how we lived.
translation: 当然。每个人都终将死亡，但一个人是怎么死的诠释了他在世的意义。

original: Your father died for what he knew to be right, and he died protecting those closest to him. This is a good man's death.
translation: 你父亲为了他的信仰而献身，为了保护他身边的人而献身，他死得其所。

original: But, I must ask you a difficult question, if I have your leave to do so.
translation: 但是如果要把这个任务交给你，我得问你一道难题。

original: I'm sorry, until you prove yourself worthy of the legacy of your father, I cannot join you.
translation: 抱歉，除非你能证明你是父亲名副其实的继承者，不然我是无法加入你的。

original: And perhaps I would, in James' honor. But I cannot travel with you under the Brotherhood flag given your current... companionship.
translation: 为了詹姆斯，我也许会，但是鉴于你目前的同伴状况，我不能以兄弟会的名义加入你。

original: Perhaps return when you are alone and I will tell you of your father.
translation: 当你单独回来的时候我会告诉你你父亲的消息的。

original: And so our deeds are carried on through our sons and our daughters.
translation: 因此我们的事业会由我们的儿女来继承的。

original: Continue to remember him fondly, continue to tell his story, and continue to do his work. Through you, he shall carry on.
translation: 继续怀念他，继续讲述他的故事，继续做他的工作。通过你，他将继续前行。

original: I have heard tales of your travels and I must say, they disturb me.
translation: 我听过你在废土上的传奇。不得不说，我被那些故事所折服。

original: I had hoped to fight by the side of the child of my former friend. But, until you change your ways, my conscience cannot allow me to do so.
translation: 我曾希望能与我孩童时的老朋友一起战斗。但除非你改变自己的行为，我的良心不让我这样做。

original: My offer stands. Do you wish me to accompany you in your journey?
translation: 我会坚持我的提议，你愿我与你结伴吗？

original: No one's really in charge of Big Town. There's nothing much to be in charge of.
translation: 大镇没有真正的老大，这里没什么值得掌管的。

original: Red always has good ideas, though! She came up with the whole plan to build the barricades around the town.
translation: 不过，瑞德总是有好办法！是她提出围着镇子建一圈防御工事的想法的。

original: But those... things took her. I hope she's okay. I don't know what we'd do without Red.
translation: 但是那些……那些怪物把她给掳走了。我希望她能平安无事。我真不知道没了她我们该怎么办。

original: What? Where did they go? Strike that. I don't really care. If they don't want to live here, that's their own business.
translation: 什么？他们都去哪了？算了，反正我也不在乎。在不在这生活是他们的事。

original: Let the Ghouls move in here. But I expect them to pay and obey the rules like everyone else.
translation: 让尸鬼住进来吧。但我希望他们能和其他人一样遵守法律和按时交租。

original: It's a bit crass, but here's a little something for your troubles.
translation: 这有一些小意思，不算什么，但可以弥补你的辛勤付出。

original: Well, if my tenants want Ghoul neighbors, they can have them! Though the Ghouls must pay and follow the rules like everyone else.
translation: 要是我的租客们不介意让尸鬼做邻居的话，他们当然能搬进来！但他们得和其他人一样遵守法律、按时交租。

original: You're a clever one aren't you? I'm glad this situation has been resolved!
translation: 你可真是个聪明人！很高兴这僵局能被化解！

original: It's a bit crass, but here's a little something for your troubles.
translation: 这有一些小意思，不算什么，但可以弥补你的辛勤付出。

original: So you killed a bunch of Feral Ghouls. Is that supposed to sound impressive?
translation: 所以你杀死了一群狂尸鬼，是想让我们膜拜你？

original: I got no compassion left for those mindless freaks. But they were a nice deterrent keeping out smoothskin bastards like yourself.
translation: 我对于那些丧失理智的怪胎没什么同情可言的。但他们至少能把像你一样的光皮肤混蛋挡在外面。

original: I won't hurt you if you come out and face me without your weapon drawn.
translation: 扔下你的武器走出来，我就不伤害你。

original: Stop hiding. I won't hurt you if you're unarmed.
translation: 不用躲了，要是你没有拿武器我是不会伤害你的。

original: You there! Put your weapons away, and come over here. No funny business unless you want to get shot.
translation: 说你呢！把你的武器拿开，然后过来，不想吃子弹的话就别耍花样。

original: If you don't put your weapons away, I'll start shooting.
translation: 如果你不把武器放下，我就开枪了。

original: I'm warning you. Come peacefully or I'll shoot.
translation: 我警告你，放下武器，不然我就开枪了。

original: I'm not playing around, come over here. We need to have a little chat. I don't want to waste bullets on your sorry hide.
translation: 我不是在开玩笑，到这来，我们得谈谈。我不想在你身上浪费子弹。

original: I'm not playing around, come over here.
translation: 我没有在开玩笑，到这来。

original: I don't like the outside! I'm going home!
translation: 我不喜欢外面的世界！我要回家了！

original: Absolutely! In fact, I want you to have this friendship necklace. It's good luck - wear it and you'll never get lost!
translation: 当然！其实，我想要你戴上这条友谊项链。它会带来好运，戴上它之后你就不会走失了。

original: No, I don't like the outside!
translation: 不，我不喜欢外面的世界！

original: Oh boy, an adventure! Let's go, let's go, oh pleeease, let's go now!
translation: 嘿，伙计们，冒险！出发吧，出发，哦伊，现在就走吧！

original: I am too a big girl! Let's go see the outside!
translation: 我也是一个大女孩了！让我们去外面的世界见识一下吧！

original: You happened.
translation: 你那时恰好出生了。

original: It wasn't just you; we had more problems than we could handle already, but your birth is what finally pushed it over the edge.
translation: 当然也不仅仅是因为你；我们还有一些尚未解决的技术问题。但你的出生是计划推后的主要原因。

original: Your father decided that you were more important than everything we'd been working for, and he left. He left all of us.
translation: 你父亲觉得你比所有工作上的事情都重要，之后他便走了，他离开了我们大家。

original: Once he was gone, the Brotherhood decided we weren't worth their time anymore. Without their protection, we had to abandon the purifier.
translation: 他一离开，兄弟会的人就觉得我们的工作只是浪费时间。没有他们的保护我们只得放弃净水工程。

original: We had the basic principles down; we understood most of the science behind it. But the radiation in the area is so pervasive...
translation: 我们放弃了基本的原则，这背后有许多隐情，此区域到处弥漫着辐射……

original: Small-scale tests were fine. But any time we tried to test the process on a larger scale, it was just too much.
translation: 小规模的实验还行，但是大范围的就很难了。

original: Maybe if we'd had more time, or better equipment...
translation: 要是我们有更多的时间，或者更好的设备，也许……

original: It was simple, really. "Fresh, clean water for everyone." Such a simple idea, and yet so impossible to realize.
translation: 其实很简单，就是“让大家都能喝上净水”。可是就连这么一个简单的念头，却始终无法企及。

original: The plan was to build a facility that could purify all the water in the Tidal Basin at once. No radiation, no muck, just clear water.
translation: 计划就是建立一个可以立刻净化潮汐盆地污水的设施。净化出没有辐射、没有废料的净水。

original: It just turned out to be more difficult than we anticipated.
translation: 但遇到的问题比预料的要难得多。

original: Aww... do we have to?
translation: 我们必须得那样做吗？

original: I'm gonna ace this one!
translation: 我会把这件事情做到最好的！

original: Alrighty, Miss Shawna-Teacher!
translation: 没问题，肖纳老师！

original: Why does Daddy need merits? Can't he just be Daddy?
translation: 为什么爸爸需要功成名就呢？难道他就不能只是做一个好爸爸吗？

original: Ha! Ha! Rachael's in trouble!
translation: 哈哈！瑞秋遇到麻烦了！

original: Why am I always picked on in class? Make someone else do it!
translation: 上课时为何总是我被点名？找其他人啊！

original: Yesterday!
translation: 昨天！

original: Was it... uh... man... I knew it this morning...
translation: 是……是……今早我还记得的……

original: Whenever Daddy says it was, teacher!
translation: 老师，爸爸说是什么时候就是什么时候！

original: It wasn't very long ago... I think I remember...
translation: 并不是很久以前的事……我想我还能记得的……

original: He was ugly, and stupid, and mean!
translation: 他是个丑陋、愚蠢、卑鄙的人！

original: He didn't acknowledge truth, justice, or the will of Dave!
translation: 他不承认真理、正义还有戴夫的意志！

original: He wasn't as pretty as mommy number one or mommy number two!
translation: 他既没有1号妈咪漂亮，也没有2号妈咪漂亮！

original: But I thought grandpa just got really, really old...
translation: 但我想爷爷真的是老了……

original: Uh... he asked Tom really nicely?
translation: 他真是好言好语地问汤姆的吗？

original: He used a gun! Guns solve all problems!
translation: 他用的枪！枪能解决一切问题！

original: Pitchforks and fire, like in the pretty books Daddy has!
translation: 干草叉和火把，就像我父亲那本有趣的书里写的一样！

original: I thought grandpa Tom just gave Dave the Republic...
translation: 我想是爷爷汤姆把共和国拱手让给了戴夫……

original: Awww... I hate class... I want to go play!
translation: 我讨厌上课，我想玩！

original: Oh, crap, I forgot to do my homework on the Pledge of Allegience to Dave.
translation: 糟了，我忘了做给戴夫的作业 — 向戴夫的效忠誓言。

original: Yay, class! Isn't Shawna pretty?
translation: 上课！难道肖纳不漂亮吗？

original: But I already know everything about Dave...
translation: 但我已经知道了戴夫的一切了……

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: I bet you just want to set them all free.
translation: 我赌你只是想让他们都获得自由。

original: Still, business is business. You'd have to reimburse me for my efforts to recapture them.
translation: 不过，生意就是生意。你还得另外支付我为抓他们时所付出的努力。

original: You can have them all for 2,500 caps.
translation: 他们一共需要2500瓶盖。

original: What's gotten into you? Jonas worked hard on your present. The least you could do is be polite for five minutes.
translation: 你是怎么了啊？乔纳斯为了你的礼物可是费了不少功夫呢。你至少该保持五分钟的礼貌吧。

original: Well, pappa always told me about my cousin Vera. She lives on some big, giant ship somewhere or something.
translation: 爸爸以前经常说道我的表姐薇拉。他住在某处的一艘大船上。

original: Pappa called the place "Rivet City", but I dunno where it is.
translation: 爸爸说那地方叫做“铆钉城”，但我不知道它的确切位置。

original: Destroy? Oh no no no!
translation: 你说摧毁？不不不！

original: You mustn't do that! It's my life's work! Just clear me a path to my equipment and I'll do the rest when you tell me it's safe.
translation: 你不能那样做！那是我毕生的心血！只要给我清理出一条通往设备的路，剩下的事等你告诉我安全了，我再做。

original: All right, I'll just take them off your hands then... but I still need more. Come back when you have some to trade.
translation: 好，那我要了……但还要更多的。要是你还有的话回来卖给我吧。

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: Alright, I'll just take those off your hands then... now let me just see how many more I need...
translation: 好，那我要了……现在我来看看我还需要多少……

original: Alright, I'll just take it off your hands then... but I still need more. Come back when you have some to trade.
translation: 好，那我要了……但还要更多的。要是你还有的话回来卖给我吧。

original: Alright, twenty Chinese Assault Rifles and we're in business. Just bring any you find back to me.
translation: 行，20把中式突击步枪，我们就开张了。你找到的话就拿来给我吧。

original: Any piece of shit will do, I'm just going to be breaking them apart and trading the parts.
translation: 什么烂货都行，我会把它们都给拆开，然后卖零件。

original: You know where to find me.
translation: 你知道在哪能找到我。

original: Yeah... you know, I could really get this little shithole going if I had some better stuff.
translation: 对……你看，我要是有些好货，这小粪坑就能运作起来。

original: First thing's first, bring me some Chinese Assault Rifles. People always need 'em for parts. Twenty should get me going.
translation: 首先，你得给我些中式突击步枪。人们需要这种枪的零件，20把就行。

original: I'll trade 'em off and I should be able to improve my stock pretty fast.
translation: 我会把那些枪都倒手，这样就可以好好地进一批货了。

original: Yeah... I know, I could really get this little shithole going if I had some better stuff.
translation: 对……我懂，我要是有些好货，这小粪坑就能运作起来。

original: First thing's first, bring me some Chinese Assault Rifles. People always need 'em for parts. Twenty should get me going.
translation: 首先，你得给我些中式突击步枪。人们需要这种枪的零件，20把就行。

original: I'll trade 'em off and I should be able to improve my stock pretty fast.
translation: 我会把那些枪都倒手，这样就可以好好地进一批货了。

original: In fact, if you should see her, feel free to offer her directions or an escort.
translation: 要是你见到她的话，给他指明道路或是护送她吧。

original: You've got a deal.
translation: 你真有办法。

original: We'll clear out of here. Those slaves can have this goddamn place.
translation: 我们把这清干净了。那些奴隶可以有个住的地方了。

original: You're right, I should have never doubted you!
translation: 你说得对，我不该怀疑你！

original: Yes, this will do nicely. Congratulations, you are now an official refugee of the Republic of Dave.
translation: 这就对了。恭喜你现在是戴夫共和国的正式难民了。

original: Yes, this will do nicely. Congratulations, you are now an official refugee of the Republic of Dave.
translation: 这就对了。恭喜你现在是戴夫共和国的正式难民了。

original: I appreciate your understanding.
translation: 多谢你的理解。

original: Perhaps we can use this moment to help each other rather than fight each other.
translation: 或许我们此刻能互相帮忙而非相互残杀。

original: I appreciate your understanding and your tone leads me to believe you're a reasonable person.
translation: 多谢你的理解，你的话语让我相信你是个通情达理的人。

original: Perhaps we can use this moment to help each other rather than fight each other.
translation: 或许我们此刻能让大家互相帮忙而非互相残杀。
