translation: 好的，我希望她能得到应有的下场。

original: No, sorry. I've left that part of my life behind.
translation: 不，对不起，我已经舍弃了我昔日的那种生活。

original: Who knows. Shoot myself up until I forget who I am?
translation: 谁知道呢。自我沉沦直到忘了我是谁？

original: The Wasteland sucks, kid. Just get used to it.
translation: 废土太糟糕了，孩子，学着习惯吧。

original: What key? Oh, that key.
translation: 什么钥匙？哦，那把钥匙。

original: You're a moron. I don't have any of his precious keys. Idiot.
translation: 你这蠢货。我没有他那把宝贝钥匙，白痴。

original: Help!
translation: 救命！

original: You're right. It's dangerous out here.
translation: 你是对的，外面很危险。

original: I... I have to go. Before more of them come.
translation: 我…我必须走了。等下他们会来更多人。

original: Here, thank you again! I'm going to try to make it home... if it's still there.
translation: 拿着，再次感谢你！我要试着回家……如果它还在的话。

original: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
translation: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。

original: "All hail the Overseer! We're born in the Vault, we die in the Vault!" And all that other assorted lunacy.
translation: “赞美监督者！我们生于避难所，我们死在避难所！”之类的各种疯言疯语。

original: Kid, you've got better programming than our own Deputy Weld. You'd best wise up quick. Wouldn't want anyone... takin' advantage of ya. Hmm?
translation: 孩子，你做事比我们的“副警长威尔德”更有计划。你最好快点明白。你不会希望有人……占你的便宜吧，对吧？

original: Aaahhhh. I see. You know, I heard about the brainwashin' that goes on down there. From some other fella, escaped, oh... five years back.
translation: 哈哈哈哈，我了解了，你知道吗，我从一些那里逃出来的家伙那儿打听到，那里有着某种洗脑活动……5年前的事了吧。

original: <whine>
translation: <哀鸣声>

original: I'll take that as a compliment.
translation: 我就当作是恭维了。

original: If we don't try to keep the mutants from killing everyone and everything in the Capital Wasteland, who will?
translation: 如果我们不去阻止超级变种人烧杀抢掠，还有谁会去？

original: The Brotherhood does its best, but sometimes it takes a little something... special. That's where the Lyons' Pride comes in.
translation: 兄弟会做得很好，但是有时会有一些特别的……任务，也就是“里昂斯的骄傲”参与的时候。

original: Hahahaha! Irving! Are you serious?
translation: 哈哈！艾尔文！你说真的吗？

original: Oh man... wait until the other guys hear this... Irving!
translation: 哦，哥们…让其他人来听听吧……艾尔文！

original: Here's the pool. You earned it!
translation: 给你，这是你赚的！

original: Maybe that's because I don't want to be found.
translation: 或许那是因为我不想被找到。

original: I guess I shouldn't be surprised that you're here. I figured Evan King would get someone to track me down sooner or later.
translation: 对于你的到来，我并不应该感到惊讶。我早就猜到埃万·金迟早会派人来找我。

original: Yeah, I guess I should have known this would happen.
translation: 嗯，我想我早就应该知道这事会发生。

original: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
translation: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！

original: I think I had it all wrong. I shouldn't have come here. I bet Lucy is feeling just as bad as me.
translation: 我想我完全错了。我不该来这鬼地方，我发誓露西现在心里和我一样难受。

original: Go back to Arefu and tell Evan King that I'm coming home. I have a few things to pack and I want to say my goodbyes to this place... alone.
translation: 回阿雷富去告诉埃万·金，我要回家了。我还有些东西要收拾，想一个人跟这个地方道别……

original: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
translation: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！

original: I think I had it all wrong. I shouldn't have come here. I bet Lucy is feeling just as bad as me.
translation: 我想我完全错了。我不该来这鬼地方，我发誓露西现在心里和我一样难受。

original: Please, tell Vance I've made my decision. I'm going home to Arefu. I hope to see you there as well.
translation: 求你了，告诉万斯我下了决心，我要回阿雷富的家。希望在那见到你。

original: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
translation: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！

original: I think I had it all wrong. I shouldn't have come here. I bet Lucy is feeling just as bad as me.
translation: 我想我完全错了。我不该来这鬼地方，我发誓露西现在心里和我一样难受。

original: Go back to Arefu and tell Evan King that I'm coming home. I have a few things to pack and I want to say my goodbyes to this place... alone.
translation: 回阿雷富去告诉埃万·金，我要回家了。我还有些东西要收拾，想一个人跟这个地方道别……

original: Maybe you're right. It was easier to run away with the Family than to face what I did.
translation: 或许你是对的。跟着家族逃避总比正视自己的所作所为来得容易。

original: Go back to Arefu and tell Evan King that I'm coming home. I have a few things to pack and I want to say my goodbyes to this place... alone.
translation: 回阿雷富去告诉埃万·金，我要回家了。我还有些东西要收拾，想一个人跟这个地方道别……

original: She... she really misses being home and she's asked about me in here a lot!
translation: 她……她真心怀念我们一家人团团圆圆的日子，她还问我现在的情况！

original: You have no idea how much this means to me. Thanks so much!
translation: 你不知道这对我有多重要。真心感谢你！

original: Umm... Well... Ahhh... Sure... Uh...
Ha ha! You talk a lot! Sound funny when you talk, like a stupid human. Ha ha ha ha ha!
translation: 哈！你话好多！你说话的时候真搞笑，就像愚蠢的人类。哈哈哈哈哈！

original: This is boring. We should be collecting more humans. We need more of us! The bucketheads have killed too many...
translation: 无聊呢。我们应该多收集些人类。我们需要更多帮手！水桶脑袋杀死了太多……

original: I have joke for you. Ready? Knock knock.
translation: 我给你说个笑话。准备好了没？诺克敲门。

original: You've definitely proven your worth. I'll make sure to tell our people on patrol that you're a friend of the Outcasts.
translation: 你确实证明了你的价值。我保证会通知在巡逻中的伙伴，你是我们放逐者的朋友。

original: Useful stuff out there. Hope you don't have to use too much.
translation: 在外面很有用。希望你不会常用。

original: Can't stand this stuff, myself. Goes through me like a rampaging Brahmin.
translation: 我受不了这东西，用了后我的体内就像有只在狂奔的双头牛。

original: Here. Everyone's favorite. What would we do without them?
translation: 给，每个人都喜欢它。要是没有这玩意，我们该怎么活？

original: Here, enjoy them in good health. Or, at least, when you'd like to be in good health.
translation: 给，你要是受了伤就来上一针。它至少可以让你活得久一点。

original: Be careful. These can pack quite a pop.
translation: 小心，它会爆的。

original: Always a popular choice, these. Enjoy.
translation: 很多人都选它。好好享受。

original: Here you go. Try not to use it all in one place, unless you have to.
translation: 给你。如非必要，不要一次用光。

original: Here's hoping you don't have to use it. But who am I kidding?
translation: 希望它用不上。可是我在骗谁呢？

original: It's practically junk, but we can get some use out of it.
translation: 它实际上是垃圾，但我们能变废为宝。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: It's practically junk, but we can get some use out of it.
translation: 它实际上是垃圾，但我们能变废为宝。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: Interesting. Very interesting.
translation: 有趣。非常有趣。

original: This definitely bears some study. Now, how would you like your payment?
translation: 有一定的研究价值。你想要什么回报？

original: What in the world?
translation: 到底是什么？

original: Yes, I think the boys down in the lab would be very interested in this. You did right to bring this to us!
translation: 是的，我想实验室的男孩们会对这玩意非常感兴趣。把它给我们你算是找对了人！

original: Now, what would you like in return for this amazing find?
translation: 为了这一惊人的发现，你想要什么回报？

original: Pretty rare piece of equipment, this. Good find.
translation: 非常稀有的装备。好手段。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: Pretty rare piece of equipment, this. Good find.
translation: 非常稀有的装备。好手段。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: We can always use another one of these.
translation: 这些东西对我们来说总是多多益善。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: We can always use another one of these.
translation: 这些东西对我们来说总是多多益善。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: This is some pretty heavy-duty stuff. We'll take good care of it.
translation: 相当耐用的东西。我们会好好保管。

original: Now, what can I give you in return?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: Well I'll be damned. The Advanced Power Armor Mark II. This is superb. Absolutely superb.
translation: 我的天，先进动力装甲II型。一级棒，绝对一流。

original: Now, what can I give you in return?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: You'd better believe it. I haven't seen a suit like this in a long time.
translation: 信不信，我很久没见过这样的装备了。

original: And what would you like for this little surprise?
translation: 那你想要什么作为这个小惊喜的报酬？

original: Not much good on its own, but the optics are useful, at least.
translation: 它本身并不太好，但至少目镜很有用。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: Always good to have another of these in the vaults.
translation: 这东西在避难所里当然是多多益善。

original: How'd you like your payment?
translation: 你想要什么回报？

original: I see you've got some of our Power Armor there. I'll just take that off your hands.
translation: 我看见你带着我们那种动力装甲。我就要它了。

original: I'm sure you just found it in the Wastes and you're returning it to us, right? Because you'd have to be a real moron to try to turn it in for pay.
translation: 我相信你是在废土找到它，拿来还给我们的，对吧？想用它来换钱，你还真是个白痴。

original: Now, let's see what else you've got.
translation: 让我看看你还有什么。

original: Let's see what you've got.
translation: 让我看看你都有些什么。

original: Suit yourself. Why don't you go talk with Lyons? He's always got time for your kind.
translation: 随你便。你为什么不找里昂斯谈谈？他总是有时间来应对你这种人。

original: Okay, but first you'll have to talk with Protector Casdin. You can work out the details with him.
translation: 好吧，但你要先和卡斯丁保护者谈谈。他能帮你出出主意。

original: It's simple enough. Bring in technological devices, and we'll pay you for what you find.
translation: 再简单不过。把你找到的科技装置带给我们，我们付你报酬。

original: Big things like power armor or energy weapons are best, but we'll take things like sensor units or spare parts, too. You never know what's important.
translation: 像动力装甲、能量武器这样的大玩意是最好不过，不过传感器或其他零件这些垃圾我们也照单全收。天晓得什么东西会有用。

original: In return, we'll pay you with your choice of 5.56 ammo, grenades, stimpaks, or Rad-Away. I'll bet they're more useful to you out there, anyway.
translation: 作为回报，你可以从5.56弹药、手榴弹、治疗针或消辐宁里选一样。我保证它们物超所值。

original: Well, that depends on who you ask.
translation: 嗯，这取决于你问的是谁。

original: Lyons will tell you it's because we're protecting the poor, innocent people of the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 里昂斯会告诉你我们是为了保护首都废土贫困和无辜的人民。

original: Most others here will tell you the same thing. They'll do anything for that man.
translation: 这里大多数的人都会这么说。他们愿意为这个人赴汤蹈火。

original: The, um... Mechanist and the AntAgonizer. That's just what they call themselves. It's ridiculous, I know...
translation: 嗯……机械侠和痛苦蚁后。他们这么称呼自己。我知道这很滑稽……

original: A while ago, we were attacked by the AntAgonizer - that woman with the ants, obviously. The Mechanist saved the town with his robots.
translation: 我们刚才被痛苦蚁后攻击了，就是那个带着蚂蚁的女人。机械侠带着他的机器人救了镇子。

original: That was all well and good, but I swear their fights are getting bigger, and it's been driving off the merchants. They simply won't leave!
translation: 那也好，不过我敢发誓他们的战斗不断升级，商人也被赶跑了。他们完全不肯离开！

original: Uh... maybe you should sit in the corner. I can check to see if we have any squirrel if you wish.
translation: 嗯……或许你应该到角落找个位置坐下，我去看看还有没有松鼠肉。

original: That's pretty underhanded, even for Bannon.
translation: 这事对班侬来说都显得下作了。

original: Once word gets out, I bet the market vendors won't want him to represent them anymore.
translation: 这事一旦公布出去，我打赌市场的商人们不会再让他当代表了。

original: Thank you for your help, citizen.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助，公民。

original: A threat? No, of course not! Well, maybe. He wants to replace me on the council.
translation: 威胁？不，当然不是！好吧，也许是。他想取代我在议会的位置。

original: He's a shady character, I just can't prove it. Now if someone were to find something incriminating in his room...
translation: 他是个阴险的人，我只是不能证明这一点。如果谁能去他的房间找到一些控告他的罪状……

original: Well, let's just say I would be very appreciative.
translation: 嗯，我只能说，我会非常感激的。

original: So you've met him, eh? Well he wants to replace me on the council. Now, I can't have that. No siree.
translation: 你见过他了？呵，他想要取代我在议会的位置。我不会让他美梦成真的。没门。

original: He's a shady character, I just can't prove it. If someone were to find something incriminating in his room...
translation: 他是个阴险的人，我只是不能证明这一点。如果谁能去他的房间找到一些控告他的罪状……

original: Well, let's just say I would be very appreciative.
translation: 嗯，我只能说，我会非常感激的。

original: All right! You and me, just hangin'.
translation: 好吧！你和我，一起干。

original: Here? In Rivet City?
translation: 在这？铆钉城？

original: I'm packing and most of the rest of these guys are packing. Not to mention security.
translation: 这里的人都带着家伙。安全不成问题。

original: I don't put the good stuff out on the table. If you're interested, I can show you the stuff in the locker.
translation: 我没把好东西摆出来。你要是有兴趣，我可以向你展示一下锁柜里的东西。

original: In the year before you were born, things became difficult.
translation: 在你出生的前一年，事情变得很棘手。

original: There had always been something of a "mutants problem" in the city, but it became worse. They attacked more frequently, and more aggressively.
translation: 城里一直都有“变种人问题”，但情况变得更糟了。他们的攻击更加频繁，也更加凶猛。

original: Support for the project eroded as time went on, when we couldn't produce any significant results. Progress came to a halt. And then you were born.
translation: 随着时间推移，由于我们无法取得任何显著成果，对该工程的支持逐渐减弱。进展停滞。然后你就出生了。

original: Your mother and I had talked about what to do when that time came, but then I... We lost her, and I had to make a decision. I chose to leave.
translation: 你母亲和我曾经讨论过到那时该怎么办，但是后来……我们失去了她，我不得不做出决定。我选择离开。

original: From what I understand, things happened quickly after that. It became too dangerous for the others to stay, and so the project was abandoned.
translation: 就我所知，那之后的事发展得很快。其他人留下来太危险了，所以工程被放弃了。

original: Doctor Li and her team left for what became Rivet City, and Project Purity has sat waiting ever since.
translation: 李博士和她的团队去了后来的铆钉城，净水工程就此一直搁置了。

original: It started as an idea, really. Remember the Bible passage your mother loved so much?
translation: 它开始是一个理想，真的。还记得《圣经》中你妈妈最喜爱的话吗？

original: Free, clean water for everyone. What a difference it could make in the lives of everyone here in the Wastes.
translation: 每个人都能喝上免费、干净的水。多么的不可思议，它能够影响这蛮荒世界中每个人的命运。

original: Over time, that idea took the form of a purifier. Not like the one in the Vault, though.
translation: 随着时间推移，理想终成现实，虽然它和避难所的有所不同。

original: This one was gigantic, capable of purifying millions of gallons of water at once.
translation: 这是一个庞然大物，能够瞬时提纯数百万加仑的水。

original: We used the old Jefferson Memorial for the location, right on D.C.'s Tidal Basin. Someday soon, I hope you'll see it work.
translation: 我们把它建在老杰斐逊纪念馆，正好在特区的潮汐盆地。有朝一日，我希望你会看到它运作。

original: Head back downstairs. The one you're looking for is underneath the mainframe room, I think.
translation: 回到楼下，我想你要找的就在主机下面。

original: Sure, I can fix most anything. Let me see what you've got.
translation: 当然，大多数东西我都能修。让我看看你要修什么。

original: Pain is your friend.
translation: 痛苦是你的朋友。

original: First you took away my uncle, and now you took away them, too?
translation: 你先是赶走了我叔叔，你现在也赶走了他们？

original: Fine - here! Take it and go away forever!
translation: 很好 — 给你！拿走，永远别回来！

original: You got it. Use it well, and take down some more Muties with it for us.
translation: 你说对了。好好用它，用它为我们干掉更多的变种人。

original: Consider this place your home away from home. If you're ever in the neighborhood again, you're more than welcome to take shelter here.
translation: 把这当你自己的家。你以后要是经过附近，我们将非常欢迎你到这来。

original: I guess that does it. See you 'round, kid.
translation: 就这样，回见，孩子。

original: The armor it is. Wear it with pride, kid. We do.
translation: 这是你的装甲，自豪地穿上它吧，孩子。我们都是如此。

original: Consider this place your home away from home. If you're ever in the neighborhood again, you're more than welcome to take shelter here.
translation: 把这当你自己的家。你以后要是经过附近，我们将非常欢迎你到这来。

original: I guess that does it. See you 'round, kid.
translation: 就这样，回见，孩子。

original: Well, if you've picked the Mutie corpses clean, there isn't much else to scrounge.
translation: 哦，你要是把变种人的尸体都搜遍了，那就没有其他地方可以找了。

original: I dunno if you came across it or not, but one of our guys dropped on the second floor stairwell. He had an ammo crate with him.
translation: 我不知道你有没经过二楼的楼梯间，我们一个兄弟掉到了那里。他身上有一个弹药箱。

original: We lost a good man on the retreat to this godforsaken roof. Theo. Newest guy in the group too.
translation: 我们撤到这荒凉的楼顶上时，失去了个好同伴。西奥，最近加入队伍的新兵。

original: He got killed on the second floor stairwell of the hotel. He was carrying our ammo supply with him.
translation: 他死在旅馆的二楼楼梯间，他随身带着我们的弹药补给。

original: Here, let me give you the code. The more ammo we have the better!
translation: 给你密码。弹药越多越好！

original: On our way to the roof, one of our guys got scragged. Poor son-of-a-bitch got blown apart by a frag.
translation: 我们去楼顶的路上，一个兄弟挂了。可怜的家伙被手榴弹炸开了花。

original: I think he went down on the second floor stairwell of this place. You find him, and you'll find his ammo crate.
translation: 我想他掉到了二楼楼梯间。你找到他，就会找到弹药箱。

original: We lock that stuff so the Muties can't steal what's inside.
translation: 我们把东西锁起来，这样变种人就偷不到里面的东西了。

original: Yeah, here you go. It's all I've got.
translation: 是的，给你。我只有这些了。

original: Sorry. I only had one Stimpak to spare. Hang in there.
translation: 抱歉，我只有一个治疗针，坚持住。

original: Injuries? You look fine to me.
translation: 受伤？依我看你很好。

original: HAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: FATHER! NO!
translation: 父亲！不！

original: He put water in my vodka to make more caps from me. Make the drink weak and try to charge me more!
translation: 他往我的伏特加里掺水，想骗我花更多瓶盖。在酒里掺水好收我更多钱！

original: Maybe the next bartender, he won't be stupid, eh? HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
translation: 或许下个酒保不会像他这么蠢，呃？哈哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Curious. Many years ago, I survived by drinking from fresh bloodpacks I recovered from hospital ruins.
translation: 有意思。许多年前，我喝了从医院废墟里找到的新鲜血浆袋活了下来。

original: The problem was that these bloodpacks were scarce.
translation: 问题是这些血浆袋很稀少。

original: What do you propose?
translation: 你的想法是什么？

original: Yeah, I got some stuff around here. But it'll cost you.
translation: 是的，我在这附近找到了一些东西，但得花掉你不少钱。

original: No problem at all.
translation: 完全没问题。

original: Sure will. Sure will...
translation: 一定，一定……

original: Please, keep doing what you do.
translation: 加油，再接再励。

original: Okay, let's get this over with. Cycle the airlock, will you?
translation: 好吧，让我们做完，打开气密门，好吗？

original: Yeah, it is nice. I don't even sleep without it under my pillow.
translation: 没错呢。它不在我枕头底下我都睡不着。

original: My father made gun ammunition for a living. Taught me everything about how firearms work.
translation: 我父亲靠制造枪支弹药生活，他还教会了我枪械的工作原理。

original: So, I've spent my downtime tinkering with guns like my 10mm Ultra SMG here. It's like a hobby I guess.
translation: 所以我把休息时间都花在了摆弄枪支上，就像我的这把10毫米极致冲锋枪。我想这是我的业余爱好。

original: What?!
translation: 什么？！

original: Oh... oh my god! That's his voice! It's really him!
translation: 哦……天啊，是他的声音，真的是他！

original: I can't believe you brought this to me. I don't know what to say but thank you.
translation: 真不敢相信你把这个带给了我。我不知道该说什么，但谢谢你。

original: Wait! Here, take my 10mm Ultra SMG. It's never let me down. Besides, I won't really need it anymore.
translation: 等等！给，拿上我的10毫米极致冲锋枪。它从没让我失望过。而且，我不再需要它了。

original: By bringing this to me, do you realize you've both just written yourselves into the history books?
translation: 你意识到了吗，把这给我，意味你们将自己载入了史册？

original: You're both true American heroes and will be remembered for this glorious day!
translation: 你们都是真正的美利坚英雄，这荣耀的一天会永远被后世铭记！

original: Sydney's name will forever be memorialized for her great sacrifice. She was a patriot and will be missed.
translation: 因为她的牺牲，希妮这个名字将永远被铭记。她是爱国者，会被后人缅怀。

original: But enough of that. Allow me to present you with some sort of compensation for your deed.
translation: 不多说了。请允许我为你的行为赠予一些报酬。

original: By bringing this to me, do you realize you've both just written yourselves into the history books?
translation: 你意识到了吗，把这给我，意味你们将自己载入了史册？

original: You're both true American heroes and will be remembered for this glorious day!
translation: 你们都是真正的美利坚英雄，这荣耀的一天会永远被后世铭记！

original: But enough of that. Allow me to present you with some sort of compensation for your deed.
translation: 不多说了。请允许我为你的行为赠予一些报酬。

original: I will award Sydney's promised bounty to her personally. No need to worry yourself about that.
translation: 我会按照约定把奖金给希妮的，这你就不必担心了。

original: By bringing this to me, do you realize you've just written yourself into the history books?
translation: 你意识到了吗，把这给我，意味你将自己载入了史册？

original: You're a true American hero and will be remembered for this glorious day!
translation: 你是真正的美利坚英雄，这荣耀的一天会永远被后世铭记！

original: But enough of that. Allow me to present you with some sort of compensation for your deed.
translation: 不多说了。请允许我为你的行为赠予一些报酬。

original: By bringing this to me, do you realize you've just written yourself into the history books?
translation: 你意识到了吗，把这给我，意味你将自己载入了史册？

original: You're a true American hero and will be remembered for this glorious day!
translation: 你是真正的美利坚英雄，这荣耀的一天会永远被后世铭记！

original: But enough of that. Allow me to present you with some sort of compensation for your deed.
translation: 不多说了。请允许我为你的行为赠予一些报酬。

original: What? You have the Declaration? Unbelievable!
translation: 什么？你有宣言？难以置信！

original: Are you certain this time? Or is this another joke?
translation: 这次你确定吗？不是又在开玩笑？

original: Would you believe... "no"? It's pathetic, really, considering we've been fighting those abominations for nearly twenty years.
translation: 你相信吗……“不”？真可悲啊，我们已经跟那些鬼玩意战斗了近20年。

original: In all that time, all we've managed to do is to contain the threat. Hold them back, so they don't overrun every blasted settlement out here.
translation: 在这段时间里，我们所能做的就是遏制威胁。顶住他们，这样他们就不会泛滥到每一个该死的定居点。

original: But we don't really "know" anything. Where they're from, why they've infested the D.C. ruins.
translation: 但我们真的是一无所“知”。他们从哪来，他们为什么会在特区废墟大批滋生。

original: And now here we are, holed up in our Citadel. Low on resources, low on troops. It's enough to make an old man so very... tired.
translation: 看看现在，我们躲在大本营里，缺资源、少军队，这些足以让一个老人觉得……身心疲惫。

original: Sure. I pinched this from his table. He never even saw me.
translation: 给，我从他的桌上顺的，他根本没看到我。

original: I can get you some more by tomorrow.
translation: 我明天可以给你更多。

original: You... You really believe that?
translation: 你……你真那么想？

original: When I read that comic, it explained so much. Where I came from, who I was destined to be, what I had to do...
translation: 当我读到那本漫画，它给了我很多答案，我从哪来，我的命运，我必须做什么……

original: But it never said the AntAgonizer could ever have a chance to go back to being normal. It never said I had a chance...
translation: 但它从没提及，痛苦蚁后可能永远也没有机会回到原来的样子，它没有提到我有机会……

original: Please... I think I've made some terrible mistakes. If you really think I still have a chance, just let me go.
translation: 拜托……我想我犯了些可怕的错。如果你真的觉得我还有机会，让我走吧。

original: I'll give you the suit. No one ever has to see the AntAgonizer again. Just please, let me have another chance.
translation: 我会给你这件套装。没有人会再见到痛苦蚁后。拜托，再给我一个机会。

original: There has been an error in the medical subsystem. Please run a level two diagnostic.
translation: 医疗系统有些故障。请进行二级诊断。

original: You're asking me what I think about the Enclave?
translation: 你问我对英克雷的看法？

original: Well... The Brotherhood of Steel has actually faced the Enclave before. Back West. More than thirty years ago, according to our chronicles.
translation: 嗯……根据我们的编年史，早在30年前，钢铁兄弟会事实上就已经在西部和英克雷打交道了。

original: Judging from those records, I'd say their soldiers are outfitted in Advanced Power Armor Mark II. It's... pretty strong. Better than our Power Armor.
translation: 从那些记录来看，我得说他们的士兵配备了先进的二型动力装甲。它……相当坚固，比我们的动力装甲要好。

original: And some of their technology is amazing! Vertibirds! Plasma weapons that can turn a man to goo!
translation: 他们的一些技术令人称奇！飞鸟！等离子武器能把人变成灰烬！

original: Does... that help?
translation: 那些……有用吗？

original: Oh yes! I've studied them quite a bit since I've been here!
translation: 哦，是的！自从我来这后，就一直在研究他们！

original: They're not all the same, you know. Besides the regular ones, there are also Brutes. And after them, the Masters -- they're really tough.
translation: 他们不是千篇一律的，你知道。除了普通的，他们还有一些狂人。他们上面还有霸主……那些真的很强悍。

original: But the worst of all? The Behemoth! He's a giant! I saw one once, outside the Citadel walls. Sooo scary.
translation: 但最恐怖的是谁？超级变种巨人！对，是超级变种巨人！我从前看到过一个，就在大本营的墙外。真可怕。

original: The Super Mutants are all over the city ruins, but Elder Lyons doesn't actually think they're from there, or we would have found their home by now.
translation: 超级变种人布满了这城市的废墟，但里昂斯长老觉得他们实际上来自别处，否则我们早就找到他们的巢穴了。

original: It kind of seems like they're looking for something, but we're not really sure what that is.
translation: 他们好像在找什么，不过我们不知道会是什么。

original: Sure sure. I got it all. Check it out.
translation: 当然，当然，我都带着。你看看。

original: Sure thing, man. Sure thing.
translation: 没问题，兄弟。没问题。

original: Why do you think I ride these Initiates so hard? I make training hell so fighting those Uglies won't be.
translation: 你觉得我为什么要对这些新兵这么狠？我进行地狱式的训练，等他们对付丑八怪时就容易了。

original: There's meat under that armor, and meat can be ground.
translation: 穿着装甲的肉，也是能被打倒的肉。

original: Targets confirmed westbound. Move to intercept.
translation: 目标确认向西移动，前去阻截。

original: Fine. I'll practice on someone else. Thanks for nothing.
translation: 好吧。我会找其他人试试。不谢了。

original: Tell you what. Let's hook up later and go see Scribe Bowditch. I heard he's been working on some new Power Armor mods. Can't hurt.
translation: 告诉你，我们迟点一起去看看鲍蒂奇学士。我听说他正在研究一些新的动力装甲插件。反正没损失。

original: It used to be part of the Museum of History. The exhibit that used to be here was focused on what happens after death: hell and whatnot.
translation: 它过去是历史博物馆的一部分。展览的主题是身后之事：地狱之类的。

original: A lot of it was focused on this old book called "Paradise Lost." It's about a guy who goes to Hell. Pretty interesting stuff.
translation: 还有一些展览集中在这本叫《失乐园》的古书上。它说的是一个家伙下了地狱，相当有意思的东西。

original: I found a big box of copies of the book in one of the back rooms.
translation: 我在一间辅助库房找到了一大箱这书。

original: Here, take one. Nobody around here wants 'em.
translation: 给你一本，这里谁也不要它。

original: Oh, that's wonderful news! I'm so glad! If you see him, please tell him that his mother misses him and loves him and that I hope he's happy.
translation: 哦，令人愉快的消息！我真高兴！你要是看见他，请告诉他，他的妈妈想念他，爱他，我希望他快快乐乐。

original: But, he shouldn't come visit. It's too dangerous. No, no. He should stay put where he is.
translation: 但是，他不应该来这，那太危险了。不，不，他应该待在那。

original: Enjoy your stay. Just... try and keep from shooting up the place.
translation: 玩得开心。只是……别在这开枪。

original: We've got a nice little deal going on down here. We'd like to keep it nice.
translation: 我们在这下面的营生还不错。我们希望保持下去。

original: Enclave strength is at 100%. They're getting reinforcements from somewhere, but we still haven't determined the location of their headquarters.
translation: 英克雷的兵力达到了100%，他们显然从其他地方获得了增援，但我们始终没法确定他们的总部位置。

original: Super Mutant activity in D.C. is high, but nothing out of the ordinary. The area around Galaxy News Radio is... nearly secure.
translation: 超级变种人在特区很活跃，但还没有超过正常范畴。银河新闻电台周围……基本安全。

original: Enclave troops have fortified the purifier complex. With those vertibirds, they're able to transport personnel at a remarkable rate.
translation: 英克雷军队加强了净化器的防守力度。利用那些飞鸟，他们能高效率地运送人员。

original: There's been another Behemoth sighted in the Wasteland, in the Evergreen Mills region. That's heavy Raider country, so things could get interesting.
translation: 在废土的常青工厂那一带，发现了另一个超级变种巨兽。那地方是掠夺者的巢穴，所以事情可能会很有趣。

original: It appears the Enclave troops have moved beyond the purifier, into the surrounding Wasteland region. No telling how far they might spread.
translation: 似乎英克雷的军队已经由净化器出发，进入了周围的废土地区。不知道他们将渗透到多远。

original: All right, Rothchild. Fire it up. Pride, move out!
translation: 好的，罗斯查德，点火，“里昂斯的骄傲”，开始行动！

original: It's called economics, kid. You got something I want and I got something you want. Nothing's free.
translation: 孩子，这就叫经济学。你有我要的，我有你要的，没有免费的午餐。

original: I told you the favor would earn you some caps if you really took care of it. Now, fork 'em over!
translation: 我告诉过你这个忙你要是认真的帮了我，就能够让你赚很多。现在，交出来！

original: How can you be so rude when I'm going to provide you with such a useful public service?
translation: 当我要提供给你这么有用的公益服务时，你怎么能这么粗鲁？

original: Your dad came through here, all right. Didn't stay long, though. Said he had some important business to attend to, and headed off to the city.
translation: 你爸爸确实来过这。但待得时间不长。他说有些重要的事情要处理，就一直向城那边走了。

original: Something to do with Galaxy News Radio. Guess that'd be the place for you to start. Good hunting, and thanks for the caps.
translation: 和银河新闻电台有点关系。我想你应该从那里着手。祝你好运，另外谢谢你的瓶盖。

original: Now that wasn't so difficult was it?
translation: 事情就是这么简单。

original: Your dad came through here, all right. Didn't stay long, though. Said he had some important business to attend to, and headed off to the city.
translation: 你爸爸确实来过这。但待得时间不长。他说有些重要的事情要处理，就一直向城那边走了。

original: Something to do with Galaxy News Radio. Guess that'd be the place for you to start. Good hunting, and thanks for the caps.
translation: 和银河新闻电台有点关系。我想你应该从那里着手。祝你好运，另外谢谢你的瓶盖。

original: Running default factory protocol...ERROR. Loading daily agenda... ERROR.
translation: 运行默认的工厂协议……错误。载入日常议程……错误。

original: Production threat identified. Initializing program: Excalibur.
translation: 生产威胁确认。程序初始化中：石中剑。

original: Please stand clear and go about your normal work routine. Your friendly RobCo Factory Helper will have this cleaned up in a moment.
translation: 请保持距离，继续您正常的工作。您友好的RobCo工厂助手很快就会清理干净的。

original: This disturbance will be credited towards your daily break allotment. Thank You.
translation: 此次干扰将计入您的日常休息配额。谢谢。

original: Due to an unforseen incident you have been issued an unpaid holiday. Enjoy.
translation: 由于一起意外事件，您被安排了一次无薪假期。好好享受。

original: Please stand clear and keep the palaver to a minimum. Thank you.
translation: 请保持距离，尽量少说话。谢谢。

original: Greetings fellow employee. Please present your valid work ID.
translation: 您好，同事。请出示您的有效工作证。

original: Proceeding with scan... scan accepted. Thank you.
translation: 正在进行扫描……扫描通过。谢谢。

original: No valid ID detected. Please state name clearly for voice identification.
translation: 未检测到有效证件。请清晰地说出姓名以便语音识别。

original: Unidentified personnel. Please vacate the premises immediately.
translation: 身份不明人员。请立即离开此地。

original: Sure. Just be quick about it.
translation: 当然，只是快点。

original: That is great news indeed!
translation: 那确实是个非常好的消息！

original: As soon as Caleb gets what he needs, we can start our trip.
translation: 只要卡勒布得到了他所要的，我们就能上路。

original: It would be a great favor to me if you would help him.
translation: 你要是愿意帮助他，那对我是一个天大的恩惠。

original: Fine. Some people just don't appreciate the spoken word.
translation: 好吧，有些人就是不健谈。

original: This holotape contains the location of the military weapons cache. I hope you put them to good use and keep up the fight.
translation: 这盘全息磁带记录了军用武器藏匿物的位置。我希望你用于正途，继续战斗。

original: Remember to keep us tuned in while you're out there, and watch yourself.
translation: 在外时，记得继续关注我们，并照看好自己。

original: This holotape contains the location of the military weapons cache.
translation: 这盘全息磁带记录了军用武器藏匿物的位置。

original: I hope you put them to good use and keep up the fight.
translation: 我希望你用于正途，继续战斗。

original: Remember to keep us tuned in while you're out there, and watch yourself.
translation: 在外时，记得继续关注我们，并照看好自己。

original: This holotape contains the location of the weapons cache.
translation: 这盘全息磁带记录了武器藏匿物的位置。

original: I hope you put them to good use and keep up the fight.
translation: 我希望你用于正途，继续战斗。

original: Remember to keep us tuned in while you're out there, and watch yourself.
translation: 在外时，记得继续关注我们，并照看好自己。

original: You can't fire me! I'm the boss of this gang! And I say you're fired! And that I'm going back to Rivet City for a drink! Suck on that!
translation: 你不能炒我的鱿鱼哇！我是这帮派的老大！我说，你才被炒了呢！……我要回铆钉城喝一杯！真他妈晦气！

original: Very well. Although you remain my employer until my contract changes hands. I will wait for you in Underworld, should you need me again.
translation: 好吧。虽然在我的契约转手之前，你仍然是我的雇主。我会在冥界等你，如果你还需要我的话。

original: If that's the way you're going to play, lover. I'll be waiting at Eulogy's place when you come crawling back.
translation: 你要想这么玩，那就如你所愿，爱人。当你想爬着回到我身边，我会在尤勒基的地方等你。

original: <whimper>
translation: <呜咽>

original: I see how it is: the old man can't keep up. Whatever. I'm gonna go see if there's anything left of Megaton.
translation: 我明白的：老人总是跟不上步子。不管怎样，我会去兆吨镇看看还有什么留下来了。

original: I see how it is: the old man can't keep up. Whatever. I'll be at Moriarty's if you change your mind.
translation: 我明白的：老人总是跟不上步子。不管怎样，你要是改变了主意，我会在莫里亚蒂那等你。

original: I'm disappointed, but I cannot say I'm surprised. If you change your mind, I shall be studying in the American History Museum, downtown.
translation: 我很失望，但不觉得奇怪。你要是改变主意，我应该在市区的美利坚历史博物馆里学习。

original: Leaving a soldier behind? Very bad form. Making base in Canterbury Commons for when you come to your senses, sir!
translation: 扔下一个勇猛的战士？真无奈啊。我会暂时在坎特伯雷社区驻扎，你要是醒悟过来，就去那里找我，先生！

original: Very well. I shall return to my duties at the Citadel should you require my aid once again.
translation: 好吧，我应当回到大本营的岗位上去，有一天你会再次需要我的援助。

original: Dead? Argyle? You... you’re sure? My God. I always thought he’d outlive me, by at least 100 years. Poor bastard.
translation: 死了？阿盖尔？你……你确定？我的天。我一直认为他会活得比我久，至少多活100年，可怜的家伙。

original: But thank you! Thank you for telling me. At least now I know. At least now the poor guy can catch a breather.
translation: 不过还是谢谢你！谢谢你告诉我。至少现在我知道了。至少这可怜人能安息了。

original: I’d like to return your kindness. Here, take this key. It unlocks my safe. Lots of stuff in there I'll never use again. My adventuring days are over.
translation: 我想回报你的善意。给你这把钥匙，用它打开我的保险柜，里面很多东西我再也用不上了。我的冒险生涯结束了。

original: Vance told me later that he was basically covering for me and allowing the Family to... to feed at the same time.
translation: 万斯后来告诉我，他主要是想替我掩盖，并同时让家族去……去吃一顿。

original: Since my parents were already dead, they drank their blood and left the mark on the wall. He didn't want Evan to suspect that I had done it.
translation: 因为我父母已经死了，所以他们吸了他们的血，在墙上留下这标记。他不想埃万怀疑是我干的。

original: The irony is they were stalking our town to feed anyway. It's almost like Vance knew this would happen...
translation: 讽刺的是，他们本就是潜进我们的镇子来吃饭的。就好像万斯知道事情会是这个样子……

original: Lucy said Mom and Dad would never have understood. She told me to keep what I did a secret and that she'd try and help me.
translation: 露西说爸妈永远不会理解的。她让我保守秘密，她会尽力帮我的。

original: Thanks to Lucy, she was able to stop that from ever happening again for years.
translation: 多亏露西，这些年，她阻止了这种情况再次发生。

original: Every time I'd feel the hunger, she'd hold onto me and not let go. After a while, the hunger almost seemed to go away... until... well.
translation: 每次我感到饥饿时，她都会紧紧抓住我不放。过了些日子，饥饿感似乎消失了……直到……嗯。

original: I was about 10 years old and I was playing with Lucy down under the overpass. We loved throwing rocks in the water.
translation: 我10岁大的时候。我和露西在高架桥下玩，我们喜欢往水里扔石头子。

original: We saw some Wastelander trying to break open the Brahmin pens and steal one of them, so I ran over and told him to stop.
translation: 我们看见一个废土客试图砸开双头牛的栅栏，想从里面偷一只，所以我跑过去叫他住手。

original: He just laughed and pushed me away. When I fell, suddenly my head started to hurt and my eyes got all blurry. It was almost like I blacked out.
translation: 他大笑着一把把我推开。等我倒下去，我的头突然开始刺痛，眼睛一片模糊。我像是快要昏厥了。

original: Next thing I know Lucy was pulling me off the guy... I had ripped his throat open with my teeth.
translation: 接下来我所知道的事，是露西把我从那家伙身上拖下来……我已经用牙齿撕破了他的喉咙。

original: Then I can't help you. Sorry.
translation: 那我就帮不了你了。抱歉。

original: And a quick shot... all done.
translation: 快来一针……一切搞定。

original: Sure can. Quick and easy, only 100 caps.
translation: 当然能。很快也很容易，只要100个瓶盖。

original: Sure can. Quick and easy, only 100 caps.
translation: 当然能。很快也很容易，只要100个瓶盖。

original: Okay. Here's what I have. What do you have?
translation: 好吧，这是我的货物，你那有什么？

original: Okay.
translation: 好吧。

original: This is all I have. I hope it's okay.
translation: 这是我全部的货物，希望你喜欢。

original: Alright. Let's see if we can't find something mutually agreeable.
translation: 好吧，我们看看能不能做一笔大家都满意的买卖。

original: Excellent!
translation: 好棒！

original: I'm sure you'll find something agreeable.
translation: 我保证你会找到喜欢的东西。

original: Oh, no no no no no no no! Fire would be too painful for me and poor old Bob. You keep that stuff away from us!
translation: 哦，不不不不不不不！火会让我和可怜的老鲍勃太痛苦了。你让那玩意离我们远点！

original: The heart would be just fine... I won't feel a thing.
translation: 毁掉心脏就行……我不会有任何感觉的。

original: You shoulda seen my pop, he personally saved old Stanley! But guess you wouldn't know what it's like to have a hero for a dad, would you?
translation: 你应该见见我爸爸，他一个人救了老斯坦利！但我想你不会知道有一个英雄爸爸是什么感觉，对吧？

original: Up at Moriarty's at the south end of town. Talk to Nova, she'll help you out.
translation: 在莫里亚蒂那的上层，镇子的最南端。找诺瓦谈，她会帮助你。

original: Oh yeah? Well why didn't you say so, you stupid mungo?
translation: 哦，是吗？你为什么不说，你这愚蠢的毛人？

original: I dunno why you bothered to come here and wake me then. I would have been better off sleeping through it.
translation: 我不知道你为什么要来叫醒我，让我继续睡着更好。

original: They are?! Holy shit!
translation: 真的吗？真他妈的走运！

original: Look, either I need to get out there and lend them a hand or they aren't going to last much longer.
translation: 听着，要是我不去帮他们一把，他们是撑不了多久的。

original: We can never really thank you enough for everything you've done. It's not much, but take this with you, to remember us by.
translation: 你所做的一切，我们再怎么感谢你也不为过。虽然比较寒酸，但请你带上，它会让你想起我们。

original: It'll be a while before we're actually ready to go outside. But once the Vault is stable again, maybe we'll see you out there.
translation: 我们需要时间才能真正准备好走出这。等避难所的局势稳定了，我们说不定会在外面相见。

original: So I guess this is goodbye for now. But with luck, we'll meet again.
translation: 我看该说再见了。一路顺风，我们会再见的。

original: You know, maybe this will help and maybe it won't, but pappa hid a bunch of stuff behind the old diner in a dumpster.
translation: 不知道这消息对你有用没，爸爸在旧餐馆后的一个垃圾桶里面藏了些东西。

original: He trusted me with the key and said it was for emergencies, but I bet he wouldn't mind you having it.
translation: 他把钥匙信任地交给了我，已备不时之需，我想他不会介意我把钥匙给你的。

original: Well, there is Will... he was sorta my friend. And then there was his dad and his mom.
translation: 嗯，这有威尔……他算是我的朋友。还有他的爸爸和妈妈。

original: He was a strange man. He paid pappa some caps to help him build a shack and carry a bunch of junk into it.
translation: 他很奇怪。他给爸爸一些钱，请他帮忙修了个小屋，然后把一堆垃圾搬进去。

original: Pappa called him an egghead, but his head was shaped regular, so I didn't get it.
translation: 爸爸管他叫书呆子，但他的神情并不呆滞，所以我不明白他说的是什么意思。

original: Why can't man follow the ant's example? They work together as a team... every waking moment dedicated to the colony.
translation: 为什么人类不能效仿蚂蚁呢？他们团队般的协作……醒着的每一刻都奉献给蚁群。

original: They require no wealth or material items... everything they need is provided for them by their fellow insects.
translation: 它们对金钱与物质没有追求……它们所需的一切都由昆虫同伴提供。

original: But I digress. If it's payment you need, all I can offer is one of my Mutagenic Bioenhancers.
translation: 但我跑题了。如果你需要报酬，我所能提供的只有我的诱变生物增强剂。

original: Why can't man follow the ant's example? They work together as a team... every waking moment dedicated to the colony.
translation: 为什么人类不能效仿蚂蚁呢？他们团队般的协作……醒着的每一刻都奉献给蚁群。

original: They require no wealth or material items... everything they need is provided for them by their fellow insects.
translation: 它们对金钱与物质没有追求……它们所需的一切都由昆虫同伴提供。

original: But I digress. If it's payment you need, all I can offer is one of my Mutagenic Bioenhancers.
translation: 但我跑题了。如果你需要报酬，我所能提供的只有我的诱变生物增强剂。

original: Pinkerton, eh? That name takes me way back. Claimed to have cured radiation poisoning. Or was it food poisoning? I don't recall.
translation: 平克顿，嗯？这名字让我想起了好久以前。他声称治愈了辐射中毒，还是食物中毒来着？我记不清了。

original: He was always telling folks that he founded Rivet City. All he did was break off the front of it. Or did he die there? I don't recall.
translation: 他总不停地跟人说，是他创建了铆钉城。他所做的就是断开了前端部分。还是他就死在那里了？我记不清了。

original: Yes, I suppose you're right. Science must learn to acquiesce to your standards in order to advance itself.
translation: 是的，我想你是对的。科学为了自身的进步，必须学会接纳你的标准。

original: I was merely going to offer one of my Mutagenic Bioenhancers, but I suppose I could up the ante.
translation: 我本打算只提供一种我的诱变生物增强剂，不过我想我可以提高报酬。

original: I will also award you with my old lab coat. It's served me well over the years... and you may find it useful for your own experiments.
translation: 我再送你一件旧的实验室外套，它跟了我好多年……你可能会发现它对你的实验很有用。

original: Sir, I encountered three Ferals on my patrol. This was somewhere around 0300 hours, I think, and it was dark, so they saw me first.
translation: 长官，我在巡逻中碰到了三个狂尸鬼。我想当时时间大约是0300，光线很暗，所以是他们先看见了我。

original: I discharged my firearm four times, fatally striking two of the three. My weapon jammed before I could fire on the third target.
translation: 我换了四次弹夹，击倒了其中两个。就在我要向第三个目标开火时，我的枪卡住了。

original: Just then I realized it wasn't engaging. I knew our orders were to report on anything unusual, and well -- I thought that was pretty strange.
translation: 就在那时，我意识到它没有进攻。我明白我们的命令是报告任何不寻常的事，反正 — 我认为那相当奇怪。

original: He actually followed me back on his own. We put him in the trailer with the other and he's been quiet as you like. Strangest thing I've ever seen.
translation: 他事实上只是跟着我。我们后来把它击倒了，他的样子很安静。那是我曾见过的最奇怪的事。

original: I've managed to isolate some of the Fire Ant genes and distill them into human-safe genetic enhancers!
translation: 我设法分离了一些火蚁基因，并将它们提炼为对人体无害的基因强化剂！

original: I can inject you with one of these formulas and you'll find yourself with either enhanced strength or enhanced perception!
translation: 我可以给你注射其中一种配方，你会发现自己的力量或感知得到了增强！

original: Not only that, but you'll be somewhat more resistant to fire! How marvelous!
translation: 不仅如此，你还能提升一定的火焰抗性！多不可思议！

original: No, it should all wrap up rather nicely. I've rigged my equipment at my portable terminal to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
translation: 不，但结果应该会圆满。我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了设备，来发射我称为“抑制脉冲”的东西。

original: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
translation: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失与蚁后的共鸣联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

original: So, that's all there is to it. What do you say?
translation: 就是这么回事。你说怎样？

original: No, it should all wrap up rather nicely. I've rigged my equipment to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
translation: 不，但结果应该会圆满。我已经在我的终端上安装了设备，来发射我称为“抑制脉冲”的东西。

original: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
translation: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失与蚁后的共鸣联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

original: However, there is one final detail I need your help with. Could you do something about Bryan Wilks for me?
translation: 可是，还有最后一个细节需要你帮忙。你能帮我处理一下布赖恩·威尔克斯的事吗？

original: Yes, it should all wrap up rather nicely. I've rigged my equipment at my portable terminal to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
translation: 是的，结果应该会圆满。我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了设备，来发射我称为“抑制脉冲”的东西。

original: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
translation: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失与蚁后的共鸣联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

original: So, that's all there is to it. What do you say?
translation: 就是这么回事。你说怎样？

original: That's everything to do with the ants, yes indeed. I've rigged my equipment to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
translation: 就是这些了，嗯，没错。我已经在我的终端上安装了设备，来发射我称为“抑制脉冲”的东西。

original: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
translation: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失与蚁后的共鸣联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

original: However, there is one final detail I need your help with. Could you do something about Bryan Wilks for me?
translation: 可是，还有最后一个细节需要你帮忙。你能帮我处理一下布赖恩·威尔克斯的事吗？

original: I've rigged the equipment at my portable terminal to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
translation: 我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了设备，来发射我称为“抑制脉冲”的东西。

original: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
translation: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失与蚁后的共鸣联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

original: So, that's all there is to it. What do you say?
translation: 就是这么回事。你说怎样？

original: I've rigged the equipment at my portable terminal to emit what I call an Inhibitor Pulse.
translation: 我已经在我的便携式终端上安装了设备，来发射我称为“抑制脉冲”的东西。

original: Once I send this pulse, all of the remaining ants will lose their empathic link with the Queen and frenzy, destroying each other in the process!
translation: 一旦我发出这种脉冲，所有剩下的蚂蚁都会丧失与蚁后的共鸣联系，然后陷入狂暴，相互攻击！

original: However, there is one final detail I need your help with. Could you do something about Bryan Wilks for me?
translation: 可是，还有最后一个细节需要你帮忙。你能帮我处理一下布赖恩·威尔克斯的事吗？

original: W-what is this weird thing?
translation: 这奇怪的东西是什 - 什么？

original: How marvelous! Here is the promised Lab Coat. I'm certain you'll find it quite useful.
translation: 太棒了！这是答应过的实验室外套。我肯定你会发现它很有用的。

original: Which injection did you want? Will it be the Ant Sight or Ant Might?
translation: 你要哪种注射剂？“蚁之感”还是“蚁之力”？

original: How marvelous! Which injection did you want? Will it be the Ant Sight or Ant Might?
translation: 太棒了！你要哪种注射剂？“蚁之感”还是“蚁之力”？

original: Then I will proceed to my portable terminal at once and make the necessary changes to the formula.
translation: 那么我要立刻去我的便携式终端那里，对配方做必要的修改。

original: Let's proceed to my terminal and we'll see if I can undo all the damage I've caused.
translation: 让我们去我的终端那里，看看是否能挽回我造成的所有损失。

original: The secret kind...
translation: 秘密……

original: Well, if you must know... I'm an electrician and computer expert. AND I'm a bit of a surgeon. Really, the most gifted scientist you'll find...
translation: 好吧，如果你一定要知道……我是个电气和电脑专家。我还是个外科医生。真的，我是你能找到的最有天赋的科学家……

original: Hmph. I'm the guy that got Rivet City up and running in the first place!
translation: 哼。我是建造铆钉城并让它运作的人！

original: And after all that Li and her gang of flunkies pushed me out. Ha! Project Purity indeed. What a bunch of morons -- they can't even clean some water.
translation: 之后，李和她的那帮小人把我排挤了出去。哈！净水工程对吧，一群白痴 — 他们净化不了一滴水。

original: Defender Morgan and I executed a reconnaissance mission last night to gauge Raider entrenchment in the structural underground of Fairfax.
translation: 我和摩根捍卫者昨晚执行了一次侦察任务，以评估费尔法克斯地下结构中的掠夺者防卫工事。

original: We located three entrances into underground utility tunnels, and confirmed the enemy has occupied and fortified these positions. Some are undefended.
translation: 我们发现了三个进入地下公用设施隧道的入口，并确认敌人已占领和加固这些阵地。一些没有设防。

original: We also identified a small weapons cache in the southeast section of the tunnels. We were compromised by a patrol while placing explosives here.
translation: 我们还在这些隧道的东南区域查找到了小型武器的隐藏点。在埋设炸药时，我们被巡逻队撞见。

original: In accordance to mission parameters, we did not engage, instead retreating to Base. Raiders will be likely to attach more patrols to that area now.
translation: 根据任务目的，我们没有和他们交火，选择了撤回基地。掠夺者目前可能会在那区域增派更多的巡逻队。

original: We've secured the building and are currently implementing our orders for the occupation of Fairfax.
translation: 我们已经守住了大楼，目前正在执行占领费尔法克斯的命令。

original: Raider activity in town has increased since we first took up positions in and around the fort. We've killed a lot of them and scared off others.
translation: 自从我们拿下堡垒和附近的区域，掠夺者在镇子里的活动有所增加。我们干掉他们不少人并吓走一些。

original: But they just keep coming back. Their numbers seem limitless, while requests for our own reinforcements are repeatedly denied.
translation: 但他们不停地反扑，他们的数量像是源源不断，而我们自己的增援请求却再三遭到拒绝。

original: That the Raiders take such continued risks to invade our facility appears to confirm suspicions that we've had an intelligence leak.
translation: 那些掠夺者不惜余力地冒险侵入我们的设施，这确凿地说明我们的情报已经泄露了。

original: They've tried tenaciously to infiltrate the base, but so far haven't stood a chance. Our objective remains the same: protect the research personnel.
translation: 他们顽强地设法渗透进基地，但到目前为止还没成功过。我们的任务照旧：保护研究人员。

original: Awww, come on. You're pretty tough taking out all those ants by yourself!
translation: 哦，来吧，你非常强壮，可以独自干掉所有蚂蚁！

original: The name's Bryan Wilks, by the way, I live in Grayditch. Well, that is, I did until those Fire Ants turned this place into a cemetery.
translation: 我叫布赖恩·威尔克斯，顺便说一下，我住在灰渠。嗯，在那些火蚁把这地方变成坟场之前，我一直住在这里。

original: They killed everyone in town... including my pappa. Now I'm all alone.
translation: 它们杀掉了镇子的每个人……包括我爸爸。我现在孤身一人了。

original: Taylor, stop shooting, damnit!
translation: 泰勒，停止射击，该死的！

original: ...that batch of tests was inconclusive, but Madison and I are convinced it's a problem with the secondary filtration system.
translation: ……那批测试没有说服力，不过麦迪逊和我深信问题出在二级过滤系统。

original: We’re going to re-calibrate the equipment and try again tomorrow, so that... James, please, I’m trying to work. Now’s not the time...
translation: 我们准备明天重新校准设备再试一次，所以……詹姆斯，求你了，我正在努力，现在不是……的时候。

original: So that's the next step. Assuming we get the results we need, we'll move on to... James! Stop! I need to finish these notes...
translation: 假如我们得到了想要的结果，下一步我们会…… 詹姆斯！停下！我需要完成这些记录……

original: We'll move on to diagnosing the issues with the radiation dampeners. That should... Ow! James! Now? We really shouldn't... Ha ha ha ha ha!
translation: 然后我们要使用放射抑制器诊断下。那应当……噢！詹姆斯！现在？我们真的不应该……哈哈哈哈哈！

original: The stimulation of the subject's evolutionary trigger by the mutagen caused a bio-defensive reaction metamorphosing the ant's venom glands.
translation: 诱变剂对实验对象进化触发器的刺激，引起生理防御反应，使蚂蚁的毒液腺变形。

original: This process caused unexpected oscillations in the venom molecules at such a vast rate it produces a thermodynamic biochemical reaction.
translation: 这一过程在毒液分子中引起了意想不到的振荡，振荡频率之快，产生了热力学生化反应。

original: As the subject ejects the volatile solution, it becomes conflagrant due to new structures in its maw I call its calefaction array.
translation: 当实验对象喷射出挥发性溶液时，它的口腔中会出现新的结构，我称之为“加热阵列”，从而使其易燃。

original: Amazing, isn't it?
translation: 很惊人吧，对吧？

original: All scientists take responsibility for their failures, because it comes with the territory.
translation: 所有的科学家都该为他们的失败负责，因为这涉及整个研究领域。

original: I will take this experimentation to completion without roosting on the moral high ground.
translation: 道德在我的实验中没有立足之地。

original: If I allow emotions to enter the mix, all this time and energy spent will have been for nothing.
translation: 我要是让情绪掺杂到我的实验中，我花费的所有时间和精力都会付诸东流。

original: Are you kidding me? We don't have time for this.
translation: 你说笑吗？我们没时间做这事。

original: Fine. If you're going to do it, then do it. But hurry up.
translation: 好吧，如果你要做，那就去做。不过要赶快。

original: Here you go! Enjoy it!
translation: 给你！好好享用！

original: Well, it will save me the trip.
translation: 得，省了我跑一趟。

original: Fine, you've got a deal. Enjoy!
translation: 成交！喝得开心！

original: In a way. I tracked you using your Geomapper.
translation: 可以这么说，我用你的地理测绘仪跟踪到了你。

original: Reilly sent me to find you so I could bring you this.
translation: 莱莉派我来的，要我把这给你。

original: Looking for you. I tracked you using your Geomapper.
translation: 我在找你，我用你的地理测绘仪跟踪到了你。

original: Reilly sent me to find you so I could bring you this.
translation: 莱莉派我来的，要我把这给你。

original: Nice. So that's the thanks I get for coming all this way to bring you this?
translation: 很好，费尽功夫给你带来这个之后，你就这么感谢我吗？

original: Tracked you using the Geomapper.
translation: 用地理测绘仪跟踪的你。

original: Reilly sent me to find you so I could bring you this.
translation: 莱莉派我来的，要我把这给你。

original: Oh, yes, of course! Please, accept this. It's all I have, but surely I owe everything to the lessons in your holy guide. Bless you.
translation: 哦，是的，当然！请收下，这是我仅有的，但我的一切都要归功于您神圣指南中的教诲。祝福您。

original: Yes, it teaches us how to live, and how to return to the paradise that was! Truly, it is our guide through this wasted land.
translation: 是的，它教我们如何生活，如何回到曾经的天堂！真的，它是我们在这片荒芜土地上的向导。

original: Please, take these as my thanks. So many of us owe our lives to your great work. Bless you.
translation: 请收下这些作为我的感谢。我们中的许多人都因你的伟大工作而活着。祝福你。

original: It's a glory of a book! It teaches us what to do, how to live, and how our people can return to the paradise that once was!
translation: 这是本荣耀之书！它教我们该做什么，如何生活，以及我们的百姓如何回到曾经的天堂！

original: You simply must read it, friend, it'll save your life... and maybe even your soul!
translation: 朋友，你一定要读一读，它会拯救你的生命……甚至可能是你的灵魂！

original: Please, take my copy and spread the word!
translation: 请收下我的这本，并广为传播！

original: Well, I'd have to be an idiot to listen to this piece of crap.
translation: 这么说吧，我要是想看这本破书那我就是个白痴。

original: Here, you think so much of it, you take it. Fat lot of good it'll do you.
translation: 拿着，你觉得这本书不错是吧，那你自己留着吧，它能帮你很大忙呢。

original: Here, take a look. It's good for a laugh, but don't try to actually follow its advice. Not unless you're looking for a quick way to end it all.
translation: 给，看看，它很好笑，不过别把它的建议当真，除非你不想活了。

original: Then I think you oughtta leave, before I decide to pay you back for all the bad advice.
translation: 那么我想你应该走了，在我决定补偿你那些糟糕的建议之前。

original: And take your damned book with you, too.
translation: 把你那本该死的书也带走。

original: Yeah, I guess I should be getting back. I'll tell Amata you're okay, she'll be happy to hear that.
translation: 嗯，我想我该回去了。我会告诉阿玛塔你一切都好，她听到这消息后会很高兴。

original: Oh, and here: have some fresh water from the Vault. I guess it's pretty hard to find it out here. Take care out here, and thanks again.
translation: 哦，给：从避难所带来的一点淡水，我猜在这很难找到。多保重，再次感谢。

original: Oh, I will. They'll be glad to hear from you.
translation: 哦，我会的。他们听到你的消息一定很高兴。

original: Oh, and here: have some fresh water from the Vault.
translation: 哦，给，从避难所带来的一点淡水。

original: I guess it's pretty hard to find it out here, and maybe it'll be a taste of home for you. Take care out here, and thanks again.
translation: 我猜它在外面一定少见，它会让你感受到家的味道。多保重，再次感谢。

original: Okay! Wave bye-bye Bob! Oh come on, move a branch at least... *sigh*
translation: 好的！再见，鲍勃！哦，拜托，至少摇下树枝嘛……*唉*

original: I can't say I blame you. It's my mistake for making you do something you didn't want to do in the first place, I guess.
translation: 我不能怪你。我想，一开始让你去做你不想做的事是我的错。

original: Still, maybe it's all for the best. I mean, I've been talking with Birch and they really seem to need me.
translation: 不过，或许这一切就是最好的安排。我是说，我和伯奇聊过了，他们似乎真的很需要我。

original: What do you say Herbert, should I give em' another chance?
translation: 赫伯特，你怎么说，我该再给他们一次机会吗？

original: Oh ye- fine, fine... I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
translation: 哦——好，好吧……我是说鲍勃。我还是觉得叫他赫伯特很好玩。

original: No, I suppose you aren't. My mistake for making you do something you didn't want to do in the first place I guess.
translation: 是啊，我想你也不是。是我的错，不该让你做一开始就不想做的事。

original: Still, maybe it's all for the best. I mean, I've been talking with Birch and they really seem to need me.
translation: 不过，或许这一切就是最好的安排。我是说，我和伯奇聊过了，他们似乎真的很需要我。

original: What do you say Herbert, should I give em' another chance?
translation: 赫伯特，你怎么说，我该再给他们一次机会吗？

original: Fine, fine... I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
translation: 好，好吧……我是说鲍勃。我每次叫他赫伯特都觉得很好玩。

original: So, they really need me that badly, huh? I guess I never thought of it that way. Awfully selfish of me.
translation: 这么说，他们真的那么需要我，哈？我想我从来没这么想过。我太自私了。

original: Should we give em' another chance, Herbert?
translation: 我们再给他们一次机会怎么样，赫伯特？

original: Fine, fine... I mean Bob. I still think it's funny when I call him Herbert.
translation: 好，好吧……我是说鲍勃。我每次叫他赫伯特都觉得很好玩。

original: I... I understand. You have to look out for yourself.
translation: 我……我懂了。你要小心。

original: Just leave me...
translation: 让我一个人待着……

original: Really? Seriously? My God. Thank you. Thank you so much. I'll never forget this!
translation: 真的？当真？我的天，谢谢你，非常感谢你。我永远不会忘记！

original: Water... precious water... thank you! You're a saint!
translation: 水……宝贵的水……谢谢你！你是个圣人！

original: My... thank you. Thank you so much. You've saved my life. Bless you.
translation: 我的……谢谢你。非常感谢你。你救了我的命。上帝保佑你。

original: Really? Thank you. You're the first person willing to actually give me any of that.
translation: 真的吗？谢谢。你是第一个愿意给我这些的人。

original: Thank you... I'm starting to think Aqua Pura is even better than normal purified water.
translation: 谢谢……我开始觉得“纯净水”甚至比普通纯化水更好。

original: I... I understand. You have to look out for yourself.
translation: 我……我懂了。你要小心。

original: Just leave me...
translation: 让我一个人待着……

original: He's the only other kid that lives here besides you. He's a big crybaby... You'll see.
translation: 他是除你以外，这里唯一的小孩。他是个爱哭鬼……你等着瞧吧。

original: Make him cry and then come back here so we can talk some more.
translation: 把他弄哭，然后回到这，我们就可以再聊聊。

original: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Oh... oh... ha ha ha ha ha ha... That good one! Ha ha ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！噢……噢……哈哈哈哈哈哈……这个好！哈哈哈哈哈！

original: Kill the humans! Kill them all! Aggghhh!
translation: 干掉人类！干掉所有人类！啊~~~！

original: Humans who?
translation: 什么人类？

original: Humans.
translation: 人类。

original: Who there?
translation: 那是谁？

original: Maybe... MAYBE he didn't exactly wander off. Maybe he fled. Escaped captivity, as it were, if he began to misinterpret his "situation."
translation: 或许……或许他并不是真的走失。也许他是逃走了。如果他开始误解自己的“处境”，对他来说，就像是逃出了囚禁一样。

original: It's possible my android sought to forget his previous life. Wipe away all memory, all guilt. Trick himself into believing he really IS human.
translation: 有可能我的仿真人是想遗忘他以前的生活，擦去所有记忆和所有愧疚，欺骗自己，让自己相信他真的是一个人类。

original: So no, he may not be just an ordinary robot, but he's certainly not human, no matter how badly he wishes it so. I made him. I want him. End of story.
translation: 所以不，他不可能只是个普通的机器人，但他肯定不是人类，无论他多么地希望如此。我创造了他，我想要他，就这样。

original: By God, you're as annoying as you are clever. Very well. I'll tell you what you want to know, if it helps you locate my property.
translation: 上帝啊，你很聪明也很烦人。好吧，要是你能找到我的财产，那我告诉你。

original: The duty of this particular unit was the hunting and capturing of other escaped androids. Yes, others have escaped.
translation: 这个特殊单位的职责是搜寻和捕获其他逃跑的仿真人。没错，其他仿真人逃跑了。

original: It's one of the side effects of having such an advanced A.I. Machines start to think for themselves. Fool themselves into believing they have rights.
translation: 这是拥有如此先进人工智能的副作用之一。机器开始自己思考。它们自欺欺人地认为自己拥有权利。

original: And so... this particular android may have believed he'd done something... wrong. Immoral. And wanted to forget those deeds. Satisfied now?
translation: 所以……这个特殊的仿真人可能认为自己做了……错事。不道德的事。并且想要忘记那些行为。满意了吗？

original: You!? You killed her!?
translation: 你！？你杀了她！？

original: That's it... you're dead meat! Say hello to the Kneecapper!
translation: 对……你玩完了！跟碎膝者打个招呼吧！

original: James... Your father caused an overload. He sacrificed himself to keep the Enclave from getting the purifier, and to buy us some time to escape.
translation: 詹姆斯……你父亲引发了一次超载。他牺牲了自己来阻止英克雷，保护了净化器，为我们逃跑争取时间。

original: There'll be more of them coming. We need to get out of here before they find us, or else your father died in vain.
translation: 他们快来了。在他们找到我们之前，我们要离开这，否则你父亲就白死了。

original: Feeling a bit anxious, perhaps?
translation: 或许会感觉有点不安？

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记着，一旦购买了一个主题，你就不能再把它卖给我，不过你可以随时购买一个新的主题。

original: Yuck, the thought of walking around naked's making me sick.
translation: 讨厌，这种裸奔的想法让我觉得恶心。

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记着，一旦购买了一个主题，你就不能再把它卖给我，不过你可以随时购买一个新的主题。

original: Remember, once you buy a theme you can't sell it back to me, although you could always purchase a new one.
translation: 记着，一旦购买了一个主题，你就不能再把它卖给我，不过你可以随时购买一个新的主题。

original: What? Let me see that! This is a Neuro-Servo... Unique to the A3-21... I... And you say you got this from his corpse?
translation: 什么？让我看看！这是神经伺服……A3-21独有的……我……并且你说是从他的尸体上找到的？

original: I suppose there's no other way you could have obtained it. Well... damn it. I was afraid this would happen, out here in this, this... Wasteland.
translation: 我想你没别的办法能得到它。嗯……该死。我就怕会发生这种事，在这，这……废土上。

original: Well. Here's 50 caps for your troubles. Try to buy yourself an education out here in this hell. Good day.
translation: 好吧。这50个瓶盖，就算给你的辛苦废。试着在这地狱般的地方为自己买点教育吧。再见。

original: At ease.
translation: 稍息。

original: Fine. Blow me off. Live in denial. But take this. It's an internal component from the very android you're searching for.
translation: 好啊，轰我走。逃避现实。但拿着这个。这是你要找的那个仿真人的一个内部组件。

original: Don't ask how I obtained it. If you change your mind, if you decide you want to help, present the component to Doctor Zimmer in Rivet City.
translation: 别问我是怎么得来的。你要是改变主意，决定要帮忙，就把这组件交给铆钉城的齐默博士。

original: Tell him the android is dead, and that was on the corpse. He'll believe you. He'll go back to the Commonwealth, and you'll have saved a man's life.
translation: 告诉他仿真人已经死了，这是从尸体上找到的。他会相信你，然后会回到联邦去，而你则拯救了一个人的生命。

original: You really want to help? Take this. It's an internal component from the very android you're searching for. Don't ask how I obtained it.
translation: 你真的想帮忙？拿上这个。这是你要找的仿真人的一个零件。别问我是怎么得来的。

original: Present it to Doctor Zimmer in Rivet City. Tell him the android is dead, and that was on the corpse. He'll believe you.
translation: 给铆钉城的齐默博士看这零件，告诉他这仿真人死了，零件是从尸体上找到的。他会相信你。

original: Do that, and Zimmer will go back to the Commonwealth, and leave that poor soul alone. Do that, and you'll have saved a man's life.
translation: 做完这件事，齐默会回到联邦，放过那可怜家伙。做完这件事，你将拯救一个人的生命。

original: Hhhuuuhh...
translation: 呃啊……

original: Oh, dear. Is that old radio on the fritz again? I should turn it off.
translation: 哦，亲爱的。老收音机又出问题了？我应该关掉它。

original: Yeah, run along and cry now!
translation: 耶，滚吧，哭吧！

original: Shut up before I pound you!
translation: 在我揍你之前，闭嘴！

original: You know, the usual.
translation: 你知道，这很平常。

original: Not much, I guess. Apart from keeping you dumbasses in line, that is.
translation: 我想不多。除了管好你们这群蠢货。

original: Evewything's a-okay!
translation: 一且……正场！

original: Just talking to morons who keep bugging me. Scram!
translation: 去和那些不停打扰我的蠢货说话。滚开！

original: Fun times and laughs as always!
translation: 总是笑声不断！

original: Cool junk and collecting, as always!
translation: 继续收垃圾！

original: I was running so fast, I thought my legs were gonna fly off, but then they didn't, which makes sense, 'cause legs don't have wings. You know?
translation: 我飞快地跑，我想我的腿都快要飞出去了，不过它们没有，那是什么意思，因为腿没有翅膀。你知道吗？

original: Just relaxing. Nothing much.
translation: 放松。没事了。

original: Nothing.
translation: 没什么。

original: Just playing around, you know?
translation: 只是玩玩，懂吗？

original: Keeping everyone from killing themselves. Same as ever.
translation: 和以前一样，阻止人们自相残杀。

original: Watching after the younger kids and seeing if they can't accidentally learn a thing or two. You know how it goes.
translation: 观察这些年纪轻轻的孩子，看他们能否意外学会一些事情。你知道怎么做。

original: Not much. Still trying to find a way to turn this fungus into something that doesn't taste like toenails.
translation: 不多。还在想办法把这些蘑菇变成尝起来不像脚趾甲的东西。

original: I got a new tooth today! It was just lying there and now it's mine!
translation: 我长了颗新牙！它就躺在那，现在它是我的了！

original: Not much.
translation: 没什么。

original: What's up, pal?
translation: 怎么啦，兄弟？

original: What's happening, pal?
translation: 出什么事了，兄弟？

original: Hewwo. What's up?
translation: 哈罗，怎么了？

original: Hello, there. What're you up to? Not getting into too much trouble?
translation: 你好，你忙什么呢？没什么麻烦吧？

original: Hello. What's happening today?
translation: 喂，今天有什么事？

original: What're you up to, today?
translation: 今天忙什么呢？

original: Hello. What's happening?
translation: 喂，怎么了？

original: Oh hey! What's happening? Something fun?
translation: 哦，嗨！发生什么事？有趣吗？

original: Hello. Anything interesting happening?
translation: 喂，有什么趣事？

original: Hello. What's up?
translation: 喂，怎么了？

original: Hey, what's happening?
translation: 喂，怎么了？

original: Everything fine down here in paradise? What's happening?
translation: 天堂一切都好？发生了什么？

original: Hey, what's up?
translation: 嗨，怎么样？

original: Well, that's awfully generous of you seeing as I never made a deal with you in the first place.
translation: 你可真大方，我并没有首先和你达成协议呢。

original: But I guess it's pretty decent of you not to sell it to someone else instead. Thanks, kid.
translation: 不过你没有把它卖给别人，还真是实在人。谢谢，孩子。

original: Fine, fine. Anything to get it! Here's your caps, now hand it over.
translation: 好吧，好吧，怎么都行！给你瓶盖，交货。

original: Shrewd kid, very shrewd.
translation: 精明的小子，非常精明。

original: Okay. Seeing as I was going to pay Grady anyway, here's the caps I owed him. Now, lemme have it.
translation: 好吧，既然我反正要付钱给格雷迪，我把还欠他的瓶盖给你。现在把它给我吧。

original: Hey, thanks a bunch for bringing it to me. You could have been a jerk and sold it to someone else, but you didn't.
translation: 喂，多谢你把它带给我。你本来可以把它卖给别人，但你没有。

original: Ah hell, let me give you the rest of the caps I was gonna give Grady anyway.
translation: 啊，他妈的，让我把欠格雷迪的瓶盖给你吧。

original: Yeah. That's what I thought. Now scram!
translation: 那就好，滚吧！

original: Why do you torment me? You know who I am. You know that I am really Doctor Braun, that I created this place...
translation: 你为什么要折磨我？你知道我是谁。你知道我真是的布劳恩博士，我创造了这地方……

original: And now I'm trapped here. It's all your fault.
translation: 而且现在我被困在这了，都是你的错。

original: Hmmm, so you wanna live life on the wild side, huh? Okay. Go for it.
translation: 嗯，那么你是要到野外去谋生了，呃？好吧，去吧。

original: Yeah, as soon as you bring me some more Sugar Bombs.
translation: 是啊，只要你带给我更多甜麦炮弹。

original: Sure. I stay away from them and they don't bother me. It's a good relationship. They live somewhere East of here.
translation: 当然，我不找他们的麻烦，他们也不打搅我，我们和平共处。他们就住这东边的某个地方。

original: If you're feeling foolish, I think there's an underground way through to their place deeper into the metro station here.
translation: 你要是够愚蠢，我想这的地铁站下面有地道通到他们住的位置。

original: Good... good. There's more out there, so go and find it.
translation: 好的……好的……外边还有更多，继续去找吧。

original: Nice work. The Ultrajet's coming along nicely.
translation: 干得好。超级杰特的进展很好。

original: Excellent! keep it coming.
translation: 太棒了！常来！

original: Fine, anything to get what I need. Now scram, I got some preparing to do!
translation: 好吧，怎么都行。走开，我还有事！

original: I'm sorry to hear that. I hope you'll consider meeting me in Rivet City.
translation: 听到这我很遗憾。希望你能考虑去铆钉城找我。

original: That's good to hear. Let's not waste any time.
translation: 很好，我们别浪费时间了。

original: Nicely played; and I know talent when I see it.
translation: 打得好；天才我看一眼就知道。

original: Here you go. Okay team, let's get out of here.
translation: 拿去。队员们，让我们离开这。

original: Now that's teamwork! Good choice.
translation: 那是团队协作！明智的选择。

original: Okay team, let's get out of here.
translation: 队员们，让我们离开这。

original: Certainly, allow me to whip up a copy for you.
translation: 当然，我这就给您复制一把。

original: There you are. Have a wonderful and productive day!
translation: 给，祝您今天过得高效且充实！

original: I've gotten word that a band of mercs called Reilly's Rangers were trapped on a D.C. rooftop, pinned down by Super Mutants.
translation: 我获得消息，一队名叫“莱莉的游骑兵”的雇佣兵被困在了特区的一处楼顶上，被超级变种人缠住了。

original: Well, it's about time someone put that bastard out of his misery.
translation: 嗯，这杂种到了脱离苦海的时候。

original: And here's the reward for it. Spend it well, Lawbringer.
translation: 这是你的奖赏。好好用，执法者。

original: A place called Underworld. It's a Ghoul city down in D.C. I set off up here to find adventure and fortune. And... well... I found this place.
translation: 一个叫冥界的地方。那是位于特区的尸鬼之城。我跑到这儿来闯荡，寻找刺激和钱财。结果……唉，就找到这破地方。

original: I'm sort of stuck here. Colin says that I can't leave until I pay off my debt to him. Of course, he charges me room and board too.
translation: 我算是被困在这儿了。科林说我没还清欠他的债前不准走。当然，他连食宿费都要收我的。

original: If you ever get to Underworld, tell Carol that I said hi.
translation: 要是你哪天去了冥界城，替我向卡洛尔问声好。

original: Yeah, I can spare a few rounds.
translation: 嗯，我可以分你点。

original: Well you'd better be, soldier. We're running short on time and that was NOT an offer, that was an order.
translation: 你最好快做准备，士兵。时间不够了，而且这由不得你，这是命令。

original: We have three hardened targets we need your team to handle otherwise Operation Anchorage will be dead in the water.
translation: 我们需要你的小队去消灭3个顽固的目标，否则安克雷奇行动将会失败。

original: There are three hardened targets that stand between us and the Chinese Headquarters. That's where your Strike Team comes in.
translation: 我们与中国军队总部之间有3个顽固的目标。这就是你的突击组的任务。

original: You heard our signal? How'd you manage that? It's not broadcast on a standard frequency...
translation: 你收听到我们的信号？怎么做到的？我们又没有在标准频率上广播…

original: ...oh, I see. You've got one of those wrist-mounted computers. Well, well. Isn't that interesting.
translation: …哦，我明白了。你有那种戴在手腕上的电脑。好啦，好啦。很有趣。

original: How the hell did you hear my signal? It's not broadcast on a standard frequency...
translation: 你怎么收听到我的信号的？我们又没有在标准频率上广播…

original: ...oh, I see. You've got one of those wrist-mounted computers. Well, well. Isn't that interesting.
translation: …哦，我明白了。你有那种戴在手腕上的电脑。好啦，好啦。很有趣。

original: You filthy fucking wastelander... You're dead, you hear me? Dead!
translation: 你这肮脏的垃圾废土客…你死定了，听见了没有？死定了！

original: Are you some kind of idiot? Listen, little girl... hey, wait a second. What's that on your wrist there? Some kind of computer?
translation: 你是白痴吗？听着，小姑娘…喂，你手腕上那个是什么？是不是某种电脑？

original: Are you some kind of idiot? Listen, kid... hey, wait a second. What's that on your wrist there? Some kind of computer?
translation: 你是白痴吗？听着，小伙子…喂，你手腕上那个是什么？是不是某种电脑？

original: I suggest you turn right around before you find yourself full of holes. We've taken over this sector, and...
translation: 我建议你在被打成马蜂窝之前立即向后转。这里是我们的地盘，还有…

original: Hang on. Is that some kind of computer on your wrist?
translation: 等一下。你手腕上那个是某种电脑吗？

original: Uh huh. Well, now that you've been nice enough to return it to us...
translation: 呵呵。你人还不错啊，居然能把它还给我们…

original: ...hey, what's that on your wrist? That's some kind of computer, isn't it?
translation: …喂，你手腕上那个是什么？是不是某种电脑？

original: Well, isn't that nice of you. Looks like things have calmed down now, so why don't you just run along...
translation: 啊，你真是太好了。看起来事情平息了，你为什么不离开呢…

original: ...hey, what's that on your wrist? That's some kind of computer, isn't it?
translation: …喂，你手腕上那个是什么？是不是某种电脑？

original: Yes, that is our main base of operations in the area. If Casdin is willing to trust you, then I hope we can work together.
translation: 是的，那是我们在这一地区的主要行动基地。如果卡斯丁愿意相信你，那我希望我们能合作。

original: You're not wrong. So for now I'll overlook the fact that you've got some of our tech.
translation: 你是对的。到目前为止我才注意到你拥有我们某些科技。

original: If you can assist us, it'll be worth your while.
translation: 如果你肯帮助我们，我们会报答你的。

original: IF you can help, then I suspect it will definitely be worth your time.
translation: 如果你肯帮忙，我们一定会报答你的。

original: That device on your wrist. That's not our tech. That, and the fact that none of us would be stupid enough to take our armor off.
translation: 你手腕上的那台设备。那不是我们的技术。而且，事实上我们都不会蠢到脱掉装甲。

original: This is the part where I'd have you killed. At least, under normal circumstances.
translation: 这就是我要杀了你的部分。至少，在正常情况下。

original: But, it turns out you might be useful to us. If you can help, I'll forget that you should be dead for wearing that armor.
translation: 但事实证明你对我们有用。如果你能帮上忙，我就不计较你胆敢穿着那装甲的死罪。

original: That device on your wrist. That's not our tech.
translation: 你手腕上的那台设备。那不是我们的技术。

original: This is the part where I'd have you killed. At least, under normal circumstances.
translation: 这就是我要杀了你的部分。至少，在正常情况下。

original: But, it turns out you might be useful to us. If you can help, I'll forget that you should be dead for wearing that armor.
translation: 但事实证明你对我们有用。如果你能帮上忙，我就不计较你胆敢穿着那装甲的死罪。

original: Fine, fine. I get it. I'm not trying to intimidate you here. I just need your help, and we can both come out of this better off than we are now.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我懂了。我不是想恐吓你。我只是需要你的帮助，这样我们都能摆脱困境。

original: That computer on your wrist there. I need that, and I need you to use it. Okay? That's it. No one's going to hurt you.
translation: 你手腕上那个电脑。我需要它，而且我需要你来使用它。好吗？就这样。没人会伤害你的。

original: I'm not an idiot. That computer you've got on your wrist there? That's not our tech.
translation: 我不是白痴。你手腕上戴的那个电脑？那不是我们的科技产物。

original: So how about you tell me what you're really doing here before I have you killed.
translation: 在我叫人杀了你之前，告诉我你到底来这里做什么。

original: Do we look like cannibals? Are you really that dense?
translation: 我们看起来像是食人者吗？你不会这么笨吧？

original: That computer on your wrist is what I'm talking about. I need that computer -- and the person attached to it -- to access the technology here.
translation: 我说的是你手腕上戴的那个电脑。我需要那个电脑 — 还有戴着它的人 — 来访问这里的科技。

original: Heh, all right. You're obviously sharper than the average rubble dweller.
translation: 呵，好吧。很明显，你看起来要比那些一般的平民要聪明得多。

original: That computer you've got on your wrist is a specialized piece of equipment. I need someone who knows how to use it.
translation: 你手腕上那个电脑是种专门的设备。我需要懂得使用它的人。

original: If you can be that someone, I'm willing to work with you to make your life easier.
translation: 如果你肯帮忙，我很乐意和你一起工作，让你的人生更美好。

original: So you do have half a brain. That's good.
translation: 这么看来你还有点脑子。很好。

original: I'll keep it simple. I need you, and I need that computer of yours. You help me out, and I'll do what I can to help you.
translation: 我长话短说。我需要你，还需要你那个电脑。你帮助我，我就会尽我所能帮助你。

original: This isn't an offer the Outcasts extend to anyone, so you really should think carefully about it.
translation: 一般情况下放逐者不会提供这样的机会，所以你要好好考虑一下。

original: Just hear me out. I've been thinking… imagine what a group like Talon Company could do with the two of us. Huh? You and me, goin' merc...
translation: 听我说。我一直在想……像鹰爪公司这样的企业会不会需要我们两个，嗯？你和我，去做佣兵…

original: I'll just take care of all your old gear for you and here are the new ones.
translation: 我来保管你所有的旧装备，给你新的。

original: Everything appears to be in order. Here you go.
translation: 看来一切井然有序。给。

original: I'll just take care of all your old gear for you and here are the new ones.
translation: 我来保管你所有的旧装备，给你新的。

original: Everything appears to be in order. Here you go.
translation: 看来一切井然有序。给。

original: I'll just take care of all your old gear for you and here are the new ones.
translation: 我来保管你所有的旧装备，给你新的。

original: Everything appears to be in order. Here you go.
translation: 看来一切井然有序。给。

original: I'll just take care of all your old gear for you and here are the new ones.
translation: 我来保管你所有的旧装备，给你新的。

original: Everything appears to be in order. Here you go.
translation: 看来一切井然有序。给。

original: What's going on is this whole mission is one big rat-fuck. We've been stuck here for way too long with no results.
translation: 现在的状况就是，这整个任务是个天大的笑话。我们陷入了泥潭中，长时间没有进展。

original: McGraw won't give up, so we've stooped to using chumps like you to try and get something out of this place.
translation: 麦格劳不会放弃的，所以我们才会降低要求使用像你这种傻瓜。

original: Well, I suppose if you don't mind us hacking off your forearm, we don't really.
translation: 要是你不介意我们把你前臂剁下来，我们才不需要你呢。

original: The sim is looking for an external interface. I haven't quite figured out why, but there's no way to bypass it.
translation: 模拟程序需要一个外部接口。我没弄明白那是为什么，但也没办法绕开它。

original: Your Pip-Boy there is a match. So since you're the one wearing it, you're the one running through the simulation. Get it?
translation: 你那哔哔小子完全符合。既然你戴着它，就由你去进行模拟程序。懂了吗？

original: The same thing we always do. Recover technology and preserve it, making sure it doesn't fall into the wrong hands.
translation: 就是我们一直在做的事情：找到科技所在，把它保存好，确保它不会落入敌手。

original: McGraw's hope is that whatever's in here will give us a big advantage. I'm not convinced, but I'm on his side.
translation: 麦格劳希望不论这里有什么，都能让我们受益无穷。我不大相信这个，但我站在他那边。

original: *Sigh* I find your level of ignorance disgusting... if not unexpected.
translation: *叹气* 你的无知让我感到恶心…那也是意料之中的。

original: This sim had to have been one of the most important of its time -- it's the liberation of Anchorage, Alaska from the Chinese.
translation: 这个程序展示了那个时代最重要的事件之一 — 从中国人手里解放阿拉斯加的安克雷奇。

original: Eventually, the Americans went in and liberated the city, but there were heavy losses. This simulation trained soldiers for that engagement!
translation: 最后，美国人出兵解放了城市，但付出了沉重的代价。这个模拟程序就是为那次战斗训练士兵用的！

original: Really, you must brush up on your history.
translation: 真的，你该复习一下历史了。

original: That's enough. McGraw's in charge, so we follow his orders, no matter how much we don't like it.
translation: 够了。麦格劳是头儿，所以我们服从他的命令，就算我们多不愿意都要服从。

original: Come on, man. How long you gonna let McGraw screw us over like this?
translation: 拜托，伙计。你还要让麦格劳像这样搞多久？

original: Man, this is the last thing we need...
translation: 伙计，这就是我们想要的最后一件东西…

original: Right away, sir.
translation: 遵命，长官。

original: Yeah, yeah... so I was wrong. Let's keep moving.
translation: 是啊，是啊……所以我错了。我们继续走吧。

original: Yes sir. On our way. We'll wait for you by the Mining Town.
translation: 是的，长官。立即出发。我们会在矿镇等你。

original: Yes sir. On our way. We'll wait for you by the Chimera Depot.
translation: 是的，长官。立即出发。我们会在奇美拉维修站等你。

original: Yes sir. On our way. We'll wait for you by the Listening Post.
translation: 是的，长官。立即出发。我们会在监听站等你。

original: Well, it's about goddamned time.
translation: 那么，真他妈是时候。

original: About damn time the reinforcements showed up! Fall in, soldier!
translation: 援军来的正是时候！冲啊，士兵们！

original: We've got multiple hostiles between here and the base camp. We're sweeping the area to secure it. Let's move!
translation: 在这里到敌营之间有很多敌军。我们正在横扫此处消灭敌人。出发！

original: Hell, you earned a lot of respect with the soldiers for what you did to those Chinese artillery guns.
translation: 管他呢，你摧毁了那些中国军队火炮，赢得了很多士兵的尊重。

original: Tell you what... take this extra gear with you, requisitions be damned. If anyone asks, it fell off a truck.
translation: 这样吧…拿上这个附加装备吧，去他的申请表。如果有人问到，就说是从卡车上掉下来的。

original: Fine, great. The sooner you're done, the sooner we can leave.
translation: 好，太棒了。你越快完成，我们就能越早离开。

original: First you need to put on the Neural Interface suit, and then you can get going.
translation: 你要先穿上神经接口服，才能继续。

original: Well, you're certainly not the help that Morrill had in mind, but from the looks of you, you might be useful in other ways.
translation: 你当然不是起着莫里尔所想的那种作用，但从你的外表看来，你在其他某些方面有用。

original: Under different circumstances, that wouldn't be nearly enough of an explanation.
translation: 在不同的情况下，那还不能构成一个解释。

original: But... I think you can be helpful, and so I'll overlook it for now.
translation: 但是…我想你是有用的，现在我就可以预见到。

original: You're fine now. Just be careful out there, all right?
translation: 你现在好了。小心行动，好吗？

original: Sure. See you around.
translation: 当然。再见。

original: Yeah, of course. Go on through.
translation: 嗯，当然。继续。

original: You're clear, but the pet Frankenstein stays up here...
translation: 你可以过去了，但你的宠物科学怪人得留在这儿…

original: Sure, but the zombie stays here.
translation: 当然，但这个丧尸得留在这儿。

original: No problem, but your friend stays topside with me.
translation: 没问题，但你的朋友得和我留在上面。

original: No problem, but leave the bot here.
translation: 没问题，但机器人得留在这里。

original: Yeah, but Lyons' woman stays topside. You head in. Alone.
translation: 嗯，但里昂斯的女人得留在上面。你一个人进去。

original: Yeah, but make sure that stray pooch doesn't tag along.
translation: 嗯，但你要确保那条野狗不会乱跑。

original: Yeah, of course. Go on through.
translation: 嗯，当然。继续。

original: Sure, but your pet Frankenstein stays here.
translation: 当然，但你的宠物科学怪人要留在这儿。

original: Sure, but the zombie stays up here, where I can keep an eye on it...
translation: 当然，但丧尸要留在这里，我要看着它…

original: No problem, but your friend stays topside with me.
translation: 没问题，但你的朋友要和我留在上面。

original: No problem, but leave the bot here.
translation: 没问题，但机器人要留在这里。

original: Yeah, but Lyons' woman stays topside. You head in. Alone.
translation: 嗯，但里昂斯的女人在最上面。你一个人进去。

original: Yeah, but make sure that stray pooch doesn't tag along.
translation: 嗯，但你要确保那条野狗不会乱跑。

original: About time. Report to Protector McGraw, but leave your friend with me.
translation: 时间差不多了。去向麦格劳保护者报到，但把你的朋友留在我这。

original: You've got some nerve bringing Lyons' bitch here. You go down. Alone.
translation: 你居然敢带里昂斯的婊子来这里，胆子不小啊。你只能一个人下去。

original: No dogs allowed. Head down, but leave the mutt with me.
translation: 狗不能进去。你下去，但把狗留在这里。

original: Umm... Noooo...
It's the liberation of Anchorage, Alaska from Chinese Communists. It was a pretty significant event in American history, according to our Scribe.
translation: 是阿拉斯加的安克雷奇从中国共产党手中获得解放。据我们的学士说，这是美利坚历史上的一件大事。
