original: We're talking front line, heavy combat -- safety protocols disengaged. That means you die in the sim... your body goes into massive cardiac arrest.
translation: 我们说的是前线，激烈战斗——安全协议已解除。这意味着你会在模拟中死去……你的身体会出现严重的心脏骤停。

original: You're still listening, so I'm going to assume you're interested. But time's wasting. Sibley can take you to the pod. Olin will get you briefed.
translation: 你还在听，那我就当你感兴趣啰。但别浪费时间。西布利会带你去模拟仓。奥林会给你做简报。

original: If you want to walk away, you're free to leave. My men won't stop you.
translation: 如果你不想干，可以自由离去，我的人不会阻拦你。

original: ...<laughs>You almost sound like a sympathizer - you really feel sorry for the poor saps?
translation: …<大笑>你听起来很像是个同情者 - 你真的为那些可怜的家伙感到难过？

original: ...<static>...
Yeah, exactly. They're in for a long haul.
translation: 嗯，确实。他们会长期加入。

original: You'd think, but they're not like us. Their boys are drafted and left to rot on whatever shit assignment they're handed.
translation: 你可以这么想，但他们不像我们。他们的人接到任务后就没人管了。

original: No, no - it's not that at all. I get that the Chinese occupation in Alaska is strictly military, but don't you think they'd settle in a bit?
translation: 不，不 - 完全不是那样。我了解到中国人在阿拉斯加是严格意义上的军事占领，但难道你认为他们不会在那里殖民吗？

original: ...yeah, I can. Don't know who exactly this simulation is supposed to benefit, though.
translation: ……嗯，我可以。但不知道究竟是谁会因这个模拟而受益。

original: ...<static>...
Jesus, are these guys serious? Why would they bring that kind of hardware with them?
translation: 上帝啊，这些人搞什么啊？他们为何要带着那种硬件？

original: I got word from brass at the Pentagon. We're going to need to modify the RoE on the Chinese to match this.
translation: 五角大楼的混蛋们传过话来了。我们需要修改与中国人的交战规则（RoE），以便与之匹配。

original: We just got more field reports from DoD. Hey, Rick. You busy?
translation: 我们刚从国防部那里得到战地报告。嗨, 里克。你有空吗？

original: Gary?
translation: 加里？

original: Listen, son, I know Morrill was rough on you. I'm sorry, I really am -
translation: 听着，孩子，我知道莫里尔对你很粗暴。我很抱歉，真的——

original: Gary? Gary?
translation: 加里？加里？

original: Right. You can drop the act, now. I'm not here to hurt you.
translation: 好了。你别装了。我不是来伤害你的。

original: <heavy sigh> Look, just remove the PIP-Boy and we can part ways.
translation: <沉重的叹气> 这样吧，把哔哔小子取下来，我们就可以分道扬镳。

original: Gary? GARY!
translation: 加里？加里！

original: You know what? Fuck this. Hand me that saw - and turn off the recorder.
translation: 你明白吗？去他妈的，把那锯子给我 - 还有把录音机关掉。

original: Gaaaaaaary...
translation: 加加加加加里……

original: I appreciate your honesty. It's a rare virtue in this age.
translation: 我欣赏你的坦诚，这是这个时代少有的德行。

original: Wernher was my lieutenant until he betrayed me and escaped justice. And if I know him, he brought you here to steal something very dear to the city.
translation: 沃纳曾是我的副手，直到他背叛了我，还逃过了裁决。就我对他的了解，他带你来这里，是为了偷这个城市最珍贵的东西。

original: Do you intend to follow through with his plan? Feel free to be honest. Please, don't be intimidated by the turret behind you.
translation: 你打算执行他的计划吗？说实话吧。请不要被身后的炮塔吓到。

original: I figured it'd be something like that. Goodbye, new blood.
translation: 我就知道会是这样。再见了，新人。

original: I figured it'd be something like that. Goodbye, new blood.
translation: 我就知道会是这样。再见了，新人。

original: Watch where you're going, meat!
translation: 当心，肉！

original: Just head back and talk to Sandra. She'll explain all about the cure. Then you'll see why you have to put an end to Wernher.
translation: 回头跟桑德拉谈谈，她会向你解释解药的事，然后你会明白，你为什么必须干掉沃纳。

original: I suggest you forget Wernher's offer, and consider mine: stop Wernher, and you'll have a bright future in The Pitt. Don't disappoint me, new blood.
translation: 我建议你忘掉沃纳的提议，考虑一下我的：阻止沃纳，你会在匹兹堡前途无量。别让我失望，新人。

original: That's an interesting way to put it. But yes, I suppose the city's future does rest squarely upon it.
translation: 你这么说倒是很有趣，不过也是，我认为这座城市的未来确实仰仗于此。

original: Something tells me you won't want the responsibility that comes with it.
translation: 我猜想你不是会愿意承担这个东西所附带的责任的。

original: Now, someone of your character would be much better off if you just...
translation: 现在，你会过得好起来的，只要你……

original: Easy enough. You could say no because he lied to you.
translation: 简单极了。他欺骗了你，你应该对他说不。

original: My discovery is a miracle, but it isn't the type that sets slaves free.
translation: 我的发现是个奇迹，不过它本身不可能给予奴隶们自由。

original: Now, it would do a lot more good if you were to...
translation: 现在，它将会带来更多的好处，要是你……

original: Oh, it's valuable. I'd say there's nothing I care more about in the world.
translation: 哦，它很珍贵。我要说这世上再没什么其他东西比它更让我在意的了。

original: But Wernher doesn't truly appreciate everything it means to me, or to The Pitt.
translation: 不过沃纳确实不欣赏它对我，或者对匹兹堡来说所意味的一切。

original: Now, if caps are all you want, I can make you a much better offer than that snake, and all you have to do is...
translation: 现在，如果瓶盖就是你想要的，我可以出比那毒蛇更好的价钱，而且你要做的只是……

original: Not in the slightest. During the Scourge, we looted The Pitt and left the rest of it to rot. I was just a dumb convert who got stuck here afterwards.
translation: 一点都不怀念。天谴行动期间，我们掠夺了匹兹堡，把它变成了一片狼籍。我只是一个后来被陷在了这儿的愚蠢信徒。

original: See, beneath it all, the Brotherhood's just lazy. It's easier to loot a dying city than work to bring it back to life, so that's what they did.
translation: 瞧，在整个事情的背后，兄弟会真是懒透了。掠夺一座快要死掉的城市总比把它带回生机要容易得多，所以他们就那么做了。

original: They're so obsessed with the technology of the past, they don't care what needs to be done for today and tomorrow.
translation: 他们太迷恋过去的技术，不在乎要为今天和明天做些什么。

original: It takes real hard work to rebuild and run a city. But there isn't a machine to do it for them, so the Brotherhood isn't interested. Good riddance.
translation: 重建和运作一座城市需要动真格的。但没有机器能帮他们完成，所以兄弟会对此没有兴趣。走得好。

original: What the hell do you think? We're still brought here against our will, and we still have to work until we fall over.
translation: 你以为呢？我们还违心地呆在这，我们在倒下之前还得不停的工作。

original: Sure, maybe the guards don't shoot us for fun as often. And there's a slim chance that someday we'll stop getting sick and dying. Maybe.
translation: 是啊，也许守卫们没有像平常一样觉得好玩而向我们射击。可能我们还有一线希望在将来的某一天停止患病和死亡。

original: Whoop-tee-fucking-doo. Thank goodness you came here to save us.
translation: 你真是太他妈善良了，真感谢上天派你来拯救我们。

original: You better believe it. No more beatings, no more forced work, no more slaves being brought here in chains. You did some good work.
translation: 你最好相信。再没有鞭打声，再没有强迫式的工作，再没有戴着枷锁的奴隶被送到这来。你积了点德。

original: Of course, we've got all new problems, now that Ashur and the taskmasters are gone. Not enough food getting brought in, for one thing.
translation: 当然，我们碰到了新的麻烦，现在那个阿舒尔和工头们走了。首先，没有足够的食物送到这边来。

original: Wernher said he'll organize scavenging parties, but I think he'd rather stay up in the bar than actually do any leading.
translation: 沃纳说他会组织拾荒队，不过我想他事实上宁可待在酒馆，也不愿做什么领导工作。

original: Whatever. We'll work it out, somehow.
translation: 管他的。我们总会搞定的。

original: Oh, things are fine. Don't let any grumblers tell you differently!
translation: 哦，都很好。别信那些牢骚鬼跟你说的废话。

original: Oh, sure, there are a few problems... We need scavenging teams, people to fight off the Trogs, and overseers for the mill's operation.
translation: 哦，当然，有一些小麻烦……我们需要拾荒人员，能够击退这些兽化人的人手，以及轧钢厂的监工。

original: But it's a small price to pay for seeing the end of Ashur and his bastards, right?
translation: 但只要能让阿舒尔和他那帮狗娘养的完蛋，这代价就不算什么，对吧？

original: Sorry... I'm just so tired. I'll work harder. Don't hurt me.
translation: 抱歉……我太困了……我会卖力干活。别伤害我。

original: Nap time's over, asshole. On your feet!
translation: 打盹时间过了，混球。站起来！

original: Now, stay still while mommy takes a few readings. Don't worry, dear, you're perfectly safe!
translation: 妈妈阅读的时候别乱动。别着急，亲爱的，你绝对安全！

original: You want to die, asshole? Back to it!
translation: 你想死，混球？回去！

original: It looks like you've already got a set of Slave Clothes to disguise yourself with. Good. That'll make things easier.
translation: 你看来像是已经搞到了一套奴隶的衣服。很好，这样事情就好办多了。

original: I'll meet you up by the tunnel that leads to The Pitt. You go get whatever you'll need for the trip.
translation: 我会在通向匹兹堡的隧道附近跟你碰头。你先去准备点路上用得到东西。

original: Make sure you're prepared. It's a long trip and you won't be back here for a while.
translation: 确定你准备好了。这是趟长途旅行，你一时半会回不来了。

original: My clothes? Off my back? Well... I guess. You did help us. I'm sure... I'm sure I'll make do out there in the wastes.
translation: 我的衣服？从我身上脱下来？那么……我想想。你确实帮了我们的忙。我肯定……我肯定我在废土中是可以将就一下的。

original: I... don't worry about me. I'll find something, I'm sure.
translation: 我……不用担心我。我会找到的，我会的。

original: Take them, please. Take them.
translation: 请收下吧。拿去吧。

original: My clothes? Off my back? Well... I guess. You did help us. I'm sure... I'm sure I'll make do out there in the wastes.
translation: 我的衣服？从我身上脱下来？那么……我想想。你确实帮了我们的忙。我肯定……我肯定我在废土中是可以将就一下的。

original: I... don't worry about me. I'll find something, I'm sure.
translation: 我……不用担心我。我会找到的，我会的。

original: Take them, please. Take them.
translation: 请收下吧。拿去吧。

original: My clothes? Off my back? Well... I guess. You did help us. I'm sure... I'm sure I'll make do out there in the wastes.
translation: 我的衣服？从我身上脱下来？那么……我想想。你确实帮了我们的忙。我肯定……我肯定我在废土中是可以将就一下的。

original: I... don't worry about me. I'll find something, I'm sure.
translation: 我……不用担心我。我会找到的，我会的。

original: Take them, please. Take them.
translation: 请收下吧。拿去吧。

original: Finally. Here's the key to the gate. Do whatever you want with 'em. I couldn't care less.
translation: 很好，给你大门钥匙。你可以对他们做你想做的任何事。我不会管的。

original: Oh, hey: Eulogy says to tell your man that we're sorry that we could only get three. We'll get a better roundup next time.
translation: 哦，嗨，尤勒基让我跟你们的人讲，我们很抱歉，这回只抓到了三个奴隶。下一回围捕我们会努力点。

original: Pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 很高兴跟你做生意。

original: No guts? What do you mean-
translation: 没胆？你什么意思——

original: One of 'em is coming back? Dumbass slaves... Open the gate!
translation: 他们有个人回来了？傻瓜奴隶们……开门！

original: Who is that down there? I can't see a fuckin' thing. Open up the gate, it might be one of those slaves.
translation: 谁在那？他妈的我什么都看不见。打开门，可能是那些奴隶中的一个人。

original: Hang on. Someone's coming. Let me do the talking.
translation: 等等，有人来了。让我来和他说。

original: Hey, hey! What are you guys doing here?
translation: 嗨，嗨！你们这些家伙在这里干什么？

original: Yeah, that's what I thought, asshole.
translation: 是的，我就是那么想的，混蛋。

original: The last person to try that was Wernher, and you can be damned sure Ashur's going to turn him into a little ball of pain.
translation: 上一个想这么干的人是沃纳，而阿舒尔肯定会让他粉身碎骨。

original: I recommend you get out there and help, and maybe I'll forget you had that little lapse of judgement.
translation: 我建议你赶快离开这里到外面去帮忙，没准我会忘掉你刚才的一时冲动。

original: Think of it as clearing the stage. The cure in this brat's genes is the only thing worth keeping, and now we can wipe that hellhole clean.
translation: 把它看作是新时代开始的信号吧。这个调皮孩子基因里的解药是唯一值得保存下来的东西，现在我们可以把这个堕落之地清洗掉。

original: And that takes us to the last part of the plan: letting the Trogs overrun Uptown, killing every last bastard in there.
translation: 这样我们就进入到这个计划的最后部分：让兽化人席卷上城区，杀掉那里剩下的每一个狗娘养的。

original: Leaving you to take Ashur's place.
translation: 接下来你去占领阿舒尔的地盘。

original: It means that we can study Ashur's bastard, and once we dig the cure out of it, make sure that we all get the treatment.
translation: 这意味着我们可以研究阿舒尔的私生子，一旦我们找出治疗法，就能确保我们所有人都能得到治疗。

original: But more importantly, it means we're ready for the last part of the plan - letting the Trogs overrun Uptown and wipe out the bosses.
translation: 但更重要的是，这表示我们已经为计划的最后一部分做好了准备——让兽化人席卷上城区，消灭老板们。

original: Leaving the slaves free, and turning the bosses into Trog food!
translation: 让奴隶们自由，把老板们变成兽化人的口粮！

original: She's not just any baby. She holds the promise of a cure for our own children, and we can ransom her back for our freedom.
translation: 她可不是个平常的孩子。她掌握着治疗我们自己孩子的承诺，我们可以用她赎回我们的自由。

original: Don't think I enjoy this any more than you. But it's the only way we can be free and healthy enough to leave.
translation: 别以为我比你更喜欢干这种事。不过这也是我们得到自由，健健康康离去的没有办法的办法。

original: Of course, she'll be safe. We're just going to do our own research for the cure, and then ransom her back for our freedom.
translation: 当然，她会平安无恙的。我们只是要自己研究出治疗法，然后用她赎回我们的自由。

original: You've seen how Ashur and his people treat us. It's far, far kinder than they deserve.
translation: 你也看到了阿舒尔和他的人是怎么对待我们的。这比让他们得到应有的惩罚不知道要仁慈多少倍。

original: Oh, now I see how it is! Think you're going to become Ashur's new lieutenant, do you? Maybe wait until you can take his throne?
translation: 噢，我明白是怎么一回事了！你将成为阿舒尔的新副官，对吗？你或许会取而代之？

original: I've seen your type come and go, and they always leave town face down in the river.
translation: 我总是能见到你这种人，他们最后也总是死在河里的。

original: So, fine. You picked your side, and you made your choice. See where that takes you.
translation: 那么，很好。你选了你的立场。我们等着瞧你会有什么样的归宿。

original: We're just supposed to live and die in slavery, and watch our children turn into monsters, all because you don't have the balls to do your job?
translation: 那我们就该老老实实地在奴隶制度下生老病死，眼睁睁的看着我们的孩子变成怪物，一切都是因为你没有闭上嘴干活？

original: Wake up, you simple-headed sap. That baby could do more good for us than all of his mongrel raider family ever did for us combined.
translation: 醒醒吧，你这个头脑简单的傻瓜。那个孩子比他整个杂种歹徒家族曾给我们的所有一切加起来都有用处。

original: It's not like we were going to harm her. We just needed to kidnap her for our freedom. Look, sometimes, these things have to happen!
translation: 我们没打算伤害她，我们只是为了我们的自由所以才这么做。听着，有时候会逼不得已！

original: Okay, okay! Wernher was the one who wanted to steal the baby. I just wanted our freedom. I didn't think about what it would take.
translation: 好吧，好吧！沃纳是想偷这个孩子的人。我只想得到我们的自由，我不考虑后果。

original: Wernher's hiding in the steelyard. Look for a rooftop door in the southwest. There, are you happy? Go! Just stop looking at me like that!
translation: 沃纳的藏身处在钢院，在西南屋顶一扇门后面。高兴了吧？走吧！别再那样子看着我！

original: Fine, if it'll get you out of the way, go check under the blast furnace in the steelyard.
translation: 好了，我告诉你，你快离开吧。去钢院的鼓风炉下面查查看。

original: Look for a rooftop door in the southwest. It's got a blue light, you can't miss it. But Wernher will put you in your place.
translation: 找到西南屋顶上的门，上头有盏蓝色的灯，别走错了。不过沃纳会叫你明白你是谁的。

original: The Bear Brothers are dead! Amazing! This newcomer is showing promise, my friends!
translation: 贝尔兄弟死了！不敢相信！这个新手前途无量，我的朋友们！

original: They're savage! They're brutal! They're here to keep this worker in place -- the undefeated Bear Brothers!
translation: 他们野蛮！他们残忍！他们在这让这位工人无法动弹——不败的贝尔兄弟！

original: Let's find out if the newcomer can hold against real fighters! Release! Fight!
translation: 让我们瞧瞧这个新手能不能放倒真正的战士！打开！开打！

original: And there is only one left standing! Only one! Oh, my friends! What a fantastic fight! How far will this slave go?
translation: 仅有一个人能挺到最后！仅有一个！哦，我的朋友们！多么美妙的战斗！这个奴隶能走多远？

original: And now, my friends, we have for you a group of slaves willing to kill and slaughter in order to become one of we privileged few!
translation: 那么，我的朋友们，我们给你们这样一群奴隶一个机会，你们当中谁愿意杀戮，谁就有可能跻身成为特权精英的一员。

original: They will fight! They will die! And all for you! All for your entertainment!
translation: 他们将角斗！他们会死去！一切都是为了你们！都是为了愉悦你们！

original: Now, are they ready to die for their chance at freedom? Let's find out! Release the barrels! Fight!
translation: 现在，他们准备好要为争得自由的机会而豁出命去了吗？我们拭目以待！打开这些桶！开打！

original: Well all right! That's what I like to hear! Get on in there!
translation: 这就好！这才是我想听到的！进去！

original: Well all right! That's what I like to hear! Get on in there!
translation: 这就好！这才是我想听到的！进去！

original: If you're ready, just step on in.
translation: 你要是准备好了，就直接走进去。

original: Citizens of The Pitt, workers of Downtown, traders of Uptown, and all fierce souls who do what must be done!
translation: 匹兹堡的平民、下城区的工人、上城区的商人和所有坚守着岗位的凶猛灵魂们！

original: I bring you good news! We stand at the dawn of a new golden age. Where others merely survive, we thrive!
translation: 我给你们带来了好消息！我们站在新黄金时代的拂晓。其他地方的人们只能苟延残喘，而我们欣欣向荣！

original: Our industry is the envy of the Commonwealth! Our safety is the envy of the Capital Wastes! Our might is the envy of Ronto!
translation: 我们的工业生产力压联邦！我们的安全保障冠绝首都废土！我们的力量让伦多羡慕不已！

original: And while I have led your efforts, it has been by your own strength that you have earned all of the envy of the world.
translation: 在我的带领下，你们奋发图强，通过自己的力量赢得了世界上所有人的尊敬。

original: They envy the steel shaped by the workers in our mills, and they envy the strength of our traders and raiders who wield that steel for The Pitt.
translation: 他们羡慕我们的工厂中工人们锻造出来的钢铁，他们羡慕我们的商人，羡慕为匹兹堡挥舞着那些钢铁武器的掠夺者的力量。

original: And most of all, they envy our victories in the struggle for freedom. Because, yes, freedom is what we all work towards.
translation: 他们最最羡慕的是，我们在自由的斗争中所获得的成功。因为，是的，自由是我们付出一切努力的方向。

original: Freedom from fear, freedom from disease, freedom to live as once we did before we were shackled by atomic fire!
translation: 免于恐惧，免于疾病，自由地生活，就像我们被原子之火烤焦之前一样！

original: And so, to celebrate this struggle, I ask my loyal workers: who among you is prepared to fight for your freedom?
translation: 因此，为了庆祝这场斗争，我问我忠诚的工人们：你们当中有谁准备为自由而战？

original: Who among you will risk your life in the crucible to create a new life of freedom in Uptown? Who will take this rare chance to thrive?
translation: 你们当中有谁愿意冒着生命危险，在上城区创造自由的新生活？谁将抓住这个难得的机会茁壮成长？

original: Anthony's sick. He sent me to take his place.
translation: 安东尼病了，他派我顶替他。

original: Yes, you'd think that, wouldn't you? But that's because you're an idiot who thinks he can get away with kidnapping Ashur's daughter.
translation: 是的，你是那么想的，不是吗？不过那只因为你是个以为自己可以带着绑架来的阿舒尔女儿逃走的白痴。

original: Our raiders will tear you apart, and when they're done, Marie will be playing with your bones as a rattle.
translation: 我们手下的歹徒会扒了你的皮，然后玛丽会把你的骨头拿来当玩具玩。

original: And you really think the slaves can develop a cure more efficiently than I can? Don't be an idiot.
translation: 你真觉得奴隶们能比我更有效率地研制出解药吗？别傻了。

original: And if they so much as pluck one hair off her head, I'll be sure to pluck one eye out of each of theirs.
translation: 他们要敢动她一根头发，我保证会挖下他们每个人的一颗眼珠子。

original: So maybe you should just put her back right this instant and tell those miserable bastards that they can wait until their goddamned turn.
translation: 所以你也许该立刻乖乖将她放回去，然后告诉那些可悲的混蛋，他们可以等到轮到他们的时候。

original: You don't even know how dead you are, do you?
translation: 你甚至不知道你死定了，对吗？

original: I can't really help you there. Ask around. Maybe check with Marco in the Mill. He's been making some of our tools into weapons.
translation: 我帮不了你。去四下打听一下，可以问问轧钢厂的马可。他把我们的一些工具做成了武器。

original: You might even be able to find a gun on one of the dead bosses out in the Steelyard. They- what was that?
translation: 你甚至可以在钢院的老板们的尸体上找到枪。他们——那是什么？

original: I can't really help you there. Ask around. Maybe check with Marco in the Mill. He's been making some of our tools into weapons.
translation: 我帮不了你。去四下打听一下，可以问问轧钢厂的马可。他把我们的一些工具做成了武器。

original: You might even be able to find a gun on one of the dead bosses out in the Steelyard. They- what was that?
translation: 你甚至可以在钢院的老板们的尸体上找到枪。他们——那是什么？

original: Outside of the mill, there are a bunch of old steel ingots just lying around. Every so often, the Foreman puts out a work order to collect them.
translation: 在轧钢厂外边，闲放着不少钢锭。有时候，工头会贴出工作告示找人去收集这些钢锭。

original: It's practically a death sentence and they never assign it to anyone. They make us pick who's going to do it. Bastards.
translation: 谁要是接这份工，几乎等于判了死刑。他们从没把这份工作指派给任何人，他们让我们自己挑人。那些杂种。

original: Oh, I see how it is. You signed on with Ashur, and now you're going to stand by your man. Maybe trying to catch his eye and be his queen?
translation: 哦，我明白咋回事了。你投靠了阿舒尔，现在你要支持你地男人。也许想着法子吸引他的注意，成为他的王后？

original: Well, good luck with that, starfucker. I'm sure the two of you will kill each other eventually, even without my help.
translation: 祝你好运，大白痴。我肯定你们俩最终会互相残杀，甚至不需要我插手。

original: You, him, and this whole town can burn for all I care. I'm gone.
translation: 你，他，还有这整个城镇都下地狱吧，我不在乎。我走了。

original: Sure, fine. Obviously, you've joined with Ashur and I think you've got a bright future as a lackey. You really do.
translation: 当然，好的。看来你已经加入阿舒尔一伙了，我想，作为一个奴仆，你得到了光明的前途。你确实得到了。

original: But you know what? Fuck this city, and fuck the raiders, fuck the slaves, and fuck you too, fucker. I'm gone.
translation: 不过你知道吗？操这座城市，操那些歹徒，操这些奴隶，也操你这个蠢货。我走了。

original: Oh yeah? You sure you're ready to die?
translation: 哦，是吗？你准备好去送死了？

original: Yeah... you're the one Midea told me about. Wernher sent you, right? I can help you out.
translation: 是的……美狄亚跟我提起过你。沃纳派你来的，对吧？我可以帮你。

original: Take this. It's called an Auto Axe. Nice, huh? I make 'em out of the old car parts the breakers drag in from the city.
translation: 拿上这个，它叫自动斧。很妙吧，嘿？我用那些拆卸工从城里搞来的那台老式汽车的原件做的。

original: Do what you can with it, just be careful around the bosses. Make a wrong move and you're done.
translation: 你随便用，只是小心周围的老板们，走错一步你就完了。

original: That's probably for the best.
translation: 那也许是最好的主意。

original: It's your funeral. Here you go.
translation: 它是你的葬礼。给你。

original: It's your funeral. Here you go.
translation: 它是你的葬礼。给你。

original: Go! Get him! Get the traitor!
translation: 上！抓住他！抓住这个叛徒！

original: Okay, break's over.
translation: 好吧，休息时间结束。

original: Yes, sir!
translation: 是，长官！

original: Now, I've got a very important meeting with our new friend, so if anything big comes up, you use the intercom.
translation: 现在，我要和我们的新朋友进行一次非常重要的会面，所以要是出了什么大事，你就用对讲机通知我。

original: And keep a watch on Midea at all times - anything big happens, it's bound to go through her.
translation: 时刻监视美狄亚——出任何大事都和她脱不了干系。

original: All right, all right. Put your guards on alert, tell them to be on the lookout for anyone loitering too long downtown.
translation: 好吧，好吧。让你的守卫保持警惕，告诉他们注意任何在下城区游荡太久的人。

original: Whatever we call them, they've been gathering makeshift weapons.
translation: 不管我们称他们什么，他们都已经准备好了临时用的武器。

original: We call them "workers." Helps with morale, reminds them they might earn their freedom, someday.
translation: 我们称他们“工人”，帮助鼓舞士气，提醒他们有一天他们可能会获得自由。

original: What?
translation: 什么？

original: "Workers."
translation: “工人。”

original: Sir, we've had sightings of Wernher back in the city, and there's been an increase in chatter between slaves.
translation: 长官，我们在城里发现了沃纳的踪迹，奴隶之间的对话也越来越多了。

original: No, but I may heal the infirm later in the week. Time permitting, of course.
translation: 不，但我可以在本周晚些时候治疗体弱者。当然，时间允许的话。

original: And I suppose you'll follow that up by raising the dead?
translation: 我猜你还会让死人复活吧？

original: I'll be with you, right after I maintain some order and dispense a little justice.
translation: 等我维持好秩序，伸张一下正义之后，我会和你站一起的。

original: And I'm telling you, I've got it covered.
translation: 我告诉你，我能搞定。

original: I'm telling you, they're planning something!
translation: 我告诉你，他们正计划着什么！

original: Not yet, hotshot. Ashur's got people watching me, and I can't keep a baby hidden in this dump.
translation: 还不行，高手。阿舒尔派人监视着我，我不能把孩子藏在这鬼地方。

original: Wernher sent me word that he's hiding out in the Steelyard. He's got everything there to take care of the cure.
translation: 沃纳给我的消息说，他藏在钢院。他已经准备好了一切，来照顾这解药。

original: Take it to him, and he'll handle the rest. Now get going!
translation: 把它给他带过去，剩下的就交给他吧。行动吧！

original: She'll be all right - just not with me. Ashur's guards are always watching me. They'd find her right away.
translation: 她会没事的——只是不能和我在一起。阿舒尔的守卫一直在监视我，他们会马上找到她的。

original: Wernher sent me word that he's hiding out in the Steelyard. He's got everything there to take care of the cure.
translation: 沃纳给我的消息说，他藏在钢院。他已经准备好了一切，来照顾这解药。

original: Take it to him, and he'll handle the rest. Now get going!
translation: 把它给他带过去，剩下的就交给他吧。行动吧！

original: Don't make me come in there...
translation: 别让我过去……

original: Hold it right there, grinder. Inspection.
translation: 待在那别动，磨工。检查。

original: Hold it right there, Waster. Inspection.
translation: 呆在那别动，废物。检查。

original: Come on, we're almost there. It's just past this gate.
translation: 来吧，我们快到了，穿过这扇门就是。

original: Well then, I hope you also said goodbye! HAHAHAHA! Alright, play time's over. Get to work, grinders.
translation: 那么，我希望你也说声再见！哈哈哈哈！好吧，放风时间结束。去干活，磨工。

original: Yes sir. I told him what he needs to do. He knows. 10 ingots. As fast as he can.
translation: 是的，长官。我跟他讲了要做的事情。他知道了，10块钢锭，越快越好。

original: Yes sir. I told her what she needs to do. She knows. 10 ingots. As fast as she can.
translation: 是的，长官。我跟她讲了要做的事情。她知道了，10块钢锭，越快越好。

original: Oh yeah? So he's the one that's going out to the Steelyard, huh?
translation: 噢，是吗？那么他就是要去钢院的人吗，嘿？

original: Oh yeah? So she's the one that's going out to the Steelyard, huh?
translation: 噢，是吗？那么她就是要去钢院的人吗，嘿？

original: Uhm... nothing. Nothing... uh... sir. I was just telling this new worker about the job the Foreman posted.
translation: 嗯……没什么。没事……嗯……长官。我只是在跟这个新来的工人说说工头布置的工作。

original: You're looking for Marco, hrm? What's he up to?
translation: 你在找马可，嗯？他是做什么的？

original: He's over in the old control room, near the gate to Uptown. I'll... I'll let him know you're coming.
translation: 他在上城区大门附近的旧控制室。我会……我会让告诉他你来了。

original: He's over in the Mill. I don't see him except for meals.
translation: 他在轧钢厂，除了进餐时间，我没见过他。

original: I tried. Really I did. This is your own fault.
translation: 我试过了，真的。这是你自己的错。

original: Very well, Midea. If that is the will of the workers, then this man shall be their champion!
translation: 非常好，美狄亚。如果那是工人们的意愿，那么这位勇士就是他们的冠军。

original: Very well, Midea. If that is the will of the workers, then this woman shall be their champion!
translation: 非常好，美狄亚。如果那是工人们的意愿，那么这位女士就是他们的冠军。

original: Sir, you carry not only the dream that workers can become free, but that we may all someday become truly free from the threats of our world.
translation: 先生，你不仅承载工人们获得自由的梦想，也肩负着我们有朝一日能真正摆脱世界威胁的重任。

original: Madam, you carry not only the dream that workers can become free, but that we may all someday become truly free from the threats of our world.
translation: 女士，你不仅承载工人们获得自由的梦想，也肩负着我们有朝一日能真正摆脱世界威胁的重任。

original: Prepare yourself, sir. And when you are ready to be forged anew, report to Faydra in the Steel Mill.
translation: 好好准备，先生。当你准备好被重新锻造时，到轧钢厂的费德拉那里报到。

original: Prepare yourself, Madam. And when you are ready to be forged anew, report to Faydra in the Steel Mill.
translation: 好好准备，女士。当你准备好被重新锻造时，到轧钢厂的费德拉那里报到。

original: The rest of you are dismissed.
translation: 其他人解散。

original: Right here! We have one! This woman here will fight in the Hole!
translation: 在这儿！我们有一个！这个女人将进入角斗坑战斗！

original: Right here! We have one! This man here will fight in the Hole!
translation: 在这儿！我们有一个！这个男人将进入角斗坑战斗！

original: C'mon, Ashur! Will you send someone to the Hole who actually stands a chance?
translation: 来呀，阿舒尔！你能派一个真正有实力一战的人进到角斗坑里面去吗？

original: All workers report to the Square. All workers report to the Square.
translation: 所有的工人到广场报到。所有的工人到广场报到。

original: And now, this slave has proven willing to kill and die for his freedom! But how will he fare against the last man who made it all the way: Gruber!
translation: 那么，这个奴隶已经证实他愿意为了他的自由而搏命！不过当他遭遇到最后的这位所向披靡的对手：格鲁伯，他会怎么样呢！

original: And now, this slave has proven willing to kill and die for her freedom! But how will she fare against the man who made it all the way: Gruber!
translation: 那么，这个奴隶已经证实她愿意为了她的自由而搏命！不过当她遭遇到最后的这位所向披靡的对手：格鲁伯，她会怎么样呢！

original: Undefeated in the Hole, Gruber has yet to meet his match.
translation: 格鲁伯在角斗坑中没被击败过，他还没遇见过敌手。

original: Only one will walk out with their freedom! Only one will walk out alive! Release the barrels! GO!
translation: 仅有一个人将带着他们的自由走出去！仅有一个人活着走出去！打开这些桶！上！

original: C'mon, coward!
translation: 来啊，胆小鬼！

original: I know I shouldn't trust you, but if it'll make Marie happy, it means I can get some sleep. So, okay.
translation: 我知道我不该相信你，但如果这能让玛丽开心，我就能睡个好觉了。那么，好吧。

original: She seems to really enjoy teddy bears. She just can't seem to get enough of them.
translation: 她好像蛮喜欢泰迪熊。只是她对这些玩具像是不知足一样。

original: Bring as many as you can, and I'll even pay you... Once I make sure they aren't filled with razor blades.
translation: 你尽可能多带些来，我甚至可以付钱给你……只要我确定它们没有装刀片就行。

original: Oh, you'd be such a life-saver! A happy Marie means I can get some sleep once in a while.
translation: 哦，你真是我的救世主！玛丽高兴，那我就有机会好好地睡上一觉了。

original: She seems to really enjoy teddy bears. She just can't seem to get enough of them!
translation: 她好像蛮喜欢泰迪熊。只是她对这些玩具像是不知足一样。

original: Bring as many as you can, and I'll make sure you're well paid for the effort!
translation: 尽可能的多帮我搞些来，我保证会付你钱。

original: Thanks! And Marie says thanks too!
translation: 谢谢！玛丽也谢谢你！

original: Thanks, but don't think this makes up for what you did.
translation: 谢谢，但别以为这能弥补你做过的事。

original: Here's your pay, I guess.
translation: 我想这是你的报酬。

original: That sure would help me out. Happier Marie is, the more likely I can get a full night's sleep for once in my life.
translation: 那无疑帮了我的忙。玛丽越高兴，我就越有可能睡上我这辈子的第一次完整觉。

original: She seems to really enjoy teddy bears. Creepy little things, but I guess she doesn't know any better.
translation: 她好像蛮喜欢泰迪熊这种怪模怪样的小玩意，不过我猜她也就知道这么多事了。

original: Bring as many as you can, and you'll get paid plenty for it. I promise.
translation: 尽可能的多帮我搞些来，我保证会付你大笔钱。

original: Thanks, you have no idea how much this will help.
translation: 谢谢，你绝对想不到这帮了我多大的忙。

original: Here's your pay.
translation: 给你工钱。

original: It hurts my heart to see a sober customer.
translation: 看见没醉的顾客伤了我的心。

original: If you walk out of here sober, I'm not doing my job.
translation: 你要是从这里走出去还不醉，我的工作不干了。

original: Oh, good! And here I thought you were planning to stay sober.
translation: 噢，得！你就是打算不醉啊。

original: You'd best not be wasting my time, newbie.
translation: 你最好别浪费我的时间，菜鸟。

original: Yeah sure, newbie.
translation: 是的，当然，菜鸟。

original: Sure thing, newbie.
translation: 当然，菜鸟。

original: You're a real joker, aren't you? Whatever. Listen, I come from a place called The Pitt. It's a city far to the northwest.
translation: 你真会开玩笑，是吧？随便啦。听着，我来自一个叫匹兹堡的地方，那是西北方一座遥远的城市。

original: The place is a nightmare for... well, for so many reasons. But the bigger problem is that my people are slaves.
translation: 那地方是个噩梦，因为……嗯，因为许许多多的原因。不过更大的问题是，我的人民都是奴隶。

original: No big deal, right? It's a rough world. Who cares? But I have the chance to free them. I just need an outsider's help before we lose that chance.
translation: 没什么大不了的，对吧？它是个粗暴的世界，谁关心呢？不过我有机会解放他们。在那个机会错失之前，我迫切需要一个外来者的帮忙。

original: Yeah, whatever. I didn't come to D.C. to swap insults with Wasters. You want to flap gums, fine. But don't waste my time.
translation: 行了，随你的便。我可不是来特区找废土客对骂的。你想嚼舌头，没问题。但别浪费我的时间。

original: Now, you came about the broadcast. You want to hear what I have to say about The Pitt or not?
translation: 现在，你是为广播过来的。那你到底想不想听我说匹兹堡的事？

original: Here come more of them! Watch out!
translation: 他们来了不少人！当心！

original: Hey! There's someone in the pen! Get 'em!
translation: 嗨！有人在围栏里！抓住他们！

original: You can get to the power plant from a manhole down in the Steelyard. It's near the train tracks -- you can't miss it.
translation: 现在，你可以从钢院下方的检修孔到达发电站。就在火车道附近——你不会错过的。

original: Head down there and find the floodlight controls. Turn off Uptown's floodlights, and I'll meet you back in Downtown's Market Square.
translation: 去那里找到探照灯控制器，关掉上城区的探照灯。我们在下城区的集市广场碰头。

original: And here, take this - you'll want to stay hidden when those Trogs start swarming. Now get moving!
translation: 给，拿上这个——遇上兽化人的时候你要躲好。开始行动！

original: Sorry, doll, but I'll be busy setting everything up with the squirt, here. But for you, I guess I can spare a few supplies.
translation: 抱歉，姑娘，我要在这伺候小毛孩。不过我想我可以给你准备些点补给品。

original: You can get to the power plant from a manhole down in the Steelyard. Near the train tracks -- you can't miss it.
translation: 你可以从钢院下方的检修孔到达发电站。就在火车道附近——你不会错过的。

original: Head down there, find the floodlight controls, and turn off Uptown's floodlights. I'll meet you back Downtown.
translation: 去那里找到探照灯控制器，关掉上城区的探照灯。之后我会在下城区跟你碰头。

original: And here, take this - you'll want to stay hidden when the Trogs come. Now get moving!
translation: 给，拿上这个——遇上兽化人的时候你要躲好。开始行动！

original: My advice? Keep running until you're in Downtown, and don't look back!
translation: 我的忠告？一直跑，直到你进入了下城区，千万别回头！

original: Now, you can get to the power plant from a manhole down in the Steelyard. Near the train tracks -- you can't miss it.
translation: 现在，你可以从钢院下方的检修孔到达发电站。就在火车道附近——你不会错过的。

original: Head down there. find the floodlight controls, and turn off Uptown's floodlights. I'll meet you back Downtown.
translation: 去那里找到探照灯控制器，关掉上城区的探照灯。之后我会在下城区跟你碰头。

original: And here, take this - you'll want to stay hidden when the Trogs come. Now get moving!
translation: 给，拿上这个——遇上兽化人的时候你要躲好。开始行动！

original: Hey! Hands off the merchandise!
translation: 嗨！别碰那些货物！

original: Bill's a friend of mine, a very dear friend. We've worked the mill together for a long time.
translation: 比尔是我的朋友，非常要好的朋友。我们一起在轧钢厂工作了很长时间。

original: Last week we were forced to choose someone to gather ingots from the Steelyard. Bill volunteered.
translation: 上星期我们被迫挑选一个人去钢院收集钢锭。比尔自愿跟去。

original: He didn't want anyone to have to die out there. But... he's a survivor. He can't be dead.
translation: 他不想看到别人白白送命。不过……他是个幸运儿，他不会死的。

original: You look like you can handle yourself. Could you look for him and bring him back?
translation: 你看起来能保护好自己。你能找到他并带回来吗？

original: Sure thing, newbie.
translation: 当然，菜鸟。

original: Oh. Oh? A cure? That is very interesting. I'll be sure to note that.
translation: 哦。哦？解药？非常有趣。我肯定会注意到的。

original: Here's a little something that I found. Make good use of it.
translation: 给你一些我找到的东西，好好利用。

original: From outside The Pitt? That's new. I heard there might be someone from far away showing up.
translation: 从匹兹堡外边来的？那倒新鲜。我听说有个人是从遥远的地方来的。

original: Here's a little something that I found. Make good use of it.
translation: 给你一些我找到的东西，好好利用。

original: I guess that shouldn't surprise anyone. The bosses all thought they were up to something.
translation: 我想那不足为奇。老板们都认为他们在搞什么鬼。

original: Here's a couple of things for your trouble. They should help keep you alive out here.
translation: 给你几个救急物品，它们会让你活着回来。

original: That figures. Must be why the bosses hate him so much.
translation: 有道理。这肯定是老板们为什么这么恨他的原因。

original: Here are a couple things. Thanks for your help.
translation: 给你几个东西。谢谢你的帮忙。

original: I knew that bastard was up to something. Finally! After all he's done to me, I can get him!
translation: 我就知道那个杂种想要造反。终于露出马脚了！在他对我干了这一切之后，我可以抓他了！

original: Here's something for your trouble. I can't thank you enough for this one.
translation: 给你几个东西，即使那不足以表达我对你的谢意。

original: Bill's a friend of mine, a very dear friend. We've worked the mill together for a long time.
translation: 比尔是我的朋友，非常要好的朋友。我们一起在轧钢厂工作了很长时间。

original: Last week we were forced to choose someone to gather ingots from the Steelyard. Bill volunteered.
translation: 上星期我们被迫挑选一个人去钢院收集钢锭。比尔自愿跟去。

original: He didn't want anyone to have to die out there. But... he's a survivor. He can't be dead.
translation: 他不想看到别人白白送命。不过……他是个懂得保护自己的人，他不会死的。

original: Well, okay. I hope you'll change your mind.
translation: 那好吧。我希望你能改变主意。

original: No? Well, if you do see him, could you let me know?
translation: 没有吗？好吧，如果你见到他，能告诉我吗？

original: Ashur's new pet is looking for a beating!
translation: 阿舒尔的新宠物正在找打！

original: Oh, that's it! RIOT!
translation: 哦，就是这样！暴动！

original: As long as I know he's okay, then that's all that matters. Thank you for your help. I'll tell the others that Bill is alright.
translation: 只要我知道他没事，这就足够了。谢谢你的帮助 我会告诉其他人比尔没事的。

original: Here, take these stimpaks. They're all I have. Goodbye.
translation: 给，拿着这些治疗针。我只有这些了。再见。

original: He's dead? But he promised us he would come back... I... I have to let the others know.
translation: 他死了？但他向我们保证他会回来的……我……我要去告诉其他人。

original: Thank you for your help. Here, take these stimpaks. They're all I have.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助。给，拿着这些治疗针。我只有这些了。

original: Oh! That's wonderful! Where is he now? Did he come back with you?
translation: 噢！太棒了！他在哪？他跟你一起回来了吗？

original: He's dead? But he promised us he would come back... I... I have to let the others know. Thank you for your help.
translation: 他死了？但他向我们保证他会回来的……我……我要去告诉其他人。谢谢你的帮助。

original: Here, take these stimpaks. They're all I have. Goodbye.
translation: 给，拿着这些治疗针。我只有这些了。再见。

original: I don't feel... I'm going to...
translation: 我不觉得……我要……

original: Please, please stop. I can't hear anymore of it. I don't feel so well.
translation: 求你了，别说了。我听不下去了。我感觉不太好。

original: Hey, that's my stuff. Get your fuckin' hands off of it.
translation: 嗨，那是我的东西，拿开你他妈的臭手。

original: Relax. It's not about you. It's about your... robot
translation: 轻松点，我不是说你，我是说你的……机器人。

original: We won't be able to maintain him on the road.
translation: 这一路上我们照顾不了他。

original: Besides, we don't need some bucket of bolts tagging along. He'll only get in the way.
translation: 还有，我们不需要老爷车跟着，他只会碍手碍脚。

original: No, he expects you to accept his courteous invitation. Or at least to guess what would happen if you keep him waiting.
translation: 不，他希望你接受他客气的邀请。你要是让他久等，你可以猜一猜会发生什么。

original: You'll find him in Haven, his tower in Uptown. Take the northeast exit from here and look for the tallest building in town.
translation: 你可以在避风港找到他，他的塔楼位于上城区。从这里的东北出口出去，寻找镇上最高的建筑。

original: Oh, Ashur also said that he has a few gifts for you. You'll find them in the container behind me.
translation: 噢，阿舒尔也说，他有一些礼物给你。你可以在我身后的柜子中找到。

original: Enjoy. And don't keep the man waiting.
translation: 好好享受。别让他久等。

original: He watches over the city from Haven, his tower in Uptown. Take the northeast exit from here and look for the tallest building in town.
translation: 他在上城区的避风港塔上监视着这座城市。从这走到东北边的出口，找到镇上最高的建筑。

original: Oh, Ashur also said that he has a few gifts for you. You'll find them in the container behind me.
translation: 噢，阿舒尔也说，他有一些礼物给你。你可以在我身后的柜子中找到。

original: Enjoy. And don't keep the man waiting.
translation: 好好享受。别让他久等。

original: HAHA! I love it. Another slave wandered back here, huh? You couldn't even get over the bridge, could you? You're lucky I don't fuckin' paste you.
translation: 哈哈！我爱这样。又一个奴隶溜回来了，嗯？你连桥都过不去，对吧？算你走运，我他妈的没狠狠揍你一顿。

original: And look at all this! Where'd you get all this shit anyway? Whatever. Mine now. I hit the fuckin' jackpot today!
translation: 看看这些东西！不管咋说，你从哪搞到的这些破烂？无所谓了，都是我的了。我今天中头奖了！

original: Now get back in there and get to work, or next time I'll just stake you out there for the Trogs.
translation: 现在滚回去干活，要不然下次我会把你绑去喂兽化人。

original: Looks good.
translation: 看起来不错。

original: I'll just take those.
translation: 我收下了。

original: Nothing like some heavy labor, huh?
translation: 不是什么重体力活，对吧？

original: More metal for the Mill.
translation: 给轧钢厂收集更多的金属。

original: Okay, got it. Let's go!
translation: 好了，拿了。我们走！

original: Okay. Here you go. Don't take it out until you get past the gate. You clear on what you need to do?
translation: 很好，给你。没过那道门之前，别把它拿出来现。清楚你要做什么了吗？

original: Okay. Here you go. Don't take it out until you get past the gate. You clear on what you need to do?
translation: 好吧。去吧。没过那道门之前，别把它拿出来现。清楚你要做什么了吗？

original: You head down to the hole. Talk to Faydra. She sets up the fights.
translation: 你下到洞里。跟费德拉交谈，她安排战斗事宜。

original: If you need a weapon, check with Marco in the Mill. He's been making some of our tools into weapons.
translation: 你要是需要武器，跟轧钢厂的马可商量商量。他正在把我们的一些工具做成武器。

original: You might even be able to find a gun on one of the dead bosses out in the Steelyard. They- what was that?
translation: 你甚至可以在钢院的老板们的尸体上找到枪。他们——那是什么？

original: Well, if you mess it up and get killed, you won't get any reward, now will you?
translation: 那么，你要是搞砸了，被杀了，你的报酬也就没了，你愿意吗？

original: Now, outside of the mill, there are a bunch of old steel ingots just lying around. Every so often, the Foreman puts out a work order to collect them.
translation: 现在，在轧钢厂外边，闲放着不少钢锭。有时候，工头会贴出工作告示找人去收集这些钢锭。

original: It's practically a death sentence and they never assign it to anyone. They make us pick who's going to do it. Bastards.
translation: 谁要是接这份工，几乎等于就判了死刑。他们从没把这份工作指派给任何人，他们让我们自己挑人。那些杂种。

original: Outside of the mill, there are a bunch of old steel ingots just lying around. Every so often, the Foreman puts out a work order to collect them.
translation: 在轧钢厂外边，闲放着不少钢锭。有时候，工头会贴出工作告示找人去收集这些钢锭。

original: It's practically a death sentence and they never assign it to anyone. They make us pick who's going to do it. Bastards.
translation: 谁要是接这份工，几乎等于就判了死刑。他们从没把这份工作指派给任何人，他们让我们自己挑人。那些杂种。

original: Hey, that's Ashur's kid! Sound the alarm!
translation: 嗨，那是阿舒尔的跟班！拉警报！

original: Now that Marie's back, we have a chance at curing the disease that's been ravaging The Pitt since the bombs.
translation: 现在玛丽回来了，我们就有机会治愈自核弹袭击以来，一直肆虐匹兹堡的疾病了。

original: Without it killing our kids, we can grow like a real city. No more bringing in slaves. No more forced labor. Things can get better.
translation: 没疾病杀死我们的孩子，我们就能像真正的城市一样发展。不再需要奴隶。不再强迫劳动。一切都会好起来。

original: It's taken me a lot of work to rebuild this city. With your help, it's finally going to have a chance.
translation: 我们花了大量的工夫重建这座城市。有了你的帮助，城市终于有机会了。

original: We have a chance at curing the disease that's been ravaging The Pitt since the bombs.
translation: 我们就有机会治愈自核弹袭击以来，一直肆虐匹兹堡的疾病了。

original: Without it killing our kids, we can grow like a real city. No more bringing in slaves. No more forced labor. Things can get better.
translation: 没疾病杀死我们的孩子，我们就能像真正的城市一样发展。不再需要奴隶。不再强迫劳动。一切都会好起来。

original: It's taken me a lot of work to rebuild this city. With your help, it's finally going to have a chance.
translation: 我们花了大量的工夫重建这座城市。有了你的帮助，城市终于有机会了。

original: Oooh!
translation: 嚯！

original: That's it! This is between me and the little shit! Nobody else!
translation: 够了！这是我和这坨屎之间的事！其他人别管。

original: I was the first thing you saw in this city, and damn if I ain't gonna be the last, too.
translation: 我是你在这座城市看到的第一个人，我也会是最后一个，见鬼去吧。

original: Then here... Delicious food for you! Eat, and be good.
translation: 这是……给你的美味！吃吧，乖。

original: Then say no more, friend. Can't share much, but this should do the trick. Use it in good health!
translation: 不用再说了，朋友。没有太多的东西可分享，不过这应该够了。用它来保持身体健康！

original: Help me!
translation: 救救我！

original: Guess I couldn't stop you, but then you'd never find all the little bonuses I got stashed over the years.
translation: 我想我阻止不了你，但你也永远找不到我这些年珍藏起来的小奖励了。

original: How about this: you bring me ingots, like you used to, and I'll make sure you get compensated when you do. Can't be more fair than that.
translation: 这样吧，跟过去一样，你帮我找钢锭，我保证付你报酬。再公平不过了。

original: Understood, champ! But if you want to keep collecting ingots, I still got plenty of gear stashed away.
translation: 明白，冠军！不过你想继续收集钢锭的话，我还有很多装备藏着呢。

original: You bring me ingots, I'll make sure you get rewarded. Can't be more fair than that.
translation: 你帮我找钢锭，我保证付你报酬。再公平不过了。

original: Like it or not, this is what you're getting.
translation: 不管你喜不喜欢，这是你的所得。

original: See for yourself. If you're heading back out there, these oughta help with the Trogs.
translation: 你亲自去看吧。你要是再回到那边，这些应该可以帮你对付兽化人。

original: Well, how about metal for metal? That's gotta be a fair trade.
translation: 金属换金属怎么样？再公平不过了。

original: Here. This armor was a special order for one of the Hole fighters. Great against bullets, but didn't help him when he got pushed off the bridge.
translation: 给。这件装甲是为角斗坑的一位战士特别定做的。挡子弹很棒，不过他被推下桥时，就没能帮得了他。

original: How about something one-of-a-kind? Bit of a weird one, here - found it from some sucker out of town.
translation: 来点独一无二的怎样？给，这个有点古怪——从镇外边某个笨蛋那里搞来的。

original: Some genius got to tinkering with his laser. Polished metal barrel, a few prisms in there, and he got this lethal light show.
translation: 某个天才捣鼓了他的激光器。抛过光的金属枪管，配上几个棱镜，就有了这致命的灯光秀。

original: Is it ever! Check out this cutting edge of fashion, huh? Wear this armor, and everyone's going to want to get close to you.
translation: 当然值得！试试这最前沿的时尚，哈？穿上这身装甲，所有人都会想亲近你。

original: Which just means they'll be inside your blast radius!
translation: 也就是说他们会在你的爆炸半径内！

original: Sure is. This armor used to belong to one of those desert-crazy priests. Said wearing it made him bulletproof.
translation: 肯定值。这套护甲曾属于一位沙漠疯子祭司，说是穿上这个能让他刀枪不入。

original: Course, that didn't stand up to a little testing. But damn if it wasn't a gloriously fun time.
translation: 当然，这经不起一点考验。但该死的，那段时间真是爽极了。

original: All the metal you're bringing in, I suppose it's worth giving you something to really help with those Trogs.
translation: 我想就你带过来的那些金属，值得我给你点东西，能真正帮你对付那些兽化人。

original: Here, this thing's mauled Trogs and Ghouls from here to Monroeville. Give it a whirl.
translation: 给，这个东西曾把兽化人和尸鬼从这儿打到门罗维尔。试试看吧。

original: Kid, this is worth more than you know. But damn if you ain't earned it.
translation: 孩子，这比你想的更值得。但如果这不是你应得的，那就见鬼了。

original: Here. This is the best gun I ever had. A little slower on the trigger, but she makes up for it in power and accuracy. Use her in good health.
translation: 给。这是我用过的最好的枪。扳机稍微慢了一点，但她在威力和精确度上弥补了这一点。好好利用她。

original: Well, I'll be damned. That makes 100 ingots you found. And here I remember thinking you'd be lucky to bring back any at all.
translation: 这也太离谱了。你找到了100锭。我还记得我当时觉得你能带回来就算走运了。

original: Ain't no question, you earned the treasure of my collection. This armor goes all the way back to when the Brotherhood tried to wipe out The Pitt.
translation: 毫无疑问，你赢得了我收藏的宝藏。这套装甲可以追溯到兄弟会试图抹除匹兹堡的时候。

original: Some of the tribals who worshipped Ashur made it to look like their god. Try it on, and you'll feel a little like a god, yourself!
translation: 一些崇拜阿舒尔的部落，把它制成看起来像他们的神。你穿上试试，你也会觉得自己像个神！

original: Guess I could spare this.
translation: 我想可以匀这个给你。

original: Yeah, looks like you've earned it. If you're heading back out there, these oughta help with the Trogs.
translation: 是啊，看来是你应得的。你要是回到那边，这些东西可以帮你对付那些兽化人。

original: How about I give you some metal this time?
translation: 这次我给你些金属做的怎么样？

original: Here. This armor was a special order for one of the Hole fighters. Great against bullets, but didn't help him when he got pushed off the bridge.
translation: 给。这件装甲是为角斗坑的一位战士特别定做的。挡子弹很棒，不过他被推下桥时，就没能帮得了他。

original: Sure thing. Bit of a weird one, here - found it from some sucker out of town.
translation: 当然。给，这个有点古怪——从镇外边某个笨蛋那里搞来的。

original: Some genius got to tinkering with his laser. Polished metal barrel, a few prisms in there, and he got this lethal light show.
translation: 某个天才捣鼓了他的激光器。抛过光的金属枪管，配上几个棱镜，就有了这致命的灯光秀。

original: You bet I do! Check out this cutting edge of fashion! Wear this armor, and everyone's going to want to get close to you.
translation: 当然有了！试试这最前沿的时尚！穿上这身装甲，所有人都会想亲近你。

original: Which just means they'll be inside your blast radius, huh?
translation: 也就是说他们会在你的爆炸半径内，对吧？

original: Guess you earned this. Used to belong to a desert priest. Said wearing it made him bulletproof.
translation: 我想这是你应得的。它曾属于一个沙漠祭司，说是穿上这个能让他刀枪不入。

original: Course, that didn't stand up to a little testing. But damn if it wasn't a gloriously fun time.
translation: 当然，这经不起一点考验。但该死的，那段时间真是爽极了。

original: All the metal you're bringing in, I suppose it's worth giving you something to really help with those Trogs.
translation: 我想就你带过来的那些金属，值得我给你点东西，能真正帮你对付那些兽化人。

original: Here, this thing's mauled Trogs and Ghouls from here to Monroeville. Give it a whirl.
translation: 给，这个东西曾把兽化人和尸鬼从这儿打到门罗维尔。试试看吧。

original: I probably shouldn't, but damn if you ain't earned it.
translation: 也许我不该这么做，但如果这不是你应得的，那就见鬼了。

original: Here. This is the best gun I ever had. A little slower on the trigger, but she makes up for it in power and accuracy. Use her in good health.
translation: 给。这是我用过的最好的枪。扳机稍微慢了一点，但她在威力和精确度上弥补了这一点。好好利用她。

original: Well, I'll be damned. That makes 100 ingots you found. And here I remember thinking you'd be lucky to bring back any at all.
translation: 这也太离谱了。你找到了100锭。我还记得我当时觉得你能带回来就算走运了。

original: Ain't no question, you earned the treasure of my collection. This armor goes all the way back to when the Brotherhood tried to wipe out The Pitt.
translation: 毫无疑问，你赢得了我收藏的宝藏。这套装甲可以追溯到兄弟会试图抹除匹兹堡的时候。

original: Some of the tribals who worshipped Ashur made it to look like their god. Try it on, and you'll feel a little like a god, yourself!
translation: 一些崇拜阿舒尔的部落，把它制成看起来像他们的神。你穿上试试，你也会觉得自己像个神！

original: Dammit! Dammit, you monster! Wernher's in the steelyard!
translation: 该死！该死，你这个怪物！沃纳在钢院！

original: Here, take his damn message, hunt him down, whatever. Just leave my people alone, you bastard!
translation: 给，带上他该死的便条，不管采用什么法子逮到他。离我的人远点，你个狗日的！

original: I know. We run out in two days and then it's back to the radiated shit.
translation: 我知道，我们呆了两天，这些玩意就都化成辐射屎了。

original: I am currently functioning at 78 percent capacity which is well within acceptable operating parameters.
translation: 我目前以78%的负荷运行，完全在可接受的工作参数范围内。

original: The following systems are non-operative or damaged: surface visual systems and communications uplink to White House and Police Department.
translation: 以下系统无法运行或已损坏：地表影像系统、白宫与警察局之间的通讯上行线路。

original: There is additional partial damage to my internal sensing devices and numerous severed data lines.
translation: 我的内部传感设备也有额外的部分损坏，并且许多数据线路被切断。

original: We do what we can. Take, for example, this Ghoul Griffon. He wanted to PURCHASE a bunch of water.
translation: 我们尽力而为，比如这位尸鬼格里芬，他想买一大堆水。

original: What the hell does that droopy irradiated fool need with pure water? Thinks he can sell it in Underworld. Moron.
translation: 那个快腐烂的傻瓜要这么多净水干嘛？他以为他能在冥界卖掉这些水。蠢货。

original: But, he's the only one who's offered to PAY for water, in caps AND technology.
translation: 不过，只有他愿意用瓶盖和科技来换水。

original: And what Lyons doesn't know won't hurt him. There's plenty of water to go around.
translation: 里昂斯虽然不知道，但这对他没什么危害。这儿还有好多水。

original: And I can use it to pay Rivet City to provide security for all the caravans we can't escort ourselves. I'm lucky he came along.
translation: 我们还能用他给的钱让铆钉城的警力保护我们的旅队。他来找我可是我的运气。

original: I don't know WHAT to think. I got Lyons breathing down my neck about it though.
translation: 我都不知道该怎么办了。里昂斯在这件事上对我逼得太紧了。

original: Apparently Megaton's sending him nasty letters demanding a shipment. I JUST sent them a week's supply! A month's, if they ration.
translation: 很明显兆吨镇给他寄了封卑鄙的信朝他讨水。可我刚给他们送了一个星期的量！如果他们实行配给的话那些水够用一个月。

original: Look, if you can straighten out Megaton so I get Lyons off my back, I'll make it worth your while.
translation: 听着，如果你能摆平兆吨镇的问题好让我给里昂斯一个交代，我会给你可观的报酬的。

original: Everyone was so excited about that Purifier: "Project Purity this," and "Project Purity that."
translation: 每个人都对净化器兴奋异常: 整天“净水工程这”，“净水工程那”。

original: But did anyone stop to ask, "Hey, what are we going to DO with all that clean water?" Well, guess who gets to fill in that tiny detail.
translation: 但有没有人停下来问：“嘿，我们要怎么处理这些干净的水？”好吧，猜猜是谁来填补这个微小的细节。

original: It'd be one thing if I had support, but that little war with the Enclave has depleted much of the Brotherhood's resources.
translation: 如果我得到足够的支援的话事情还有得办，但是和英克雷的那场仗耗费了兄弟会太多的资源。

original: And to top it off, I have to be mommy to a bunch of lab coats.
translation: 而更糟糕的是，我还得给一群实验室的白大褂当爹当妈。

original: What is it now?!
translation: 现在如何？！

original: Oh-Kay... I'll swing by another time.
translation: 好-的……我一会儿再回来吧。

original: <Clears throat> Have you ever seen a map? North... points... UP!
translation: <清了清嗓子> 你之前看过地图么？北……是……朝上的！

original: I wish. But no, I need them. They're some of the few that bothered to come back at all - a hardy bunch, this group. Almost as good as our own men.
translation: 我倒是想。但不要，我需要他们。他们是为数不多敢回来的人 - 这群人，算得上硬汉。和我的人有的一拼。

original: Oh, he did? I was beginning to think he forgot about us.
translation: 噢，他派你来的？我还以为他把我们给忘了呢。

original: Not sure how much you know: There's been an increase in attacks on the caravans. Seems organized and not just the random Raider or Mutant encounter.
translation: 不确定你知道多少：袭击旅队的事件越来越多。似乎是有组织的，而不只是偶然遇到的掠夺者或变种人。

original: I'm running out of resources and I'm down to my greenest men. I want to get to the bottom of these coordinated attacks. The sooner the better.
translation: 我的资源快用完了，而且我只剩下几个菜鸟手下了。我想尽快查明这些有组织的袭击的真相。越快越好。

original: I suppose I don't really need it pushing papers around here, do I?
translation: 我猜我其实不需要用这写来文件，不是吗？

original: Alright. Consider it an advance on your payment. You better not disappoint.
translation: 好吧。把这个当作订金吧。别跟我抱怨。

original: That so? You're one of the newbies? You best know the pass phrase asshole. Or you're dead.
translation: 是吗？你也是新来的？你最好知道口令你这混蛋。否则你死定了。

original: Okay. You're lucky you knew that. Don't know who let you in, don't really care.
translation: 好的。能知道这些你可真走运。不知道是谁让你来的，我也不关心这个。

original: This is a real simple gang. Whoever's the toughest sets the rules, and that's ME. And I got just one rule: Do what the hell I say, when I say it.
translation: 我们是一个很简单的帮派。谁最厉害谁就制定规则，而那个人就是我。我只有一条规矩：我说什么就做什么。

original: Now, find a seat. We're waiting for some of the boys to get back.
translation: 现在，找个位子坐下。我们在等人回来。

original: Okay. You're lucky you knew that. Don't know who let you in, don't really care.
translation: 好的。能知道这些你可真走运。不知道是谁让你来的，我也不关心这个。

original: This is a real simple gang. Whoever's the toughest sets the rules, and that's ME. And I got just one rule: Do what the hell I say, when I say it.
translation: 我们是一个很简单的帮派。谁最厉害谁就制定规则，而那个人就是我。我只有一条规矩：我说什么就做什么。

original: Now, find a seat. We're waiting for some of the boys to get back.
translation: 现在，找个位子坐下。我们在等人回来。

original: Oh, and put this on. We're a gang. We all wear the same uniform.
translation: 哦，穿上这个。我们是个帮会。我们都穿统一的制服。

original: Here you go. Run along now.
translation: 给你。走吧。

original: And remember: All sales are final. No refunds.
translation: 还有别忘了: 一旦售出，概不退换。

original: Right you are! Here's the bottle, and I'll take those caps. Pleasure doing business with you, sir. Come again!
translation: 好的！拿好这瓶，瓶盖我收下了。非常高兴和您做买卖，先生，欢迎再来！

original: And remember: All sales are final. No refunds or exchanges.
translation: 还有，别忘了: 一旦售出，概不退换。不退款，不换货。

original: Right you are! Here's the bottle, and I'll take those caps. Pleasure doing business with you, ma'am. Come again!
translation: 好的！拿好这瓶，瓶盖我收下。非常高兴和您做买卖，女士，欢迎再来！

original: And remember: All sales are final. No refunds or exchanges.
translation: 还有，别忘了: 一旦售出，概不退换。不退款，不换货。

original: A FREE sample you say? Hmm... Well... I normally don't do this... but, for YOU, for this ONE TIME ONLY, a VERY special VIP promotional offer...
translation: 你说免费样品？嗯……好吧……我一般是不会这么做的……但是，为了你，仅此一次，给你一次VIP的待遇吧……

original: Ladies and gentlemen, DING-DING-DING! We have a new winner in our daily Aqua Cura Sweepstakes!
translation: 女士们先生们，叮-叮-叮！一位每日沌净水抽奖的幸运儿诞生了！给你，女士。免费试饮！

original: Here you go, sir. Your FREE bottle! Step right up in the next 5 minutes, and get your VERY OWN bottle of the Amazing Aqua Cura at HALF price! Ladies and gentlemen. Half price!
translation: 给你，先生。您的免费赠品！五分钟内行动起来的话，你就能以半价得到一瓶属于自己的神奇的沌净水！女士们先生们。半价！

original: A FREE sample you say? Hmm... Well... I normally don't do this... but, for YOU, for this ONE TIME ONLY, a VERY special VIP promotional offer...
translation: 你说免费样品？嗯……好吧……我一般是不会这么做的……但是，为了你，仅此一次，给你一次VIP的待遇吧……

original: Ladies and gentlemen, DING-DING-DING! We have a new winner in our daily Aqua Cura Sweepstakes!
translation: 女士们先生们，叮-叮-叮！一位每日沌净水抽奖的幸运儿诞生了！给你，女士。免费试饮！

original: Here you go, ma'am. Your FREE bottle! Step right up in the next 5 minutes, and get your VERY OWN bottle of the Amazing Aqua Cura at HALF price! Ladies and gentlemen. Half price!
translation: 给你，女士。您的免费赠品！五分钟内行动起来的话，你就能以半价得到一瓶属于自己的神奇的沌净水！女士们先生们。半价！

original: Based on the data you brought us from the relay station, we've identified where the Enclave is basing their operation.
translation: 根据你从中继站带给我们的数据，我们找出了英克雷部队的基地位置。

original: It seems they have a second base of operations at Adams Air Force Base, outside of D.C.
translation: 看来他们还有第二个行动基地，位于特区外的亚当空军基地。

original: The only safe way to get there is through the Presidential Metro used by the government before the war.
translation: 去那里唯一安全的方法，就是通过战前政府使用的总统地铁。

original: You're going to be on your own again for now; the rest of the Brotherhood will be providing a distraction so you can slip in undetected.
translation: 你现在又得靠自己了； 兄弟会的其他人会引开对方的注意，让你潜入。

original: Once you breach the Presidential Metro and get to Adams Air Force Base, look for the Resupply Crate.
translation: 一旦你通过总统地铁到达亚当空军基地，寻找补给板条箱。

original: Inside, you'll find your new orders and hopefully we can put a working Tesla Cannon into your hands.
translation: 里面会有你的新命令，希望我们能把能用的特斯拉加农炮交到你手里。

original: Here you go! Another satisfied customer, I'm sure!
translation: 好极了！毫无疑问，又有一个顾客心满意足了！

original: Right you are! Pleasure doing business with you, sir. Come again!
translation: 好的！非常高兴和您做生意，先生。欢迎再来！

original: Right you are! Pleasure doing business with you, ma'am. Come again!
translation: 好的！非常高兴和您做生意，女士。欢迎再来！

original: It's true, I got a thing going.
translation: 没错，我正在干一番大事业。

original: I take the Aqua Pura, store it to sell to humans later, then I put the regular irradiated crap in the bottles and sell it to these fools.
translation: 我买来纯净水，储藏起来过一阵子再卖回给人类，之后再往剩下的空瓶子里灌满普通的受过辐射的脏水卖给那些傻瓜。

original: No one's getting hurt. In fact, the Brotherhood actually needs the caps and technology I give them to fund their "free" water caravans.
translation: 没有人会因此受到什么伤害。实际上，兄弟会需要我的瓶盖和技术来资助"免费的"贩水商队。

original: Just ask Bigsley at Project Purity, he'll tell you how grateful he is I'm helping them out like this.
translation: 不信你去问问净水工程的比格斯利，他会告诉你我这样帮助他们让他们有多高兴。

original: But watch yourself. Get in my way, and... let's just say, I'm good at removing problems.
translation: 但是小心一点。你要是敢捣乱，那么……这么跟你说吧，我可是很擅长摆平麻烦的。

original: Heheh. You're not fooling anyone. Everyone knows you're one of the good guys.
translation: 呵呵呵。别跟我装了。谁都知道你是那种老实人。

original: But seriously kid. I'm not up to anything. Just ask any of these fools - ahem - I mean, LOYAL customers.
translation: 但是说真的小子。我可没打算要怎么样。你去问下那些傻瓜- 哦不 - 我是说忠实的顾客。

original: They already see the many benefits of the Amazing Aqua Cura!
translation: 他们已经看到我神奇的沌净水的功效了！

original: Oh alright, alright. But if you start blabbing, I've got some buddies with itching trigger fingers...
translation: 哦，好吧，好吧。但你要是多嘴泄密，我这儿的几个弟兄可是要扣扳机了……

original: So I've got this little operation taking Aqua Pura and replacing it with regular crap. It's not like it'll hurt us Ghouls.
translation: 于是我动了点小手脚，买来纯净水，用一些个次货换掉它们。但这又不会对我们尸鬼们产生伤害。

original: The Aqua Pura I'm storing to sell back to humans later. You know, raiders, Outcasts, etc. The guys the Brotherhood doesn't share with.
translation: 那些纯净水我都留着卖给人类呢。你知道的，那些个掠夺者，放逐者，诸如此类。兄弟会不会分水给他们的。

original: I'm not a bad guy. I'm just trying to help. The Brotherhood needs me. My caps mean water for the Wasteland. Just ask Bigsley at Project Purity.
translation: 我可不是坏人。我只是想帮忙。兄弟会需要我。我的瓶盖就好比废土大地上的清水。不信你可以去问问净水工程的比格斯利。

original: Wow!
translation: 哇哦！

original: The Amazing Aqua Cura cures all the common Ghoul ailments! Guaranteed!
translation: “神奇的沌净水”能够治疗尸鬼的各种常见病！包你满意！

original: Hellacious halitosis. It's a common condition of the Ghoul state. But it's not permanent. Not with Amazing Aqua Cura that is!
translation: 难闻的口臭。这对尸鬼来说是常见毛病。但绝不是永久的。只要你用了“神奇的沌净水”它就不是！

original: Friends, have you stopped combing your hair? Afraid of pulling out the few remaining plugs?
translation: 朋友们，你是否已经不再梳理你的头发？害怕把脑袋上仅剩的几根毛发拽下来？

original: Hmm. That's pretty steep...
translation: 嗯。听上去太多了……

original: What the hell. It's just this once, and then we're through.
translation: 真他妈的。只此一次，从此我们就两清了。

original: Fine. Here's your 300 caps. There. I just bought your silence. So keep your mouth shut.
translation: 好吧。这是你的300个瓶盖。这样的话，我已经给了你封口费，所以管好你的嘴。

original: I can't believe it... I have a good thing going here... Why mess that up for me? What have I done to you?
translation: 我真不敢相信……我正在这忙我的好事呢……你干嘛来捣乱？我惹你了吗？

original: I'm not hurting anyone. I mean, really? Reverse the Ghoul condition? With a bottle of water? I wasn't fooling anybody; they were fooling themselves.
translation: 我没有伤害任何人。我是说，真的吗？逆转尸鬼的状态？用一瓶水？我没有欺骗任何人，他们只是在欺骗自己。

original: Fine. I've made enough money here, anyway. Well, um... It's probably best if I tell them. I think I know what to say.
translation: 好吧。反正我也赚够了。那么，呃……还是我来告诉他们好些。我知道该说些什么。

original: Wish me luck.
translation: 祝我好运吧。

original: Please, water. I'm so thirsty.
translation: 求你了，水。我好渴。

original: Oh, poor dear. Here, I've got some water I can spare.
translation: 噢，可怜的。拿着，我这有点水可以分给你。

original: For... for me? Crystal clear water? Oh, bless you! Bless you!
translation: 给……给我？水晶般清澈的水？噢，上帝保佑你！保佑你！

original: No, bless you. I'm glad to help.
translation: 不，保佑你，我很高兴能帮助你。

original: No, it's not okay! Not for him! It was supposed to be holy water. The man at the monastery in Springvale said it was blessed!
translation: 不，不可以！他不能喝！这应该是圣水。春之谷修道院里的人说它是被祝福过的！

original: He gave me this pamphlet along with the water. Called himself Brother Gerard. You can find him on the road through Springvale.
translation: 他还把这个宣传册随水赠给了我。他自称杰勒德修士。你可以在春之谷的路上看到他。

original: I don't know if it'll help, but I don't know what else I can do.
translation: 我不知道这是否有用，但我不知道我还能做什么。

original: I thought it would help him. It was supposed to be holy water. The man at the monastery in Springvale said it was blessed!
translation: 我以为这能帮到他。那应该是圣水。春之谷修道院的人说这是经过祝福的！

original: He gave me this pamphlet along with the water. Called himself Brother Gerard. You can find him on the road through Springvale.
translation: 他还把这个宣传册随水赠给了我。他自称杰勒德修士。你可以在春之谷的路上看到他。

original: They said they had lots of this holy water. Please, do something to stop them!
translation: 他们还说有好多这样的圣水。拜托，请阻止他们！

original: No, I promise, I thought it would help! It was supposed to be holy water. The man at the monastery in Springvale said it was blessed!
translation: 不，我保证，我以为能帮上忙的！那应该是圣水！春之谷修道院的人说这是被祝福过的！

original: Here, he gave me this pamphlet with the water. Called himself Brother Gerard. You can find him on the road through Springvale! He's responsible!
translation: 看这个，他还把这个宣传册随水赠给了我。他自称杰勒德修士。你可以在春之谷的路上看到他。他要负责！

original: I was just trying to help. It's not my fault! Please!
translation: 我只是想来帮忙的。这不是我的错！真的！

original: Why, to offer Enlightenment to all those who suffer, of course. No more, no less.
translation: 为什么，当然是为了给所有受苦受难的人带来启迪。不多，也不少。

original: Atom came to me with a vision: the starving, the ill, the weak, all being made whole and well by receiving the sacrament of Atom's Glow.
translation: 原子带给我这样一个愿景：饥饿，疾病，虚弱，一切生命在接受了原子的荣光的圣礼后都重新复苏了。

original: And so, with our holy water, we can make this vision a reality. When exposed to Atom's supreme Glow, the ill are reborn in his glowing visage.
translation: 因此，有了我们的圣水，我们可以让这一愿景变为现实。当笼罩在原子至高无上的光辉时，苦难中的人们将恢复生气而获得新生。

original: Those reborn never hunger, never suffer, and never age. All our Enlightened brethren need to know is Atom's Glow, and they are happy.
translation: 重生的人将不再饥饿，不再受苦，不再衰老。我们所有启发过的同胞只须谨记原子的荣光，便可仙福永享。

original: It's been confirmed. The Purifier has been activated. We've been ordered to fortify our current position and wait for orders.
translation: 已经确认。净化器已经启动。我们奉命原地坚守，并等待指示。

original: With a lull in the fighting, we set up and fortified our position outside the Capitol Building, near Seward Square.
translation: 战斗间歇，我们在国会大厦的外围，靠近苏华德广场的地方建立了防御工事。

original: Things have been relatively quiet around here lately. That'll all change when word spreads of the purifier.
translation: 前段日子这里相当平静。但当净化器的消息传开后，一切都会变的。

original: Anyone and everyone will do whatever they can to get there hands on some of that water. For life or profit, it makes no difference.
translation: 任何人都想会尽一切可能弄到水。为生存或利益，这没什么区别。

original: Same old killing, just a different ingredient.
translation: 一如既往的杀戮，只是为了不同的理由。

original: We've been in position for a couple of days now. No sign of the caravans. This is bullshit! I want some god damn water.
translation: 我们已经在目标地点等了好几天了。没有商队的消息。真他妈的！我要那该死的水。

original: I'm gonna kill Jed for putting us girls through this shit. Why get close to the caravan when we could just blow 'em away from a distance?
translation: 我打算为了姑娘们把杰德干掉。如果可以从远距离赶走商队我们为什么还要靠近他们呢？

original: He says we need the ammunition and can't afford to lose anybody. "Just use your good looks or something", he says. What an ass.
translation: 他说我们需要弹药，并且没法承受失去任何人了。他说，“只要使用你的美貌或别的什么”。多么愚蠢。

original: Hahaha!
translation: 哈哈哈！

original: What?!
translation: 什么？！

original: Damn it. I just don't have that kind of money at my disposal...
translation: 该死。我手头可没那么多钱……

original: Here's the deal. I'll give you 500 caps, from my own personal savings, mind you, and you call off the attacks. But that's it. That's all I have.
translation: 这样吧。我给你500个瓶盖，记住，这是从我自己的积蓄里出的，然后你取消袭击。但就这么多，我只有这么多。

original: Fine. Here's an extra 50 caps. Now get out of here until next week.
translation: 好吧。这里还有50个瓶盖。现在离开这儿下个礼拜前别回来。

original: Damnit man, why you got to be like that?
translation: 真该死，哥们，你什么时候开始变得这么贪？

original: Here. Take half my caps. Then get the hell out of here until next week.
translation: 拿着。我的钱分你一半。现在滚吧下周之前别回来。

original: Just don't hurt me, alright? Here's all my caps.
translation: 别伤害我好吗？我的瓶盖全在这里。

original: I don't got shit for you to take. Honest man. My pockets are empty.
translation: 我身上没东西值得拿的。说真的伙计。我的口袋空空如也。

original: Ha. I might of believed you were capable of that. But everyone knows you're a softy.
translation: 哈。我真该相信你能做的出来那种事。但每个人都知道你是个软蛋。

original: Yeah. I guess you're right. Here's a bigger share of the take. We'll see you next week.
translation: 是的。我猜你是对的。我再多分你点儿钱吧。我们下周见。

original: No! That's not supposed to happen! No, get up! Get up! You can't pass out, you're supposed to get better! I gave you holy water, and everything!
translation: 不！这不该发生的！不，起来！起来！你不能就这样过去了，你该好起来的！我给了你圣水，还有一切！

original: That water... you... damn you!
translation: 这水……你……该死！

original: I haven't tasted water this pure since... urk... Oh. Oh god, what's wrong? Water...
translation: 我好久都没喝过这么纯的……呃……噢。天啊，怎么了？这水……

original: The security breach inside the Presidential Metro System has been cleared. All sections, stand down from alert status.
translation: 总统地铁系统内的安全漏洞已被排除。所有区域解除紧急状态。

original: Due to the security breach, access to the southern and eastern metro lines is currently prohibited.
translation: 由于安全漏洞，地铁南线和东线目前禁止通行。

original: The Metro Transit Authority would like to extend its very best to our soldiers fighting abroad and wishes them a safe and speedy return.
translation: 地铁运输局向在海外作战的士兵致以最诚挚的问候，并祝愿他们早日平安归来。

original: The robot is our best weapon. If we can keep it running, we have a chance. If not, we have to find another way to counter their Vertibirds.
translation: 机器人是我们最好的武器，如果我们能保持它的运转，我们就有取胜的机会，如果不能，那必须找到其他办法来对付他们的飞鸟。

original: Don't forget they apparently have missiles they can launch at us from... hell, I don't know. Space? Kind of hard to fight back against that.
translation: 别忘了他们还有导弹，他们可以从…操，我也不知道从哪里打击我们。也许是太空？见鬼，那样的话，怎么还手啊。

original: It's a necessary move, but yeah. If the attack fails, they're going to come at us hard.
translation: 这是必要的行动，但没错，如果进攻失败，他们会对我们穷追猛打。

original: We've been able to steamroll the Enclave so far, but how do you think this is going to end? Can we really defeat them?
translation: 我们一直到现在都压着英克雷打，但是你觉得最后会结束吗？我们真的能打败他们？

original: I'm trying to stay positive, but losing the robot was a huge blow. Do you think we'll still be able to pull through this?
translation: 我想乐观些，但是没有了机器人，真是打击很大。你觉得我们能渡过这个难关吗？

original: Go on...
translation: 继续……

original: Ah, but of course! You have been blessed by Atom with Eternal Light, and are most welcome to our monastery.
translation: 啊，没问题！你已经被原子的永恒之光祝福过了，非常欢迎来到我们的修道院。

original: You will find many kindred spirits within. Please, introduce yourself to our leader, our Luminescent Mother, Curie the Third.
translation: 你会在里面发现很多血族的勇士。请你向我们的首领，我们的荧光嬷嬷，圣母居里三世，介绍你自己吧。

original: Ah, I can feel the Light within you. By all means, you are welcome in our sanctuary.
translation: 噢，我能感觉到你体内的圣光。也就是说，我们的圣所现在欢迎你。

original: Please, speak with our leader, our Luminescent Mother, Curie the Third.
translation: 请您与我们的领袖谈谈，我们的荧光母亲，居里三世。

original: Oh, truly your Light is second only to the Suns of Atom themselves! You are more than welcome.
translation: 哦，你的光芒真的仅次于原子骄阳！我们非常欢迎您。

original: Please, speak with our leader, our Luminescent Mother, Curie the Third.
translation: 请您与我们的领袖谈谈，我们的荧光母亲，居里三世。

original: Still working on decrypting the Enclave data pulled from the last encounter. We should have solid results soon.
translation: 我们还在破解上次交锋时获得的英克雷数据。相信很快就会有重大进展。

original: I can't stay here. Not after something like that...
translation: 我不能呆在这儿。尤其是发生了这种事之后……

original: Well, maybe. I mean, possibly. I think so, but I'm not certain.
translation: 嗯，可能吧。我是说，也许。我想是的，不过不能确定。

original: I don't know how much this will actually help... I mean, I'm not quite sure how effective it might be since it hasn't really been field tested...
translation: 我不知道这能帮上多少忙……我是说，我不太确定它是否有效，因为这还没在实地测试过……

original: But I think I've figured out a way to override the signals the Enclave is using to control their Deathclaws.
translation: 但我想我找到了一种方法，可以覆写英克雷用来控制死亡爪的信号。

original: Here, take this. It's only a prototype, so please don't lose it.
translation: 给，拿着。只有一台样机，所以别弄丢了。

original: Ah... my um... LOYAL customers and FRIENDS!
translation: 啊……我的……嗯……忠实的顾客和朋友啊！

original: Yeah, but we're Ghouls so it's not like it's hurt anybody.
translation: 没错，但是我们都尸鬼，所以这玩意不会危害到任何人。

original: And, as I've said with each and every purchase: "All sales are final." Eheh.
translation: 并且，就像我对每一个买我货的人说的一样：“概不退换。”嗯。

original: Little Sister, I've stashed away a considerable amount of fuel behind the small building west of the Air Traffic Control Tower as you requested.
translation: 妹妹，我按你的要求，在空中交通控制塔西边的小楼后面藏了相当多的燃油。

original: The container's tucked away under some barrels and tires. And no, I couldn't safely confiscate an Incinerator for you, that's your job.
translation: 那个容器就藏在一些桶和轮胎下面。不过，我无法安全地为你没收一把焚烧器，只有靠你自己了。

original: I took too big a risk hiding that fuel for you in the first place. If you do come across an Incinerator, please be careful.
translation: 我当初为你藏匿燃料冒了太大的风险。如果你真的遇到了焚烧器，那就要当心了。

original: Anyway, they're shipping me out to some relay station far west of here in the Wasteland. I'm afraid I won't be seeing you for awhile.
translation: 不管怎样，他们要把我送去废土西面很远的一个中继站，恐怕我们要有一段时间不能见面了。

original: Take care and good luck in all your endeavors. Your Big Brother.
translation: 以后的日子自己当心，祝你好运。你的大哥。

original: So get your glasses ready, children. This round's on me.
translation: 所以把你的杯子准备好了，孩子们。这次我请客。

original: As I speak, the Brotherhood is working with Rivet City security to get that fresh water to the Wasteland. The caravans are coming!
translation: 就在我说话的时候，兄弟会正在与铆钉城保安把那些淡水送往废土。小篷车就来了!

original: God, ain't that beautiful? But even better, it's finally happened! The water is clean, and hell yes, it's free! Just a little patience, children.
translation: 天啊，是不是很漂亮？但更重要的，最后成真了！水是干净无害的,它是免费的！只要有点耐心，孩子们。

original: See, she was a scientist too, worked on that project. You know what she wanted? "The waters of life. Free and clean, for any and all."
translation: 看，她也是科学家，参与那项目。你知道她想要什么吗？“生命之水。干净的、免费的，给所有的人。”

original: Now you all remember James, right? Father of 101? Well, Three Dog has learned that back in the day, James' wife had a dream.
translation: 现在你们记住了詹姆斯，对吗？101小子的父亲？嗯，三狗在以前已经认识了，詹姆斯妻子的梦想。

original: Two weeks. It's been two weeks since our boys in Power Armor kicked those Enclave bastards out of Project Purity, and started that baby chugging.
translation: 两个星期。两周前，我们的小伙穿着穿动力装甲把英克雷混蛋踢出净水工程，并启动那婴儿咕噜咕噜地咕噜。

original: Three Dog's advice? If you've got one of those Mister Dandy butler bots, have him make you some purified water, and count yourself lucky.
translation: 三狗的建议？如果你有一个丹迪先生管家机器人，让他给你做一些纯化水，算你走运。

original: The water going 'round may be free, but it sure as hell ain't clean. So when you see that caravan comin', tell 'em to keep on going.
translation: 水可能是免费的，但肯定不干净的。所以，当你看到大篷车来的时候，告诉他们继续走。

original: Coincidence? Three Dog thinks not. For all their good intentions, it looks like those eggheads at the Jefferson Memorial screwed up royally.
translation: 巧合吗？三狗认为不是。杰斐逊纪念馆的那些书呆子虽然用心良苦，但似乎还是把事情搞砸了。

original: It also happens that this new illness ONLY started showin' up AFTER the Brotherhood started distributing so-called "clean" water from that purifier.
translation: 而且，这种新的疾病也是在兄弟会开始从净化器中分发所谓的“干净的”水之后，才开始出现的。

original: Experience would tell ya this is your garden variety radiation sickness, but nuh uh. This is something else, children. Something worse. Much worse.
translation: 经验告诉你，这只是普通的辐射病，但不是。这不是一般的病，孩子们。更糟的东西。严重得多。

original: People are gettin' sick. Sicker than usual, I mean. Weakness, nausea, you name it. Even a couple of deaths reported.
translation: 人们生病了。我是说比平时更难受，虚弱、恶心，应有尽有。甚至有了几例死亡报告。

original: All righty, children, time to let you know about yet another problem plaguing our tranquil little post-apocalyptic neighborhood.
translation: 好了，孩子们，是时候让你们知道，又有一个问题困扰着我们这个宁静的小后启示录社区了。

original: The Enclave's been responsible for enough death and destruction. We need to get back to normal. You know, like fighting Raiders and Super Mutants.
translation: 英克雷造成了太多的死亡和破坏。我们需要回到正常的生活。你知道，如同抵抗掠夺者和超级变种人。

original: You know, some laser beams here, a few exploded corpses there. Let's just hope this mop up operation ends ASAP.
translation: 你知道，一些激光光束闪过，一些尸体被分解。我们希望尽快完成操作。

original: But the fight, dear children, did not end there. The Brotherhood has been pursuing "President" Eden's little minions throughout the Wasteland.
translation: 但是这场战斗，亲爱的孩子们，并没有到此为止。兄弟会还在废土追缴伊甸“总统”的一些走狗。

original: It's been some time since those plucky paladins in Power Armor first stormed the Jefferson Memorial and gave the Enclave their walking papers.
translation: 自从那些穿着动力装甲的勇敢圣骑士第一次冲进杰斐逊纪念馆，并给了英克雷他们的解聘书，已经有一段时间了。

original: As you know, I had my reservations about engaging the Enclave. They did not directly attack us, and I believed we had time. Time to be cautious.
translation: 你知道的，我在关于与英克雷交战的问题上还保留意见。他们不会直接攻击我们，我认为我们还有时间。是时候谨慎行事了。

original: Their assault on the purifier forced our hand. We had no choice but to engage them directly.
translation: 他们对净化器的袭击迫使我们动手。除了开战，我们别无他法。

original: And, once that engagement was begun, we could do nothing but see it through to the end. If they had not considered us a threat before, they do now.
translation: 而且，一旦交战开始，我们只能奉陪到底。如果他们以前不认为我们是威胁，那么现在就是了。

original: So we have spent the time since you and I last spoke systematically locating and destroying every bastion of Enclave force we can.
translation: 自从我们上次找出并摧毁英克雷的每一个堡垒之前已经有些时日了。

original: Liberty Prime has proven far more successful than any of us could have hoped for.
translation: 自由先锋已经证明我们能取得的成功远超出我们的期望。

original: I've been trying to get outta here for awhile. See, I've done things for the Enclave... Things I can't say I'm proud of, but a man's gotta eat.
translation: 我想离开这里有段时间了。你也看到了我为英克雷做事……我不能说我很自豪，但是人总要吃饭啊。

original: When the Enclave picked me up, I was starving and suffering from radiation poisoning. I felt I owed them. But now... now it's time to leave.
translation: 英克雷接我回来的时候，我正饱受饥饿之苦和辐射的伤害。我觉得我欠他们的。但现在……现在是时候离开了。

original: You'll make a great distraction while I make off with a few robots and supplies. I help you, and you help me.
translation: 你尽可能的吸引他们的注意力，而我去弄点补给和机器人。我们互帮互助。

original: Man, I'm glad you realize I'm not one of the bad guys. I'll be happy to answer any questions you have.
translation: 伙计，我很高兴你明白了我不是个坏人。我很乐意回答你的任何问题。

original: There's something jamming the control frequency!
translation: 有东西在干扰控制波频！

original: Releasing Deathclaw!
translation: 放出死亡爪！

original: Good job. I'll inform Lyons of your progress.
translation: 干得漂亮。我会告诉里昂斯你所做的。

original: Fantastic. I'll get the Scribes to record your kills.
translation: 难以想象。我会让学士们记录下你的杀敌数量。

original: Nice work. Come back when you have more.
translation: 干得不错。如果你取得了更多的就回来找我。

original: Great! Keep them coming.
translation: 太好了！请再给我多带一些。

original: Yeah, you don't seem like the goody-goody type. But don't spread this around: So this Ghoul, Griffon, comes in wanting to PURCHASE a bunch of water.
translation: 是啊，你看起来不像是那种假正经的人。但是不要到处宣扬：那个尸鬼，格里芬，进来想要买一大堆水。

original: What the hell does that droopy irradiated fool need with pure water? Thinks he can sell it in Underworld. Moron.
translation: 那个快腐烂的傻瓜要这么多净水干嘛？他以为他能在冥界卖掉这些水。蠢货。

original: But, he's the only one who's offered to PAY for water, in caps AND technology.
translation: 不过，只有他愿意用瓶盖和科技来换水。

original: And what Lyons doesn't know won't hurt him. There's plenty of water to go around.
translation: 里昂斯虽然不知道，但这对他没什么危害。这儿还有好多水。

original: And I can use it to pay Rivet City to provide security for all the caravans we can't escort ourselves. I'm lucky he came along.
translation: 我们还能用他给的钱让铆钉城的警力保护我们的旅队。他来找我可是我的运气。

original: Ah, very nice. I'll have my assembling team get right on it.
translation: 啊，很好！我现在就让装配组去做！

original: We'll need a lot more where this came from to reconstruct Prime's electrical systems. Keep bringing more.
translation: 我们还需要更多的材料才能重新建造“先锋”的电子系统。请多带点过来。

original: It's but a drop in the bucket, but it'll have to do. Thanks.
translation: 杯水车薪啊，但是聊胜于无。多谢啦。

original: Good, good. Please keep bringing them to me... it's my only hope of getting Prime's optics rebuilt.
translation: 很好，很好。请再多带一些过来…只有靠这样我才能把先锋的光学系统修复。

original: Oh, splendid! Hopefully these will contain unbroken lenses unlike the last few I've acquired.
translation: 噢，太棒了！我希望这里面还有完好的镜头，可别像我上次拿到的那几个。

original: Excellent! I'll begin disassembling them immediately. Good work!
translation: 太棒了！我马上就把它们拆开。干得好！

original: If someone finds this... please get this to my lover at the La Maison Beauregard Hotel in East Georgetown... he'll want to hear what I have to say.
translation: 如果有人发现了这个……请把这交给我住在乔治敦东部，拉·迈松·博勒加德酒店的爱人……他会想听我说了什么的。

original: My darling... they've found me. I... I tried to get away... tried to get away so we could be together once again...
translation: 亲爱的……他们找到我了。我……我试着逃走……试着逃走，这样我们就又能在一起……

original: I know you risked your life to get it to me... combing the ruins, avoiding the Super Mutants... all for me.
translation: 我知道你冒着生命危险为我找到它……搜寻废墟，避开超级变种人……这一切都是为了我。

original: It seems I shall never lay my eyes upon your gift... you... you'll have to keep it and remember me every time you see it.
translation: 看来我永远也见不到你的礼物了……你……你要好好保存它，每次看到它都要记住我。

original: I'm so sorry my darling... so... so... sorry I've let you down. So many have died for this thing... so many hearts have been broken.
translation: 对不起，亲爱的……真的……真的……对不起，让你失望了。太多人为这东西而死……太多人因此心碎。

original: Please remember, I'll always love you... you will be with me forever in my spirit... I... I... l-love... you...
translation: 请记住，我会永远爱你……你会永远在我心里……我……我……我爱……你……

original: Look, this wasn't how it was supposed to go down.
translation: 听着，事情不该是这样的。

original: It was a good idea at the time, y'know? Figured we'd try and set ourselves up down here. Just like Underworld, only better.
translation: 当时这是个好主意，你知道吗？想想我们试着在这里建立起我们自己的地盘，就像冥界那样，而且比那里更好。

original: Who's gonna bother a bunch of Ghouls living underneath Old Olney, right? So we get down here, we start knockin' some walls down...
translation: 谁会去惹一大群住在老奥尔尼地下的尸鬼，对吧？所以我们来到这里，开始试着推倒几堵墙……

original: And the next thing you know we're getting our faces chewed off by Deathclaws.
translation: 而接下来的事你也知道了，我们的脸被死亡爪嚼碎了。

original: Yes, yes. I received a message from her. It's here somewhere... Well, no matter where it is, I know what it said.
translation: 是的，是的。我收到她的讯息了。应该在这的……嗯，算了，我知道上面说了什么。

original: <Sigh.> The Initiates just finished itemizing a requisition of confiscated Enclave gear. There were a few items that we didn't immediately send out.
translation: <叹气。>新兵们刚刚完成了一份对收缴的英克雷装备的征用清单。有几样东西没有立即送出去。

original: I suppose you are welcome to those...
translation: 我觉得你会喜欢……

original: The Brotherhood thanks you for your efforts. Now if you don't mind? I think I'll just take a brief nap here at my desk...
translation: 兄弟会感谢你付出的努力。现在如果你不介意的话……我想我能在这儿打个盹……

original: <Sigh.> The Initiates just finished itemizing a requisition of confiscated Enclave gear. There were a few items that we didn't immediately send out.
translation: <叹气。>新兵们刚刚完成了一份对收缴的英克雷装备的征用清单。有几样东西没有立即送出去。

original: I suppose you're welcome to those...
translation: 我觉得你会喜欢……

original: The Brotherhood thanks you for your efforts. Now if you don't mind? I think I'll just take a brief nap here at my desk...
translation: 兄弟会感谢你付出的努力。现在如果你不介意的话……我想我能在这儿打个盹……

original: Heard about that. News traveled fast. I couldn't believe it. I mean, everyone knew it was crazy building a city around that bomb...
