translation: 这事传的很快，我听说了。不过我不敢相信。我是说，是人都知道围着炸弹建房子肯定是脑子进水了……

original: But I don't think anyone expected the bomb to actually go off...
translation: 但我觉得没人会相信那炸弹能真正安全……

original: I didn't expect things to end like this... but it did get Lyons off my back about it.
translation: 我没料到这事会这样如此结束……但这确实让里昂斯不再为这件事烦我了。

original: So here. Might as well take the money I was going to give you.
translation: 给你。不如把我要给你的钱拿走吧。

original: A cult? There's something about Megaton, isn't there. It's apparently THE place to start a cult these days.
translation: 邪教？兆吨镇果然有古怪，不是么。显然那就是这些天开始冒邪教的地方。

original: Guess I can start sending them water again. Hopefully they can keep their grubby hands on their shipments this time.
translation: 看来我又能给他们送水了。希望这次他们的脏手不要来碰这些货物。

original: Here. It's not much. Most of the assets have been exhausted, but take this. It's definitely worth getting Lyons off my back. Thanks.
translation: 给。不算很多。大部分资产已经耗尽，但收下这个。让里昂斯不再烦我，这很值得。谢谢。

original: Obadiah sent you? Well, then, let's see what he has to say.
translation: 奥巴迪亚派你来的？好吧，来看看他要说什么。

original: (Pauses to read note)
translation: （停下来读信）

original: Oh dear... no, no. This can only mean one thing.
translation: 哦，天哪……不，不。这只能说明一件事

original: We must get it back before the Krvibi learn anything from it.
translation: 我们必须在卡维碧从中学到任何东西之前夺回来。

original: There's a ritual site... I'm certain they'll be hiding it there. I don't know yet what we must do, but for now it's enough to steal the book.
translation: 有一处仪式之地……我确信他们会将它藏在那里。我还不知道我们该怎么做，但现在只要偷书就够了。

original: This isn't some ordinary book we can toss in a fire and be done with. I can destroy it here and now, but the ritual requires a sacrifice.
translation: 这书不一般，不是扔到火里烧了就完事的。我可以在此时此地毁掉它，但仪式需要牺牲。

original: They'll kill me anyway. Now that they've possessed the book, they'll do anything to get it back.
translation: 无论如何他们都会来杀我。他们已经丧心病狂了，并会不惜一切将其夺回。

original: I... I see. Friend, this book is the bane of my Family. Now it seems it will be the death of us, too.
translation: 我…我明白了。朋友，这书是我家族衰败的根源。看来我们也会因此消失吧。

original: I'll be bloody well damned. She was right. It's back.
translation: 这也太他妈的离谱了。她是对的。它回来了。

original: You have it? God help us; you do. That damned book is back, and this time it'll be the death of me.
translation: 你拿到了？天佑我们；你得到了。那本该死的书又回来了，这次它会要了我的命。

original: Marcella? Why? She's done nothing to them!
translation: 玛塞拉？为什么？她没对他们做什么！

original: Good job blocking off that hole! Hurry and get in here! It looks like they are about to breach from the East wing!
translation: 洞口堵住了！干得漂亮！快进来！看起来他们要从东翼突破了！

original: Hurry! Get in there before more of them come out! Find where they are coming from and stop them. Just like before I'll be keeping an eye out.
translation: 快！在更多人来之前进去！看看他们是从哪进来的，阻止他们。和刚才一样，我会一直盯着你。

original: That's one less way for them to get in. Follow me. I think we are about to get hit hard.
translation: 他们又少了一条可以进来的路。跟我来。咱们有场硬仗要打。

original: Yeah, here they come. Grab all the ammo and stimpaks you need. This is gonna be a rough one!
translation: 耶，他们来了。拿上你所需要的弹药和治疗针。这会很刺激！

original: They've been at it all night. I think they are just about to breach the inner walls. Follow me. I'm going to go check it out.
translation: 他们忙了一整晚。我想他们就快攻破内墙了。跟我来。我们去看看。

original: It looks like they are coming in from somewhere upstairs. Hurry, follow me!
translation: 看来他们是从楼上进来的。快，跟着我！

original: Go through these doors and up the stairs. Find where they are coming in and stop them. I'll be keeping an eye on the cameras down here. Hurry!
translation: 从这些门上楼。看看他们从哪进来的，阻止他们。我会在楼下盯着的摄像头。快去！

original: Old Man Herzog's Mine-hole? Isn't much, but it's home!
translation: 老赫尔佐格的矿井？不多，但那是家！

original: This is Caroline Saunders, principal geological chemist, for Bysshe natural gas survey MD-16-001.
translation: 这里是卡洛琳·桑德斯，首席地质化学家，负责彼希天然气勘查MD-16-001。

original: Sample set one shows promising concentration of bio-gas in mostly limestone substratum of wetlands.
translation: 样本的分析指出生化气体最有可能会在塘持的石灰岩底层。

original: No exact levels yet, but this site should exhibit more than enough extraction potential to meet survey goals.
translation: 没有具体数据显示可能会在多深处，但是这个地点应该有足够的量来萃取以达到测量目标。

original: I'm going to leave a couple of interns here to handle the minutiae, but it's a formality.
translation: 我将会留下几个实习生来处理细节上的东西，但是那都不过是形式上的措施罢了。

original: I'll move on to the other sites now to make sure this isn't an aberration. Consider this my authorization signature on Sample Site One.
translation: 我现在就去下一个地点，以确定测量上没有差错。可以把这当成是我的样本地点一的授权。

original: Hey! Over here!
translation: 嗨！这！

original: Ok, any second now. Get ready!
translation: 好了，随时会来。做好准备！

original: Here they come! Second floor, on the right!
translation: 他们来了！二楼，右边！

original: More of them! On the right, first floor!
translation: 又来了！右边，一楼！

original: The door on the left! First floor!
translation: 左边的门！一楼！

original: They're at the front door! Get ready!
translation: 他们在正门！准备好！

original: That looks like the last of 'em. You're a pretty good shot.
translation: 看来是最后一波了。你枪法不错。

original: Oh, just about whatever ails you, sweetie! A real cure-all. Say, I don't reckon you're the dry type, is you? Oh, never mind.
translation: 无论是什么让你不适，宝贝！真正包治百病。我认为你不是那种干燥的类型，对吗？噢，别介意。

original: Aren't you a smart one? Sweeter tonic's better for both of us, after all.
translation: 你不是一个聪明人吗？毕竟，甜一些的补药对我们俩都好。

original: I reckon you've got a deal, sweetie, but I'd better notice a difference in the tonic.
translation: 我认为你做了笔买卖，宝贝，但我最好注意到补药的不同。

original: I reckon I can scrape that together. Go ahead and do what you can for it.
translation: 我认为我能把那弄到一起。去吧，尽力而为。

original: Could it, now? I suppose you'd know how to see to that, wouldn't you?
translation: 是吗？我想你知道怎么修，对吧？

original: Why, I'm just folk. What more is there?
translation: 怎么，我只是个平民。还有什么事？

original: I reckon you can, at that. I just need some help brewing up a little tonic.
translation: 而且我认为你能做到。我只是需要点帮助来调制补药。

original: Reckon it's the Orange Fever. I do feel light in my head...
translation: 估计是橙热病。我确实觉得脑袋轻飘飘的……

original: Little scrawny, but they'll do. Thank you, sweetie.
translation: 小个了点，但也行。谢谢你，宝贝。

original: Sweet and ripe, too. These will do just fine.
translation: 又甜又熟。这些正合适。

original: Go to the bank and use password xìn tian weng. The software is configured to recognize only our voices.
translation: 去银行，并且使用密码xìn tian weng。软件已被设置为只识别我们的声音。

original: Yes, thank you so much! And now that she's got this boat and carrying all this cargo...
translation: 是啊，太感谢你了！现在她有了这艘船，还载着这么多货物……

original: Well, I can afford to actually pay you! Thank you so much!
translation: 嗯，我真的付得起你的报酬了！太谢谢你了！

original: Oh, it's smoke, all right. Where there's smoke, there's fire - and where there's fire, there's profit to be made selling an extinguisher!
translation: 噢，是烟，好吧。哪儿有烟，哪儿就有火 — 哪儿有火，哪儿就有兜售灭火器的机会！

original: That smoke's coming from old Calvert Mansion. I always heard it was haunted, but more importantly, I always heard it was full of Pre-War treasure!
translation: 烟是从老卡尔弗特公馆出来的。我一直听说那儿闹鬼，但更重要的是，总听到那里满是战前宝藏！

original: I know I said Point Lookout was perfect for treasure hunters, but it's a rare day when you get a beacon like that!
translation: 我知道我说过望海崖非常适合财宝猎人，但很少有一天能遇到这样的烽火！

original: I wasn't born right. Mama hid me in the basement and pappy kinda just forgot about me, but I knew I had to go before I grew up.
translation: 我生得不是时候。妈妈把我藏在地下室，爸爸好像是把我忘了一样，但是我知道我要在我长大之前离开这里。

original: Come over here, boy. Let's talk.
translation: 快过来，小子。咱们谈谈。

original: Come over here, girl. Let's talk.
translation: 快过来，小妞。咱们谈谈。

original: We take no pleasure in violence. Our goal was merely to remove the Ghoul. His presence is an offense to the Transcendent Master's astral dominion.
translation: 我们不以暴力为乐。我们的目标仅仅是除掉那个尸鬼。他的存在是对我们至高无上主人的星之领土的冒犯。

original: I cannot claim to understand the exact reasons that the mansion's resident caused such disruption, however. To understand fully, ask the Master.
translation: 不过，我并不了解这公馆的住户造成如此混乱的确切原因。要想完全了解，去找主人。

original: Of course I did, but that moron thought it was one of his addled visions. The real goal was to destroy the Ghouls' jamming device!
translation: 当然是我，但那个傻子以为是他混乱的幻象呢。真正的目的是去摧毁尸鬼的干扰装置！

original: Honestly, those fools aren't worth the meat they're made of. A minion that can't follow directions is no use at all!
translation: 坦白地说，那些蠢货一点存在的价值都没有。奴才要是不听话，那就一点用都没有！

original: Woah, woah, woah! That was all Jackson's crazy idea. I knew better than to volunteer for that suicide mission!
translation: 哇哦，哇哦，哇哦！这很显然是杰克逊出的疯狂的主意。这种自愿去送死的做法，我一眼就能看出来。

original: Last time I wandered too close to that mansion, some old Ghoul sicced his dogs on me. Screw that!
translation: 上次我溜达太靠近那公馆，有些老尸鬼放狗放出来咬我。去他娘的！

original: Well, that's just too bad, ain't it? But since you're so afraid, attach the thing to one of the cars and then spin it around to get it to the top.
translation: 喔，那太糟了，不是吗？但既然你这么害怕，那就随便装到一个客厢上，再转到高处。

original: I'll watch from here and turn it on when it's ready. Then we'll see where our little Professor is.
translation: 我就从这里观察，就绪了便开启开关。然后就能知道咱们的小教授在哪了。

original: Now, go!
translation: 去吧！

original: Right. Attach it to the bottom car, then turn it on and spin the jammer to the top. No fuckin' problem.
translation: 没错。装到最下面的吊箱上，开启开关，把干扰器转到最高处。绝对他妈的没问题。

original: I'll watch from here and turn it on. Then we'll see where our little professor is.
translation: 我在这里看着并打开它。然后看看我们的小教授在哪儿。

original: Now, go!
translation: 去吧！

original: You're in Blackhall Manor. This isn't a tourist attraction, but I appreciate your good taste. Come, let's talk.
translation: 你身处布莱克霍尔庄园。这不是旅游胜地，但我欣赏你的品位。来吧，我们谈谈。

original: I... guess that's Kenny-Bear. Thanks for bringing him back.
translation: 我…猜那就是肯尼熊吧。谢谢你帮我把他带回来。

original: Gee, thanks! I dropped him near the shaft, so he's probably at the bottom.
translation: 耶啊，谢谢！我把他掉进那个通风管道里了，也许你能在最底部找到。

original: Kenny-Bear! You're the greatest!
translation: 肯尼熊！你是最棒的！

original: Kenny-Bear! You're the greatest!
translation: 肯尼熊！你是最棒的！

original: So hey. You can use this place as your hideout if you want. Hide from the folk out there. Stash your stuff. Okay?
translation: 那么，嘿。如果你想的话你可以把这里当做你的藏身之处。藏起来不被外面那些家伙发现。存放你的东西。好吗？

original: I told you about their ritual site, remember? See if they're hiding the book there and bring it back to me. From there? I don't yet know.
translation: 我跟你说过他们的仪式场所，记得吗？看看他们有没有把书藏在那儿，有的话带回来？我可说不好。

original: Perhaps you're in the wrong place? Do come back when you have the means.
translation: 也许你找错地方了吧？当你想到解决办法的时候再回来。

original: That's the spirit! The other participants are waiting, so just press the button inside to let me know when to begin.
translation: 要的就是这种精神！其它的参与者都在等着呢，如果你准备好的话就按下那个按钮。

original: Yes, Desmond. But whose side is she on? Do you know? Can you be sure? You always were so bad at choosing your allies.
translation: 是的，德斯蒙德。但你知道她会帮哪边吗？你能确定吗？你总是不会选择盟友。

original: You're free to take whatever you find in this disgusting place.
translation: 在这个令人恶心的地方，你找到的东西都归你所有。

original: What I came for is of no interest to you.
translation: 我来这里的原因与你无关。

original: Enjoy your spoils. I don't think our paths will ever cross again. And I think we can both thank Christ and say hallelujah for that.
translation: 好好享用你的战利品吧，我想我们以后的道路不再会有交集了。并且我们可以为此感谢主，并说声哈利路亚。

original: You're free to take whatever you find in this disgusting place.
translation: 在这个令人恶心的地方，你找到的东西都归你所有。

original: What I came for is of no interest to you.
translation: 我来这里的原因与你无关。

original: Enjoy your spoils. I don't think our paths will ever cross again. And I think we can both thank Christ and say hallelujah for that.
translation: 好好享用你的战利品吧，我想我们以后的道路不再会有交集了。并且我们可以为此感谢主，并说声哈利路亚。

original: You're free to take whatever you find in this disgusting place.
translation: 在这个令人恶心的地方，你找到的东西都归你所有。

original: What I came for is of no interest to you.
translation: 我来这里的原因与你无关。

original: Enjoy your spoils. I don't think our paths will ever cross again. And I think we can both thank Christ and say hallelujah for that.
translation: 好好享用你的战利品吧，我想我们以后的道路不再会有交集了。并且我们可以为此感谢主，并说声哈利路亚。

original: Brace yourself, my friend. You're about to witness the end of an era!
translation: 你要打起精神，我的朋友，因为你将见证一个时代的终结！

original: After this, I won't require your services any longer. I suppose that works out now, doesn't it?
translation: 这一切结束以后，我就不再需要你的服务了。我想这就解决了我们之间的问题，不是吗？

original: So, since we're in agreement about this, let's go in there and "retire" the good professor!
translation: 因为你已经同意了，那么就让我们进去，让那个大教授“退休”吧！

original: Brace yourself, you're about to witness the end of an era!
translation: 你要打起精神，我的朋友，因为你将见证一个时代的终结！

original: I've waited a long time for this.
translation: 我为了这一刻已经等了很久了。

original: Savor the moment, my friend. This is the end of an era.
translation: 好好品味这一时刻吧，我的朋友。这是一个时代的终结。

original: I don't need eyes to know you're there. Come here!
translation: 我不用眼睛就知道你在哪里。过来！

original: Yes, we shall be free of all limitations! Thank you, master. We shall be the instrument of your mighty will.
translation: 是的，我们不应受任何界线的阻碍！谢谢你，主人。我们将辅佐你万能的意念。

original: Yes, fine, go destroy the house and its "impurities." Just stop that jammer, and I'll be free of you morons, once and for all!
translation: 是，好吧，去毁了那房子和它的“杂质”。只要关了干扰器，我就能永远摆脱你们这些蠢货了！

original: No need to worry, enlightened one. We shall re-consecrate the mansion, and remove the impurities disrupting your perfect guidance.
translation: 不必担心，开悟者。我们将重新圣化那座宅邸，并清除干扰您完美指引的杂质。

original: No, not "astral knowledge" you simpleton! Psychic domination! And that still won't be possible until you destroy Desmond's jamming device.
translation: 不，不是“星界知识”，你这呆子！心灵控制！而且要等你摧毁了德斯蒙德的干扰器后才有可能！

original: Yes, and you will be able to spread your knowledge across the astral plane for all those wise enough to accept it!
translation: 是的，你将可以在整个星界对那些足够聪明的人散播你的知识。

original: At last, yes! Desmond will die, and our long struggle will finally end the only way it could have - with me as the victor!
translation: 最终，是的！德斯蒙德会死，而我们旷日持久的斗争终将迎来唯一可能的结局——我是胜者！

original: Soon, your sacred land shall be cleared of all obstacles. No longer shall its mystical powers be diminished!
translation: 不久之后，你的圣地将清除一切障碍。所蕴藏的神秘力量将不再衰弱！

original: Excellent. I cannot tell you how satisfying it is to find a suitable assistant after all these years.
translation: 太好了，这么多年，我终于找到了像你这样合适的帮手，这可真是太令我满意了。

original: Now, the Ghoul is a pain, and may require disposal, but Desmond is only of secondary importance. The real target is a device in his possession.
translation: 现在，那个尸鬼是个障碍，也许需要除掉他，不过嘛，德斯蒙德是次要的。真正的目标是他拥有的装置。

original: He has a jammer which limits my projection range to this pathetic cave. Remove that, and I can extend my reach so much further...
translation: 他的那个干扰设备限制了我的对这个可怜的洞穴的控制。除掉那个东西，我就可以将我的思想传播得更远了…

original: At the moment, they've been no use at all, but I have very few options. They can't even seem to remove a single Ghoul from a house.
translation: 目前来说，这些人一点用都没有，但是我的选择并不多。他们连个房子里的一个尸鬼都搞不定。

original: Jackson believes me to be some kind of god. You'd think that would be good, but his interpretations of my commands leaves something to be desired.
translation: 杰克逊还以为我是什么神呢。你也许认为这不错，但是他对我的命令的解释说明却延缓了我渴望要做的事情。

original: Regardless, I trust you can be more effective than he has been. I need your help on an important task.
translation: 不管怎么样，你做事会比他更有效率吧。我需要你帮我做一个非常重要的事情。

original: There's a troublesome Ghoul who lives in Calvert Mansion. I need him destroyed, and his jamming device neutralized, immediately.
translation: 有一个非常麻烦的尸鬼，他住在卡尔弗特公馆。我需要立刻消灭他，并且毁掉它的干扰设备。

original: He thinks I'm some sort of god, and I have no reason to disabuse him of the notion. This makes me de facto leader of the tribe, as it were.
translation: 他以为我是个神，并且我也没有理由去纠正他错误的想法。在某种程度上，这使我成为这个部族的实际首领。

original: Regardless, I trust you can be more effective than he has been. I need your help on an important task.
translation: 不管怎么样，你做事会比他更有效率吧。我需要你帮我做一个非常重要的事情。

original: There's a troublesome Ghoul who lives in Calvert Mansion. I need him destroyed, and his jamming device neutralized, immediately.
translation: 有一个非常麻烦的尸鬼，他住在卡尔弗特公馆。我需要立刻消灭他，并且毁掉它的干扰设备。

original: I may be the man who leads our physical affairs, but I cannot claim true wisdom. I take my orders from a higher master!
translation: 我大概是领导这里实际事务的人，但我不能称自己是真正的智慧。我接受更高阶主人的命令！

original: Whether it be how to explore higher planes, or the decision to remove the disruptive Ghoul, all wisdom comes from the Transcendent Master.
translation: 无论是定下长远目标，还是决定除掉恼人的尸鬼，所有的智慧，学问与正确的判断都来自于那个至高无上的主人。

original: What splendid news! At last the holy land is empty of its destructive aurora, and the astral plain is open to us all.
translation: 真是好消息！圣地终于没有了毁灭性的极光，星光平原向我们所有人敞开了大门。

original: Oh, but the Transcendent Master will want to hear of this! And as the returning champion, it is your right and honor to tell him yourself.
translation: 哦，但是至高无上的主人会想知道的！作为一个明显被幻象所引导的人，你有权利和荣誉亲自告诉他！

original: After all, it is he who makes all true decisions about the spiritual growth of our tribe, including the decision to cleanse the mansion.
translation: 毕竟，他才是我们部族精神上的决策者，决策也包括净化那公馆。

original: You best keep this one to yourself, sweetie. The family tonic gets real kick from our secret ingredient. We just need a lil' bit of battery acid.
translation: 这个你最好自己留着，亲爱的。家传补药的真正刺激来自于我们的秘方。我们只需要一点点电池酸液。

original: Oh, don't look like that, now.
translation: 哦，别这样看我。

original: You reckon I'd be around to tell you about it if it weren't safe enough? Bring me six fission batteries and I'll scrape 'em into the mix.
translation: 要是危险的话，你觉得我还会告诉你吗？给我带六块裂变电池，我来把它们磨碎搅进去。

original: I thought so. Those things do carry a smell, don't they?
translation: 我想也是。那些东西真臭，不是吗？

original: Let me take 'em off your hands, then.
translation: 那我把它们从你手里拿走吧。

original: I see. Thank you kindly for these.
translation: 我知道了。谢谢你这些东西。

original: Wild fruit, eh? Just as good, if a sight weaker for flavor.
translation: 野生果，嗯哼？也不错，希望味道不会太浓烈。

original: I see you sprung for the refined fruit. Good for you, sweetie.
translation: 看来你搞到了优质果。太棒了，亲爱的。

original: Are you fucking joking? I suppose you aren't. What is it you people use for money these days? Those bottle caps?
translation: 你他妈在开玩笑？我看不像。最近你们人都把什么当作货币？那些瓶盖？

original: Right. Well, here's a bunch of those. Now go do your goddamn job before my patience runs out.
translation: 没错。唔，这还有一堆。现在，在我失去耐心之前滚回去做你那该死的工作。

original: You... and- ... that Ghoul... ... ...both... ... pay...
translation: 你……和-……那个尸鬼……都……代价……

original: ...coming for- ...you... ... ...
Now, I'm not normally one to discourage an adventurous spirit, but certain... events have convinced me of the value of forewarning.
translation: 如今，我通常不会劝阻有冒险精神的家伙，但某些……事让我相信预先警告的重要性。

original: I know you think you're ready for anything, but the threats you'll face in the swamp make those Super Mutants look like playful puppies.
translation: 我知道你认为自己已经做好面对一切的准备，但你在沼泽里面对的威胁，会让那些超级变种人看起来像顽皮的小狗。

original: So just be sure you know what you're getting into, okay? You still want to head out to Point Lookout?
translation: 所以你一定要清楚自己要面对什么，好吗？你仍想去望海崖吗？

original: Let's see what you've got to trade.
translation: 让我看看你都有些什么东西要卖。

original: Happy to oblige!
translation: 乐意听从！

original: At last! He's just ahead! I'll circle around and distract him. You take him from the front.
translation: 终于！要逮到他了！我绕着分散他的注意力。你从正面进攻。

original: Air Com, we have multiple flashpoints on horizon, come back?
translation: 空军指挥部，我们发现地平线有多处闪光点，请指示？

original: Air Command, USN Three-Five-Oh requesting landing vector. Have zero ceiling visbility and low on state, somebody get me a landing clearance.
translation: 空军指挥部，美国海军3-5-0请求着陆航线。当前能见度为零并且器械运转状态不佳，请给与着陆指示。

original: State One plus one zero to splash, have zero read on outer marker. This is USN Three-Five-Oh, I'm blind out here.
translation: 状态为离斑点1+10处，雷达无显示。这里是美国海军3-5-0，我失去定位能力。

original: Attempting Emergency Landing over water. INS pinger active on distress band. Flaps up, descent to eight cherubs. Three green, over.
translation: 尝试紧急水上迫降。惯性导航系统声波发生器紧急启动。有振动，高度降至800。通话结束。

original: Five cherubs, treeline up, throttle easy on four lights. Prepping to pull the loud handle. <Static>
translation: 高度降至500，垂直下降，油门调节可轻易达到四灯。做好拉起飞机准备。<静电声>

original: Good! Good... now, come speak with me. We have matters to discuss...
translation: 很好！好吧… 现在，来跟我聊聊。有些事需要讨论…

original: No! How... how could this... be... ... ?
translation: 不！怎么…怎么会…这样……？

original: No! How... how could this... be... ... ?
translation: 不！怎么…怎么会…这样……？

original: All robots! Activate! Destroy Desmond!
translation: 所有机器人！启动！干掉德斯蒙德！

original: All robots! Activate! Destroy Desmond!
translation: 所有机器人！启动！干掉德斯蒙德！

original: Surely you mean that you will TRY!
translation: 看来你想试试！

original: Robots! TO ME!
translation: 机器人！到我这来！

original: I certainly hope you enjoy your final moments!
translation: 我当然希望你能享受最后的时刻！

original: Robots! To me!
translation: 机器人！到我这来！

original: Ha ha ha ha ha! YES! LET'S!
translation: 哈哈哈！是的！来吧！

original: Robots! To me!
translation: 机器人！到我这来！

original: Assist me, my robots! I am... under attack!
translation: 协助我，我的机器人！我遭到了…攻击！

original: Assist me, my robots! I am... under attack!
translation: 协助我，我的机器人！我遭到了…攻击！

original: One... two... three... four... five... six... seven... eight... nine... ten...
translation: 一…二…三…四…五…六…七…八…九…十…

original: Ok ok... I'll do it. Just point that thing somewhere else... My name is John Adlam, son of Joseph Adlam, and brother of Richard Adlam.
translation: 好，好……我会说的。你能不能把那个东西指向别处啊……我的名字是约翰·阿德拉姆，约瑟夫·阿德拉姆的儿子，理查德·阿德拉姆的哥哥。

original: Two days ago I was caught stealing from the groups' claim.
translation: 2天前，我因为偷东西而被抓。

original: Today, with the consent of my father, I am to be shot and killed on the cliffs of the old cathedral by the hands of my brother, Richard.
translation: 今天，在我父亲的许可之下，我将会在大教堂那里的悬崖上被枪决，而执行枪决的人是我的弟弟，理查德。

original: With my execution, my punishment is exacted and the Adlam name will be avenged.
translation: 我被枪决以后，我将受到应有的惩罚，而且阿德拉姆家也会被正名。

original: Let my punishment be a reminder to those who may be tempted to do as I did.
translation: 就让对我的惩罚警告后人不要步我后尘。

original: We are nothing alike. More so than you could ever comprehend. Go now, and never return.
translation: 我们完全不同。你完全无法理解。走吧，别再回来了。

original: Then you shall die along with him!
translation: 那你就跟他一起死吧！

original: You would have been wise to listen to him!
translation: 你该乖乖听他的话的！

original: ROBOTS! ATTACK!
translation: 机器人！进攻！

original: You are permitted to talk while you DIE!
translation: 有什么话等下地狱再说吧！

original: ROBOTS! TO ME!
translation: 机器人！到我这来！

original: Professor Calvert is never kidding!
translation: 卡尔弗特教授从不说笑！

original: ROBOTS! TO ME!
translation: 机器人！到我这来！

original: I have a very special gift for you, my friend...
translation: 我有份特别的礼物给你，朋友……

original: DEATH!
translation: 死吧！

original: I found some of it. Some was here when I got here. I get some from them mercs.
translation: 我找到了一些。来的时候就有一些。我还从走私贩那里弄到一些。

original: And every once in a while, that weirdo with the boat comes up here and trades a few good things.
translation: 并且每隔一段时间，那个开船的古怪家伙就会来这里一次并交易一些好东西。

original: Look around. It's all here.
translation: 随便看吧。都在这呢。

original: I got all sorts of stuff. Take a look.
translation: 我这里什么都有。看看我的货吧。

original: That's what I'm here for.
translation: 我就是为这来的。

original: I knew that's why you came to me...
translation: 我知道你为什么来找我…

original: All of Madam Panada's wares are top quality.
translation: 帕娜达女士的商品可都是最优质的。

original: And what is it you would like to purchase?
translation: 你想要买什么东西呢？

original: Well, I'll be. Here, let me give you something for your trouble.
translation: 嗯，不会吧。来，我给你点补偿吧。

original: Tell you what - have a bit. This is left over from an old batch, but should be a swig or two there. More'n enough to loosen you up, I wager!
translation: 告诉你—来一点。这是一批老货里剩的，可能够喝一两口。足够让你放松了，我打赌。

original: Gristle and gore await! Proceed inside and use the button, as before.
translation: 软骨和血块在等待着你！进到里面来，并且按下那个按钮，就像以前一样。

original: It feels good to work with dirt, doesn't it? Some people call it work, but they don't understand.
translation: 跟土打交道的感觉可是相当好的，不是吗？有些人说那叫工作，实际上他们根本不理解。

original: Take my shovel. It has seen much use, and much dirt. Maybe it will help you?
translation: 拿上我的铲子。已经使用过很多次了，上面还有不少泥土。也许能帮上你的忙？

original: But be careful not to cut yourself with it. It can make you sick.
translation: 小心点，不要被它割伤。不然你会因此得病的。

original: I do not know if this is a secret, but I have always used this shovel. It has seen much work, and much dirt.
translation: 我不知道这算不算秘诀，但我一直用这把铲子。它见证了许多工作和泥土。

original: If it helps, have it. But be careful not to cut yourself. It can make you sick.
translation: 如果它能帮上忙，你就把它拿去。但小心别割到自己，它会让你得病的。

original: Yes, yes, of course. Here's your errand fee. Now, give it to me!
translation: 好，好，当然。这是你的跑腿费。现在，把它给我！

original: Surely you're not considering giving it to Marcella? Come now, the woman can't rub two caps together. Give it to me and be paid.
translation: 你不会想把它给玛塞拉吧？得了吧，那女人连两盖子都凑不出。给我吧，然后拿钱。

original: There's no reason in your keeping that book - my book! Talk to me again when you've come to your senses.
translation: 你没理由留着那本书——我的书！想清楚了再来找我。

original: They attacked while I slept. I... I don't expect to survive. I only pray that you haven't taken that book to Obadiah. You must take up my mission.
translation: 他们趁我睡觉时发动袭击。我…我不奢望活下来。我只祈祷你没把那本书带去奥巴迪亚。你必须接受我的使命。

original: There is... one way to utterly destroy the Krivbeknih, but you must take a pilgrimage, far north of Point Lookout, in the Capital Wasteland.
translation: 有……个办法能彻底销毁黯日圣经，但你必须去朝圣，望海崖遥远的北方，首都废土。

original: Seek a place called Dunwich. Within is an obelisk, itself a wicked thing. It'll consume the book - you need only press the book to its surface.
translation: 寻找一个叫敦威治的地方，里面有一座方尖碑，本身就是邪恶之物。它将吞噬这本书——你只需将书按在它的表面。

original: May God shed his blessings upon you, child. Make haste for Dunwich.
translation: 愿上帝保佑你，孩子。快去敦威治。

original: My God, I am sorry for all my sins with all my heart. In choosing to do wrong and failing to do good, I have sinned against You whom I should...
translation: 天啊，我真心为我的罪孽悔过。我选择了行恶而非为善，我犯下了罪孽…

original: I'm gonna catch you!
translation: 我会捉到你的！

original: Hehe. That was fun.
translation: 呵呵。真有趣。

original: I'll get you!
translation: 我会捉到你的！

original: Haha! Here I come!
translation: 哈哈！我来了！

original: Look out!
translation: 小心！

original: Tag! You're it! You'll never catch me!
translation: 捉住了！该你了！你永远都捉不到我的！

original: Hark! Who goes there?
translation: 听着！谁在那儿？

original: Dammit! Trapped! I knew he'd try this!
translation: 该死！是陷阱！我就知道他会这么干！

original: He's just down this way!
translation: 顺着这条路就能找到他了！

original: And now we say goodbye.
translation: 现在是说再见的时候了。

original: I said another thing.
translation: 我说的是其他事。

original: We are talking.
translation: 我们正在谈话。

original: Hello yourself.
translation: 你好。

original: Don't be daft. You agreed to retrieve my book. With more haste than this, I would have thought.
translation: 别犯傻了，你答应帮我拿回书。我还以为会比现在更匆忙呢。

original: You need to head for the ritual site east of the boardwalk, and expect a fight.
translation: 你得去木栈道东边的仪式之地，可能会有一场战斗。

original: I'm afraid I don't have a copy of the scripture with me, but I can share a few passages. Here's one of my favorites.
translation: 我恐怕我没有经文的拷贝，不过我可以分享你几段。这是我比较中意的一段。

original: I tell you the truth, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be condemned;
translation: 我实话告诉你，无论谁听见我的话并且相信他会带给我永恒的生命，都不会受到责难。

original: he has crossed over from death to life.
translation: 他死里逃生。

original: Of course! "I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely."
translation: 当然！“我是阿尔法和欧米伽，是起始，亦是终结。我要将生命水的泉源白白赐给口渴的人。”

original: So lovely. Selflessness like that is a rare commodity these days. I can see why that particular passage inspired her.
translation: 真美啊。如今，像这样的无私精神已不多见了。我明白为什么这段话会鼓舞她了。

original: Leave me alone, okay?
translation: 别烦我，行么？

original: I appreciate the advice, but I'm fine, okay?
translation: 我很感激你的建议，但是我没事，明白？

original: You're not the boss of me.
translation: 你又不是我的老大。

original: Sure, okay.
translation: 当然，好的。

original: Whatever.
translation: 随便。

original: Yes, mother Woodrose.
translation: 是的，银背藤母亲。

original: I try to, sir.
translation: 先生，我会尽力的。

original: Yes. Simple.
translation: 是的。很简单。

original: As you say.
translation: 如你所说。

original: Thank you. Be at peace.
translation: 多谢。祝你平安。

original: It's worth a try. What's the worst that could happen? Nothing changes, only we've got a few more bruises. Big deal. Let's give it a shot.
translation: 值得一试。再糟还能怎样呢？我们顶多会有几处擦伤。没什么大不了的，试试看吧。

original: I promise I'll go easy on you.
translation: 我保证对你下手会轻点。

original: Your guess is as good as mine. I can't understand what they're saying. I don't remember half of what they did to me, and that might be a good thing.
translation: 你猜的和我想的差不多。我听不懂他们在说什么。他们对我做的事，我有一半都记不起来了，这或许反而是件好事。

original: I know we ain't the only ones; there's a whole bunch of us in here. They'll pluck folks out every now and then.
translation: 我知道不只是我们，这还有一大群和我们一样的人。他们时不时就会挑出几个带走。

original: Sometimes they bring 'em back... Sometimes they don't. Either way, I ain't keen to find out what they're doing.
translation: 有时候会把人带回来……有时候就不会。不管怎样，我可不想知道他们在搞什么。

original: Okay, yeah. Let's do something about getting out.
translation: 对，是啊。让我们做点啥从这里出去。

original: Well, there ain't no easy way out. Trust me, I've looked. Can't even find anything to pry open, see what's blocking the doorway.
translation: 唉，根本没有轻松的出路。相信我，我看过了。连能用来撬一撬，看看是什么堵住门口的东西都找不到。

original: I'm thinkin' they did us a favor, putting us together in here like this. And I say we use it to our advantage.
translation: 我想他们这样把我们放在一起，反倒帮了我们一个忙。我说，咱们得利用这一点作为我们的优势。

original: Okay. Whatever you think is best.
translation: 好的。你觉得怎样好就怎么办。

original: Putting me on guard duty, huh? Swell.
translation: 让我站岗放哨，哈？真棒。

original: Fine. If I see any aliens, I'll say hello for you.
translation: 行。要是我看到外星人，会代你向他们问好的。

original: Now you're speakin' my language. Hell yeah, I'll come with you.
translation: 这可说到我心坎上了。当然行，我跟你一起去。

original: Heck yeah. I can take apart and put together a Protectron with my eyes shut. I'll go with you. Lead on.
translation: 那当然。我闭着眼睛都能拆解再组装一台保护者。我跟你去。带路吧。

original: Hmmm. Sounds like I may be of some use in there. If there are other people in stasis, I could help revive them or something. Just watch my back.
translation: 嗯……听起来在那儿我或许能派上用场。要是还有其他人处于静滞状态，我可以帮忙唤醒他们之类的。你只管帮我留意背后就行。

original: Does it really matter?
translation: 这真的很重要吗？

original: I mean, we're fighting to stay alive here. Whatever I did before we got to this point doesn't mean a whole lot right now.
translation: 我是说，我们在为了活下去拼尽全力。在我们陷入当前困境之前，无论我做过什么，现在看来意义不大。

original: Does it really matter?
translation: 这真的很重要吗？

original: I mean, we're fighting to stay alive here. Whatever I did before we got to this point doesn't mean a whole lot right now.
translation: 我是说，我们在为了活下去拼尽全力。在我们陷入当前困境之前，无论我做过什么，现在看来意义不大。

original: My what? Who the hell are you... oh my god... wait a minute!
translation: 我的什么？你们到底是谁……我的天……等一下！

original: Aliens! I was taken by aliens! You! You must be the aliens trying to get into my mind... well that's not gonna work!
translation: 外星人！我被外星人抓走了！你们！你们肯定是想窥探我思想的外星人……哼，这可不会得逞！

original: Private Elliott Tercorien, U.S. Army Medic, Serial Number 3477809. That's all I'm telling you.
translation: 列兵埃利奥特·特克里安，美国陆军军医，编号3477809。我就跟你们说这些。

original: Looks like this door's locked, too. Hang on, I'll see if I can get it from the other side.
translation: 看起来这扇门也锁上了。等一下，我看能不能从另一边打开。

original: I can't believe you killed him, he has it just as bad as us. I'll see you later.
translation: 我不敢相信你杀死了他，他和我们一样。迟点见。

original: I could use one of those stimpaks if you don't mind.
translation: 要是你不介意的话，我想来一支那种治疗针。

original: Fuck you and this whole fucking situation. They'll work when they work.
translation: 他妈的一团糟，需要它们时就能运作了。

original: Hmm, looks like I'm at the helm. I'll have these controls figured out in no time at all.
translation: 嗯，看来我负责掌舵。我很快就能搞清楚这些操控装置怎么用。

original: That's my squad in there! What the hell are the aliens doing to them?
translation: 里面的是我的小队！这些外星人在对他们做什么？

original: You green bastards! Get your hands off them!
translation: 你们这群绿杂种！把你的手拿开！

original: There has to be a way to release their containment seal! Maybe there's a button or something on this console.
translation: 肯定有办法打开他们的密封装置！也许这个控制台上有按钮之类的东西。

original: They're flanking us from behind. Quick, find some cover.
translation: 他们正从后面包抄我们。快，寻找掩护。

original: So that's the generator. Now how the heck do we destroy it?
translation: 原来那就是发电机。可我们究竟要怎么毁掉它呢？

original: Get a load of this!
translation: 拿上这个！

original: Would ya look at that...
translation: 你看那个……

original: Wow!
translation: 哇！

original: It's holding fine for now, I guess. It should help with the bastards teleporting onto the ship.
translation: 我猜它现在运行得好极了，它能够帮你传送到飞船顶部。

original: Hey, don't forget to put on the Astronaut's Suit before starting the decompression sequence.
translation: 嘿，在开始减压程序前，别忘了穿上宇航服。

original: I got it! The deathray is working and will be fully charged in 30 seconds!
translation: 知道了！死光正在运行，还需要30秒才能充能完毕！

original: 20%. I hope you've got a plan.
translation: 20%。我希望你另有打算。

original: Can't be sure if I'm reading this right, but it looks like they're hitting us pretty hard. Hull integrity is at about 90%.
translation: 我不确定这读数是否正确，不过看起来它们正在猛攻我们。飞船耐久度约为90%。

original: Ship's at 30%. I hope you have something up your sleeve.
translation: 飞船耐久度30%。你最好抓紧时间。

original: At about 60%. Do something.
translation: 大约60%。做点什么。

original: 30%. This is not good.
translation: 30%。大事不妙。

original: Watch out, more are coming from behind you. I'll try to block their progress.
translation: 小心，更多敌人从你身后过来了。我会试着拉住他们。

original: It's obvious, isn't it? They're threatening us. You could tell just by the way he sounded.
translation: 很明显，不是吗？它们在恐吓我们。你能从刚才它的语气里听出来。

original: Are you kidding me? That was stupid of them. Now we know they're getting desperate.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？它们太蠢了，我们知道它们已经要绝望了。

original: Give me a minute, I'll try to get these doors open for you.
translation: 给我一分钟，我试着帮你把这些门打开。

original: Wow, that looks dangerous. See if you can turn it off while I try and figure this door out.
translation: 哇，那看起来很危险。我想法子打开这扇门，你看看能不能把它关掉。

original: Uh-oh. I think they found a way to get to you. I'll try and get the next door open fast!
translation: 哎呀不好。我觉得他们找到接近你的办法了。我会赶紧打开下一扇门！

original: Hang on! One of these buttons has got to open that door...
translation: 坚持住！这些按钮中肯定有一个能打开那扇门……

original: Their radios got quiet all of a sudden. I'd be careful if I were you...
translation: 他们的无线电突然没声了。如果我是你，我会小心点……

original: More could bust in at any second. Get ready!
translation: 随时都可能有更多家伙冲进来，做好准备！

original: I told you so! Ambush!
translation: 我告诉过你的！有埋伏！

original: We're almost out of here! I'll meet you up ahead. Hurry!
translation: 我们就快离开这儿了！我在前面和你碰头。快点！

original: Elliott... Is that you? What... What's going on? Where the hell are we?
translation: 埃利奥特……是你吗？怎么……怎么了？我们到底在哪里？

original: Agh... feels like someone rearranged my insides. What happened to us?
translation: 啊……感觉有人把我内脏重新摆弄了一番。我们遭遇了什么？

original: Wait! I think that's some more of my squad!
translation: 等等！我想那是我小队的其他成员！

original: Okay, let's see. This must initiate the thawing process. Blood pressure looks normal. Heart rate... normal enough.
translation: 好，我们来看看。这个肯定是启动解冻程序的。血压看起来正常。心率……也还算正常。

original: Okay. Lets put these guys to use.
translation: 好的。让这些伙计派上用场吧。

original: No sense discussin’ it now.
translation: 现在讨论这个没意义。

original: I don’t know, but maybe we should... there must be something...
translation: 我不知道，但也许我们应该……肯定有办法的……

original: And how are we supposed to do that? We can’t understand what the hell they’re saying!
translation: 那我们该怎么做？我们根本听不懂他们在说些什么鬼话！

original: He’s not going anywhere. Why don’t we just hold on to him, and try to negotiate? Y’know, like a hostage?
translation: 他哪也去不了。我们为什么不把他扣下，试着谈判呢？你懂的，就像人质那样？

original: Hmmm. Let me take some of this cryogenic compound back to the engine core. I might be able to make some use of it.
translation: 嗯。我带些这种低温化合物回引擎核心，也许能派上用场。

original: Wait just a second...
translation: 稍等一下……

original: Try hitting that button down there. It's flashing, it probably does something good.
translation: 试着按那个按钮。它在闪，也许能派上些用场。

original: There's some alien goo tubes on that table over there. I've seen them use it to fix guns and stuff. I bet it'll work for you too.
translation: 那边桌子上有些外星凝胶管，我见过它们用它来修理武器等东西。我相信它也能为你所用。

original: Go away, meanie! Just you wait 'till my friend gets here!
translation: 走开，讨厌鬼！等我朋友来了有你好看的！

original: Hey, we're moving... Cool!
translation: 嘿，我们在移动……太酷了！

original: Aliens! Look out!
translation: 外星人！小心！

original: Cows? We got cows!
translation: 牛？我们看到了牛了！

original: Yeah, I think so. Before I was shipped out to Anchorage, I was trained in cryoscience. We were hoping to apply that to medicine.
translation: 嗯，我觉得可以。我被派到安克雷奇之前，接受过低温科学方面的培训。当时我们希望能将其应用于医学领域。

original: The compounds we used weren't that different from this cryogenic liquid. I'm pretty sure I can make us some improvised weapons from it.
translation: 我们之前用的化合物和这种低温液体没有太大区别。我很确定能用它制作一些简易武器。

original: I'm thinking something along the lines of cryo grenades and cryo mines... I don't know yet.
translation: 我在考虑制作类似低温手雷和冷冻地雷之类的东西……目前还不确定。

original: Check back with me in about an hour and I'll see what I can do.
translation: 大概一小时后再来找我，看看我能做出什么。

original: Yeah, sure did. I was able to make a few cryo grenades and cryo mines.
translation: 那当然。我已经制作出了几枚冰冻手榴弹和冰冻地雷。

original: I can make more, but I'll need around three more hours. Keep checking back with me and I'll tinker with it.
translation: 我还能做更多，但大概还需要三个小时。你可以继续来找我，我会不断改进。

original: Here you go. Hope you're making good use of them. If you need more, I should have a batch ready in about three hours.
translation: 给你，希望你好好利用。要是还需要，大约三小时后我这儿又能有一批。

original: Not yet. Still working on them.
translation: 还没有。还在制作中。

original: Oh, sessha no ken! Katajike nai.
translation: 哦，在下的剑！万分感激。

original: Sumanuga, korekara dosuruka hitoride kangaetai. Shitsurei suru.
translation: 抱歉，在下想独自细想今后的打算。失礼了。

original: Got it! Give me a minute to sneak around them.
translation: 收到！给我点时间绕他们后面。

original: Cool!
translation: 酷！

original: Give me just a second to get behind them...
translation: 给我一点时间绕到他们身后……

original: Do you think we were noticed?
translation: 你觉得我们被发现了吗？

original: Oh, I get it! We're in one of their trash cans that move around the ship. I always wondered where these things go...
translation: 哦，我知道了！我们在他们飞船上的一个移动式垃圾桶里。我一直好奇这些东西都去哪儿了……

original: Gas. Flammable gas.
translation: 瓦斯。可燃气体。

original: They're flooding the room with gas.
translation: 它们想用瓦斯灌满这房间。

original: Hell, my horse never did that...
translation: 真见鬼，我的马从来不那样…

original: Our situation didn't get any better by the looks of what happened here. I say we get the hell out of here.
translation: 这里发生的事并没改善我们的处境。要我说，我们该离开这鬼地方了。

original: Curious, but I don't think I want to know the answer judging by what happened here. Let's not stay long, this place gives me the creeps.
translation: 有点好奇，但关于这里发生了什么来看，我不想知道答案。我们别待太久了，这地方让我毛骨悚然。

original: What kind of horses are these anyway? I can't see anyone havin' any respect ridin' into town on one of those things.
translation: 这到底是什么马？我不觉得骑这种东西会有人尊重我。

original: What are they doing to the Buttercups?
translation: 它们在对奶油小马做什么？

original: Oh OK, now it all makes sense...
translation: 哦，好吧，现在一切都说得通了……

original: Why look at what we got here. Little girl here ridin' one of those horses. Giddyup Buttercup...kind of catchy ain't it?
translation: 看看我们这里有什么。小姑娘骑在马背上。奶油小马……它挺吸引人的，不是吗？

original: Oh wow. I remember these posters plastered all over the place back home.
translation: 哇。我记得老家那里到处都贴着这样的海报。

original: They even have some of the posters I've seen scattered about the Wastes. Looks like they're studying them...or idolizing them, not sure.
translation: 它们甚至有那些我在废土上见过的海报，看来它们正在学习…或者崇拜它们，我不确定。

original: Giddyup.
translation: 驾。

original: This is kind of disturbing.
translation: 令人不安。

original: OK, this is getting a little ridiculous now.
translation: 有点意思。

original: Well I'll be damned...look at all 'em!
translation: 好吧，我会被诅咒的… 看看它们！

original: Look, even more of them. Buttercups that is.
translation: 看啊，还有更多。奶油小马。

original: Huh, I wonder what they're doing with them.
translation: 我想知道它们正在对他做什么。

original: Hey look, Giddyup Buttercups! All the rich kids had them. Waste of money if you ask me.
translation: 嗨，看啊，奶油小马！有钱的孩子都有。但要我说那就是浪费钱。

original: You've got to be kidding me... I saw posters like these all over the ruins. Never actually saw one 'til now.
translation: 你一定是在开玩笑……我在废墟中见过类似所有这些一样的海报。但直到现在从没见过一个这样的。

original: Now that looks like some tough ridin'. Those things real?
translation: 现在那看起来有些不好骑的样子。那些东西是真的吗？

original: Yes, yes, I understand! I've seen the others. I'll do what you want.
translation: 是的，是的，我明白！我见过其他人了。我会照你说的办。

original: This is Doctor Morrison Rand, Professor of Anthropological Archaeology at Banfield College, Humboldt, Oregon.
translation: 这是莫莉森·兰德博士，俄勒冈州洪堡班菲尔德学院的人类考古学教授。

original: Shortly after 10:00 p.m., on August 16, 2041, as I was leaving the college campus, headed to my car, I saw a blinding light.
translation: 2041年8月16日下午10时后，就在我离开大学校园，走向我的汽车的时候，我看到了一道耀眼的光芒。

original: It just... appeared. In the sky, directly over me. I was blinded. I also found my body completely immobilized. I couldn't move, not at all.
translation: 它…出现了。在天上，直对着我。我看不见了。我还发现我的身体被完全固定了。一动都不能动。

original: What happened next is... hazy. I don't remember much. But what became clear later - what is certainly clear now - is that I was abducted.
translation: 后来发生的事很…朦胧。我记不太清。但我后来明白了一些事—现在则彻底明白了—我被绑架了。

original: I am now the captive of an alien race, one of many people held here, against our will. And, like those others, I am recording who I am.
translation: 我现在是外星人的俘虏，被强行囚禁在这的人中的一员。和其他人一样，我正在记录着我是谁。

original: Why? Because the aliens want us to, for some reason. They have us do it right before they put us into some kind of... suspended animation.
translation: 为什么？因为出于某种原因，外星人要我们这样做。它们要让我们进入了一种…假死状态。

original: These recordings... It's almost as if we're creating our own library catalog entries, before we get put into a giant collection.
translation: 这些录音…这就相当于我们正在创建我们自己的资料库索引条目，在当我们被放置进一个巨大的收集库之前。

original: The entire experience would be fascinating if I weren't so completely terrified.
translation: 如果我不是被吓坏了，这个经历将会是多么令人着迷。

original: What? Stop? You want me to stop now. All right! All right, see? I'm stopping...
translation: 什么？停止？你要我现在停止。好吧！好吧，明白了，我已经停止了…

original: What? Talk into this thing? Just... talk? I don't have to do anything else?
translation: 什么？谈谈？只是…谈？我不需要做什么其他的事？

original: Ow! All right! <Zap!> Ow! I said all right! Just stop!
translation: 嗷！好吧！<电击声！> 嗷！我说好吧！快停下！

original: Hello. Um... hello. My name is Andrew Endicott.
translation: 你好…我叫安德鲁·恩迪科特。

original: On the night of May 17th, the year our Lord 1697, I was... I was taken. From my home in Salem Village.
translation: 在5月17日晚上，教历1697年，我被……带走了，从塞勒姆村的家里。

original: I... I do not know where I am, exactly, or why I came to be here.
translation: 我…我不知道我在哪里，还有为什么会来到这里。

original: I have seen, through... windows... the stars, and sun, and beloved Earth. Down there, below me.
translation: 透过…窗户…我看到星星、太阳和亲爱的地球。就在那里，在我脚下。

original: So it would seem I am aboard some vessel, suspended in the ether. Ironically, it would seem, so close to where I thought Heaven must surely lie.
translation: 我似乎是上了一艘悬浮在以太中的飞船。讽刺的是，这看似非常接近我曾认为是天堂的所在之处。

original: But this is not Heaven. And my captors are not angels. I am not entirely unconvinced that the scripture is wrong. That Heaven and Hell are reversed.
translation: 但这不是天堂，虏劫我的并非天使。我不是说信奉的圣经是错的，天堂与地狱已然颠倒。

original: For my captives are devils. Demons from my nightmares. Even now they watch me, make me talk.
translation: 虏劫我的人是魔鬼。来自我噩梦中的魔鬼。即使是现在它们还在盯着我，逼我开口。

original: They seem to want me to tell my story. I know not why. A record of their deeds, perhaps? Or am I just a pawn in some... some evil game.
translation: 它们似乎想知道我的故事。我不知道为什么。也许是为了它们的一项记录？或者我只是一只棋子…一只邪恶游戏中的棋子。

original: And there are others. Other... captives, I mean. From whence they came I cannot say.
translation: 还有其他一些。其他…我是说，俘虏。我不能确定他们来自何方。

original: Some wear strange dress, as if they are from... a different time. And some are... frozen! As in ice! Unmoving! But, I think... alive.
translation: 一些穿着怪异的服装，好像来自…不同的时代。一些是…被冻结的！在冰块里！一动不动！但是我觉得是…活的。

original: I believe they plan the same fate for me. Will I be frozen, too? Will I...
translation: 我相信它们也打算给予我同样的命运。我也会被冻起来？我将……

original: Ow! Stop it! I did what you said! You wanted me to talk, so I talked! Just leave me! Leave me be!
translation: 噢！住手！我照你说的做了！你要我说，我都说了！现在放过我！放过我吧！

original: We'll be at the engineering core in no time!
translation: 我们马上就能到工程中枢了！

original: Nuka what?
translation: 核子什么？

original: Thirsty? Heh, I wonder if the aliens love this stuff as much we do down below.
translation: 口渴了？嘿，我怀疑外星人和我们下面的人一样喜欢这东西。

original: Nuka-Cola! You know, they came out with this stuff called Nuka-Cola Quantum way back. Now that was some powerful stuff. I can still taste it now.
translation: 核子可乐！我知道，他们中途还推出过种叫做量子型核子可乐的玩意。那可是相当带劲的东西。我现在嘴里都还有它的味道。

original: I wouldn't go jumpin' down there if I were you.
translation: 要是我是你的话，是不会冒险下去的。

original: Now that's what I call a trash chute. I wouldn't get too close, don't wanna fall in or anything.
translation: 那就是被我称为垃圾瀑布的玩意。我可不想靠太近，免得掉下去或出别的什么事。

original: Well, that's one way to take out the garbage.
translation: 好吧，那就是条处理垃圾的通道。

original: Okay, here it is. Neat, huh?
translation: 好了，在这。对吗，是吧?

original: Oh god, what are you doing to me? What's that thing? Get it out of me!
translation: 天哪，你在对我做什么？那是什么东西？把它从我身上拿掉！

original: Ahhh... that hurts... oh, please... stop... no... <grunting>
translation: 啊……疼……噢，拜托……停下……不要……<惨叫声>

original: <growling noises>
translation: <嗥叫声>

original: Wow, look at this place! It looks like the ship in Captain Cosmos!
translation: 天哪看看这里！简直和《宇宙舰长》里的飞船一模一样！

original: Uh-oh...
translation: 哦不……

original: We're stuck. Let me see if I can figure something out.
translation: 我们被困住了。让我看看能不能想出什么办法。

original: Wow! This looks just like the bridge on Captain Cosmos! I know what to do!
translation: 哇！这里看起来就跟《宇宙舰长》里的舰桥一模一样！我知道该怎么做啦！

original: Shit, they hit the core and sapped our power. Look around for some buttons or something to restart the generators.
translation: 该死，他们击中了核心，耗尽了我们的能量。找找有没有按钮之类的东西，重启发电机。

original: Lights out, they killed our power! Maybe there's some buttons or something around here to restart this hunk of junk.
translation: 灯灭了，他们切断了我们的电力！也许这附近有按钮之类的东西能重启这堆破玩意儿。

original: Things are flashing again! We got flashing things! You must be doing something right. Keep it up!
translation: 东西又闪起来了！我们让灯闪了！你肯定做对了什么。继续！

original: Holy shit. Where did that come from?
translation: 操。那是从哪冒出来的?

original: Just take it easy. If they wanted us dead, we'd be dead. They must need something from us.
translation: 放松点。如果它们要弄死我们，我们早就死了。它们一定要我们做什么。

original: Hey! I said, calm down! If they hear you they may come for us. Try and take it easy!
translation: 嗨！冷静点！如果它们听到你的话就要来抓我们了！

original: I said to SHUT UP! <slap>... I'm... I'm sorry I did that. Please, forgive me. But we need to keep our heads on straight if we're going to survive.
translation: 我说闭嘴！<打耳光> 我很……我很抱歉这样对你。原谅我。不过我们要生存下去就要时刻保持头脑清醒。

original: What are we gonna do? They just threw me in this cell with you after they poked and prodded me and now I just hope they won't kill us.
translation: 我们怎么办？它们刚才对我又戳又刺的，现在又把我跟你丢到了一起，希望它们不要杀了我们。

original: Just take it easy. If they wanted us dead, we'd be dead. They must need something from us.
translation: 放松点。如果它们要弄死我们，我们早就死了。它们一定要我们做什么。

original: Yeah! They need us for FOOD or something! You saw that guy! He was all... cut open... like he'd been butchered! Oh my god! We're gonna be next!
translation: 对！它们应该把我们当作食物或什么的！你看那家伙！他就被整个…切开了…就像被屠宰了一样！天哪！我们就是下一个了！

original: Hey! I said, calm down! If they hear you they may come for us. Try and take it easy!
translation: 嗨！冷静点！如果它们听到你的话就要来抓我们了。试着放轻松点！

original: NO! GET US THE HELL OUT OF HERE! <pounding noise> SOMEONE! GET US OUT! PLEASE! <pounding noise>
translation: 不！带我离开这个鬼地方！！<砸墙声>有人吗？救我们出去！！求你了！

original: I said to SHUT UP! <slap>... I'm... I'm sorry I did that. Please, forgive me. But we need to keep our heads on straight if we're going to survive.
translation: 我说闭嘴！<打耳光> 我很……我很抱歉这样对你。原谅我。不过我们要生存下去就要时刻保持头脑清醒。

original: Please, please. I just want to go home... I just want to go home...
translation: 救命，救命。我只想回家…我只想回家…

original: Our defenses consist of 3 battalions of light infantry, 34 pieces of field artillery, 108 armored vehicles and 42 aerial vehicles.
translation: 我们的防御包括3个轻步兵营，34门重炮，108辆装甲车辆以及42个飞行单位。

original: We have 38 ICBM's always on alert and ready to fire when the word is passed down from the White House.
translation: 我们有38枚受命白宫随时准备发射的洲际导弹。

original: The codes to activate the launch sequences are... are... uhhngh... no... I can't let you... uggh... get out of my mind!
translation: 发射导弹的密码是……是……啊~~……不……我不能让你们……噢……从我的脑子滚出去！

original: Agggh! The c-codes... are... ugh... no... I can't betray... AGH! My head! I can't... won't... AGGGGH! Agggh...
translation: 啊~~~！密……密码……是……噢……不……我不能背叛……唔呃！我的头！我不能……不会……啊~~~！啊~~~……

original: Damn it. Their shields are back up at max.
translation: 该死。它们的护盾能量又充满了。

original: I told Mr. Elliott this really funny joke earlier, but he didn't get it. He's weird.
translation: 我之前给埃利奥特先生讲了个很好笑的笑话，但他没听懂。他真怪。

original: Yep, sure thing!
translation: 当然，没问题！

original: Here you go.
translation: 给你。

original: Here's everything I've got.
translation: 这是我拿到的所有东西。

original: Oh, yeah! Here, you can have this stuff. I found it when I was looking around the rest of the ship.
translation: 哦，对了！给，这些东西你拿去吧。我在飞船其他地方查看的时候找到的。

original: Yep, I was able to scrounge up some more stuff for you. Here you go, Captain!
translation: 有，我又给你搜罗到了一些东西。给你，舰长！

original: Sir, yes sir! I found some more supplies for you, sir!
translation: 长官，有汇报！长官，我又给您找到了些补给物资！

original: Oh, korekoso sessha no ken. Katajike nai.
translation: 哦，这正是在下的剑。万分感激。

original: Sumanuga, sessha mizukara korekara okorukotoni sonaeneba naranu.
translation: 抱歉，在下必须独自应对今后所发生之事。

original: Oh, sessha no ken! Kaeshite moraerutowa, katajike nai.
translation: 哦，在下的剑！承蒙寻回，万分感激。

original: Sumanuga, sessha mizukara korekara okorukotoni sonaeneba naranu.
translation: 抱歉，在下必须独自应对今后所发生之事。

original: Hmm... maybe, just maybe, they're responsible for life on earth. Like, they seeded the planet a really long time ago.
translation: 嗯……可能，仅是可能，地球上的生命是他们造就的。比如说，他们很久以前就在地球上播种生命了。

original: And they've been coming back every once in a while to check on the progress... and now they've decided they don't like how it turned out.
translation: 然后他们时不时回来查看进展……而现在，他们觉得事情发展的结果不如意。

original: Can you imagine? They made us and now they're pissed at us!
translation: 你能想象吗？他们创造了我们，现在却对我们大为光火！

original: Well, at least it wasn't coming for us...
translation: 好吧，至少它不是冲着我们来的……

original: Hello, Mr. Alien. Yeah, I know... I'll talk into the thing.
translation: 你好，外星人先生。嗯，我知道……我会对着那东西讲话的。

original: I don't know why you brought me back here. We've done this a whole bunch of... Hey! Giddyup Buttercup! Wow!
translation: 我不知道你为什么带我回来。我们已经做过很多次了……嘿！奶油小马！哇哦！

original: I always wanted one of those!... Why do you have one?
translation: 我一直想要一个！……你怎么会有？

original: I don't understand... What do you want? It's a toy. A TOY. Why are you so excited? You're weird.
translation: 我不懂……你想要什么？这是玩具。一个玩具。你为什么这么兴奋？你真奇怪。

original: Oh, great.
translation: 哦，真棒。

original: All right, listen. Not that it's any of your damn business, but yeah. Before I got sucked up into this crazy alien land here, I pulled some shady stuff.
translation: 好吧，听着。虽说这不关你屁事，但没错。在我被卷进这疯狂的外星人世界之前，我做过些不光彩的事。

original: Many of my associates may or may not have been slavers, and I may or may not have received payment for helping them in their trade.
translation: 我的很多伙伴可能是奴隶贩子，也可能不是，而我可能收了钱帮他们做奴隶买卖，也可能没有。

original: Okay? Big secret exposed! Great job! Hope you're happy.
translation: 行了吧？重大秘密曝光了！干得好！希望你满意。

original: A reason? Yeah, there's a reason. It's because I worked for slavers, okay? I worked for them, I helped them, and sometimes I liked it.
translation: 原因？是的，是有原因。我为奴隶贩子工作，对吧？我为他们工作，我帮助他们，我就喜欢这样。

original: They needed someone who was good with machines, stripping tech, building shit. That's me.
translation: 他们需要擅长摆弄机器的人，精通技术，制造机器。那个人就是我。

original: So I did the work. And look where it got me. Now can we stop talking about me?
translation: 是的，那就是我做的，看看我得到了什么？现在能不能别再讨论我了？

original: <sobbing>
translation: <哭泣声>

original: Please... just please, let me go...
translation: 拜托……拜托了，让我走吧……

original: <mechanical sounds>
translation: <机器声>

original: Well, not really shut it off... More like blow it up. If you turn off the coolant, it'll get really hot and then explode, so be careful, okay?
translation: 嗯，也不是真的把它关掉……更像是把它炸了。如果你关掉冷却剂，它会变得非常热然后爆炸，所以要小心，好吗？

original: You have to shut that off to open the door here.
translation: 你得关掉那个才能打开这的门。

original: What the hell is this thing? What are we supposed to do with it?
translation: 这到底是什么东西？我们该拿它怎么办？

original: All clear out there, captain, sir!
translation: 那边一切都好，队长！

original: Nothing I couldn't handle, captain, sir!
translation: 没什么我不能解决的，队长！

original: You're damn right she's a bitch. Ruined my whole goddamn life. But I can see you don't give a crap about any of that. Fine.
translation: 你他妈的太对了，她就是个婊子。毁了我他妈的一生。不过我看你对这些都不在乎。好吧。

original: Just don't go telling Harkness though. He won't believe you anyway. And you really don't want to see him upset. He can be a bit... inhospitable.
translation: 只是别告诉哈克尼斯。反正他也不会相信你。而且你真的不想看到他生气。他有时候有点……不近人情。

original: I didn't win it, huh? Well, there'll always be other elections.
translation: 我没赢对吧，呃？嗯，还会有下一次选举的。

original: There'll always be other elections.
translation: 总会有下一次的。

original: Who needs it. I'd prefer to be second in command anyway.
translation: 谁稀罕。我宁愿当副手。

original: The people have re-elected me as their president.
translation: 人们又选了我作为他们的总统。

original: It's great to see the democratic process at work.
translation: 如此民主的过程真是让人欣慰啊。

original: There was a tie. Under these unique circumstances, I'll have to remain the leader until we know the results for sure.
translation: 出现了平局。在这种罕见的情况下，我将继续作为领袖直到确认选举结果。

original: Under these unique circumstances, I'll have to remain the leader until we know the results for sure.
translation: 在这种罕见的情况下，我将继续作为领袖直到确认选举结果。

original: I had always assumed if a human happened upon our home, it would be for the purpose of our extermination.
translation: 我一直以为如果有人类接近我们的家，就是来屠杀我们的。

original: It appears my fears were ill-placed. It is a pleasant surprise to meet someone as amenable as yourself.
translation: 看来我的担心是错误的。能碰见像你这样通情达理的人真是让人惊奇。

original: Very well. I will allow you to speak to Ian. Perhaps you can help him come to grips with his greatest enemy. Himself.
translation: 很好，我会让你去找伊恩谈。或许你能帮他对付他最大的敌人。他自己。

original: Indeed? Tell me what you've learned from the Laws. What do you think we are?
translation: 真的？告诉我你从我们的法则里明白了什么？你觉得我们是什么？

original: Very well, I've waited this long, a bit longer won't make much difference.
translation: 好吧，我已经等了那么久，再多等一会也没差。

original: In the meantime, allow me to get back to my calculations.
translation: 与此同时，请允许我继续我的演算。

original: Well, there is the personal shelter next to the old diner.
translation: 嗯，有一个圆形遮蔽所就在餐厅旁。

original: Pappa always said to stay away from it... but, I guess it's supposed to be safe.
translation: 爸爸总是让我离那远点……但我觉得那里面很安全。

original: I'll head over there and wait inside. Hurry back!
translation: 我会躲在那里面。快点回来！

original: Hmph. Didn't think you had it in you. Guess you proved me wrong. Good job. Knowing those Ghouls are gone takes a load off my mind. Thanks.
translation: 哼哼。没想到你还真有两下子，看来你证明我错了。好样的。知道那些尸鬼都没了，我也放心了。谢谢。

original: You'll be wanting the reward now, won't you? I suppose you've earned it.
translation: 你现在想要报酬了吧？我觉得这是你应得的。

original: There's your caps. Contract fulfilled, debt paid. This don't mean we're buddies, alright? Now get going.
translation: 这是你的瓶盖。约定完成，欠债付清。这并不意味着我们是同伴了，懂吗？现在走吧。

original: That witch ruined my life, but you're right. Who gives a crap about any of that.
translation: 那泼妇毁了我的生活。但你是对的，谁会在乎那些呢。

original: Just don't go telling Harkness though. He won't believe you anyway. And you really don't want to see him upset. He can be a bit... inhospitable.
translation: 只是别告诉哈克尼斯。反正他也不会相信你。而且你真的不想看到他生气。他有时候有点……不近人情。

original: Well, she's got nothing to do with anything, except ruining my whole goddamn life. But I can see you don't give a crap about any of that. Fine.
translation: 嗯，她跟任何事都没关系，除了毁了我他妈的一生。不过我看你对这些都不在乎。好吧。

original: Just don't go telling Harkness though. He won't believe you anyway. And you really don't want to see him upset. He can be a bit... inhospitable.
translation: 只是别告诉哈克尼斯。反正他也不会相信你。而且你真的不想看到他生气。他有时候有点……不近人情。

original: Well, go get it!
translation: 那就去拿来！

original: I'm not going to just take your word for it. I want that key.
translation: 我可不信空口无凭的话。我要那钥匙。

original: Well, go get it!
translation: 那就去拿来！

original: I'm not going to just take your word for it. I want something of his as proof.
translation: 我可不信空口无凭的话。我需要一些他的东西来证明。

original: Well, go get it!
translation: 那就去拿来！

original: I'm not going to just take your word for it. I want that key.
translation: 我可不信空口无凭的话。我要那钥匙。

original: Well, go get it!
translation: 那就去拿来！

original: I'm not going to just take your word for it. I want something of his as proof.
translation: 我可不信空口无凭的话。我需要一些他的东西来证明。
